p-001.title: Simba rekudziisa tyubhu inochengetedza kupisa
p-001.summary: Kana ukadira mvura inopisa mutyubhu inochengetedza kupisa kuti iite kuti inwiwa irambe ichipisa kwenguva refu.
p-001.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa kunoitika nekufambisa, kufamba kwemhepo uye kubwinya; vhiki yemhepo inodzikisa kufambisa nekufamba, madziro akaiswa sirivha anodzikisa kubwinya. Kupisa $Q = mc\Delta T$ kunotanga kushandiswa kupisa madziro echirongo.
p-001.example: Kudziya madziro estainless e500 mL tyubhu (anenge 200g, $c\approx0.5\ \mathrm{J/g\cdot K}$) kubva pa 20°C kusvika pa 90°C kunoda anenge 7kJ. Pasina kudziya, inwiwa inopa kupisa uku uye inotonhora nenge 3–4°C pakutanga.
p-001.actionItem: Nhasi mangwanani zadza tyubhu nemvura ichibika, siya maminitsi 3, dururira kunze wozodira inwiwa.

p-002.title: Dzikisa chikafu chinopisa usati wachiisa mufiriji
p-002.summary: Kana ukaisa muto unopisa mufiriji pakarepo, unodziya zvimwe zvokudya zvichiita kuti magetsi ashandiswe zvakawanda.
p-002.principle: Firiji inofanira kubudisa kupisa kwakapinda $Q = mc\Delta T$ nekompresa. Mudziyo usina kudzika uye mupamhi une nzvimbo yakakura, saka unotonhora nokukurumidza $P = hA\Delta T$.
p-002.example: Kutonhodza muto we3 L (80°C) kusvika pa5°C kunoreva anenge $3000\times4.18\times75\approx940\ \mathrm{kJ}$ kufiriji. Kana ukatanga kuutonhodza kusvika pa40°C panzvimbo yekupisa, unochengeta anenge hafu.
p-002.actionItem: Nhasi isa chikafu chaibikwa mumidziyo isina kudzika, chitonhodze kusvika pa30–40°C wozochiisa mufiriji mukati memaawa 2.

p-003.title: Kuvharira mahwindo nepurasitiki yemhepo
p-003.summary: Kana ukanamira purasitiki yemhepo pahwindo, mhepo yakamira inodzikisa zvakanyanya kurasikirwa kwekupisa.
p-003.principle: Kuendesa kupisa kwemhepo yakamira kuri anenge $0.026\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$, ndiko 1/40 yegirazi ($1.0$). Mukurasikirwa kwekupisa $Q = UA\Delta T$ $U$ kunodzika.
p-003.example: Hwindo rimwe 2 $\mathrm{m^2}$ nekusiyana kwekupisa kwemukati nekunze kwe20°C, pa$U\approx5.8$ kurasikirwa kuri 232W. Kana $U\approx3.5$ yadzikiswa kusvika pa3.5 nepurasitiki yemhepo, kurasikirwa kunoita 140W, unochengeta anenge 90W.
p-003.actionItem: Nhasi dzvanya mvura pahwindo sezvainoenderana nehukuru, woisa divi rakachena repurasitiki yemhepo pagirazi.

p-004.title: Gumbeze remagetsi kana boiler
p-004.summary: Kana uri woga, gumbeze remagetsi rinopisa nzvimbo yakatenderedza muviri chete rinoshanda zvakanyanya kupfuura kupisa imba yose.
p-004.principle: Simba rekupisa ndi$E = Pt$ uye rinoenderana nehukuru hwenzvimbo inopiswa. Kana ukapisa nzvimbo diki chete pakati pemuviri negumbeze, kupisa kunodiwa kunopera.
p-004.example: Gumbeze remagetsi re50 W kwemaawa 8 rinoshandisa 0.4kWh. Kupisa imba yose ne4 kW kwemaawa 8 kunoshandisa kusvika pa32 kWh, saka musiyano uri kakawanda.
p-004.actionItem: Manheru ano dzikisa boiler ne1–2°C woshandisa gumbeze remagetsi pasimba rakadzika.

p-005.title: Kuchengeta mupunga wakapisa kana kuuisa mufiriji kuita zvikamu
p-005.summary: Panzvimbo yokuchengeta mupunga wakapisa mubika kwemaawa anopfuura 12, magetsi anoshandiswa zvishoma kana ukaupfumisa wakapatsanurwa uye woudziisazve.
p-005.principle: Kuchengeta kupisa kunoda kuramba uchizadza kurasikirwa kwekupisa kuburikidza nemadziro $P = UA\Delta T$. Kudziisazve mu microwave kunoshandisa $E = Pt$ panguva inodiwa chete.
p-005.example: Kuchengeta kupisa kwe60 W kwemaawa 24 kunoshandisa 1.44kWh. Kudziisazve mugove mumwe (200g) ne700 W kwemaminitsi 2 kunoshandisa anenge 0.023kWh.
p-005.actionItem: Nhasi putira mupunga wakasara muzvikamu mune foil, uwandire mufiriji wobvisa bhatani rekuchengeta kupisa.

p-006.title: Bhatiri refoni mukutonhora
p-006.summary: Foni inodzima pakarepo mukutonhora nokuti zviitiko zvemakemikari mubhatiri zvinononoka.
p-006.principle: Kumhanya kwemaion maererano neArrhenius $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ kunodzika zvakanyanya nekupisa kwakadzikira uye kuramba kwemukati kunowedzera, saka voltage inodzika.
p-006.example: Bhatiri re lithium-ion pa0°C rine simba rinoshandiswa renge 70–80% uye pa−10°C rinogona kudzikira zvakare. Foni yaiva ne100% inogona kuratidza 30% kunze uye ikadzima.
p-006.actionItem: Paunoenda kunze isa foni muhomwe yemukati, uye kana yadzima, iite yatonhora nemuviri wako woidzivisa zvakare.

p-007.title: Kutarisa bhatiri remotokari muzhizha rematsutso usati wadhonza
p-007.summary: Motokari haitange mukutonhora nokuti simba rebhatiri rinodzikira uye mafuta emuchina anobvirira.
p-007.principle: Simba rebhatiri ndi$P = V I$ uye mukutonhora kuramba kwemukati $r$ kunowedzera, saka voltage yetermina $V = \varepsilon - Ir$ inodzika.
p-007.example: Pakutanga ne400 A, kana kuramba kwemukati kukawedzera kubva pa0.01Ω kusvika pa0.02Ω, kudzika kwevoltage kunowedzera kubva pa4 V kusvika pa8 V uye nebhatiri re12 V kutanga kunonetsa.
p-007.actionItem: Nhasi usati watanga dzima mwenje nekudziya, uye bhatiri rinopfuura makore 3 rinoda kuongororwa.

p-008.title: Kufamba pachando
p-008.summary: Pachando, nzira yakanakisa yekushandisa kukwesha kuderedza nhanho uye kutsika netsoka yose.
p-008.principle: Mamiriro ekusadhonza ndiwo simba rakachinjika $F \le \mu N$. Pachando $\mu\approx0.05\text{-}0.1$, inenge 1/10 yetara rakaoma ($\approx0.7$).
p-008.example: Pakufamba, unodonha kana chiyero chesimba rakachinjika nerakamira $\tan\theta$ chikapfuura $\mu$. Kana ukadzikisa nhanho kusvika pahafu, $\theta$ inodzika uye unoramba uri munzvimbo yakachengeteka.
p-008.actionItem: Nhasi kana kuine chando, deredza nhanho kusvika pahafu yenguva dzose uye bvisa ruoko muhomwe.

p-009.title: Pakati pakasiyiwa mu microwave
p-009.summary: Kana ukaronga chikafu nenzira yedonati pamupendero, microwave inochidziisa zvakaenzana.
p-009.principle: Microwave inopisa nemafungu amire e2.45GHz uye maererano nehurefu hwemafungu $\lambda = c/f \approx 12.2\ \mathrm{cm}$ nzvimbo dzinopisa nedzinotonhora dzinoitika.
p-009.example: Pakati pepuranga pazhinji panotonhora nokuti mafungu madiki ipapo. Kana ukaronga chikafu pamupendero woshanda pakati penguva, musiyano wekupisa unogona kudzikira ne20°C kana kupfuura.
p-009.actionItem: Nhasi isa chikafu chekudziya pamupendero wepuranga uchisiya pakati pakasimba, woshanda pakati penguva.

p-010.title: Kubika uchivhara
p-010.summary: Kungovhara poto nechivharo chete kunodzikisa zvakanyanya mari yegasi.
p-010.principle: Kana mvura ichiputika, kupisa kwekupuruzira $L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{J/g}$ kunobuda. Chivharo chinodzivirira kurasikirwa kwemvura nekufamba, saka kupisa kwakafanana kunoita kuti ibike nokukurumidza.
p-010.example: Kudziya 1L yemvura kubva pa20°C kusvika pa100°C kunoda $Q = 1000\times4.18\times80\approx334\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Kana ukavhara, nguva negasi zvinowanzodzikira nenge 20–30%.
p-010.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika noodles nemuto vhara poto kubva pakutanga.

p-011.title: Zadza friza, siya firiji isina zvakawanda
p-011.summary: Friza rizere haribudi kupisa kana woivhura, asi firiji inoda kufambisa mhepo.
p-011.principle: Chando nezvokudya zvine kupisa kukuru kwekuchengeta $C = mc$ zvinochengeta kutonhora uye zvinodzikisa shanduko yekupisa $\Delta T = Q/C$. Firiji inoda kufambisa mhepo inotonhora.
p-011.example: Kana ukavhura musuo kwemasekondi 10, anenge 100L yemhepo mufiriza inochinjana uye nzvimbo isina chinhu inopisa nenge 5°C, asi friza rizere rinovhiringidza nokuda kwezvokudya.
p-011.actionItem: Nhasi zadza nzvimbo dzisina chinhu mufiriza nemabhodhoro emvura akaomeswa.

p-012.title: Bhodhi rinoratidzira kuseri kweradiator
p-012.summary: Kana ukanamira aluminium foil pamadziro kuseri kweradiator, kupisa kunodzoka mukati mekamuri.
p-012.principle: Kupisa kunobwinya ndi$P = \varepsilon\sigma A T^4$, uye aluminium inovhenekera ine emissivity yakadzika uye kuratidzira kwakakwira, saka inoratidzira infrared kuenda mukamuri.
p-012.example: Chikamu chekupisa kweradiator padhuze nedziro rekunze chinopinzwa mudziro. Kana ukachidzorera nebhodhi, nekupisa kwakafanana kurasikirwa kwemudziro kunodzika uye kamuri inodziya nokukurumidza.
p-012.actionItem: Nhasi namira bhodhi rakakora refoil kuseri kweradiator padhuze nedziro rekunze.

p-013.title: Kuvhima kushandiswa kwemagetsi kuri mukumirira
p-013.summary: Kunyange zvishandiso zvinoita sezvakadzimwa zvinoshandisa magetsi kana zviri mu socket.
p-013.principle: Simba ndi$E = Pt$. 5W mukumirira inoita senge shoma, asi pamusoro pemaawa 24 pazuva uye 8,760 pagore inowedzera.
p-013.example: Nemagetsi ekumirira ose e20 W ndi$0.02\times8760 \approx 175\ \mathrm{kWh}$ uye pamarimi 200 pa kWh ndiyo 35,000 won pagore.
p-013.actionItem: Nhasi batanidza TV, set-top box nemachaja pamultiplug ine switch uye uidzime usati warara.

p-014.title: Dzikisa kupisa nepa 1°C
p-014.summary: Kunyange kudzikisa tembiricha yemukamuri ne1°C chete kunodzikisa zvakanyanya simba rinoshandiswa pakupisa.
p-014.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa ndi$Q = UA\Delta T$ uye kunoenderana nemusiyano wekupisa pakati pemukati nekunze $\Delta T$.
p-014.example: Kana kunze kuri 0°C woderedza mukamuri kubva pa22°C kusvika pa21°C, $\Delta T$ inodzika kubva pa22 kusvika pa21, anenge 4.5%, uye simba rekupisa rinodzikira nenge kudaro.
p-014.actionItem: Nhasi dzikisa musetting wekupisa ne1°C woshonha jasi rakarukwa.

p-015.title: Hurefu hwemakurtini nekurasikirwa kwekupisa kwehwindo
p-015.summary: Makurtini akakora anosvika pasi anodzivirira kufamba kwemhepo inotonhora padhuze nehwindo.
p-015.principle: Mhepo padhuze negirazi rinotonhora inorema, inodzika, uye kuyerera kunoitika. Mukurasikirwa kwekupisa $Q = hA\Delta T$ makurtini anodzikisa coefficient yekufamba $h$.
p-015.example: Kana ukavhara makurtini akakora kubva pahwindo kusvika pasi, kurasikirwa kwekupisa kuburikidza nehwindo kunowanzodzikira ne10–25%. Kana pane mikaha mukurtini, mhepo inotonhora inobuda sepachimuri.
p-015.actionItem: Manheru ano zuva ratsvaira vhara makurtini zvakakwana uye tarisa kana mupendero wepasi wakabata pasi.

p-016.title: Dzivirira mhepo yepamusuo pamusuwo
p-016.summary: Mukaha wemusuwo we1 mm unokwidza mari yekupisa muchando.
p-016.principle: Mhepo inopinda mumukaha inoda kudziiswa pachiyero chevolume $\dot V$ uye $P = \rho c \dot V \Delta T$. Kune mhepo $\rho c \approx 1.2\ \mathrm{kJ/m^3K}$.
p-016.example: Nemhepo yemumukaha 20 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ ne$\Delta T=20$ °C, $P \approx 1.2\times20\times20/3.6\approx133\ \mathrm{W}$. Kana ukavhara hafu nepepa rekuvhara musuwo, unochengeta anenge 66W.
p-016.actionItem: Nhasi namira tepi yekuvharira pamukaha unomusuwo nemipendero yemahwindo.

p-017.title: Kumanikidza kwemadhayi muchando
p-017.summary: Kana kupisa kuchidzika, kumanikidza kwemadhayi kunodzikawo.
p-017.principle: Pagasi rakanaka nevolume yakamira $P/T = \text{const}$. Kana tembiricha yakazara $T$ ikadzika, kumanikidza $P$ kunodzikawo zvichienderana.
p-017.example: Dhayi re35 psi pa20°C (293K) pa−10°C (263K) rine $35\times263/293\approx31.4\ \mathrm{psi}$, saka kumanikidza kunodzika nenge 3.6psi.
p-017.actionItem: Nhasi mangwanani yera kumanikidza kwemadhayi akatonhora uye uzadze kusvika pakukurudzirwa.

p-018.title: Nei mittens dzichipisa kupfuura gloves
p-018.summary: Mittens dzine zvigunwe zvakaungana dzinopisa kupfuura gloves.
p-018.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa ndi$Q = hA\Delta T$ uye kunoenderana nenzvimbo yakavhurika $A$. Kana ukaunganidza zvigunwe, nzvimbo inodzikira uye zvigunwe zvinogoverana kupisa.
p-018.example: Mittens dzine nzvimbo yakavhurika inenge 20–30% shoma kupfuura gloves dzine zvigunwe zvakaparadzana, saka nekuvharira kwakafanana kurasikirwa kwekupisa kunenge kwakadzikawo.
p-018.actionItem: Nhasi pazuva rinotonhora kwazvo pfeka mittens pamusoro pe gloves.

p-019.title: Mhepo yemukati mekupfeka zvipfeko zvakawanda
p-019.summary: Zvipfeko zvitete zvakawanda zvinogona kupisa kupfuura chimwe chakakora.
p-019.principle: Mhepo yakamira pakati pezvipfeko inovharira. Kuramba kwekupisa kwose $R = \sum d_i/k_i$ kunowedzera nenhamba yezvidimbu.
p-019.example: Chidimbu chimwe chemhepo yakamira chakakora 5mm chinowedzera $R = 0.005/0.026\approx0.19\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Kana kuchipisa, bvisa chidimbu chimwe kuti udzivise kutonhora kwedikita.
p-019.actionItem: Nhasi paunobuda pfeka zvidimbu zvitatu: bhurugwa rinodziisa, hembe, jasi rinodzivirira mhepo.

p-020.title: Kuomesa zvipfeko mukati nekufambisa mhepo
p-020.summary: Zvipfeko zvemukati zvinoomesa nokukurumidza zvakanyanya kana ukasiya nzvimbo pakati nekubvisa unyoro kana kuvhura mhepo.
p-020.principle: Kukurumidza kwekuputika ndi$\dot m \propto A(p_s - p_a)$, saka kunoenderana nenzvimbo nemusiyano wekumanikidza kwemhute.
p-020.example: Kana anenge 500g yemvura ichiputika kubva pa1 kg yezvipfeko zvakanyorova, $500\times2.26\approx1130\ \mathrm{kJ}$ kunotorwa. Kana ukapatsanura, kuomesa kunogona kuderera kusvika pahafu yenguva.
p-020.actionItem: Nhasi isa zvipfeko uchisiya nzvimbo pakati woshandisa fan pasimba rakadzika.

p-021.title: Kudzivirira girazi rinopisa kuti risatsemuka
p-021.summary: Kana ukadira mvura inopisa pakarepo mugirazi, rinogona kutsemuka.
p-021.principle: Nekuda kwemusiyano wekupisa, kuwedzera kwakasiyana, uye kushushikana kwekupisa $\sigma = E\alpha\Delta T$. Girazi rakajairika re soda-lime haririrambidzi zvakanaka.
p-021.example: Ne$E\approx70\ \mathrm{GPa}$, $\alpha\approx9\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$ ne$\Delta T=70$ ndi$\sigma\approx44\ \mathrm{MPa}$, izvo zvinogona kukonzera kuparara kwepamusoro.
p-021.actionItem: Nhasi mugirazi rinotonhora tanga wadira mvura inodziya kuti ridziye, wozodira inwiwa inopisa.

p-022.title: Kuenderanisa pasi pepoto neinduction
p-022.summary: Induction inoshanda zvakanaka kana pasi pepoto pakati uye hukuru hwakakodzera.
p-022.principle: Induction inogadzira kupisa $P = I^2R$ nemaeddy currents pasi pepoto zvakananga. Poto inofanira kuva yemagnet uye kubatana kwakanaka kunowedzera kushanda.
p-022.example: Kana dhayamita yepoto ichikura zvakanyanya pane coil, kupisa kunopera uye zvinotora nguva. Kushanda kuri anenge 85–90%, kupfuura gasi (anenge 40–50%).
p-022.actionItem: Nhasi isa magnet pasi pepoto uone kana ichinamira.

p-023.title: Kushandisa convection mu air fryer
p-023.summary: Mu air fryer unofanira kusiya nzvimbo pakati pezvokudya kuti zvive crisp.
p-023.principle: Mukumanikidzwa kwemhepo inopisa $Q = hA\Delta T$, $h$ inowedzera. Kana zvokudya zvikaiswa pamusoro pezvimwe, nzvimbo $A$ yainoropafadzwa nemhepo inoderera.
p-023.example: Convection muovheni $h\approx10\ \mathrm{W/m^2K}$, convection nefan $h\approx30\text{-}50$ inokurumidza ka3–5. Kana ukaparadzira zvokudya mumutsetse mumwe, nguva dzimwe nguva inodzikira nemaminitsi 10.
p-023.actionItem: Nhasi mubhasikiti reair fryer isa zvokudya mumutsetse mumwe pasina kuzviisa pamusoro pezvimwe.

p-024.title: Kuchenesa fireta yedryer
p-024.summary: Kana ukabvisa fireta yemvere mudryer, kuomesa kunotora nguva shoma.
p-024.principle: Kana fireta yatsiviwa, kuyerera kwemhepo $\dot V$ kunodzika uye kukurumidza kubvisa unyoro $\dot m = \dot V\Delta\omega\rho$ kunodzikira.
p-024.example: Fireta yakadzivirirwa inogona kuwedzera nguva yekuomesa ne20–30%. Kana kutenderera kuchibva pamaminitsi 80 kusvika 100, 0.4kWh yakawanda inoshandiswa (pa2 kW).
p-024.actionItem: Nhasi vhura fireta yemvere mudryer uichenese.

p-025.title: Kudzikisa static yemagetsi muchando
p-025.summary: Kuzvimba pamubato wemusuwo muchando kunoitika nokuti mumhepo yakaoma mutero hauzvibudisi.
p-025.principle: Mutero $Q$ unounganidzwa nekukwesha unowedzera voltage senge mu capacitor $V = Q/C$ uye mumhepo yakaoma unodzikira zvishoma, saka unosvika pamavolts zviuru.
p-025.example: Kumuviri wemunhu $C\approx100\ \mathrm{pF}$ ne$Q=0.3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ ndi$V = 3000\ \mathrm{V}$. Kana ukawedzera unyoro kusvika pa40% kana kupfuura, mutero unodzikira zvishoma.
p-025.actionItem: Nhasi usati wabata mubato wemusuwo, bata kiyi kana madziro kuti udziisewo mutero.

p-026.title: Dzivirira kuremerwa kwemultiplug
p-026.summary: Kana ukabatanidza zvidziyo zvikuru zvakawanda mumultiplug, kune njodzi yekupisa nekupisa moto.
p-026.principle: Simba $P = VI$, saka pa220 V $I = P/V$ uye kupisa kunogadzirwa ndi$P_\text{heat} = I^2R$, saka kunoenderana nesquare yecurrent.
p-026.example: Heater ye1,500W + kettle ye1,000W inoita $2500/220\approx11.4\ \mathrm{A}$, izvo zvinopfuura 10A yemultiplug yakajairika. Kunyange kuwedzera kwecurrent ne10% kunowedzera kupisa ne21%.
p-026.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa rated current yemultiplug (semuenzaniso 10A) uye batanidza zvidziyo zvekupisa zvakananga musocket yemadziro.

p-027.title: Kuchaja bhatiri 20–80%
p-027.summary: Kana ukashandisa foni pakati pe20–80%, bhatiri rinogara nguva refu.
p-027.principle: Voltage yekuchaja yakakwirira inokurumidza kuparadza electrolyte. Kukurumidza kwekuora kunonzwa kupisa sa$k\propto e^{-E_a/RT}$.
p-027.example: Zvinozivikanwa kuti kana ukadzivisa kuchaja kusvika pa100% nekupisa, huwandu hwemhando dzinochengeta 80% yesimba rebhatiri hunogona kuwedzera kubva pa500 nekumazana akati wandei.
p-027.actionItem: Nhasi vhura 'optimized charging' kana muganho we80% mufoni.

p-028.title: Unochengeta marii yakawanda sei kana ukachinja kuenda ku LED
p-028.summary: Kunyange mwenje une kuvhenekera kwakafanana, LED inoshandisa magetsi shoma kwazvo.
p-028.principle: Tinofananidza kushanda kwemwenje $\eta = \Phi/P$ (lm/W). Mwenje wekare anenge 13 lm/W, LED anenge 100 lm/W kana kupfuura.
p-028.example: Mwenje we800 lm ndiyo 60W yekare, 8W LED. Nemaawa 5 pazuva unochengeta $0.052\times5\times365\approx95\ \mathrm{kWh}$ pagore.
p-028.actionItem: Nhasi chinja mwenje umwe kuenda ku LED mukamuri rinovhenekerwa nguva refu.

p-029.title: Nei mubato wesimbi unotonhora
p-029.summary: Pakupisa kwakafanana simbi inonzwika kutonhora kupfuura huni.
p-029.principle: Kupisa kunokurukura pakubata kunoenderana ne thermal effusivity $e = \sqrt{k\rho c}$. Kana kupisa kuchibuda nokukurumidza, unonzwa kutonhora.
p-029.example: Simbi $e\approx10{,}000\text{-}20{,}000$, huni $e\approx400$ (SI) zvinosiyana nemakumi emakwikwi. Kunyange pa0°C imwe chete simbi inonzwika inotonhora zvakanyanya.
p-029.actionItem: Nhasi paunobuda muchando bata zvibato zvesimbi uchipfeka magirovhosi kana kupfekedza jira.

p-030.title: Maitiro ekudzivirira mapombi emvura kuti asaome chando
p-030.summary: Kana kuchitonhora pasi pe0, mvura mumapombi inoita chando, inowedzera uye pombi inogona kutsemuka.
p-030.principle: Mvura kana yaita chando, huwandu hunowedzera nenge 9%. Mupombi yakavharika kumanikidza kunokwira kwazvo uye pombi inotsemuka nemamiriro $\Delta P = K\Delta V/V$.
p-030.example: Ne bulk modulus $K\approx2\ \mathrm{GPa}$ kuverenga kunopa mazana eMPa, izvo zvinokonzera kutsemuka. Kana mvura ichiyerera zvishoma, hazviite chando nyore.
p-030.actionItem: Nhasi kana kuchitaurwa kuti kuchatonhora, siya mukomberedzo wemvura uchiyerera zvishoma uye vhara mita yemvura nechidziyo.

p-031.title: Kana ukabuda mumba dzima kupisa here kana kuchidzikisa
p-031.summary: Kana ukabuda kwenguva pfupi, siya kupisa kuchishanda, kana kwenguva refu, kudzikise.
p-031.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa kunokurumidza $P = UA(T_\text{in}-T_\text{out})$ uye pakupisa kwakadzika kurasikirwa kuri kushoma. Simba rekudziisazve ndiko kupisa kwekuchengeta $C\Delta T$.
p-031.example: Kana ukabuda kwemaawa 12, tembiricha yemukamuri inodzikira kubva pa22°C kusvika pa17°C, kurasikirwa kunodzika nenge 25% uye kupisa kwekudziisazve kuri kushoma, saka ndiyo purofiti. Kune maawa 2–3, purofiti ishoma.
p-031.actionItem: Nhasi paunobuda kwemaawa anopfuura 6 isa mode yekusavepo, uye pakubuda kwenguva pfupi siya setting sezvayakaiswa.

p-032.title: Kureba kwekubhureka pachando
p-032.summary: Pachando, kureba kwekubhureka kunowedzera kakawanda kupfuura panzira yakaoma.
p-032.principle: Kureba kwekubhureka ndi$d = v^2/(2\mu g)$. Kunoenderana nesquare yekumhanya uye kunopesana nekusakurukurika kwekukweshera.
p-032.example: Pa50 km/h (13.9m/s) panzira yakaoma $\mu=0.7$ $d\approx14\ \mathrm{m}$, pachando $\mu=0.2$ $d\approx49\ \mathrm{m}$. Kana ukadzikisa kumhanya kusvika pa30 km/h, inenge 18m.
p-032.actionItem: Nhasi pachando dzikisa kumhanya kusvika pahafu yenguva dzose uye wedzera kureba kuri pakati pemota.

p-033.title: Dzivirira musana pakudzora chando
p-033.summary: Pakusimudza chando, kana ukabata mubato wepeji wakareba uchishandisa muviri wose, mutoro pamusana unodzikira.
p-033.principle: Torque yerivha ndi$\tau = Fd$. Kurema kunenge kuri kure nechiuno, torque pamusana inowedzera.
p-033.example: Kana wakasimudza 5kg yechando noruoko rwakatambanudzwa 0.6m kubva muchiuno, ndi$\tau\approx5\times9.8\times0.6\approx29\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$, kana ukachibata padyo nemuviri pa0.2m, inenge 10N·m, ndiko 1/3.
p-033.actionItem: Nhasi pakusimudza chando tora zvidiki kakawanda, ubate padyo nemuviri uye ushandise makumbo panzvimbo yomusana.

p-034.title: Kuvhura chivharo chebhodhoro zviri nyore
p-034.summary: Chivharo chakasungwa chinovhurwa kana ukawedzera radius yeruoko uye nokudaro torque.
p-034.principle: Torque ndi$\tau = Fr$. Kunyange nesimba rimwe chete torque inowedzera zvichienderana nekuwedzera radius $r$.
p-034.example: Kune chivharo cheduramita 3cm ($r=1.5\ \mathrm{cm}$) ne torque inodiwa 3N·m ndi$F=200\ \mathrm{N}$. Neopener ne$r=6\ \mathrm{cm}$ ndi$F=50\ \mathrm{N}$, ndiko 1/4.
p-034.actionItem: Nhasi putira girovhosi yerabha kana tauro pachivharo kana shandisa chigadziro chekuvhura mabhodhoro.

p-035.title: Usati wakwira pachigaro
p-035.summary: Paunokwira pachigaro, nzvimbo yesimba rekurema inofanira kuva pamusoro penzvimbo yekutsigira kuti urege kuwa.
p-035.principle: Muviri unogara wakasimba kana mutsetse wakatwasuka unobva pakati pekurema uri mukati menzvimbo yekutsigira. Muganho wekuchengama ndi$\tan\theta = b/h$.
p-035.example: Pakufara kwepasi $b=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ uye kureba kwepakati pekurema kwemunhu $h=100\ \mathrm{cm}$, unowa kunyange pakuchengama $\theta=\arctan0.2\approx11^\circ$.
p-035.actionItem: Nhasi panzvimbo dzakakwirira panzvimbo yechigaro shandisa sitepi rakagadzikana kana makwerere.

p-036.title: Makwerere pa75 degrees
p-036.summary: Kana makwerere akamira nechokumusoro, anowira kumashure, uye kana akarara, anotsvedza.
p-036.principle: Mamiriro okuti makwerere asatsvedza ndi$\tan\theta \ge 1/(2\mu)$ (kukwesha kwemadziro hakutarwi).
p-036.example: Kana coefficient yekukweshera yepasi $\mu=0.4$, ndi$\tan\theta \ge 1.25$, saka $\theta\ge51^\circ$. Ngirozi yekuchengetedza inokurudzirwa ndeye anenge 75° (nzvimbo yepasi yemakwerere yakasiyiwa 1/4 yehurefu kubva padziro).
p-036.actionItem: Nhasi simbisa makwerere kuti pasi pawo pave 1/4 yehurefu hwawo kubva padziro.

p-037.title: Girazi rekushambira rinoita mhute
p-037.summary: Girazi rinoita mhute mushure mekushambira nokuti mhute inoita mvura pasi pedew point.
p-037.principle: Kana kupisa kwepamusoro kuri pasi pe dew point $T_d$, mhute inoita mvura. Anenge $T_d \approx T - (100-RH)/5$.
p-037.example: Pa30°C mubhafu uye unyoro 90%, $T_d\approx28$ °C. Kana girazi riri pa25°C, mhute inoita mvura. Kana ukadzikisa unyoro kusvika pa60% nefani, ndi$T_d\approx14$ °C.
p-037.actionItem: Nhasi pakushambira vhura fani woisiya ichishanda maminitsi 10 pashure pokupera.

p-038.title: Usadhonze mafenicha akaremara, asi
p-038.summary: Mafenicha akaremara anofambiswa nyore kana ukasimudza divi rimwe, woisa jira woisundira.
p-038.principle: Simba rekusadhonza rekumira ndi$f = \mu_s N$. Jira rakaiswa rinodzikisa $\mu$ uye rinodzivirirawo pasi.
p-038.example: Kune kabati ye50 kg ne$\mu=0.5$ ndi$f=0.5\times50\times9.8\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$. Kana mapedhi emafenicha achidzikisa $\mu=0.2$, simba ndere98 N, ndiko 60% shoma.
p-038.actionItem: Nhasi isa mapedhi e felt kana tauro pasi pemakumbo emafenicha woawana kufambisa.

p-039.title: Kuenzanisa huwandu hwemvura mu kettle yemagetsi
p-039.summary: Kana ukabika chete zvaunonwa, unochengeta magetsi nenguva.
p-039.principle: Kupisa kwekuvira ndi$Q = mc\Delta T$ uye kunoenderana nehuremu hwemvura $m$.
p-039.example: Kuvira 1L kubva pa20°C kusvika pa100°C kunoda 334kJ ≈ 0.093kWh. Kune kapu rimwe (250mL) ndi0.023kWh, ndiko 1/4.
p-039.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa mamaki ekapu uise huwandu hwemvura hunodiwa chete mukettle.

p-040.title: Siya nzvimbo kuseri kwefiriji
p-040.summary: Kana ukamanikidza firiji kudziro, kupisa hakubudi uye magetsi anoshandiswa anowedzera.
p-040.principle: Kupisa kunobva mucompressor kunobuda nepaundlen kwakazvarwa kwekupisa nekufamba kwemhepo. Kana kufamba kwemhepo kwavharwa, $Q = hA\Delta T$ kunodzika $h$.
p-040.example: Kana kubuda kwekupisa kwavharwa uye tembiricha yecondenser ikakwira ne10°C, kushanda (COP) kunodzika uye magetsi anoshandiswa anogona kuwedzera nenge 10–15%. Pa400 kWh pagore ndi40–60kWh.
p-040.actionItem: Nhasi siya firiji kuseri nepamicheto 5–10cm kubva padziro woisula guruva.

p-041.title: Kudzikisa kudengenyeka kwekutenderedza muwasher
p-041.summary: Kana zvipfeko zvakazviunganidza kudivi rimwe, muchina unodengenyeka zvakanyanya pakutenderedza.
p-041.principle: Kana huremu husina kuenzana $m$ hunotenderedza pa radius $r$, simba rinotenderedza $F = m\omega^2 r$ rinoitika, rinoenderana nesquare yekumhanya kweangular.
p-041.example: Pa1000 rpm ($\omega\approx105\ \mathrm{rad/s}$) uye huremu husina kuenzana hwe1 kg pa$r=0.2\ \mathrm{m}$ ndi$F\approx2200\ \mathrm{N}$. Kana wakaenzanisa, simba iri rinenge rapera.
p-041.actionItem: Nhasi pakusukurudza zvidimbu zvikuru semagumbeze, wedzera zvidimbu zvidiki zvezvipfeko uzvigoverane zvakaenzana.

p-042.title: Kudzorera simba rekudhonza revacuum
p-042.summary: Kana ukabvisa fireta nechirongo cheguruva, simba rekudhonza rinenge rodzoka sepakutanga.
p-042.principle: Chigadzirwa chemusiyano wekumanikidza kwekudhonza $\Delta P$ nekuyerera kwemhepo $Q$ ndicho simba rekudhonza $P = \Delta P\cdot Q$. Kana kwavharwa, kuyerera kunodzikira zvakanyanya.
p-042.example: Kana fireta yavharwa hafu, kuyerera kunogona kudzika nenge 30–50%. Kunyange nemota imwe chete, simba rekudhonza rinodzikira zvakadaro uye kuchenesa kunotora nguva refu.
p-042.actionItem: Nhasi dururira chirongo cheguruva revacuum woudza kana kuchaya fireta kana kuigeza wouomesa.

p-043.title: Kupisa kwakavanzika kwepakiti rechando
p-043.summary: Kuti uchengete kutonhora, kushandisa kupisa kwakavanzika kwekunyungudika kwechando ndiko kunoshanda zvakanyanya.
p-043.principle: Chando chichinyungudika chinotora kupisa $Q = mL$ che $L=334\ \mathrm{J/g}$ uye kupisa kunoramba kuri pa0°C.
p-043.example: Pakiti rechando re500 g rinotora $500\times334\approx167\ \mathrm{kJ}$ pakunyungudika. Ndiko 16 nguva yekupisa (10kJ) kunodiwa kuti mvura yakaenzana ye0°C ipise ne5°C.
p-043.actionItem: Nhasi paunoenda kunotenga isa pakiti rechando uye isa zvokudya zvakaomeswa kupera.

p-044.title: Kurema kwechando padenga
p-044.summary: Chando chinonyorova chinorema kakawanda kupfuura chakaoma, saka denga kana greenhouse zvinogona kuwa.
p-044.principle: Mutoro ndi$P = \rho g h$. Chando chakaoma $\rho\approx100\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, chando chinonyorova $\rho\approx400\text{-}500$.
p-044.example: Chando chinonyorova chakakora 30cm ($\rho=400$) chinopa $400\times9.8\times0.3\approx1180\ \mathrm{Pa}$, ndiko 4 nguva chando chakaoma (anenge 300Pa).
p-044.actionItem: Nhasi kana chando chakawanda, bvisa chando pamusoro pe greenhouse nemabhatani nenzira yakachengeteka.

p-045.title: Kushanda kwekupisa nepombi yekupisa
p-045.summary: Kupisa nepoyi yekupisa kunogadzira kupisa kwakawanda kubva kumagetsi akaenzana kupfuura heater yemagetsi.
p-045.principle: Pombi yekupisa inofambisa kupisa, saka $\mathrm{COP} = Q_h/W$ yakakura kupfuura 1. Heater yemagetsi ine $\mathrm{COP}=1$.
p-045.example: Ne COP 3, 1kWh yemagetsi inopa 3kWh yekupisa. Kupisa kwe3 kW kwemaawa 5 heater yemagetsi inoshandisa 15kWh, pombi yekupisa 5kWh, saka unochengeta 10kWh.
p-045.actionItem: Nhasi panzvimbo yeheater yemagetsi edza mode yekupisa yeairconditioner yakaiswa pa20°C.

p-046.title: Nei magirovhosi akanyorova achitonhorera
p-046.summary: Magirovhosi akanyorova anobvisa kupisa nokukurumidza kupfuura akaoma.
p-046.principle: Kuendesa kupisa kwemvura kuri anenge $0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$, anenge ka23 kupfuura mhepo ($0.026$), uye pamwe nekupisa kwekuputika $Q = kA\Delta T/d$ inowedzera.
p-046.example: Pakukora kwakafanana, kurasikirwa kwekupisa kwemagirovhosi akazara nemvura kunowedzera kakawanda, saka maoko anotonhora nokukurumidza. Mvura yega yega ye1 g inoputika inobvisa 2.26kJ yakawedzerwa.
p-046.actionItem: Nhasi omesa nokukurumidza magirovhosi aunobata chando wotora kamwe jira.

p-047.title: Mapfupa echando pamupendero wedenga anoratidza kupisa kuchibuda kuenda kudenga
p-047.summary: Kana chando padenga chichinyungudika kubva pasi chigoita chando zvakare pamupendero, ingave chiratidzo chekuti kupisa kwemukati kuri kubuda kuenda kudenga.
p-047.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa ndi$\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$. Kana kuvharira kusina kunaka, $U$ inowedzera uye kupisa kwepamusoro pedenga kunosvika pamusoro pe0°C, saka chando chinonyungudika.
p-047.example: Padenga re100 m², kana $U$ ikadzika kubva pa0.5 kusvika pa0.25 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\,K)}$, kurasikirwa pa$\Delta T=20$ kunodzika kubva pa$0.5\times100\times20=1{,}000$ kusvika pa500 W, ndiko hafu.
p-047.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kana pane mapfupa echando pamupendero wedenga kana veranda (usamire pasi pawo) uye kana akawanda, tarisa kuvharira kwesiringi kana attic.

p-048.title: Firimu resipo rinodzivirira magirazi kuti arege kuita mhute
p-048.summary: Magirazi anoita mhute kunyange kana wakapfeka mask nokuti pamusoro pelenzi ipepeti kupfuura dew point yemhepo yaunofema. Kana ukapfapfaidza firimu resipo rakatetepa pamalenzi, panzvimbo yemadonhwe kunoitika firimu rakajeka remvura uye kuona kunoramba kuri kwakachena.
p-048.principle: Kana kupisa kwepamusoro $T_s$ kuri pasi pe dew point $T_d$, mhute inoita mvura. Zvinhu zvinoshanda pamusoro zvinodzikisa ngirozi yekubata, saka madonhwe madiki anotapurirwa mufirimu rakajeka.
p-048.example: Dew point yemhepo yaunofema pa34 ℃ nehumvuri 100% inenge 34 ℃ asi pamusoro pelenzi pari anenge 20 ℃, saka inoita mhute pakarepo. Kana ukapfapfaidza dhonzi rimwe retsvina isina kusarudzika pamalenzi woisiya ichiomerera, madonhwe anotapurirwa pamalenzi ose uye mhute inodzikira zvakanyanya.
p-048.actionItem: Nhasi pfapfaidza dhonzi rimwe retsvina isina kusarudzika pamativi ose maviri emalenzi, uriise iomerere pachayo usina kuipukuta, woshonha waya yemuromo yemask kuti mhepo yaunofema irege kubuda ichiita kumusoro.

p-049.title: Kuziva magirazi echokwadi ekudzivirira zuva ane polarization
p-049.summary: Chiedza chinoratidzirwa kubva pamusoro pemvura nenzira yakanyorova chinowanzova polarized zvakachinjika, saka malenzi epolarization anochiputsa uye anodzikisa kubwinya nekuneta kwemaziso. Magirazi echihwerwere anogona kungova akasviba mavara, saka tarisa iwe pachako.
p-049.principle: Simba rechiedza chinopfuura nepolarizer rinotevera Malus's law $I=I_0\cos^2\theta$ uye kuratidzira kubva pamusoro pemvura kunenge kwakazara polarized padyo ne Brewster's angle $\theta_B=\arctan(n)\approx 53^\circ$.
p-049.example: Kana axis yelenzi iri pa90° kune polarization direction ($90^\circ$), $\cos^2 90^\circ=0$, uye chiedza chinoratidzirwa chinenge chavharwa. Kuvimbika kunogona kuongororwa nekuisa malenzi maviri pa$90^\circ$ ichiita kusviba. UV400 yakasiyana nepolarization, saka tarisa chiratidzo.
p-049.actionItem: Tarisa sikirini yefoni uchishandisa lenzi, tendeedza lenzi ne$90^\circ$ uone kana sikirini ichisviba, uye tarisa chiratidzo che UV400.

p-050.title: Nei nzira yepabhiriji ichiita chando pakutanga
p-050.summary: Bhiriji rinosangana nemhepo inotonhora kumusoro nepasi, saka rinoita chando pamberi penzira yakajairika, uye black ice isingaonekwi nyore inoitika.
p-050.principle: Nzira iri pasi inotonhora zvishoma nokuti kupisa kunobva pasi, asi pasi pebhiriji pane mhepo zvakare, saka hapana kupisa kunopinda. Kureba kwekubhureka ndi$d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$.
p-050.example: Pa50 km/h ($v\approx13.9$) panzvimbo yakaoma $\mu\approx0.7$ anenge 14m uye pachando $\mu\approx0.1$ anenge 99m, ndiko kuda ka7.
p-050.actionItem: Pakupisa pasi pe3°C usiku nekumangwanani, deredza kumhanya kare pamberi pemabhiriji, mikoko yemigero nenzvimbo dzine mumvuri.

p-051.title: Nei girazi rekuvandudzwa remuromo rinoitwa katatu kana kaviri rakakwana
p-051.summary: Girazi rinokudza haritsanangurwi nekuti kukudza kwakakura. Kana focal length yakapfupika unofanira kuisa chiso padyo kwazvo uye nzvimbo yekuona inopfupika.
p-051.principle: Concave mirror $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, magnification $m=-\dfrac{d_i}{d_o}$. Kana chinhu chiri mukati mefocus, nzira yakananga yakakurudzwa inoonekwa.
p-051.example: Kune girazi re focal length $f=20$ nechiso pa$d_o=10$ ndi$d_i=-20$, $m=2$, saka kukudza kaviri. Girazi rekukudza ka10 re focal 5cm rinoda kuti uise chiso mukati me5 cm uye unoona ziso rimwe panguva imwe. Pamusoro pefocus, mufananidzo unotenderera.
p-051.actionItem: Paunotenga girazi, yera kureba kunowanzoita chiso, usarudze girazi re focal length yakapetwa kaviri nekureba uku (kukudza kaviri kusvika katatu).

p-052.title: Kudzikisa nguva yekubika nemari yegasi nepoto yekumanikidza
p-052.summary: Poto yekumanikidza inokwidza kumanikidza kwemukati uye inokwidza boiling point yemvura kusvika pa120℃, ichidzikisa nguva yekubika kusvika pa1/3 kana pasi.
p-052.principle: Boiling point inokwira nekumanikidza (Clausius-Clapeyron). Kukurumidza kwekushanda kunowedzera kaviri nepa $10^\circ$ yega yega, saka $2^{(120-100)/10}=4$ iri ka4 yakakurumidza.
p-052.example: Pa gauge 1atm (absolute anenge 2atm) boiling point inenge 120℃. Mbabvu dzinotora maminitsi 60 mupoto yakajairika dzinopera munenge maminitsi 20, nepa induction ye1.5kW unochengeta anenge 1kWh. Usatombovhura chivharo kusvikira kumanikidza kwapera.
p-052.actionItem: Manheru ano bika chikafu chinotora nguva refu (nyama yakabikwa, nyemba, chakabikwa nemhute) mupoto yekumanikidza, uye panzvimbo yekuwedzera kupisa dzima moto woisiya kumanikidza kwakasara kuwedzera kubika.

p-053.title: Mukaha wemusuwo we1% unodzikisa kuvharira ruzha kubva pa30 dB kusvika pa20 dB
p-053.summary: Kunyange musuwo wakakora une kuvharira ruzha kwakaipa zvakanyanya kana pane mukaha mumwe pasi. Tepi yekuvhara musuwo yemari shoma inoderedza ruzha nemhepo.
p-053.principle: Huwandu hwekupfuura $\tau=\dfrac{\sum S_i\tau_i}{\sum S_i}$, kurasikirwa kwekupfuura $TL=-10\log_{10}\tau$.
p-053.example: Kune musuwo une kuvharira 30dB (τ=0.001) nemukaha we1% wenzvimbo (τ≈1) ndi$\tau=0.99\times0.001+0.01=0.011$, saka TL inenge 19.6dB, ndiko kudzika kubva pa30 kusvika pa20 dB. Kana ukavhara mukaha netepi (anenge 3 madhora), unodzikisawo mhepo yechando uye unochengeta mari yekupisa.
p-053.actionItem: Vhara musuwo, tarisa kana chiedza chichipinda mumikaha iri pasi nepamicheto yemusuwo, woisa rubber ye silicone kana door sweep.

p-054.title: Kungochinja nzvimbo yerouter yeWi-Fi kunochinja kumhanya
p-054.summary: Pakuwedzera kwega kwega kwakapetwa kaviri kweurefu, chiratidzo chinodzika ka4 (6dB) uye madziro ega ega anobvisa 3–10dB yakawedzerwa. Kana ukaisa router panzvimbo yakavhurika pakati pemba, kumhanya kunovandudzika.
p-054.principle: Kurasikirwa kwenzira munzvimbo isina chinhu $FSPL(\mathrm{dB})=20\log_{10}d+20\log_{10}f+32.44$ ($d$ mu km, $f$ mu MHz).
p-054.example: Pa2.4GHz pa10 m inenge 60.0dB uye pa20 m inenge 66.0dB, saka pakupeta kaviri kureba +6dB. Kana pakati pane madziro e concrete, 5–10dB yakawedzerwa inorasika uye mukamuri rekupedzisira kumhanya kunodzika zvakanyanya.
p-054.actionItem: Tamisa router kubva kuseri kweTV kana mudhirowa kana pasi kuenda pashelefu rakavhurika pakureba kwe1–1.5m pakati pemba, woenzanisa kumhanya mukamuri rekupedzisira usati waita nepashure.

p-055.title: Pa3 dB ega ega yehunyanzvi hwemahedifoni, nguva yakachengeteka inoita hafu
p-055.summary: Pakuwedzera kwega kwega kwe3 dB mukukwira kwekurira, simba rinoita kaviri uye nguva yaunogona kuteerera zvakachengeteka inoita hafu. Kunyange kudzikisa zvishoma ruzha kunowedzera zvakanyanya nguva yekudzivirira nzeve.
p-055.principle: Sound pressure level $L=10\log_{10}\dfrac{I}{I_0}$ ($I_0=10^{-12}$). Kuratidzwa kunokurudzirwa: maawa 8 pa85 dB, pakuwedzera kwega kwega kwe3 dB nguva yakapetwa hafu.
p-055.example: Pa85 dB maawa 8, pa88 dB maawa 4, pa91 dB maawa 2, pa94 dB awa 1 uye pa100 dB maminitsi 15. Kana ukawedzera ruzha nokuda kweruzha rwetereni kusvika pamusoro pe95 dB, kunyange maminitsi 30 haasi mutoro mudiki.
p-055.actionItem: Nhasi mufoni vhura setting yekuchengetedza mahedifoni nemuganho weruzha woganhura ruzha rwakanyanya kusvika pa60% kana kupfuura.

p-056.title: Hydroplaning mumvura yechirimo: deredza kumhanya ne20% chete
p-056.summary: Panzira yakanyorova pakumhanya kwakakwirira, mvura iri pamberi pedhayi haikwanise kuyerera, inoita nzvimbo yewedge uye inosimudza dhayi. Pahydroplaning, kutenderedza nekubhureka zvinenge zvisingaiti.
p-056.principle: Kana dynamic pressure yemvura $q=\tfrac12\rho v^2$ yakatsvedza padyo nekumanikidza kwekubata $p$, firimu remvura rinosimudza dhayi. Kumhanya kwakakosha $v\approx\sqrt{2p/\rho}$ (kufungidzira kuri nyore).
p-056.example: Pakumanikidza kwekubata kwe220 kPa ndi$v\approx\sqrt{2\times220000/1000}\approx21$, ndiko anenge 76km/h. Kana madhayi akapera, mvura haibudi uye hydroplaning inoitika nekumhanya kwakadzikira, saka kudzikisa kumhanya kubva pa100 km/h kusvika pa80 km/h kunochengetedza.
p-056.actionItem: Tarisa kana chiratidzo chekupera kwedhayi (TWI) chiri pakureba kwemitsara, uye mumvura famba pa80% yekumhanya kwenguva dzose.

p-057.title: Usatenda nhamba ye NRR pamapuggu enzeve zvakanyanya
p-057.summary: NRR yakanyorwa pabhokisi ndiyo mwero wepamusoro wegwaro, uye kudzikisa ruzha chaiko kuri kwakaderera. Mapuggu ekongiti nenzvimbo dzekuvaka anofanira kuenzaniswa nenhamba yakagadziridzwa.
p-057.principle: Kufungidzira kudzikisa chaiko $\mathrm{NRR}_{\text{chaizvoi}}\approx\dfrac{\mathrm{NRR}-7}{2}$ dB (mushure mekugadzirisa A nekushandisa 50%).
p-057.example: Mapuggu e foam ane NRR 33 ane kudzikisa chaiko kwe$(33-7)/2=13$ dB. Pakongiti ye100 dB inodzikisa ruzha kusvika pa87 dB, izvo zvichiri pamusoro zvishoma pemuganho we85 dB. Kuaisa nenzira kwakarurama kwakakosha kupfuura nhamba.
p-057.actionItem: Putsa mapuggu e foam kuita matete, dhonza nzeve kumusoro nekumashure, uaise woaimanikidza noruoko kwemasekondi 30 kuti awedzere.

p-058.title: Mukuchaja kwenzira isina waya, nzvimbo yecoil inogadza kushanda
p-058.summary: Kuchaja pasina waya kune kurasikirwa kwakawanda kupfuura nenzira yewaya, uye kana foni yakanyaruka, kupisa kunoitika uye magetsi anoshandiswa anowedzera. Kunyange kugadzirisa chaiko kunodzikisa kurasikirwa nekuora kwebhatiri.
p-058.principle: Kushanda kwekubatana kweinductive kunoenderana ne coupling coefficient $k$ sa$\eta=\dfrac{k^2Q_1Q_2}{\left(1+\sqrt{1+k^2Q_1Q_2}\right)^2}$. Pakunyaruka $k$ inodzika zvakanyanya.
p-058.example: Pakuchaja foni ye5,000 mAh · 3.85V (anenge 19.3Wh) pa90% newaya 21.4Wh, pa70% pasina waya 27.5Wh, uye pakunyaruka pa50% 38.5Wh. Nekuchaja kamwe pazuva, kana wakagadzirisa unoshandisa anenge 2kWh pagore, kana wakanyaruka anenge 6kWh yakawanda.
p-058.actionItem: Isa foni chaiko pakati pechiratidzo checoil pachaja pad, uye bvisa kesi yakakora, makadhi kana mapuranga esimbi paunochaja.

p-059.title: Kusimudza chitsoka pamusoro pegesi kare pamberi petrafiki
p-059.summary: Kana ukabhureka kana chiratidzo chitsvuku, simba rekufamba remotokari rinoshanduka kuita kupisa uye rinorasika. Kana ukasimudza chitsoka kare, motokari inoenda ichifamba nemafuta akadzimwa uye unochengeta mafuta.
p-059.principle: Kinetic energy $E_k=\tfrac12mv^2$. Simba rinorasika nekubhureka rinoenderana nesquare yekumhanya.
p-059.example: Motokari ye1,500kg inofamba pa60 km/h (16.7m/s) ine $E_k\approx208$ kJ. Kana simba rinoshandiswa re1 L petrol rakaenzana nenge 8.5MJ, ndiko anenge 25mL panguva yega yega yaunomira. Kana ukapindura kumatrafiki 10 kare, unochengeta makumi kusvika mazana emL pazuva.
p-059.actionItem: Nhasi paunofamba, kana tiraffiki yepamberi ichitsvuka, simudza chitsoka pagesi anenge 150m kare, siya motokari ichifamba pachayo wobhureka zvishoma kana zvichidiwa.

p-060.title: Kutamisa mvura nesiphon pasina pombi
p-060.summary: Kuchinja mvura muaquarium kana kudururira dhiramu remvura yemvura inodiwa pombi nemusiyano wekukwirira chete. Kana pombi yazadzwa nemvura kamwe chete, mvura inoramba ichiyerera kuenda kudivi riri pasi.
p-060.principle: Kana pakubuda pari $\Delta h$ pasi pepamusoro pemvura, mvura inoyerera nemusiyano wekumanikidza $\Delta P=\rho g\Delta h$ uye kumhanya kwakakodzera ndi$v=\sqrt{2g\Delta h}$.
p-060.example: Pamusiyano wekukwirira we0.5m kumhanya kwakakodzera ndi3.1m/s, asi nekuda kwekukweshera mupombi chaiko ndiye anenge 1m/s. Mupombi yedhayamita 10mm, $Q\approx0.08$ L/s, saka 20L unotamisa mukati memaminitsi 4.
p-060.actionItem: Soka pombi mumvura, uizadze, vhara kuguma kumwe wotamisa mvura kuenda mubhaketi riri pasi. Usatombotora mvura yemakemikari nomuromo.

p-061.title: Pazuva rine chando, mwenje weUV unobva pamusoro napasi
p-061.summary: Chando chitsva chinoratidzira UV yakawanda, saka munzvimbo dzine chando maziso nechiso zvinopfira nezuva nyore kupfuura sezvaungafunga.
p-061.principle: Albedo ndi$\alpha=I_r/I_0$ uye kuratidzwa kwose kweUV kuri anenge $I_0(1+\alpha)$. UV albedo yechando chitsva inenge 0.8–0.9, yesora inenge 0.03.
p-061.example: Kana UV yakananga tikaiita 1, pasora inenge 1.03 uye pachando chitsva inenge 1.8–1.9, anenge kaviri.
p-061.actionItem: Paunoenda kuchando kana kumakomo ane chando, tora magirazi (magirazi echando) ane kudzivirira UV nechiteshi chekudzivirira zuva.

p-062.title: Nei nzeve dzinovharika kana ndege ichiburuka
p-062.summary: Kumanikidza kwemhepo mukati mendege kunenge kwakaenzana nekumusoro kwemamita 2,400, saka mushure mekusimuka mhepo iri munzeve inoputika, uye pakuburuka inomanikidzwa zvakare. Kana wavhura nzeve kubva pakutanga kuburuka, unodzivirira kurwadza.
p-062.example: Kubva pa101kPa pasi kusvika pa75kPa mundege, vhoriyamu yemhepo munzeve inowedzera ka$101/75\approx1.35$, zvinoreva 35%. Pakuburuka inodzoka ichidzikira uye eardrum inodhonzwa mukati. Kana mhino yakavharwa nechikosoro, ngoro yeEustachian inonetsa kuvhura.
p-062.actionItem: Kana mutauriri ataura nezvekudzika, chaya chingamu, shamisa kana kunyunga mate, uye usarara asi urambe wakamuka.

p-063.title: Nhamba yebinoculars 8x42, kuverenga kujeka
p-063.summary: Nhamba dzebinoculars ndiyo kuwedzera × dhayamita yegirazi guru. Kana uchishandisa mangwanani-ngwanani kana manheru, exit pupil inofanira kuva hombe kuti ive yakajeka, uye kana uchishandisa masikati chete, ndiyo diki neyakareruka inonaka.
p-063.example: 8x42 ndi$42/8=5.25$mm uye kujeka kwepasi kunenge 27.6, 10x25 ndi2.5mm ne6.3, saka murima inopfuura ka4 kujeka. Nzeve yemunhu murima ndi5~7mm, saka kutarisa shiri mangwanani exit pupil yakakura kupfuura 4mm inobatsira.
p-063.actionItem: Kana uchida kutarisa shiri mangwanani kana manheru sarudza $D/M\ge4$mm, kana kufamba masikati sarudza diki yakareruka, wozoyedza iwe pachako.

p-064.title: Kana wakakomberedza mapombi emvura inopisa kupisa hakurasikiri zvakawanda
p-064.summary: Pombi yemvura inopisa isina chinhu kubva kuboiler kusvika kutepi inorasikirwa nekupisa nguva dzose. Kana ukaiisa insulation, kurasikirwa kunoderera kwazvo.
p-064.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa kwepombi ndi$\dot Q\propto \Delta T/R$ uye insulation inowedzera kuramba kwekupisa $R$. Kana $R$ ikapetwa kaviri pa$\Delta T$ imwe chete, kurasikirwa kunova hafu.
p-064.example: Kana pombi yemvura inopisa isina chinhu yemamita 10 ichiramba iine musiyano we25K nekamuri ichirasikirwa ne25W pamita, ndi250W. Mushure meinsulation kana yave 60W kunenge, pamaawa 10 pazuva unochengetedza 1.9kWh.
p-064.actionItem: Muboiler room kana pasi pesinki, yera urefu hwepombi yemvura inopisa isina chinhu, uye uronga kutenga foam insulation yekuikomberedza.

p-065.title: Roof box, rayise muchirimo
p-065.summary: Kana roof box yawaishandisa kutakura zvishandiso zveski muchando ikasiiwa, kudhonza kwemhepo pakumhanya kunowedzera uye mafuta anoparara.
p-065.example: Mota ine $C_dA=0.69\,\mathrm{m^2}$ inomhanya pa100km/h (27.8m/s) inoda 8.9kW kunenge, asi roof box inoita kuti $C_dA$ iwedzere 20%, inova 10.7kW, 1.8kW yakawanda. Pa100km inoshandisa 0.8L yemafuta yakawedzera.
p-065.actionItem: Tarisa roof box nemabhawa erack, kana isina chinhu, uibvise nhasi uichengete mugaraji.

p-066.title: Zvikopa zvinonamira usadhonze kumusoro, zvidhonze zvakareba kumativi
p-066.summary: Zvikopa zvinonamira zvakasimba pakudhonzwa pasi (shear) asi zvisina simba pakubviswa zvakananga kubva pamadziro (peel).
p-066.principle: Pa shear, nzvimbo yose inonamira inogovana simba, asi pa peel simba rinounganidzwa pamucheto, saka $F_{\text{peel}}\ll F_{\text{shear}}$.
p-066.example: Semuenzaniso, kopa inosunga 2 kgf pa shear inogona kuburuka pa0.2~0.5 kgf pa peel. Naizvozvo kurema kunorembera pasi kuri nani, asi kusimudzira kumusoro zviri nyore kuburuka.
p-066.actionItem: Paunonamira kopa, dhiraya guruva nemvura pachiso, tsikirira pamusoro paminiti imwe. Pakubvisa, dhonza zvishoma nezvishoma pamwe nedziro.

p-067.title: Noise cancelling inodzikisa vhoriyamu ne6dB
p-067.summary: Noise cancelling inoita ruzha rune phase yakaipikisana neruzha kuti ruzha rutadzise. Muchitima chepasi pasi, haudi kukwidziridza vhoriyamu, saka nzeve dzinochengetedzwa.
p-067.principle: Destructive interference: $A\sin\omega t+A\sin(\omega t+\pi)=0$. Inobatsira pamazwi akaderera anoramba aripo (anenge 1kHz kana pasi).
p-067.example: Pa80dB yeruzha rwechitima chepasi, kana noise cancelling ikadzikisa ruzha rwakaderera ne20dB kunenge, unogona kunzwa mimhanzi imwe cheteyo ne6dB pasi pevhoriyamu (semuenzaniso 91dB→85dB), uye nguva yekunzwa yakachengeteka inowedzera kubva pamaawa 2 kusvika 8, ka4.
p-067.actionItem: Muchitima chepasi kana bhazi, batidza noise cancelling uye dzikisa vhoriyamu ne2~3 stepisi.

p-068.title: Kona mukunaya kwechirimo, nhaka yekumhanya
p-068.summary: Kumhanya kwepamusoro kwekutenderera kona zvakachengeteka kunotarirwa nekusungana kwemugwagwa nenyaya yemudenderedzwa. Kana unyoro, muganhu unoderera zvakanyanya.
p-068.principle: Kumhanya kwemuganhu $v=\sqrt{\mu g r}$ (simba rinotora pakati = simba rekusungana).
p-068.example: Pakona ine radius 50m, mugwagwa wakaoma ($\mu=0.7$) unenge 67km/h, wakanyorova (0.4) unenge 50km/h, uye muchando (0.2) unenge 36km/h. Zviratidzo zvekumhanya zvinoshandiswa pamugwagwa wakaoma, saka kana kuchinaya dzikisa zvakanyanya.
p-068.actionItem: Usati wapinda mukona, dzikisa kumhanya uchiri mugwagwa wakananga, uye mukati mekona dzivisa kubhureka nekutenderera nekukurumidza.

p-069.title: Hukuru hweTV, pane resolution, tarisa kureba kwekutarisa
p-069.summary: Kugona kwekusiyanisa kwerziso remunhu kunenge arcminute imwe. Kana waagara kure, ziso harigoni kusiyanisa 4K neFull HD, saka kuisa mari pahukuru hwescreen kunopfuura resolution.
p-069.principle: Kugona kwekusiyanisa kweziso $\theta\approx1'\approx2.9\times10^{-4}$ rad, pa pixel pitch $p$ kureba kwepamusoro kwekusiyanisa $d=\dfrac{p}{\theta}$.
p-069.example: Pixel pitch ye4K ye55 inch inenge 0.32mm, saka musiyano wepixel unoonekwa mukati me$d\approx1.1$m chete. Kana sofa iri 3m kure, FullHD haioneke pixels kusvika 75 inch, saka tarisa hukuru nemhando yemufananidzo (contrast, HDR) pane 4K premium.
p-069.actionItem: Yera nemetre kureba kubva panzvimbo yeTV kusvika kusofa, wosarudza hukuru hwescreen zvichienderana nekureba uku.

p-070.title: Chando chiri mufiriza kana chakora, magetsi anowedzera kushandiswa
p-070.summary: Chando chinewo mhepo yakawanda pakati pemakristaro echando, saka chinoita insulation layer, chinodzivirira kupfuura kwechando uye compressor inoshanda nguva refu.
p-070.principle: Kuramba kwekupisa ndi$R=d/k$ uye kunowirirana nehupamhi $d$. $k$ yechando inenge 0.2~0.5 $\mathrm{W/(m\,K)}$, yakaderera kupfuura echando chakachena (inenge 2.2).
p-070.example: Pa$k=0.3$ chando che5 mm ine $R=0.005/0.3\approx0.017\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$, ka5 yeye ye1mm. Kunaka kwekutonhodza kunoderera zvakadaro.
p-070.actionItem: Kana chando chapfuura 3~5mm, dzima magetsi uye uchisiye chinyunguduke. Usachikwenya nebanga kana chishandiso chakapinza.

p-071.title: Mvura yemvura makumi maviri emalita 200, mvura yemahara yemunda wechirimo
p-071.summary: Kana ukaunganidza mvura yechirimo inonaya padenga, unogona kudiridza munda pasina mvura yepombi. Kana ukasimudza dhiramu, kumanikidza kwemvura kunoita kuti uvhare hozi.
p-071.principle: Kumanikidza kwemvura $P=\rho g h$, mvura inounganidzwa $V=A\times R$ (nzvimbo × mvura).
p-071.example: Padenga re10m² nemvura ye20mm, ma$10\times20=200$L anounganidzwa. Kana ukasimudza dhiramu ne1m, kumanikidza kwe9.8kPa (anenge 0.1bar) kunoita kuti mvura iyerere nehozi kuenda pamubhedha wakaderera.
p-071.actionItem: Isa dhiramu yemvura yemvura pamusoro pechigadziko che50cm kana kupfuura, uye uvhare nechifukidzo nenetiweki kudzivirira makonzo.

p-072.title: Microphone howling, kudzikisa ne3dB kunoyera
p-072.summary: Kana microphone ikawedzera zvakare ruzha rwemhere, 'pii-' howling inoitika. Kugadzirisa kureba nevhoriyamu chete kunoita kuti uidzivise nyore.
p-072.principle: Loop gain $G=g_{amp}\cdot g_{path}\ge1$ uye kana phase yakaenzana, kunoitika oscillation.
p-072.example: Kana ukawedzera kureba pakati pemicrophone nemhere kaviri, kurasikirwa kwemugwagwa kunowedzera ne6dB, saka unogona kukwidziridza vhoriyamu zvikuru. Asi kana ukadzikisa vhoriyamu ne3dB chete, loop gain inova hafu uye howling inoyera.
p-072.actionItem: Usaise mhere ichitarisa nzvimbo yatarisa microphone, asi itarise vateereri, uye dzikisa vhoriyamu yeinput yemicrophone ne3dB (nhanho imwe kana mbiri).

p-073.title: Fungidzira simba revultraviolet kubva pamumvuri
p-073.summary: Kana mumvuri wakatapira kupfuura urefu hwako, kukwira kwezuva kunopfuura 45 madhigirii uye ultraviolet inesimba. Pakupera kwaKurume, mumvuri wemasikati wakatotapira kupfuura urefu.
p-073.principle: Huwandu hweUV hunowirirana ne$\alpha$ ye$\sin\alpha$ yekukwira kwezuva uye urefu hwemumvuri $L=\dfrac{h}{\tan\alpha}$.
p-073.example: Pa latitude 37°, pa spring equinox (anenge 20 Kurume) kukwira kwemasikati ndi$90^\circ-37^\circ=53^\circ$ uye mumvuri ndi$1/\tan53^\circ=0.75$ ka urefu. Pakutanga kwaKukadzi (kukwira kunenge 38°) yaiva 1.28.
p-073.actionItem: Nhasi masikati tarisa mumvuri wako, kana uri mupfupi kupfuura urefu hwako, pfeka sunscreen SPF30 kana kupfuura uye ngowani.

p-074.title: Kutarisa kumhanya muchikamu, kumhanya kunosiya maminetsi maviri chete
p-074.summary: Kutarisa kumhanya muchikamu kunoongorora kumhanya kwepakati. Nguva inowanikwa nekumhanya kwekukurumidza ishoma asi simba nenjodzi zvinowedzera zvakanyanya.
p-074.principle: Kumhanya kwepakati $\bar v=\dfrac{\Delta s}{\Delta t}$, simba rekudhonza kwemhepo $\propto v^3$.
p-074.example: Kutora chikamu che20km pa100km/h inotora maminetsi 12, pa120km/h maminetsi 10, musiyano wemaminetsi maviri, asi simba rekudhonza kwemhepo rinova ka$1.2^3=1.73$ (+73%) uye simba rekufamba rinowedzera ne44%. Kumhanya kwekutanga kunofanira kudzoserwa pashure, saka hapana mubayiro.
p-074.actionItem: Muchikamu chekutarisa kumhanya, isa cruise control pamuganhu wekumhanya uye famba nenzira yakaenzana.

p-075.title: Pamhere tarisa sensitivity (dB) pane maWatt
p-075.summary: Musiyano we3dB musensitivity kuti uwane ruzha rwakaenzana ndiyo musiyano wekapetwa kaviri kwemagetsi eamplifier. Nhamba hombe yemaWatt haireve ruzha rwakawanda.
p-075.example: Kuti uwane 85dB pa3m, pa1m unoda 94.5dB kunenge. Mhere ine sensitivity 90dB inoda 2.8W kunenge, 84dB inoda 11.2W, ka4 musiyano.
p-075.actionItem: Pamapepa emhere yaunoda kutenga, tarisa sensitivity (dB/1W/1m) uye usarudze yakakwira.

p-076.title: Kudzikisa kumhanya kwefan ne20% chete kunoita magetsi hafu
p-076.summary: Magetsi anoshandiswa nefan anowirirana necube yemhanya. Kana mhepo yakaderera zvishoma ichiita, unogona kuchengetedza magetsi akawanda.
p-076.principle: Mutemo wekufanana kwemafan: mhepo yakaiswa $Q\propto N$, magetsi anoshandiswa $P\propto N^3$.
p-076.example: Kana ukadzikisa mhanya kusvika 80%, mhepo inova 80%, uye magetsi $0.8^3=0.51$ ari hafu. Fan ye40W inodzika kusvika 20W kunenge, uye pamaawa 8 pazuva unochengetedza 4.7kWh pamwedzi.
p-076.actionItem: Nhasi isa fan kana ventilator pa 'pakati' pane 'yakakwira' uye utarise kana kutonhora kuchikwana.

p-077.title: Hozi yemunda ine nozzle imwe chete inochengetedza mvura 40%
p-077.summary: Kana ukamanikidza pakuguma kwehozi, pamvura yakaenzana ruvara rwemvura runomhanya uye runoenda kure, uye shut-off nozzle inobvisa kuparara panofambwa.
p-077.example: Hozi ye15mm dhayamita ine 10L/min (0.167L/s), kumhanya kwemvura kunenge 0.94m/s uye kana ukaisa nozzle ye5mm, kunenge 8.5m/s, ka9 kumhanya, uye kunoda kumanikidza kwe36kPa kunenge. Kana shut-off nozzle ikamisa mvura pakufamba, kudiridza kwemaminetsi 5 kwe50L kunogona kudzikira kusvika 30L.
p-077.actionItem: Isa shut-off nozzle yemaoko pakuguma kwehozi uye udiridze mvura kumidzi yezvirimwa chete.

p-078.title: Ruzha 'gungwa' pakuvhara tepi, water hammer
p-078.summary: Kana ukavhara nekukurumidza, mvura inoyerera inomira zvakanyanya, shock waves dzinoita mupombi, 'gungwa' inzwika uye pombi inogona kukuvara.
p-078.principle: Fomula yaZhukovsky $\Delta p=\rho c\,\Delta v$ (c: kumhanya kwemuzwi mupombi).
p-078.example: Muchipo chemukopa chine kumhanya kwemvura 2m/s, $c\approx1200$m/s, kana ukavhara nekukurumidza, $\Delta p\approx2.4$MPa (24bar), ari ka6 kumanikidza kwemvura kwenguva dzose 3~4bar. Kana nguva yekuvhara iri pamusoro pe$2L/c$ (pamukopa we10m anenge 17ms), kudzvinyirirwa kunoderera zvakanyanya.
p-078.actionItem: Vhara matepi emalever nemavhavha emuchina wekuwachisa zvishoma nezvishoma, uye kana zvichiitika zvakare, bvunza nezvekuisa water hammer arrestor.

p-079.title: Nguva yekuchinja mbatya dzekumhanya, tarisa simba rekubata
p-079.summary: Kana cushion yapera, nguva yekumira kwetsoka inopfupika, uye simba rinoshanda pamabvi nematundu rinowedzera. Tarisa paanenge 500~800km.
p-079.principle: Impulse $F\,\Delta t=\Delta p$, saka simba rekubata repakati $F=\dfrac{m\Delta v}{\Delta t}$.
p-079.example: Kana munhu ane 70kg akadzikisa momentum ye70N·s pakumira, kana akamira mu0.035s ndi2,000N, kana cushion yapera akamira mu0.02s ndi3,500N (anenge ka5 huremu hwemuviri), inowedzera ne75%.
p-079.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kana pasi pembatya dzekumhanya padzvanywa uye pakapwanyika, uye nyora kilometers dzawakamhanya kubva pakuchinja kwekupedzisira.

p-080.title: Kutyaira husiku, kana ukamhanya kupfuura mwenje wepasi, njodzi
p-080.summary: Mwenje wepasi unoratidza anenge 40m asi kumira kwe80km/h kuri kure kupfuura izvi. Kufanana nekupinda munzvimbo isingaonekwi.
p-080.example: Pa80km/h (22.2m/s), nguva yekupindura 1s, $\mu=0.7$ ndi$22.2+36=58$m, kupfuura 40m. Pa60km/h ndi$16.7+20=37$m, yakachengeteka. Mhute kana mafuta mukati megirazi rekumberi zvinopararira mwenje uye zvinodzikisa kuona.
p-080.actionItem: Usati wabva, dhiraya mukati megirazi rekumberi nemwenje, uye munzira dzakasviba dzemativi famba pa60km/h kana pasi.

p-081.title: Helmet yebhasikoro, hupamhi hwekutora kudzvinyirirwa ndihwo hunokosha
p-081.summary: Helmet inowedzera kureba kwekumisa musoro, ichidzikisa simba rekubata. Certification nekukwana pakupfeka zvakakosha kupfuura mutengo kana dhizaini.
p-081.example: Musoro we5kg unorova pa6m/s ndi$E_k=90$J. Pasina helmet, kureba kwekumira 2mm kunopa 45kN kunenge, uye ne20mm EPS foam, 4.5kN kunenge, chikamu chegumi. EPS kana yaomeswa nekurova kamwe, inorasikirwa nesimba.
p-081.actionItem: Tarisa zviratidzo zveKC·CPSC·EN1078, gadzirisa kuti ichikwane pamusoro peziso nekureba kwemunwe miviri, uye chinyorwa chinotenderera pamusoro penzeve chive chimiro cheY.

p-082.title: Mwenje wezuva wemunda, kana wakatsikirirwa kumaodzanyemba 35°, unowana 25% yakawanda
p-082.summary: Solar panel inogamuchira zvakawanda kana ichiri perpendicular nemwenje wezuva. Kana ukatsikirira mwenje wemunda zvinoenderana ne latitude, kuchaja kunowedzera.
p-082.principle: Mwenje unogamuchirwa $\propto\cos\theta$ ($\theta$: kona yekuwira). Kutsikirira kwakanakisa $\approx$ latitude.
p-082.example: Pa latitude 37°, kukwira kwezuva kwemasikati paspring equinox 53°, panel yakatwasuka $\sin53^\circ=0.80$, panel yakamira pamadziro $\cos53^\circ=0.60$, panel yakatsikirirwa 37° 1.0. Inogamuchira anenge 25% yakawanda pane yakatwasuka uye 67% pane yakamira.
p-082.actionItem: Itarisa panel yemwenje wemunda kumaodzanyemba, tsikirira 35~40° uye bvisa mumvuri neguruva.

p-083.title: Mwenje wedesiki, kana wakaswededza 30cm magetsi anova chikamu chechina
p-083.summary: Kujeka kwemwenje kunoderera segwara rekureba. Kana ukaisa mwenje pedyo, unowana kujeka kwakafanana nebulb isina simba.
p-083.example: Kana ukaendesa mwenje kubva pa60cm kusvika pa30cm, illuminance inova ka4. Kuti uwane 500lux pa60cm unoda 12W LED, asi pa30cm 3W inokwana, uye pamaawa 4 pazuva unochengetedza anenge 13kWh pagore.
p-083.actionItem: Isa mwenje anenge 30cm kubva pabhuku, kune rimwe divi kubva paruoko rwekunyora, uye uchinje kuita bulb ine maWatt mashoma.

p-084.title: Nei runhare runocheka mu elevator
p-084.summary: Bhokisi resimbi ndiro Faraday cage inovharira mafungu eelectromagnetic, saka masignal haapindi. Kana wakagadzirira zvichiri nguva, unogona kuchengetedza mafoni akakosha.
p-084.principle: Skin depth $\delta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f\mu\sigma}}$ (kudzika kunoderera mafungu mukondakita).
p-084.example: Mualuminium ($\sigma=3.8\times10^7$S/m), skin depth yefungu re1.8GHz inenge 1.9µm chete, saka kunyange sheet yesimbi yakaonda inovharira masignal. Unovimba nesignal inopinda zvishoma nemukati meminwe yemikova nemakanzura emhepo.
p-084.actionItem: Pedza mafoni akakosha usati wapinda mu elevator kana batidza Wi-Fi calling, uye utore mafaira anodiwa usati wapinda mugaraji repasi.

p-085.title: Kuchenesa kukuru kwechirimo, guruva usapfure, risukunure
p-085.summary: Guruva diki rinogara mumhepo nguva yakasiyana zvinoenderana nehukuru. Kana ukapfura, guruva rakagara rinomuka zvakare uye rinopinda munzira yekufema.
p-085.example: Guruva re10µm rinodzika pa6mm/s kunenge uye rinodzika 1m mumaminetsi 3, asi re2.5µm kumhanya kuri ka$1/16$ kudzika, 0.38mm/s, saka rinotora maminetsi 44. Zvidimbu zvidiki zvinogara mumhepo kwenguva refu kunyange mushure mekuchenesa.
p-085.actionItem: Nhasi pakuchenesa shandisa rag rakanyorova pane kupfura, uye kana wapedza vhura mahwindo uvhunhuke kwehora rimwe.

p-086.title: Mutemo weasekonzi 2 wekureba kwakachengeteka mumugwagwa mukuru
p-086.summary: Kana ukabhureka pakureba kwakaenzana nemota iri pamberi, nzvimbo inodiwa ndiyo reaction distance yemutyairi. Nemasekonzi maviri, pa100km/h unowana anenge 56m.
p-086.example: Pa100km/h (27.8m/s), nguva yekupindura 1.5s unoda $41.7$m uye mutemo weasekonzi 2 unopa 55.6m, iine nzvimbo yakawanda. Kana kuchinaya wedzera kusvika masekonzi 3~4.
p-086.actionItem: Kana mota iri pamberi ichipfuura chiratidzo kana mwenje wemugwagwa, verenga 'imwe, piri' uye utarise kana wapedza kuverenga usati wasvika panzvimbo iyoyo.

p-087.title: Masutukesi nemapurami zvine mavhiri makuru zvinopfuura zvidhinha nyore
p-087.summary: Vhiri rine dhayamita hombe rinokwira chidhinha chimwe chete nekona yakapfava, saka simba rinodiwa shoma.
p-087.principle: Simba rakatwasuka rinosunda axle kana vhiri re radius $R$ richipfuura chidhinha chehurefu $h$ ndi$F=mg\,\dfrac{\sqrt{2Rh-h^2}}{R-h}$.
p-087.example: Kana huremu hunotsikirira vhiri $mg=100$ N, hurefu hwechidhinha $h=1$ cm, dhayamita 6cm inoda anenge 112N, 10cm 75N, 16cm 55N.
p-087.actionItem: Pakutenga sutukesi kana purami, tarisa dhayamita yemavhiri nezvaakagadzirwa nazvo (rabha, urethane), uye pamberi pechidhinha sumudza vhiri rekumberi zvishoma.

p-088.title: Kuchaja nekukurumidza, nei kurasikirwa kuchidzikira kana voltage yakakwira
p-088.summary: Kupisa kunorasika mukuramba kwekabhuru kunowirirana negwara retsika yeki. Kunyange nemagetsi akaenzana, kuchaja ne voltage yakakwira nerudzi rwakadzikira kunodzikisa kurasikirwa.
p-088.example: 18W yakatumirwa pa5V ndi3.6A, saka mukabhuru une kuramba 0.2Ω 2.6W (14%) inorasika, asi pa9V ndi2A, saka 0.8W (4.4%) chete inorasika. Makabhuru akaonda nemarefu anorasikirwa zvakanyanya.
p-088.actionItem: Shandisa kabhuru rakakora uye pfupi rinotsigira standard imwe cheteyo nechaja (PD nezvimwe), uye uchinje makabhuru akare.

p-089.title: Kuomesa mbatya nezuva nemhepo yechirimo
p-089.summary: Kuomesa mvura mumbatya dzakanyorova kunoda simba rakawanda. Zuva nemhepo zvinopa simba iri pasina mubhadharo.
p-089.principle: Latent heat yekuvhuvhutika $Q=mL$ ($L=2.26\times10^6$J/kg), mwero wekuvhuvhutika $E\propto(a+bu)(e_s-e_a)$ (unowedzera nemhepo $u$ yakakura).
p-089.example: Kuvhuvhutisa mvura ye1kg yembatya kunoda $2.26$MJ $\approx0.63$kWh. Kana wakapfura nemamhanya 1,000rpm kana kupfuura uye wakasuka mumhepo ye2m/s, dzinoomera nekukurumidza kupfuura mukati, uye unochengetedza 2~3kWh yekushandisa dryer kamwe. Pamazuva ane pollen yakawanda shandisa mukati.
p-089.actionItem: Kana wapedza kupfura, zunza mbatya, dzirase, uzvirase nemuviri pakati pazvo kuti mhepo ipinde, munzvimbo ine zuva.

p-090.title: Kuchinja matayi echirimo, mabholiti emavhiri asingabviri
p-090.summary: Pakuchinja matayi echando kuita emazuva ose, mabholiti haatsvaire nekuti torque inodiwa yakakura. Wrench refu rinodzikisa simba.
p-090.example: Torque yakatemwa yebholiti yevhiri yanenge 110N·m, kana ukaibvisa nerenji re0.3m unoda simba rinenge 370N, nerenji re0.6m inenge 183N, hafu. Asi pakusunga, usaisa pombi kuti usasunge zvakanyanya, shandisa torque wrench uchiteerera mwero wakatemwa.
p-090.actionItem: Usati wasimudza mota nejack, svetuka bholiti hafu yeruoko vhiri richiri pasi, uye shanda panzvimbo yakati sandara.

p-091.title: Bhegi rekukwira gomo, isa zvinorema padyo nechirebvu
p-091.summary: Bhegi rinenge rakatarisana nemuviri kure, torque inotsikirira chiuno nemapfudzi inowedzera. Kana ukaisa zvinorema padyo nechirebvu uye uchitamisa kurema kuchiuno nebhandi, kuneta kunodzikira.
p-091.principle: Torque $\tau=mgd$ ($d$: kureba kubva paaxis yemuviri kusvika pakati pekurema).
p-091.example: Kana ukaisa kurema kwe6kg 25cm kubva pamuviri, ndi$\tau=6\times9.8\times0.25=14.7$N·m, kana ukaiswededza 10cm, 5.9N·m, kudzika kwenge 60%. Rega bhandi rechiuno ritore 70% yekurema kuenda kunzvimbo yemakumbo.
p-091.actionItem: Isa zvinorema semabhodhoro emvura nemidziyo yechikafu pakati-pakati pechirebvu mubhegi, sunga bhandi rechiuno zvakasimba, wobva.

p-092.title: Kuwana mhepo nekuvhura mahwindo akatarisana kwemaminetsi 10
p-092.summary: Kuvhura mahwindo maviri akatarisana kunoshandura mhepo yekamuri nekukurumidza kupfuura kuvhura hwindo rimwe chete.
p-092.principle: Kufamba kwemhepo kunotevera equation yaBernoulli $p+\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$ nekuyerera $Q=Av$. Kana pane pekupinda nepekubuda, mhepo inopfuura uye ventilation inowedzera.
p-092.example: Muimba ye75 m³ nekuvhurika kwe0.5m² mhepo ye1 m/s inopinda $Q=0.5\times1=0.5\ \mathrm{m^3/s}$ (1,800m³/h). Chaizvoizvo mhepo inoshanduka 5~10 pahora, saka maminetsi 10 anokwana, uye kana ukavhura hwindo rimwe chete ndiyo 1~2 chete.
p-092.actionItem: Nhasi vhura mahwindo akatarisana (kana musuo wepamberi nehwindo) panguva imwe chete, uye uvhunhuke kwemaminetsi 10.

p-093.title: Mhepo yetayi rebhasikoro nekuramba kwekutenderera
p-093.summary: Kana mhepo yetayi iri shoma, kunyange pakumhanya kwakaenzana unoneta zvakanyanya.
p-093.principle: Kuramba kwekutenderera ndi$F_\mathrm{rr}=C_\mathrm{rr}\,mg$, kana mhepo yatsvuka, nzvimbo yekubata inoparara uye kurasikirwa kwekusandurwa kunowedzera, saka $C_\mathrm{rr}$ inowedzera.
p-093.example: Kana huremu hwose hwe80 kg, kana $C_\mathrm{rr}$ yakwira kubva pa0.005 kusvika pa0.010, $F_\mathrm{rr}$ inoita kapetwa kaviri kubva pa3.9N kusvika pa7.8N, uye pa20 km/h (5.6m/s) inowedzera kubva pa22 W kusvika pa44 W.
p-093.actionItem: Usati wabva, zadza mhepo yetayi kusvika pamwero unorairwa (psi/bar) wakanyorwa parutivi rwetayi.

p-094.title: Masiki eguruva anosefa nemagetsi ekumira
p-094.summary: Masiki eKF haasefi nemakuva akaonda asi nemagetsi ekumira anobata guruva, saka kana akaonana nemvura kana doro kushanda kwacho kunoderera.
p-094.principle: Tambo yekusefa ine charge yekusingaperi inokweva zvidimbu neCoulomb force $F=k\dfrac{q_1q_2}{r^2}$. Mvura, doro, nekuvhuvhuta zvinobvisa charge.
p-094.example: KF94 inosefa zvidimbu 0.4μm kupfuura 94%, asi mushure mekupfapfaidza doro kushanda kunogona kudzikira pasi pe80%. Kana wavapfeka kamwe, zvakakodzera kushandisa zuva rimwe (anenge maawa 8 pamusoro).
p-094.actionItem: Usashambidza kana kupfapfaidza masiki nemushonga wekuuraya utachiona, uye kana yanyorova kana kushanduka chimiro, chinja nenyowani nhasi.

p-095.title: Kofi yedrip nekuyerera kwemvura
p-095.summary: Kana ukadururira mvura nechiyerera chidiki uye zvishoma nezvishoma, extraction inokwana uye unowana kunwisa kwakasimba kubva kumhodzi dzakafanana.
p-095.principle: Muromo mutete unowedzera kumhanya kwemvura $v=Q/A$ uye unoita turbulence inosanganisa upfu zvakaenzana. Extraction inoenderana nenguva yekubata nekupisa.
p-095.example: Chimiro chakajairika ndechekudururira 250mL emvura ye92~96°C pamhodzi dzekofi 15g mukati memaminetsi 2.30~3. Kana ukadururira mvura yose mumasekonzi 30, nguva yekubata inodzika kusvika 1/5 uye kofi inova yakaonda uye ine acid yakawanda.
p-095.actionItem: Mangwanani ano nhasi dururira kofi nemvura mukati mezvikamu zvitatu, nechiyerera chidiki uye zvishoma nezvishoma.

p-096.title: Kudzikisa kujeka kwescreen kunodzikisawo magetsi
p-096.summary: Simba rebacklight reLCD monitor rinenge rakaenzana nekujeka, saka kana ukadzikisa kujeka, magetsi nekuneta kweziso zvinodzika pamwe chete.
p-096.principle: Simba rebacklight ndeye $P\approx kB$ rinowirirana nekujeka $B$, uye rose ndi$P=P_0+kB$.
p-096.example: Kana mu40 W yose, backlight iri 25W pa100% kujeka, pa50% 12.5W inobvisa uye unochengetedza 31% kunenge. Pamaawa 8 pazuva ndi$0.0125\times8\times30\approx3$ kWh pamwedzi.
p-096.actionItem: Nhasi dzikisa kujeka kwemonitor neTV kusvika pa50% kunenge zvichienderana nekujeka kwakakomberedza.

p-097.title: Zvirongo zveinduction zvinofanira kuva nepasi pakati sandara
p-097.summary: Induction cooker inopisa nekuita magetsi pasi pechirongo, saka kana pasi paka bhenda kushanda kwekupisa kunoderera.
p-097.principle: Magnetic field inochinja inoita eddy currents pasi pechirongo uye inopisa neJoule heat $P=I^2R$. Kana nzvimbo pakati pepasi nechitofu ichikura, kubatana kunodzikira.
p-097.example: Kushanda kweinduction kunenge 85~90%, kwakakwira kupfuura chitofu chegasi (anenge 40~50%). Kana pasi pakasimudzwa 2mm kana kupfuura, kushanda kunoderera zvakajeka uye kuvira kunotora maminetsi mashoma akawanda.
p-097.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kana chirongo chakagara panzvimbo yakati sandara pasina kuzunguzika kana kusimuka.

p-098.title: Isa mabhuku anorema padyo nemubatsiri weshelufu
p-098.summary: Kunyange huremu hwakaenzana, kana kuri kure nemubatsiri, torque (moment) inoshanda pashelufu inowedzera uye shelufu inotsikirira kana kubuda.
p-098.principle: Moment inoshanda pamubatsiri ndi$M=Fd$ uye inowirirana nekureba $d$.
p-098.example: Kana ukaisa bhuku re5 kg (anenge 49N) 5cm kubva pamubatsiri, $M\approx2.5\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, kana 25cm, $M\approx12\ \mathrm{N\,m}$ ndiko ka5.
p-098.actionItem: Nhasi pakurongedza mashelufu isa zvinorema padyo nemadziro kana vatsigiri, uye zvareruka kunze.

p-099.title: Usarege musuo wefiriji wakavhurika nguva refu
p-099.summary: Kana ukavhura musuo, mhepo inotonhora inobuda uye inopisa inopinda, uye compressor inofanira kushanda zvakare.
p-099.principle: Mhepo inofamba nekusiyana kwedensity uye kupisa $Q=mc\Delta T$ kunopinda. Mhepo yefiriji yemalita 300 inenge 0.36kg.
p-099.example: Kana ukavhura musuo kwemasekonzi 30, tembiricha yemukati inokwira kubva pa4 °C kusvika padyo ne10 °C, uye kutonhodza zvakare kunoda maminetsi 10~20 ekushanda kwecompressor. Kana ukazvivhura pasina chikonzero ka20 pazuva, magetsi emwedzi anogona kuwedzera 2~4%.
p-099.actionItem: Nhasi usati wavhura firiji, sarudza zvauchatora uye uvhare mukati memasekonzi 10.

p-100.title: Kana kureba kwapetwa kaviri, ruzha runodzika ne6 dB
p-100.summary: Kungogara kure nepanobva ruzha kunodzikisa ruzha zvakanyanya, ndiyo nzira iri nyore yekuchengetedza kunzwa.
p-100.principle: Simba repoint source ndi$I\propto1/r^2$ uye kumanikidza kwemuzwi ndi$L=10\log_{10}(I/I_0)$. Kana kureba kwapetwa kaviri ndi$\Delta L=-20\log_{10}2\approx-6\ \mathrm{dB}$.
p-100.example: Mhere ine 90dB pa1 m ndi84 dB pa2 m, 78dB pa4 m. 85dB kwemaawa 8 ne91 dB kwemaawa 2 ndiwo muganhu unorairwa, saka kuisa kureba kunowedzera nguva yakachengeteka.
p-100.actionItem: Nhasi pachirongwa kana panzvimbo yekuvaka, mira kure kaviri kubva pamhere kana panobva ruzha.

p-101.title: Kana kumhanya kwapetwa kaviri, kureba kwekubhureka kuri ka4
p-101.summary: Kunyange kudzikisa kumhanya zvishoma kunodzikisa kureba kwekubhureka zvakanyanya, uye kunodzikisa njodzi yeruzhinji.
p-101.principle: Kureba kwekubhureka kubva pasimba rekufamba $\tfrac{1}{2}mv^2=\mu mg\,d$ kuenda $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Kunowirirana negwara rekumhanya.
p-101.example: Pamugwagwa wakaoma ($\mu\approx0.7$) 50km/h (13.9m/s) inenge 14m, 100km/h (27.8m/s) inenge 56m, ka4. Pamugwagwa wakanyorova ($\mu\approx0.4$) pa100 km/h unoda anenge 98m.
p-101.actionItem: Nhasi kana kuchinaya, dzikisa kumhanya ne20% pasi pemuganhu uye uchengete kureba kwakapetwa kaviri nemota iri pamberi.

p-102.title: Yera huremu nesikero pasi pakaoma uye pakati sandara
p-102.summary: Pakapeti yakapfava kana pasi pakatsikirira, masensors esikero haawani simba zvakaenzana uye kuyera kunozunguzika.
p-102.principle: Sikero rinoyera nehuwandu hwemasensor mana emakona $W=\sum F_i$. Kana pasi pakatsikirira kana kupfava, kugoverwa kwekurema kunoshanduka.
p-102.example: Kana huremu hwemuviri hwe70 kg, $mg\approx686$ N inogoverwa kumasensor mana ne171 N imwe neimwe, asi kana ruvanze rumwe rwakadzvanywa pasi pakapfava, sensor imwe inotora zvakawanda uye hutadzi hunoitika.
p-102.actionItem: Isa sikero panzvimbo yakaoma uye yakati sandara senge matayera ekushambira, uye uyere nguva dzose panzvimbo imwe cheteyo.

p-103.title: Zvinonamira zvinosunganidzwa nemhepo zvinonamira kana mhepo yabviswa
p-103.summary: Simba rekunamira kwebhokisi rekushambira harisi remunamiri asi kumanikidza kwemhepo yekunze kunotsikirira.
p-103.principle: Simba rekunamira ndi$F=\Delta P\cdot A$. Kana mhepo yemukati yabviswa, musiyano nekumanikidza kwemhepo yekunze (anenge 101kPa) unotsikirira pamapepa.
p-103.example: Nzvimbo yepepa ye5 cm dhayamita ndi$A=\pi(0.025)^2\approx1.96\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, saka simba repamusoro rinenge $101{,}000\times1.96\times10^{-3}\approx198$ N. Chaizvoizvo rakaderera zvakanyanya nekuti mhepo inobuda.
p-103.actionItem: Usati wanamira, dhiraya mvura neguruva patayera kana girazi, tsikirira zvakasimba kubvisa mhepo, wozoturika zvisingapfuure huremu hwakatenderwa hwakanyorwa.

p-104.title: Masikati dzima mwenje uchishandisa mwenje wepahwindo
p-104.summary: Mumazuva akajeka echirimo, mwenje wezuva pahwindo unopfuura mwenje wemukati kakawanda, saka masikati kazhinji kudzima mwenje kunokwana.
p-104.principle: Illuminance ndi$E=\Phi/A$ (chikamu lx). Pahwindo pazuva rakajeka inenge 1,000 lx kana kupfuura, nepo illuminance yemukati inorairwa kuverenga neofisi ari 300~500 lx.
p-104.example: Kana ukadzima mabhubhu matatu eLED e8 W (24W) mumba yekugara kwemaawa 6 masikati, unochengetedza $0.024\times6\times30\approx4.3$ kWh pamwedzi.
p-104.actionItem: Nhasi masikati vhura machira, tamisira dhesiki kana nzvimbo yekuverenga pahwindo, uye udzime mwenje.

p-105.title: Pafan, enzanisa ruzha nekuyerera kwemhepo (CMM)
p-105.summary: Kunyange dhayamita yakaenzana, huwandu hwemhepo hunosiyana. Kuyerera kwemhepo kunotarirwa nekuwanda kwenzvimbo yemapepa nekumhanya kwemhepo.
p-105.principle: Kuyerera kwemhepo ndi$Q=Av$ (chikamu $\mathrm{m^3/min}$). Nzvimbo yefan ine dhayamita $D$ ndi$A=\pi D^2/4$.
p-105.example: Kana fan ye0.3m ($A\approx0.071\ \mathrm{m^2}$) ichifuridza pa3 m/s pakati, ndi$Q\approx0.21\ \mathrm{m^3/s}\approx12.8\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$, uye inosanganisa mhepo yemuimba ye30 $\mathrm{m^3}$ kamwe chete mumaminetsi 2 nemasekonzi 20.
p-105.actionItem: Pakutenga fan kana circulator, enzanisa kuyerera kwemhepo (CMM), ruzha (dB) nemagetsi (W) patafura yechigadzirwa.

p-106.title: Insect screen kana yakakora inovharira zvikwekwe asi inodzikisawo mhepo
p-106.summary: Kana huwandu hwemesh hwewedzera, mabhurukwa anova madiki uye anovharira zvikwekwe zvidiki, asi nzvimbo inopfuurwa nemhepo (open ratio) inodzikawo.
p-106.principle: Hukuru hweburuka hunenge $25.4/N-d$ mm ($N$: huwandu hwetambo pa inch, $d$: dhayamita yetambo) uye open ratio ndi$\varphi=\left(\dfrac{p-d}{p}\right)^2$ ($p=25.4/N$).
p-106.example: Kana dhayamita yetambo iri 0.25mm, 18 mesh ine burukwa 1.16mm kunenge, open ratio 68% kunenge, uye 24 mesh ine burukwa 0.81mm kunenge, open ratio 58% kunenge.
p-106.actionItem: Usati wachinja insect screen, sarudza hukuru hwezvikwekwe zvaunoda kudzivirira nekuwanda kwemhepo inodiwa, wosarudza huwandu hwemesh.

p-107.title: Magetsi anowedzera nezvakaenzana nekushanda kwechaja
p-107.summary: Simba rinotorwa muchikoro rinopfuura simba rinopinda mubhatiri refoni. Musiyano unorasika semoto muchaja nebhatiri.
p-107.example: Bhatiri re5,000 mAh·3.85V rinenge 19.3Wh. Kana kuchaja kuri 85%, kubva pakoro unoshandisa $19.3/0.85\approx22.7$ Wh, uye kuchaja 300 pagore kunenge 6.8kWh.
p-107.actionItem: Nhasi paunochaja shandisa adapter yakasimbiswa, uye uchaje panzvimbo ine mhepo, kwete pasi pemakumbo.

p-108.title: Kana musoro wakakwirira zvakanyanya, kurema kunotakurwa nemutsipa kunowedzera
p-108.summary: Huremu hwemusoro hunoda simba guru remuzvimba wemutsipa kana hwakatsikira mberi nekuda kwe lever effect.
p-108.principle: Kana huremu hwemusoro $W$ huri kure $d$ mberi kubva pakubata kwemutsipa, moment $M=Wd$ inoitika, uye mhasuru dzinofanira kuitsungirira.
p-108.example: Huremu hwemusoro hunenge 5 kgf, uye modhi yekuongorora inofungidzira kuti kana musoro wakadonha 15°, mutoro wemutsipa unowedzera kusvika 12 kgf kunenge, uye pa60° 27 kgf kunenge.
p-108.actionItem: Nhasi simudza screen yelaptop kana runhare padanho reziso, uye pamaminetsi 30 ega ega simudza musoro uye usekesere mutsipa.

p-109.title: Tafura ine makumbo mana inobata pamapoinzi matatu chete uye inozunguzika
p-109.summary: Nzvimbo yakatwasuka inotsanangurwa nemapoinzi matatu, saka kana gumbo rechina risiri panzvimbo imwe chete, rimwe gumbo rinogara rakasimuka uye tafura inozunguzika.
p-109.principle: Mamiriro ekuenzana ndi$\sum F=W$ ne$\sum M=0$. Kutsigirwa nemapoinzi matatu kunogara kwakasimba, asi mana anobata chete kana ari panzvimbo imwe chete.
p-109.example: Kana gumbo rimwe riri 1mm pfupi, gumbo iroro rinosimuka uye mamwe matatu anogovana kurema. Pepa rakapetwa rinenge 0.1~0.2mm, saka unofanira kupeta akati wandei kuti ugadzirise.
p-109.actionItem: Isa pepa rakapetwa kana pad inogadziriswa pasi pegumbo rinozunguzika, uye kana yakaenzana tsikirira nemaoko utarise kana yatomira kuzunguzika.

p-110.title: Kana mvura yeshawa iri shoma
p-110.summary: Kana limescale yaungana muburuka reshawa head, maburukwa anopfava uye kuyerera kunodzikira zvakanyanya.
p-110.principle: Kuyerera mupombi diki kunoenderana nemutemo wePoiseuille $Q=\dfrac{\pi r^4\Delta P}{8\eta L}$ uye kunowirirana nepeturo yechina yeradius.
p-110.example: Kana radius yeburukwa yadzikira ne20%, kuyerera kunova ka$0.8^4\approx0.41$, kudzika ne59%. Kana ukanyudza shawa head mumvura yakasanganiswa nevhiniga 1:1 kwemaminetsi 30, limescale inonyunguduka.
p-110.actionItem: Nhasi bvisa shawa head, uinyudze mumvura yevhiniga yakasanganiswa kwemaminetsi 30, wozoshambidza.

p-111.title: Waterproof rating yetende mm ndiko kureba kwemudiwa wemvura
p-111.summary: Waterproof rating yetende rekambi mumwaka wemvura inoreva kureba kwenzvimbo yemvura (mm) ruvara rwunogona kusunga.
p-111.principle: Hydrostatic pressure ndi$P=\rho g h$. Mutsara wemvura 1,000mm unenge 9.8kPa.
p-111.example: Waterproof rating 1,500mm iruvara runosunga $1000\times9.8\times1.5=14.7$ kPa. Kunaya kwakasimba nepasi panotsikirirwa nehuremu hwemunhu zvinodawo mwero wakakwirira.
p-111.actionItem: Usati wakambi mumwaka wemvura, tarisa waterproof rating yelabel yetende (fly 1,500mm kana kupfuura inorairwa) nemamiriro ekusona.

p-112.title: Tarisa gasket yemusuo wefiriji nepepa
p-112.summary: Kana rabha regasket remusuo riri lahlama, mhepo inopisa inopinda uye compressor inoshanda nguva refu.
p-112.principle: Kupisa kunopinda nemukaha ndi$\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$. Kana nzvimbo yemukaha ichiwedzera, kuyerera kwemhepo nekupinda kwekupisa kunowedzera.
p-112.example: Kana mukaha uri 1mm pakati, uye muzonga wemusuo 3m, nzvimbo yemukaha ndi$0.001\times3=3\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, 30cm², inofanana nekuvhurika kwehomwe yepamberi.
p-112.actionItem: Isa pepa mumusuo wavhara uchidhonza. Kana pane panobuda nyore, dhiraya kana chinja gasket.

p-113.title: Magetsi anoshandiswa nemidziyo yepamusha anozopedzisira ashanduka kupisa mukamuri
p-113.summary: Simba remagetsi rinopedzisira rashanduka kupisa uye rinokwidza tembiricha yemukati. Mutoro weAC unowedzerawo.
p-113.principle: Zvinoenderana nekuchengetedzwa kwesimba $Q=Pt$. Magetsi emidziyo $P$ anenge ose anova kupisa kwemukamuri.
p-113.example: Kana ukashandisa computer ye100 W kwemaawa 4, $0.1\times4=0.4$ kWh, inenge 1.44MJ inoramba semoto mukamuri, inofanana nehita diki ye100 W.
p-113.actionItem: Nhasi dzima makomputa, mwenje nemachaja asingashandiswi kudzikisa zvinobva kupisa mukamuri.

p-114.title: Enzanisa energy efficiency label nekWh yegore
p-114.summary: Usatarise grade chete, enzanisa kWh yegore (kana yemwedzi) yakanyorwa pa label uone magetsi chaiwo anoshandiswa.
p-114.principle: Simba remagetsi ndi$E=Pt$ (kWh). Musiyano wemagetsi egore unowedzerwa nenguva yekushandisa kuwana musiyano wose.
p-114.example: Firiji ye300 kWh pagore neye450 kWh pagore zvinosiyana ne150 kWh pagore, 1,500kWh mumakore 10.
p-114.actionItem: Pakutenga midziyo, enzanisa grade yekushanda kwesimba negore kWh pa label.

p-115.title: Sarudza air purifier neCADR nehukuru hwekamuri
p-115.summary: Mumwaka weguruva, kushanda kwepurifier kunofanira kuenderana nehukuru hwekamuri. Chikuru ndechekuti inosefa mhepo kangani pahora.
p-115.principle: Huwandu hwekushandurwa kwemhepo pahora ndi$\mathrm{ACH}=\mathrm{CADR}/V$. CADR ndiyo huwandu hwemhepo yakachena ($\mathrm{m^3/h}$).
p-115.example: Kana purifier ye CADR 300 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ ikashandiswa mukamuri re25 $\mathrm{m^2}$ × 2.4m = 60 $\mathrm{m^3}$, ndi$300/60=5$ pahora.
p-115.actionItem: Nhasi wedzera nzvimbo yekamuri nehurefu hwedenga kuwana vhoriyamu, wotarisa kana CADR yepurifier iri ka5 kana kupfuura vhoriyamu.

p-116.title: Mhute pagirazi remota inobva padew point
p-116.summary: Kana tembiricha yegirazi yadzika pasi pedew point yemhepo yemukati, mvura inoita mhute pagirazi.
p-116.principle: Kubva pa relative humidity $\mathrm{RH}$ netembiricha, dew point $T_d$ inoverengwa, uye Magnus formula ndi$T_d\approx\dfrac{243.12\,\gamma}{17.62-\gamma}$, $\gamma=\ln\mathrm{RH}+\dfrac{17.62\,T}{243.12+T}$.
p-116.example: Mukati 22°C, relative humidity 70% dew point inenge 16.3°C. Kana tembiricha yegirazi iri 10°C, mhute inoitika, uye kana ukabatidza AC (dehumidify) nemhepo inopisa pamwe, humidity yepagirazi inodzika.
p-116.actionItem: Kana girazi rekumberi rakaita mhute, nhasi vhura bhatani reAC uchinje kuita mhepo yekunze kuti udzikise humidity.

p-117.title: Pazvinhu zvakakora, cheka nemukati meshizha remakisi
p-117.summary: Makisi chiyero chekuwedzera simba, saka pedyo neaxis mukati meshizha, simba rimwe chete reruoko rinopa simba rekucheka rakakura.
p-117.principle: Kuenzana kwechiyero ndi$F_{\text{cheka}}\,d_c=F_{\text{ruoko}}\,d_h$. Pedyo nepoint yekucheka nenzvimbo yeaxis, $d_c$ inova diki uye $F_{\text{cheka}}$ inova hombe.
p-117.example: Kana kubva paruoko kusvika paaxis ndi$d_h=10$ cm, uye poindi yekucheka iri 3cm kubva paaxis, simba reruoko re50 N rinova $50\times10/3\approx167$ N. Pamuromo (10cm) rinoramba 50N.
p-117.actionItem: Nhasi paunocheka zvinhu zvakakora zvekuputira kana kadhibhodhi, isa mukati zvakadzika meshizha remakisi.
