p-118.title: Kukwira makwara iyo yakanaka kunyange kana ichiyerwa nesimba
p-118.summary: Kana ukakwira dhizha rimwe, unoita basa rekusimudza muviri uye unobuda simba rakakura kunyange munguva pfupi.
p-118.principle: Simba rekukwira ndi$P=\dfrac{mgh}{t}$. Ndiko kuwedzera kwepotential energy $mgh$ kwakakamurwa nenguva yatorwa.
p-118.example: Munhu ane huremu 70kg anokwira dhizha rimwe (3m) mumasekonzi 15 ndi$P=70\times9.8\times3/15\approx137$ W. Potential energy yedhizha rimwe inenge 2.1kJ uye kana tichiti kushanda kwemhasuru 25%, metabolic energy inenge 2kcal.
p-118.actionItem: Nhasi panzvimbo yeelevator kwira makwara maviri, batisa borobhoro kuti ufambe zvakachengeteka.

p-119.title: Travel adapter, tarisa voltage nekuyerera, kwete chimiro chepulagi
p-119.summary: Kunyange pulagi yakwana, haisi kuti zvose zvinogona kushandiswa. Kana voltage iine mutsauko nenyika, kuyerera nekuchengeteka kwemidziyo kunosiyana.
p-119.principle: Simba $P=VI$ saka pasimba rakaenzana, kana voltage iri shoma, kuyerera $I=P/V$ kunowedzera.
p-119.example: Chishandiso che1,500W pa220 V ndi$I\approx6.8$ A, asi kana chikashandiswa munyika ye110 V nechishandura voltage, ndi$I\approx13.6$ A, zvinoita kuti zviri nyore kupfuura mwero weadapter.
p-119.actionItem: Usati wafamba, tarisa voltage yenzvimbo yauri kuenda nayo neinput voltage yelabel yechishandiso chako (semuenzaniso 100-240V), uye utarise kuyerera kunotenderwa kweadapter.

p-120.title: Mubhazi rinomira nekukurumidza, kotamisa mabvi uye wanzura makumbo
p-120.summary: Kana bhazi richibhureka nekukurumidza, muviri unokandirwa mberi nekuda kweinertia. Maitiro ekumira nekubata kwetsoka zvinodzivirira kuwa.
p-120.principle: Inertial force ndi$F=ma$, uye kuti makumbo asatsvedza, coefficient yekubata inofanira kuva $\mu\ge a/g$.
p-120.example: Kana deceleration $a=3\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ (anenge 0.3g), munhu ane 60kg anokandirwa mberi ne180 N kunenge, uye kubata kwemachira nepasi kunofanira kuva $\mu\ge0.31$ kuti usatsvedza.
p-120.actionItem: Nhasi kana uri kumira mubhazi kana chitima, wanzura makumbo munzira yekufamba uye batisa borobhoro.

p-121.title: Banga rakapinza rinoda simba shoma
p-121.summary: Kana banga rakapinza, nzvimbo yekubata idiki saka pasimba rakaenzana kumanikidza kunowedzera zvakanyanya uye zvinhu zvinopwanyika nyore.
p-121.principle: Kumanikidza ndi$P=\dfrac{F}{A}$. Kana nzvimbo yemucheto $A$ iri diki, pa$F$ imwe cheteyo $P$ inowedzera.
p-121.example: Kana upamhi hwemucheto weshizha re1 cm uri 0.02mm, ndi$A=2\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, pa20 N ndi$P=10\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Kana rakapfava rikava 0.2mm, rinova 1MPa, chikamu chegumi, saka unofanira kusundidza zvakanyanya uye njodzi yekutsvedza nekukuvara inowedzera.
p-121.actionItem: Nhasi yedza kana banga raunoshandisa rinocheka pepa nyore, uye kana rakapfava, pinza nebwe kana muchina wekupinza.

p-122.title: Inverter AC usaidzima uchibatidza
p-122.summary: Inverter AC inochengetedza tembiricha yakatarwa nekugadzirisa mhanya yecompressor, saka kuramba yakabatidzwa kunowedzera kushanda.
p-122.principle: Cooling coefficient of performance $\mathrm{COP}=\dfrac{Q_c}{W}$ inowedzera pa partial load nekuti heat exchanger inova hombe uye musiyano wetembiricha unodzikira.
p-122.example: Kana constant-speed ichishandisa 480W pakati (0.8kW × 60% nguva) uye inverter 300W kunenge, pamaawa 6 pazuva ndi2.88 vs 1.8kWh, uye pamazuva 30 unochengetedza 32kWh kunenge.
p-122.actionItem: Nhasi isa AC pa26~28°C uye urambe wakaibatidza.

p-123.title: Gadzirai mumvuri wechikamu chekunze che air conditioner
p-123.summary: Kana mhepo yakatenderedza chikamu chekunze yakanyanya kutonhora, compressor inoshanda zvishoma uye inopa kutonhodza kwakafanana nemagetsi mashoma.
p-123.principle: Kuita kwakanakisisa kwekutonhodza ndiko Carnot $\mathrm{COP}_\mathrm{max}=\dfrac{T_c}{T_h-T_c}$. Kunowedzera kana condensation temperature $T_h$ yakaderera.
p-123.example: Kana evaporation temperature $T_c=280\ \mathrm{K}$, $T_h=318\ \mathrm{K}$ inova 7.4, $308\ \mathrm{K}$ inova 10, angangoita 35% yakakwira. Mumidziyo chaiyo, kudzikisa tembiricha yemhepo inopinda ne3~5°C kunodzikisa magetsi ne5~10%.
p-123.actionItem: Nhasi isai mumvuri pamusoro pechikamu chekunze, asi musavhara kufamba kwemhepo kwe30 cm kana kupfuura kumberi nekumashure.

p-124.title: Shandisai air conditioner nefeni pamwe chete
p-124.summary: Kana feni ichigadzira mhepo, tembiricha inonzwika inodzikira ne2~3°C, saka unogona kukwidza setting yeair conditioner.
p-124.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa kweganda kuburikidza ne convection ndi $Q=hA(T_s-T_a)$, uye kana kumhanya kwemhepo kuchiwedzera, heat transfer coefficient $h$ inowedzera.
p-124.example: Pane ganda re33 °C, mukati me28 °C, nzvimbo ye1.8m², pasina mhepo $h\approx5$ ndi45 W, nemhepo ye1 m/s $h\approx10$ unorasikirwa angangoita 90W ukanzwa kutonhorera. Kukwidza setting ne1 °C kunodzikisa magetsi ne5~10%.
p-124.actionItem: Nhasi kwidzai air conditioner kuita 28°C uye mushandise feni pakumhanya kwakaderera pamwe chete.

p-125.title: Tonhodzai kani yechinwiwa nekitchen towel yakanyorova
p-125.summary: Nenheyo yekuti mvura yakavhuvhuta inotora kupisa, kana ukaputira kani netissue yakanyorova ukaisa kumhepo, chinwiwa chinodzikira madhigirii mashoma.
p-125.principle: Kuvhuvhuta kunoda kupisa kwe $Q=mL_v$, uye $L_v\approx2.4\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$ yemvura. Kupisa uku kunotorwa muchinwiwa.
p-125.example: Kana 10g yemvura ikavhuvhuta, inotora angangoita 24kJ, saka chinwiwa che355 mL chinodzikira $\Delta T=24/(0.355\times4.0)\approx17\ \mathrm{K}$ mudzidziso. Chaizvoizvo, pamberi pemhepo mumaminitsi 10 kunodzikira 5~8°C.
p-125.actionItem: Nhasi putirai kani isinganyanyi kutonhora nekitchen towel yakanyorova muise pamberi pefeni kwemaminitsi 10.

p-126.title: Mumvuri unoshanda kana wakavhara kunze kwegirazi
p-126.summary: Kana wavhara mushure mokunge chiedza chazuva chapfuura negirazi, kupisa kwatopinda mukati. Mumvuri wekunze unoshanda zvakanyanya.
p-126.principle: Kupisa kwezuva kunopinda nepawindo ndi $Q=\mathrm{SHGC}\times A\times I$. Kuisa chinovhara kunodzikisa effective SHGC.
p-126.example: Pawindo re2 m², nechiedza chezuva che600 W/m², girazi rakajeka (SHGC 0.8) rinopinza 960W, blind yemukati (0.5) 600W, mumvuri wekunze (0.15) angangoita 180W, kudzikisa angangoita 80%.
p-126.actionItem: Nhasi tsvakai mumvuri unogona kuiswa kunze kwewindo (awning, blind yekunze, roll screen).

p-127.title: Mukati mekare yakamiswa munopisa nokukurumidza
p-127.summary: Mukati mekare pasi pezuva munoita segreenhouse, kupisa kunosungwa, saka kusiya mwana kana mhuka yekuchengeta kunyange kwechinguva kunoshamisa ngozi.
p-127.principle: Girazi rinoita kuti chiedza chezuva chinopfuura (short-wave), asi rinosunga infrared (long-wave) inoburitswa nemukati unodziya. Kupisa kunotorwa $Q=\alpha IA$ kwakakura kupfuura kurasikirwa kwe convection nekuendesa kupisa.
p-127.example: Pane tembiricha yekunze ye30 °C, mukati mekare munogona kusvika angangoita 50°C mumaminitsi 30, dashboard kusvika kupfuura 70°C. Kunyange ukavhura windo zvishoma, kukwira kwetembiricha hakudzikiri zvakanyanya.
p-127.actionItem: Nhasi pese paunobuda mukare tarisai chigaro chekumashure, uye musarega mwana kana mhuka yekuchengeta.

p-128.title: Gadzirisai kukwirira kwechigaro chebhasikoro kuti mabvi akotamiswe zvishoma
p-128.summary: Kana chigaro chakaderera zvikuru, mabvi anotapukirwa zvakanyanya, uye kana chakakwira zvikuru, chiuno chinodedera nokukuvadza musana nemabvi.
p-128.principle: Fomura yakajairika yekufungidzira kukwirira kwechigaro ndi $\approx0.883\times$ (urefu hwemuguyo kubva pasi kusvika pachiuno). Kana pedal iri pazasi, mabvi anotsamira 25~35°.
p-128.example: Kana urefu hwemuguyo ari 80cm, kukwirira kwechigaro ndi $0.883\times80\approx70.6$ cm (kubva pa axle yepedal kusvika pamusoro pechigaro).
p-128.actionItem: Nhasi usati wakwira bhasikoro, yerai kukwirira kwechigaro, muise pedal pazasi, muise chitsitsinho pamusoro, mutarise kuti vabi vanenge vachitambanuka.

p-129.title: Kudzikisa tembiricha yemvura yekushamba ne2~4°C kunodzikisa simba
p-129.summary: Kunyange huwandu hwemvura inopisa hwakafanana, kupisa mvura kusvika patembiricha yakakwira kunoda simba rakawanda.
p-129.principle: Kupisa kunopisa mvura ndi $Q=mc\Delta T$. Specific heat yemvura ndi $c=4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\,K)}$.
p-129.example: Mvura yepombi 15°C, kupisa 40L yemvura yekushamba kusvika 42°C ndi $40\times4.18\times27\approx4{,}514$ kJ (1.25kWh), uye kusvika 38°C angangoita 3,846kJ (1.07kWh), musiyano we0.19kWh pakushamba kamwe, angangoita 68kWh pagore.
p-129.actionItem: Nhasi edzai kudzikisa tembiricha yemvura yekushamba ne2~4°C, uye kana kuchitonhora, taurai kutanga kudzikisa nguva yekushamba.

p-130.title: Edzai kudzikisa 10km/h chete mumugwagwa mukuru
p-130.summary: Kudzivirira kwemhepo kunowedzera nesquare yekumhanya, saka kunyange kudzikisa kumhanya zvishoma kunochengetedza mafuta zvinoonekwa.
p-130.principle: Simba rekudzivirira kwemhepo ndi $F_d=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^2$ uye simba rinoshandiswa ndi $P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$.
p-130.example: Pa $C_dA=0.7\ \mathrm{m^2}$, 110km/h (30.6m/s) ndi angangoita 12.0kW, 100km/h angangoita 9.0kW, 25% shoma. Simba pakireshoni $(100/110)^2\approx0.83$ nguva rinodzikira ne17%, uye nguva yeku100 km inowedzera maminitsi 5 chete.
p-130.actionItem: Nhasi mumugwagwa mukuru, famba nekumhanya kuri pasi pe10 km/h pamusoro pemuganhu wekumhanya, uchichengetedza kumhanya kwakaenzana.

p-131.title: Tarisai huremu hwemuviri uye buoyancy (N) yelife jacket
p-131.summary: Tube yekushambira haisi life jacket. Life jacket inopa buoyancy inokwana kuchengetedza chiso pamusoro pemvura.
p-131.principle: Buoyancy ndi $F_b=\rho V g$. Kana ukasundira 1L yemvura, unotambira simba rinosvika 9.8N.
p-131.example: Jacket ye50 N buoyancy inoenderana nebuoyancy yekusundira angangoita 5L yemvura (angangoita 5.1 kgf). Vana nevakuru vanoda buoyancy yakasiyana, saka chigadzirwa chinofanira kuenderana nemhando yehuremu.
p-131.actionItem: Usati washamba, tarisai label yehuremu hwemuviri nechiratidzo chekutenda pa life jacket, uye mushure mekuipfeka, simbisai chin strap.

p-132.title: Kuenda nebhasikoro uri kumashure kwemumwe munhu kunoda simba shoma
p-132.summary: Nekuda kwe slipstream apo munhu ari mberi anovhara mhepo, unogona kufamba nekumhanya kwakafanana nesimba shoma.
p-132.principle: Simba rekudzivirira kwemhepo ndi $P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$. Kana uri kumashure, effective $C_d$ inodzikira.
p-132.example: Pamugwagwa wakati sandara pa30 km/h (8.3m/s), kana $C_dA=0.35\ \mathrm{m^2}$ $P\approx0.5\times0.35\times1.2\times8.3^3\approx120\ \mathrm{W}$ inova, uye kuenda kumashure chaiko kunodzikisa ne30~40% kusvika angangoita 75~85W.
p-132.actionItem: Nhasi muhurongwa hwegroup ride, chengetai chinhambwe che1~2m kumashure kwemumwe munhu, asi musabatanidza mavhiri ekumberi.

p-133.title: Tarisai kutenda nekupisa kwe fast charger
p-133.summary: Kana simba rekuchaja rakawanda, kupisa kunowedzerawo, saka charger yakatendwa nekufamba kwemhepo zvinoona kuchengeteka nehupenyu hwebhatiri.
p-133.principle: Simba ndi $P=VI$, kurasikirwa kwekushandurwa ndi $P_\mathrm{loss}=(1-\eta)P$. Kana efficiency $\eta=0.88$, charger ye20 W inoita angangoita 2.4W kupisa.
p-133.example: Kupisa kwe charger ye5 W angangoita 0.6W, charger ye65 W angangoita 7.8W. Kana kupisa kusingabudi sepasi pegumbeze, bhatiri rinopfuura 35°C, kuchaja kunononoka nehupenyu hunodzikira.
p-133.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai chiratidzo chekutenda (sema KC) pa charger nechiratidzo che W chinoenderana nechigadzirwa, uye musachaja pasi pegumbeze.

p-134.title: Kana uchimirira kwemasekonzi anopfuura 10, kudzima injini kwakanaka
p-134.summary: Injini inoramba ichimhanya ichipisa mafuta kunyange isiri kufamba. Kumirira kwenguva refu, kuparadza kunowedzera.
p-134.principle: Kushandiswa kwemafuta ndi $V_f=\dot V_f\,t$ uye idling fuel consumption rate $\dot V_f$ yemotokari yevanhu kazhinji 0.6~1L/h.
p-134.example: Kana $\dot V_f=0.8$ L/h, kumira kwemaminitsi 5 (300 s) kunopisa $0.8/3600\times300\approx0.067$ L, kamwe pazuva kwemazuva 365 angangoita 24L.
p-134.actionItem: Kana uri pakuparka kana kumirira munhu, dzimai injini (mota dzine auto-stop panguva yerobhoti dzishandise sezvazviri).

p-135.title: Shangu dzine chitsitsinho chidiki dzinoita kuti huremu hwakafanana huve nekudzvinyirirwa kakawanda
p-135.summary: Kana huremu hwemuviri hwakakumbanira pachinhu chimwe, kudzvinyirirwa kunowedzera uye tsoka nepasi zvose zvinotambura.
p-135.principle: Kudzvinyirirwa ndi $P=F/A$. Kunyange simba rakafanana, kana nzvimbo yekubatana $A$ yakadzikira, kudzvinyirirwa kunowedzera.
p-135.example: Kana huremu hwemuviri hwe60 kgf (angangoita 588N) huri patsoka imwe, chitsitsinho che1 cm² chine kudzvinyirirwa kwe5.9MPa, chitsitsinho che20 cm² chakafara chine 0.29MPa, musiyano wenguva 20.
p-135.actionItem: Pazuva rekufamba kwenguva refu, pfekai shangu dzine nzvimbo yekubatana yakafara kuderedza mutoro patsoka nemabvi.

p-136.title: Ruzha rwemusoro wepasi runoda mass nekunyudza ruzha
p-136.summary: Zvinhu zvinorema nezvakakora zvinoshanda kudzivirira ruzha, uye mat kana padi inodzikisa kurova inobatsira.
p-136.principle: Maererano neMutemo we mass, transmission loss ndi $TL\approx20\log_{10}(mf)-47\ \mathrm{dB}$ ($m$: kg/m², $f$: Hz), uye kana mass yakapetwa kaviri inowedzera angangoita 6dB.
p-136.example: Kudzikira kwe10 dB kunonzwika sekudzikira kwehafu yeruzha. Kuisa felt pad kumakumbo echigaro kunogona kudzikisa ruzha rwekudhonza ne5~10dB, uye mat rakakora rinodzikisa ruzha rwekusvetuka.
p-136.actionItem: Nhasi isai felt pad pamakumbo echigaro uye rukidzai mat rakakora panzvimbo yamunofamba kazhinji.

p-137.title: Kushandisa tsvimbo uchidzika gomo kunoyamura mabvi
p-137.summary: Tsvimbo dzinogovanisa chikamu chemutoro kumaoko, ichidzikisa mutoro wemabvi pakudzika.
p-137.principle: Pakudzika, mabvi anotambira simba rinosvika katatu kweuremu hwemuviri pakutora kuvhunduka, uye kana tsvimbo dzichigovana simba rekutsigira $F_s$, simba remabvi rinodzikira kusvika $F_k=3mg-F_s$.
p-137.example: Kana huremu hwemuviri hwe70 kg, huremu ndi686 N uye simba remabvi angangoita 2,060N. Kana tsvimbo dzichitora angangoita 20%, dzinodzikisa angangoita 410N.
p-137.actionItem: Nhasi pakukwira gomo, gadzirisai urefu hwetsvimbo kuti nhengo yepaoko ive 90 degrees, uye dzirefusei pakudzika.

p-138.title: Kuvhura chikafu chakaomeswa mufiriji yekutonhodza kunodzosa kutonhora
p-138.summary: Nekuti echine rinotora kupisa kana richinyungudika, kuvhura mufiriji yekutonhodza kunoita kuti kutonhora uku kushandiswe kutonhodza firiji.
p-138.example: Kana nyama yakaomeswa ye1 kg ine angangoita 70% yeechine, kuvhura kunotora $0.7\times334\approx234$ kJ (angangoita 0.065kWh). Firiji inoshanda zvishoma nokuda kweizvi.
p-138.actionItem: Nhasi manheru, tamisai zvekubika kubva mufiriji yekuomesa kuenda mufiriji yekutonhodza husiku hwekare. Mbivi dzekuvhura panze dzinofanira kudzivirirwa nekuda kwehutsanana.

p-139.title: Kana tambo yekuomesa nguvo yakakwevera zvakanyanya, simba rinotorwa netambo nemakoko rinowedzera
p-139.summary: Kana ukakwevera tambo yekuomesa nguvo zvakasimba, kudonha kunodzikira, asi simba rinoshanda patambo nemakoko rinowedzera zvikuru.
p-139.principle: Kana huremu $W$ huri pakati petambo yakachinjika uye tambo iri pa $\theta$ angle ne horizontal, simba ndi $T=\dfrac{W}{2\sin\theta}$.
p-139.example: Pa5 kg yenguva (angangoita 49N), kana angle yekudonha iri 30° $T=49\text{ N}$, asi pa5° ndi $T\approx281$ N (angangoita 29 kgf), angangoita nguva 6.
p-139.actionItem: Nhasi pakuisa tambo yekuomesa kana rack, musakwevera zvakanyanya, siyai kudonha kwetambo kuri angangoita 5~10% yeurefu hwetambo.

p-140.title: Fungidzirai kupisa nekunzwika (heat index)
p-140.summary: Kunyange tembiricha yemhepo yakafanana, kana humidity yakakwira, ziya haridzoreke, saka unonzwa kupisa zvakanyanya nokuva nengozi.
p-140.principle: Heat index ndiyo function $HI = f(T, RH)$ yetembiricha yemhepo nerelative humidity, uye evaporative cooling kana ichidzikira, tembiricha inonzwika inokwira.
p-140.example: Pane tembiricha 32°C, kana humidity 40% unonzwa angangoita 32°C, asi kana humidity 70% unonzwa angangoita 41°C, iyo ndiyo nzvimbo yekuchenjerera chirwere chekupisa.
p-140.actionItem: Usati wabuda panguva yemvura, tarisai tembiricha pamwe chete nehumidity uye gadzirisai nguva yemabasa ekunze.

p-141.title: Unogona kuziva kuti ambulance iri kuswedera nepamusoro wekurira
p-141.summary: Siren kana ichiswedera inonzwika yakakwirira, kana ichiramba inonzwika yakadzikira, iyi ndiyo Doppler effect.
p-141.principle: Kana source ichifamba ne speed $v_s$, frequency inonzwika ndi $f'=f\,\dfrac{v}{v\mp v_s}$ (kana ichiswedera $-$, kana ichiramba $+$).
p-141.example: Kana mota ine siren ye1,000Hz ichiswedera ne20 m/s, inonzwika $1000\times343/323\approx1{,}062$ Hz, kana ichiramba inonzwika $1000\times343/363\approx945$ Hz.
p-141.actionItem: Nhasi kana siren ichiwedzera ruzha nekukwira, tarisai zvakatenderedza uye siyai nzira.

p-142.title: Sarudzai air conditioner nechikamu cheimba
p-142.summary: Air conditioner haisi yakanaka nekuti hombe, asi inofanira kuenderana ne cooling load yeimba kuti ishande zvakanaka.
p-142.principle: Sarudzai capacity ichienderana ne cooling load $Q \approx q_0 A$ (angangoita 150~200W/m² pachikamu). Kana iri hombe zvikuru, kuvhura nekudzima kupfupi kunowedzera.
p-142.example: Imba ye15 m² inoda angangoita 2.3~3.0kW (angangoita 8,000~10,000 BTU/h). Kana capacity iri hombe zvakanyanya, kuvhura nekudzima kupfupi kunodzikisa efficiency.
p-142.actionItem: Usati wasarudza air conditioner, nyorai chikamu cheimba, kana pane windo rakatarisana nekumavirira, uye nhamba yekakwira, mugoenzanisa capacity nomutengesi.

p-143.title: Kukwidza setting yeair conditioner ne1~2°C kunodzikisa cooling load
p-143.summary: Kana musiyano wetembiricha pakati pekunze nemukati uri mudiki, kupisa kunopinda nemadziro newindo kunodzikira, saka air conditioner inoshanda zvishoma.
p-143.principle: Kupisa kunopinda nekufambisa ndi $\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$ uye kunowirirana nemusiyano wetembiricha $\Delta T$.
p-143.example: Kana kunze kuri 33°C, kukwidza mukati kubva 24°C kuenda 26°C, $\Delta T$ inodzikira kubva 9K kuenda 7K, uye kupinda kwekupisa kuburikidza nekufambisa kunodzikira angangoita 22%.
p-143.actionItem: Nhasi kwidzai setting yeair conditioner kuita 26°C uye mushandise feni zvishoma pamwe chete.

p-144.title: Kana murazvo wemoto ukapfuura mugumo wepoto, gasi rinoparara
p-144.summary: Murazvo mukuru kupfuura pazasi pepoto unotsemuka kumativi uchipisa mhepo chete. Kana murazvo uchienderana nepazasi, kupisa kunosvika pepoto zvakanyanya.
p-144.principle: Kupisa kunosvika pepoto ndi $Q=\eta E_{\text{mafuta}}$. Kana thermal efficiency $\eta$ yakakwira, mafuta anoshandiswa pakupisa kwakafanana anodzikira.
p-144.example: Kupisa 1L yemvura kubva pa20 °C kusvika 100°C kunoda 334kJ, uye kana $\eta$ iri 40% mafuta anodiwa 835kJ, kana 50% 668kJ. Pamusoro pechikamu chekufungidzira, unochengetedza 20%.
p-144.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika, dzikisai murazvo kuti usasvika pamupendero wepazasi pepoto.

p-145.title: Water-repellent coating yeambrella nekontakiti angle
p-145.summary: Ambrella inodonhedza matinji emvura nekuti contact angle yepamusoro yakakura, uye coating inogona kudzoserwa mushure mekushambidzwa.
p-145.principle: Equation yaYoung: $\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{sv} - \gamma_{sl}}{\gamma_{lv}}$. Kana contact angle $\theta > 90^\circ$ ichitonhora hydrophobic.
p-145.example: Gumbeze reambrella rine water-repellent treatment rine contact angle angangoita 110~120° uye matinji emvura anotenderera semabhiza. Kana kupenya nekukweshura kuchidzikisa angle iyi pasi pe70°, tanga kunyorovera.
p-145.actionItem: Omesai ambrella yakanyorova yakavhurika mumumvuri, uye kana matinji ave kupinda, nyudzai water-repellent spray.

p-146.title: Kuyera chinhambwe nechikamu chekupenya kwemheni nekutinhira
p-146.summary: Kana ukaverenga masekonzi kubva pakupenya kusvika pakutinhira, unogona kuziva kuti mheni iri padyo sei.
p-146.principle: Ruzha rune $v \approx 343\ \mathrm{m/s}$ uye chiedza chinosvika nekukurumidza, saka chinhambwe $d = vt$.
p-146.example: Kana kutinhira kunonzwika masekonzi 9 mushure mekupenya, $d \approx 343 \times 9 \approx 3.1\ \mathrm{km}$. Mukati memasekonzi anenge 10 (3.4km), uri mukati mepamberi pengozi yemheni.
p-146.actionItem: Panguva yemvura, kana ukanzwa kutinhira, rega mabasa ekunze uye pinda mukati memamba kana mumotokari.

p-147.title: Pakumisa bhasikoro, shandisai mabreki ekumberi nekumashure pamwe chete, nechikamu chikuru kumberi
p-147.summary: Pakumisa, huremu hunofamba hunokwidzirwa kuvhiri rekumberi, saka vhiri rekumberi rinogona kuita simba rakakura rekumisa.
p-147.principle: Huremu hunofamba kuenda kuvhiri rekumberi pakumisa ndi $\Delta N=\dfrac{m a h}{L}$ ($h$: kukwirira kwe center of gravity, $L$: wheelbase).
p-147.example: Kana mass 80kg, $h=1.0$ m, $L=1.0$ m, deceleration $a=4\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $\Delta N=320$ N. Static load kumberi 314N·kumashure 470N inoshanduka kuita kumberi 634N·kumashure 150N.
p-147.actionItem: Nhasi pakukwira bhasikoro, musashandise breki yekumashure chete; batai yekumberi nekumashure zvinyoro pamwe chete. Kubata kumberi chete nekukurumidza kunogona kukuita kuti uwe.

p-148.title: Tarisai chinhambwe nemissivity pa thermometer isingabatwi
p-148.summary: Infrared thermometer inoverenga tembiricha kubva pakupisa kwe radiation kunoburitswa nechinhu, saka mhedzisiro inochinja nemamiriro epamusoro nechinhambwe.
p-148.principle: Radiation intensity ndi $P=\varepsilon\sigma T^4$. Pamusoro pakapenya pane missivity $\varepsilon$ yakadzika, pano verengwa pasi pezvakaita chaizvo.
p-148.example: Missivity yeganda angangoita 0.98 saka inoenderana zvakanaka, asi simbi inopenya ndi0.1~0.3 saka kukanganisa kukuru. Kana distance ratio 12:1, pa1.2m chinhambwe mutsetse we10 cm unotsvakurudzwa.
p-148.actionItem: Pakutenga thermometer, tarisai chinhambwe chekushandisa nenzvimbo yekuyera, uye nhasi tevedzerai chinhambwe chakanyorwa mumabhuku (kazhinji masentimita mashoma).

p-149.title: Kubika zvishoma, toaster oven diki inoshandisa kupisa kushoma
p-149.summary: Oven hombe ine mhepo nesimbi zvakawanda zvekupisa, saka kune kudya kwevanhu vamwe kana vaviri, oven diki inokwana nekupisa kushoma.
p-149.principle: Kupisa kunodiwa pakupisa ndi $Q=\sum m c\,\Delta T$. Kana mass inopisa iri diki, kupisa kunodiwa kunodzikira.
p-149.example: Kukwidza simbi yemukati ye5 kg ($c\approx0.45$ kJ/(kg·K)) ne180 K kunoda angangoita 405kJ, asi 1kg inoda angangoita 81kJ. Kupisa 60L yemhepo ndi angangoita 13kJ, diki.
p-149.actionItem: Nhasi kana huwandu hwekubika hushoma, shandisai toaster oven kana air fryer panzvimbo yeoven hombe.

p-150.title: Dzimai moto nguva shoma kare uye pedzisai nekupisa kwakasara
p-150.summary: Mvura nezvinhu zviri mupoto zvine kupisa kwakachengetwa, saka kana chivharo chakavharwa uye pasina moto, kubika kunoenderera.
p-150.principle: Kupisa kwakachengetwa ndi $Q=mc\Delta T$, uye kana pane chivharo, kurasikirwa kwekupisa kunodzikira uye tembiricha inodzikira zvishoma nezvishoma.
p-150.example: Kana kudzima 2 maminitsi kare ne3 kW burner (kufungidzira gas thermal efficiency 40%), kupisa kwemafuta kwe $3\times120=360$ kJ kunochengetwa. 1.5L yemvura yakavharwa inochengetwa pamusoro pe90 °C kwemaminitsi mashoma.
p-150.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika noodles, muto, kana kuvhumba, dzimai moto 1~2 maminitsi kare, vhararai chivharo mupedze nekupisa kwakasara.

p-151.title: Tambo yeearphone ironga nechimiro che8 kuti irege kusungana
p-151.summary: Kana ukaisa tambo kunzira imwe chete, tambo inounganidza kutenderera ichisungana kana uchibudisa. Kuisa nechimiro che8 kunodzimisa kutenderera.
p-151.principle: Kutenderera kwetambo kamwe kunounganidza twist angle $\theta=2\pi$, uye twisting moment ndi $\tau=\dfrac{GJ}{L}\theta$.
p-151.example: Kana ukaisa tambo ye1 m kakumi munzira imwe chete, kutenderera kunounganidza kakumi, asi kana wakaisa kashanu +, kashanu − (chimiro che8), huwandu hwose hunova 0 uye hapana kusungana kana uchibudisa.
p-151.actionItem: Nhasi pakurongedza earphone nechaja cable, musazviputira pachigunwe, vabate nechimiro che8 muzviise.

p-152.title: Mvura iri muzeve haibudi nekuda kwe surface tension
p-152.summary: Chitsutsa chidiki chezeve chinochengetedza tinji remvura nekuda kwekudzvinyirirwa kunogadzirwa ne surface tension, saka haizobudi nyore.
p-152.principle: Laplace pressure ndi $\Delta P=\dfrac{2\gamma}{r}$ uye surface tension yemvura $\gamma\approx0.072$ N/m. Kana radius $r$ yakadzika, kudzvinyirirwa kunowedzera.
p-152.example: Kana $r=3$ mm, $\Delta P=2\times0.072/0.003=48$ Pa, ndizvo zvakaoma kubuda nehuremu chete.
p-152.actionItem: Mushure mekushamba, tsemai musoro mudhonze zvishoma nzeve uye mudhorere netsoka imwe. Musashandise cotton swab; kana pane marwadzo kana kubuda kwemvura, enda kuchipatara.

p-153.title: Dhurai peg yetende nenzira yakatsvedzera, kutarisa kupesana netambo
p-153.summary: Peg inofanira kudhurwa padyo nekupesana netambo kuti ivhu rimire simba rekukwevera zvakanaka.
p-153.principle: Tension yetambo $T$ inogoverwa kuita horizontal $T\cos\theta$ uye vertical $T\sin\theta$, uye chikamu chakamira chinokwevera peg kumusoro.
p-153.example: Kana tension ye100 N, angle yetambo 45°, horizontal 71N, simba rekukwevera kumusoro 71N. Kana peg ikatsemuka angangoita 45~60° kupesana netambo, ivhu rinoibata.
p-153.actionItem: Nhasi pakuenda kumakamba kana pikiniki, dhurai peg kuti ive padyo nekuenderana netambo, uye kwevai tambo pangle ye45°.

p-154.title: Sarudzai cooler box nehupamhi, chivharo chakavharwa uye huwandu hweechine
p-154.summary: Nguva iyo cooler box inochengeta kutonhora inosarudzwa nehupamhi hwekudzivirira kupisa nehuwandu hweechine.
p-154.principle: Kupinda kwekupisa nemadziro ndi $\dot Q=\dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, uye kupisa kwekunyungudika kweechine ndi $Q=mL_f$, $L_f\approx334$ kJ/kg.
p-154.example: Kana kupinda kwekupisa ndi10 W, echine re2 kg (668kJ) rinoramba $668{,}000/10\approx18.6$ maawa, kana 20W rinoramba angangoita 9.3 maawa.
p-154.actionItem: Kana nhasi muine hurongwa hwekuenda kunze, shandisai echine re2 kg kana kupfuura nezvinwiwa zvakatonhodzwa kare, zadzai pasina mahwindo, uye musavhura chivharo kazhinji.

p-155.title: Panguva yemvura, chikamu chemagetsi eair conditioner chinoshandiswa kuita kuti hunyoro huve mvura
p-155.summary: Pazuva rinonyorova, hazvisi kutonhodza mhepo chete, simba rinoshandiswa kushandura mhute kuita mvura.
p-155.principle: Kana mhute ikava mvura, kupisa kunobuda sezvinoita $Q=mL_v$, uye $L_v\approx2{,}260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$ yemvura.
p-155.example: Mumba ye60 $\mathrm{m^3}$ (mhepo angangoita 72kg), kudzikisa mhute ye2 g pa1 kg yemhepo kunoita kuti air conditioner igadzirise $0.144\times2{,}260\approx325$ kJ (angangoita 0.09kWh).
p-155.actionItem: Nhasi pazuva rinonyorova, shandisai dehumidify mode yeair conditioner kana 26~28°C pakumhanya kwakaderera, uye vharai misuo nemahwindo kuti hunyoro husapinde.

p-156.title: Electric kettle ine energy efficiency yakakwira kupfuura gas stove
p-156.summary: Pakuvira mvura, electric kettle isingarasikirwi nekupisa inoshandisa simba shoma kuvira mvura yakafanana.
p-156.principle: Efficiency $\eta = \frac{mc\Delta T}{E_{in}}$. Kupisa 1L yemvura kubva pa20°C kusvika 100°C kunoda $1 \times 4.18 \times 80 = 334\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ($\approx 0.093\ \mathrm{kWh}$).
p-156.example: Electric kettle ine efficiency angangoita 90% inoshandisa angangoita 0.103kWh, uye gas flame ine efficiency angangoita 40% inoshandisa angangoita 0.23kWh.
p-156.actionItem: Pakuvira mvura, yerai huwandu hunodiwa chete uye vira mu electric kettle.

p-157.title: Nguva yekupisa mukombe mumwe inogona kutarwa nekuverenga
p-157.summary: Kana nguva yemicrowave ikasarudzwa nekufungidzira, kuvhura kwenguva refu kunowanzoparadza simba.
p-157.principle: Kupisa kunopisa mvura ndi $Q=mc\Delta T$, uye nguva inodiwa ndi $t=Q/P_{\text{kubuda}}$.
p-157.example: Kupisa 250g yemvura kubva pa20 °C kusvika 90°C kunoda $0.25\times4.18\times70\approx73$ kJ, uye pa700 W output, angangoita 104 masekonzi (1 miniti 44 masekonzi).
p-157.actionItem: Nhasi pakupisa chinwiwa, tangai nemasekonzi angangoita 90, uye kana asina kukwana wedzerai masekonzi 20 imwe neimwe.

p-158.title: Kana mvura ichinaya kubva kumusoro chete, kumhanya kunonyorovera zvishoma
p-158.summary: Kana ukamhanya mumvura, nguva yekurohwa kumusoro kwemusoro nemagxa inodzikira, asi huwandu hwemvura inorova kumberi kwemuviri hunosarudzwa nechinhambwe.
p-158.principle: Mumvura inonaya kumusoro zvakananga, huwandu hunorova pamusoro $W_{\text{pamusoro}}\propto t=L/v$ hunopesana nekumhanya, uye huwandu hunorova kumberi hunowirirana nechinhambwe $L$ chete.
p-158.example: Kufamba 100m (1.4m/s) kunotora angangoita masekonzi 71, kumhanya (3.5m/s) angangoita masekonzi 29, nguva yekurohwa pamusoro inodzikira ne59%. Kana mhepo ichifuridzira, mhedzisiro inochinja.
p-158.actionItem: Nhasi kana mvura ichinaya, pamusoro pakadzikira pasina ambrella famba nokukurumidza mukati memuganhu usingakuvadzi kuchengeteka, uye chenjerera pasi rinotsvedza.

p-159.title: Mutemo we20-20-20: mushure memaminitsi 20 ega ega, tarisa kure ne6 m kwemasekonzi 20
p-159.summary: Kana ukatarisa skrini iri padyo kwenguva refu, lens yeziso inoramba ichiwedzera kukora uye kuneta kunounganidza.
p-159.principle: Mufomura yelens $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, kana chinhu chiri padyo, refractive power (diopter) $D=1/d_o$ inodiwa inowedzera.
p-159.example: Skrini iri pa40 cm inoda angangoita 2.5 D yekugadzirisa, asi pa6 m angangoita 0.17 D, mutoro unodzikira angangoita nguva 15.
p-159.actionItem: Nhasi isai timer pamaminitsi 20, uye pese painorira tarisai kure kupfuura 6m kwemasekonzi 20.

p-160.title: Kana wakakweverwa ne rip current, shamba uchienderana nechitsuwa
p-160.summary: Rip current inzira yemvura yakamanikana inokurumidza kubva pamahombekombe ichienda kugungwa, uye kushamba uchirwisa kunoneta.
p-160.principle: Maererano ne continuity equation $A_1v_1=A_2v_2$, kana mvura ichiunganidzwa munzira yakamanikana, kumhanya kwemvura kunowedzera.
p-160.example: Kumhanya kwe rip current kunogona kusvika angangoita 2m/s, kumhanya kupfuura kwekushamba kwemunhu (angangoita 1m/s), uye hupamhi hunowanzova makumi emamita, saka kufamba kumativi ne20~30m kunokubudisa.
p-160.actionItem: Kana nhasi muine hurongwa hwekutamba pagungwa, tambai panzvimbo ine vachengeti vehupenyu, uye kana ukakweverwa ne rip current, chengetai simba, shamba uchienderana nechitsuwa, wozoreverera ruoko kuti ubatsirwe.

p-161.title: Parasol yakanaka kana kunze kuchena mukati kuri kunhuhwi
p-161.summary: Chena chekunze chinodzosera chiedza chezuva, uye ruvara rwakasviba rwemukati runotora chiedza chinodzoserwa chinokwira kubva pasi.
p-161.principle: Radiation inotorwa nepamusoro ndi $q=(1-\alpha)I$. $\alpha$ ndiyo reflectance.
p-161.example: Pa800 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ yezuva remasikati, chena chine reflectance 0.7 chinotora 240 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$, nhema ine reflectance 0.05 inotora 760 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ (kufungidzira).
p-161.actionItem: Pakutenga parasol, tarisai ruvara rwekunze nechiratidzo chekudzivirira ultraviolet seUPF 50+.

p-162.title: Chikonzero nei feni hombe ichishanda zvakanaka
p-162.summary: Kana mhepo yakafanana, feni ine mapapiro makuru kana ichitenderera pakumhanya kwakaderera inoshandisa simba shoma zvikuru.
p-162.principle: Simba rekinetic energy yemhepo $P = \frac{1}{2}\rho A v^3 = \frac{\rho Q^3}{2A^2}$ ($Q = Av$ air flow).
p-162.example: Pa air flow ye0.5m³/s, dhayamita ye30 cm ine theoretical power angangoita 15W, dhayamita ye60 cm angangoita 1W. Kana nzvimbo yakapetwa kane, simba rinova 1/16.
p-162.actionItem: Pakutenga feni, enzanisai dhayamita yemapapiro uye shandisai hombe pakumhanya kwakaderera.

p-163.title: 5km, bhasikoro rinoshandisa simba shoma kupfuura mota
p-163.summary: Kana wakaenda chinhambwe chiri padyo nebhasikoro panzvimbo yemota, unogona kudzikisa mafuta nesimba zvakanyanya.
p-163.principle: Kinetic energy inoverengwa kubva pa work $W=Pt$ nefficiency. 1L yepeturu ine chemical energy angangoita 9kWh.
p-163.example: Bhasikoro 5km (15km/h, 100W, maminitsi 20) ndi33 Wh, uye kunyange tichifunga muscle efficiency 25% angangoita 0.13kWh. Mota ine fuel economy 12km/L inoshandisa angangoita 3.7kWh pa5 km, musiyano wenguva 28.
p-163.actionItem: Nhasi pakubuda kwe5 km kana kupfuura, edzai kufamba netsoka kana nebhasikoro.

p-164.title: Mvura yeduri remaruva yakadururwa kubva pazasi inopinda nekuda kwe capillary action
p-164.summary: Matuwo madiki pakati pezvidimbu zvevhu anokwevera mvura kumusoro, saka kudururira mvura mu saucer kunosvikisa mvura kumidzi.
p-164.principle: Capillary rise height ndi $h=\dfrac{2\gamma\cos\theta}{\rho g r}$. Kana radius yetuwo $r$ yakadzika, mvura inokwira kumusoro.
p-164.actionItem: Nhasi dururai mvura mu saucer yeduri remaruva mugoirega kwemaminitsi 20, wobva wadurura yakasara. Mvura yakamira inounza kuora kwemidzi nemiriyoni yemiriwo yemhuka.

p-165.title: Yerai blood pressure noruoko rwakaiswa pakureba kwemoyo
p-165.summary: Kana ruoko rwuri pasi pemoyo, huremu hweropa (hydrostatic pressure) hunowedzerwa, saka blood pressure inoverengwa yakakwira kupfuura chaiyo.
p-165.principle: Musiyano we hydrostatic pressure ndi $\Delta P=\rho g h$. Density yeropa angangoita 1,060 $\mathrm{kg/m^3}$ uye 1kPa angangoita 7.5mmHg.
p-165.example: Kana ruoko ruri 20cm pasi pemoyo, $\Delta P=1060\times9.8\times0.2\approx2.08$ kPa, ndiko kuti angangoita 15.6mmHg yakakwira inoyerwa.
p-165.actionItem: Pakuyera blood pressure, gara pachigaro unotsamira, wobva waisa ruoko rwakaputirwa cuff patafura pakureba kwemoyo.

p-166.title: Mitoro iri mukati memotokari inobhururuka kumberi nesimba guru kana ukamisa nekukurumidza
p-166.summary: Mitoro isina kusungwa inoramba ichimhanya nekuda kwe inertia kunyange kana mota yamira, saka pakumisa nekukurumidza inova simba guru rekurova.
p-166.principle: Simba rinoshanda pamutoro panguva yekudzikisa kumhanya ndi $F=ma$ uye $a=v/\Delta t$.
p-166.example: Kana mutoro we10 kg wamira mumasekonzi 0.1 kubva pa50 km/h (13.9m/s), $a\approx139\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $F\approx1{,}390$ N (angangoita 140 kgf).
p-166.actionItem: Nhasi pakuisa mitoro mumota, isai pasi pe trunk uye musunge, uye musaise zvinhu zvinorema pa rear shelf kana pamusoro pezvigaro.

p-167.title: Nhamba ye waterproof rating IPX inoratidza mamiriro emvura
p-167.summary: IPX4 inoreva kudzivirira kutsvedza kwemvura, IPX7 inoreva kuramba mavhiki 30 maminitsi pa1 m kudzika, uye nhamba huru haisi nguva dzose yakanaka.
p-167.principle: Water pressure ndi $P=\rho g h$. Kudzvinyirirwa pa1 m kudzika angangoita 9.8kPa.
p-167.example: IPX4 inoyedzwa nemvura inotsvedza kubva kumativi ose, IPX7 inoyedzwa pa1 m kudzika kwemaminitsi 30, uye pakawanda haipi chivimbiso kumvura yegungwa, sipo, kana mvura inopisa.
p-167.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai nhamba ye IPX yeearphone nespika, uye kana muchida kuvashandisa pazuva remvura, tarisai kuti ndeye IPX4 kana kupfuura.

p-168.title: Dehumidifier: compressor type ne Peltier type
p-168.summary: Kana imba yakakura, compressor type inoenderana, uye kwenzvimbo diki seyewadrobe, Peltier type inoenderana.
p-168.principle: Coefficient of performance $COP = \frac{Q_c}{W}$. Compression type angangoita 3, Peltier angangoita 0.5.
p-168.example: Kuita mvura 1kg kunoda angangoita 2.26MJ (0.63kWh). Compression type angangoita 0.2kWh, Peltier angangoita 1.3kWh.
p-168.actionItem: Panguva yemvura, tarisai dehumidifying capacity inoenderana nehukuru hweimba uye mushandise compressor type kuchengeta lounge.

p-169.title: Kana mhepo yehusiku yatonhora, bvisai kupisa kweimba nekuvhura mhepo
p-169.summary: Kupisa kwakaunganidzwa masikati kunogona kubviswa husiku nekuvhura mahwindo pasina simba kana mhepo yekunze yatonhora.
p-169.principle: Kupisa kunobuda nekuvhura mhepo ndi $\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$.
p-169.example: Mukati 28°C, mhepo yekunze yehusiku 22°C, kana kuvhura mhepo pa600 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ (mhepo angangoita 0.2kg/s), unogona kubvisa $0.2\times1.005\times6\approx1.2$ kW yekupisa.
p-169.actionItem: Nhasi kana tembiricha yehusiku yadzikira pasi pemukati, vhurai mahwindo emhepo inopfuura uye muavhare nokukurumidza mangwanani.

p-170.title: Chikonzero nei drain inoita ruzha rwekuzvimba ndechekuchinja kwe air pressure
p-170.summary: Kana mvura yakawanda ichidzika panguva imwe chete, air pressure iri mupombi inochinja, mvura yeTrap inokweverwa mukati uye mhepo inopinda nekubuda ichiita ruzha.
p-170.principle: Kudzvinyirirwa kwekoramu yemvura ndi $P=\rho g h$, saka negative pressure $\Delta P$ inokwevera mvura nezvikamu $h=\Delta P/(\rho g)$.
p-170.example: Negative pressure ye100 Pa inoenderana nekoramu yemvura yerefu ye $100/(1000\times9.8)\approx10$ mm. Kana water seal depth ye trap iri 50mm kana kupfuura kazhinji inogara.
p-170.actionItem: Nhasi kana drain ichiita ruzha rwekuzvimba, dururai mvura zvishoma nezvishoma, uye kana ichidzokororwa, kumbirai kuongororwa nemubatanidzwa wekuchengetedza kana plumbing company.

p-171.title: Mhepo yefeni inodzivirira madhunduru
p-171.summary: Madhunduru anobhururuka zvishoma, saka panzvimbo ine mhepo yefeni zvinonetsa kuswedera.
p-171.principle: Kumhanya kwekubhururuka kwedhunduru ndi 1.5m/s kana pasi, saka kana wind speed $v_{wind} > v_{mosq}$ zvinonetsa kuswedera, uye mhepo inoparadzawo carbon dioxide plume.
p-171.example: Feni ye wind speed 3m/s inoita kaviri kumhanya kukuru kwedhunduru. Kana mhepo ichitumirwa kumakumbo, kuswedera kwekuruma kunodzikira.
p-171.actionItem: Pavhurandha kana panze, vhurai feni yakatarisana nekureba kwemakumbo.

p-172.title: Pakupfuura padyo nemotokari hombe mumugwagwa mukuru, gadzirirai mhepo yepadivi
p-172.summary: Kana mhepo yepadivi ichipepereka kubva kutiraki kana pabhiriji, mota inosundirwa kune rimwe divi.
p-172.principle: Simba rinoshandiswa nemhepo pamotokari ndi $F=\tfrac12\rho C A v^2$ uye rinowirirana nesquare ye wind speed $v$.
p-172.example: Kana wind speed 20m/s (72km/h), side area 2.5 $\mathrm{m^2}$, $C\approx0.8$, $F\approx0.5\times1.2\times0.8\times2.5\times400\approx480$ N.
p-172.actionItem: Nhasi kana pane mushumo wemvura nemhepo yakasimba, pabhiriji uye pamusuwo wetunnel bata steering wheel nemaoko maviri uye dzikisai kumhanya.

p-173.title: Sarudzai cooling fabric nehuwandu hwe contact cooling (Q-max)
p-173.summary: Cooling materials anobvisa kupisa nokukurumidza panguva yekubata ganda, saka unonzwa kutonhora, uye huwandu hwacho hunoratidzwa ne Q-max.
p-173.principle: Heat flux panguva yekubata ndi $q\propto\dfrac{b\,\Delta T}{\sqrt{t}}$ uye kana thermal effusivity $b=\sqrt{k\rho c}$ yakakura, unonzwa kutonhora.
p-173.example: Panguva yekubata ne $\Delta T=5$ K, fabric ine Q-max 0.25 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$ inobvisa kupisa nenguva 1.7 kupfuura iya ine 0.15 (muenzaniso).
p-173.actionItem: Pakusarudza nguvo nemibhedha yezhizha, tarisai Q-max pa label (kazhinji 0.2 kana kupfuura inonzi cooling).

p-174.title: Electric bike range inoverengwa nebhatiri Wh nekushandiswa
p-174.summary: Kana ukakamura capacity yebhatiri (Wh) nesimba rinoshandiswa pa1 km (Wh/km), unogona kufungidzira range.
p-174.principle: Range ndi $d=E/e$ uye air resistance ndi $F\propto v^2$ saka kana kumhanya kwakakura $e$ inowedzera.
p-174.example: Bhatiri re500 Wh, 15Wh/km angangoita 33km. 25km/h ine drag $(25/20)^2\approx1.56$ nguva yeya20 km/h, saka range inodzikira.
p-174.actionItem: Nhasi pakukwira electric bike, chengetai kumhanya kwakaenzana ne20 km/h uye tarisai tyre pressure.

p-175.title: Mutoro we100 kg mu trunk unopisa mafuta akawanda pa100 km
p-175.summary: Kana mota ichirema, simba rinoshandiswa pa rolling resistance nekumhanyisa rinowedzera, saka kutakura mitoro isingashandiswi kunoparadza mafuta.
p-175.principle: Rolling resistance ndi $F_r=C_{rr}mg$ uye work ndi $W=F_r d$.
p-175.example: $C_{rr}=0.01$, $m=100$ kg ndi $F_r\approx9.8$ N uye pa100 km $W\approx0.27$ kWh. Kana engine efficiency 25%, peturu 9kWh/L, angangoita 0.12L, uye acceleration energy ndeyakasiyana.
p-175.actionItem: Nhasi bvisai mitoro isingashandiswi mu trunk.

p-176.title: Chikonzero nei pasi pebhaturumu panyorova panotsvedza
p-176.summary: Mvura inodzikisa friction coefficient zvakanyanya, saka isai non-slip mat mubhaturumu.
p-176.principle: Static friction limit $F \le \mu N$. Kana friction coefficient iri pasi pezvinodiwa nekufamba (angangoita 0.3~0.4), unotsvedza.
p-176.example: Tile yakaoma $\mu \approx 0.6$, tile yakatsvedzera yakanyorova $\mu \approx 0.2$, rubber mat inoramba angangoita 0.6 kunyange yanyorova.
p-176.actionItem: Isai non-slip mat pasi pebhaturumu nepanzvimbo yekushambira.

p-177.title: Ultraviolet inopfuura kunyange pazuva rine makore
p-177.summary: Makore anodzikisa chiedza chinoonekwa, asi anopfuudza chikamu chikuru cheultraviolet, saka kudzivirira kunodiwawo pazuva rine makore.
p-177.principle: UV index $UVI = 40 \int E_\lambda\, s(\lambda)\, d\lambda$ (erythemal action spectrum $s$). Makore matete haadzikisi UV zvakanyanya.
p-177.example: Makore matete anopfuudza angangoita 80~90% yeUV. Kana UV index yemasikati ayo Chikumi ine 8, ganda rinogona kupisa mukati memaminitsi angangoita 20.
p-177.actionItem: Kunyange pazuva rine makore, tarisai UV index usati wabuda uye mugwadze sunscreen.

p-178.title: Mushure mekupfuura mvura yakamira, tsikai breki zvinyoro kuti iome
p-178.summary: Brake pads nedisc dzakanyorova dzine friction shoma, saka kumisa kunononoka. Kutsika zvinyoro kunoita kuti mvura ivhuvhute nekuda kwefriction heat.
p-178.principle: Braking distance ndi $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Kana braking friction ichidzikira, $d$ inowedzera.
p-178.example: Pa60 km/h (16.7m/s), kana $\mu=0.4$ angangoita 35.5m, uye kana yanyorova $\mu=0.25$ ichidzikira angangoita 56.7m, angangoita nguva 1.6 (kufungidzira).
p-178.actionItem: Nhasi panguva yemvura, mushure mekupfuura mvura yakadzika yakamira, kana nzvimbo iri yakachengeteka, tsikai breki kakawanda zvinyoro mutarise mamiriro.

p-179.title: Sarudzai poto nehupamhi hwepazasi nezvinhu
p-179.summary: Poto ine pazasi pakakora ine aluminum kana copper layer inogovanisa kupisa zvakaenzana, saka kunamatira kunodzikira.
p-179.principle: Fourier's law $q = k\frac{\Delta T}{d}$. Stainless steel $k \approx 16$, aluminum $\approx 237$ W/(m·K).
p-179.example: Pa thickness 3mm, ΔT 10K, stainless steel angangoita 53kW/m², aluminum angangoita 790kW/m², kupisa kunoyerera kuri nguva 15.
p-179.actionItem: Pakusarudza poto, tarisai kuti pazasi pakati sandara uye pakakora, uye kana iri induction, kuti pazasi pane magnetic.

p-180.title: Pisai mvura mugaba nezuva kuchengetedza mvura yekushamba
p-180.summary: Zuva rinopa simba rinosvika angangoita 1kW pa1 m², saka unogona kupisa mvura iri mugaba dema usingabhadhare.
p-180.principle: Kupisa kunotorwa ndi $Q=\alpha I A t$ uye kukwira kwetembiricha yemvura ndi $\Delta T=Q/(mc)$.
p-180.example: Gaba dema re20 L (0.25 $\mathrm{m^2}$) ne $I=700\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, kufungidzira absorptivity 0.9, $0.9\times700\times0.25\approx158$ W, angangoita 1.1MJ inopinda mumaawa 2 uye mvura inokwira angangoita 13°C.
p-180.actionItem: Nhasi kana zuva rakasimba, zadzai gaba dema kana hosepipe nemvura muise pamuzuva kwemaawa 2~3, wozoishandisa kudiridza maruva kana kushambidza mota.

p-181.title: Musuwo unoita ruzha, stick-slip friction
p-181.summary: Hinge inoita ruzha nekuti static friction yakakura kupfuura kinetic friction, saka inoitika kuvhiya nokutsvedza.
p-181.principle: Stick-slip: $F_s = \mu_s N > F_k = \mu_k N$. Lubrication inodzikisa zvose $\mu$.
p-181.example: Kana simbi yakaoma $\mu \approx 0.5$ ichidzikira kusvika angangoita 0.1 mushure mekudzora, friction inodzikira angangoita 80% uye ruzha runoenda.
p-181.actionItem: Dzvinyai silicone lubricant kana mafuta tinji rimwe pa hinge pin uye pukunyai zvakadonha.

p-182.title: Kuwedzera ruzha, 3dB, mafeni maviri
p-182.summary: Kana mafeni maviri akafanana akavhurwa, ruzha harwuiti kaviri, rwunowedzera 3dB chete. Ruzha rwakadzika runokosha panguva yekurara.
p-182.example: Mafeni maviri e40 dB ndi $10\log_{10}(2\times10^4) \approx 43\ \mathrm{dB}$. WHO inokurudzira ruzha rwehusiku mukamuri yekurara angangoita 30dB kana pasi.
p-182.actionItem: Enzanisai noise (dB) yezvishandiso zvekamuri yekurara, uye panguva yekurara shandisai imwe yakanyarara chete.

p-183.title: Mhenderekedzo pasina shangu masikati, nei jecha rakaoma rinopisa asi jecha rakanyorova rinotonhora
p-183.summary: Jecha rakaoma masikati rinopisa nyore uye rinogona kupisa tsoka, asi jecha rakanyorova rine mvura rinopisa zvishoma.
p-183.principle: Kana vachitambira kupisa kwakafanana $Q$, kukwira kwetembiricha ndi $\Delta T=\frac{Q}{mc}$. Specific heat yejecha rakaoma ndi $c\approx0.8\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, mvura $4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, mvura yakakura zvikuru saka inokwira zvishoma, uye kuvhuvhuta kwemvura kunotorawo kupisa.
p-183.example: Kana jecha 1kg nemvura 1kg zvichitambira 50kJ imwe neimwe, jecha rinokwira angangoita $+62\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, mvura angangoita $+12\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Saka pamusoro pejecha rakaoma masikati unokwira kusvika 50~60°C, asi jecha rakanyorova rinosvikwa nemafungu rinogara angangoita 30°C.
p-183.actionItem: Masikati famba muzvitsiyaniso, woenda nejecha rakanyorova pedyo nemvura.

p-184.title: Mvura yegungwa inoita kuti unyatsoyera kupfuura mvura isina munyu
p-184.summary: Munhu mumwe chete anoyerera zvishoma kumusoro mugungwa kupfuura mudziva rokushambira kana murwizi.
p-184.principle: Buoyancy isimba remvura yakatsvedzerwa $F_b=\rho g V$. Mvura yegungwa ndi $\rho\approx1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, mvura isina munyu ndi $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, iri 2.5% huru.
p-184.example: Kuti munhu ane huremu hwe70 kg ayerere zvakakwana, anotsvedzera mvura ye70 L mumvura isina munyu, uye $70/1.025\approx68.3$ L mumvura yegungwa. Vhoriyamu inodikanwa yokunyura inoderera ne1.7L. Mumvura ine munyu mukuru weDead Sea (1240kg/m³ pamwe chete) unoyerera zvakanyanya.
p-184.actionItem: Edza kuyerera pamusana mugungwa wakazorora uchiramba wakapfeka life jacket, asi panzvimbo isina kudzika.

p-185.title: Pombi yesnorkel ngaive pfupi, usaite kuti yakure kupfuura 30cm
p-185.summary: Kana pombi yesnorkel ikareba, kufema kunonetsa nokukurumidza nokuda kwemhepo yemvura, uye mhepo yakabudiswa inogara mupombi ichikonzera ngozi.
p-185.principle: Water pressure ndi $\Delta P=\rho g h$ uye inowedzera ne0.1 atmosphere (9.8kPa) pamita imwe neimwe yokudzika. Chipfuva chinofanira kukunda pressure iyi kuti chifeme, uye kana pombi ichireba, dead space inosara mhepo yakabudiswa inowedzera.
p-185.example: Pamwe pombi yakakwira pamusoro pemvura panokudzika kwe30 cm ndi $\Delta P\approx2.9\ \mathrm{kPa}$, asi pamita 1 yokudzika ndiyo 9.8kPa, iri padyo nehuwandu hwokufema hwakanyanya hwomunhu, saka kufema kunenge kusingaiti. Dead space yepombi ine diameter yemukati ye18 mm uye kureba kwe30 cm ndi 75mL.
p-185.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kureba kwesnorkel yako, uye usashandise midziyo yakawedzerwa kureba kupfuura standard kana yakabatanidzwa nehosi.

p-186.title: Pasi pedziva rokushambira rinoratidzika risina kudzika
p-186.summary: Pasi remvura rinoratidzika rakadzika kuita zvikamu zvitatu pamwe zvina zvakadzika chaizvo, saka kudzika chaiko kukuru kupfuura kunoonekwa.
p-186.principle: Chiedza chinotsvedza chichibuda mumvura chichipinda mumhepo, saka apparent depth inova $d'=\frac{d}{n}$. Refractive index yemvura ndi $n\approx1.33$, saka $d'\approx0.75\,d$.
p-186.example: Pasi pedziva rakadzika mamita 2.0 rinoratidzika sa $2.0/1.33\approx1.5$ m kana richitariswa kubva kumusoro. Kudzika kwe3 m kunoratidzika se2.3m, mutsauko we0.7m.
p-186.actionItem: Usati wapinda mudziva, tarisa zviratidzo zvokudzika pamadziro, uye usadzungaira kupinda nemusoro munzvimbo dzausingazive.

p-187.title: Nei zvichiitika kuti ugowana mvura inotonhora tsvete kamwe chete mugungwa
p-187.summary: Mugungwa nemumadhamu ezhizha, mvura inopisa yepamusoro nemvura inotonhora yepasi zvinoumba matanho, saka kunyange kupinda zvishoma unogona kusangana nokutonhora nokukasira.
p-187.principle: Mvura yepamusoro inopiswa nezuva ine density $\rho(T)$ diki, saka inoyerera pamusoro, mvura inotonhora inonyura ichigadzira stable layer (thermocline). Kana layer yakasimba, mvura yekumusoro nepasi haisanganisi zvakanaka, saka tembiricha inochinja nokukasira pamuganhu.
p-187.example: Density yemvura ndi 997.0 pa25 °C uye 999.1kg/m³ pa15 °C, mutsauko we0.2% wakakwana kuchengetedza layer. Mudziva kana mugungwa, kudzika kwe5~10°C mumamita mashomanana kwakajairika, uye kana mhepo ichisundira mvura yepamusoro, mvura inotonhora inokwira uye tembiricha yegungwa pamucheto inodzika nokukasira.
p-187.actionItem: Usati wapinda zvakadzika, soka tsoka namakumbo zvishoma nezvishoma kuti unzwe shanduko yetembiricha, uye pamazuva anotonhora usaenda kure kamwe chete.

p-188.title: Kumhanya kwokupinda mumvura nokusvetuka: kubva pamita 3 ndi 28km/h
p-188.summary: Kana ukasvetuka uchibva pamita 3, unorova mvura nokumhanya kunosvika 28km/h, saka kupinda usina kutarisa kudzika kwemvura ngozi.
p-188.principle: Pasina kuramba kwemhepo, pakukwirira kwokudonha $h$ kumhanya ndi $v=\sqrt{2gh}$ nokuchengetedzwa kwesimba.
p-188.example: Kana $h=3\ \mathrm{m}$ ndi $v=\sqrt{2\times9.8\times3}\approx7.7\ \mathrm{m/s}\approx27.6\ \mathrm{km/h}$. Pamita 10 kukwirira, kumhanya kunosvika 14m/s (50km/h), saka kukwirira kukawedzera kupfuura katatu, kumhanya kunowedzera nokuda kwe1.8.
p-188.actionItem: Usati wasvetuka kana kupinda mumvura, tarisa chiratidzo chokudzika, uye usapinda nemusoro mumvura isingazivikanwi kudzika kwayo.

p-189.title: Sarudza nguvo dzezhizha nokukwanisa kuratidzira chiedza, kwete mavara
p-189.summary: Kunzwa kutonhora kwenguvo dzezhizha hakuenderani nezita ravara, asi nokuti inoratidzira chiedza chezuva zvakadini uye mhepo inopfuura zvakadini.
p-189.principle: Simba renguvo rinotora ndi $q=(1-\alpha)\,I$. $\alpha$ ndiyo reflectance (albedo), $I$ ndiyo solar irradiance. Mavara akacheneruka anoratidzira chiedza chinooneka zvakanyanya, saka anotora zvishoma.
p-189.example: Pa solar irradiance $I=1000\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ nguvo chena ine reflectance 0.7 inotora 300W/m², nguvo nhema ine reflectance 0.1 inotora 900W/m², mutsauko we3. Zvisinei, dzimwe nguvo dzine mavara matema dzinodzivirira UV zvakanaka, saka tarisai UPF.
p-189.actionItem: Pakutenga nguvo dzezhizha, tarisa ma-weave ane mhepo uye chiratidzo cheUPF palabel.

p-190.title: Mabhodhoro akajeka ane mvura nemaaquarium egirazi anogona kukonzera moto
p-190.summary: Mabhodhoro akaita denderedzwa ane mvura kana ma-aquarium anoita sa lens yakaunganidza chiedza chezuva uye zvinhu zvinopisa zvinogona kuvhura moto.
p-190.principle: Convex lens inotevera $\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}$ uye chiedza chinobva kuchinhu chiri kure ($u\to\infty$) sezuva chinounganidzwa pa focus $v=f$. Focal length yechidziyo chiri spherical chizere nemvura ndi $f\approx\frac{nD}{4(n-1)}$.
p-190.example: Bhodhoro remvura rine diameter $D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$ ndi $f\approx1.33\times8/(4\times0.33)\approx8\ \mathrm{cm}$. Pa solar irradiance ye1000 W/m², cross-section area ye50 cm² inounganidza 5W, iyo inounganidzwa muchidimbu che mm² mashomanana uye inogona kusvika patembiricha yokupisa mapepa kana nguvo.
p-190.actionItem: Bvisa mabhodhoro emvura, ma-aquarium nezvishongedzo zvegirazi zviri pamafafitera anovhenekerwa nezuva, pamabalcony kana mumotokari, uzviise mumumvuri kana uzvifukidze nendarira isingapfuure chiedza.

p-191.title: Sarudza mavhu nokuridza pamusoro pawo
p-191.summary: Mavhu akaibva zvakanaka anoita ruzha rwakadzika runodzungaira, saka ruzha rwokukwapura runogona kushandiswa sechiratidzo. Asi usatarise ruzha chete, tarisa huremu nechitarisiko.
p-191.principle: Natural frequency yechinhu ndi $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$. Kana nyama ichiibva, stiffness $k$ inodzikira uye frequency inodzikira, uye kana risina kuibva, ruzha runokwira uye rwakaoma.
p-191.example: Kana huremu hwakaenzana asi stiffness $k$ ichidzikira ne36% ichiva $0.64k$, frequency inova ka$\sqrt{0.64}=0.8$, kureva inodzikira ne20%. Kana saizi yakaenzana, sarudza rinorema uye rine mavara echena pasi.
p-191.actionItem: Pakutenga mavhu, rova ruzive kana ruzha rwakadzika runodzungaira, usarudze rinorema pakati pemasaizi akaenzana.

p-192.title: Pfuurisa matyre nemabhora ekubheche ne80% chete
p-192.summary: Pasi pezuva rinopisa, mhepo inowedzera uye matyre kana mabhora ekubheche akazara anogona kupfuta, saka kuvafuridza ne80% chete kunogutsa.
p-192.principle: Mu ideal gas $PV=nRT$, pane pressure yakaenzana $V\propto T$, (Charles's law), kana vhoriyamu yakagadziriswa $P\propto T$. Verenga tembiricha muKelvin (K).
p-192.example: Kana tembiricha ichikwira kubva ku25 °C (298K) kuenda ku50 °C (323K), vhoriyamu inowedzera ka$323/298\approx1.084$, kureva 8.4%. Kunyange kuzadza ne95% chete kunopfuura muganhu, uye mukati meboot yemotokari ye60 °C (333K) vhoriyamu inowedzera ne12%.
p-192.actionItem: Zadza matyre nemabhora ekubheche ne80~90% chete, uye usaasiya mumotokari inopisa kana pasi pezuva rakananga kwenguva refu.

p-193.title: Nei mvura inonaya isingarwadzise, terminal velocity 9m/s
p-193.summary: Kunyange mvura inodonha kubva mamwe makiromita kumusoro haikurumidze kupfuura 30km/h nokuda kwokuramba kwemhepo, saka haikurwadzisi. Asi mabwe emvura anokurumidza uye ane ngozi.
p-193.principle: Kana gravity nokuramba kwemhepo zvakaenzana, kumhanya kunova nguva dzose, uye pa $mg=\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2C_dA$ terminal velocity ndi $v_t=\sqrt{\frac{2mg}{\rho C_dA}}$.
p-193.example: Mvura ine diameter ye5 mm inodonha ne9 m/s (32km/h), ne2 mm ne6.5m/s. Mu vacuum pa1 km inosvika 140m/s. Mabwe emvura ane diameter ye2 cm anodonha ne20 m/s (72km/h) uye anogona kukuvadza motokari.
p-193.actionItem: Pamazuva ane kutaura kwemabwe emvura, tarisa mamiriro ekunze uye mira motokari yako pasi pedenga.

p-194.title: Tendeudza mhepo yeair conditioner kumusoro
p-194.summary: Kana uchitonhodza, kutumira mhepo kumusoro kunoita kuti mhepo inotonhora idonhe uye kamuri yose itonhore zvakaenzana.
p-194.principle: Density yeideal gas ndi $\rho=\frac{PM}{RT}$ uye inowedzera sezvo tembiricha ichidzikira. Mhepo inotonhora inorema inonyura, inopisa inokwira, uye natural convection inoitika.
p-194.example: Pa1 atmosphere, mhepo ye18 °C (291K) ndi 1.21kg/m³, ye28 °C (301K) ndi 1.17kg/m³, mhepo inotonhora inorema ne3.4%. Kana mhepo ichitumirwa kumusoro, haizonyatsorova munhu, saka kunyange kana setpoint ikakwidzwa ne1~2°C, unozonzwa zvakanaka uye simba rinogona kuchengetedzwa.
p-194.actionItem: Nhasi paunotonhodza, tendeudza vanes dzemhepo kumusoro (kana yakachinjika), uye paunopisa dzitendeudze pasi.

p-195.title: Kutarisa mafungu pachidziviriro chegungwa: kana kukwirira kwefungu kuri kaviri, simba ka-4
p-195.summary: Kana kukwirira kwefungu kuri kaviri, simba refungu riri ka-4, saka kutarisa mafungu uri pachidziviriro chegungwa kana pamatombo kuri ngozi huru kupfuura sezvinofungidzirwa.
p-195.principle: Simba pa unit area yefungu rakarongeka ndi $E=\frac{1}{8}\rho g H^2$ uye rinoenderana nesquare yewave height $H$.
p-195.example: Kana $\rho=1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ wave height ye1 m ndi 1.26kJ/m², ye2 m ndi 5.0kJ/m², ka-4. Wave overtopping (kufungu kupfuura chidziviriro) kunogona kutsvairira munhu.
p-195.actionItem: Pamazuva anemafungu akakura, usakwire pachidziviriro chegungwa kana matombo, uye usati wabva tarisa wave height kubva pakutaura kwegungwa.

p-196.title: Foni inopisa zvakanyanya muzhizha: bvisa case kuchengetedza hupenyu hwayo
p-196.summary: Tembiricha yakakwira inoderedza hupenyu hwebhatiri nokukurumidza, saka muzhizha bvisa case uye dzivisa chiedza chezuva chakananga kuti kupisa kubude.
p-196.principle: Conduction thermal resistance ndi $R=\frac{L}{kA}$, uye kana heat generation $P$ tembiricha mutsauko ndi $\Delta T=PR$. Insulating case ine thickness $L$ hukuru inowedzera $R$ ichiita kuti kupisa kuome kubuda.
p-196.example: Silicone case ine thickness ye2 mm, thermal conductivity $k\approx0.2\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$, ichifukidza 70cm² ndi $R\approx1.4\ \mathrm{K/W}$. Kana kuburitsa 3W sezvinoita navigation, tembiricha inowedzera ne4 °C. Lithium-ion batteries dzinokurumidza kuparara pamusoro pe35 °C, uye pamwe chete ne10 °C yose, kukura kunokurumidza kusvika kaviri.
p-196.actionItem: Pakushandisa navigation kana kuchaja pasi pezuva, bvisa case uye isa foni mumumvuri kana panzvimbo ine mhepo.

p-197.title: Frisbee inofamba kure nenzira yakatwasuka kana ichitenderedzwa
p-197.summary: Kana uchikanda frisbee, kutenderedza nomutsipa wegumbo kunoita kuti ifambe kure nenzira yakatwasuka pasina muviri wako kuzungunuka, uye kukanda kunoitawo muzoro wemuviri wose wakareruka.
p-197.principle: Pasina external torque, angular momentum $L=I\omega$ inochengetedzwa. Frisbee inotenderera inogara iri stable nokuda kweiyo gyro effect inoita kuti nzira isachinji nyore.
p-197.example: Frisbee ine spin ye5~8 pasekondi inofamba 30~40m ichigara yakasimba, asi kana ikakandwa yakaswedera isina spin inoitenderera kana kudonha mukati memamita mashomanana. Pane yakaenzana kumhanya, spin ikawedzera kaviri, $L$ inowedzerawo kaviri, saka torque yakaodzwa inodiwa kuzungunusa mamiriro ndiyo kaviri.
p-197.actionItem: Edza kukanda frisbee nomutsipa wegumbo kwemaminitsi 10 pachiteshi chepaki. Zorodza mapfudzi nomutsipa wegumbo usati wakanda.

p-198.title: Mvura yakapiswa mumicrowave inobuda pasina kuratidza kuvira, ichibuda nokukasira
p-198.summary: Kana mvura iri mukapu yakapfava yakapiswa mumicrowave kwenguva refu, inopfuura boiling point isina kuvira uye inogona kuputika nokukasira kana yabatwa, ichikonzera kupisa.
p-198.principle: Kuti mabubbles aumbwe, zvinodiwa mamwe mavhaenzi kana zvimedu, asi mukapu yakapfava nemvura yakachena izvi hazvisipo, saka mvura inopfuura boiling point (100°C) ichiita superheating. Kana yabatwa kana mupfudzi wapinda, inova mhepo nokukasira.
p-198.example: Kupisa 250mL kubva ku20 °C kusvika ku100 °C kunoda $Q=0.25\times4.18\times80\approx84\ \mathrm{kJ}$, uye ne microwave ye800 W ndi 105 masekondi. Kana nguva ikawedzerwa, imwe mvura inogona kupfuura 100°C, saka kunyange poda shoma inoita kuti furo ifurukire.
p-198.actionItem: Paunopisa mvura, isa chipuni chomuti kana microwave stick mukati, siya masekondi 30 mushure mokupisa usati wabudisa, uye usaisa chiso pamusoro pekapu.

p-199.title: Pisa pan kusvika mvura yakaita sebhora richidzungaira
p-199.summary: Pan yestainless steel kana ikapiswa kusvika mvura yadonha yodzungaira sebhora, chikafu hachinamatire zvakanyanya, uye kupisa kupfuura izvi kunopedza gasi.
p-199.principle: Kana pan surface ichipfuura 200°C, vapor film inoumbwa pasi pemvura, saka mvura haivire pakarepo asi inoyera ichidzungaira (Leidenfrost effect). Tembiricha iyi ndicho chiratidzo chakanaka chokuisa mafuta.
p-199.example: Kupisa stainless steel pan ye1.2kg (specific heat 0.5kJ/(kg·K)) kubva ku20 °C kusvika ku200 °C kunoda $Q=1.2\times0.5\times180\approx108\ \mathrm{kJ}$ (0.03kWh). Kana mvura ikaparara nokukasira pachiridzwa 'ssss', tembiricha inenge ichiri 150~190°C.
p-199.actionItem: Donhedza dhonzi remvura papan; kana richidzungaira sebhora, isa mafuta uye deredza moto.

p-200.title: Pamadziro egypsum board shandisa anchor kuparadzira mutoro
p-200.summary: Gypsum board inogona kukuvara nyore, saka kana ukaisa screw chete inobuda nyore, saka shandisa anchor inobvura kumashure kuparadzira mutoro padyo guru.
p-200.principle: Bearing pressure ndi $p=\frac{F}{A}$. Contact area $A$ yakakura inoderedza pressure pagypsum board nemutoro wakaenzana. Wedge-expansion kana toggle anchors dzinovhura kumashure dzichiwedzera area.
p-200.example: Mufananidzo une huremu hwe10 kg ($F\approx98\ \mathrm{N}$) kana ukatsigirwa nescrew imwe ye1 cm² unopa 0.98MPa, asi toggle anchor ine 8cm² inopa 0.12MPa, kana 1/8. Anchor imwe neimwe ine mutoro wayo wakabvumirwa, saka tarisa pachigadzirwa.
p-200.actionItem: Kune zvinhu zvinorema, tsvaga stud (frame) uchipinda mairi, kana sarudza anchor ine mutoro wakabvumirwa wakakwana.

p-201.title: Color temperature yebulb: 3000K kuimba, 5000K kamuri yokudzidzira
p-201.summary: Color temperature yakakwira inoreva chiedza chebhuruu uye chinotonhora. Sarudza K yakadzika yenzvimbo dzokuzorora uye K yakakwira yenzvimbo dzokudzidza nokushanda.
p-201.principle: Wavelength inoburitswa zvakanyanya neblackbody inopisa ndiyo Wien's law $\lambda_{max}=\frac{b}{T}$, $b=2.898\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Kana tembiricha ichikwira, inoenda kubhuruu, uye color temperature yebulb ndiyo kukosheswa kwayo nechiedza cheblackbody.
p-201.example: Blackbody ye3000 K inoita peak pa966 nm, 5000K pa580 nm, 6500K pa446 nm, uye zvakakwira zvinonzwika bhuruu. Imba ndeye 2700~3000K (warm white), kamuri yokudzidzira ndeye 4000~5000K (daylight).
p-201.actionItem: Pakutenga bulb, tarisa chiratidzo cheK pachipaketi, sarudza 3000K pamusoro peimba uye 5000K pamusoro pekamuri yokudzidzira.

p-202.title: Tarisa kuzungunuka kweLED nefoni slow-motion
p-202.summary: LED lighting inogona kuzungunuka zvisingaonekwi, uye dzakachipa dzinozungunuka zvakawanda zvichiita kuti maziso aneta. Zviri nyore kuvaongorora nokurekodha slow-motion.
p-202.principle: LED yakagadziriswa kubva paAC inosiyana kupenya kaviri nefrequency yemagetsi, saka nzvimbo dze60 Hz dzinozungunuka 120Hz, dze50 Hz 100Hz. Period ndi $T=\frac{1}{f}$ uye pa120 Hz ndi 8.3 ms.
p-202.example: Kana ukatungamira foni ye240 fps slow-motion kumwenje, frame interval ndi 4.2 ms, saka pamusoro peperiod imwe pane mafuremu 2, nokudaro mitsara kana shanduko yokupenya inooneka. Zvigadzirwa zvinozungunuka zvakanyanya zvinogona kukonzera kunetseka kwemaziso kana musoro kuvava.
p-202.actionItem: Rekodha mwenje wemumba menyu nefoni slow-motion, kana mitsara yaoneka, funga kuchinjira kuzvigadzirwa zvisingazungunuki.

p-203.title: Panomhanya pasi, shandisa engine braking kudzivirira kupisa kwebreki
p-203.summary: Kana uchimhanyira pasi kwenguva refu uchishandisa breki chete, kupisa kunounganidzwa uye simba rokumisa rinodzikira, saka shandisa engine braking nelow gear zvakare. Fuel cutoff inochengetedzawo mafuta.
p-203.principle: Potential energy yakarasika $mgh$ nekinetic energy yakaderera $\frac{1}{2}mv^2$ zvinoshanduka kuita kupisa mumabrake pads. Kana tembiricha ichikwira zvakanyanya, friction inoderera nokukasira (brake fade).
p-203.example: Motokari ye1500 kg inodonha 500m, $1500\times9.8\times500\approx7.4\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (2kWh) inova kupisa. Kinetic energy yokumisa pa100 km/h (27.8m/s) iri 580kJ. Kushandisa low gear kunoita kuti engine resistance igovane kupisa uku.
p-203.actionItem: Usati watanga pasi pakareba, deredza gear kuti ive yakadzika uye shandisa breki rimwe nerimwe chete.

p-204.title: Kusasa maoko paunofamba kunoderedza simba rinodiwa
p-204.summary: Kana uchisasa maoko zvakasikwa paunofamba, simba rishoma rinodiwa kupfuura nokuchengetedza maoko akamira uye muviri unozungunuka zvishoma.
p-204.principle: Ruoko ipendulum inozungunuka pamapfudzi ine natural period $T=2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$. Kana gait rhythm nokusasa kwemaoko zvichienderana (resonance), simba shoma rinodiwa, uye maoko anosasa anodzima kutenderera kwemuviri kunogadzirwa nemakumbo.
p-204.example: Kana effective length yeruoko iri $L\approx0.35\ \mathrm{m}$, ndi $T\approx1.2\ \mathrm{s}$ iri padyo ne gait period (1.1 s). Zvidzidzo zvinoratidza kuti kudzivirira kusasa maoko kunowedzera kushandiswa kwesimba pakufamba ne10%.
p-204.actionItem: Nhasi paunofamba, zorodza mapfudzi usase maoko zvakasikwa kwemaminitsi 10.

p-205.title: Nei kuimba kunonzwika zvakanaka mubhavhu, reverberation
p-205.summary: Bhavhu yakazara matairi negirazi zvisingatore ruzha, saka ruzha runogara kwenguva refu uye kuimba kunonzwika kwakazara. Pavideo calls, kunogona kuita echo inokonzera kusagadzikana.
p-205.principle: Reverberation time ndi Sabine's formula $T=\frac{0.161\,V}{A}$. $V$ ndiyo vhoriyamu yemukamuri (m³), $A$ ndiyo total absorption (m²), sum yeproduct ye surface area ne absorption coefficient.
p-205.example: Kana vhoriyamu ye7.2m³, surface area 23m² uye absorption coefficient yematairi 0.02, $A\approx0.46\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $T\approx2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. Imba ine carpet nemacurtains inoita 0.4~0.6 masekondi, saka ruzha runoparara nokukasira kuri nani.
p-205.actionItem: Kana uchida kufona kana kurekodha mubhavhu, rembedza matauro kana mat kuderedza echo, kana enda kuimba ine zvikwatani zvakapfava.

p-206.title: Hose yokudhirera yeair conditioner ngaive pasi kusvika kumagumo
p-206.summary: Mvura yeair conditioner inoyerera nesimba regravity chete, saka hose yokudhirera inofanira kuramba iri pasi kusvika kumagumo, uye kana ichipfeka kana kukotama panzira, inovharika mvura ichikwanisa kudonha mukati.
p-206.principle: Mvura inoyerera kubva kukwirira kuenda kudzika negravity, uye hose inoda kudzika kwe1 cm pamita imwe neimwe (1/100 slope kana kupfuura). Kana mvura ichimira, kusvibiswa, kuvharika nokudonha zvinoitika.
p-206.example: Pamazuva ane chinyoro, air conditioner inogadzira 1L yemvura paawa. Hose ye5 m inofanira kuva pasi kusvika 5cm pamagumo. Kana kudonha kukanyorovesa mapepa omudziro nepasi, mutengo wokugadzirisa mukuru.
p-206.actionItem: Tarisa kana hose yokudhirera iri pasi kusvika kumagumo, pasina mukombama kana kukotama, uye kumagumo hakusi mumvura.

p-207.title: Zvakaoma kuziva nzira yeruzha mumvura
p-207.summary: Mumvura, ruzha runofamba nokukurumidza zvikuru zvokuti time difference pakati pemadzithi maviri inoparara, saka zvakaoma kuziva kuti ngarava kana munhu anobva kupi.
p-207.principle: Kumhanya kweruzha mumhepo ndi 343m/s, mumvura 1500m/s. Nzira inozikamwa kubva pa time difference $\Delta t=\frac{d\cos\theta}{v}$ pakati pemadzithi maviri, uye kana $v$ ichiwedzera, $\Delta t$ inova diki zvikuru.
p-207.example: Kana kuparadzana kwemadzithi ndi $d\approx0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, maximum time difference mumhepo ndi 0.58 ms, asi mumvura 0.13 ms, 1/4.4. Ubongo hahugoni kusiyanisa, saka haunzwi kuti ruzha rwemoto runobva kupi.
p-207.actionItem: Paunoshambira, shambira mukati menzvimbo yakatemwa (mukati mebuoy) chete uye ramba uchisimudza musoro kuti uone ngarava nemaziso ako.

p-208.title: Pfuti yemvura inokanda kure kana yakarirwa pa45 degrees
p-208.summary: Kana kuramba kwemhepo kuri kushoma, mvura inokanda kure kana yakatarisa pa45 degrees. Edza izvi paunokwikwidza chinhambwe.
p-208.principle: Range yeprojectile inokandwa kubva pakukwirira kumwe ndi $R=\frac{v^2\sin2\theta}{g}$, uye inokura kana $\sin2\theta$ ichiva maximum pa $\theta=45^\circ$. Chaizvoizvo, kuramba kwemhepo kunoita kuti optimal angle ideredze zvishoma.
p-208.example: Mvura ye10 m/s inosvika $R=10^2/9.8\approx10.2\ \mathrm{m}$ pa45 degrees, uye pa30 kana 60 degrees ndi $\sin60^\circ\approx0.866$ kana 8.8m, 86%.
p-208.actionItem: Paunokanda nepfuti yemvura, chinja angle kuti uwane iri kure zvikuru, asi usatarise chiso nemaziso evamwe.

p-209.title: Nei bhora richikotama: spin, Magnus force
p-209.summary: Bhora rinotenderera richifamba rinokotama kune rimwe divi nokuti spin inoita kuti pressure yemhepo mumativi maviri ebhora ive yakasiyana.
p-209.principle: Kana bhora rinotenderera richifamba mumhepo, simba $\vec v$ rakatwasuka kuvelocity $\vec\omega$ nerotation axis $\vec F=S(\vec\omega\times\vec v)$ rinoitika (Magnus force). Mhepo kune rimwe divi inokurumidza uye pressure difference inoitika.
p-209.example: Free kick yebhora retsoka inofamba ne108 km/h (30m/s) nokutenderera 8 pasekondi inogona kukotama 3~4m kumativi mukufamba kwe25 m. Pasina spin, inofamba yakatwasuka.
p-209.actionItem: Paunorova bhora paki, shandisa spin yepadivi nechikamu chomukati chetsoka uye ona kuti nzira yokukotama inochinja sei.

p-210.title: Mhepo yegungwa ndiye 4.7km kubva pamahombekombe
p-210.summary: Kubva pakukwirira kwemaziso kwe1.7m, chinhambwe chokusvika pahorizon yegungwa ndi 4.7km chete, saka gungwa rine kure rinooneka pamahombekombe riri padyo kupfuura sezvinofungidzirwa.
p-210.principle: Nokuti Pasi iri denderedzwa, kubva pakukwirira kwemaziso $h$ (m) kusvika pahorizon ndi $d\approx3.57\sqrt{h}$ km. Kukosheswa kunobva pakubira kwemhepo kwatotorwa.
p-210.example: Kana maziso ari pa1.7m, ndi $d\approx3.57\times\sqrt{1.7}\approx4.65$ km, uye kubva pamusoro pegwa remahombekombe ye10 m ndi 11.3km. Ngarava dzinouya dzinotanga kurasa hull, mast chete ichisara.
p-210.actionItem: Paunenge uri pamahombekombe, tarisa ngarava iri kure uye ona hull ichipera mast ichisara.

p-211.title: Bhatani rokuyedza yeELCB, risiye mwedzi mumwe neumwe munguva yemvura
p-211.summary: Munguva yemvura ine chinyoro, ngozi yeleakage iri hukuru, saka tarisa mwedzi wose kuti ELCB inoshanda zvakanaka nebhatani rokuyedza.
p-211.principle: ELCB inotora mutsauko $I_\Delta=|I_{in}-I_{out}|$ pakati pecurrent inopinda neinobuda, uye kana rated sensitivity ichipfuura 30mA, inocheka magetsi mukati me0.03 masekondi. Bhatani rokuyedza rinogadzira mutsauko uyu zvakananga kuti riongorore kuita basa.
p-211.example: Kana leakage current iri 30mA, inogona kuva ngozi kana munhu abata, saka inofanira kucheka pakarepo pamwero uyu. Kana bhatani rokuyedza richarovera, lever inodzika uye magetsi anodzima.
p-211.actionItem: Chengetedza mafaira ari kushandiswa, bva wapinda bhatani rokuyedza rekeELCB kuti utarise kuti rinocheka, uye kana risingacheki kumbira mubatsiri wemagetsi kuti atarise.

p-212.title: Ongorora infrared yeremote yeair conditioner nefoni camera
p-212.summary: Kana air conditioner isingapindure remote, shandisa foni camera kuti utarise kuti remote inobudisa chiratidzo here, kuti usadaidze mukomana zvisina kukodzera.
p-212.principle: Infrared LED yeremote inotumira chiratidzo pa940 nm (wavelength isingaonekwi) uye photon energy ndi $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{940\ \mathrm{nm}}\approx1.32\ \mathrm{eV}$. CMOS sensor yecamera inozvinzwa nokuratidza chiedza chakajeka pascreen.
p-212.example: Kana uchiratidza remote kucamera lens uchirova bhatani, kana screen ichiratidza chiedza chebhuruu kana chena chiri kuzungunuka, remote iri nani. Kana haioneki, shandura mabhatiri (AAA 2) kana kuongorora remote kutanga. Dzimwe front cameras dzine IR filter isina simba saka dzinoona zviri nani.
p-212.actionItem: Vhura front camera yefoni yako uye rovera bhatani reremote kuti uone kana chiedza chichioneka.

p-213.title: Nei huremu hwemuviri hunochinja paunotanga nokumira lift
p-213.summary: Lift kana ichitanga kukwira muviri unorema, kana ichimira unorerekera, zvichiitika nokuti simba rinosundwa nepasi rinochinja, kwete huremu hwemuviri.
p-213.principle: Mu lift inofamba nechikurumidziro chokumusoro $a$, simba rinosundwa nepasi pamunhu (normal force) ndi $N=m(g+a)$. Scale inoverenga uku, saka apparent weight inochinja.
p-213.example: Munhu ane 70kg kana akakwira nechikurumidziro che1 m/s², $N=70\times(9.8+1)\approx756\ \mathrm{N}$ saka scale inoratidza 77kg. Kana achikwira ozomira nechikurumidziro chepasi che1 m/s², anonzwa se63 kg.
p-213.actionItem: Kana lift ichitanga nokumira, kotamisa mabvi zvishoma uye batisisa handrail kuti usarudze balance.

p-214.title: Kudivi rakarurama renzira yedutu rakanyanya ngozi
p-214.summary: Dutu reNorthern Hemisphere rine mhepo yakasimba kudivi rakarurama renzira yaro, saka mudunhu rakarurama renzira inofamba dutu unofanira kugadzirira kukuvara kukuru.
p-214.principle: Dutu rine mhepo inotenderera counterclockwise $v_{rot}$ nokumhanya kwedutu pachayo $v_{move}$, saka kudivi rakarurama renzira kumhanya kwacho kunowedzerwa uye kuruboshwe kunobviswa: $v_{wind}=v_{rot}\pm v_{move}$.
p-214.example: Kana rotating wind iri 40m/s uye kumhanya kwedutu 8m/s, kurudyi ndi 48m/s, kuruboshwe 32m/s, uye wind pressure inoenderana nesquare yekumhanya, saka mutsauko wacho ndi ka$(48/32)^2=2.25$. Nzvimbo iyi yakarurama inonzi dangerous semicircle.
p-214.actionItem: Panguva yedutu, tarisa nzira yakafungidzirwa kubva kuMeteorological Service, uye kana uri kurudyi rwenzira, kanzura kana kunonotsa kuenda kunze nokurwendo rwegungwa.

p-215.title: Mhepo kukwira kaviri, pressure ka-4
p-215.summary: Mhepo kana ikawedzera kumhanya kaviri, simba rinorova mawindows nemabhodhi rinowedzera ka-4, saka usaongorore dutu nokunzwa mhepo isina simba.
p-215.principle: Simba remhepo pachikamu $A$ ndi $F=\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2A$ (drag coefficient pamwe chete 1) uye rinoenderana nesquare yekumhanya. Air density ndi $\rho\approx1.225\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
p-215.example: Pawindo re1 m² nemhepo ye20 m/s ndi $F\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$, ye40 m/s 980N (100 kgf), ka-4. Mawindows makuru anogamuchira simba guru kupfuura izvi.
p-215.actionItem: Usati wadutu, tarisa kuvharwa kwemawindo, uye panguva yedutu garira kure nemawindo.

p-216.title: Kana mawindo achirira nemhepo yakasimba, shandisa buffer pamatanho
p-216.summary: Kurira kwemawindo nemhepo kunoitika nokuti kuzungunuka kunoenderana nenatural frequency yewindo, saka kuisa buffer pamatanho kunoderedza ruzha nemhepo inopinda.
p-216.principle: Natural frequency yewindo frame ndi $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. Kana frequency yemhepo ichienderana ne $f$, resonance inoita kuzungunuka kukuru. Buffer inowedzera damping uye inochinja stiffness $k$ kudzivirira resonance.
p-216.example: Kana windo reuremu hwe8 kg rinotsigirwa ne $k=80\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ ndi $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{80000/8}\approx15.9\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Kana $k$ ikawedzera kaviri ndi 22.5Hz, uye damping inowedzera kudzikisa kurira. Kuvhara matanho kunoderedzawo mhepo yechando uye kuchengetedza simba rokupisa.
p-216.actionItem: Namira weatherstrip buffer ye5~10mm pamatanho emawindo uye tarisa kana ruzha rwokurira rwakaderera.

p-217.title: Nei tarp yekusasika inosimuka nemhepo
p-217.summary: Mhepo inomhanya pamusoro petarp inoderedza pressure uye inosimudza jira, saka nzira yokusunga tarp pamazuva emhepo ndiyo inogadzirisa kuchengeteka.
p-217.principle: Mukati meBernoulli principle, apo kumhanya kwetaranji kuri kukuru pressure iri diki, pressure difference yekumusoro nepasi ndi $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2$. Pressure difference iyi inova lift inosimudza jira.
p-217.example: Pa wind speed ye10 m/s ne $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\times1.225\times10^2\approx61\ \mathrm{Pa}$ simba rinosvika 980N (100 kgf) rinogona kuiswa patarp ye4 m × 4m (16m²). Pa wind speed ye20 m/s ndi ka-4.
p-217.actionItem: Pakutenga tarp, tarisa huwandu hweeyelets nokusimbiswa, uye paunoiisa, isa divi rakadzika kumhepo uye dhonza pegs zvakadzika zvakakotama.

p-218.title: Siya fan mode kwemaminitsi 10 usati wadzima air conditioner
p-218.summary: Kumhanyisa air conditioner mu fan mode kwemaminitsi 10 usati wadzima kunoomesa chinyoro chemukati uye kunoderedza hwema hwehuruva, uye mari yemagetsi haibatwi zvakanyanya.
p-218.principle: Mushure mokutonhodza evaporator ine mvura yakagadzirwa. Kuvira kunoenderana ne $(p_s-p)$ pakati pesaturated nenyika vapor pressure, saka kubvisa mhepo ine chinyoro nefan kunoomesa nokukasira.
p-218.example: Simba refan mode ndi 40W, uye maminitsi 10 ndi $40\times\frac{10}{60}\approx6.7\ \mathrm{Wh}$ chete. Kana chinyoro chichisara, hutachiona nehuruva zvinokura zvichikonzera hwema, mutengo wokuchenesa air conditioner uye kudzikira kwebasa.
p-218.actionItem: Nhasi usati wadzima air conditioner, mhanyisa fan kana dry mode kwemaminitsi 10, kana iine auto-dry function, isimbise.

p-219.title: Mundege panguva yeturbulence, gara wakasunga seatbelt
p-219.summary: Turbulence inouya pasina kuziviswa, saka kugara wakasunga seatbelt wakagara ndiyo nzira yakasimba kwazvo yokudzivirira kukuvara.
p-219.principle: Newton's second law $F=ma$ inoreva kuti kana ndege ichikurumidza zvakatwasuka, muviri unorangarirawo chikurumidziro chimwe chete. Kana vertical acceleration iri $\pm1\,g$, apparent weight inova 0 kana kaviri.
p-219.example: Munhu ane huremu hwe70 kg munguva yeturbulence yepakati ye$\pm0.5\,g$ anowana shanduko yesimba ye$0.5\times70\times9.8\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$. Mu turbulence yakasimba ye1 g kana kupfuura, munhu asina kusunga anokwira kubva pachigaro agorova denga.
p-219.actionItem: Paunenge wakagara mundege, sunga seatbelt yakaenzana nomuviri pasi pepelvis.

p-220.title: Mukati memotokari yakanyura mumvura, musuo haungavhurike
p-220.summary: Musuo wemotokari yakanyura mumvura haungavhurike nokuda kwewater pressure, saka tiza nepafafitera pachinzvimbo chemusuo nokukasira.
p-220.principle: Simba remvura pamusuo ndi water pressure pa average depth yakapetwa nearea $F=\rho g\frac{h}{2}A$. Kusvika mvura yemukati neyekunze yaenzana, unofanira kuvhura uchirwisa simba iri.
p-220.example: Musuo une upamhi hwe1.0m nemvura yakakwira 0.5m (area 0.5m²) ndi $F=1000\times9.8\times0.25\times0.5\approx1225\ \mathrm{N}$ = 125 kgf. Mawindows emagetsi anogona kumira kushanda nokukasira. Fambisa pakarepo kana mvura ichangotanga kupinda, usati mvura yazara.
p-220.actionItem: Isa nyundo yokutiza (chishandiso chokuputsa windo) panzvimbo inosvikika mumotokari, uye usambopinda mumigwagwa yakanyura.

p-221.title: Panguva yemheni, bvisa zvinhu zvemagetsi muplug
p-221.summary: Panguva yemheni, voltage yakakwira zvikuru (surge) inoitwa pamiwaya nechinguva, ichikuvadza maTV nemakomputa, saka bvisa mapulagi usati wabva mheni.
p-221.principle: Kana lightning current ichichinja nokukasira, voltage $V=-M\frac{dI}{dt}$ inoitwa mumuwaya wakaswedera ($M$ ndiyo mutual inductance). Kana rate yeshanduko yecurrent ichikura, kV mashomanana anogadzirwa.
p-221.example: Kana $M=1\ \mathrm{\mu H}$ uye $dI/dt=6\times10^9\ \mathrm{A/s}$, $V\approx6\ \mathrm{kV}$ inopfuura 1.5~2.5kV iyo midziyo yemumba ye220 V inogona kutsungirira. Asi mheni ikarova pamusoro pemusoro wako, usaswedere kubvisa plug.
p-221.actionItem: Usati wadutu, bvisa maTV, makomputa nerouter, kana shandisa surge-protected power strip, uye panguva yemheni usabate mawaya nezvishandiso.

p-222.title: Isa mabhodhoro emaruva ebalcony mukati usati wadutu
p-222.summary: Mabhodhoro emaruva anotorwa nemhepo kana kudonha panguva yedutu anogona kuuraya vari pazasi, saka isa mabhodhoro nezvinhu zvebalcony mukati kare.
p-222.principle: Simba rechinhu chinodonha kubva pakukwirira $h$ ndi $mgh$, uye kumhanya kwokudonha, pasina air resistance, ndi $v=\sqrt{2gh}$. Ngozi inowedzera nehuremu nokukwirira.
p-222.example: Bhodhoro re5 kg kana ripakudzika kweanenge 30m (pamusoro pechikamu che10) rinodonha $v\approx24\ \mathrm{m/s}$ (87km/h), uye simba rinova $5\times9.8\times30\approx1470\ \mathrm{J}$. Izvi zvakaenzana nesimba rechinhu che3.8kg chinouya ne100 km/h.
p-222.actionItem: Kana dutu rakataurwa, isa mabhodhoro emaruva ari pamacheka ebalcony, zvokuyanikira mbatya nemamwe maforo madiki mukati, uye vhara mawindows.

p-223.title: Mugungwa, pakati nepasi paship pane kurwara kwegungwa kushoma
p-223.summary: Pakati peship nepamubato wepasi, kuzungunuka kuri kushoma, saka kurwara kwegungwa kuri kushoma. Sarudza ikoko paunosarudza kabini kana chigaro.
p-223.principle: Ship inozungunuka yakatenderera pedyo nepakati, saka huwandu hwokufamba hwenzvimbo hunoenderana nechinhambwe kubva pakati pokutenderera ($s\approx r\theta$). Kana mukuona kwemaziso nokunzwa kweinner ear vestibular system zvichisiyana, kurwara kwegungwa kunoitika.
p-223.example: Kana kuzungunuka kwakarurama-kuruboshwe $\pm2^\circ$ (0.035 rad), pamberi peship panomita 40 kubva pakati panofamba $\pm1.4\ \mathrm{m}$, pakati panomita 5 panofamba $\pm0.17\ \mathrm{m}$, mutsauko ka-8. Pasi pakakwirira kuzungunuka kunowedzera.
p-223.actionItem: Paunobuka ship, sarudza kabini yepasi pakati peship, uye shure kwokukwira ona horizon.

p-224.title: Mutsetse wemeteor unoonekwa mushure memaminitsi 20 maziso ekuita rima
p-224.summary: Kuti uone meteor unobva panzvimbo ine chiedza, maziso anotora maminitsi 20~30 kuti azvibatanidze nerima, saka usati wasvika meteor dzakaoma hadzioneki zvakanaka.
p-224.principle: Murima rod cells dzinova dzinonzwa chiedza uye photopigments dzinovakazve, uye visual threshold light amount inodzikira zvikuru nenguva. Rod cells dzinotora maminitsi 20~30 kuti dzinyatsozvibatanidza, uye chiedza chescreen chefoni chinopedza kuzvibatanidza.
p-224.example: Kana maziso azvibatanidza nerima, kunzwa chiedza kunosvika zviuru 10 kupfuura panzvimbo ine chiedza. Perseid meteor shower inosvika pamusoro pa Nyamavhuvhu 12~13 gore rimwe nerimwe, uye nzvimbo isina mwedzi nemhenderekedzo yemaguta dzinogona kuona makumi pa awa.
p-224.actionItem: Kana ukaenda kunoona meteor shower, tora rima kwemaminitsi 20 usingatarise foni, utarise denga rakakura.
