p-225.title: Nei screen isingaonekwi pasi pezuva ranaa, luminance nechiedza chakaratidzirwa
p-225.summary: Pasi pechiedza chakasimba kunze, screen haionekwi kwete nokuti iri rima, asi nokuti chiedza chezuva chinoratidzirwa nescreen surface chinofukidza chiedza chescreen.
p-225.principle: Contrast ratio ndi $CR=\frac{L+L_a}{L_a}$ uye $L$ ndiyo screen luminance (nit), $L_a=\frac{RE}{\pi}$ ndiyo luminance yechiedza chakatenderedza chinoratidzirwa nesurface ($R$ reflectance, $E$ illuminance). Kana chiedza chakaratidzirwa chikakura, contrast ratio inosvika padyo ne1.
p-225.example: Pa direct sunlight $E=100{,}000\ \mathrm{lx}$, reflectance $R=2\%$ ndi $L_a\approx637\ \mathrm{nit}$. Screen ye800 nit ndi $CR\approx(800+637)/637\approx2.3$:1, inenge isingaonekwi, uye mukati meimba ye300 lx ndi $L_a\approx1.9\ \mathrm{nit}$, uye $CR$ ndi mazana.
p-225.actionItem: Pamazuva ezuva rakasimba, isa screen brightness pamaximum kana auto, uye edza kuita mumvuri pascreen nomuviri kana ruoko.

p-226.title: Nei compass yemapu rokufambira inongwara
p-226.summary: Compass yefoni inoverenga magnetic field yePasi isina simba, saka inotsauka nyore kana pane magnets kana simbi padyo.
p-226.principle: Magnetic field yePasi ndi $50\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ (munzvimbo yeKorea) isina simba, saka kana magnetic field $B_{int}$ yezvinhu zvakatenderedza ikawedzerwa, direction error ye$\theta\approx\arctan\frac{B_{int}}{B_{earth}}$ inoitika.
p-226.example: Kunyange case ine magnet kana car mount ichiwedzera $10\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ chete, error ndi $\arctan(10/50)\approx11^\circ$. Zvakare, kuKorea magnetic declination ndi 8° pakati pemagnetic north netrue north, saka tarisa mutsauko pakati pegrid north nemagnetic north.
p-226.actionItem: Kana map app ichiratidza nzira zvisina kujairika, tenderedza foni nenzira ye8 kuti uite calibrate compass, uye siyana nemagnets nesimbi.

p-227.title: Mugomo, pamita 100 yose yokukwira tembiricha inodzika 0.65 degrees
p-227.summary: Makomo marefu anotonhora zvikuru kupfuura nzvimbo yakati sandara pazuva rimwe chete, saka kana ukapfeka uchitarisa kupisa kwenzvimbo sandara, unotonhora mugomo.
p-227.principle: Tembiricha yemhepo inodzikira nokukwira kwenzvimbo nenzira ye average lapse rate $\Gamma\approx6.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C/km}$. Kana altitude difference ndi $\Delta z$, tembiricha inochinja ne $\Delta T=-\Gamma\Delta z$.
p-227.example: Kana panzvimbo yokutanga yakakwira 100m ndi 30°C, Chonwangsan pa1915 m ndi $30-0.65\times18.15\approx18.2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kana pane mhepo, wind chill inodzikira zvakare.
p-227.actionItem: Usati waenda mugomo, tarisa tembiricha pamusoro pegomo kubva pamamiriro ekunze, uye isa jacket isingapindwi nemhepo mubhegi.

p-228.title: Tropical night: madziro anoburitsa kupisa kwakachengetwa masikati
p-228.summary: Kupisa panguva ye tropical night kunoitika nokuti madziro nepasi zvinoburitsa kupisa kwakachengetwa masikati, saka dzivisa zuva masikati uye ita ventilation usiku.
p-228.principle: Thermal mass senge concrete inochengetedza kupisa $Q=mc\Delta T$ kana tembiricha ichikwira, uye inoburitsa kana mukati michitonhora. Mass nespecific heat zvakakura zvinoita kuti inochengetedza zvakawanda.
p-228.example: Madziro econcrete ane thickness 20cm, area 10m² (mass 4800kg, specific heat 0.88kJ/(kg·K)) kana akakwira ne5 °C anochengetedza $Q\approx4800\times0.88\times5\approx21\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (5.9kWh). Kupisa uku kunoburitswa zvishoma nezvishoma usiku.
p-228.actionItem: Masikati vhara mawindows anovhenekerwa nezuva nemacurtains kana blinds, uye usiku kana tembiricha yekunze ichiita yakadzikira kupfuura yemukati, vhura mawindows kuita ventilation, wozotarira air conditioner ku26~27°C.

p-229.title: Shower inodziya maawa 1~2 usati warara
p-229.summary: Shower inodziya maawa 1~2 usati warara inobudisa kupisa kwemuviri kunze uye inogadzira shanduko yetembiricha yemuviri inobatsira kurara.
p-229.principle: Kana mvura inodziya ichikurisa peripheral blood vessels, kupisa kunobuda nepaganda uye core body temperature inodzikira: $q = hA(T_s - T_a)$.
p-229.example: Kana ukashambira nemvura ye40 °C kwemaminitsi 10 woenda kurara mushure memaawa 1~2, zvidzidzo zvinoratidza kuti nguva yokurara inoderera ne10 maminitsi pamwe chete.
p-229.actionItem: Nhasi edza kushamba nemvura ye40 °C kwemaminitsi 10 maawa 1~2 usati warara.

p-230.title: Plunger inovhura kana yadhonzwa, kwete kana yasundwa
p-230.summary: Plunger ichishandisa kuisa kapu mumvura, kuiita seal, uye kudhonza zvakasimba kuzunza chinhu chakavharisa.
p-230.principle: Pressure difference pakati pemukati nekunze kwekapu inogadzira simba: $F = \Delta P \cdot A$. Zadza nemvura, kwete mhepo, kuti pressure itumirwe sezvakaita.
p-230.example: Kana cup area $0.01\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ne $\Delta P = 5\ \mathrm{kPa}$ ndi 50N (5 kgf) pasimba pachinhu chakavharika.
p-230.actionItem: Nhasi isa kapu yepadrain mumvura, ipinde zvakasimba, sundira zvinyoronyoro, ugodhonza zvakasimba, uchidzokorora ka10 (usashandise nemishonga).

p-231.title: Screw ine matanho akaswedera inopinda nesimba rishoma
p-231.summary: Pitch (kuparadzana kwematanho) kukapfupika, unogona kusunga zvakasimba nesimba rimwe chete, saka screws dzakatetepa dzakanaka kumatanda akaoma.
p-231.principle: Ideal mechanical advantage yescrew ndi $MA = \dfrac{2\pi r}{p}$ ($r$: radius yescrewdriver, $p$: pitch).
p-231.example: Kana $r = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$ uye pitch iri 1.0mm, ndi $MA \approx 12.6$, kana 0.5mm ndi $MA \approx 25$, simba rakapetwa hafu (usatarise friction).
p-231.actionItem: Nhasi kune matanda akaoma sarudza screws dzine pitch diki uye tanga wabboora pilot hole.

p-232.title: Kurovedza nerubber band kunochinja resistance sekureba
p-232.summary: Elastic band inowedzera resistance sokureba kwayakatambanudzwa, saka kutambanudza kunosvika pakureba kumwe chete ndicho chiyero chesimba rokurovedza.
p-232.principle: Hooke's law: $F = kx$ (rubber band yakatambanudzwa zvakanyanya haienderani nemutsetse, saka iyi ndeye approximation).
p-232.example: Band ye$k = 100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ inopa resistance ye30 N kana yatambanudzwa 0.3m, 60N kana 0.6m.
p-232.actionItem: Nhasi paunorovedza neband, nyora nzvimbo yemaoko kuti utambanudze kureba kumwe chete nguva dzose.

p-233.title: Mhepo inotonhora yakamirira mvura ichanaya chiratidzo chokutiza
p-233.summary: Mhepo inotonhora inovhuvhuta pakarepo usati wakamirira dutu ndiyo mhepo inotonhora inodonha yedutu rine mheni, chiratidzo chokuti mheni nemhepo zvakasimba zviri kuuya.
p-233.principle: Mhepo inotonhora ine density hukuru, saka inonyura ichiparadzira: $\rho = \dfrac{P}{R_s T}$.
p-233.example: Pa1 atmosphere, air density pa30°C ndi $1.165\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, pa20°C ndi $1.204\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, inorema ne3%, uye mhepo inogona kusvika 60~90km/h.
p-233.actionItem: Nhasi kana mhepo inotonhora ikavhuvhuta kunze uchinzwa mheni, pinda pakarepo mumba kana mumotokari.

p-234.title: Air conditioner yemotokari: tanga nemhepo yekunze, ichitonhora shandura kuinner circulation
p-234.summary: Kana wapinda, vhura mawindo kubudisa mhepo inopisa, uye kana mukati mataonhora, shandura kuinner circulation kudzikisa cooling load.
p-234.principle: Cooling load inoenderana nenhamba yemhepo nemutsauko wetembiricha: $\dot{Q} = \dot{m}\, c_p\, \Delta T$.
p-234.example: Kana $\dot{m} = 0.1\ \mathrm{kg/s}$, $c_p = 1.005\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, mhepo yekunze 35°C→22°C ndi 1.3kW, mhepo yemukati 25°C→22°C ndi 0.3kW.
p-234.actionItem: Nhasi kana wapinda mumotokari, vhura mawindo kwemuminiti rimwe kubudisa mhepo, uye kana yatonhora shandura kuinner circulation (parwendo rurefu shandisa mhepo yekunze nguva nenguva).

p-235.title: Kuzununguka kwemifananidzo yeusiku: mutemo we shutter 1/focal length
p-235.summary: Paunonongedza nemaoko, kuisa shutter time pfupi kupfuura reciprocal ye lens focal length kunoderedza zvakanyanya kusvibiswa nokuzununguka kwemaoko.
p-235.principle: Rule of thumb: $t \le \dfrac{1}{f}$ (full-frame equivalent focal length $f$ mm, ndi $t$ masekondi).
p-235.example: Lens ye50 mm ndiyo 1/50 sec, 200mm ndiyo 1/200 sec kana pfupi zvakachengeteka, uye kana rima, wedzera ISO kana chengetedza muviri.
p-235.actionItem: Nhasi paunofotora usiku, namira makumbo ako pamuviri kana pamadziro uye shandisa 2 second timer.

p-236.title: Moto wemoto unotsva zvakanaka kana huni dzakarongerwa dzakamira
p-236.summary: Kana huni dzakarongerwa dzakakotamira, chimney effect inoita kuti mhepo ikwezve kubva pasi uye moto unotsva zvakanaka.
p-236.principle: Draft pressure inogadzirwa nenzvimbo yemhepo inopisa: $\Delta P \approx \rho g h \dfrac{\Delta T}{T}$.
p-236.example: Kana kukwirira $h = 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$, kumoto 600K, mhepo yekunze 300K, ndi $\Delta P \approx 1.2 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 \times \dfrac{300}{600} \approx 3\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-236.actionItem: Nhasi paunenge uri kumusasa, ronga huni dzakamira sekatendi diki, asi chengetedza mvura padyo uye usatange moto munzvimbo dzakarambidzwa moto.

p-237.title: Kunyange ice ichinyungudika, mvura mukapu haidonhi
p-237.summary: Ice inoyerera pamvura kana ichinyungudika, mvura haichinji zvakanyanya, saka kunyange kapu yakazara haidonhi.
p-237.principle: Ice inoyerera inotsvedzera mvura yakaenzana nehuremu hwayo: $V_{\mathrm{d}} = \dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$, uye vhoriyamu yemvura yakanyungudika ndi $\dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$.
p-237.example: Ice ye90 g inotsvedzera mvura ye90 mL (kubva paye total volume $98\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ chikamu $8\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ chete chinobuda kumusoro), uye kana ichinyungudika inova 90mL, saka mvura ichiramba yakaenzana.
p-237.actionItem: Nhasi zadza kapu neice nemvura ugarire kusvika yanyungudika yose (usasundire nomuoko).

p-238.title: Tarisa green zone yepressure gauge yefire extinguisher
p-238.summary: Pressurized fire extinguisher inogona kushandiswa chete kana gauge needle iri mugreen zone (normal 0.7~0.98MPa).
p-238.principle: Pressure isimba pa unit area: $P = \dfrac{F}{A}$. Kana gasi ichibuda, pressure yechidziyo inodzikira uye simba rokupfura rinoderera.
p-238.example: Normal range ye0.7~0.98MPa ndi 7~9.8bar (7~10 nguva yeatmospheric pressure), uye kana needle iri mured zone kana padyo ne0, inoda kutsiviwa kana kuzadzwazve.
p-238.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kuti gauge yefire extinguisher yemumba kana yemumotokari iri mugreen zone here, pamwe nesafety pin nehose.

p-239.title: Seesaw inoenzana kana munhu anorema agara padyo nepakati
p-239.summary: Kunyange vanhu vaviri vane huremu hwakasiyana, kana anorema agara padyo nepakati, seesaw inoenzana.
p-239.example: Kana mwana ane 30kg agara pa2 m kubva pakati uye ane 60kg pa1 m, $30 \times 2 = 60 \times 1$, zvinoenzana.
p-239.actionItem: Nhasi kana wakaenda kupaki nomwana, chinja nzvimbo dzokugara kuti uwane balance point, uye bvisa mumwe nomumwe zvakachengeteka.

p-240.title: Nei mabhiriji nemigwagwa yezhizha ine matanho pamakurukuro
p-240.summary: Simbi neconcrete zvinowedzera kana zvichipisa, saka mabhiriji nemigwagwa zvinosiya matanho pamakurukuro kuti ave nenzvimbo yokuwedzera.
p-240.example: Dhorobha ye100 m yesimbi ($\alpha \approx 12 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$) kana yachinja kubva -10°C kusvika 40°C, $\Delta L \approx 0.06\ \mathrm{m}$ ndiko kureba kuri 60mm.
p-240.actionItem: Nhasi paunopfuura bhiriji kana pavement joint, tsvaga matanho, uye usaise matombo kana marara mavari.

p-241.title: Mabhatiri ezvidemo anopenya series, anogara parallel
p-241.summary: Mabhatiri akabatanidzwa series anowedzera voltage saka anopenya, parallel anochengetedza voltage yakaenzana asi capacity inowedzera saka anogara, asi total energy yakaenzana.
p-241.principle: Series: $V = V_1 + V_2$, parallel: $Q = Q_1 + Q_2$. Energy $E = VQ$.
p-241.example: Mabhatiri maviri e1.5V·2500 mAh series ndi 3V·2.5 Ah, parallel 1.5V·5 Ah, zvose zviri zviviri zvinoita 7.5Wh.
p-241.actionItem: Nhasi shandura mabhatiri etoroji pamwe chete akafanana mhando uye ane chaji yakaenzana, uye usavhenganise matsva nemakare.

p-242.title: Windscreen yemicrophone inodzikisa ruzha rwemhepo muvideo yegungwa
p-242.summary: Windscreen yeubwe pamberi pemicrophone inoparadzira turbulence uye inodzikisa zvikuru ruzha rwemhepo.
p-242.principle: Standard yeflow yaturbulent ndiyo Reynolds number: $\mathrm{Re} = \dfrac{\rho v D}{\mu}$.
p-242.example: Kana wind speed ye5 m/s, microphone diameter 1cm ndi $\mathrm{Re} \approx 3{,}300$, uye fur cover inodzikisa ruzha rwemhepo ne10~20dB.
p-242.actionItem: Nhasi paunorekodha video pagungwa, fukidza microphone nefur windscreen uye utarise microphone kure nemhepo.

p-243.title: Nei touchscreen isingashande zvakanaka maoko akanyorova
p-243.summary: Madonhwe emvura anotakura magetsi uye anopararira pamusoro pescreen, achichinja capacitance yeelectrodes dzakawanda, saka phantom touch inoitika.
p-243.example: Kana madonhwe emvura abata, sensor inogona kuverenga shanduko yecapacitance yakafanana nemunwe, saka kunyange screen isina kuparara inogona kushanda zvisina kururama.
p-243.actionItem: Nhasi kana screen ichishanda zvisina kururama, usati wakurudzira kugadziriswa, kokorodza mvura pamaoko nescreen nejira rakaoma.

p-244.title: Camping stove: isa windscreen, asi usafukidze gas canister
p-244.summary: Windscreen inodzikisa kurasikirwa kwekupisa kwestove nehari, asi kufukidza gas canister kunoita kuti ipise kwazvo uye ine ngozi.
p-244.principle: Convective heat loss: $q = hA\Delta T$ (kana mhepo ichisimba, $h$ inowedzera).
p-244.example: Pamusoro pehari $0.05\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $\Delta T = 80\ \mathrm{K}$, kana $h$ inokura kubva ku10 kusvika ku30 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$, kurasikirwa kunowedzera kubva 40W kusvika 120W (muenzaniso).
p-244.actionItem: Nhasi paunobika kunze, isa windscreen padyo nehari nestove chete uye siya gas canister kunze (usashandise mukati kana mukati mekatendi).

p-245.title: Chikonzero nei guruva rinoumbwa mangwanani akajeka ekudzoka kwechirimo
p-245.summary: Usiku hwakajeka husina mhepo, pasi pano panotonhorera nekuburitsa kupisa, mweya wasvika padew point, uye guruva rinoumbwa.
p-245.principle: Kufungidzira kwe dew point: $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100 - \mathrm{RH}}{5}$ (°C, RH mu %).
p-245.example: Kana masikati ari 20°C uye humidity ari 70%, $T_d \approx 14$°C, uye kana mangwanani kwodzika kusvika ku 12°C, mweya unozara uye guruva rinoumbwa.
p-245.actionItem: Kana uchityaira nhasi mangwanani muguruva, batidza mwenje yakaderera nemwenje yeguruva uye siya mukaha mukuru kupfuura wenguva dzose.

p-246.title: Sarudza magiya ebhasikoro nekadence, kwete nesimba
p-246.summary: Pamasimba akafanana, giya rinokubvumira kutenderedza ma pedal zvakapfava pa 70-90 rpm rinorerutsa mutoro pamabvi ako.
p-246.principle: Simba ndiko torque kuwanza nekukasira kwekutenderera: $P = \tau \omega$, $\omega = \dfrac{2\pi \cdot \mathrm{rpm}}{60}$.
p-246.example: Kuburitsa simba rinenge 210W unoda torque inenge 33N·m pa 60 rpm asi inenge 22N·m chete pa 90 rpm.
p-246.actionItem: Pakukwira kwako nhasi, shandura magiya kuti ucheuke cadence yako pa 70-90 rpm.

p-247.title: Mhenderekedzo yematope inovhurika inenge maminitsi 50 gare gare zuva rimwe nerimwe
p-247.summary: Mwedzi unotora maminitsi anenge 50 akawedzerwa zuva rimwe nerimwe kuti udzoke, saka nguva dzemafungu dzinononoka nemaminitsi anenge 50 zuva rimwe nerimwe.
p-247.principle: Zuva remwedzi ndi $T_{\mathrm{lunar}} \approx 24\ \mathrm{h}\ 50\ \mathrm{min}$ uye pane mafungu maviri pazuva remwedzi, saka mafungu anouya anenge maawa 12 maminitsi 25 akaparadzana.
p-247.example: Kana low tide ari 10:00 nhasi, mangwana ichave inenge 10:50 uye, mazuva matanhatu mushure, $6 \times 50 = 300$ min gare gare, inenge 15:00.
p-247.actionItem: Usati waenda kumhenderekedzo yematope, tarisa tafura yemafungu uye sarudza nguva yauchadzoka wabuda mafungu asati adzoka.

p-248.title: Muchina wevacuum unotendera kudzvanywa kwemhepo kuita basa rekudzvanya
p-248.summary: Muchina wevacuum unobvisa mweya mubhegi kuitira kuti kudzvanya kwemhepo yekunze kudzvanye mapakeji zvakasimba pachikafu.
p-248.example: Pabhegi re $0.03\ \mathrm{m^2}$ rine musiyano wepressure we 80kPa, anenge 2.4kN (anenge 240 kgf) anoparadzirwa pamusoro pose.
p-248.actionItem: Nhasi, pakiza zvikafu zvakaomeswa kana zvikamu zvekuisa mufiriza nevacuum, asi ramba uchiisa zvikafu zvinoora nyore mufiriji kana mufiriza.

p-249.title: Steamer inobika nekukasira nekupisa kwecondensation
p-249.summary: Mhute inoita condensation pachikafu ichiburitsa latent heat yakawanda, ichiunza kupisa nekukasira kupfuura kuvira kwemvura.
p-249.example: Kuita condensation kwe 50g yemhute kunoburitsa anenge 113kJ, anenge ka 6.8 ye 16.7kJ inoburitswa ne 50g yemvura ye 100°C ichitonhora kusvika ku 20°C.
p-249.actionItem: Kana uchibika nesteamer nhasi, chengeta chivharo pachinzvimbo, uye chisimudze kure nechiso chako kuti urege kupiswa nemhute.

p-250.title: Unogona kufungidzira tembiricha kubva pakuimba kwemakwekwe
p-250.summary: Makwekwe anoimba nekukasira kana kwakapisa, saka kuverenga kuimba kunopa tembiricha inofungidzirwa.
p-250.example: Kuimba 100 paminitsi kunopa anenge 65°F (anenge 18°C) uye 160 kunopa anenge 80°F (anenge 27°C), kufungidzira kwakatenderedza kunosiyana nerudzi.
p-250.actionItem: Manheru ano, verenga kuimba kwemakwekwe kwemasekonzi 15, wanzira ne 4, uye ufungidzire tembiricha nefomula.

p-251.title: Chikonzero nei kurovera kwezuva kuri tsvuku
p-251.summary: Kana zuva riri pasi, chiedza chinofamba nzira refu nemumhepo, bhuruu inotanga kupararira, uye tsvuku ndiyo inosara.
p-251.example: Bhuruu (450nm) inopararira ne $(700/450)^4 \approx 5.9$ nguva zvakasimba kupfuura tsvuku (700nm), saka inotanga kubuda.
p-251.actionItem: Tarisa ruvara rwedenga pakurovera kwezuva nhasi, asi usatarisa zuva zvakananga kana kutungamira kamera kana binoculars kwariri.

p-252.title: Mwedzi wakazara unoratidzika sesikipa rakabatwa kure
p-252.summary: Mwedzi wakazara mudiki kupfuura sezvaunonzwika, mudiki zvekuti mhodzi yerice paruoko rwakatambanudzwa inouvhara.
p-252.example: Sikipa re 24mm riri anenge 2.7m kure rine angular size imwe chete, uye paruoko rwakatambanudzwa rwenge 60cm chinhu chinenge 5mm pakufara chinovhara Mwedzi.
p-252.actionItem: Kana Mwedzi wakazara wabuda nhasi, tambanudza ruoko rwako uuvhare nemhodzi imwe yerice.

p-253.title: Kuvhiringika kwemotokari panguva yezororo kunotangira pakudzvanya breki kamwe
p-253.summary: Mugwagwa une motokari dzakawanda, motokari imwe ichidzvanya breki inounganidza kunonoka kwekuita pakati pezvinotevera uye ngungu yekuvhiringika inopararira kumashure.
p-253.principle: Stopping distance: $d = v\,t_r + \dfrac{v^2}{2a}$; ngungu yekuvhiringika inowanzofamba kumashure inenge 15-20km/h.
p-253.example: Pa 100km/h (anenge 27.8m/s), kuita nesekonzi 1 kunofukidza 27.8m breki isati yatanga, uye kuchengeta mukaha wemasekonzi 3 uchityaira zvakanaka kunogona kuchengetedza mafuta anenge 5-10%.
p-253.actionItem: Pakutyaira kwako nhasi, chengeta mukaha wemasekonzi 2-3 uye bvisa tsoka paaccelerator nekukasira kuti udzvanye breki zvishoma.

p-254.title: Chengeta 15m kana kupfuura kubva kubrush cutter
p-254.summary: Muromo webrush cutter blade unofamba nekukasira zvekuti matombo anobhururuka seembambo, saka chengeta munhu wese pamusoro pe 15m kubva panzvimbo yebasa.
p-254.principle: Blade tip speed: $v = \omega r$; thrown range: $R = \dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}$.
p-254.example: Ne blade radius ye 0.115m pa 6,500 rpm ($\omega \approx 681\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), $v \approx 78\ \mathrm{m/s}$, anenge 280km/h.
p-254.actionItem: Usati wacheka nebrush cutter nhasi, tarisa kuti hapana vanhu kana motokari mukati me 15m uye pfeka zvekudzivirira maziso nechiso.

p-255.title: Tarisa comfort rating yesleeping bag ne R-value yematiresi
p-255.summary: Usiku kupisa kwakawanda kunorasika kuenda pasi kupfuura kumhepo, saka tarisa zvose zviri zviviri comfort rating yebhegi ne R-value yematiresi.
p-255.example: Matiresi efoam e 2cm ane $k = 0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ane $R \approx 0.57\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$ (anenge 3.2 mumayuniti e US R-value), uye R-value ye 3 kana kupfuura i mutemo wakajairika wekukambi mukudzoka kwechirimo.
p-255.actionItem: Kana uchisarudza zvekukambi nhasi, tarisa kuti comfort rating yebhegi iri pakana kana pasi pekudzika kunotarisirwa uye R-value yematiresi i 3 kana kupfuura.

p-256.title: Barometer yefoni inogona kuverenga shanduko dzekukwirira
p-256.summary: Mafoni mazhinji ane pressure sensor, saka shanduko dzepressure dzinogona kufungidzira kuti wakwira kana kudzika zvakawanda sei.
p-256.principle: $\Delta P \approx -\rho g\,\Delta h$; padyo nechiyero chegungwa, kudzika kwe 1hPa = kukwira kwe anenge 8m.
p-256.example: Ne $\rho = 1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, 8m dzega dzega i $1.2 \times 9.8 \times 8 \approx 94\ \mathrm{Pa} \approx 0.94\ \mathrm{hPa}$, saka chivako chemahwerengedzero 30 (anenge 90m) chiri pamusoro anenge 11hPa pasi.
p-256.actionItem: Nhasi, vhura barometer app uye enzanisa kuverenga pasi nepamusoro pechivako (yera nekukasira, nokuti mamiriro ekunze anoshandura pressure zvakare).

p-257.title: Bata matafura emabhuku nemafiriji kuti adzivirire kudengenyeka kwenyika
p-257.summary: Mafenicha marefu akatetepa anowa nekudengenyeka kushoma, saka kuabata kuruware kunoachengetedza.
p-257.principle: Tipping condition: $mg\,\dfrac{b}{2} < m a\, h_c$, kureva $a > g\,\dfrac{b}{2 h_c}$ ($b$: upamhi, $h_c$: kukwirira kwecenter of mass).
p-257.example: Bookcase ye 1.8m yakareba ($h_c = 0.9\ \mathrm{m}$) iri 0.3m kudzika inowa pa $a > 0.3/1.8\, g \approx 0.17\,g$.
p-257.actionItem: Nhasi, bata mafenicha marefu kuruware nema L-bracket uye isa zvinhu zvinorema pamasherufu epasi.

p-258.title: Chikonzero nei gitare inobuda mutune kana tembiricha ichichinja zvakanyanya
p-258.summary: Kana tembiricha ichichinja, kudzvanywa kwetambo kunochinja uye pitch inoshanduka, saka tune zvakare usati wavhiya.
p-258.example: Kudzika kwe 1% kwetension kunodzikisa frequency ne 0.5%, saka noti ye 440Hz inodzika ne 2.2Hz (anenge 9 cents), inogona kunzwika.
p-258.actionItem: Usati wavhiya nhasi, tune zvakare netuner (uye kamwezve gitare yagadzikana).

p-259.title: Rereka mukukotama kwenjanji yekumhanya
p-259.summary: Kurereka mukati muchikotama kunobvumira friction kupa centripetal force kuti utendeuke usingatsvedze.
p-259.example: Kumhanya 14.4km/h (4m/s) kutenderera chikotama che radius ye 20m kunopa $\tan\theta \approx 16/196 \approx 0.082$, anenge 4.7° yekurereka.
p-259.actionItem: Pachikotama nhasi, dzikisa kukasira nekukurumidza uye rereka zvishoma mukati kubva pamagokora uchitendeuka.

p-260.title: Mitsetse yemhepo inogara inoratidza mweya une hunyoro pamusoro
p-260.summary: Kana mutsetse wemhepo usingapere nekukasira uchipararira, mweya wepamusoro une hunyoro hwakakwana kuti ive supersaturated maererano nechando.
p-260.principle: Relative humidity pamusoro pechando: $\mathrm{RH}_i = \dfrac{e}{e_i} \times 100\%$; mutsetse wemhepo unogara kana $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.example: Pa anenge -40°C, saturation vapor pressure pamusoro pechando i anenge 68% chete yeiri pamusoro pemvura, saka humidity ye 70% maererano nemvura yatopa $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti mitsetse yemhepo inogara nguva yakadii mudenga, uye utore iri refu inopararira sechiratidzo chakatenderedza chemweya une hunyoro pamusoro chete, kwete kufanotaura.

p-261.title: Chopstick mugaba rerice inogona kusimudza gaba rose
p-261.summary: Pakiza rice mugaba uye pinza chopstick uye mbeu dzinoibata zvakasimba zvekuti gaba rose rinosimudzwa.
p-261.principle: Pressure pakati pembeu inodzvanya chopstick ichigadzira friction: $f = \mu N$.
p-261.example: Semuenzaniso, simba repadivi $N = 50\ \mathrm{N}$ ne $\mu = 0.4$ rinopa anenge 20N yefriction, yakakwana kusimudza anenge 1kg (anenge 9.8N) yegaba nerice.
p-261.actionItem: Nhasi, zadza gaba rakatetepa nerice, dzvanyisa, pinza chopstick zvakadzika uye usimudze, uchizviita pamusoro petafura kuti pasapunyuke chinhu.

p-262.title: Sarudza chibereko chinorema kana makuru akaenzana
p-262.summary: Pakati pemichero yakaenzana pakukura, inorema kazhinji ine muto wakawanda uye haina kuoma.
p-262.example: Pamaorenji maviri ane vhoriyamu yakafanana e 220g ($\rho \approx 1.10\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$) ne 190g ($\rho \approx 0.95\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$), inorema kazhinji ine muto wakawanda.
p-262.actionItem: Kana uchitenga michero nhasi, bata yakafanana pakukura muruoko rumwe nerumwe kuenzanisa huremu, uye utarise kuti hapana kuvhunika.

p-263.title: Kufamba pamoving walkway yepaairport kunowedzera kukasira
p-263.summary: Kufamba pamoving walkway kunowedzera kukasira kwekufamba kwako kukukasira kwebhandi, saka unotangira kure zvakanyanya.
p-263.example: Walkway ye 0.75m/s pamwe nekufamba kwe 1.4m/s zvinopa 2.15m/s; pa 200m i anenge 93 s panzvimbo ye 267 s wakamira, anenge maminitsi matatu nekukasira.
p-263.actionItem: Kana uchifamba pamoving walkway nhasi, gara kudivi rimwe, bata handrail, uye chengeta mavhazi padyo newe.

p-264.title: Bike reflector stickers dzinodzosera chiedza kwachakabva
p-264.summary: Retroreflective stickers dzinodzosera chiedza chemwenje yemotokari kwachakabva, zvichiita kuti bhasikoro rionekwe mumigwagwa yerima.
p-264.principle: Corner cube inoshandisa magirazi matatu akatarisana nenzira yakarurama kudzosera chiedza antiparallel: $\vec{r}_{out} = -\vec{r}_{in}$.
p-264.example: Zvipfeko zvinoratidza zvinowanzoonekwa kubva panenge 150m kure, nepo zvipfeko zvakasviba zvichiwanzonzwiwa mukati me 30-50m chete.
p-264.actionItem: Nhasi, namira ma reflector pamavhiri, frame nema pedal ebhasikoro rako, uye shandisa mwenje yepamberi neyepashure zvakare.

p-265.title: Usarume soup inopisa pakarepo
p-265.summary: Kurumira soup inopisa mu blender yakavharwa kunobvumira mhute kuwedzera ichibhuruka chivharo, izvo zvinogona kukonzera kupiswa.
p-265.principle: Ideal gas law: $PV = nRT$. Gramu rimwe remvura rinoshanduka kuita mhute rinotora anenge 1.7L pa 100°C ne 1atm.
p-265.actionItem: Nhasi, rega soup inopisa itonhore maminitsi 10 kana kupfuura, zadza jar isingapfuure hafu, vhurisa chivharo uye ufukidze netauro uchirumira.

p-266.title: Chikonzero nei masikati nehusiku zvakaenzana pa autumn equinox
p-266.summary: Pa autumn equinox zuva riri pamusoro pe equator, saka masikati nehusiku zvinenge maawa 12 kwose pasi pano.
p-266.example: Declination i +23.4° pa June solstice (anenge June 21), 0° pa autumn equinox (anenge September 22), uye -23.4° pa December solstice (anenge December 21).
p-266.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa nguva dzekubuda nekurovera kwezuva uye uverenge kuti zuva rine maawa anenge 12 here.

p-267.title: Bvisa mweya muboiler neradiator pakuchinja kwemwaka
p-267.summary: Mweya wakasungirwa muheating loop unovharira kuyerera kwemvura, uchisiya kumusoro kweradiator kuine kutonhora; kuubvisa kunopa kudziya kwakawanda nemafuta akaenzana.
p-267.principle: Kupisa kunopiwa kunoenderana nekuyerera kwekutenderera: $Q = \dot{m}\, c\, \Delta T$.
p-267.example: Radiator ye 1kW inoda anenge $1\ \mathrm{L/min}$ yemvura pa $\Delta T = 15\ \mathrm{K}$, uye chikamu chizere nemweya hachiburitsi kupisa.
p-267.actionItem: Heating yakadzimwa uye yatonhora, vhura air valve paradiator inotonhora kumusoro kuti ubvise mweya, wobva watarisa boiler pressure sezvinotaurwa nemanyuaru.

p-268.title: Pakupaka pamupata, tendeudza mavhiri akatarisana nekabhi
p-268.summary: Kana uchipaka pamupata, kunze kwehandbrake negiya, tendeudza mavhiri kuti kabhi iimise motokari kana ikaramba ichidzika.
p-268.principle: Simba mukati memupata: $F = mg\sin\theta$; friction: $f = \mu N$.
p-268.example: Motokari ye 1,500kg pamupata we 10% ($\theta \approx 5.7^\circ$) inodhonzwa pasi nesimba rinenge 1.46kN (anenge 150 kgf).
p-268.actionItem: Nhasi, paka wakatarisa pasi uine mavhiri akatendeudzirwa kukabhi, kana kuti kumusoro padyo nekabhi uine mavhiri akatendeudzirwa kure, uye batidza handbrake ne P (kana giya rekutanga).

p-269.title: Zvinoratidzika zviri padyo zvinopfuura nepahwindo renjanji nekukasira kukuru
p-269.summary: Pakukasira kumwe chete, zvinhu zviri padyo zvinopfuura nepamberi pekuona kwako nekukasira kukuru, nepo makomo ari kure achiratidzika sekukambaira.
p-269.example: Pa 100km/h (27.8m/s), muti uri 20m kure unopfuura pa $\omega \approx 1.39\ \mathrm{rad/s} \approx 80^\circ/\mathrm{s}$, nepo gomo riri 5km kure rinopfuura pa anenge $0.3^\circ/\mathrm{s}$.
p-269.actionItem: Kana uchinzwa kuda kurutsa uchifamba nhasi, tarisa makomo ari kure kana denga panzvimbo yezvinhu zviri padyo.

p-270.title: Tug of war inokunda nefriction yetsoka, kwete nehuremu hwemuviri
p-270.summary: Mu tug of war rope inodhonza zvakaenzana kumativi ose, uye mhedzisiro inotarwa nemaximum friction iyo pasi inogona kupa kutsoka dzako.
p-270.principle: Static friction: $f \le \mu N$ ($N = mg$); rope tension yakaenzana kumativi ose (action-reaction).
p-270.example: Kumunhu we 70kg, $\mu = 0.8$ pasi rakaoma rinobvumira kusvika anenge 550N, asi $\mu = 0.4$ pasi rinotsvedza anenge 270N chete.
p-270.actionItem: Kana uchitamba tug of war nhasi, pfeka mashangu anobata uye rereka kumashure pasi, asi usamboputira rope paruoko rwako.

p-271.title: Kuvhiya nyama ichiita hafu kunoibika nekukasira kunenge ka 4
p-271.summary: Kucheka nyama kusvika pahafu yekukora kunodzikisa nguva yekuti kupisa kusvike pakati kusvika pachikamu chechina, zvichichengetedzawo mafuta.
p-271.principle: Heat diffusion time: $t \propto \dfrac{L^2}{\alpha}$ ($L$: kukora, $\alpha$: thermal diffusivity).
p-271.example: Kana chimedu che 6cm kukora chinotora anenge maminitsi 60, chimedu che 3cm chinotora anenge $60 \times \left(\dfrac{3}{6}\right)^2 = 15$ min.
p-271.actionItem: Nhasi, cheka zvimedu zvikuru zvenyama kuita zvitete usati wabika, uye tarisa nethermometer kuti pakati pasvika anenge 75°C kana kupfuura.

p-272.title: Ridza nesweet spot yebhatiri rebaseball kuti usarwadziwa maoko
p-272.summary: Bhatiri rine center of percussion, sweet spot, apo kurova bhora hakutumire kuvhunduka kushoma kumaoko ako.
p-272.principle: Kureba kweicenter of percussion kubva pa pivot: $q = \dfrac{I}{m d}$ ($I$: moment of inertia pamusoro pe pivot, $d$: kureba kubva pa pivot kuenda kucenter of mass).
p-272.example: Kune uniform rod ye 0.84m yakabatwa pamuromo, $q = \dfrac{2}{3} L \approx 0.56\ \mathrm{m}$; mabhatiri chaiwo anorema kumuromo, saka nzvimbo inoshanduka zvishoma.
p-272.actionItem: Mukudzidzira kurova kwenhasi, tarisira kusangana nebhora nesweet spot yepakati yebhatiri, kwete muromo.

p-273.title: Kuputira rope katatu pachigadziko kunoderedza simba rinodiwa
p-273.summary: Kutendeuka kushoma kwe rope pachigadziko kunokwidziridza friction zvakanyanya zvekuti simba diki rinogona kubata mutoro unorema.
p-273.example: Ne $\mu = 0.3$ nekutendeuka kwe 3 ($\varphi = 6\pi \approx 18.85\ \mathrm{rad}$), $e^{5.65} \approx 285$, saka mutoro we 1,000N unobatwa nenge 3.5N (ideal value).
p-273.actionItem: Kana uchisunga mutoro nhasi, tora kutendeuka 2-3 pachigadziko, asi usamboputira rope paruoko kana pamuviri kana kuishandisa pamitoro inokosha upenyu.

p-274.title: Uchi kana syrup inodziya inoyerera nyore zvakanyanya
p-274.summary: Kana uchi kana syrup richidziya, viscosity yaro inodzika zvakanyanya, zvichisiya zvishoma zvakanamira mujar.
p-274.example: Uchi hune anenge 10Pa·s pa 20°C hunotetepa kusvika pa anenge 1-2Pa·s pa 40°C, kuyerera nyore ka 5 kusvika ka 10.
p-274.actionItem: Nhasi, isa jar yeuchi yakavharwa mumvura inodziya ye 40°C kwemaminitsi 5 usati washandisa, uye dzivisa mvura inovira kana microwave.

p-275.title: Chengeta kimchi pa balcony ine mumvuri mubhokisi refoam
p-275.summary: Styrofoam haitakure kupisa zvakanyanya uye mumvuri unovharira kupisa kwezuva. Pamwe chete zvinochengeta kimchi yakachengetwa yakatonhora uye yakagadzikana kwenguva refu.
p-275.principle: Conductive heat loss i $q=\frac{kA\Delta T}{L}$. Polystyrene foam ine $k\approx0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$, yakaderera kupfuura matanda (anenge $0.12$). Zuva rakananga rinopisa pamusoro pe container nekuburitsa kupisa, saka mumvuri unodiwawo.
p-275.example: Kubhokisi rine masvingo e $3\ \mathrm{cm}$ nenzvimbo ye $1\ \mathrm{m^2}$ nemusiyano we $10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ pakati pemukati nekunze, $q=0.035\times1\times10/0.03\approx12\ \mathrm{W}$. Bhokisi retanda rekukora kumwe chete rinoburitsa anenge $40\ \mathrm{W}$, kupfuura ka 3.
p-275.actionItem: Nhasi, isa container yekimchi mubhokisi refoam kudivi rine mumvuri rebalcony uye zadza mukaha nenyuzipepa usati wavhara chivharo.

p-276.title: Bvisa mashizha mumadhirenji mvura isati yazara
p-276.summary: Mashizha anovhara dhirenji anodzikisa kuyerera kunogona kutakura, saka mvura yemvura imwe chete inogona kuunganidza ichiita mafashama. Miniti rimwe rekuchenesa mvura isati yanaya ndiko kudzivirira kwakachipa.
p-276.principle: Flow rate i $Q=Av$, saka kana effective open area $A$ ichideredzwa, drainage inodzika zvichienderana. Mashizha anovhara mavhomho egrate uye anocheka $A$ zvakanyanya.
p-276.example: Dhirenji ye $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ muvhara ine nzvimbo inenge $79\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Kana mashizha achivhara hafu yaro, $A\approx39\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, uye pakukasira kuyerera kumwe chete drainage inodzika kusvika pa anenge $50\%$.
p-276.actionItem: Nhasi, bvisa mashizha pachivharo chedhirenji yepabalcony, padenga kana pamusuo nemaoko ane magirovhosi kana tongs.

p-277.title: Maminitsi gumi echiedza chemangwanani akajeka kakawanda kupfuura mwenje yemukati
p-277.summary: Kunyange mangwanani ane makore kunze akajeka kupfuura mwenje yemukati, uye chiedza chakajeka chinobatsira kuronga rhythm yemuviri yezuva nezuva. Kubuda kwenguva pfupi mangwanani ndiko tsika yechiedza iri nyore zvikuru.
p-277.principle: Illuminance ndicho chiedza chinosvika pamusoro pechinhu pachikamu, $E=\frac{\Phi}{A}$, chinoyerwa mu lux ($\mathrm{lm/m^2}$). Kunze pazuva rakajeka i anenge $10{,}000\sim100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$; chiedza chemukati chakajairika i $100\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-277.example: Mangwanani akajeka kunze pa anenge $10{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ i anenge ka 20 hofisi ye $500\ \mathrm{lux}$ uye anenge ka 70 imba yekugara ye $150\ \mathrm{lux}$. Kunyange mazuva ane makore kazhinji ari pamusoro pe $1{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, akajeka kupfuura mukati.
p-277.actionItem: Mangwanani ano, tora maminitsi gumi uchifamba kunze panzvimbo yekutarisa nepahwindo. Usatarise zuva zvakananga.

p-278.title: Mukukwira makomo kwekudzoka kwechirimo zuva rinorovera nekukasira kupfuura tafura inoratidza nekuda kwemumvuri wegomo
p-278.summary: Matafura ekurovera kwezuva anotora kuti horizon yakaenzana, saka gomo riri kumavirira rinovanza zuva nekukasira. Mumakomo kurovera chaiko ndiko kana zuva rasvika pamutsetse wegomo.
p-278.principle: Kana gomo rekumavirira rinovharira zuva kusvika pakukwirira $h$, kurovera chaiko ndiko kana zuva radzika kusvika pakukwirira uko, anenge $\Delta t\approx\frac{h}{\omega}$ kwakare. Pamidlatitudes mukudzoka kwechirimo kukasira kwekudzika kwezuva i anenge $\omega\approx12^\circ/\mathrm{h}$.
p-278.example: Negomo re $10^\circ$ kumavirira, $\Delta t\approx10^\circ/12^\circ\mathrm{/h}\approx50\ \mathrm{min}$ yemumvuri wekutanga. Kuwedzera rima rinotevera, mukaha wako wakachengeteka wekudzika unodzikira nemaawa anopfuura rimwe.
p-278.actionItem: Nhasi, isa nguva yekupedza kukwira kwako maawa 1.5 kusvika 2 zuva risati rarovera maererano netafura uye tora headlamp.

p-279.title: Tarisa zvose fill power nefill weight yejaketi yedown
p-279.summary: Fill power inoyera kuti down inozvimba zvakanaka sei kubata mweya. Nhamba yakakwira inoreva kudziya kumwe chete nehuremu hushoma, asi kudziya kwose kunoenderananewo nekuti fill yakashandiswa yakawanda sei.
p-279.principle: Fill power i $\mathrm{FP}=\frac{V\,(\mathrm{in^3})}{m\,(\mathrm{oz})}$, vhoriyamu pachikamu chehuremu hwedown. Kudziya kunoenderana nekukora kwemweya wakasungirwa usingafambi ($k\approx0.026\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$), saka huremu hunodiwa kuzadza vhoriyamu yakapihwa i $m\propto\frac{1}{\mathrm{FP}}$.
p-279.example: Kuzadza kukora kumwe chete, fill power 600 inoda $100\ \mathrm{g}$ uye fill power 800 inoda $600/800\times100=75\ \mathrm{g}$. Kudziya kumwe chete, iko kunenge $25\%$ kureruka.
p-279.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchitenga puffer jacket, enzanisa zvose fill power nefill weight (g) pachiratidzo.

p-280.title: Solar calculator inoshanda kunyange pasi pemwenje yemukati
p-280.summary: Calculator inoshandisa ma microwatts mashoma, saka chiedza chakaneta chemukati chakakwana. Chinokosha ndechekuti simba rephoton imwe neimwe rinopfuura threshold here, kwete kuti chiedza chakajeka sei.
p-280.principle: Photon energy i $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{\lambda}$. Kana ichipfuura semiconductor band gap, ma electron anosunungurwa uye current inoyerera; chiedza chakaneta chinodzikisa current chete.
p-280.example: Photon yakaonekwa ye $550\ \mathrm{nm}$ inotakura $E\approx2.25\ \mathrm{eV}$, pamusoro pe band gap yeamorphous silicon inenge $1.7\ \mathrm{eV}$. Imba ye $500\ \mathrm{lux}$ i anenge $1/200$ yechiedza chezuva rakajeka (anenge $100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$) asi ichiri yakakwana kucalculator inoshandisa ma $\mu\mathrm{W}$ mashoma.
p-280.actionItem: Nhasi, batidza solar calculator pasi pemwenje yemumba uye vhara panel yayo noruoko rwako kuti uone display ichiita rima.

p-281.title: Dark mode inochengetedza battery pamafoni eOLED
p-281.summary: Pixel imwe neimwe yeOLED inogadzira chiedza chayo, saka ma pixel matema anoshandisa simba shoma zvikuru. Kana background yerima yakawanda pascreen, simba redisplay rinoshandiswa rakaderera.
p-281.principle: Display power i huwandu hwema pixel ose $P=\sum_i P_i$, uye pixel dema ine $P_i\approx0$. LCD ine backlight inogara yakabatidzwa inoshandisa simba rinenge rakafanana pasinei nezvinoratidzwa, saka dark mode haibatsiri zvakanyanya imomo.
p-281.example: Tora kuti display power i $1.0\ \mathrm{W}$ pabackground chena uye $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ pabackground dema. Mumaawa 3 izvozvo zvinochengetedza $0.5\ \mathrm{W}\times3\ \mathrm{h}=1.5\ \mathrm{Wh}$, anenge $10\%$ yebattery ye $15\ \mathrm{Wh}$.
p-281.actionItem: Nhasi, kana foni yako ine OLED screen, batidza dark mode musettings. Pafoni yeLCD, dzikisa brightness panzvimbo.

p-282.title: Tyaira muguruva uine mwenje yakaderera nemwenje yeguruva
p-282.summary: Muguruva, high beams dzinodzoserwa nematundu emvura kudzokera kwauri uye dzinoita kuti kuona kuipe. Low beams nemwenje yeguruva, dzakatarisa pasi, dzinopa kuona kwakajeka.
p-282.principle: Matundu eguruva (anenge $1\sim20\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ mukufara) akaenzana newavelength yechiedza, saka Mie scattering inotumira chiedza zvakasimba kumativi ose, kusanganisira kudzokera kumutyairi. Chiedza chinodzikira se $I=I_0e^{-\beta x}$, uye chiedza chehigh-beam padyo nekukwirira kwemaziso chinodzoserwa semwenje unobvongodza.
p-282.example: MuKorea, kana kuona kuri mukati me $50\ \mathrm{m}$, muganhu wekukasira unofanira kudzikiswa nemashoma e $50\%$, saka mugwagwa we $100\ \mathrm{km/h}$ unova $50\ \mathrm{km/h}$ kana pasi.
p-282.actionItem: Kubva nhasi, mazuva eguruva batidza mwenje yakaderera nemwenje yeguruva, dzima high beams uye siya mukaha mukuru kumotokari iri pamberi.

p-283.title: Isa mwenje wekuverenga kudivi rinopesana neruoko rwaunyora naro
p-283.summary: Nokuti chiedza chinofamba nemitsetse yakananga, ruoko rwako nepeni zvinoita mumvuri pamusoro pemashoko. Mwenje uri kudivi rinopesana unokanda mumvuri uyu kumashure kweruoko saka maziso ako anoneta zvishoma.
p-283.principle: Kune point source pakukwirira $H$, chinhu chekukwirira $h$ pamusoro pekureba kwakatwasuka $d$ chinoita mumvuri unoenda $s=\frac{dh}{H-h}$ kumashure kwacho. Mwenje uri kudivi rimwe neruoko rwekunyora unoisa mumvuri uyu pamusoro pemashoko.
p-283.example: Nemwenje wekukwirira $H=40\ \mathrm{cm}$, ruoko rwekukwirira $h=3\ \mathrm{cm}$ uye kureba $d=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, mumvuri i $s=\frac{30\times3}{37}\approx2.4\ \mathrm{cm}$. Chiedza chekuverenga che $300\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$ chakajairika.
p-283.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchishandisa ruoko rwerudyi, isa mwenje wedesiki kumberi kuruboshwe; kana uchishandisa ruboshwe, kumberi kurudyi.

p-284.title: Kwira makomo akatsetseka nezigzag
p-284.summary: Pakukwira kwakaenzana basa rakaenzana, asi kutora nzira yakarereka kunodzikisa simba pachikamu chimwe nechimwe saka hauneti zvakanyanya. Chikamu chakaipa ndechekuti kufamba kwakareba.
p-284.principle: Pamupata basa i $W=mgh$ pasinei nenzira, asi simba mukati memupata i $F=mg\sin\theta=mg\frac{h}{L}$, rinodzika kana kureba kwenzira $L$ kuchikura.
p-284.example: Munhu we $70\ \mathrm{kg}$ achikwira $100\ \mathrm{m}$ anoita $W\approx69\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Kukwira kwakananga kwe $30^\circ$ kunoda $F\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ pamusoro pe $200\ \mathrm{m}$; zigzag ye $15^\circ$ inoda $F\approx178\ \mathrm{N}$ pamusoro pe anenge $386\ \mathrm{m}$.
p-284.actionItem: Nhasi, pachikamu chakatsetseka, tevera switchbacks dzenzira yakatarwa uye usacheke zvakananga pakati padzo.

p-285.title: Matayi echando anogara akapfava pasi pe 7°C
p-285.summary: Rabha inoomarara mukutonhora uye inorasikirwa negrip, asi matayi echando anoshandisa compound inogara ichipfava pakutonhora kwakaderera. Kunyange pasina chando, anobatsira kana tembiricha iri padyo ne 7°C.
p-285.principle: Rabha inogara ine elasticity pamusoro peglass transition temperature $T_g$ yayo uye inoomarara padyo nayo. Friction i $F=\mu N$ uye stopping distance i $d=\frac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, saka $\mu$ yakaderera inowedzera kureba kwayo.
p-285.example: Pa $80\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ($22.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$), $\mu=0.8$ inopa anenge $31\ \mathrm{m}$, nepo tayi rakaomeswa nekutonhora rine $\mu=0.6$ rinoda anenge $42\ \mathrm{m}$. Nhamba idzi ndedzekufungidzira kuratidza.
p-285.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa mamiriro ekunze kuti uone kana tembiricha dzepasi dzichigara padyo ne 7°C uye uronge nguva yekushandura matayi echando.

p-286.title: Mwenje wemuhwara unonzwa infrared inobva pakupisa kwemuviri
p-286.summary: Mwenje une motion sensor unobatidzwa kana uchiona shanduko dze infrared radiation inoburitswa nemuviri wako paunofamba. Kubatidza kana zvichidikanwa chete kunodzikisa zvakanyanya simba remwenje yemuhwara.
p-286.principle: Peak radiation wavelength inotevera mutemo waWien $\lambda_{\max}=\frac{b}{T}$ ne $b\approx2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Kune ganda pa anenge $33\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($306\ \mathrm{K}$), $\lambda_{\max}\approx9.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$, uye PIR sensor inocherechedza shanduko dze infrared iyi.
p-286.example: LED ye $10\ \mathrm{W}$ yemuhwara yakasiiwa yakabatidzwa maawa 24 inoshandisa $240\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Nesensor inoibatidza maawa 2 pazuva uye inoshandisa $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ yekumirira, huwandu ihuwu $20+12=32\ \mathrm{Wh}$, anenge $87\%$ shoma.
p-286.actionItem: Nhasi, tsiva mwenje wemuhwara kana wesuo newemotion sensor, kana gadzira nguva yawo yekubatidzwa kuita maminitsi 1 kusvika 2.

p-287.title: Vhara musuo wemakamuri asingashandiswi kuderedza vhoriyamu yaunodziisa
p-287.summary: Mweya shoma nenzvimbo yemadziro yekudziisa zvinoreva kupisa kushoma patembiricha imwe chete. Asi usavhara kamuri zvachose, nokuti condensation inogona kuumba; chengeta tembiricha yakaderera.
p-287.principle: Kupisa kwekudziisa mweya i $Q=mc\Delta T$ ne $m=\rho V$, saka kunoenderana nevhoriyamu $V$ inodziiswa. Mweya une $\rho\approx1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ne $c\approx1005\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
p-287.example: Kukwidziridza mweya mukamuri isina chinhu ye $25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ne $5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kunotora $Q=1.2\times25\times1005\times5\approx151\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.04\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Kuwedzera madziro, mafenicha nekuyerera kunoenderera, nhamba chaiyo inoita ka kakawanda.
p-287.actionItem: Nhasi, vhara musuo wekamuri isingashandiswi uye dzikisa heating valve yayo kusvika pashoma panzvimbo yekuidzima zvachose.

p-288.title: Mwenje inopenya yemotokari dzinouya: tarisa kumucheto wemugwagwa wekurudyi
p-288.summary: Kure kwekutarisa kwako kubva kuchiedza, chiedza chishoma chakapararira mukati memaziso chinovharira kuona kwako. Kutarisa kumucheto wemugwagwa wekurudyi kunodzikisa kupenya uye kuchiratidza mugwagwa.
p-288.principle: Veiling luminance kubva pachiedza chakapararira mumaziso i anenge $L_v\approx\frac{10E}{\theta^2}$, apo $E$ i illuminance pamaziso ($\mathrm{lux}$) uye $\theta$ i angle pakati pechiedza nekutarisa kwako ($^\circ$).
p-288.example: Kutarisa kwe $5^\circ$ kubva pachiedza kunopa $L_v\propto1/25$, uye $10^\circ$ kunopa $1/100$, saka veiling luminance inodzika ku $1/4$. Pupil yako inodzikira muchiedza chakajeka zvakare, izvo zvinobatsira zvakare.
p-288.actionItem: Manheru ano, kana ukasangana nehigh beams dzinouya, usavhara maziso; tarisa kumutsetse wekurudyi wemugwagwa uye dzikisa kukasira.

p-289.title: Chikonzero nei screen inobatidzwa mukamuri yerima ichiguta maziso
p-289.summary: Mukamuri yerima ma pupil ako akafara nepo screen yakajeka zvikuru, saka maziso ako anoramba achigadziridza kumusiyano wechiedza. Kubatidza zvakapoterera zvinyoro kunoderedza musiyano uye kunorerutsa kuneta.
p-289.principle: Pupil area i $A=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}$ ne diameter inosiyana kubva pa anenge $2\sim8\ \mathrm{mm}$, uye retinal illuminance inoenderana ne $E_r\propto L\,A$. Reshiyo huru yeluminance pakati pescreen nezvakapoterera inomanikidza kugadzirisa zvakare nguva dzose.
p-289.example: Kubva pa pupil ye $2\ \mathrm{mm}$ kusvika ye $8\ \mathrm{mm}$ kunowanza nzvimbo ka 16. Nezvakapoterera zviri pa $0.5\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$ uye screen pa $200\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, reshiyo i $400:1$, kupfuura zvakanyanya $3:1\sim10:1$ inoratidzwa kazhinji.
p-289.actionItem: Manheru ano, kana uchishandisa screen, batidza bias light kumashure kwayo kana mwenje mudiki wedesiki kubatidza kamuri zvinyoro.

p-290.title: Mutsetse wekuchengetedza wepaplatform uripo nekuda kwemhepo yenjanji
p-290.summary: Njanji inokasira inowedzera kukasira kwemweya padivi payo uye inodzikisa pressure yawo, izvo zvinogona kudhonza munhu kunjanji. Kumira kuseri kwemutsetse wekuchengetedza ndiko kudzivirira kwakasimba zvikuru.
p-290.principle: Maererano nemutemo waBernoulli, $p+\frac12\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$, kukasira kwemweya $v$ kukuru kunoreva pressure $p$ yakaderera. Kudzika kwepressure i $\Delta p=\frac12\rho v^2$.
p-290.example: Kana mweya padivi penjanji uchiyerera pa $10\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\Delta p=0.5\times1.2\times10^2=60\ \mathrm{Pa}$, zvichipa simba rinenge $F\approx36\ \mathrm{N}$ (anenge $3.7\ \mathrm{kgf}$) panzvimbo yedivi remuviri ye $0.6\ \mathrm{m^2}$. Turbulence inoita kuti nhamba chaiyo ichichinja.
p-290.actionItem: Nhasi, kana njanji ichisvika paplatform, tora nhanho imwe yekumashure kuseri kwemutsetse wekuchengetedza.

p-291.title: Mapani ebhekai matema anobika nekukasira
p-291.summary: Pani dema rinotora kupisa kwakawanda kweoven, nepo pani rinopenya resirivha richidzoserera zvakawanda. Recipe imwe chete inoita brown pasi nekukasira mupani dema.
p-291.principle: Pamusoro inotora radiant energy zvichienderana ne absorptivity yayo (yakaenzana ne emissivity) $\varepsilon$, uye simba rinoburitswa i $P=\varepsilon\sigma AT^4$. Pamusoro dema pane $\varepsilon\approx0.95$ uye aluminium yakapukunyiswa anenge $0.1$.
p-291.example: Munzvimbo imwe chete ye radiant, pani dema rinotora anenge $0.95/0.1\approx9$ nguva kupisa kuri radiant kupfuura resirivha rakapukunyiswa. Ndosaka ma recipe achiwanzokurudzira kudzikisa oven nenge $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kumapani matema.
p-291.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchibika mupani dema, dzikisa oven ne $10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ uye utarise browning nekukurumidza.

p-292.title: Thermostat yeelectric blanket i bimetal strip
p-292.summary: Chidimbu chitete chakagadzirwa nesimbi mbiri dzakabatanidzwa chinokotama kana chapiswa uye chinovhura kana kuvhara electrical contact. Izvozvo zvinoita thermostat nyore inocheka simba patembiricha yakatarwa.
p-292.principle: Linear expansion i $\Delta L=\alpha L\Delta T$. Nokuti simbi mbiri dzinosiyana mu expansion coefficient ne $\Delta\alpha$, chidimbu chinokotama, uye muromo wacho unofamba $\delta=\frac{3\Delta\alpha\Delta T L^2}{4t}$ ($t$: kukora kwose).
p-292.example: Ne $L=50\ \mathrm{mm}$, $t=1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta\alpha=7\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$ ne $\Delta T=40\ \mathrm{K}$, muromo unofamba $\delta\approx0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$, zvakakwana kuparadzanisa contact.
p-292.actionItem: Nhasi, shandisa electric blanket yakatambanudzwa pasi, isingakurwi kana kuunganidzwa, uye gadzika pamwero wakaderera wekurara.

p-293.title: Kupisa padyo ne thermostat yeboiler kunonyengera heating yako
p-293.summary: Thermostat inoyera tembiricha pachinzvimbo chayakasungirirwa chete kuti ibatidze nekudzima boiler. Heater kana zuva padyo nayo rinosiya imba yose yakatonhora kupfuura zvakagadzirwa, nepo madziro anotonhora padyo nayo achikonzera kupisa kwakanyanya.
p-293.principle: Thermostat inoshanda chete kana tembiricha pasensor yayo, $T_{\mathrm{sensor}}$, iri pasi peasetpoint $T_{\mathrm{set}}$. Saka ne room average $T_{\mathrm{room}}=T_{\mathrm{sensor}}+\epsilon$, placement error $\epsilon$ ndiyo heating error.
p-293.example: Kana kupisa padyo kuchiita kuti sensor iverenge $23\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ apo imba ine average ye $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, boiler inodzima kunyange pasetpoint ye $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ uye imba i $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ inotonhora. Mune zvakapesana, $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ yekupisa kwakanyanya inokwidziridza mari yeheating nenge $14\%$ (mutemo wakatenderedza we anenge $7\%$ pa 1°C).
p-293.actionItem: Nhasi, bvisa maheater emagetsi, ma TV nezvimwe zvinopisa kana mafenicha kubva padyo ne thermostat.

p-294.title: Kupesanisa polarity paspika imwe kunoita kuti bass inyangarike
p-294.summary: Kana + ne − yespika imwe yakachinjwa, maspika maviri anorira mu phase inopesana uye bass ine wavelength refu inozvicheka. Kana ruzha rwakaonda uye imaging yakashata, tarisa polarity kutanga.
p-294.principle: Mafungu maviri anosiyana mu phase ne $\pi$ anoita destructive interference uye huwandu hwawo hunoderera. Kana wavelength $\lambda=\frac{v}{f}$ iri refu zvakanyanya kupfuura kureba pakati pemaspika, kuzvicheka kunenge kwakakwana pamberi nepamberi.
p-294.example: Pa $100\ \mathrm{Hz}$, $\lambda=343/100=3.4\ \mathrm{m}$, refu kupfuura kureba kwemaspika kwe $2\ \mathrm{m}$, saka level inodzika zvakanyanya padyo nepakati. Pa $5\ \mathrm{kHz}$, $\lambda\approx6.9\ \mathrm{cm}$, saka kufamba mashoma e cm kunokwidziridza nekudzikisa level; mhedzisiro i bass inoshaikwa.
p-294.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti maspika ose maviri anobatanidza + (tsvuku) ku + terminal uye − (dema) ku − terminal nenzira imwe chete.

p-295.title: Knee push-ups dzinopfupisa lever yemuviri
p-295.summary: Kuzorora pamabvi kunopfupisa lever, saka maoko ako anotakura mutoro mushoma. Kana push-ups dzakajairika dziri nyore, kutanga neknee push-ups nechimiro chakanaka kwakanaka.
p-295.principle: Kutora muviri selever, torque balance $F_{\mathrm{hand}}\,L=mg\,d$ inopa simba reruoko $F_{\mathrm{hand}}=mg\frac{d}{L}$. Kufambisa pivot kubva kumunwe wetsoka kuenda kumabvi kunochinja $L$ ne $d$ uye kunodzikisa chikamu chemutoro.
p-295.example: Zvidzidzo zvinoratidza mitoro yemaoko inenge $64\%$ yehuremu hwemuviri mupush-ups dzakajairika uye inenge $49\%$ mu knee push-ups. Kune $70\ \mathrm{kg}$, ndiyo anenge $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ versus $34\ \mathrm{kg}$, anenge $23\%$ kureruka.
p-295.actionItem: Nhasi, edza seti 2 dze knee push-ups 8, uchichengeta musoro, chiuno nemabvi mumutsetse wakananga. Mira kana paine chinorwadza.

p-296.title: Tsvaga kumaodzanyemba newachi ye analog nezuva
p-296.summary: Tarisa hour hand kuzuva, uye nzira iri pakati pe hour hand ne 12 o'clock inenge kumaodzanyemba. Iyi nzira yakatenderedza isina compass yeNorthern Hemisphere.
p-296.principle: Zuva rinofamba $\omega_\odot=15^\circ$ paawa nepo hour hand ichifamba $\omega_h=30^\circ$ paawa. Reshiyo $\frac{\omega_\odot}{\omega_h}=\frac12$ ndicho chikonzero bisector ichitarisa kumaodzanyemba.
p-296.example: Pa 4 p.m., tarisa hour hand (iri pa $120^\circ$ kubva pa 12) kuzuva, uye nzira iri pakati, $2$ o'clock, i kumaodzanyemba. Standard meridian yeKorea ($135^\circ$ E) yakasiyana neSeoul (anenge $127^\circ$ E), saka solar time yakarasika nenge maminitsi $30$ uye kukanganisa kunenge $\pm15^\circ$.
p-296.actionItem: Nhasi, pazuva rakajeka kunze, fungidzira kumaodzanyemba newachi ye analog uye uenzanise ne compass yefoni yako.

p-297.title: Magnifier ine dioptre yakakwira ine focal length pfupi
p-297.summary: Simba remagnifier ndiro reciprocal yefocal length, saka nhamba huru inoreva focus pfupi uye magnification yakawanda. Lens yakasimba, kuona kwakatetepa uye inofanira kubatwa padyo nemaziso nechinhu.
p-297.principle: Lens power i $D=\frac{1}{f}$ ($f$ mu m, $D$ mu dioptres), uye angular magnification yemaziso e near point ye $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ i $M\approx\frac{25\ \mathrm{cm}}{f}=\frac{D}{4}$.
p-297.example: $5\ \mathrm{D}$ inoreva $f=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ uye anenge $1.25\times$; $10\ \mathrm{D}$ inoreva $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ uye anenge $2.5\times$; $20\ \mathrm{D}$ inoreva $f=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ uye anenge $5\times$.
p-297.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchisarudza magnifier, sarudza simba rinoenderana nekushandisa kwako, uye usambochisiya muzuva, nokuti chinogona kutarisa zuva ichiparadza moto.

p-298.title: Heat-recovery ventilation inodzosa kupisa kunobuda
p-298.summary: Chishandiso ichi chinopfuudza kupisa kubva kumweya wemukati unobuda kuenda kumweya unotonhora unopinda. Unoshandura mweya uchichengeta kupisa kwakawanda.
p-298.principle: Recovery efficiency i $\eta=\frac{T_{\mathrm{supply}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}{T_{\mathrm{in}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}$, uye ventilation heat loss i $P=\rho c\,\dot V\,\Delta T$ ($\rho c\approx1200\ \mathrm{J/(m^3\cdot K)}$).
p-298.example: Ne $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ mukati, $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kunze uye $150\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$ yekuyerera kwemweya, kurasikirwa i $1200\times\frac{150}{3600}\times22\approx1100\ \mathrm{W}$. Pa $\eta=70\%$ inodzika kusvika pa anenge $330\ \mathrm{W}$ uye supply air inosvika pa anenge $15.4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-298.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uine heat-recovery ventilator, chenesa filter yayo pakati penguva yakanyorwa mumanyuaru ayo.

p-299.title: Rug yepasi inowedzera imwe layer yethermal resistance
p-299.summary: Rug inowedzera layer inodzivirira pakati pepasi netsoka dzako. Pasi rinopisa, asi, rug yakakora inovharirawo kupisa kuenda mukamuri, saka sarudza yakatetepa.
p-299.principle: Kumalayers akatevedzana, thermal resistance i $R=\sum\frac{L_i}{k_i}$ uye heat flux i $q=\frac{\Delta T}{R}$. Kuwedzera layer kunokwidziridza $R$ uye kunodzikisa $q$.
p-299.example: Rug ye $1\ \mathrm{cm}$ kukora ne $k\approx0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ine $R=0.2\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Kana pasi pane $R=0.5$ ne $\Delta T=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, flux inodzika $q=20\to14.3\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, anenge $29\%$ shoma.
p-299.actionItem: Nhasi, isa rug pawakagara kana kumira pamusoro pepasi rinotonhora, uye sarudza yakatetepa kana kamuri ine floor heating.

p-300.title: Kana musuo uchinyura, simbisa zvikero zvehinge yepamusoro kutanga
p-300.summary: Huremu hwemusuo hunodhonza hinge yepamusoro uye hunodzvanya yepasi, saka zvikero zvepamusoro zvinopera simba kutanga. Kusimbisa zvikero zvehinge yepamusoro chete kazhinji kunogadzirisa kunyura.
p-300.principle: Musuo wakagadzikana uri mu torque balance, $\sum\tau=0$. Nehuremu $W$ hunoshanda pakati pemusuo ($\frac{w}{2}$ kubva kumahinge) uye kureba kwemahinge $h$, simba rakatwasuka i $F=\frac{W\,w/2}{h}$.
p-300.example: Kumusuo we $20\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($W\approx196\ \mathrm{N}$), $0.9\ \mathrm{m}$ mukufara une mahinge akaparadzana ne $1.6\ \mathrm{m}$, $F=\frac{196\times0.45}{1.6}\approx55\ \mathrm{N}$ inodhonza hinge yepamusoro uye inodzvanya yepasi.
p-300.actionItem: Nhasi, musuo uri wakavhurika, simbisa zvikero zvehinge yepamusoro nePhillips screwdriver; zadza gomba rakaparara netoothpicks negum yematanda, wobva wasimbisa zvakare.

p-301.title: Kana uchimuka pachigaro, rereka muviri wepamusoro mberi kutanga
p-301.summary: Wakagara, center of mass yako iri kuseri kwetsoka dzako, saka kurereka mberi kuiunza pamusoro petsoka kunoita kuti kumira kuve nyore uye kwakagadzikana.
p-301.principle: Kuti umire, vertical projection ye center of mass (COM) inofanira kuwira mukati menzvimbo inotsigirwa netsoka dzako. Kana COM iri pakureba kwakatwasuka $x$ kubva patsoka, torque yegravity i $\tau=mg\,x$.
p-301.example: Kana COM yawakagara iri anenge $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ kuseri kwetsoka, kurereka muviri wepamusoro mberi nenge $30^\circ$ kunofambisa COM anenge $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ mberi uye kunobvisa zvakawanda ze $x$ (nhamba dzakatenderedza).
p-301.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchimuka pachigaro, rereka mhino yako kumunwe wetsoka, dhonza tsoka dzako padyo nechigaro, wobva wamuka. Kana kutenderera musoro kuchienderera, taura nemunhu ane unyanzvi.

p-302.title: Husiku hwechando, kukwirira kwePolaris kunoenzana ne latitude yako
p-302.summary: Polaris iri padyo ne north celestial pole, saka kukwirira kwayo pamusoro pe horizon kunenge kwakaenzana ne latitude yemutariri. Nyeredzi imwe inokubvumira kufungidzira latitude yako.
p-302.principle: Kukwirira kwe north celestial pole kwakaenzana ne latitude yemutariri $\varphi$, uye Polaris iri anenge $0.7^\circ$ kubva papole, saka $h_{\mathrm{Polaris}}\approx\varphi$.
p-302.example: MuSeoul (anenge $37.5^\circ$ N) Polaris iri anenge $37.5^\circ$ pamusoro pe horizon, uye muJeju (anenge $33.5^\circ$ N) anenge $33.5^\circ$. Ruoko rwakasungwa rwakatambanudzwa i anenge $10^\circ$, saka Polaris yeSeoul iri pakukwirira kwemaoko akasungwa anenge 3.75.
p-302.actionItem: Manheru ano, kana denga rakajeka, tsvaga Polaris uchishandisa Big Dipper kana W yeCassiopeia uye uyere kukwirira kwayo neruoko rwako rwakasungwa.

p-303.title: Chikonzero nei anti-reflective coatings dzemagirazi ezvikwiriro dzichiratidzika sebhuruu
p-303.summary: Anti-reflective coating i firimu rakatetepa zvikuru rinoita kuti mafungu echiedza anodzoserwa azvicheke. Rakagadziridzwa kumawavelength epakati egirinhi, saka bhuruu netsvuku zvishoma zvinosara zvichiita ruvara pakudzoserwa.
p-303.principle: Kana kukora kwefirimu $d$ kuri $\frac{\lambda}{4n}$, kudzoserwa kubva kumusoro nepasi pacho kunosiyana nenzira ye $\frac{\lambda}{2}$ uye kunozvicheka. Ideal film index i $n_c=\sqrt{n_s}$.
p-303.example: Firimu re $\mathrm{MgF_2}$ ($n=1.38$) pa $\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$ rinoda $d=\frac{550}{4\times1.38}\approx100\ \mathrm{nm}$. Girazi risina coating rinodzosera anenge $4\%$ papamusoro mumwe nemumwe; coating inoderedza kusvika pasi pe $1\%$.
p-303.actionItem: Nhasi, chenesa magirazi ako nelens cleaner nemicrofiber cloth, uye dzivisa kukwesha kwakaoma kana mvura inopisa.

p-304.title: Cable yakatetepa yekuchaja inochaja zvishoma nezvishoma
p-304.summary: Waya yakatetepa ine resistance yakakwira, saka voltage inodzika mucable uye simba rimwe rinorasika sekupisa. Necharger imwe chete, cable yakakora inotakura current yakawanda.
p-304.principle: Voltage drop i $V=IR$ uye wire resistance i $R=\frac{\rho L}{A}$. Simba rinorasika sekupisa mucable i $P=I^2R$.
p-304.example: Kuchaja kwe $2\ \mathrm{A}$ pamusoro pe $2\ \mathrm{m}$ yekuenda nekudzoka kwemhangura ($\rho=1.7\times10^{-8}\ \Omega\mathrm{m}$), waya ye $0.08\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (28 AWG) ine $R\approx0.42\ \Omega$, ichidzika $0.84\ \mathrm{V}$ uye ichirasikirwa ne $1.7\ \mathrm{W}$. Waya ye $0.2\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (24 AWG) ine $0.17\ \Omega$, $0.34\ \mathrm{V}$ ne $0.7\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-304.actionItem: Nhasi, tsiva cable yakatetepa inononoka kana inopisa neyakakora inotaura rated current yayo.

p-305.title: Kimchi fridge inovhurika kumusoro inoburitsa mweya unotonhora shoma kana yavhurwa
p-305.summary: Mweya unotonhora unorema uye unodzika, uchiunganidza pasi. Chivharo chekumusoro chinochengeta mweya unotonhora uyu mutub, saka mushoma unobuda kana uchichivhura.
p-305.principle: Air density i $\rho=\frac{p}{R_sT}$, hukuru patembiricha yakaderera. Buoyant force kubva pamusiyano wedensity i $\Delta\rho\,g\,V$, saka mweya unotonhora unogara zvakagadzikana pasi.
p-305.example: Mweya une $4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ i anenge $1.27\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ uye pa $25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ anenge $1.18\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, anenge $7\%$ unorema. Fiziji ine musuo padivi inobvumira mweya unotonhora unorema uyu kubuda nemusuo wakavhurika.
p-305.actionItem: Nhasi, sarudza pakare zvichabviswa mukimchi fridge uye vhura chivharo kamwe, nekukasira.

p-306.title: Isa tsvimbo yemuti pamusoro pepoto inobira
p-306.summary: Kana mapundu achisvika patsvimbo ugoputika, kubira kunonoka kazhinji. Asi hazvisi kugadzirisa kwakazara, saka kudzikisa moto uchitarisa ndiko kwakakosha.
p-306.principle: Musiyano wekumanikidza wechidimbu chimwe chebubble ndiwo equation yaLaplace $\Delta p=\frac{2\gamma}{r}$ ($\gamma$: surface tension, $r$: radius yekukombama). Kana firimu rebubble rikasangana nepamusoro pemuti une makwai, rinotetepa ndokuputika.
p-306.example: Mvura ye$100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ine $\gamma\approx0.059\ \mathrm{N/m}$, bubble ye radius $1\ \mathrm{mm}$ ndi$\Delta p=\frac{2\times0.059}{0.001}\approx118\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Mvura yemupunga ne pasta ine starch yakawanda ine mapundu akasimba.
p-306.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika noodles isa tsvimbo yemuti yakaoma yakadambuka pamuromo wepoto uye uise moto pakati nepasi. Tsvimbo irege kubata moto.

p-307.title: Pamhepo ye1 m/s yega yega, kutonhora kunonzwika kunodzika nenge 1°C
p-307.summary: Kana mhepo ichivhuvhuta, mhepo inodziya padyo nehuro inobviswa saka unonzwa kutonhora kunyange pakupisa kwakafanana. Muchando sarudza zvipfeko uchitarisa mhepo pamwe chete nekupisa.
p-307.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa nekufamba kwakamanikidzwa ndi$q=h(v)\,A\,(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}})$ uye mhepo $v$ inowedzera $h$ inowedzera. Wind chill index ndi$T_{wc}=13.12+0.6215T-11.37v^{0.16}+0.3965Tv^{0.16}$ ($v$: $\mathrm{km/h}$).
p-307.example: Pa$0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ mhepo $1.4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($5\ \mathrm{km/h}$) inenge $-1.6\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($18\ \mathrm{km/h}$) inenge $-4.9\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, saka pakuwedzera kwemhepo kwe$3.6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ kunodzika $3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-307.actionItem: Nhasi pazuva rinemhepo zvikuru, vhara ganda rakashama nejasi rinodzivirira mhepo nechitambaro chehuro.

p-308.title: Mhete yemwedzi inogona kuratidza mvura iri kuuya
p-308.summary: Mhete yemwedzi imhete inoitika nekubvarura kweshoko remwedzi nemakristaro echando mumakore epamusoro. Makore akadaro anowanzoonekwa kana front ichiswedera, saka mukana wemvura unokwira asi hazvisi zvechokwadi.
p-308.principle: Minimum deviation angle yeprism yechando chehexagon ndi$D_{\min}=2\arcsin\left(n\sin30^\circ\right)-60^\circ$. Kana chando $n\approx1.31$, $D_{\min}\approx22^\circ$ uye mhete ye$22^\circ$ inoitika kutenderedza mwedzi.
p-308.example: Pa$n=1.31$ ndi$\arcsin(0.655)\approx40.9^\circ$ saka ndi$D_{\min}\approx2\times40.9-60\approx21.8^\circ$. Kana ukatambanudza ruoko, kufara kweruoko kunenge $20^\circ$, saka kubva kumwedzi kusvika kumhete kunenge sekufara kweruoko rumwe.
p-308.actionItem: Kana usiku humwa uchiona mhete yemwedzi, tarisa kufanotaura kwemamiriro ekunze mangwana woisa jira repvura mubhegi.

p-309.title: 9H pafirimu regirazi rakasimbiswa ihardness yepenzura
p-309.summary: 9H zvinoreva kuti kunyange nepenzura yakaoma kwazvo haipi mavara, haisi Mohs hardness 9. Guruva reredenga rakaoma kupfuura uye rinogona kukweshera.
p-309.principle: Pamusoro pacho pakwesherwa kana chidimbu chakaoma kupfuura pamusoro $H_{\mathrm{particle}}>H_{\mathrm{surface}}$. Chiyero chehardness yepenzura neMohs hardness zvakasiyana.
p-309.example: Quartz (chinhu chikuru chejecha) ine Mohs hardness $7$ iri yakaoma kupfuura girazi (anenge $5.5\sim6$). Kunyange firimu re9H, kana riri pasi peMohs 7, rinogona kukweshwa neguruva rejecha.
p-309.actionItem: Nhasi isa foni yako mumhomwe isiri yemakiyi nemari uye zunza guruva rejecha rinenge riri mumhomwe.

p-310.title: Muchando vhura makurtini ezuva pahwindo rinotarisa kumaodzanyemba kuti uwane zuva
p-310.summary: Muchando kunyange zuva riri pasi, hwindo rinotarisa kumaodzanyemba rinowana chiedza zvakanyanya zvakananga uye kupisa kwakawanda. Kuvhura makurtini masikati uye kuvhara kana zuva ratsvaira ndiko kupisa kwemahara.
p-310.principle: Kuwedzera kupisa kwezuva kwehwindo ndi$Q=A\,I\,\mathrm{SHGC}\cos\theta$ ($I$: simba rezuva, SHGC: solar heat gain coefficient, $\theta$: angle yekupinda). Muchando hwindo rakatwasuka rekumaodzanyemba rine angle diki yekupinda saka kupfuura kuri kukuru.
p-310.example: Hwindo $2\ \mathrm{m^2}$, simba rezuva pamasikati akajeka $I\approx500\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, $\mathrm{SHGC}=0.6$ ndi$600\ \mathrm{W}$. Kana tikafunga avhareji $400\ \mathrm{W}$ yemaawa 4, unowana anenge $1.6\ \mathrm{kWh}$ (kukosha kwekufungidzira) kwekupisa.
p-310.actionItem: Nhasi pamasikati akajeka vhura makurtini nema blinds ehwindo rekumaodzanyemba, uye uvhare usati wasvika manheru kuti udzikise kurasikirwa kwekupisa usiku.

p-311.title: Musuwo wemukati wepamberi ndiyo nzvimbo yekudzivirira mhepo
p-311.summary: Nzvimbo diki iri pakati pemusuwo wepamberi nemusuwo wemukati inoita buffer, ichidzivirira mhepo inotonhora kuti isapinda mumba pakarepo. Chakakosha ndechokusavhura misuwo yose miviri panguva imwe.
p-311.principle: Kuchinjana kwemhepo kuburikidza nemusuwo wakavhurika kunoitika nekufamba uye kurasikirwa kwekupisa ndi$Q=\rho cV\Delta T$ ($V$: volume yemhepo inochinjana). Musuwo wemukati unodzikisa volume yekuchinjana kusvika kunenge nzvimbo yepamberi.
p-311.example: Kana $3\ \mathrm{m^3}$ yepamberi ichichinjana nemusiyano we$20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ndi$Q=1.2\times1005\times3\times20\approx72\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.02\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Kana pasina musuwo wemukati uye kamuri re$60\ \mathrm{m^3}$ rikabatwawo, mwero mukuru ndi$0.4\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
p-311.actionItem: Nhasi paunodzoka kumba vhara musuwo wepamberi kutanga wobva wavhura musuwo wemukati, uye paunobuda vhara musuwo wemukati wobva wavhura wepamberi.

p-312.title: Kuvira kwepamusoro chete muovheni kunokonzerwa nenzvimbo yerack
p-312.summary: Kana wava padyo neheater yepamusoro, kubwinya kunosimba nokukurumidza uye pamusoro pachabva pawanikwa. Kudzikisa rack nechikamu chimwe kunobika pamusoro napasi zvakaenzana.
p-312.principle: Pa point source approximation simba rekubwinya ndi$I=\frac{P}{4\pi r^2}$, rinopesana nesquare yeudiki. Heater chaiyo isurface source saka shanduko yakanyanyisa kunyorera, asi padhuze simba rinowedzera.
p-312.example: Kuti zvive nyore, rack ye$5\ \mathrm{cm}$ kubva kuheater iri $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ yakabwinya kaviri kupfuura rack ye$(10/5)^2=4$. Chaizvo ndeheater yepasi saka 2–3 nguva.
p-312.actionItem: Nhasi kana pamusoro pavira kutanga, dzikisa rack nechikamu chimwe, uye kana zvichidiwa vhara pamusoro nefoil zvakasununguka.

p-313.title: Kupfeka masokisi maviri kunodzikisa mapundu emakumbo
p-313.summary: Mapundu anoitika nekukweshera kwerupi netsoka nesokisi, uye nemasokisi maviri kukweshera kunoitika pakati pemasokisi saka ganda rinodhonzwa zvishoma. Kana shangu dzakamanikidza zvikuru hazvibatsiri, saka siya nzvimbo.
p-313.principle: Simba rekukweshera ndi$F=\mu N$ uye shear stress yeganda ndi$\tau=\frac{F}{A}$. Kana coefficient yekukweshera pakati pezvidimbu iri diki kupfuura yeganda-sokisi, kutsvedza kunoitika pakati pezvidimbu uye kushushikana kweganda kunodzikira.
p-313.example: Pakufamba, tsoka rimwe $N\approx700\ \mathrm{N}$, nzvimbo yekubata $A\approx100\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ yakafungidzirwa, $\mu=0.5$ ndi$\tau\approx35\ \mathrm{kPa}$, pakati pezvidimbu $\mu=0.3$ ndi$\tau\approx21\ \mathrm{kPa}$, ndiko kudzikira kwe$40\%$ (kukosha kwekufungidzira).
p-313.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchizofamba kwenguva refu pfeka sokisi yakatetepa inotora dikita woisa imwe pamusoro, uye tarisa kuti shangu hadzina kuomarara.

p-314.title: Nei mafoto echando achibuda akasviba
p-314.summary: Auto exposure yekamera inoenzanisa avhareji yechiitiko kusvika pagrey yepakati, saka chando chichena chinoratidzwa segrey. Kana ukawedzera exposure, chando chinobuda chichena.
p-314.principle: Auto exposure inoenzanisa avhareji reflectance kusvika pa$18\%$ grey. Kana reflectance yechando iri $\rho$, kugadzirisa kunodiwa ndi$\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{\rho}{0.18}$.
p-314.example: Kana reflectance yechando $\rho\approx0.8$ ndi$\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{0.8}{0.18}\approx2.1$. Saka kazhinji kugadzirisa kwe$+1\sim+2\ \mathrm{EV}$ kunoitwa.
p-314.actionItem: Nhasi paunotora mifananidzo yechando, tinya pachando pasikirini woshandisa slider yekuvhenekera kusvika $+1\sim+2$.

p-315.title: Sarudza maambrella ane nzira dzemhepo
p-315.summary: Kana mhepo ichisundira pamusoro peambrella nesimba, kana jira repamusoro rine nzira dzekubudisa mhepo musiyano wekumanikidza unodzikira uye ambrella haipfidzirwi. Usashandise ambrella dzipi zvadzo mumhepo yakasimba.
p-315.principle: Drag force ndi$F_D=\frac12\rho C_DAv^2$ inoenderana nesquare yekumhanya kwemhepo. Kana mamiriro ekufambisa mhepo achidzikisa $C_D$ saka simba rinodzikirawo zvakaenzana.
p-315.example: Pamhepo $15\ \mathrm{m/s}$, dhayamita $100\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($A\approx0.79\ \mathrm{m^2}$), $C_D=1.2$ ndi$F_D\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$ (anenge $13\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Kana $C_D$ yadzika kusvika $0.9$ inenge $95\ \mathrm{N}$ inodzika ne$25\%$ (kukosha kwekufungidzira).
p-315.actionItem: Nhasi paunosarudza ambrella tarisa double canopy kana mamiriro ekufambisa mhepo uye kana ine fiberglass ribs.

p-316.title: Heater ye1 kW inopisa se1 kW
p-316.summary: Heater yemagetsi inoshandura magetsi ose anoshandiswa kuita kupisa. Saka magetsi anodiwa pakupisa kwakafanana anowanikwa chaizvo nekuwedzera simba nenguva.
p-316.principle: Kushanda kwekupisa nekuramba ndi$100\%$ uye simba rinoshandiswa ndi$E=Pt$. Heat pump (airconditioner yekupisa) ine coefficient of performance $\mathrm{COP}=\frac{Q}{W}$ inenge 3, kureva kuti kupisa kwakafanana kunogadzirwa ne$\frac13$ yemagetsi.
p-316.example: Heater ye$1\ \mathrm{kW}$ kwemaawa 3 inoshandisa $3\ \mathrm{kWh}$, uye kana tikafunga mutengo wemagetsi we$200$ won/kWh ndi$600$ won (anenge USD 0.45). Heat pump ye$\mathrm{COP}=3$ inoshandisa $1\ \mathrm{kWh}$, anenge $200$ won kupisa kwakafanana.
p-316.actionItem: Nhasi paunoshandisa heater tarisa rated capacity (W) woisa timer kuti ishande kwenguva inodiwa chete.

p-317.title: Gumbeze regumbo rinotsiva 1–2°C yekupisa
p-317.summary: Kutonhora kunonzwika kunokwira sezvo kupisa kunobuda mumuviri kuchidzikira, saka gumbeze regumbo rimwe rinoita sekuwedzera kupisa kwemukamuri ne1–2°C. Unogona kugara wakadziya kunyange kudzikisa kupisa zvishoma.
p-317.principle: Kurasikirwa kwekupisa ndi$q=\frac{T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}}}{R_{\mathrm{clo}}+R_{\mathrm{air}}}$, uye pakugara, mhando ye$1\ \mathrm{clo}$ ($0.155\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$) yezvipfeko inodzikisa tembiricha yekugadzikana nenge $5.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-317.example: Kana gumbeze regumbo riri $0.3\ \mathrm{clo}$ rinodzikisa tembiricha yekugadzikana nenge $1.7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kudzikisa kupisa ne$1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kunofungidzirwa kudzikisa mari yekupisa nenge $7\%$, saka $1.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ndi$10\%$.
p-317.actionItem: Nhasi dzikisa musetting wekupisa wekamuri rekugara ne1°C woisa gumbeze regumbo pasofa.

p-318.title: Foil mu microwave inopfira kubva pamuromo une pamuromo wakapinza
p-318.summary: Munzvimbo dzine meso akapinza esimbi munda wemagetsi unounganidzwa munzvimbo imwe uye mhepo inobvaruka ichiita mheni. Usaise foil, mabhaudhi ane muganhu wegoridhe kana zvishongedzo zvesimbi.
p-318.principle: Pamuromo une radius diki, munda wemagetsi unowedzera sa$E\approx\frac{V}{r}$. Mhepo inovharika kana ichisvika anenge $E_b\approx3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$ kuita corona/spark discharge.
p-318.example: Kana radius yemuromo wefoil $r=0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$ ine voltage $V=300\ \mathrm{V}$, ndi$E=\frac{300}{10^{-4}}=3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, ndiko kuparara kwekuvharika (kukosha kwekufungidzira). Foil yakapamhama yakakura iri shoma kupfuura muromo, asi ine njodzi.
p-318.actionItem: Nhasi usaise zvidziyo zvesimbi, foil kana mabhaudhi ane muganhu wegoridhe mu microwave. Kana pakatanga mheni, dzima pakarepo uye utore zvakatonhora.

p-319.title: Nei kugara padyo nehwindo rinotonhora kuchinzwika kutonhora kupfuura kupisa kwemukamuri
p-319.summary: Muviri unorasikirwa nekupisa nekubwinya kwete nemhepo chete asi nenzvimbo dzinotonhora dziri padyo. Padyo nehwindo kunyange mhepo yakafanana, nokuti pamusoro pari kutonhora unonzwa kutonhora kwakawanda.
p-319.principle: Kurasikirwa chaiko kwekupisa nekubwinya ndi$q=\varepsilon\sigma\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}^4-T_s^4\right)\approx h_r\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_s\right)$ uye padyo nekupisa kwemukamuri $h_r\approx5\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$.
p-319.example: Kana pamusoro pehembe $28\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, pamusoro pehwindo $8\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ndi$q\approx5\times20=100\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, uye kune madziro e$18\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ndi$50\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Kana nzvimbo yakatarisana $0.5\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ndiko kusiyana kwe$25\ \mathrm{W}$ (kukosha kwekufungidzira).
p-319.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchitonhorwa pachigaro chepahwindo, kure chigaro 1m kubva pahwindo kana vhara makurtini kana insulation sheet.

p-320.title: Mucamping yechando, isa tende pakati pegomo kwete mumupata
p-320.summary: Usiku hwakajeka husina mhepo, mhepo inotonhora inodzika uye inounganidzwa mumipata nezvidziyo. Pamusoro pegomo mhepo yakasimba, saka nzvimbo yakati sandara pakati pegomo isina mhepo zvakanyanya ndiyo yakanaka.
p-320.principle: Mhepo inotonhora inorema, saka inoyerera ichidzika nebuoyancy acceleration $a\approx g\frac{\Delta T}{T}$ ichiita matunhu emhepo inotonhora. Kupisa kunodzika nenge $0.65\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}/100\ \mathrm{m}$ pakukwira kwega kwega, asi mu night inversion zvinopesana.
p-320.example: Kana $\Delta T=5\ \mathrm{K}$ ne$T=278\ \mathrm{K}$, ndi$a\approx9.8\times\frac{5}{278}\approx0.18\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Usiku hwechando hwakajeka husina mhepo yakawanda, pasi pemupata panogona kutonhora $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dzakati wandei kupfuura pakati pegomo.
p-320.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchienda kucamping, dzivisa nzvimbo dzakadzika mukati menzvimbo yakagadzirwa ucampe woisa tende panzvimbo yakati sandara isina mhepo zvakanyanya.

p-321.title: Maheater emagetsi ekubwinya nekufamba anosiyana
p-321.summary: Heater yekubwinya inopisa vanhu nezvinhu zvakananga saka inopisa nekukurumidza, yekufamba inopisa mhepo ichidziisa kamuri rose zvishoma nezvishoma. Sarudza zvinoenderana nenzvimbo.
p-321.principle: Kubwinya ndi$q=\varepsilon\sigma(T_h^4-T_s^4)A$ kunoendesa kupisa pamusoro pasina mhepo, uye kufamba ndi$q=hA\,\Delta T$ kunofambisa kupisa nemhepo inopisa inotenderera.
p-321.example: Heater yekubwinya ye1 kW inopisa ganda pa1 m pakarepo, asi yekufamba inoda $Q=mc\Delta T\approx0.18\ \mathrm{MJ}$ chete kudziisa mhepo yekamuri re30 m³ (mhepo anenge 36kg) nepa5°C, uye kudziisa madziro nemafenicha kunotora nguva refu zvikuru.
p-321.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchida kutenga heater, tanga wasarudza kushandiswa: yekubwinya yenzvimbo imwe sepadhesiki, yekufamba yekamuri rose.

p-322.title: Pamotokari yemagetsi muchando shandisa chigaro chinopisa panzvimbo yemhepo
p-322.summary: Motokari yemagetsi inoshandisa bhatiri rakawanda mu heater yemhepo yemukati, saka kudziisa muviri nechigaro chinopisa nesitiringi uye kudzikisa setting yemukati kunochengeta range.
p-322.principle: Kana ukapisa kubata muviri zvakananga, kupisa kunodiwa kuri kushoma zvikuru. Kudziisa mhepo kunoda $Q=mc\Delta T$ pamwe nekuramba uchizadza kurasikirwa kunobuda nemuviri negirazi.
p-322.example: Panzvimbo ye heater yemukati ye3 kW, kana ukadzikisa setting woshandisa chigaro chinopisa che60 W, unochengeta anenge 1.4kWh pawa, uye nemotokari ye6 km/kWh ndiko anenge 8km yerange.
p-322.actionItem: Nhasi pakutyaira tanga wavhura chigaro chinopisa nesitiringi wozodzikisa setting yekupisa kwemukati ne1–2°C.

p-323.title: Muchando heater imafuta anoparara enjini saka zvinenge zvisina mutengo
p-323.summary: Heater yemotokari yemafuta inoshandisa kupisa kwenjini kunoparara kunounganidzwa mumvura inotonhodza, saka kunyange wakaivhura mafuta haawedzere. Mafuta anoshandiswa na compressor yeairconditioner (A/C).
p-323.principle: Anenge 60% yesimba remafuta rinoparara sekupisa ($Q_\mathrm{waste}\approx 0.6\,Q_\mathrm{fuel}$), uye heater core inodzosera chikamu chaizvozvo mukati. A/C compressor inotora $W$ yakawedzerwa kubva kunjini.
p-323.example: Kupisa kunoshandiswa neheater kunenge 2–4kW, chikamu chidiki chekupisa kwenjini inoparara pakufamba, asi A/C compressor inotora anenge 1–3kW yakawedzerwa kubva kusimba renjini.
p-323.actionItem: Kana pasina mhute pagirazi, nhasi pakutyaira muchando dzima bhatani reA/C woshandisa heater chete.

p-324.title: Bhodhoro reketchup usaribvunze, riwisire nechepasi nesimba
p-324.summary: Ketchup kana ichiramba yakamira inoramba yakasimba, asi kana ikapiwa simba inoyerera pakarepo. Tora bhodhoro uriwisire padivi nekurirova nesimba kamwe kuti upe simba pakarepo.
p-324.principle: Ketchup ishear-thinning non-Newtonian fluid, kumhanya kwe shear $\dot\gamma$ kunowedzera apparent viscosity $\eta=\tau/\dot\gamma$ inodzika uye inoyerera kana yapfuura yield stress.
p-324.example: Pakumira viscosity inopfuura anenge 50Pa·s, asi nekusimba kwe shear inogona kudzikira nezvikamu zvakawanda. Chichiri chakakora zvikuru kupfuura mvura (anenge 0.001Pa·s).
p-324.actionItem: Nhasi tora bhodhoro reketchup uriwisire woirova nechikamu chepasi pedivi nhengo yeruoko nesimba kamwe.

p-325.title: Pa treadmill isa kurereka kwe1% kuti zvienderane nekunze
p-325.summary: Treadmill haina kuramba kwemhepo saka kunyange pakumhanya kwakafanana kunyore kupfuura kunze. Kuwedzera kurereka kusvika pa1% kunowanzogadzirisa musiyano uyu.
p-325.principle: Basa rinoshandiswa pakuramba kwemhepo rinotsiviwa nesimba repotential rekurereka: $P=mgv\sin\theta\approx mgv\times(\text{chiyero chekurereka})$.
p-325.example: Munhu une huremu hwe70 kg achimhanya pa10 km/h (anenge 2.78m/s), kurereka kwe1% kuri simba rinowedzerwa re$70\times9.81\times2.78\times0.01\approx19\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-325.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa treadmill, isa kurereka kuita 1% womhanya.

p-326.title: Paunotora mifananidzo kunze kwewindow yebhazi/chitima namira lenzi pagirazi
p-326.summary: Kuratidzira kwechiedza chemukati mudehwe remotokari mufananidzo kunodzikira zvikuru kana ukaisa lenzi padyo negirazi. Kuvhara nzvimbo yakatenderedza lenzi noruoko kana hood kunonyanya kunaka.
p-326.principle: Kuratidzira kwepamusoro pegirazi iFresnel reflection uye kuri anenge 4% divi rimwe ($R=\left(\frac{n-1}{n+1}\right)^2,\ n\approx1.5$), uye kana ukanamira lenzi, ngirozi yechiedza chinoratidzirwa chinopinda mulenzi inodzikira.
p-326.example: Pamativi maviri egirazi 4% yega yega inoratidzirwa, saka anenge 8% yechiedza chemukati chinoratidzirwa muwindow. Kana kunze kwakasviba, chiyero ichi chinonyanya kuoneka pamufananidzo.
p-326.actionItem: Nhasi paunotora mifananidzo kunze kwewindow, bata lenzi pagirazi zvishoma wovhara chiedza chakatenderedza noruoko rumwe. Asi usamanikidze zvakanyanya panzvimbo dzinodengenyeka.

p-327.title: Fambira mberi kuenzanisa mahedifoni nefoni nema impedance (Ω)
p-327.summary: Pazvishandiso zvine voltage yepasi yekubuda sefoni, mahedifoni ane impedance yakadzika anopa ruzha rukuru. Anoita impedance yakakwira anopa kubuda kushoma pa voltage imwe chete.
p-327.principle: Simba rinowanikwa nemahedifoni ndi$P=\frac{V^2}{R}$, saka pa voltage imwe $V$, kana impedance $R$ ikakura, $P$ inodzikira.
p-327.example: Pa voltage ye0.5V (RMS) mahedifoni e16 Ω anenge 15.6mW, e300 Ω anenge 0.83mW, ndiko musiyano we19 nguva.
p-327.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa impedance mupepa rezvinhu zvemahedifoni, uye kana uchizo batanidza zvakananga nefoni sarudza e16–32Ω.

p-328.title: 1kWh ndi3.6MJ, anenge 860kcal
p-328.summary: kWh yebhiri remagetsi, kcal yechikafu uye joule yesainzi zvose iunits zvesimba uye zvinoshandurwa chaizvo.
p-328.example: 2,000kcal pazuva ndi8.4MJ, ndiko anenge 2.3kWh, uye avhareji yenge 97W. 1kWh inobatidza bulb ye100 W kwemaawa 10.
p-328.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kushandiswa kwamwedzi uno (kWh) mubhiri remagetsi kana app.

p-329.title: Mukati mukwevera musuwo weovheni, tembiricha inodzika ne25°C
p-329.summary: Kana ukavhura musuwo weovheni kamwe, mhepo inopisa inobuda uye inotonhora inopinda uye tembiricha yemukati inodzika zvakajeka, uye kuiwedzera zvakare kunoda simba.
p-329.principle: Kana musuwo wavhurwa, mhepo inochinjana nekufamba nekuda kwemusiyano wekupisa, uye kudzorerwa kunoda kupisa kwe$Q=C\Delta T$. Madziro anochengeta kupisa saka kudzika kunosiyana neovheni.
