p-329.example: Ovheni ye180°C inozivikanwa kudzika nenge 20–30°C kana musuwo wavhurwa kamwe uye kudzorerwa kunotora maminitsi mashoma. Nguva yekubika inowedzera nemagetsi anoshandiswa anowedzerawo.
p-329.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika muovheni usavhure musuwo, tarisa mamiriro nehwindo remwenje weovheni.

p-330.title: Mazai mbishi nemazai akabikwa anosiyaniswa nekutenderedza
p-330.summary: Kana ukatenderedza zai patafura, zai rakabikwa rinotenderera zvakanaka kwenguva refu, rembishi rinodengenyeka uye rinomira nokukurumidza.
p-330.principle: Zai rakabikwa rakaita muviri wakasimba saka rinotenderera zvakaenzana ne$L=I\omega$. Mukati mezai rembishi mvura inofamba zvakasiyana nechikamu uye simba rinopararira uye pashure pekumira mvura inoramba ichitenderera zvichiita kuti rienderere zvishoma zvakare.
p-330.example: Pakutenderedza zai rinenge 60g, rakabikwa rinotenderera zvakagadzikana kwemasekondi akati wandei, rembishi kazhinji rinomira nokukurumidza. Kana ukarimisa nesimba zvishoma woisunungura, rembishi chete rinofamba zvishoma zvakare.
p-330.actionItem: Nhasi tenderedza mazai maviri mufiriji patafura uone rinotenderera zvakanyorova.

p-331.title: Kukosora nemukono/chigunwe, mapundu emvura anobhururuka mamita akati wandei
p-331.summary: Kukosora nekupopota kunoita mhepo inomhanya inotumira mapundu kusvika mamita akati wandei. Kuvhara nemukati mechigunwe kana mazamu kunodzikisa zvikuru kureba kwekupararira.
p-331.principle: Jet inobuda mumuromo ine kumhanya $p=mv$, inopararira mberi uye kumhanya kwayo kunoderera zvishoma nezvishoma ichiparadzirwa mumhepo.
p-331.example: Kumhanya kwekutanga kwemhepo yekukosora kunonzi anenge 10m/s, uye mapundu madiki anogona kuramba ari mumhepo, saka anogona kukanganisa kusvika mamita akati wandei.
p-331.actionItem: Nhasi kana wakasimba kukosora, vhara muromo nekushaya nemukati mechigunwe kana mazamu panzvimbo yemaoko.

p-332.title: Magirazi ekuska ski, sarudza ruvara rwelenzi zvichienderana nemamiriro ekunze
p-332.summary: Pazuva rakajeka lenzi yakasviba inodzikisa kubwinya, uye pazuva rine makore kana chando lenzi dzvuku-yero/orenji dzinoratidza musiyano wenzvimbo.
p-332.principle: Malenzi ane kupfuura kwakasiyana kwemhando yewavelength, uye kupfuura kwechiedza chinoonekwa $\mathrm{VLT}=I/I_0$ kunogadza kuvhenekera. Yero/orenji inosefa bhuruu ichiwedzera contrast pazuva rine makore.
p-332.example: Pazuva rakajeka grey yakasviba/mirror lens ine VLT inenge 10–20%, uye pazuva rine makore lenzi yero/rose ine VLT inenge 40–60% ndiyo sarudzo yakajairika.
p-332.actionItem: Nhasi paunotora magirazi eski tarisa kufanotaura kwemamiriro ekunze woita sarudzo yeruvara rwelenzi (kana lenzi yekutsiva).

p-333.title: Isa spika 20cm kana kupfuura kubva padziro
p-333.summary: Kana ukamanikidza spika padziro bass inowedzera uye mamwe manzwi anorasika, saka manzwi anova akaremara uye asina kujeka.
p-333.principle: Padyo nedziro bass inowedzera nenzira yeboundary effect (anenge 3–6dB), uye pa frequency $f=\frac{c}{4d}$ apo kuratidzira kwedziro kuri kunopesana nephase neruzha rwakananga ruzha runodzikira.
p-333.example: Pa20 cm kubva padziro $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.2}\approx430\ \mathrm{Hz}$ inodzikira padyo, uye pa50 cm anenge 170Hz padyo inodzikira ichichinja bass band. Zvinosiyana nemamiriro ekamuri.
p-333.actionItem: Nhasi isa spika 20cm kana kupfuura kubva padziro woteerera rwiyo rumwe chete zvakare.

p-334.title: Inverter yemotokari ine current hombe pa12V
p-334.summary: Kana ukabatanidza chishandiso chine simba guru semuchaja we laptop neinverter mumotokari, current yepa12 V inova hombe zvikuru uye fiyuzi yesocket inogona kuputika.
p-334.principle: Simba $P=VI$, saka pasimba rakaenzana, voltage yakadzika, current $I=P/V$ yakakura.
p-334.example: Chishandiso che150 W chine $150/12=12.5\ \mathrm{A}$ mundangariro, uye kana tikafunga kushanda kwe90% kweinverter anenge 13.9A, padyo nemuganho wefiyuzi yesocket ye10–15A yakajairika.
p-334.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kugona kwefiyuzi yesocket yemotokari (A) woparadzanisa simba rezvishandiso zvaunoda kubatanidza ne12 V.

p-335.title: Kuyambuka kwekudziya kwekutanga muovheni imari yakagadziriswa, saka kubika zvose pamwe chete kunobatsira
p-335.summary: Kuyambuka kwekutanga kunoshandisa simba rakaenzana pakuvhura ovheni kwega kwega zvisinei nehuwandu hwekubika. Kana ukabika zvakawanda panguva imwe, huwandu hwekudziya kwekutanga hunodzikira.
p-335.principle: Kupisa kwekudziya kwekutanga kunogadziriswa nekugona kwekupisa kweovheni nekukwira kwekupisa: $Q=C_\mathrm{oven}\Delta T$. Hakuenderane nehuwandu hwechikafu.
p-335.example: Kudziya ovheni yemagetsi kusvika pa180°C kunoda anenge 0.3–0.4kWh, uye kana ukabika kamwe panzvimbo yekubika kaviri, unogona kuchengeta anenge 70 won (anenge 0.05 madhora).
p-335.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa ovheni, unganidza zvaunobika pamwe woabika pamwe pamashelefu maviri.

p-336.title: Tsvaga stud mudziro nekuchaya
p-336.summary: Kana ukachaya madziro egypsum board nechigunwe, panzvimbo isina chinhu pane ruzha rwakadzika runodzvova, pamusoro pestud (chimiro) pane ruzha rwakaoma rwakakwira.
p-336.principle: Pamusoro pakachayiwa panodengenyeka uye panopa resonance frequency $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$, pamusoro pechimiro rigidity $k$ yakakura saka ruzha runova rwakakwira uye rupfupi.
p-336.example: Ma stud anowanzova pakati pe400–600mm, saka kana ukafamba mudziro uchichaya anenge 10cm panguva imwe, nzvimbo dzinochinja ruzha dzinooneka dzakarongeka.
p-336.actionItem: Nhasi usati wapaka mhete, chaya madziro utsvage stud, uye tarisa kana waya kana mapombi achipfuura.

p-337.title: Sauna ye80°C inotsungirirwa asi mvura ye80°C hairambirwi
p-337.summary: Mhepo haiendesi kupisa zvakanaka saka sauna ye80°C inogona kutsungirirwa, asi mvura yekupisa kwakafanana inobvumbura pakarepo.
p-337.principle: Kupisa kunoenda kuganda kunoenderana nekuendesa kupisa nekugona kwekupisa. Kuendesa kupisa kwemvura kuri anenge $0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\,K}$, ndiko anenge ka25 kupfuura mhepo ($0.026$), uye kugona kwekupisa pavolume kuri kukuru zvikuru.
p-337.example: Kuendesa kupisa kwemvura kuri anenge ka25 kupfuura mhepo, uye kugona kwekupisa pavolume anenge ka3,500, saka mvura inopfuura 60°C inogona kukonzera kupfira mukati memasekondi mashoma.
p-337.actionItem: Nhasi usati washambira kana kugeza, tarisa kutanga tembiricha yemvura nemukati mechigunwe.

p-338.title: Chando chedziva chinoshandiswa chete kana chakakora 10cm kana kupfuura
p-338.summary: Simba rechando rekutsigira mutoro rinowedzera sesquare yekukora, asi chando chitete chine njodzi. Tarisa kukora uteerere nhungamiro dzenzvimbo.
p-338.principle: Mutoro wekutsigira wechando ndi$P\propto h^2$, saka kana kukora $h$ kwakapetwa kaviri inotsigira anenge 4 nguva.
p-338.example: Kazhinji 5cm munhu mumwe chete anofamba anotsigirwa zvishoma, uye pamusoro pe10 cm vanhu vakati wandei vanotorwa vachichengeteka, uye kana kukora kuchibva pa5 cm kusvika pa10 cm kutsigira kunenge ka4.
p-338.actionItem: Nhasi usati wabuda panguva yechando tarisa nhungamiro dzenzvimbo nekukora kwechando, uye kana une kupokana usaende.

p-339.title: Lantern inoyerwa nelumens, nguva yekushanda neWh
p-339.summary: Kuvhenekera kwelantern kunoyerwa nelumen (lm) uye nguva yekuramba inoyerwa nekupatsanura kugona kwebhatiri (Wh) nesimba rinoshandiswa.
p-339.principle: Kushanda ndi$\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$ uye nguva yekushandisa ndi$t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: Kana ukapa 300 lm nekushanda kwe100 lm/W, ndi3 W. Bhatiri re3.7V 5,000 mAh (anenge 18.5Wh) inovhenekera anenge maawa 6 pamusoro pepepa.
p-339.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa lumens nebhatiri Wh (kana mAh×V) mumashoko e lantern woverenga nguva yekushandisa.

p-340.title: Zuva rinowira nokukurumidza hariwo zuva rakapfupika rechando (winter solstice)
p-340.summary: Zuva rinowira nokukurumidza anenge mavhiki maviri kunge pashure pezuva rakapfupika (winter solstice, anenge 21 Zvita) kutanga kwaZvita. Zvinopesana, zuva rinobuda nekuchedzera ndiro kutanga kwaNdira.
p-340.principle: Nguva iyo zuva rinosvika chaizvo kumaodzanyemba inopiswa ne equation of time $E$, saka mamiriro ekuwira/kubuda kwezuva anosiyana newinter solstice.
p-340.example: MuSeoul kuwira kwezuva kunotanga nokukurumidza kutanga kwaZvita anenge 17:16 uye pakati pewinter solstice anenge 17:20, kunoreva anenge maminitsi 4 shure, asi nguva yezuva yakapfupika kwazvo iri pawinter solstice.
p-340.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa nguva yekuwira kwezuva woramba uchitarisa kana ichicheruka zvakare kusvikira pakati paZvita.

p-341.title: Chiyero chekicheni chinoparadza zvishoma kupfuura kapu rekuyera
p-341.summary: Hupfu hwakazadzwa nekapu hunosiyana zvikuru nenzira yakadzvanywa, asi chiyero chinoyera chaizvo ne g uye chinoparadza zvishoma.
p-341.principle: Huremu ndi$m=\rho V$, asi hupfu hunosiyana $\rho$ kupfuura 20% zvichienderana nekudzvanywa uye huremu hunosiyana kunyange nevolume imwe chete.
p-341.example: Kapu rimwe rehupfu (anenge 240mL) rinosiyana kubva ku100 kusvika 150g zvichienderana nenzira yekuzadza, ndiko kusvika pa50%, uye mukanyiwa unoita wakaoma kana wakanyorova.
p-341.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchibika chingwa kana mabhisikiti, shandisa chiyero kuyera zvinhu mu g panzvimbo yekapu.

p-342.title: Kuisa foni mugirazi kunowedzera ruzha
p-342.summary: Kana ukaisa foni mugirazi risina chinhu, ruzha runounganidzwa ruchienda mberi uye runoita echo mukati mekapu zvichiita kuti rinzwike richikura. Mhedzisiro iri anenge ma dB mashoma.
p-342.principle: Chubhu yakavharwa kudivi rimwe inoita resonance padyo $f=\frac{c}{4L}$, uye girazi rinounganidza ruzha kudivi rimwe richiwedzera directivity.
p-342.example: Kana girazi rine kudzika kwe10 cm, padyo $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$ panoshanduka kuita pakasimba, uye kunogona kukura anenge 3–6dB (simba reruzha 2–4 nguva) uye zvinosiyana nechigadzirwa.
p-342.actionItem: Nhasi isa foni nemuromo wespika mukati megirazi woenzanisa kukura kweruzha.

p-343.title: Kupisa kwakaderera kunogona kupisa kunyange pa44°C mukati memaawa akati wandei
p-343.summary: Kunyange kupisa kusina kunyanya kupisa sekwegumbeze remagetsi kana hot pack kunobata nzvimbo imwe kwenguva refu kunokonzera kukuvadzwa kwakadzika kweganda. Kurwadziwa kushoma saka zviri nyore kusazviziva.
p-343.principle: Kukuvadzwa kweganda kunoitika nekubata nekupisa kunounganidza tembiricha nenguva yekuratidzwa, uye kunyange tembiricha ichidzika, nguva refu inowedzera kukuvadza.
p-343.example: Zvinozivikanwa kuti kubata pa44°C kwemaawa anopfuura 6 kunogona kukonzera kupisa, uye hot pack padyo ne60°C ine njodzi nenguva pfupi zvikuru.
p-343.actionItem: Nhasi usaise hot pack kana gumbeze remagetsi zvakananga paganda, isa pamusoro pezvipfeko kana jira woidzima usati warara.

p-344.title: Mafashame echando anoitika zvikuru panzvimbo dzakarereka 30–45°
p-344.summary: Pamakomo ane chando, mafashame echando anoitika zvikuru kana kurereka kuri 30–45°. Kana kuri kudiki chando chinomira, uye kana kuri kukuru chinoyerera chisati chaunganidzwa.
p-344.principle: Kana shear stress yepasi pechando $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$ yapfuura kuramba kwekukweshera inotsvedza, uye kana ngirozi yekurereka $\theta$ ichiwedzera $\tau$ inowedzera uye inokwira kusvika pa45°.
p-344.example: Kana chando chine density 300kg/m³, kukora 1m chiri pakurereka kwe38°, ndi$\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, uye kana kukosha uku kuchipfuura simba rechando, fashame rinoitika.
p-344.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchienda kumakomo echando, usati wabuda tarisa kufanotaura kwemafashame nekurereka kwenzvimbo, uye dzivisa nzvimbo dzakarereka kupfuura 30°.

p-345.title: Tripod yakareruka shandisa nechinorema
p-345.summary: Tripod yakareruka inowira nyore nemhepo. Kana ukasungirira huremu sebhegi pakati pasi kudzikisa pakati pekurema, inova yakagadzikana zvikuru.
p-345.principle: Tripod inowa kana simba rakapfuura restoring moment $mgr$ rikashanda pakureba $h$ nechikamu chechitsigiso chetsoka. Simba rinodiwa kuiwisa ndi$F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, saka kana pakati pekurema pakadzikira, simba rakawanda rinodiwa.
p-345.example: Kana tripod ye1.5kg (pakati pekurema 1.2m, radius yetsoka 0.4m) yakaiswa bhegi re3 kg pakureba kwe0.3m, pakati pekurema pakadzika kusvika pa0.6m, uye simba rinodiwa kuiwisa rinoenda kubva pa4.9N kusvika pa14.7N, anenge 3 nguva.
p-345.actionItem: Nhasi paunoshandisa tripod, sungirira bhegi pa hook iri pasi pecenter column kuti riregedzwe pamusoro pepasi.

p-346.title: Munhu mumwe chete ndiye heater ye100 W
p-346.summary: Munhu anoburitsa anenge 100W yekupisa kunyange achizorora, saka kamuri rizere nevanhu rinodziya nokukurumidza kunyange pasina kupisa.
p-346.principle: Simba rechikafu chaidyiwa rinopedzisira rabuda sekupisa, uye basal metabolic rate iri anenge $P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: 2,000kcal pazuva ndi$\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Kamuri rine vanhu 20 rinenge 2kW, ndiko kuenzana neheater diki yemagetsi imwe.
p-346.actionItem: Nhasi kana pane kuungana kwevanhu, edza kudzikisa setting yekupisa ne1–2°C.

p-347.title: Pukuta pasi pepoto rakanyorova usati waritenderera pamoto
p-347.summary: Mvura iri pasi pepoto inoputika pamoto ichitora kupisa kwakawanda, ichiparadza nguva negasi, uye madonhwe anosvetuka anogona kuva njodzi.
p-347.principle: Kana mvura ichiputika, kupisa kwakavanzika $Q=mL$ kuri kudiwa, uye kupisa kweimvura kuputika ndi$L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: Kana pasi pane 10g yemvura, $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$ kJ inoshandiswa, uye nemoto unobudirira we2 kW ndokwenge masekondi 11 ekupisa.
p-347.actionItem: Nhasi usati waisa poto pamoto pukuta mvura iri pasi nejira.

p-348.title: Nei kana mwenje umwe wemuti weKisimusi ukasvika kupera, mutsetse wose unodzima
p-348.summary: Mutsetse wemwenje yakabatanidzwa nenzira ye series kana mumwe ukaputika, hapana nzira yecurrent uye wose unodzima.
p-348.principle: Current museries circuit yakafanana pazvikamu zvose uye $I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. Kana pane pakatemwa, kuramba kunova infinite uye $I=0$.
p-348.example: Mwenje e50 ye2.4V yakabatanidzwa museries inogovera anenge 120V. Kana imwe ichibviswa, current mune dzimwe 49 inova 0.
p-348.actionItem: Nhasi mutsetse wemwenje wakadzima, bvisa plug wobva wadzvanya mwenje yakasununguka kana kutsiva neyakasara.

p-349.title: Nei kufema 'ho~' ne 'hu~' kune tembiricha yakasiyana
p-349.summary: 'Ho~' yekufema nemuromo wakavhurika kwazvo inonzwika inodziya, uye 'hu~' yekufema nemarebvu akaungana inonzwika inotonhora.
p-349.principle: Kana marebvu akaungana mhepo inoita jet inomhanya inodhonza mhepo yakatenderedza (entrainment). Tembiricha yakasanganiswa ndi$T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$ inodzika, uye kutonhora kwekuwedzera kunowedzerwa zvishoma.
p-349.example: Kana mhepo yekufema ye34°C ikasangana ne20°C yemhepo yemukamuri 1:1 inova anenge 27°C, saka mhepo inosvika paruoko inonzwika yakadzika nenge 7°C.
p-349.actionItem: Nhasi fema 'ho~' ne 'hu~' nekudzokorodza pamusana weruoko unzwe musiyano wetembiricha.

p-350.title: Kumhanya kwesled yechando kunogadziriswa nekukwirira chete
p-350.summary: Kana pasina kukweshera, kumhanya kwepasi kwesled yechando kunoenderana nekukwirira kwainodzika kubva chete uye hakuenderane nehuremu. Chaizvo kunononoka nekuda kwekukweshera nekuramba kwemhepo.
p-350.principle: Potential energy inoshanduka kuita kinetic energy, saka kubva $mgh=\frac12mv^2$ ndi$v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: Pakukwirira kwe5 m $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, anenge 36km/h, uye kumhanya chaiko kuri pasi pezvi.
p-350.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa sled yechando, sarudza nzvimbo yakati sandara isina zvipingaidzo uye pfeka heremeti.

p-351.title: Pakusarudza matiresi, rara maminitsi 10 uone nzvimbo yechiuno
p-351.summary: Pakutenga matiresi rara anenge maminitsi 10 uone kana ruoko rwemuhurokwe runopinda zviri nyore pakati pechiuno nematiresi. Kana nzvimbo iri hombe, chiuno chinosimuka uye kumanikidza kunounganidzwa munzvimbo imwe.
p-351.principle: Kumanikidza ndi$P=\frac{F}{A}$ uye kunodzikira kana nzvimbo yekutsigira $A$ yakakura. Matiresi anogoverana mutoro nespring constant $k$ uye kurongeka kwezvidimbu.
p-351.example: Kana huremu hwe70 kg (anenge 686N) hwakangoiswa pa0.1m² chete anenge 6.9kPa, kana hwagoverwa pa0.3m² anenge 2.3kPa, ndiko 1/3.
p-351.actionItem: Nhasi pakusarudza matiresi rara nepadivi wotarisa kuti mafudzi, chiuno nechiuno zvinotsigirwa zvakaenzana kwemaminitsi 10.

p-352.title: Fan iri pamusoro peitofu inotenderera pasina magetsi
p-352.summary: Fan yakaiswa pamusoro peitofu inotenderera pasina waya kana bhatiri, nekupisa kweitofu chete, ichiparadzira kupisa mukamuri.
p-352.principle: Nenzira yeSeebeck effect musiyano wekupisa $\Delta T$ pakati pemajoyinti maviri unogadzira voltage $V=S\Delta T$ uye voltage iyi inotenderedza motor.
p-352.example: Nemodule ye thermoelectric ine Seebeck coefficient yenge 0.05V/K, pakusiyana kwekupisa kwe100 K open-circuit voltage inenge 5V, uye kubuda kuri shoma pasi pema W mashoma.
p-352.actionItem: Nhasi isa fan iri pamusoro peitofu panzvimbo iri mukati mepamutemo wekupisa wakanyorwa pachigadzirwa uye usiye vana vachiibata.

p-353.title: Itofu rembiza yetea light hariwedzi kudziisa kamuri
p-353.summary: Itofu rakagadzirwa netea light mashoma nembiza haribudisi kupisa kwakakwana kudziisa kamuri uye rinowedzera njodzi yemoto ne carbon monoxide.
p-353.principle: Kenduru inobudisa kupisa chete kwakaenzana nekupisa kwekuvira kwemafuta $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, uye tea light imwe iri anenge 40W.
p-353.example: Tea light imwe inopisa ngoro 14g (anenge 0.6MJ) kwemaawa 4 anenge 40W, uye 4 inenge 160W, ndiko zvikamu zvishoma pakati pe1–3kW inodiwa pakupisa kamuri.
p-353.actionItem: Nhasi panzvimbo yeitofu rembiza vhara mikaha yemahwindo kuti udzikise kurasikirwa kwekupisa.

p-354.title: Cork yechampagne inobhururuka pa50 km/h
p-354.summary: Mukati mebhodhoro rechampagne mune anenge 6atm yekumanikidza, saka kana cork yabuda inobhururuka padyo ne50 km/h ichigona kukuvadza maziso.
p-354.principle: Musiyano wekumanikidza unomhanyisa cork nesimba $F=\Delta P\cdot A$, uye basa rakaitwa negasi rinowedzera rinova kinetic energy $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: Kana musiyano wekumanikidza uri anenge 5bar, cross section yecork anenge $2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ndi$F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, uye kana cork ichibhururuka pa14 m/s (50km/h) kinetic energy inenge 0.9J.
p-354.actionItem: Nhasi pakuvhura champagne, chengamisa bhodhoro nenge 45°, dzvanya cork nechigunwe chikuru uchitenderedza bhodhoro zvishoma nezvishoma, usatarise munhu.

p-355.title: Pakurara, ruzha rweredzi rinovanza ruzha rwekukurumidza
p-355.summary: Ruzha rweredzi rinopfava runogona kudzikisa musiyano pakati peruzha rwekukurumidza neruzha rwepashure uye rinogona kubatsira kuti urege kumuka. Mhedzisiro inosiyana nemunhu.
p-355.principle: Nekuvharika kwekunzwa, ruzha rwakapamhama runosimudza muganho wekunzwika kweimwe ruzha. Musiyano weruzha unotaurwa se$\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: Kana pashure pe30 dB ruzha rwemusuwo unovharwa we70 dB ndiwo musiyano we40 dB, asi kana kuine ruzha rweredzi rwe45 dB, musiyano unodzika kusvika pa25 dB uye unodzikira kuvhiringidza.
p-355.actionItem: Nhasi usiku, ridza ruzha rweredzi pa40 dB diki panzeve nepa timer, uye uzvise kure nenzeve dzemwana mudiki.

p-356.title: Crampons imakanika yekubata ichipinda muchando
p-356.summary: Crampons haisi yekuwedzera kukweshera, asi inodzivirira kutsvedza kuburikidza nenzara dzakapinza dzinopinda muchando dzichibata nenzira yemuviri.
p-356.principle: Mashangu pachando ane muganho wekutsvedza $\tan\theta=\mu$ uye coefficient yekukweshera $\mu$ iri diki zvikuru, asi spikes dzinobata nekushandisa kuramba kwe shear kwechando.
p-356.example: Coefficient yekukweshera yakamira pakati peshangu dzakajairika nechando inenge 0.1, saka kunyange pa$\tan^{-1}0.1$ chete inotsvedza, asi nzara dzecrampons dzinogona kutsigira kunyange pamakomo echando akarereka zvikuru.
p-356.actionItem: Nhasi usati waenda kukwira gomo tarisa kuti nzara dzecrampons hadzina kuora uye zvisungo zvinosungirirwa zvakasimba.

p-357.title: Sarudza laser pointer ye1 mW kana pasi
p-357.summary: Laser pointer yakachengeteka kumaziso ndeye Class 2 ine simba re1 mW kana pasi. Kana simba rakakwirira, kunyange reflex yekubwaira kwemaziso haidzivirire zvakakwana.
p-357.principle: Reflex yekubwaira kweziso inenge masekondi 0.25 uye simba rinopinda muziso ndi$E=P\,t$. Kana beam cross-section iri diki, irradiance $I=P/A$ inowedzera.
p-357.example: 1mW kwemasekondi 0.25 ndi$E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Beam yedhayamita 3mm ndi$I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Zvigadzirwa zvakachipa dzimwe nguva zvine simba rakakura kupfuura rakanyorwa.
p-357.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa chiratidzo che'Class 2, 1mW kana pasi' pa laser pointer uye usarare vanhu, mhuka kana mota.

p-358.title: Itofu rehuni/marasha rinopisa zvakanaka kana chimney chakareba
p-358.summary: Kana chimney chakareba uye mhepo yemukati inopisa, simba rekudhonza kumusoro (draft) rinowedzera, moto unotanga nyore uye utsi unobuda zvakanaka.
p-358.principle: Nenzira ye chimney effect draft pressure ndi$\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$ uye inoenderana nekureba $h$ nemusiyano wedensity.
p-358.example: Kana kureba kuri 5m, kunze 0°C (1.29kg/m³), gasi rinobuda 200°C (anenge 0.75kg/m³) ndi$\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa itofu tarisa majoini echimney uye tarisa bhatiri reCO alarm.

p-359.title: Kunyange muchando, zvipfeko zvinoomeswa zvakaoma
p-359.summary: Zvipfeko zvakarungirwa pasi pe0°C zvinoita chando, asi chando chinoshanduka kuita mhute zvakananga (sublimation) chigoparira zvishoma nezvishoma. Hapana kudiwa kwe dryer.
p-359.principle: Kuchinja kwechando kuita gasi zvakananga (sublimation) $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$ kunoda $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$ uye kunokurumidza kana kuri kuoma uye kune mhepo.
p-359.example: Kusublimation kwe1 kg yemvura kunoda anenge 2.83MJ. Kunotora nguva refu kupfuura kamwe kwe dryer (anenge 2–3kWh) asi hapana magetsi anoshandiswa.
p-359.actionItem: Nhasi pazuva rakajeka uye rakaoma pasi pe0°C, rungira zvipfeko, woonekesa mukati kana dzaoma.

p-360.title: Bvisa chando pamusoro pemotokari usati watanga kutyaira
p-360.summary: Chando chakaunganidzwa padenga chinobhururuka kuenda kumashure sezvikamu paunofamba, chichiwira pamotokari yepashure kana kuvhara girazi repamberi. Usati wabuda bvisa chando pamusoro, bonnet negirazi.
p-360.principle: Nekuda kwekumhanya kwemhepo pakufamba, zvikamu zvechando zvinosundirwa kumashure uye zvinorova motokari yepashure nesimba rekinetic $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: Padenga re2 m² chando che5 cm (zvichifungidzirwa density 100kg/m³) chinenge 10kg. Kana chikarova pakumhanya kwakaenzana 80km/h (22.2m/s) anenge 2.5kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Nhasi kana kwanaya chando, usati watyaira tsvaira chando chose padenga, bonnet negirazi nebhurashi rinotsetseka.

p-361.title: Nei ruzha rwemunhu rwunoita rukuru kana resitorendi ichiita ruzha
p-361.summary: Kana ruzha rwunokura, vanhu vanokwidza manzwi avo vasingazvizivi, izvi zvinonzi Lombard effect. Kana wose achizviita, ruzha runokura zvakare.
p-361.principle: Nekuda kweLombard effect, kumanikidza kwemanzwi kunokwira nekuwedzera kweruzha, uye kuti manzwi anzwikwe, signal-to-noise ratio $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$ inofanira kuchengetwa.
p-361.example: Kana ruzha rwukakwira kubva pa60 dB kusvika pa80 dB, ndiko 20dB, manzwi anozivikanwa kukwira anenge 6–10dB. Resitorendi inogona kusvika pa70–80dB.
p-361.actionItem: Nhasi pakuungana sarudza nzvimbo yekona iri kure nespika uye pfeka mutsetse wakatsetseka wokurukura nezwi rakadzika.

p-362.title: Kubuda kwezuva kwegore idzva kunoitika nokukurumidza kunzvimbo dzakatarisana nemabvazuva
p-362.summary: Zuva rinobuda kumabvazuva kutanga. Pa latitude imwe chete, pakuenda kumabvazuva ne1° ye longitude, kubuda kwezuva kunokurumidza anenge maminitsi 4.
p-362.principle: Pasi rinotenderera $15^\circ$ paawa rimwe, saka musiyano we longitude $1^\circ$ ndi$\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: Homigot ine longitude 129.6°E iri anenge 2.6° kumabvazuva kupfuura Seoul (127°E), saka kubuda kwezuva kunokurumidza anenge maminitsi 10, uye musiyano chaiwo unosiyana zvishoma nelatitude.
p-362.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchienda kunoona kubuda kwezuva kwegore idzva, tarisa kare nguva yekubuda kwezuva munzvimbo yaunoenda.

p-363.title: Mayuniti ekumanikidza kwemhepo bar·psi·kPa, kuchinja pakarepo
p-363.summary: Kumanikidza kwedhayi kunonyorwa mu bar, psi, kPa nezvimwe. Kana ukayeuka kukosha kumwe kwekushandura, unogona kuchinja kuenda kune imwe mayuniti.
p-363.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa tafura yekumanikidza kunokurudzirwa pamusuwo wemuyeuri woyera kukosha chaiko nechishandiso chekuyera kumanikidza kwedhayi.

p-364.title: Verenga nguva yekuchaja motokari yemagetsi mumba ne kWh÷kW
p-364.summary: Nguva yekuchaja inowanikwa nekugovanisa simba rinodiwa (kWh) nesimba rechaja (kW). Nekuda kwekurasikirwa, chaizvo inotora nguva yakawedzerwa zvishoma.
p-364.principle: $t=\frac{E}{P}$, uye kana kuchaja kuine kushanda $\eta$ ndi$t=\frac{E}{\eta P}$.
p-364.example: Kuzadza bhatiri re60 kWh kubva pa10% kusvika pa80% ndi$E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, uye nechaja ye7 kW (kushanda 90%) ndi$t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ maawa.
p-364.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kugona kwebhatiri remotokari yako (kWh) nesimba rechaja (kW) woverenga nguva yekuchaja.

p-365.title: Paunonyungudutsa chando kuita mvura, isa kapu remvura pakutanga
p-365.summary: Chando chine mhepo yakawanda nokudaro kuendesa kupisa hakuna kunaka, saka kana ukachiisa zvakananga mupoto isina chinhu, pasi pacho pangapisa. Kana ukaisa mvura shoma pakutanga, kubata kwekupisa kunofambira mberi uye kunonyungudika nokukurumidza.
p-365.principle: Kuendesa kupisa kwechando kuri kwakaderera uye mavhiri makuru, saka nzvimbo yekubata nepoto idiki. Kunyungudika kunoda kupisa kwefusion $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: Kuita mvura ye1 L kunoda anenge 334kJ, kunenge kuri kupisa kwekukwidza 80°C. Chando chinenge 10% yevolume ndiyo mvura, saka anenge 10L yechando inodiwa.
p-365.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchida kuita mvura kubva muchando, tanga wapisa kapu remvura wozoisa chando chakachena zvishoma nezvishoma (nguva dzose bika usati wanwa).

p-366.title: Pakukwira nzira ine chando, kumhanya zvishoma nezvishoma usingamire
p-366.summary: Panzira inokwira ine chando, kana wamira zvakaoma kutanga zvakare, uye kana wakumhanya zvakanyanya, vhiri rinotenderera risina kubata. Chengeta nzvimbo pamberi pechikwiriro wokwira zvishoma nezvishoma nekumhanya kwakaenzana.
p-366.principle: Static friction $F\le\mu_sN$ yakakura kupfuura kinetic friction $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), saka kana vhiri riri kutenderera, traction inodzikira nokukurumidza.
p-366.example: Kana $\mu\approx0.2$ yenzira yechando yakadzvanywa, pakurereka kwe10% ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$) chikamu chegravity chinenge $0.1\,mg$ uye friction inenge $0.2\,mg$, saka nzvimbo yakasara ndeye $0.1\,mg$ chete.
p-366.actionItem: Nhasi pamberi pechikwiriro chine chando siya nzvimbo yakakwana kubva kumotokari iri pamberi, ukwire nekumhanya kwakaenzana usingamire pakati.

c-001.title: Usasanganise baking soda nevhiniga, shandisai chimwe nechimwe pachayo
c-001.summary: Kana wasanganisa zvose zviviri, unongowana furo chete uye simba rekuchenesa rinoparadzirana. Baking soda inoshanda pamafuta, vhiniga inoshanda pamatombo emvura.
c-001.principle: Alkali isina simba ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) neacid isina simba ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) zvinoita neutralization zvichiita mhinduro yesodium acetate iri padyo ne neutral: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: Kana wasanganisa chipunu chikuru chimwe chebaking soda (inenge 12g) nehafu yekapu yevhiniga, furo rinopera uye pH inodzika kusvika pa 8 kana pasi, saka hazvinyunguduse mafuta kana matombo emvura zvakanaka. Kana ukazvishandisa zvega, huwandu hwakaenzana hunobvisa marudzi ose maviri edoti.
c-001.actionItem: Nhasi shandisai paste yebaking soda chete pamafuta esinki, uye kitchen towel yakanyikwa mukavhiniga chete pamatombo emvura epombi.

c-002.title: Usambosanganisa bleach neacid cleaner
c-002.summary: Kana bleach (sodium hypochlorite) yasanganiswa neacid toilet cleaner, chlorine gas ine ruzha rinouraya inoitika. Shandisai chimwe chete panguva imwe, mozopedza makashambidza zvakanaka nemvura.
c-002.principle: Kana hypochlorite yasangana neacid, inoshanduka kuita chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: Chlorine gas inokuvadza maziso nehuro kunyangwe iri pa 3ppm, uye pa 30ppm kana kupfuura inokonzera kukosora kukuru nekutambura mukufema. Mubhafurumu diki inogona kusvika pamwero une njodzi mumaminetsi mashoma.
c-002.actionItem: Paraga yebhafurumu, isai bleach neacid (hydrochloric kana citric) cleaner munzvimbo dzakasiyana, uye muverenge shoko rekuti 'musasanganise' palabel musati mashandisa.

c-003.title: Kusanganisa bleach neammonia kana glass cleaner kunewo njodzi
c-003.summary: Kana bleach yasanganiswa neglass cleaner ine ammonia, gasi rine ruzha rinonzi chloramine rinoitika. Vhurai mawindo, uye musashandise zvigadzirwa zviviri izvi pazuva rimwe.
c-003.principle: $\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ inoita chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$) inokuvadza nzira yekufema.
c-003.example: Kunyangwe wakangosanganisa cleaner ine ammonia inenge 5% nebleach shoma mubhafurumu rakavharwa, kukosora nekurwadziwa kwemaziso kunogona kutanga mumaminetsi mashoma. Kana ukashandisa bleach panzvimbo yakanyorerwa nomutsvaira, gasi rinonhuhwa rinoitikawo nomusimboti uyu.
c-003.actionItem: Tsvakai 'ammonia' pamusoro pezvinhu zvecleaner, munyore kuti musashandise nebleach pazuva rimwe, uye vhurai mawindo paunenge uchichenesa.

c-004.title: Sarudza hand sanitizer yekufamba ine ethanol 60% kana kupfuura
c-004.summary: Panzvimbo isina mvura, alcohol hand sanitizer inobatsira, asi kana ethanol iri pasi pe 60% simba rinoderera zvikuru. Mundege, isai mumidziyo isingapfuuri 100mL.
c-004.principle: Ethanol inoshandura mapuroteni emicrobes uye inonyungudutsa lipid membrane. Inopiswa nyore, uye reaction yekupisa ndeyi: $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$
c-004.example: Zvigadzirwa zvine ethanol 60~80% zvinofanira kukwizwa kwemasekonzi anenge 20 kusvikira zvaoma zvizere kuti zvishande. Pamaoko akazara tsvina, mvura nesipo zviri nani kupfuura sanitizer.
c-004.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai label ye sanitizer yaunoshandisa murwendo kuti muone ethanol (%), uye mugoisa mumidziyo isingapfuuri 100mL.

c-005.title: Paunosarudza detergent, tarisai pH palabel
c-005.summary: Dhitajeni dzekicheni nebhafurumu dzine pH dzakasiyana maererano nebasa. Sarudzai alkaline yemafuta, acid yematombo emvura, kuti mukwenye zvakanaka nemari imwe chete.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$ uye kana pH ikaderera ne 1, huwandu hwe $\mathrm{H^+}$ hunova katsi gumi. Mafuta anoita saponification mu alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Dhitajeni ye alkaline ine pH 11~12 inoshanda pamafuta, uye acid ine pH 2~3 inoshanda pa limescale. Dhitajeni yekicheni ye neutral (pH 6~8) haikuvadzi maoko, asi mafuta akasimba anotora nguva yakawanda.
c-005.actionItem: Pamusika unotevera, tarisai pH nebasa palabel yedhitajeni, uye munyore pH yedhitajeni nhatu dzamunadzo kumba.

c-006.title: Chenesai nemvura inotonhora ye 30℃ kuderedza simba rekupisa
c-006.summary: Dhitajeni dzazvino dzine enzyme dzinoshanda zvakanaka pa 30℃, saka hapana chikonzero chekuwedzera kusvika pa 60℃. Kupisa mvura shoma kunoderedza magetsi.
c-006.principle: Kupisa kunodiwa kupisa mvura ndeye $Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$), uye enzyme dzinoparadza mapuroteni dzinoshanda zvakanaka pa 30~40℃.
c-006.example: Kupisa mvura ye 10L kubva pa 15℃ kusvika pa 30℃ kunoda 627kJ, asi kusvika pa 60℃ kunoda 1,881kJ, kusiyana kwakaita katatu. Kana uchishambidza ka 4 pasvondo, mhedzisiro yekuchengetedza inounganidzwa kupfuura 200 pagore.
c-006.actionItem: Nhasi isai washing machine pa 30℃ (kana mvura inotonhora), uye pisai kusvika pa 40℃ chete mbatya dzakanyanya kunyoroveswa nejecha.

c-007.title: Bvisai matombo emvura ekettle yemagetsi nechipunu che citric acid
c-007.summary: White limescale mukati mekettle inonyungudutswa ne citric acid. Haina kunhuwa kunge vhiniga uye inodhura shoma, saka edzai kutanga musati mavhara kettle itsva.
c-007.principle: Matombo emvura e calcium carbonate anonyungudika mu acid: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: Isai chipunu chikuru chimwe che citric acid (inenge 10g) mu 500mL yemvura, bikai uye siyai kwemaminetsi 20; limescale ine ukobvu hwe 1mm inonyungudika kazhinji. Citric acid ye 1kg inenge 5,000 won inogona kushandiswa kakawanda.
c-007.actionItem: Nhasi isai mvura nechipunu che citric acid mukettle, bikai, siyai kwemaminetsi 20, mutsvire mvura, mugoshambidza kaviri kana katatu.

c-008.title: Chii chinonaya sipo yakachena pambatya nebhafurumu
c-008.summary: Mumvura yakaoma (hard water), fatty acid yesipo inosangana ne calcium ichiita soap scum isingagadziki. Zvinogona kuderedzwa nokushandisa synthetic detergent kana kushambidza nevhiniga.
c-008.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ inoita precipitate, uye furo rinoderera.
c-008.example: Munzvimbo dzine hardness ye 200mg/L (sezvo CaCO₃) kana kupfuura, nesipo yakaenzana furo rinogona kuderera kusvika pahafu. Mucheka mutema wetiles yebhafurumu unonyungudutswa neacid cleaner.
c-008.actionItem: Nhasi shandisai vhiniga kana mvura ye citric acid pamucheka mutema wetiles yebhafurumu, mudzivire kwemaminetsi 5 mozopukuta.

c-009.title: Kuderedza residual chlorine yemvura yepombi nokuiisa kana kuibika
c-009.summary: Mvura yepombi ine chlorine shoma yekuuraya utachiona. Iri pachena, asi kana usingadi kunhuwa, siyai isina chivharo kana kuibika kuti ideredze.
c-009.principle: Hypochlorous acid inoparara nenguva kana yawana chiedza: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: Residual chlorine pamvura yepombi inowanzova 0.1~0.5mg/L. Kana ukaiisa mukettle uchiisiya kwemaawa akati, kana kuibika kwemaminetsi 5 pasina chivharo, kunhuwa kunoderera zvikuru.
c-009.actionItem: Manheru ano isai mvura mukettle musina chivharo, mozoienzanisa kunhuwa mangwana musati manwa.

c-010.title: Chikonzero nei bvudzi rinoomarara mushure mekushambidza nemvura yakaoma kunze kwenyika
c-010.summary: Mvura yemuEurope nenzvimbo dzine limescale yakawanda inewo calcium ne magnesium zvakawanda, saka shampoo haiiti furo uye bvudzi rinoomarara. Kushambidza nemhinduro ine acid kunobatsira.
c-010.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ yemvura yakaoma inobatana ne anionic surfactant yeshampoo ichiita precipitate. Hardness inoratidzwa se $\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: Hardness ye 300mg/L kana kupfuura inonzi 'mvura yakaoma zvikuru', inopfuura katatu mvura yepombi yeKorea (inowanzova 50~100mg/L). Kana ukasanganisa chipunu chikuru chimwe chevhiniga yeapple mu 1L yemvura ukashambidza kekupedzisira, kuoma kunoderera.
c-010.actionItem: Parwendo rwunotevera, tutirai poda ye citric acid kana bhodhoro diki revhiniga, mobvunza hotera kuti hardness yemvura yenzvimbo iyi i yakaita sei.

c-011.title: Ion exchange resin yesoft water filter inomutsiridzwa nemunyu
c-011.summary: Soft water filter yeshawa nemamwe water purifier anobata calcium ne ion exchange resin. Resin dzinomutsiridzwa nemvura yemunyu kana kuchinjwa, saka tarisai musati mathenga.
c-011.principle: Resin inobata calcium ichipa sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. Kana yazara, inodzoserwa nemvura ine munyu wakawanda.
c-011.example: Kana filter yekuchinja inodhura 10,000 won imwe uye ichichinjwa kamwe pamwedzi, inodhura 120,000 won pagore. Dzimwe dzinomutsiridzwa dzinogona kushandiswa makore mazhinji nemari yemakirogiramu mashoma emunyu chete.
c-011.actionItem: Enzanisai 'nguva yekuchinja' ne 'kugona kumutsiridzwa' kwefilter yamunoda kutenga, mozoverenga mari yepagore.

c-012.title: Heater ine limescale inoshandisa simba rakawanda uye inokurumidza kuora
c-012.summary: Kana limescale yaunganidzwa pa heating plate yekettle yemagetsi kana humidifier, kupisa hakutamirwi zvakanaka kumvura, nguva yekupisa inowedzera uye zvikamu zvinopisa zvikuru. Kubvisa nguva dzose kunobatsira simba nehupenyu.
c-012.principle: Kutamisa kupisa ndeye $q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, uye limescale ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) i insulating layer inovharira kupisa zvakanyanya kupfuura simbi.
c-012.example: Kana limescale yawanda ne 2mm kana kupfuura, nguva yekupisa kusvika patembiricha imwe chete inogona kuwedzera nemarimi mashoma muzana, uye tembiricha ye heating element inokwira ichideredza hupenyu. Kuchenesa necitric acid kamwe pamwedzi kunokwana.
c-012.actionItem: Isai pakarenda 'Svondo rekutanga romwedzi wega wega: kuchenesa kettle nehumidifier ne citric acid' sechinhu chinodzokororwa.

c-013.title: Kunyungudutsa chando nemunyu, nyatsodzvarira nokukanda shoma chando chisati chaitika
c-013.summary: Kukanda munyu mudiki kuchando chisati chauya kana chichangoda kuita, kunoda shoma kupfuura kunyungudutsa chando chakatoita. Izvi nokuti freezing point inodzika.
c-013.principle: Freezing point depression $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, $i \approx 2$ yeNaCl inenge 2)
c-013.example: Mvura yemunyu ye 10% yemass i $m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$ saka $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, zvinoreva kuti inotanga kuita chando pa -7℃. Pasi pe -10℃ simba rinoderera zvikuru, saka panguva iyoyo shandisai jecha.
c-013.actionItem: Kana nhasi manheru kuchirangarirwa kutonhora kuri pasi pe 0℃, kandai munyu mudiki (muromo wemaoko) wakapararira zvitete pamasitepisi ekupinda mumba.

c-014.title: Calcium chloride nemunyu, ndezvipi zvinoshandiswa kupi
c-014.summary: Calcium chloride inoshanda patembiricha dzakadzika, asi inokuvadza concrete nesimbi zvikuru. Sarudzai maererano netembiricha nenzvimbo.
c-014.principle: Calcium chloride inopisa kana ichinyungudika mumvura: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Simba chairo reNaCl rinosvika pa -10℃ uye re $\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ rinosvika pa -25℃. Pedyo neconcrete itsva kana ngoro dzesimbi, deredzai kushandisa chloride mushandise jecha.
c-014.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai zvigadzirwa (sodium chloride/calcium chloride) zvesaga yedeicer, mozviisa mucherechedzo kuti zvisashandiswe pedyo nengoro dzesimbi dzepamusuo.

c-015.title: Shambidza tsoka dzezvipfuyo nemaoko zvakagunzwa nedeicer
c-015.summary: Chloride deicer yakanyaiswa mumugwagwa inoomesa tsoka dzezvipfuyo uye kana ichidyiwa inogona kukonzera kurutsa. Shambidzai nemvura inodziya mushure mekufamba.
c-015.principle: Chloride inodhonza hunyoro hweganda ichiriomesa. Mvura ine munyu yakanyunguduka inosara nokuti zvakafanana nokudzika freezing point $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$.
c-015.example: Calcium chloride inopisa kana ichinyungudika, saka kana ikabata ganda rinonyorova inogona kurwadza. Kana ukashambidza tsoka mumvura inodziya kwemasekonzi 30 ukaomesa, zvakawanda zvinogadziriswa.
c-015.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekufamba, shambidzai tsoka dzezvipfuyo nemvura inodziya, uye vanhu vapukute nzvimbo dzepasi dzemhatso nemucheka unonyorova.

c-016.title: Tarisai freezing point ye washer fluid usati wafamba rwendo rurefu muchando
c-016.summary: Washer fluid inongova mvura inoita chando pa 0℃ ichivhara kuona. Washer fluid yechando ine alcohol inodzikisa freezing point.
c-016.principle: $\Delta T_f = K_f m$ saka kana alcohol yakawanda, freezing point inodzika, asi inopiswa nyore ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Zvigadzirwa zvine -20℃ kana -30℃ palabel hazvichiti chando kusvika patembiricha iyoyo, asi kana ukazvinyungudutsa nemvura freezing point inokwira. Zvigadzirwa zvine methanol zvine vapor inokuvadza, saka vhurai mawindo.
c-016.actionItem: Musati mabva, tarisai washer fluid yasara mutanki nechiratidzo che freezing point palabel.

c-017.title: Tenga antifreeze uchitarisa dilution ratio nechiratidzo chemhando
c-017.summary: Kana antifreeze (ethylene glycol) yasanganiswa ne coolant, freezing point inodzika uye boiling point inokwira. Tevedzai ratio nemhando kuti zvishande, uye musasanganise marudzi akasiyana.
c-017.principle: $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, uye kana ethylene glycol ichiva inenge 50 vol%, freezing point inova inenge -37℃ uye boiling point inenge 106℃.
c-017.example: Kana uchishandisa undiluted chete, freezing point inokwira uye kutamisa kupisa kunoipa. Ethylene glycol inotapira saka inouraya zvipfuyo, saka pukutai nokukurumidza kana yadeuka.
c-017.actionItem: Tarisai mhando ye antifreeze inokurudzirwa uye dilution ratio mubhuku remotokari, mozobvunza paunenge uchipiwa quotation kugaraji.

c-018.title: Condensation yemawindo muchando inofungidzirwa nedew point
c-018.summary: Kana mhepo ine hunyoro mukati yasangana negirazi rinotonhora, madonhwe emvura anoita, achikonzera mold nekurasikirwa nekupisa. Kuchengeta hunyoro hwemukati zvakakodzera kunoderedza kuparadza kupisa.
c-018.principle: Dew point ndeye approximate formula $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$), uye condensation ndiyo $\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: Kana mukati mune 22℃ uye hunyoro hwe 60%, dew point inenge 14℃. Kana pamusoro pemukati pegirazi pane 10℃, condensation inoitika, asi kana hunyoro hwaderedzwa kusvika 40~50%, dew point inova 10~12℃ ichidzivirira zvakawanda.
c-018.actionItem: Nhasi isai humidifier pa 40~50% hunyoro mugoongorora humidity meter manheru.

c-019.title: Shandisai bleach yakanyungudutswa zvakachengeteka pamold ye silicone yebhafurumu
c-019.summary: Mold nhema yakapararira pasilicone inobviswa nebleach ine oxidizing power. Vhurai mawindo uye muvise kure neacid zvigadzirwa.
c-019.principle: Oxidation ye hypochlorite: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$ uye $\mathrm{OCl^-}$ inoita oxidize pigment nemasero emold.
c-019.example: Nyungudutsai bleach yekutengesa (inenge 4~5%) nemvura 1:10, mugoikwiza, mugoshambidza nemvura zvakakwana mushure memaminetsi 10. Mold inokura pa relative humidity ye 60~70% kana kupfuura, saka kuvhura mawindo mushure mekushambidza kunodzivirira kudzoka.
c-019.actionItem: Nhasi vhurai windo rebhafurumu, pfekai magirovhosi, mupukute mold ye silicone nebleach yakanyungudutswa 1:10 mugoshambidza mushure memaminetsi 10.

c-020.title: Bvisai mold nemavara echiedza nesodium percarbonate zvakachengeteka
c-020.summary: Sodium percarbonate, oxygen bleach, haina kukuvadza sebleach uye haina njodzi yechlorine gas, saka inogona kushandiswa nepamicheka ine mavara. Inoshanda zvakanyanya mumvura inodziya.
c-020.principle: Sodium percarbonate inogura ichibudisa hydrogen peroxide: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \to 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-020.example: Nyungudutsai chipunu chikuru chimwe che sodium percarbonate (inenge 10g) mu 1L yemvura ye 40~50℃, mudziye kwemaminetsi 30 kusvika awa imwe, mavara eguruva nemold anobuda. Musashandise pawool kana silk.
c-020.actionItem: Nhasi dzvarai masokisi machena akayera kana dhishi retauro mumvura ye 40~50℃ ine chipunu chikuru che sodium percarbonate kwemaminetsi 30.

c-021.title: Dehumidifier yemuwadhiropu inogara kwenguva refu munzvimbo diki
c-021.summary: Calcium chloride dehumidifier inonwa hunyoro hwemumhepo ichiva mvura. Kana ichishandiswa munzvimbo diki dzakavharwa senge wadhiropu kana nzvimbo yeshangu pane kuva muimba hombe, inoshanda zvakanyanya.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$ inonwa hunyoro, uye kana ichinwa zvakawanda inonyungudika ichiva mvura.
c-021.example: Calcium chloride inonwa hunyoro hwakapetwa kakawanda huremu hwayo. Kana ichiiswa panzvimbo inovhurwa kazhinji inozara nokukurumidza, saka kunobatsira kuishandisa munzvimbo diki yakavharwa kwemwedzi kana kupfuura. Dururai mvura yakaungana kuti irege kubata ganda kana simbi.
c-021.actionItem: Nhasi isai dehumidifier imwe pasi pewadhiropu, uye edzai kuderedza kuvhura nokuvhara musuo.

c-022.title: Kasaga kadiki mukati mechikafu: silica gel ne quicklime zvakasiyana
c-022.summary: Desiccants dzepackaging yechikafu dzinowanzova silica gel ne quicklime, uye zviviri hazvidyiwi. Quicklime inopisa kana yasangana nemvura, saka chenjerai maziso nomuromo.
c-022.principle: Quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (exothermic, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). Silica gel inonamatidza mamolecule emvura pamusoro payo.
c-022.example: Silica gel inogona kushandiswazve kana yaoma muovheni ye 100~120℃ kwemaawa 1~2. Kana saga re quicklime rakanyorova, rinova mvura ye strong alkali, saka rirasei risingabatwi nemvura.
c-022.actionItem: Bvisai maseti e desiccant mudrawa rekicheni, mutarise chiratidzo che 'silica gel/quicklime', mozviisa kure nemaoko evana.

c-023.title: Kudzivirira kumhute kwemagirazi nemagogles nedonhwe imwe re surfactant
c-023.summary: Kana wapinda mukati inodziya uchibva panze muchando, kumhute kwelens kunoitika nemadonhwe madiki emvura. Kana ukaisa surfactant film, madonhwe anopararira ichiva film yakatetepa uye kuona kunochengetwa.
c-023.principle: Kana contact angle yakakura, madonhwe anoumba. Surfactant inodzikisa surface tension $\gamma$ ichiita kuti madonhwe apararire.
c-023.example: Kana ukapfapfaidza donhwe rimwe chete redhitajeni yekicheni pa lens uchipukuta nemucheka wakaoma, kumhute kunoderera kwemaawa akati. Lens ine coating inogona kukuvara, saka tarisai mirayiridzo yemugadziri.
c-023.actionItem: Nhasi musati mabuda, namatirai mask kumusoro pamhino, mozopfapfaidza donhwe redhitajeni pamagirazi mopukuta.

c-024.title: Chikafu chakapararira chitete uye chakaomeswa nokukurumidza chinoora shoma
c-024.summary: Kana chichiita chando zvishoma nezvishoma, ice crystals hombe dzinoparadza masero, saka mushure mekunyungudika mvura inobuda uye chinova chakaoma. Kupararira chitete uye kuchiita chando nokukurumidza kunoita crystals diki, ichichengeta hunhu.
c-024.principle: Hukuru hwe crystal hunoenderana nekukurumidza kwekutonhodza. Phase change $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$, $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$ kupisa kunofanira kubviswa.
c-024.example: Kana ukapararira soup kana nyama yakasara mu zipper bag ukakora 2cm uchiiisa pa metal tray kuti ive chando, inoita chando maawa akati nokukurumidza kupfuura kana chiri chimedu chimwe, uye kurasikirwa kwemvura mushure mekunyungudika kunoderera. Kuchengeta pa -18℃ kana pasi ndiyo mutemo.
c-024.actionItem: Nhasi pararirai chikafu chimwe chakasara chitete mu zipper bag, munyore musi, mugochiisa mu freezer.

c-025.title: Mbatatisi dzakamera kana dzakasvibira dzinobatwa saizvi
c-025.summary: Mikumbu nenzvimbo dzakasvibira dzembatatisi dzine solanine yakawanda, chinhu chine ruzha. Hachiparadzwi nyore kunyangwe wabika kana kuita fry, saka dzivisai nokuisa chete.
c-025.principle: Solanine inomira kupisa uye inongoparara padyo ne $290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kana yawana chiedza, kugadzirwa kwe solanine kunowedzera pamwe chete ne chlorophyll.
c-025.example: Kana ukacheka kuenda ku 1cm kana kupfuura kutenderedza mikumbu nenzvimbo dzakasvibira, zvakawanda zvinobviswa. Kana ganda rose rakasvibira kana kuvava, rasai. Kana ukachengeta munzvimbo ine rima rinotonhora (8~10℃), mikumbu inokura zvishoma nezvishoma.
c-025.actionItem: Nhasi putirai mbatatisi mupepa renhau muchiichengeta panzvimbo ine rima rinotonhora, uye mbatatisi dzakamera cheka kana kurasa.

c-026.title: Kuvhara kuchinja kuita brown kweapple ne avocado nedonhwe re lemon juice
c-026.summary: Muchero wakachekwa unoita brown nokuda kweenzyme reaction nomweya. Kana ukawedzera acid, reaction inononoka uye zvinodyiwa zvichiri zvakachengeteka.
c-026.principle: Polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) inodzorera quinone ichiita reduce.
c-026.example: Pa pH 4 kana pasi, enzyme inoshanda zvishoma zvikuru. Kana ukacheka apple imwe ukapfapfaidza teaspoon imwe ye lemon juice, kuita brown kunononoka kwemaawa 2~3. Nzvimbo dzakaita brown hadzina dambudziko guru pakudya kana kuchengeteka.
c-026.actionItem: Nhasi kana ukacheka apple kana avocado, tsvindai matoni mashoma e lemon juice kana kuinyika kwechinguvana mumvura ine munyu.

c-027.title: Pressure cooker inokwidza boiling point ichideredza nguva yekubika negasi
c-027.summary: Mubhoyilari rakavharwa, pressure inokwira uye mvura inovira patembiricha inopfuura 100℃. Kana tembiricha ikakwira, kukurumidza kwe chemical reaction kunowedzera.
c-027.principle: Maererano ne Clausius-Clapeyron relation, pa 2atm (absolute) mvura inovira pa $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Reaction rate $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: Kana tembiricha ikakwira ne 10℃, reaction rate inenge kaviri, saka ne 20℃ inenge ka 4. Bhinzi kana nyama yakaoma inotora maminetsi 60 mupoto yenguva dzose, asi mu pressure cooker anenge maminetsi 20, saka gasi rinoderera zvikuru.
c-027.actionItem: Nhasi edzai kubika chikafu chinotora nguva (bhinzi, nyama yakaoma) mu pressure cooker muenzanise nguva.

c-028.title: Chikonzero nei jamu ine shuga yakawanda inogara kwenguva refu pasina mold
c-028.summary: Shuga inobata mvura, saka mvura inogona kushandiswa nemicrobes inoderera. Kana ukachenesa mabhodhoro uye ukatevedza ratio yeshuga, inogona kuchengetwa kwenguva refu mu refrigerator.
c-028.principle: Kana water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ ikadzika pasi pe 0.85, mabhakitiriya mazhinji haakure, uye mold inokura kusvika padyo ne 0.8.
c-028.example: Jamu ine shuga yakatenderedza 60% ine $a_w \approx 0.80$, saka mabhakitiriya anodzivirirwa asi mold inogona kukura. Kana ukaiisa mubhodhoro rakachenesa nemvura inovira, uchichengeta mufiriji usati wavhura uye ukadya mukati memavhiki 2~3 mushure mekuvhura, unoderedza kurasikirwa.
c-028.actionItem: Nhasi bikai michero yakasara ne 40~50% yeshuga muite jamu, mugoiisa mubhodhoro rakachenesa mugonyora musi.

c-029.title: Pukuta mafuta epani kutanga, mozoshambidza nemvura inodziya
c-029.summary: Mafuta akatonhorera anoomarara uye haabviswi zvakanaka nedhitajeni nemvura. Kana ukapukuta kutanga nekitchen towel ukashandisa mvura inodziya nedhitajeni, unochengetedza dhitajeni nemvura.
c-029.principle: Mafuta anoita reaction ne alkali/surfactant achiita sipo yakareruka kushambidza: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Mafuta enguruve anotanga kunyungudika pa 30~40℃, saka mvura ye 40℃ inosunungura mafuta. Kana ukapukuta kutanga, mvura yekushambidza dhishi inoderera nehafu uye kuvharika kwedhorena kunodzivirirwa.
c-029.actionItem: Nhasi musati mashambidza dhishi, pukutai mafuta epani nekitchen towel kutanga, mozoshambidza nemvura inodziya.

c-030.title: Kana ukamisa kubika fry/kutsvaira pa golden yakachenuruka, acrylamide inoderera
c-030.summary: Kana mbatatisi kana chingwa zvikabikwa nekupisa kwakanyanya kusvika pa brown yakasviba, acrylamide inowedzera. Kumira pa golden brown kunochengeta kunaka uye kunoderedza kugadzirwa.
c-030.principle: Asparagine ne reducing sugar zvinoita Maillard reaction pa $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kana kupfuura, uye acrylamide ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$) inoitika.
c-030.example: Kana ukamisa fries pa golden pa 175℃ kana pasi uye usingachengeti mbatatisi mufiriji, shuga haiwedzere uye huwandu hunogadzirwa hunogona kuderera zvikuru. Zviri nani kusadya nzvimbo dzakasviba kana dzakatsva.
c-030.actionItem: Nhasi bvisai toast kana mbatatisi yakagochwa isati yasvika pa brown yakasviba, mucheke nzvimbo dzakatsva.

c-031.title: Disposable hot pack inopisa nokuti simbi inoita ngura
c-031.summary: Iron powder mukati me hot pack inosangana nomweya mumhepo ichiita oxidation ichipa kupisa. Inobatsira parwendo rwechando, asi kana yakanamira ganda kwenguva refu pane njodzi ye low-temperature burn.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ i exothermic reaction, uye activated carbon nemunyu zvinoita kuti reaction ikurumidze.
c-031.example: Tembiricha yepamusoro inenge 50~60℃ uye inogara kwemaawa akati. Namatirai pamusoro pembatya yekunze kwe underwear, uye bvisai paunorara kuti mudzivirire low-temperature burn. Isati yavhurwa, packaging yakavharwa inovhara mhepo.
c-031.actionItem: Nhasi paunoshandisa hot pack, namatirai pamusoro pembatya, uye tarisai ganda mushure meawa yega yega.

c-032.title: Charcoal deodorizer inonamatidza, haiparadze
c-032.summary: Charcoal ne activated carbon zvinobata mamolecule enhuhwa pamusoro pazvo zvichideredza kunhuwa. Kana yazara, haishande, saka tevedzai nguva yekuchinja kana kumutsiridza.
c-032.principle: Adsorption inzvimbo iyo mamolecule anonamatira pamusoro; surface area yeactivated carbon inosvika $500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: 100g yeactivated carbon inogona kuva nesurface area yakaita sebhawa renhabvu, saka inobata nhuhwa yechikamu chimwe chefiriji. Charcoal inogona kumutsiridzwa zvishoma kana ikaomeswa nezuva kamwe pamwedzi, uye kuchinjwa mushure memwedzi 3~6.
c-032.actionItem: Nyorai musi wawachinja fridge deodorizer palabel, uye isai reminder yemwedzi mitatu.

c-033.title: Kunyika mupunga kwemaminetsi 30 kunoderedza simba rekubika
c-033.summary: Mupunga wakanyikwa wakatoita unonwa mvura, saka nguva yekupisa inopfupika uye sadza rinobika zvakaenzana. Kushandisa magetsi kana gasi kunoderera zvishoma.
c-033.principle: Starch inonwa mvura ichiita gelatinization: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ gel yakazvimba. Gelatinization inoitika pa $60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: Kana mupunga wanyikwa kwemaminetsi 30, unonwa mvura inenge 20~25% yehuremu uye mvura inosvika mukati. Nguva yekubika inopfupika kwemaminetsi mashoma pane pasina kunyika, saka kana ukabika zuva roga, unochengetedza maminetsi mazhinji pamwedzi. Muchando, mvura inodziya inokurumidza.
c-033.actionItem: Manheru ano shambai mupunga, unyike kwemaminetsi 30, mugobika, muenzanise nguva yekubika.

c-034.title: Kugeza maoko kwemasekonzi 20 ndiyo nguva inodiwa nesipo kupoteredza tsvina
c-034.summary: Mamolecule esipo ane divi rinoda mafuta nedivi rinoda mvura, saka anopoteredza tsvina nemajeremusi ozvibvisa. Maitiro aya anoda kukwizwa nenguva.
c-034.principle: Sipo inoumba micelles pa critical micelle concentration (CMC) kana kupfuura ichipoteredza mafuta: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: Kana ukakwiza sipo pachanza, kumusoro kwemaoko, pakati pezvigunwe, nepasi pezvipikiri kwemasekonzi 20 (nziyo yekuzvarwa kaviri), majeremusi enguva dzose anoderera zvikuru. Tembiricha yemvura inosarudzwa nekudzivirira ganda, kwete simba.
c-034.actionItem: Nhasi paunogeza maoko, verengai masekonzi 20 netaimba kana nziyo, mukwize kusvika pasi pezvipikiri.

c-035.title: Lip balm yechando inoumba film, haisi hunyoro
c-035.summary: Lip balm ye hydrocarbon senge Vaseline inoumba hydrophobic film inodzivirira hunyoro kubuda mumiromo. Kana ichiiswa pamiromo yakanyorova kana yakapfava, inoshanda zvakanyanya.
c-035.principle: Kukurumidza kwekupera kwemvura kunoenderana nokusiyana kwe vapor pressure yemvura pamusoro peganda, uye film ye petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ haisanganisiwi nemvura ichinonotsa kupera.
c-035.example: Mukati meimba yakaoma muchando (relative humidity inenge 20%), hunyoro hwemiromo isina chinhu hunopera nokukurumidza. Kana ukaisa Vaseline yakatetepa, kupera kunoderera zvakajeka uye kuputika kunoderera.
c-035.actionItem: Nhasi musati mavata, nyorovesai miromo nemvura mozoisa lip balm yakatetepa nhete imwe.

c-036.title: Isai hand cream ganda richiri rakanyorova kuti irambe kwenguva refu
c-036.summary: Kana ukaisa pamaoko akanyorova, moisturizer inobata hunyoro zvakanyanya. Nehuwandu hwakaenzana maoko anova anonyorova zvakanyanya, saka cream inoda shoma.
c-036.principle: Kurasikirwa kwehunyoro hweganda kunotevera mutemo we diffusion $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$, glycerin inodhonza mvura uye Vaseline inodzivirira kupera.
c-036.example: Mukati memaminetsi 3 mushure mekushamba kana kugeza maoko, pukuta zvishoma nechiremba uye isa huwandu hwakaita sebhinzi rakanaka, saka kunyangwe muchando chakaoma unogona kuderedza huwandu hwunoiswa kaviri kana katatu pazuva. Kupfeka magirovhosi paunorara kunobatsira zvikuru.
c-036.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekugeza maoko, musati mapukuta zvizere, isai hand cream yakaita sebhinzi rimwe.

c-037.title: Sarudzai face wash ine weak acid sepeganda (pH inenge 5.5)
c-037.summary: Pamusoro peganda pane weak-acid protective layer, saka sipo ine pH yakakwira inogona kuiparadza. Muchando chakaoma, weak-acid cleanser haikuvadzi.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Pamusoro peganda pH i 4.5~5.5 uye sipo yenguva dzose i pH 9~10, saka $\mathrm{[H^+]}$ iri pasi nenge kakawanda kane zviuru gumi.
c-037.example: pH 5.5 ne pH 9.5 zvine musiyano wehydrogen ion concentration we $10^4$. Face wash yakanyorwa 'weak acid' palabel haikukwevi ganda mushure mekugeza uye inoderedza huwandu hwemoisturizer.
c-037.actionItem: Paunotenga face wash inotevera, tarisai pH mutsananguro yechigadzirwa, munyore kuti ganda rinonzwika sei mushure mekugeza.

c-038.title: Chikonzero nei power bank inoderera capacity kana kuchitonhora
c-038.summary: Lithium-ion batteries patembiricha yakadzika dzinoita chemical reaction nekufamba kwe ion zvichinonoka, saka capacity inogoneka kushandiswa inoderera. Kuiisa mupokisi remukati kunoderedza discharge.
c-038.principle: Mu reaction rate $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, kana $T$ ikadzika, $k$ inova diki uye internal resistance ye battery inowedzera.
c-038.example: Padyo ne 0℃ capacity inogona kuderera ne 20~30% uye pa -10℃ yakawanda kupfuura iyoyo. Power bank ye 10,000 mAh inogona kuburitsa inenge 7,000 mAh chete panze muchando, saka kuchaja kunonzwika kuderera.
c-038.actionItem: Nhasi paunobuda, isai power bank nefoni mupokisi remukati rejasi kuti zvichengetwe zvichidziya nekupisa kwemuviri.

c-039.title: Power bank inobvumidzwa mundege inoverengwa mu Wh
c-039.summary: Lithium batteries dzinobvumidzwa chete mu carry-on baggage, kwete checked baggage, uye muganhu wecapacity uri mu Wh. Kutarisa mAh chete kunovhiringidza, saka verengai pachenyu.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (nominal lithium-ion 3.7V). 100Wh kana pasi inobvumidzwa, 100~160Wh inoda kubvumidzwa neairline.
c-039.example: 20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7V = 74Wh hapana dambudziko, uye 27,000 mAh i 99.9Wh padyo nomuganhu. 30,000 mAh (111Wh) inoda kubvumidzwa.
c-039.actionItem: Nhasi pindirai mAh yepower bank yenyu ne 3.7V muve Wh, mozotarisa kana label iine Wh.

c-040.title: Dzivirirai carbon monoxide poisoning kana muchishandisa heating kana charcoal muchando
c-040.summary: Kana mafuta akabva asina kutsva zvizere munzvimbo isina mhepo, carbon monoxide isina kunhuwa inoitika. Musashandise charcoal, briquettes kana camping stove mukati meimba.
c-040.principle: Kana oxygen isina kukwana, $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$ carbon monoxide inoitika, uye CO inobatana ne hemoglobin nesimba rinenge ka 200 kupfuura oxygen.
c-040.example: Pa CO concentration yemumhepo ye 200ppm, musoro unorwadza mumaawa akati, uye pa 800ppm kana kupfuura pane njodzi mukati meawa imwe. Tarisai kubatana kwe boiler exhaust pipe nemhepo, mugoisa CO alarm.
c-040.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai kubatana kwe boiler exhaust pipe, mugoongorora batiri re CO alarm.

c-041.title: Kana moto wegasi une yellow, mafuta ari kurasika
c-041.summary: Moto wegasi wakajairika une blue, uye kana une yellow kana orange pane incomplete combustion, soot ne carbon monoxide zvinowedzera. Kuchenesa burner kunodzosera kushanda zvakanaka.
c-041.principle: Complete combustion: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Kana oxygen isina kukwana $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: Kana moto une yellow wakasvibisa pasi pepoto, kupisa kunotamiswa shoma uye mafuta anoshandiswa akaenzana kana kupfuura. Kana ukabvisa zvisara zvechikafu mumakomba e burner nechinhu chitete, kazhinji moto unodzoka kuva blue.
c-041.actionItem: Nhasi chenesai makomba e burner yechitofu negasi nechinhu chitete, mugoongorora ruvara rwemoto.

c-042.title: Dzivirirai lead-acid battery yemotokari kuti irege kuderera muchando muchichengetedza mari yekuchinja
c-042.summary: Kutonhora nekufamba kwenguva pfupi kunodzokororwa kunoita kuti lead-acid battery iderere uye hupenyu hwayo huderere. Kana yaderera, electrolyte inobva yaita yakawanda mvura uye inogona kuita chando mukutonhora.
c-042.principle: Discharge: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. Sulfuric acid inoshandiswa, saka freezing point ye electrolyte inokwira.
c-042.example: Electrolyte ye battery yakazara inoita chando pa -60℃, asi kana yaderera inogona kuita chando pa -7℃. Kufamba kwemaminetsi 30 kana kupfuura kamwe pasvondo kana kuchaja nechaja kunononotsa mari yekuchinja yemakumi eshumiwo zviuru zve won.
c-042.actionItem: Nhasi usati watanga injini, dzimai heater, nezvimwe zvemagetsi, mugoisa chirongwa chekufamba kwemaminetsi 30 kamwe pasvondo.

c-043.title: Kugadzirisa cast-iron pan seasoning ndiyo polymerization yemafuta ichiomarara
c-043.summary: Pani itsva ye cast iron kana yakaiswa mafuta matete ikabikwa patembiricha yakakwira, inoumba film yakasimba inoderedza ngura nekunamira. Kana ukaisa mafuta akakora, anonamira.
c-043.principle: Unsaturated fatty acids dzinoita reaction ne oxygen ichiita polymerize. Ngura inoitika sezvinoratidzwa ne $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: Isai mafuta shoma zvikuru, mupukute nekitchen towel, mugobika muovheni pa 220℃ kwe 1 awa, film inoitika. Mushure mekushandisa, omesai nokukurumidza, saka pani yakagadziriswa kamwe inogona kushandiswa kwemakore, saka haidhuri.
c-043.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekushamba pani ye cast iron kana yesimbi, isei pamoto kuti mvura ipere, mugopukuta mafuta matete.

c-044.title: Pukuta zvipunu zvesirivha zvakashanduka ruvara nealuminum foil nebaking soda
c-044.summary: Silver sulfide nhema pamusoro pesirivha inodzorerwa kuita sirivha nemaitiro e electrochemical reaction. Hazvidi kukwiza, saka sirivha inodonha shoma. Inonhuwa sulfur, saka vhurai mawindo.
c-044.example: Nyungudutsai chipunu chikuru chimwe chebaking soda mu 500mL yemvura inopisa, mudzike zvinhu zvesirivha zvichibata foil kwemaminetsi 2~5. Musashandise pazvinhu zvine pearls, mabwe anokosha kana zvibato zvakanamirwa.
c-044.actionItem: Nhasi dzikai chipunu chimwe chesirivha chakashanduka ruvara mumvura inopisa ine foil nebaking soda.

c-045.title: Verdigris yebhuruu pamapoto ecopper haifaniri kudyiwa
c-045.summary: Kana copper yasangana neacid nehunyoro, verdigris yebhuruu inoitika uye inouraya. Musasiye chikafu chine acid mukati mecopper kwenguva refu, mugotarisa mamiriro ecoating yemukati.
c-045.principle: Copper oxide inonyungudika muvhiniga: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. Verdigris i $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Mapoto ecopper akachengeteka kana mukati mavo makavharwa netin kana stainless steel. Verdigris yekunze inogona kupukutwa nepaste ye 1 vhiniga : 1 munyu kwemaminetsi 5 mozoshambidzwa. Kana coating yemukati yabva, musabika.
c-045.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai mamiriro ecoating yemukati yepoto yecopper, uye kana yabva musaishandise kubika.

c-046.title: Poto rakabatidzwa rinonyikwa nokubikisa baking soda kuti rishandise simba shoma
c-046.summary: Panzvimbo yekukwiza kwenguva refu nesimba nemvura inopisa, kubikisa nemhinduro ye weak alkaline kunosunungura zvakatsva nesimba shoma. Pasi pe aluminum pots pachashanduka ruvara, saka dzivisai.
c-046.principle: Kana yapiswa, $\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ sodium carbonate inoitika uye pH inokwira kusvika padyo ne 11.
c-046.example: Isai zvipunu zvikuru zviviri zvebaking soda mu 500mL yemvura mubike nemoto mudiki kwemaminetsi 10, zvakatsva zvinosunungurwa. Kunoshandisa mvura nedhitajeni shoma kupfuura kukwiza uchirega mvura yepombi ichipfuura, uye kunochengeta mvura inopisa.
c-046.actionItem: Nhasi isai mvura nezvipunu zvikuru zviviri zvebaking soda mupoto rakatsva, mubike kwemaminetsi 10, mudzikise mozopukuta.

c-047.title: Mbatya dzine ropa dzitange kushambidzwa nemvura inotonhora
c-047.summary: Mavara eropa anobviswa kana ushambidza kutanga nemvura inotonhora iri pasi pe 20℃, kwete inodziya.
c-047.principle: Mapuroteni eropa se hemoglobin ne fibrinogen anoshanduka nekuomarara kana awana kupisa uye anonamira pamucheka. Hydrogen peroxide inoparara kana yasangana ne catalase mukati meropa: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: Shati yecotton yakashambidzwa nemvura inopisa ye 60℃ inoita mavara eropa akaomarara brown, asi kana ukainyika mumvura inotonhora ye 15℃ kwemaminetsi 5 ukaisa madonhwe mashoma e 3% hydrogen peroxide, furo (oxygen) rinoitika uye zvakawanda zvinobuda. Shandisai pambatya chena chete, uye edza pamberi panzvimbo isingaoneki pambatya dzine mavara.
c-047.actionItem: Nhasi kana mavara aitika, shandisai mvura inotonhora panzvimbo yemvura inopisa, mugoshambidza kubva kumashure kuenda kumberi.

c-048.title: Shandisai detergent shoma yakakodzera maererano nehardness yemvura
c-048.summary: Kuwedzera detergent kupfuura huwandu hunokurudzirwa hakuwedzeri simba rekuchenesa, asi kunongowedzera mvura yekushambidza nemari yedetergent.
c-048.principle: Surfactant yedetergent kana yapfuura critical micelle concentration (CMC) haichabvisi tsvina yakawanda. Calcium ions dzemvura yakaoma dzinoita precipitate yesipo: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: Kana washing machine ye 2kg ikawedzerwa 80mL yedetergent inokurudzirwa 40mL, mhedzisiro yekuchenesa yakafanana, asi detergent yakasara inoda kushambidza kamwe kunowedzera. Kana ukachengeta 40mL pakushambidza kwega kwega kwakaita 20 pamwedzi, unochengetedza 9.6L pagore, inenge 20,000 won.
c-048.actionItem: Nhasi usati washambidza, tarisai mamaki ari pachivharo chedetergent, mugoyera huwandu hunokurudzirwa chete.

c-049.title: Ultrafine dust inogadzirwa mumhepo
c-049.summary: Chikamu chakakura che PM2.5 hachibvi mumachimney asi chinogadzirwa nemhepo ye chemical reaction, saka masiki e KF94 anobatsira kana kuchinge kwakakwira muchirimo.
c-049.principle: Sulfur oxides ne nitrogen oxides zvinoita reaction ne ammonia zvichiita secondary particles: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: Pakakwira ultrafine dust muKorea, ammonium nitrate ne ammonium sulfate zvinogona kuita padyo nehafu ye PM2.5. KF94 inosefa 94% kana kupfuura yema particles e 0.4μm, asi inoshanda kana yanamatira zvakanaka kumeso.
c-049.actionItem: Nhasi kana fine dust forecast ichiti 'yakaipa', musati mabuda, dzvanyai nose clip yemask kuti inamatire pasina mukaha.

c-050.title: Water-repellent coating yegirazi remotokari i silane film inoita kuti mvura ibude
c-050.summary: Water-repellent coating inoumba film ye siloxane/fluorine molecules pamusoro pegirazi ichiita kuti mvura nechando zvidonhe sedonhwe. Kuona kunova kwakanaka, saka kutyaira muchando kunochengeteka.
c-050.principle: $\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ yegirazi inobatana ne silane ichiita film ye $\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$, uye outer hydrophobic chains dzinowedzera contact angle $\theta$ yemadonhwe kusvika $100^\circ$ kana kupfuura.
c-050.example: Contact angle yegirazi isina coating i inenge $30^\circ$ ichiita kuti mvura ipararire, asi pagirazi ine coating i $100^\circ$ kana kupfuura, saka madonhwe anopfurwa nemhepo ye 60~80km paawa. Coating inowanzopera mushure memwedzi mishoma.
c-050.actionItem: Svondo rino, chenesai windscreen kuti mubvise oil film, muisa water-repellent coating yakatetepa, mugopukuta nemucheka wakaoma.

c-051.title: Chikonzero nei cotton ne polyester dzichiomeswa nokukurumidza kwakasiyana
c-051.summary: Sarudzai polyester yemichina, uye cotton yeunderwear netauro kuti kutonga ziya nehunyoro kuve nyore.
c-051.principle: Cotton cellulose ine -OH groups dzakawanda dzinoita hydrogen bonds nemvura ichinwa kusvika inenge 25% yehunyoro, asi polyester i hydrophobic ine ester bonds ichinwa 0.4% chete. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: Kana t-shirt ye 100g ikanyoroveswa neziya, cotton inobata ziya uye inotora maawa 2 kana kupfuura kuoma, asi polyester inoomera mukati meawa imwe. Zvisinei, polyester inobata mamolecule enhuhwa mu fibers, saka inoda kushambidzwa.
c-051.actionItem: Paunotenga mbatya inotevera, tarisai chiyero chekusanganisa palabel, mugoona kana mbatya dzemitambo dzine polyester yakawanda.

c-052.title: Mari yegasi remudhorobha inoverengwa nekupisa, kwete volume
c-052.summary: Mari yegasi remudhorobha inoverengwa nekupisa, sezvakaunzwa nokuwanza volume (㎥) ne conversion factor (MJ/㎥). Kana waziva chikamu chekupisa mubhiri, kuenzanisa kushandiswa kwekupisa kunova nyore.
c-052.principle: Methane combustion: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. 1㎥ yegasi remudhorobha i inenge $42\ \mathrm{MJ}$.
c-052.example: Kana kushandiswa kwegasi pamwedzi i 50㎥, i inenge $50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$. Kana ukaderedza tembiricha ye boiler kuderedza kushandiswa ne 10%, unochengetedza inenge 210MJ.
c-052.actionItem: Nhasi tsvakai kushandiswa kwemwedzi uno (㎥) mubhiri regasi, muenzanise nemwedzi wapfuura, mugonyora.

c-053.title: Bvisai ngura nesitiriki asidhi (citric acid)
c-053.summary: Ngura tsvuku pamidziyo midiki yesimbi inopera kazhinji kana ukaiisa mumhinduro ye citric acid.
c-053.principle: Iron(III) oxide inonyungudika ichiita chelate ne citric acid: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, ipapo $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ inobatana ne citrate ions.
c-053.example: Nyungudutsai 25g ye citric acid (5%) mu 500mL yemvura, mudzike masinga akaita ngura kwemaawa 4~6, mozokwiza nebrush, ngura inobuda. Musambosanganisa nechlorine cleaner, uye mushure mekukwiza, omesai nokukurumidza muisa mafuta matete.
c-053.actionItem: Nhasi dzikai chishandiso chimwe chidiki chakaita ngura mu 5% citric acid, mangwana muchiomese muchiisa mafuta.

c-054.title: Oxygen bleach inoshanda mumvura inodziya
c-054.summary: Sodium percarbonate inoshanda zvakanyanya mumvura ye 40℃, ichidzorera mbatya chena nemari shoma.
c-054.principle: Sodium percarbonate inoparadzaniswa mumvura kuita hydrogen peroxide ne sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, ipapo $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: Kana ukanyungudutsa 25g ye sodium percarbonate mu 5L yemvura ye 40℃ ukadzika masokisi machena akaita yellow kwe 1 awa, anova machena. Inodhura shoma kupfuura bleach yekutengesa, haina nhuhwa yechlorine, uye musaishandise pawool kana silk.
c-054.actionItem: Nhasi dzikai mbatya chena imwe mumvura ye 40℃ ine 5g/L ye sodium percarbonate.

c-055.title: Mwaka we pollen, shambidzai mhino ne saline solution
c-055.summary: Pa spring allergies, kushambidza mhino ne 0.9% saline kunosuka pollen yakanamira pa mucous membrane.
c-055.principle: 0.9% NaCl, iri isotonic (osmotic pressure yakaenzana nemvura yemuviri), haizvimbi kana kuperera masero e mucous membrane. Osmotic pressure: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: Nyungudutsai 4.5g yemunyu (0.9%) mu 500mL yemvura yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa, uye dzivisai kushandisa mvura yepombi zvakananga. Mvura isina munyu i hypotonic saka inopisa.
c-055.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekudzoka kumba, shambidzai mhino mbiri kamwe kamwe nesaline spray yekutengesa.

c-056.title: Kunhuwa kwemachira hakuzi ziya, asi mabhakitiriya anodya ziya
c-056.summary: Ziya pachaiyo harina kunhuwa zvakanyanya; mabhakitiriya ari mumachira anoparadza mafuta nemapuroteni eziya achigadzira fatty acids dzinonhuwa. Baking soda inoita neutralize nhuhwa iyi ye acid uye inoderedza hunyoro.
c-056.principle: Fatty acids ine tcheni pfupi (semuenzaniso isovaleric acid) dzinoita reaction ne weak base: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: Isai 1~2 teaspoons yebaking soda mumachira mamwe chete uye musiye husiku hwese, nhuhwa ye acid inoderera uye hunyoro hunonwiwa. Mangwana, zunguzai muzopfeka.
c-056.actionItem: Nhasi paunobvisa machira, pfapfaidzai chipunu chimwe chebaking soda mukati, mogosiya husiku hwese.

c-057.title: Nhamba dziri pasi peplastic, kana inogona kupinda microwave
c-057.summary: Nhamba yekushandiswazve iri pasi pechinhu inoratidza kana chinogona kushandiswa mu microwave nechikafu chinopisa.
c-057.principle: PP (nhamba 5) ine melting point yakakwirira inenge 160℃ saka inoshandiswa mu microwave, uye PS (nhamba 6) foam containers dzinoshanduka pa 80℃. Polymerization: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: Bhokisi ye PP yemasikati inoshanduka shoma kunyangwe ichiiswa soup ye 100℃ kana kupfuura, asi kupisa chikafu chine mafuta chinopisa mu disposable PS cup noodle container kunogona kuinyungudutsa. Tarisaiwo chiratidzo che 'microwave safe' palabel.
c-057.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai nhamba dziri pasi pemidziyo mitatu yamunoshandisa kazhinji, mubvise isiri nhamba 5 mu microwave.

c-058.title: Vitamin A, D, E, K dzinonwiwa kana dzadyiwa nemafuta
c-058.summary: Fat-soluble vitamins hadzinyungudiki mumvura, saka dzinoda mafuta kuti dzinwiwe mu small intestine dzakatakurwa mu micelles. Kudya karoti kana supplements nokuzvimba isina chikafu kunogona kuderedza kunwiwa.
c-058.principle: Nonpolar molecules dzinonyungudika mukati me micelles dzinoumbwa ne bile acids uye dzinotamiswa. Kana pasina mafuta, micelles dzinoita shoma uye kunwiwa kunoderera.
c-058.example: Beta-carotene inozivikanwa kunwiwa kakawanda kana karoti yakakangwa ne teaspoon yemafuta e olive kupfuura karoti mbishi. Zviri nani kunwa vitamin D supplement pakudya.
c-058.actionItem: Nhasi kana muchinwa vitamin D kana fat-soluble supplement, inwai pakudya kune mafuta.

c-059.title: Bvisai mavara ekapu yetii nebaking soda
c-059.summary: Mavara etii kana kofi mukati mekapu anobviswa kana ukakwiza nepaste yebaking soda, nesimba shoma rekukwiza nealkaline.
c-059.principle: Tannin ne polyphenol dzetii dzinonyungudika zvakanaka mu alkali. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, weak alkaline pH inenge 8.3
c-059.example: Sanganisai chipunu chikuru chimwe chebaking soda ne teaspoon imwe yemvura, mukwize nesiponji kwemaminetsi 1, kunyangwe kapu ine makore 5 inobva yabvisa brown film kazhinji. Hapana mari yekutenga cleaner yakasiyana.
c-059.actionItem: Nhasi pukutai mug imwe ine limescale nepaste yebaking soda.

c-060.title: Coffee grounds hadzisi manyowa pakarepo
c-060.summary: Coffee grounds dzinofanira kuomeswa zvakakwana uye dzisanganiswe shoma; kukanda zvakawanda kunokonzera mold nekudzivirira kukura.
c-060.principle: Compost inoshanda zvakanaka kana C/N ratio iri inenge 25~30:1. Coffee grounds dzine inenge 20:1 yakazara nitrogen, uye caffeine residue inogona kudzivirira mbeu.
c-060.example: Kana ukasanganisa chete 10% kana pasi yevolume yevhu rembiya (100mL yegrounds pa 1L yevhu) yakaoma, unogona kuishandisa zvakachengeteka. Kana ukaisa yakanyorova yakakora, mold inoitika.
c-060.actionItem: Nhasi pararirai coffee grounds dzamakanwa pamupepa wenhau muzviome.

c-061.title: Kana aspirin inonhuwa sevhiniga
c-061.summary: Kana bhodhoro reaspirin rinonhuwa sevhiniga, ayo anenge atoparadzwa nehunyoro uye haafaniri kunwiwa, rasai.
c-061.principle: Acetylsalicylic acid inoparara kana yasangana nemvura: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (salicylic acid + acetic acid)
c-061.example: Kana ukaiisa panzvimbo ine humidity yakapfuura 80% senge shelfu rebhafurumu, hydrolysis inoitika mukati memwedzi mishoma. Chengetai mudrawa rinotonhora uye rakaoma rakavharwa, uye isai saga rimwe re silica gel pamwe chete.
c-061.actionItem: Nhasi bvisai mishonga nemasupplements akachengetwa mubhafurumu muaise mudrawa rakaoma.

c-062.title: Jaketi isingapinzi mvura, kupisa kunovandudza kuvhara kwayo
c-062.summary: Kana jaketi isingapinzi mvura isingaite madonhwe, mushure mekushambidza uye kuomesa nekupisa kushoma, unogona kuvandudza chidziviriro chemvura.
c-062.principle: DWR coating ine hydrophobic fluorine neyehydrocarbon chains dzakamira pamusoro petambo uye kusungana kwemvura kunoita kuti madonhwe ave mabhora. Contact angle $\theta>90^\circ$, equation yaYoung: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Detergent nemarara zvinotsikisa chains, saka kana wakashambidza nedetergent isina acid kana alkali uye woomesa mudryer pakupisa kwepakati (anenge 40~60℃) kwemaminetsi 20 kana kutsvaira zvishoma, chains dzinomira zvakare uye madonhwe anoumbwa. Kana zvisingashande, shandisa waterproof spray.
c-062.actionItem: Nhasi dhonza mvura pajaketi yako isingapinzi mvura utarise kana madonhwe achiita mabhora.

c-063.title: 20-10-10 pabhegi refetiraiza zvinorevei
c-063.summary: Nhamba dzeN-P-K pabhegi refetiraiza dzinoratidza nitrogen, phosphorus nepotassium (%), saka sarudza mwero unoenderana nezvirimwa.
c-063.principle: Zvirimwa zvinoshandisa nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+) kumashizha, phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$) kumidzi nemaruva, potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$) kumadzinde nezvibereko. Hydrolysis yeurea: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: 1kg yefetiraiza ye20-10-10 ine nitrogen 200g, phosphate 100g, potassium 100g. Kuzvirimwa zvemashizha, nitrogen yakawanda inokodzera, kumaruva nezvibereko phosphorus nepotassium yakawanda. Kana ukapfuura mwero walabel, midzi inopisa.
c-063.actionItem: Nhasi tsvaga kamwe mwero weN-P-K unokodzera zvirimwa zvaunorima.

c-064.title: Alkaline neLithium AA, shandisa kupi
c-064.summary: Kuremote shandisa alkaline, uye kuchando kana zvishandiso zvinoda simba guru, lithium primary batteries dzinogara nguva refu.
c-064.principle: Alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. Pakupisa kwakaderera electrolyte yemvura inononoka, asi lithium primary cell ine non-aqueous electrolyte inoshanda kusvika -40℃.
c-064.example: Mudigital camera, alkaline AA mbiri dzinowanzo tora mifananidzo 300 kunenge, lithium AA 800 kana kupfuura. Asi kumidziyo inoshandisa simba shoma senge remote nekoloko yemadziro, alkaline inodhura shoma uye yakanaka.
c-064.actionItem: Nhasi nyora kuti chishandiso chimwe nechimwe chinokodzera alkaline kana lithium.

c-065.title: Ruvara rwehydrangea runotarirwa neacidity yevhu
c-065.summary: Bhuruu nepinki yehydrangea zvinoenderana nepH yevhu, saka unogona kugadzirisa vhu kuti uwane ruvara runodiwa.
c-065.principle: Muvhu rine acid (pH pasi pe5.5) aluminium inonyungudika se$\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$, ichisunga neanthocyanin uye ichiita bhuruu, uye muvhu risina acid kana alkaline inogadzika se$\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$ ichiita pinki: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: Kana ukapa hydrangea yepinki aluminium sulfate inenge 3g paL imwe yemvura mwedzi wega wega, mushure memwedzi mishoma bhuruu inowedzera. Pane zvimwe, kana ukakwidza pH kusvika 6.5 nechimbuzi, inova pinki. Zvakawandisa zvinokuvadza midzi.
c-065.actionItem: Nhasi dzvanya pepa repH pavhu rehari uye usarudze ruvara rwaunoda.

c-066.title: Nei sweta yeruvara inoderera
c-066.summary: Sweta yeruvara inoderera nemvura inopisa nekukwesha, saka shambidza nemaoko nemvura inodziya nedetergent isina acid kana alkali.
c-066.principle: Voro idundira keratin uye kunze kwayo kwakaita sezvikwanya kunosungana nekukwesha kuita felting. Alkali nekupisa zvinodzosera peptide bonds nemvura: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: Kana ukadzvinyirira kwemaminetsi 2~3 mumvura iri pasi pe30℃ nedetergent isina acid kana alkali, usingatsvanzi, uchibvisa mvura netauro uye woomesa wakarara pasi, kuderera kunenge kusipo. Chirongwa chakajairika che40℃ mumuchina wekushambidza chinogona kudzikisa hukuru kamwe chete, uye sweta inodhura inoparara.
c-066.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa zviratidzo zvekushambidza pambatya yeruvara uye gadzirira detergent isina acid kana alkali yega.

c-067.title: Vitamin C inorwara nemwenje nemhepo
c-067.summary: Mapiritsi evitamin C anofanira kuchengetwa kure nezuva nemvura, mubhodhoro rakasviba rakavharwa zvakasimba.
c-067.principle: Ascorbic acid inoita oxidation nemhepo: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), kupisa nemwenje zvinokurumidza.
