c-067.example: Vitamin C yeupfu mubhodhoro rakavhurika pa25℃ neunyoro 70% inotsvukira mumavhiki mashoma uye simba rinoderera. Kana ukaichengeta panzvimbo inotonhorera, chigadzirwa chimwe chete chinogara kusvika pazuva rekupera.
c-067.actionItem: Nhasi tamisa mapiritsi kubva pahwindo kana shelufu yekicheni kuenda kudhirowa rinotonhorera.

c-068.title: Kusarudza mushonga wekudzinga zvipukanana DEET neicaridin
c-068.summary: Usati watanga zviitiko zvekunze, shandisa chigadzirwa chine DEET 20~30% kana icaridin 10~20% chinodzivirira maawa mashoma.
c-068.principle: DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) inovhiringidza maolfactory receptors emhete uye inoita kuti zvinetse kuwana munhu. Kana kusimba kuchikura, nguva yekudzivirira inowedzera, asi simba rinosvika pamuganhu.
c-068.example: DEET 30% inodzivirira maawa 6 kunenge uye 10% maawa 2 kunenge, pa50% kuwedzera kuri kushoma. Usapfapfaidza pachiso, isa kubva muruoko, uye usashandisa kuvana vari pasi pemwedzi 2.
c-068.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa zvinoumba nekusimba pa label yemushonga wekudzinga zvipukanana uye uuise mubhegi rekunze.

c-069.title: Stainless steel 304 ne316, kuverenga label
c-069.summary: Kumahombekombe kana zvirongo zvechikafu chine munyu, 316 stainless steel ine molybdenum inosimba kudarika kuora.
c-069.principle: Stainless steel ine chromium inopfuura 10.5% inoumba passivation film ye$\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ pamusoro: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. 316 ine molybdenum 2~3% yakawedzerwa, saka inoramba kuora kunobva kuchloride ions (Cl−).
c-069.example: 304 (18-8) yakakwana kukicheni yakajairika, asi munzvimbo ine munyu mazhinji pitting corrosion inoitika. Pathermos imwe chete, 316 inodhura anenge 20~30% asi inogara nguva refu kumahombekombe.
c-069.actionItem: Nhasi tsvaga chiratidzo che304 kana 316 pasi pezvishandiso zvestainless zvaunoshandisa.

c-070.title: Fluoride yemutuvi inoshandura pamusoro pemazino kuita makristaro akasimba
c-070.summary: Fluoride ions dzinoshandura hydroxyapatite yemazino enamel kuita fluorapatite inosimba kuacid. Kana usingashambidze zvakanyanya nemvura mushure mekutsvaira mazino, fluoride inogara nguva refu.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. Fluorapatite inotanga kunyungudika pa pH 4.5 kunenge, saka inosimba kuacid kupfuura hydroxyapatite (anenge pH 5.5).
c-070.example: Shandisa mutuvi une fluoride 1000~1500ppm wehukuru hwegwayana, uye mushure mekutsvaira shambidza kamwe chete zvishoma nemvura kuti ushandise simba reresidual fluoride.
c-070.actionItem: Nhasi manheru mushure mekutsvaira mazino usashambidza muromo kakawanda, shambidza kamwe chete zvishoma.

c-071.title: Nei chirongo chealuminium chinoita nhema
c-071.summary: Kana ukasiya chikafu chine acid muchirongo chealuminium nguva refu, chinosviba, saka shandisa chimwe chirongo kuchengetedza.
c-071.principle: Film ye$\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ pamusoro pealuminium inonyungudika muacid: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. Alkaline detergents dzinokuvadzawo, saka ita hanya.
c-071.example: Tomato sauce (anenge pH 4.5) yakasiiwa muchirongo chealuminium zuva rimwe chete inogona kuchinja ruvara rwepamusoro uye kupa kuravira kwesimbi. Kuchinja ruvara kunobviswa kazhinji nekubika maminetsi 10 mumvura 1L ine makapu maviri ecitric acid kana cream of tartar.
c-071.actionItem: Nhasi usasiya soup nesauce yakasara muchirongo, itamisire mubhodhoro regirazi kana stainless steel.

c-072.title: Chii chinokonzera mavara echando pamakwapa
c-072.summary: Mavara echando pamakwapa ehembe chena anobva muhuya nealuminium yedeodorant, saka oxygen bleach inobatsira.
c-072.principle: Mapuroteni nemafatty acids ehuya zvinosungana nealuminium salts kuita precipitate isingasungururwi, uye oxygen bleach inoita oxidation yeorganic components: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: Sanganisa chipunu chikuru chesodium percarbonate nekapu yemvura ye40℃ kuita paste yakakora, siya pavara maminetsi 30 wobva washambidza, ruvara runobuda zvakanyanya. Chlorine bleach inogona kuita mavara emapuroteni kuita yellow kupfuura.
c-072.actionItem: Nhasi isa paste yeoxygen bleach pamakwapa ehembe chena yaunopfeka usati washambidza.

c-073.title: Hunhuwi hwemidziyo mitsva isignal yeformaldehyde
c-073.summary: Hunhuwi hwemidziyo mitsva kana wallpaper hunobva kuvolatile organic compounds (VOC), saka vhura mahwindo mazuva mashoma kuti zvibude.
c-073.principle: Urea resin yegamba rePlywood inokanganisa uye formaldehyde inobuda: $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Kubuda kunowedzera kana kupisa neunyoro zvichikwira.
c-073.example: Mumavhiki maviri ekutanga mushure mekuunza midziyo mitsva, vhunza ka3 pazuva kwemaminetsi 30 uye ubatanidze bake-out yekuita kamuri kuita 25~30℃, kusimba kunodzika zvakanyanya. Muganhu unorairwa weformaldehyde mukamuri ndi0.1ppm kana pasi.
c-073.actionItem: Nhasi vhunza ka3 pazuva kwemaminetsi 10 kana kupfuura nemhepo inopfuura.

c-074.title: Mvura yemuzvikamu zvekufamba, kubika nemapiritsi echlorine
c-074.summary: Mvura isina kuchengeteka inogona kuuraya vazhinji vemarwadzo kana ukaibika maminetsi 1 kana kupfuura kana kushandisa mapiritsi echlorine.
c-074.principle: Mapiritsi echlorine anoita hypochlorous acid mumvura inoita oxidation yemicroorganisms: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Isa piritsi rimwe muL1 yemvura yakajeka uye siya maminetsi 30 (nguva refu kuCryptosporidium). Mvura yakasviba, tanga wasefa nechikwangwani, uye pamusoro pe2,000m wedzera nguva yekubika kusvika maminetsi 3.
c-074.actionItem: Nhasi isa piritsi rekuchenesa mvura kana filter inotakurika mubhegi rekufamba.

c-075.title: Fleece wash bag, kudzikisa microplastics
c-075.summary: Kana ukaisa mbatya dzesynthetic mubag rekushambidza uye ukashambidza nemvura inotonhora, kubuda kwemicrofibers kunodzika zvakanyanya.
c-075.principle: Polyester iester polymer isingaparari asi inopwanyika nekukwesha: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: Kushambidza jaketi rimwe refleece kunoburitsa zviuru kusvika mamiriyoni emicrofibers. Kushandisa bag nefilter kunobata yakawanda uye kunodzikisa kupinda munzizi, uye kushambidza nekupisa kudiki kunochengetedzawo simba.
c-075.actionItem: Nhasi vhara zip dzembatya dzefleece nepolyester, dzise mubag rekushambidza uye ushambidze nemvura inotonhora.

c-076.title: Sarudza low-self-discharge NiMH yema battery anochajwa
c-076.summary: NiMH yakajairika inodzikira ine 20% pamwedzi kunyange isingashandiswi. Mhando yakaderera yekudzikira inosara 70~85% mushure megore, saka yakanaka kuremote nekoloko.
c-076.principle: NiMH cell reaction: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Self-discharge inoitika hydrogen ichifamba zvishoma pakati peelectrolyte neelectrodes.
c-076.example: Low-self-discharge AA rechargeable (anenge 2000 mAh) rinochajwa ka500 rinogona kutsiva alkaline mazana, saka mari yenguva refu inodzika zvakanyanya.
c-076.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine mabattery eremote kana koloko, ronga kuachinja nelow-discharge rechargeable.

c-077.title: Mavara epen anobviswa nedoro kwete mvura
c-077.summary: Ink yepen idoro-based rine dye inonyungudika mu organic solvent, saka haipararire mumvura. Kana ukadzvanya nerag yakanyorwa nedisinfectant ethanol, dye inonyungudika.
c-077.principle: Zvinhu zvine polarity yakafanana zvinosanganisa zvakanaka. Dye yemafuta inonyungudika zvakanyanya mu ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 80$) kupfuura mumvura ($\varepsilon \approx 25$).
c-077.example: Isa paper towel yakaoma pasi pemavara uye uvadzvanye nekotoni swab ine 70% ethanol kubva kunze kuenda mukati, ink haipararire uye inoenda kutauro. Tanga wayedza panzvimbo diki.
c-077.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine mavara epen pambatya kana mipando, yedza doro panzvimbo isingaonekwi kutanga.

c-078.title: Miriwo yakaoma inomuka kana yakanyikwa mumvura inotonhora
c-078.summary: Lettuce nepinashi yakaoma zvakaneta nekuti mvura yakadzikira mumaseru. Kana ukazvinyika mumvura inotonhora maminetsi 20~30, osmosis inoita kuti mvura ipinde zvakare uye zvichiita crunchy, uye zvinodzikisa kurasikirwa.
c-078.principle: Kana concentration yemukati memasero yakakura kupfuura yekunze, mvura inopinda mukati. Osmotic pressure $\Pi = iMRT$ inoita turgor pressure inozvimba seru.
c-078.example: Lettuce yakaoma yezuva rimwe yakanyikwa mumvura inotonhora maminetsi 30 inowedzera huremu 5~10% uye crunchiness inodzoka. Asi mashizha akatobora kana kuora haashandi.
c-078.actionItem: Nhasi nyika miriwo yemashizha yakaoma yemufiriji mumvura inotonhora maminetsi 30, zunza mvura uye uidye.

c-079.title: Dust mite allergens dzinodzikira kana ukashambidza nemvura inopfuura 60℃
c-079.summary: Mites nemapuroteni eallergen mubhedha haadzikiri nekushambidza nemvura inotonhora. Mumvura inopisa ye60℃ kunenge, mapuroteni anoshandurwa, mites dzinofa uye allergens dzinodzikira.
c-079.principle: Kupisa kunovhura tertiary structure yeprotein uye enzyme neallergen zvinorasikirwa nebasa (heat denaturation). Pa55~60℃, mites dzinowanzofa mumaminetsi mashoma.
c-079.example: Kana ukashambidza maseti ebhedha nemapiro pa60℃, allergens dzinodzika zvakanyanya, asi pa30℃ mhedzisiro ishoma. Kana label isingatenderi, unogona kutsiva nekuomesa mudryer pakupisa kwakakwira.
c-079.actionItem: Nhasi shambidza pilo case kana shiti yebhedha uchitarisa label pachirongwa chinopisa zvakanyanya chinotenderwa.

c-080.title: Camping gas, muchando butane haipise
c-080.summary: Butane canister inoderera pedyo nezero, saka kumagumo echando shandisa gas ine propane yakasanganiswa.
c-080.principle: Liquefied gas haivhuvhutike pasi pepoint yekubira. Butane anenge $-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kupisa: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: Pasi pe0℃, butane canister ine pressure shoma, murazvo unoderera uye kubika mvura kunogona kutora nguva yakapetwa kaviri. Chengeta canister mukati mesleeping bag kana padyo nemuviri kuti ichiramba ichipisa, uye kushandisa mutende kunobata njodzi yeCO poisoning, saka vhunza.
c-080.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa tafura yezvinoumba (mwero webutane nepropane) pacamping gas canister.

c-081.title: Kuverenga zvinoumba sunscreen
c-081.summary: Chirimo chisati chasvika UV, ziva musiyano pakati peinorganic filters (zinc oxide) neorganic filters, usarudze.
c-081.principle: Zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) inoratidzira nekupararira UV, uye organic filters senge avobenzone dzinopinza uye dzinoburitsa kupisa: $h\nu + \text{filter} \to \text{filter}^* \to \text{kupisa}$
c-081.example: SPF 50 inovharira UVB 98% kunenge, SPF 30 inovharira 97% kunenge, saka musiyano mudiki. Kumeso unoda 0.5g kunenge (mitsetse miviri yeurefu hwemunwe unoratidza nemunwe wepakati) wozoisa zvakare mushure memaawa 2~3.
c-081.actionItem: Nhasi usati wabuda, dzvanya sunscreen yehurefu hwemaminwe maviri uye uiise.

c-082.title: Kana ukabvisa mvura pamarara echikafu, hunhuwi nehukuru zvinodzika
c-082.summary: Hunhuwi hwemarara echikafu igasi senge hydrogen sulfide rinobva kumicroorganisms ichidimbura mapuroteni. Kana ukamanikidza mvura kutanga, kukura kwemicroorganisms kunononoka, hunhuwi hunodzika uye huremu hunodzikawo.
c-082.principle: Kudimburwa kwemapuroteni ane sulfur amino acids: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Mwero wekukura kwemicroorganisms unononoka kana water activity $a_w$ yakaderera.
c-082.example: Marara echikafu 70~80% imvura. Kana ukamanikidza zvakanaka uye ukadzikisa mvura ne20% chete, huremu hunodzika 15% kunenge, mari yekurasa nehunhuwi zvinodzikawo.
c-082.actionItem: Nhasi usati warasa marara echikafu, aise musefa wozomanikidza mvura zvakanaka.

c-083.title: Zuva rekupera rinotarirwa nekutsamira kwekumhanya kwekuita pakupisa
c-083.summary: Kana tembiricha ikakwira ne10℃, kuora kwechikafu kunokurumidza ka2 kunenge. Naizvozvo kuchengeta tembiricha yakanyorwa kunoita kuti zuva rekupera rive nezvarinoreva.
c-083.principle: Equation yaArrhenius: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. Pakuora kune activation energy yakajairika, kumhanya kunowedzera ka2~3 pa10℃ imwe neimwe.
c-083.example: Mukaka mufiriji pa4℃ unogara mazuva 7, pa14℃ unogona kuora mumazuva 3~4. Zviri nani kuuchengeta mukati pane pamusuo wefiriji (kuchinja tembiricha kwakawanda).
c-083.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa tembiricha yefiriji kuti iri pakati pe0~4℃.

c-084.title: Washing soda pane sodium percarbonate pamafuta akaoma
c-084.summary: Mafuta akare epa range hood nechitofu anobviswa zvakanaka neWashing soda (sodium carbonate) iyo ine alkali yakakura kupfuura baking soda.
c-084.principle: Mafuta (triglyceride) anoita sabhuni mualkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. Washing soda $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ ine pH 11 kunenge.
c-084.example: Nyungudisa chipunu chikuru cheWashing soda muL1 yemvura inopisa, siya maminetsi 10 wozopukuta, mafuta akare anobuda. Inogumbura ganda, saka pfeka magirovhosi erabha, uye usashandisa paaluminium kana pani ine coating.
c-084.actionItem: Nhasi nyika imwe filter yerange hood mumvura yeWashing soda.

c-085.title: Guruva diki rinobuda pakukanya
c-085.summary: Kukanya nekubika pamoto kunowedzera PM2.5 mukati zvakanyanya, saka paunobika batidza hood uye vhura mahwindo.
c-085.principle: Kana mafuta apisa kupfuura 180℃ kunenge, anopwanyika nekupisa kuita zvidimbu neacrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (kubviswa kwemvura kuglycerol)
c-085.example: Pakukanya mackerel mupani, PM2.5 mukati inogona kusvika mazana eμg/m³, uye hood inoidzikisa zvakanyanya. Mushure mekubika siya hood iri kushanda maminetsi 10 akawanda.
c-085.actionItem: Nhasi usati watanga kubika, batidza hood uye uisiye ichishanda maminetsi 10 mushure mekubika.

c-086.title: Mushure mekuenda kugungwa, shambidza bhasikoro nemota
c-086.summary: Munyu wemhepo yegungwa unoora simbi nekukurumidza, saka mushure mekuenda kugungwa shambidza mota nebhasikoro nemvura yakajairika.
c-086.principle: Munyu sodium chloride mumvura unova electrolyte uye unoita corrosion cell yeiron: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: Munzvimbo ine munyu nemvura, iron inoora ka mazhinji nekukurumidza kupfuura pasi pakaoma. Mukati memaawa 24 mushure mekufamba kumahombekombe, shambidza pasi pemota nechain nemvura uye uise chain oil, mhepo inodzikira zvakanyanya.
c-086.actionItem: Kana wakaenda kugungwa, nhasi shambidza pasi pemota nechain yebhasikoro nemvura.

c-087.title: Kushambidza pesticides, mvura kutanga, baking soda zvadaro
c-087.summary: Mvura inoyerera ndiyo hwaro hwemichero nemiriwo, uye pane tsvakurudzo dzinoratidza kuti kunyika mumvura ine baking soda kwemaminetsi 12 kunodzikisa zvimwe pesticides zvepamusoro.
c-087.principle: Mamwe mapesticides (senge thiabendazole) anopwanyika nyore mualkali isina simba. Baking soda 1% ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) solution ine pH 8.1 kunenge.
c-087.example: Mutsvakurudzo apuro akanyikwa mubaking soda 1% (10g paL yemvura) maminetsi 12 akadzikisa residue yepesticide kupfuura mvura yega. Michero inodyiwa nechikwa, mushure mekunyika shambidza zvakare nemvura inoyerera.
c-087.actionItem: Nhasi nyika maapuro kana mazambiringa mumvura ine baking soda 10g/L, wozoashambidza.

c-088.title: Mavara eshiri nezvikwekwe maproteins, saka anyudze nekukurumidza uye upukute
c-088.summary: Marara eshiri nemvura yezvikwekwe zvine acid nemaproteins anonamira pamusoro pepende kana akaoma uye anopararira. Kana ukanyika nerag inonyorova uye ukapukuta zvinyoro, pende inokuvadzwa zvishoma.
c-088.principle: Maprotein anosungana kana akaoma uye anoita hydrogen bonds nepamusoro. Mvura nedetergent isina alkali yakasimba (pH 8~9) zvinoputsa mabond aya.
c-088.example: Marara eshiri akasiiwa kupfuura zuva rimwe anogona kukuvadza pende zvakajeka mumazuva 1~2, saka zviri nani kuisa microfiber towel inonyorova kwemaminetsi 5 wozoapukuta.
c-088.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine marara eshiri akaoma pamota kana hwindo, isa rag inonyorova maminetsi 5 uchinyudza wozoapukuta.

c-089.title: Baking powder nebaking soda zvinhu zvakasiyana
c-089.summary: Baking soda iri sodium bicarbonate chete, saka inozvimbisa kana pane acid, uye baking powder ine acid component kare, saka inozvimbisa kana ikasangana nemvura. Kana ukazvichinjanisa, kuravira kunogona kuva kunovava kana kuzvimbisa kuri kushoma.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. Teaspoon imwe yebaking soda (anenge 5g) inogona kuburitsa carbon dioxide inenge 1L.
c-089.example: Kana recipe ine 1/2 teaspoon yebaking soda neyogurt (acid), acid inoita kuti soda iite. Kana ukaisa soda chete mumusanganiswa usina acid, soda isina kuita inosiya kuravira kunovava kwesabhuni.
c-089.actionItem: Nhasi kushelufu yekicheni tarisa malabels ebaking soda nebaking powder uye uzvichengete mumidziyo yakasiyana.

c-090.title: Maapuro nemabhanana zvinofanira kuchengetwa zvakasiyana
c-090.summary: Ethylene gas inobva muapuro inokurumidza kuibisa mabhanana, saka chengeta michero iri kure nemumwe.
c-090.principle: Ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ ihomoni yezvirimwa inoita kuti enzymes dzinoparadza mapuranga eseru dziite uye inokurumidza kuibisa. Kugadzirwa: $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$ kuburitswa kunowedzera zvakanyanya kana michero ichibva.
c-090.example: Mabhanana asati abva ari muhomwe imwe neapuro anobva mazuva 1~2 ari pamberi, saka unogona kuashandisa nemaune. Kuti uchengete nguva refu, chengeta apuro kure, nguva yekuchengeta inowedzera mazuva 1~2 uye marara echikafu anodzika.
c-090.actionItem: Nhasi isa maapuro nemabhanana mumakamuri kana midziyo yakasiyana.

c-091.title: Tannin yetii nekofi inodzivirira kutorwa kweiron supplements
c-091.summary: Tannin nepolyphenols dzetii nekofi dzinosungana neiron ions kuita complexes dzisingatorwi nyore. Zviri nani kuisa musiyano wemaawa 1~2 kana kupfuura neiron supplements kana chikafu chine iron yakawanda.
c-091.principle: Tannins dzinoita chelate neiron: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Complex iyi haitorwi nyore mudumbu.
c-091.example: Tii inonwiwa nechikafu inogona kudzikisa kutorwa kwenon-heme iron ne40~60%. Kana ukainwa awa rimwe mushure mekudya, mhedzisiro inova shoma zvakanyanya.
c-091.actionItem: Kana wakatora iron supplements kana kudya spinach nezvirimwa zvakadai, famisa tii nekofi nehora rimwe.

c-092.title: Misodzi pakucheka hanyanisi inogona kudzikiswa nefiriji
c-092.summary: Kana ukacheka hanyanisi, maseru anopwanyika uye enzymes dzinoita gasi rinogumbura maziso. Kana ukaisa hanyanisi mufiriji maminetsi 30, enzyme reaction inononoka uye misodzi inodzika.
c-092.principle: Alliinase inoshandura sulfoxide kuita chinhu chinogumbura: propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) inogumbura nerves dzeziso uye inoita misodzi. Mwero weenzyme reaction unodzika nekupisa.
c-092.example: Pahanyanisi yakatonhodzwa maminetsi 30 pa4℃, mwero wekugadzirwa kwechinhu chinogumbura unodzika hafu kana pasi kupfuura hanyanisi yekamuri (25℃). Kumidzi kune ma enzymes mazhinji, saka cheka kumagumo.
c-092.actionItem: Nhasi isa hanyanisi mufiriji maminetsi 30 usati wadzishandisa.

c-093.title: Kutsikirika kwembatya kunoitika hydrogen bonds dzichisimba munzvimbo nyowani
c-093.summary: Tambo dzakaita sedonje dzinorasa hydrogen bonds pakati pemolecular chains kana dzakanyorova uye dzichipisa, uye pakutonhora dzinomira mushape nyowani. Kana ukadzikisa nemhute nekupisa wozosandara usati watonhora, kutsikirika kunoenda.
c-093.principle: $\mathrm{{-}OH}$ groups dzecellulose chains dzinoita hydrogen bonds pakati padzo. Unyoro nekupisa zvinoputsa mabonds aya, uye pakutonhora dzinosungana zvakare mushape yakasandara.
c-093.example: Tembiricha yeiron yakakodzera donje ndeye 200℃ kunenge uye synthetics pasi pe110℃. Kana ukarembera mbatya mushawa inopisa, kutsikirika kushoma kunogona kuenda pachako nekuda kwemhute nekupisa.
c-093.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa label yekushambidza yehembe yauchapfeka, wobva wadzorera kutsikirika nemhute zvichienderana netembiricha inotenderwa.

c-094.title: Mumazuva eguruva nezvidimbu zvidiki, shambidza chiso kwemasekonzi 30 nesurfactant
c-094.summary: Zvidimbu zvidiki zvinonamira pamafuta eganda (sebum), saka haabviswi nemvura yega. Kushambidza nefoam kunobvisa mafuta neguruva pamwe chete ndiko kukosha.
c-094.principle: Surfactants dzine muswe unoda mafuta nemusoro unoda mvura, uye pamusoro pecritical micelle concentration dzinosunga sebum neguruva mumicelles kuti dzishambidzwe nemvura. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{sebum + dust trapped inside})$
c-094.example: Kana ukapukuta foam facial cleanser mumvura inodziya ye30~35°C kwemasekonzi 30 wozoshambidza, guruva rakawanda rechiso rinobviswa. Pamusoro peganda pH inenge 4.7~5.5, saka zvigadzirwa zvine acid shoma (pH 5~6) zvakanaka.
c-094.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekudzoka kubva kunze, gadzira foam yakanaka nemvura inodziya uye ushambidze chiso zvinyoronyoro kwemasekonzi 30 (dzivisa mvura inopisa).

c-095.title: Mundege mhepo yakaoma inoda moisturizer nekunwa mvura
c-095.summary: Relative humidity mundege inowanzova 10~20%, senzvimbo yeguva, saka ganda nemhino mucous zvinorasikirwa nemvura nekukurumidza. Moisturizer nekunwa mvura kakawanda kunobatsira.
c-095.principle: Relative humidity $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. Ndege inopisa mhepo yekunze ichiipinza, saka saturation vapor pressure yakakwira uye chaiyo vapor pressure yakaderera, saka $RH$ yakaderera.
c-095.example: Nepo humidity yakajairika yemukati iri 40~60%, pa10~20% mundege kurasikirwa kwemvura kunokurumidza ka2~3. Mukufamba kurefu inorairwa kunwa 100~200mL yemvura paawa rega rega.
c-095.actionItem: Pakufamba kunotevera tora moisturizing cream mumudziyo une 100mL kana pasi.

c-096.title: Blanch spring greens mumvura inobira kwemasekonzi 30 chete
c-096.summary: Kublanch kwenguva pfupi kunomisa enzymes, ruvara runoramba rakajeka uye kuvava nehwema hwezvirimwa zvinodzika. Kubika nguva refu kunoshandura chlorophyll kuita yellow-olive.
c-096.principle: Kupisa kunobvisa mhepo mumatishu uye kunoita enzymes dzinoshandura ruvara dzisashande. Pakupisa nemuacid, magnesium yechlorophyll inotsiviwa nehydrogen ions kuita brown pheophytin. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: Isa munyu 10g (1%) muL1 yemvura inobira, blanch 100g yepinashi kwemasekonzi 30 wozoshambidza nemvura inotonhora, girini inoramba. Kana ukabika kupfuura maminetsi 5, inova olive.
c-096.actionItem: Kana ukatenga spring greens nhasi, blanch kwemasekonzi 30 mumvura inobira ine 1% munyu wozotonhodza nekukurumidza nemvura inotonhora.

c-097.title: Huni dzinofanira kuoma pasi pe20% kuti dzipise zvakanaka
c-097.summary: Huni dzinonyorova dzinoshandisa kupisa kutanga kuvhuvhutisa mvura zvisati zvaramba, saka dzinopa utsi hwakawanda uye kupisa kushoma. Huni dzakachengetwa kure nemvura uye dzakaomeswa mwedzi 6 kana kupfuura dzinoshanda.
c-097.principle: Latent heat yekuvhuvhutika kwemvura ndi$\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. Kubva pakupisa kwekuramba kwehuni (anenge $18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ pasi pakaoma), kupisa kwakaenzana nemvura kunobviswa.
c-097.example: Huni dzitsva ine unyoro 40% dzinopa kupisa kunoshandiswa kushoma kupfuura dzakaoma (15~20%) ne30% kunenge kana kupfuura, uye dzinopa makara mazhinji. Pamba huni utarise kana pakati pakaoma.
c-097.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine huni dzekushandisa kunze, dzirongedze panzvimbo ine mhepo isina mvura.

c-098.title: Green tea inonyikwa mumvura ye70~80℃ kuti isavave
c-098.summary: Catechins dzegreen tea dzinonyungudika zvakanyanya pakupisa kwakakwirira uye dzinowedzera kuvava nekusunga, asi theanine amino acid inobuda kunyange pakupisa kwakadzika. Mvura yakatonhodzwa kusvika 70~80℃ ine equilibrium yakanaka.
c-098.principle: Solubility inowanzowedzera nekupisa. Catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) inobuda nekukurumidza pamusoro pe80℃ ichiwedzera kuvava.
c-098.example: Tii inonyikwa maminetsi 3 mumvura ye90℃ ine catechin yakawanda zvakajeka kupfuura iyo inonyikwa mumvura ye70℃, uye inonzwika yakavava. Kana ukadururira mvura inobira mukapu kamwe, inodzika 10℃ kunenge.
c-098.actionItem: Nhasi paunogadzira green tea, dururira mvura inobira mukapu kamwe kuitonhodza, wozonyika maminetsi 2.

c-099.title: Glacial acetic acid haisi vhiniga, iAcetic acid 99%
c-099.summary: Vhiniga i acetic acid 4~8% solution, asi glacial acetic acid ndeye pure acetic acid 99% kunenge iyo inopisa ganda nemaziso. Kana uchida kuishandisa mukudya, tarisa chiratidzo chekudya uye uidzikise zvakanyanya.
c-099.principle: Vhiniga: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ anenge $0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4~5%). Glacial acetic acid inenge $17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$, ka20 kana kupfuura kusimba. Pure acetic acid inoomera senechando pasi pe16.6℃, saka inonzi glacial.
c-099.example: Kana recipe inoshandisa vhiniga yakajairika 5%, kuisa 99% glacial acetic acid nehuwandu hwakaenzana kunobata acid yakasimba ka20. Kana label isina nzira yekudzikisa yekudya, zvakachengeteka kusingatenge.
c-099.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa acidity (%) nezvinoumba palabel yevhiniga yemusha.

c-100.title: Doro rinoshanduka kuacetaldehyde muchiropa uye rinokonzera hangover
c-100.summary: Alcohol inopwanyika muchiropa kuita acetaldehyde, iyo inokonzera musoro unorwadza nenyongo kusvikira yashanduka kuacetic acid. Kunwa mvura hakuwedzeri kumhanya kwekupwanyika kwechiropa.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. Chiropa chemunhu mukuru chinopwanya anenge $7\ \mathrm{g}$ yealcohol chaiyo paawa chete.
c-100.example: Bhodhoro rimwe resoju (anenge 360mL, alcohol 50g kunenge) rinotora chiropa maawa anopfuura 7 kuripwanya. Mvura inodzikisa dehydration asi haiwedzeri kumhanya kwekupwanyika.
c-100.actionItem: Kana uine chirongwa chekunwa nhasi, nwa mvura pamwe chete uye utarise huwandu hwaunonwa pamberi.

c-101.title: Moto wekamba unofanira kudzimwa zvakakwana nemvura
c-101.summary: Moto unoda mafuta, oxygen nekupisa, uye kubvisa chimwe chete kunoudzima. Dururira mvura yakakwana pahuni, taura, uye utarise kuti madota atonhora kudzivirira kuvhiya zvakare.
c-101.principle: Pazvinhu zvitatu zvekupisa, mvura inobvisa kupisa. Latent heat yekuvhuvhutika kwemvura $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ inotora kupisa kwemarasha zvakanyanya.
c-101.example: Chidimbu chimwe chemarasha (anenge 100g) chinoburitsa MJ mashoma ekupisa, uye 1L yemvura inodururirwa inotora anenge 2.3MJ semusoro wekuvhuvhutika. Dururira mvura kusvikira kuri kunzwika kupisa kwakadzika nechigunwe.
c-101.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa moto kunze, isa bhaketi remvura yakazadzwa usati wasanganisa.

c-102.title: Sodium patafura yekudya × 2.54 = huwandu hwemunyu
c-102.summary: Nhamba yesodium haisi munyu (sodium chloride) asi huremu hweon yesodium. Kana ukashandura kuita munyu, kushandiswa kwezuva nezuva kunonzwisisika zviri nani.
c-102.principle: Molar mass yeNaCl 58.44g/mol yakakamurwa nemolar mass yeNa 22.99g/mol inenge 2.54, saka kuwedzera sodium ne2.54 kunopa huwandu hwemunyu. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: Pakiti yenoodles ine sodium 1,800mg inenge munyu 4.6g, uye inotora chikamu chikuru chemuganhu unorairwa neWHO wemunyu 5g (sodium 2,000mg) pazuva.
c-102.actionItem: Nhasi wedzera sodium mg yechikafu chimwe chakagadziridzwa chemumba ne2.54 uchishandura kuita munyu g.

c-103.title: Noodles dzinogona kubikwa nekupisa kwakasara kana moto wadzimwa
c-103.summary: Kana ukabika noodles mumvura inobira maminetsi 2~3, wodzima moto uye uvhare nechifukidzo, starch inoramba ichibika. Iyi inzira yekuchengetedza gasi.
c-103.principle: Starch gelatinization inotanga pa60~70℃ uye inoenderera kana tembiricha yemvura ichiramba iri pamusoro pe90℃. Kupisa kuchikwira, kumhanya kwekuita kunokurumidza.
c-103.example: Mvura yemuhari yakavharwa inodzika 5~8℃ chete mumaminetsi 5 mushure mekudzima moto, saka starch gelatinization inoenderera. Unogona kudzikisa nguva yekushandisa gasi ne3~4 maminetsi.
c-103.actionItem: Nhasi paunobika pasta kana noodles, dzima moto pa2/3 yenguva yakanyorwa pa package uye uvhare nechifukidzo.

c-104.title: Shuga nevhiniga shoma mumvura yeruva kuchengetedza maruva
c-104.summary: Maruva akachekwa anofemawo uye anopisa shuga. Kana ukavapa shuga shoma neacidity, unowedzera zvinovaka muviri uye unodzikisa bacteria mumvura.
c-104.principle: Maruva akachekwa anoshandisa glucose sesimba nekufema, uye mvura ine acid shoma (pH 3.5~4 kunenge) inononotsa kuvharika kwemidziyo yemvura nekukura kwebacteria. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: Kana ukasanganisa shuga 10g (1%) nevhiniga 5mL muL1 yemvura, pH inova 3.7 kunenge, uye kana ukachinja mvura mazuva maviri ega, maruva anowanzogara mazuva akati wandei akawanda.
c-104.actionItem: Nhasi chinja mvura yeruva uise yakachena 1L ine shuga 10g nevhiniga 5mL, uye ucheke magumo ematsinga zvakatsvedzera.

c-105.title: Bvisa kunamira kwestika nemafuta ekubika
c-105.summary: Kunamira kunosara mushure mekubvisa label hakubviswi nemvura asi kunonyungudika nemafuta. Kazhinji zvinogadziriswa pasina solvents dzakasimba.
c-105.principle: Gamba iri nonpolar polymer saka haisanyungudiki mumvura yakapolar, asi inosanganisa zvakanaka nemafuta ari nonpolar (zvakafanana zvinonyungudisa zvakafanana). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{like dissolves like}$
c-105.example: Kana ukaisa madonhwe mashoma emafuta ekubika pavara, woapukuta mushure memaminetsi 5, wobvisa mafuta nedetergent yekicheni, mavara mazhinji elabel pagirazi nepoteri anobviswa.
c-105.actionItem: Nhasi isa mafuta ekubika pakunamira kwebhodhoro kana ndiro, rindira maminetsi 5 wozopukuta (acetone inogona kukuvadza plastic).

c-106.title: Nzungu dzinoora nekukurumidza nekuti unsaturated fats dzinoita oxidation
c-106.summary: Unsaturated fatty acids dzenzungu nemafuta eseame dzinoita oxidation kana dzaonana nemhepo uye dzinopa hunhuwi hwakaipa. Kuvhara zvakasimba nekuisa mufiriza kunononotsa kuora kwemwedzi mishoma.
c-106.principle: Lipid autoxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$ inotanga uye aldehydes dzinoumbwa dzichipa hunhuwi. Mwero wekuita unodzika hafu pakudzika kwe10℃ kunenge.
c-106.example: Pakupisa kwekamuri (25℃) walnuts dzinotanga kuravira kuora mumavhiki mashoma kusvika mwedzi mishoma, asi kana dzakachengetwa dzakavharwa mufiriza pa-18℃, dzinogara mwedzi 6~12. Kana kuravira kunovava kana kunonhuwa, dzirase.
c-106.actionItem: Nhasi isa nzungu dzakasara mubag rezip kana mudziyo wakavharwa uchizviisa mufiriza.

c-107.title: Kupisa kunogona kudzikisa kukwasha kwekurumwa nemhete
c-107.summary: Kana mate emhete apinda mumuviri, immune reaction inoburitsa histamine uye kuzvimba nekukwasha zvinoitika. Kana ukaisa kupisa kwe50℃ kunenge kwemasekonzi mashoma, mapuroteni emate anoshanduka uye chiratidzo chekukwasha chinodzika.
c-107.principle: Histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ inogumbura nerve endings, uye kupisa kunovhura tertiary structure yeprotein yemate kudzikisa reaction (heat denaturation).
c-107.example: Pane zvinyorwa zvekuti kana ukaisa heat patch ye50℃ kwemasekonzi 10, kukwasha kunodzika maawa mashoma. Usaise chinhu chinopisa pamusoro peganda nguva refu kudzivirira kupisa.
c-107.actionItem: Pakufamba uku, tora mushonga wekudzikisa kukwasha kana cooling gel yekurumwa nemhete.

c-108.title: Potassium sorbate palabel yechikafu ipreservative inodzivirira mold
c-108.summary: Potassium sorbate ipreservative inodzivirira mold neyeast mukuvhima kweacid, inoshandiswa mutchizi, zvinwiwa nechingwa. Inoonekwa seyakachengeteka mukati memuganhu unotenderwa, asi vanhu vanonzwa vanogona kutarisa zvinoumba.
c-108.principle: Sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$) kana pH ichidzikira non-dissociated form inowedzera uye inopfuura nepa cell membrane ichishanda.
c-108.example: Pa pH 4.8, 50% yesorbic acid iri mu effective non-dissociated form, asi pa pH 6.8 inenge 1% chete. Naizvozvo inoshanda zvakanyanya muzvikafu zvine acid.
c-108.actionItem: Nhasi tsvaga mashoko ePreservative muzvinoumba zvezvikafu zviviri zvaunowanzodya.

c-109.title: Mabhatiri akapera usaarase mumarara akajairika, isa mubhini rekuunganidza
c-109.summary: Mabhatiri ane simbi dzakadai sezinc, manganese nenickel, saka kana akadzikwa nemarara akajairika anogona kupinda mumunhu. Kana ukaunganidza mubhini rekuunganidza mabhatiri akapera, simbi dzinogona kudzoserwa.
c-109.principle: Alkaline cell reaction: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. Simbi idzi kana dzadzoserwa dzinova zvinhu zvitsva.
c-109.example: Bhatiri rimwe reAA rinoremera anenge 23g uye 20% kana kupfuura ndesimbi dzakadai sezinc nemanganese. Kana ukaunganidza 100, unogona kudzoreredza simbi zhinji kubva pamabhatiri 2.3kg kunenge.
c-109.actionItem: Nhasi unganidza mabhatiri akapera emumba mumudziyo mumwe chete uye uaendese kubhini rekuunganidza padyo newe.

c-110.title: Shuga yebrown yakaomarara inodzoserwa nechidimbu chechingwa
c-110.summary: Shuga yebrown inoomarara nekuti mvura yemolasses inobuda uye makristaro anonamirana. Kana ukaivhara pamwe nechidimbu chechingwa kana kitchen towel yakanyorova, mvura inodzoka uye inopfava.
c-110.principle: Shuga ine hygroscopic nature, saka inokwevera mvura vapor $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$ uye molasses film pamusoro inopfavira zvakare. Equilibrium inoitwa pakati pevapor pressure yemhepo nepamusoro peshuga.
c-110.example: Kana ukaisa chingwa chimwe pashuga yebrown yakaomarara 500g uye uchivhara, kazhinji inopfava mukati mezuva rimwe. Kana uchikurumidza, vhara nepaper towel yakanyorova uye isa mumicrowave kwemasekonzi 20.
c-110.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine shuga yakaomarara, ise mumudziyo wakavharwa pamwe nechidimbu chechingwa.

c-111.title: Kelp (kombu) kana yakanyikwa mumvura inotonhora nguva refu inobudisa kuravira zvakanaka
c-111.summary: Glutamic acid yekelp inobuda zvishoma nezvishoma kunyange mumvura inotonhora, uye kana ukaibika zvakasimba mucilage inobuda uye soup inova yakasviba uye inonamira. Kana ukaiisa mumvura inotonhora maminetsi 30 kana kupfuura uye woibvisa pedyo nekuvhima, soup inoramba yakajeka.
c-111.principle: Glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ inonyungudika mumvura, uye mucilage polysaccharides senge alginate inonyungudika zvakanyanya kana ikabikwa nguva refu.
c-111.example: Kana ukaisa zvidimbu zviviri zvekelp zve10 cm muL1 yemvura maminetsi 30 uye woibvisa kana mvura yatanga kuvhima (anenge 90℃), kuravira kunobuda zvakakwana. Kelp yakabviswa inogona kushandiswa zvakare mudhishi dzinodzikwa.
c-111.actionItem: Manheru ano paunogadzira soup, nyika kelp mumvura inotonhora maminetsi 30 wozoibika.

c-112.title: Ruvara rwemvura yemunhu runoratidza kana unonwa mvura yakakwana
c-112.summary: Ruvara rwakajeka rwemvura yemunhu runobva kuurochrome pigment uye runova rwakasviba kana mvura iri shoma. Kana iri yellow yakajeka, kazhinji unonwa mvura yakakwana.
c-112.principle: Pa concentration $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$ kana kunwa mvura kwakaderera uye $V$ kwava kudiki, urochrome yakaenzana $n$ inooneka yakasviba zvakanyanya.
c-112.example: Kana mvura yemunhu iri 1.5L pazuva uye ruvara rwakajeka rwoutsi, kazhinji zvakakwana. Ruvara rwakasviba rweamber chiratidzo chekuti unofanira kunwa mvura yakawanda, asi kana uchitora vitamin B kana mushonga ruvara runogona kuchinja.
c-112.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa ruvara rwemvura yemuviri kamwe, uye kana yakasviba, nwa girazi remvura.

c-113.title: Grade yepetrol ndeye octane number uye shandisa inokodzera mota yako
c-113.summary: Octane number inoratidza kuti mafuta anopikisa sei kuzvipisa pakumanikidzwa (knocking). Kana bhuku remota rinorairwa grade, kuisa mafuta akakwira anodhura haana mubayiro.
c-113.principle: Octane number ndiyo kukosha kunoenzanisa kuramba knocking kuchiisa isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) pa100 neheptane pa0.
c-113.example: Kana bhuku remota rinorairwa octane 91 (regular) asi ukaisa 94 (premium), unongobhadhara zvakawanda paL imwe uye kushanda kunowedzera zvishoma zvikuru. Shandisa premium kana chete injini ine high compression ichiida.
c-113.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa octane number inorairwa mubhuku remota kana palabel mukati mechifukidzo chetanki yemafuta.

c-114.title: Zvinoumba zvezvekuzora zvinonyorwa zvichitevedza huwandu hwakawanda
c-114.summary: Pamalabel ezvekuzora zvinoumba zvose zviri pamusoro pe1% zvinonyorwa nehuwandu, uye zvese zvakaderera pasi pe1% zvinogona kunyorwa chero nzira. Zvinoumba zvekutanga zvishoma ndizvo zvikuru muchigadzirwa, saka kana chinhu chinotsvaga kutengesa chiri kumagumo, huwandu hwacho hwakaderera.
c-114.principle: Muzvigadzirwa zvizhinji mvura ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) inouya pakutanga. Kana concentration $w = \dfrac{m_{\text{chinoumba}}}{m_{\text{chose}}} \times 100\%$ iri pasi pe1%, kunyora chero nzira kunotenderwa.
c-114.example: Kana zvinoumba toner zviri mvura, glycerin, butylene glycol, zvitatu zvekutanga zvinogona kuva 90% kana kupfuura yechigadzirwa. Kana chinoumba chinotsvaga kutengesa chiri kumagumo, kazhinji chiri pasi pe1%.
c-114.actionItem: Nhasi verenga zvinoumba zvishanu zvekutanga zvechigadzirwa chekuzora chaunoshandisa.

c-115.title: Kudya kwekambi kudarike nekukurumidza nzvimbo ye4~60℃
c-115.summary: Bacteria dzinowanda nekukurumidza pa4~60℃ kunenge, inonzi danger zone. Pakambi, nyama nezvikafu zveeggs zvichengetwe mucooler pasi pe4℃, uye pakubika zvipise zvakakwana kusvika pakati.
c-115.principle: Huwandu hwebacteria hunowedzera se$N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. E. coli pa37℃ kunenge inogona kupetwa kaviri maminetsi 20 ega ega.
c-115.example: Muchikafu chakasiiwa maawa 2 mukupisa kwezhizha ye30℃, bacteria dzinogona kuwedzera ka$2^{6} = 64$. Bika nyama kusvika pakati pe75℃ kana kupfuura kwemaminetsi 1 kana kupfuura.
c-115.actionItem: Kuchikambi chino, zadza cooler neice uye utore thermometer.

c-116.title: Munyu mumvura yenoodles haukwidziri boiling point zvikuru
c-116.summary: Kufunga kuti munyu unoita kuti mvura ipise zvakanyanya hazviiti. Kuchengetedza gasi, chifukidzo nemoto mudiki zvinobatsira kupfuura munyu.
c-116.principle: Zvidimbu zvakawanda zvinonyungudika zvinokwidza boiling point ('boiling point elevation') asi kukosha kuri kudiki zvikuru. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Kunyange kuisa munyu 10g muL1 yemvura, boiling point inokwira 0.17°C chete, saka nguva yekubika inoramba yakafanana uye kuravira chete kunogadziriswa.
c-116.actionItem: Nhasi paunobika noodles shandisa munyu kuravira chete, uye kana mvura yabira, vhara nechifukidzo uye udzikise moto.

c-117.title: Mavara egirazi: doro kutanga, enzyme detergent zvadaro
c-117.summary: Mvura yegrass ine chlorophyll (chinhu chemafuta) nemapuroteni, saka haibviswi nemvura yega. Kutevedza kurongeka chete kunobvisa zvakanaka.
c-117.principle: Chlorophyll inonyungudika muethanol, uye mapuroteni emavara anokamurwa kuita peptides neprotease yeenzyme detergent. Mvura inopisa inoomesa mapuroteni uye inoita kuti anamire. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: Kana ukanyudza mavara mu70% ethanol maminetsi 5 wozoshambidza mu30~40°C nemvura neenzyme detergent, mavara egirazi anopera zvakanyanya.
c-117.actionItem: Nhasi isa disinfectant ethanol pamavara egirazi maminetsi 5 wozoshambidza pa30~40°C (tanga wayedza ruvara rwuchichinja panzvimbo isingaonekwi).

c-118.title: Iron yepinashi inotorwa zvakanyanya kana yadyiwa nerimau
c-118.summary: Plant iron (non-heme iron) haitorwi nyore, asi vitamin C inoishandura kuita chimiro chinotorwa. Tannin yetii nekofi inodzivirira kutorwa.
c-118.principle: Non-heme iron kazhinji iri se$\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ asi mudumbu rinotorwa $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ chete, uye vitamin C inoderedza ferric iron kuita ferrous iron uye inoita chelate neiron. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: Kana ukawedzera vitamin C inenge 100mg (huwandu hwerimau rimwe) muchikafu, kutorwa kwenon-heme iron kunogona kuwedzera ka2~3.
c-118.actionItem: Nhasi dururira muto werimau pa spinach kana zvirimwa zvemabhinzi, uye unwe tii kana kofi awa rimwe mushure mekudya.

c-119.title: Kutonhodza zvinwiwa nekukurumidza kunze neice nemunyu
c-119.summary: Kana ukasanganisa ice nemunyu, tembiricha inodzika pasi pe0°C zvakanyanya uye zvinwiwa zvinotonhora mumaminetsi mashoma. Unogona kuishandisa panzvimbo yefiriji pakurara.
c-119.principle: Nekudzikira kwemelting point, mvura ine munyu inosimba pasi pe0°C chete, saka ice richinyunguduka rinotora kupisa kubva kunharaunda uye tembiricha inodzika (eutectic point -21°C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
c-119.example: Kana ukasanganisa ice nemunyu 3:1 nehuremu, tembiricha inodzika kusvika -15~-20°C kunenge, uye kana ukaisa makani wozvitenderedza, zvinotonhorera 5°C kunenge mumaminetsi mashoma.
c-119.actionItem: Nhasi pakurara, sanganisa ice 3 : munyu 1 mucooler uye utenderedze makani ezvinwiwa kwemaminetsi 3~5 (tarisa kuti makani asaomere uye apwanyike).

c-120.title: Nyama ine ruvara rwebrown haisiyo kuora pakarepo
c-120.summary: Ruvara rwenyama runotarirwa nemamiriro eiron mumyoglobin uye hazvienderani nguva dzose nekutsva. Tarisawo zuva rekupera nehwema.
c-120.principle: Oxymyoglobin yakasungwa neoxygen yakajeka tsvuku, uye iron kana yaita oxidation inova brown metmyoglobin. Mukati mevacuum kana tight packaging mune oxygen shoma, saka ine ruvara rwepepuru rwakasviba. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (tsvuku), $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (brown)
c-120.example: Nyama yakachekwa yeng'ombe inova tsvuku yakajeka mumaminetsi 15~30 kana yasangana nemhepo, uye mushure memazuva mashoma mufiriji inogona kuva brown, asi kutonga kuti yaora nekuona ruvara chete hakukwani.
c-120.actionItem: Nhasi pakutenga nyama, tarisa kwete ruvara chete, asiwo zuva rekupera, mamiriro epackage nehwema hune acid kana kunamira.

c-121.title: Garlic cheka wozivarira maminetsi 10 usati wabika kuti allicin ichengetedzwe
c-121.summary: Kana ukacheka kana kupwanya garlic, enzyme alliinase inoshandura alliin kuita allicin, uye allicin iyi ihwaro hweantimicrobial nezvinhu zvine hutano. Kana ukaipisa pakarepo, enzyme inomira uye allicin shoma inoumbwa.
c-121.principle: Alliin $\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$ allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). Enzyme inoshanduka nekukurumidza pamusoro pe60~70℃.
c-121.example: Kana garlic yakachekwa ikasiiwa maminetsi 10 isati yabikwa, inosara nezvinhu zvinobva kuallicin zvakawanda ka mazhinji kupfuura yakabikwa pakarepo, hazvo zvinoratidzwa. Chengeta huwandu hwekudya kamwe chete pa1~2 zvidimbu.
c-121.actionItem: Nhasi kana ukashandisa garlic mukubika, ichekei uisiye maminetsi 10 wozoipisa.

c-122.title: Mafuta ekukanya anosefwa uye achichengetwa munzvimbo yakasviba anogara nguva refu
c-122.summary: Mafuta anoora nekupisa, mwenje neoxygen uye anopa hunhuwi hwakaipa. Kungoichengeta zvakanaka kunodzivirira kuparadza mafuta.
c-122.principle: Unsaturated fatty acids dzinoita oxidation nechain reaction yeradicals uye dzinoita peroxides nealdehydes. Kupisa nezvimedu zvechikafu zvinokurumidza reaction. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Shandisa mafuta ekubika ane unsaturation yakakwira mukati memwedzi 3 kunenge mushure mekuvhura, uye mafuta ekukanya zviri nani kusefa zvimedu uye kuashandisa 2~3 nguva chete.
c-122.actionItem: Nhasi sefa mafuta ekukanya aunoshandisa nefilter yekofi, uiise mubhodhoro rakasviba munzvimbo inotonhora, uye kana ichinhuwa sepende, irase.

c-123.title: Kunyange stainless steel inoita ngura kana muto une munyu wakasiiwa kwenguva refu
c-123.summary: Stainless steel haiti ngura nekuda kwe chromium oxide film yakatetepa, asi kana chloride ion ikapinza firimu iri, maburi madiki nemadota engura anoumbwa.
c-123.principle: Kana chromium iri 10.5% kana kupfuura, firimu $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ inoumbwa pamusoro uye inozvigadzirisa kana pane oxygen, asi $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ inoparadza firimu munzvimbo diki ichiita pitting. $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: 316 ine molybdenum 2% inosimba kumunyu kupfuura 304 (chromium angangoita 18%, nickel 8%). Kana mvura ine munyu ikasiiwa maawa mashoma, pitting corrosion inogona kuitika.
c-123.actionItem: Nhasi shambai nokukurumidza poto yestainless steel yakaiswa muto kana chikafu chine munyu, muomese mvura muchiisa.

c-124.title: Kofi yemasikati inosara kupfuura hafu kunyange husiku
c-124.summary: Caffeine inobuda mumuviri zvishoma nezvishoma, saka kofi yekuzononoka inokanganisa kurara. Kuzvidzorera nguva yekofi yekupedzisira kunobatsira.
c-124.principle: Caffeine ine half-life angangoita maawa 5 (3~7), inodzikira nechikamu chakafanana seyechiitiko che first-order. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: Kana ukanwa 150mg yecaffeine na 3 masikati, mushure memaawa 8 na 11 husiku ichine angangoita 50mg (1/3). Huwandu hwose hwezuva hunokurudzirwa pasi pe400 mg.
c-124.actionItem: Nhasi tarai chinwiwa chekupedzisira chine caffeine maawa 8 usati warara, uye mushure meizvozvo nwai decaf kana tii yebarley.

c-125.title: Mumakomo marefu, mvura inovira pa95°C uye kubika kunononoka
c-125.summary: Kana kukwirira kuchiwedzera, air pressure inodzikira uye mvura inovira patembiricha yakaderera. Ndicho chikonzero chekuti cup noodles kana mupunga zvisingabiki zvakakwana.
c-125.principle: Kana atmospheric pressure ichidzikira, boiling point inodzikira (angangoita 3.3°C pa1,000m). Tichishandisa mutemo wekuti kumhanya kwechiitiko kunowedzera kaviri pa10°C yega yega, nguva yekubika inowedzera. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: Pa1,500m pamusoro pegungwa, mvura inovira angangoita 95°C uye kumhanya kunova $2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$ nguva, saka nguva yekubika inowedzera angangoita 40%.
c-125.actionItem: Nhasi kana muine hurongwa hwekukwira gomo, nyorai kuti cup noodles itore nguva ye1.4 times, nemupunga uvharwe nechivharo ubikwe kwenguva refu, zvichienderana nekukwirira.

c-126.title: Musaite preheat yepani ine coating isina chinhu pamoto mukuru
c-126.summary: Teflon (PTFE) coating inogara kusvika angangoita 260°C, asi kupfuura apo inoparara ichibudisa utsi hunokuvadza. Mumba, kupisa pani isina chinhu pamoto mukuru ndicho chikonzero chinonyanya kujairika.
c-126.principle: PTFE inogara nekuti C-F bond yakasimba kwazvo, asi pamusoro peangangoita 300°C inoparara ichibudisa fluorine-based gas inouraya shiri. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: Kana ukaisa pani isina chinhu pamoto mukuru, inogona kusvika kupfuura 300°C mumaminitsi 2~5. Kana ukashandisa pamoto wepakati uchiisa mafuta kana zvekubika, kazhinji inogara pasi pe200°C.
c-126.actionItem: Nhasi shandisai pani ine coating pamoto wepakati kana pasi, muchitanga kuisa mafuta, musaipise isina chinhu, uye mudzivirire zvishandiso zvesimbi.

c-127.title: Kunwa vhiniga isina kuderedzwa kunonyungudisa tooth enamel
c-127.summary: pH yevhiniga angangoita 2.5, yakaderera zvikuru kupfuura pH 5.5 apo tooth enamel inotanga kunyungudika. Kana ukanwa, tsvaira zvikuru uye shambai muromo nemvura mushure mekunwa.
c-127.principle: Kunyungudika kwetooth enamel: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Kana $\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$ yakadzika, inonyungudika nokukurumidza.
c-127.example: Vhiniga ye pH 2.5 ine hydrogen ion concentration yakakwira nenguva 1000 kupfuura pH 5.5. Sanganisai chipunu chimwe chikuru chevhiniga mu200 mL kana kupfuura yemvura, munwe nestrawo, mugoshambira mazino mushure memaminitsi 30.
c-127.actionItem: Nhasi kana muchinwa vhiniga kana chinwiwa chine acid, shambai muromo nemvura kamwe, uye shambai mazino mushure memaminitsi 30.

c-128.title: Isai chingwa mufiriji yekuomesa, kwete firiji yekutonhodza
c-128.summary: Chingwa chinoomarara kwete nekuti chinoomeswa, asi nekuti starch inodzoka ichiita crystal, uye izvi zvinoitika nokukurumidza mufiriji yekutonhodza.
c-128.principle: Retrogradation apo amylose/amylopectin yestarch yakabikwa inodzoka kurongeka inokurumidza pa0~5°C, uye inenge yaramba pasi pe-18°C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Chingwa chiri patembiricha yemuimba chinogara mazuva 2~3, chiri mufiriji chinoomarara nokukurumidza, asi chakaomeswa pa-18°C chinogona kuchengetwa angangoita mwedzi 3, uye kupisa pamusoro pe60°C kunobvisa makristasi kuchiita chakapfava.
c-128.actionItem: Nhasi cheka chingwa chasara kuita zvidimbu zvega, muchiomese, mugochipisa zvakare mutoaster kana steamer paunodya.

c-129.title: Kusvibiswa netomato pachirongo chepurasitiki: zuva nemafuta
c-129.summary: Pigment tsvuku yetomato sauce inosanganisa zvakanaka nemafuta ichipinda mupurasitiki. Mafuta neultraviolet zvinoshanda zvakanaka kupfuura mvura.
c-129.principle: Lycopene pigment isina polarity inonyungudika mupurasitiki, uye 11 conjugated double bonds dzinotora chiedza dzichiita ruvara rutsvuku, uye ultraviolet inotyora dzimwe bonds idzi ichiita kuti chive pasina ruvara. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Pukunyai neyoga yemafuta, shambai nesipo yekicheni, mugoisa pamuzuva kwemaawa 2~3, uye kazhinji kunodzikira.
c-129.actionItem: Nhasi dzvinyai tinji rimwe remafuta ekubikisa pachirongo chepurasitiki chakasvibiswa mupukunye, mushambe nesipo, muchiise pamuzuva pawindo kwemaawa 2~3 (kutanga nechirongo chegirazi kunodzivirira).

c-130.title: Oral rehydration solution yekurwara dumbu nekushaiwa mvura: munyu neshuga pamwe chete
c-130.summary: Glucose nesodium zvinotorwa pamwe chete, uye mvura inotevera. Kuzadzazve mvura kunowedzera kupfuura kunwa mvura chete.
c-130.principle: SGLT1 transporter yemasero emudumbu inotakura glucose 1 molecule nesodium 2 pamwe chete, uye mvura inotorwa nekuda kweosmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Recipe yepamba yeWHO ndeye 1L yemvura yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa ine mashuga 6 madiki (angangoita 25g) nemunyu hafu yechipunu chidiki (angangoita 3g). Kana kushaiwa mvura kwakanyanya, vacheche kana kupisa kukuru, enda kuchipatara.
c-130.actionItem: Nhasi gadzirirai kuisa ORS imwe kana mbiri dzemushando mubhokisi renhumbi dzekukurumidza.

c-131.title: Kuvava kwemaziso mudziva rekushambira hakuzi nechlorine, asi chloramine
c-131.summary: Maziso anotsvuka kwete nekuti sanitizer yedziva yakasimba kwazvo, asi nekuti chloramine inoumbwa kana ichisangana nehuziya neurine. Kushamba kuri nzira yakanakisisa yekudzivirira.
c-131.principle: Chlorine inova hypochlorous acid (HOCl) mumvura ichiuraya hutachiona, uye kana ichibatana ne ammonia nitrogen inoumba chloramine inovhunduka. Pa pH 7.5, HOCl iri angangoita 50%. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: Dziva rinokurudzirwa pH 7.2~7.8, free chlorine 1~3ppm. Kushamba nesipo kwemunyika imwe miniti usati washamba kunodzikisa organic matter zvakanyanya.
c-131.actionItem: Nhasi usati waenda kudziva, shambai nesipo kwemunyika imwe miniti, uye musapihwa urine panguva yekushamba.

c-132.title: Verenga hardness kubva ku calcium ne magnesium pa label yemvura yebhodhoro
c-132.summary: Kunyange mvura yebhodhoro imwe, hardness inosiyana, uye kuravira kwekofi netii nekuumbwa kwe scale zvinosiyana. Nhamba dzepa label dzinoratidza kuti mvura yakapfava kana yakaoma.
c-132.principle: Hardness ndiyo kubatanidzwa kwe calcium ne magnesium ion kunoshandurwa kuita mass yecalcium carbonate. Kwekubika kofi 50~175mg/L inokurudzirwa. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Mvura ine calcium 80mg/L, magnesium 26mg/L ndi $2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, mvura yakaoma zvikuru (inopfuura 180) saka scale inoumbwa nyore muelectric kettle.
c-132.actionItem: Nhasi verengai hardness yemvura yamunonwa kubva pa Ca·Mg values pa label.

c-133.title: Calories ndekupisa kwekupisa, carb·protein·fat ndi 4·4·9kcal/g
c-133.summary: Calories dzechikafu dzakatemwa kubva pakupisa kunoburitswa kana chakapiswa kunze kwemuviri. Unogona kuverenga calories zvakananga kubva pa g pa nutrition label.
c-133.principle: Kupisa 1 mol yeglucose kunobudisa 2,803kJ (angangoita 15.6kJ/g, 3.7kcal/g). Atwater factors ndi 4kcal/g yecarbohydrate neprotein, 9kcal/g yemafuta. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Chingwa chine carbohydrate 50g, mafuta 20g, protein 10g chine $50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: Nhasi verengai calories zvakananga kubva pa g yecarb·protein·fat pa nutrition label yechikafu chimwe chidiki.

c-134.title: Kuomesa nguvo muzuva kunobuditsa kuchena kwakaita sebleach
c-134.summary: Ultraviolet yezuva inoparadza nokuparadza pigment stains dzakasara mu fabric, ichiita kuti nguvo chena dzive chena zvakanyanya. Pasina sodium percarbonate, zvimwe zvichangoita zvidiki zvinogona kudzikiswa nezuva.
c-134.principle: Photo-oxidation: ultraviolet photon inotyora $\pi$ bond ye pigment ichiita chiitiko neoxygen ikaisandura kuita chinhu chisina ruvara. Photon energy $E = h\nu$ inofanira kupfuura bond energy.
c-134.example: Kana T-shirt chena ine stain ikaomeswa ichiri yakanyorova pasi pezuva kwemaawa 4~6, stain yakaonda inonyorovera zvinoonekwa. Asi nguvo dzine ruvara dzinogona kunyoro nenzira imwe chete, saka dzibudisei mudzoomese.
c-134.actionItem: Nhasi uyai mumuzuva nguvo chena ine stain dzichiri dzakanyorova.

c-135.title: Kana super glue ikabatana pamaoko, nyudzai mumvura ine sipo
c-135.summary: Super glue inoomarara nekuda kwehunyoro hweganda, asi inogona kusunungurwa zvishoma nezvishoma mumvura inodziya ine sipo. Kuidhonza nechisimba kunogwatura ganda.
c-135.principle: Cyanoacrylate inoita polymerization yechain nehunyoro (OH⁻) ichiita polymer yakasimba mumasekonzi mashoma kusvika miniti. Mvura ine sipo nekukweshura zvinonyorova nokusundira glue layer. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{moisture})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: Nyudzai mumvura inodziya ine sipo kwemaminitsi 10~15 mugoitenderedza nechigunwe, kazhinji inosunungurwa. Kana yabatana nemaziso kana miromo, musaikweshura enda kuchipatara.
c-135.actionItem: Nhasi pakushandisa super glue, vhurai mhepo, uye kana zvigunwe zvabatana, nyudzai mumvura inodziya ine sipo kwemaminitsi 15 mugozvitenderedza kuti zvisunungurwe.

c-136.title: Kunhuhwirira kwehove kunodzikira kana ukawedzera acid
c-136.summary: Chikonzero chikuru chekunhuhwirira kwehove ndiyo trimethylamine, chinhu chine base. Kana ukapfapfaidza acid seyemuto werimau kana vhiniga, inoita neutralization uye kunhuhwirira kunobhururuka zvishoma.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. Amine yakava ion haivhuvhuti, saka kunhuhwirira kunodzikira.
c-136.example: Kana ukadonhedza chipunu chidiki chimwe chemuto werimau (angangoita 5mL) pahove ukairega maminitsi 5, kunhuhwirira kwehove kunodzikira zvakajeka. Nzira yekunyudza mumukaka kwemaminitsi 20 ine nheyo imwe chete, apo protein inobata zvinhu zvinonhuhwirira.
c-136.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika hove, tanga wapfapfaidza muto werimau kana vhiniga kamwe.

c-137.title: Kana kukwirira kuchiwedzera, oxygen partial pressure inodzikira uye kufema kunova kunonetsa
c-137.summary: Chikamu cheoxygen mumhepo chiri angangoita 21% pose, asi kana kukwirira kuchiwedzera, air pressure inodzikira uye oxygen partial pressure inoderera. Pa3000 m pamusoro pegungwa, unogona kufema angangoita 70% yeiri pagungwa.
c-137.principle: Dalton's law yepartial pressure: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ yakagara uye $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ inodzikira.
c-137.example: Pagungwa (101kPa), oxygen partial pressure angangoita 21kPa, uye pa3000 m (angangoita 70kPa) angangoita 14.7kPa. Kukwira zvishoma nezvishoma mukati me500 m pazuva kunodzikisa ngozi yechirwere chepamusoro.
c-137.actionItem: Kana muine hurongwa hwekuenda kunzvimbo dzakakwirira, gadzirai hurongwa hwekukwira zvishoma nezvishoma.

c-138.title: Kana kani yechikafu yakazvimba kana yakatsikwa zvakanyanya, ikandai
c-138.summary: Kani yakazvimba chiratidzo chekuti zvipukanana zvakagadzira gasi mukati, uye inogona kuva hutachiona hunokuvadza sebotulinum. Musavhure kani yakazvimba, ikandai.
c-138.principle: Microbial fermentation gas: kunobva chiitiko seyi $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ kunogadzira $\mathrm{CO_2}$ uye kudzvinyirirwa kwemukati mekani kunowedzera.
c-138.example: Kani yakanaka yechikafu ine vacuum mukati, saka chivharo chakati sandara kana chakadzikira zvishoma. Kana yakazvimba, ichiita ruzha rwe'shh' kana ichivhurwa, kana ine mapofu, musadye.
c-138.actionItem: Nhasi bvisai makani echikafu aunawo mumba mutarise kuti hapana yakazvimba kana ine ngura.

c-139.title: Mafuta ari mudhiraini yesink anoomarara kana atonhora ichivhara
c-139.summary: Mafuta anopisa mvura, asi kana atonhora saturated fat inoomarara ichimatira pamadziro emapaipi nokukwana nezvakasara. Musarase mafuta mudhiraini; pukunyai nepepa muaikande semarara ezvakajairika.
c-139.principle: Melting point ye saturated fat angangoita 30~60℃ uye kana mafuta ekubikisa atonhora $\mathrm{liquid \to solid}$ phase change. Kana ayo anosangana ne calcium ion, anoumbawo fatty acid calcium salt (soap scum).
c-139.example: Kana 200mL yemafuta akakangwa ikadururirwa mudhiraini, inoomarara pamadziro emapaipi ne1~2mm kukora, uye kana ichidzokororwa inogona kuvhara. Usati washambidza, pukunyai ndiro dzine mafuta akawanda nekitchen towel kutanga.
c-139.actionItem: Nhasi pukunyai pani ine mafuta nekitchen towel usati washambidza.

c-140.title: Mvura iri mubhodhoro rePET mumotokari muzhizha, inogona kunwiwa here
c-140.summary: Mabhodhoro ePET akasiiwa mumotokari inopisa kwenguva refu anogona kuburitsa antimony nezvimwe zvidiki zvakawanda. Kwemazuva mamwe kana maviri ngozi yakadzika, asi mvura yakasiiwa kwenguva refu inofanira kudzivirirwa.
c-140.principle: Leaching inowedzera netembiricha: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (Arrhenius equation, kana $T$ ikakwira $k$ inowedzera)
c-140.example: Mukati memotokari yekuzhizha tembiricha inogona kusvika 60~70°C, uye kumhanya kwe leaching kunokurumidza nenguva dzakawanda kupfuura pa20 °C.
c-140.actionItem: Nhasi musanwe mvura yePET iri mumotokari; kwekufamba shandisai stainless steel tumbler.

c-141.title: Mabhenefiti e air conditioner refrigerant R-32
c-141.summary: R-32 inoda refrigerant shoma kupfuura R-410A kuti itarire kutonhodza kwakafanana, uye global warming potential (GWP) yakangoita rimwe pamativi matatu. Chinhu chakakosha kutarisa pakusarudza air conditioner itsva.
c-141.principle: R-32: $\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$, kana latent heat of vaporization $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ yakakura, huwandu hwe refrigerant circulation hunodzikira.
c-141.example: GWP yeR-410A angangoita 2088, R-32 angangoita 675. Refrigerant charge inodzikirawo angangoita 20~30% ichiwedzera efficiency zvishoma.
c-141.actionItem: Pakutenga kana kuongorora air conditioner, tarisai rudzi rwerefrigerant (R-32 kana R-410A) pa label yechigadzirwa.

c-142.title: Chikonzero nei carbonated drinks dzichiramba dzisina mhepo
c-142.summary: Carbonic acid inonyungudika zvakanaka pakudzvinyirirwa uye tembiricha yakaderera, uye inobuda kana yadziya kana kudzvinyirirwa kwabviswa. Chengetai chakatonhora uye vhararai chivharo nokukurumidza kuti mabhubhu agare.
c-142.principle: Henry's law: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ inodzikira kana tembiricha yakwira.
c-142.example: Kudzvinyirirwa mubhodhoro angangoita 3~4 atmospheres, uye pa25 °C solubility ye $\mathrm{CO_2}$ inodzikira kusvika angangoita hafu yeiri pa4 °C.
c-142.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekunwa chinwiwa chine mabhubhu, vhararai chivharo nokukurumidza muchiisa mufiriji chakamira.

c-143.title: Baking soda yekubvisa kunhuhwirira mufiriji
c-143.summary: Baking soda ine base isina simba, saka inoita neutralization yezvinhu zvine acid zvinonhuhwirira mufiriji (sema fatty acids). Asi adsorption capacity idiki, saka inofanira kuchinjwa mushure memwedzi 2~3.
c-143.example: Kuisa baking soda angangoita 100g (kapu 1/2) muchirongo chimwe chinokwana kudzikisa kunhuhwirira kwakapfava mufiriji diki.
c-143.actionItem: Isai kapu imwe yebaking soda mundiro isina kudzika pashelf yefiriji, munyore zuva, uye muchinje mushure memwedzi 3.

c-144.title: Mbambaira inotapira inotapira zvakanyanya kana yakagochwa zvishoma nezvishoma pa70~75℃
c-144.summary: Enzyme beta-amylase iri mumbambaira inotapira inoparadza starch ichiita maltose inotapira, inoshanda zvakanyanya pa70~75℃ uye inomira pamusoro pe90℃. Kana yakagochwa zvishoma nezvishoma, nguva yekutapira inowedzera.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. Enzyme activity ine optimum temperature.
c-144.example: Kupisa mu180℃ oven kwemaminitsi 5 chete kunopisa zvishoma, asi kana kugocha pasi pe150℃ kwemaminitsi 50 kana kupfuura, tembiricha yemukati yembambaira inogara mumutsetse we70~75℃ kwenguva refu uye maltose inogadzirwa yakawanda zvikuru. Ndicho chikonzero chekuti mbambaira yakagochwa inotapira.
c-144.actionItem: Nhasi pakugocha mbambaira inotapira, edzai kugocha zvishoma nezvishoma patembiricha yakaderera kwenguva refu.

c-145.title: Chikonzero nei eggs dzinova soft-boiled pa62~65℃ ndechekushanduka kweprotein
c-145.summary: Protein dzeeggwhite neyolk dzinoomarara patembiricha dzakasiyana. Eggwhite inotanga angangoita 62~65℃, yolk angangoita 65~70℃, uye izvi zvinoparadzanisa soft-boiled ne hard-boiled.
c-145.principle: Heat denaturation inotyora tertiary structure yeprotein ichiita kuti dzisunganire. Ovotransferrin inoshanduka angangoita 62℃, ovalbumin angangoita 80℃.
c-145.example: Kana wabika kwemaminitsi 6 mumvura inovira, eggwhite inoomarara uye yolk iri padyo ne soft-boiled inoyerera, uye kana wabika kwemaminitsi 10 kana kupfuura, inova hard-boiled. Nekuda kwengozi yeSalmonella, vachembere nevakadzi vane pamuviri vadye hard-boiled.
c-145.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika mazai, isai timer pamaminitsi 6 ne10 mutarise musiyano.

c-146.title: Water-soluble vitamins dzinobuda murine kunyange ukadya zvakawanda
c-146.summary: Vitamin C neB group zvinonyungudika mumvura, saka kupfuura zvinodiwa hazvichengetwi mumuviri zvinobuda murine. Zvakawandisa pamasupplement ane dose yakakwira zvinogona kuparadzwa.
c-146.principle: Water-soluble molecules dzine polarity saka dzinonyungudika zvakanaka muropa neurine dzichisefiwa nematundu. Asi fat-soluble vitamins dzinounganidzwa mumafuta emuviri.
c-146.example: Vitamin C yakakurudzirwa pazuva kuvakuru angangoita 100mg, uye kana ukadya 1000mg kamwe, absorption inodzikira pasi pe50% uye zvakasara zvinobuda. Chibereko chimwe chete chinopa angangoita 50mg.
c-146.actionItem: Nhasi kana muchitora vitamin supplement, tarisai kuti pamwe nezvamunodya muchikafu hazvipfuuri huwandu hwakakurudzirwa.

c-147.title: Munyu wekusefa mvura yegungwa nemunyu wakachena zvinosiyana mune sodium chloride ratio nemamineral
c-147.summary: Munyu wakachena une sodium chloride (NaCl) angangoita 99% kana kupfuura, uye munyu wemvura yegungwa angangoita 80~90% ne magnesium, calcium nemvura zvakasanganiswa. Kuravira kwemunyu nesodium zvakafanana, saka kudya zvishoma ndicho chinokosha.
c-147.principle: Sodium ratio ndi $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. Kana huwandu hwemunyu hwakafanana, NaCl ratio yakakwira inoreva sodium yakawanda.
c-147.example: 5g yemunyu une NaCl chaiyo ine sodium angangoita 1.97g, uye kana munyu wemvura yegungwa uine NaCl 85% angangoita 1.67g. WHO inokurudzira munyu pasi pe5 g pazuva.
c-147.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai sodium content (mg/100g) pa nutrition label yemunyu wepamba.

c-148.title: Magirazi echiedza anochinja ruvara nechiedza
c-148.summary: Photochromic lenses dzine silver halide mukati inoparadzanisa kuita silver particles kana ichitambira ultraviolet ichiita rima, uye inodzoka kana chiedza chaenda. Mumotokari, ultraviolet inovharwa negirazi saka haaite rima zvakanyanya.
c-148.example: Photochromic lenses dzinodzikisa transmittance kubva angangoita 85% kusvika 20s% mukati meminiti rimwe pamuzuva, uye dzinotora maminitsi 5~15 kudzoka zvakare mukati.
c-148.actionItem: Pakutyaira pazuva rine zuva rakasimba, tarisai kuti mutore magirazi ezuva akajairika anovhara ultraviolet, mavazivise kubva kuphotochromic.

c-149.title: Mota dzemagetsi dzinorasa simba shoma kupfuura dzepeturu
c-149.summary: Injini yepeturu inoshandisa angangoita 20~30% yesimba remafuta kutenderedza mavhiri, zvasara zvinorasirwa kupisa. Mota dzemagetsi dzinotakura angangoita 80~90% yesimba remagetsi kumavhiri, saka dzinoda simba shoma pachinhambwe chimwe.
c-149.principle: 1L yepeturu ine kupisa kwe $32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$), uye kana efficiency $\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ iri angangoita 25%, basa rinobatsira ndiro angangoita 2.2kWh.
c-149.example: Mota inofamba angangoita 12km pa1 L yepeturu inofamba 12km ne2.2kWh, uye mota yemagetsi inoda angangoita 2kWh pa12 km (efficiency angangoita 6km/kWh). Kana tikaverenga kurasikirwa kwemagetsi pachigadzirwa, musiyano unodzikira.
c-149.actionItem: Nhasi pazvinofambwa zvidiki, famba netsoka kana utore transport yeruzhinji kuchengetedza mafuta.

c-150.title: Smoke point yemafuta ekubikisa nemafuta ekukanga
c-150.summary: Kana mafuta apfuura smoke point, utsi ne acrolein zvinoumbwa zvichikanganisa maziso nemhuno. Pakubika pamoto mukuru, mafuta ane smoke point yakakwira ndiwo akachengeteka.
c-150.example: Smoke point yeolive oil (extra virgin) angangoita 190°C, canola oil angangoita 240°C, refined sunflower oil angangoita 230°C.
c-150.actionItem: Pakubika nekugocha sarudzai mafuta akacheneswa ane smoke point yakakwira, uye kana utsi hwabuda dzikisai moto nokukurumidza muvhure mhepo.

c-151.title: Chikonzero nei iced tea ichisvibisa
c-151.summary: Kana black tea yakasimba yatonhora, caffeine netannin zvinosunganidza kuita zvidimbu zvichisvibisa. Kuwedzera mvura inopisa kunoita kuti itsvere, uye cold brew inosvibisa zvishoma.
c-151.principle: Caffeine + tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ complex: kana tembiricha yakaderera solubility inodzikira uye inoita precipitate.
c-151.example: Black tea yakabikwa pa100 °C kana yatonhodzwa kusvika 4°C inosvibisa mukati memaminitsi mashoma, asi cold brew (4°C, maawa 8) inosvibisa zvishoma zvikuru.
c-151.actionItem: Nhasi pakugadzira iced tea, isai tea bag mu500 mL yemvura inotonhora mugoiisa mufiriji maawa 8 kuita cold brew.

c-152.title: Amygdalin yembeu yeplum haina kukodzera kudyiwa nyowani
c-152.summary: Plum isati yaibva nembeu dzayo dzine amygdalin inogona kubudisa hydrogen cyanide kana yaparadzwa. Pakugadzira plum syrup, bvisai mbeu kana muchisefa mushure mekuibva kwemwedzi 6 kana kupfuura, uye musadye mbeu.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Kana enzyme yasvika, hydrogen cyanide inoumbwa.
c-152.example: Amygdalin iri mumbeu imwe yeplum idiki chaizvo, asi kuzvitsenga nyowani zvakawanda kunogona kuva kwengozi. Pamaplum akasvibira asati aibva, bvisai mbeu muise shuga 1:1 muchiisa kuibva kwemwedzi 6 mugoibvisa nyama.
c-152.actionItem: Nhasi pakugadzira plum syrup, musadye mbeu, munyore pa calendar nguva yekuzvibvisa.

c-153.title: Spray can inogona kuputika kana yaiswa munzvimbo inopisa
c-153.summary: Mukati mearosol can mune gas rakadzvinyirirwa uye flammable propellant, saka kana tembiricha ichikwira kudzvinyirirwa kunowedzera. Kana yaiswa mumotokari muzhizha kana padyo nemoto inogona kuputika, saka tevedzai kuchengetwa pasi pe50℃ pa label.
c-153.principle: Kudzvinyirirwa kwegasi kunowirirana netembiricha: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ iri mu Kelvin). Liquefied propellant vapor pressure inokwira nokukurumidza netembiricha.
c-153.example: Kani yakaenzana 5 atmospheres pa20℃ (293K), kana ikasvika 60℃ (333K) mukuverenga kwakapfava inova angangoita 5.7 atmospheres, uye kana tikawedzera kukwira kwevapor pressure yepropellant inokwira kupfuura izvozvo. Mumotokari yekuzhizha inogona kupfuura 60℃.
c-153.actionItem: Nhasi unganidzai zvigadzirwa zvespray zviri mumba muzvitamise kunzvimbo inotonhora isiri kuswedera kupisa.

c-154.title: Chikonzero nei jelly isingaomarare kana pineapple kana kiwi yawedzerwa
c-154.summary: Nekuti proteolytic enzymes dzepineapple nyowani nekiwi dzinoparadza gelatin kuita zvidimbu zvidiki. Kuipisa kamwe kana kushandisa yemukani kunomisa enzyme uye jelly inoomarara.
c-154.principle: Bromelain neactinidin dzinoita hydrolysis yepeptide bonds: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Enzyme inoshandurwa pamusoro pe $70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kana kupfuura.
c-154.example: Gelatin ye100 mL ine pineapple nyowani haiomarare kunyange mushure memaawa mashoma, asi pineapple yakapisa pamusoro pe80℃ kweminiti 1 kana yemukani inoomarara zvakajairika. Enzyme imwe chete inoshandiswawo kupfavisa nyama.
c-154.actionItem: Nhasi pakuisa michero nyowani mujelly kana pudding, tangai kubira pineapple nekiwi mumvura inovira kweminiti 1 musati mavashandisa.

c-155.title: Kunhuhwirira kwehunyoro kunobva patauro yakaoma
c-155.summary: Kunhuhwirira kwenguvo dzisina kuoma zvakakwana kunobva kumafatty acids seye 4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid anogadzirwa nebhakitiriya yeMoraxella. Kuomesa nokukurumidza zvipukanana zvisati zvawanda ndiko kwakakosha.
c-155.principle: Bacterial metabolism: ganda lipids $\rightarrow$ $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid) nezvimwe volatile fatty acids
c-155.example: Kana nguvo dzakanyorova dzisingaomeri mukati memaawa 5 kana kupfuura, kunhuhwirira kunotanga, uye dryer pamusoro pe60 °C inodzikisa mabhakitiriya zvikuru.
c-155.actionItem: Mushure mekushambidza, ruzhai nokukurumidza, muvhure feni kana dehumidifier, uye muomese mukati memaawa 5.

c-156.title: Chii chinoita pink slime mubhaturumu
c-156.summary: Pink slime yakananama haisi mold, asi firimu repigment tsvuku rinogadzirwa nebhakitiriya seSerratia. Hunyoro nemarara esipo ndizvo zvinodyiwa, saka kuomesa ndiko kudzivirira kwakanakisisa.
c-156.principle: Kuwanda kwebhakitiriya $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (division time $t_d$ angangoita maminitsi 30 inowedzera makumi emazana ezviuru pazuva)
c-156.example: Mubhaturumu inonyorova ye25~35°C, nhamba yebhakitiriya inowedzera angangoita nguva 4 zvuru pamaawa 6 ega ega. Kana pakaoma, kuwanda kunomira.
c-156.actionItem: Mushure mekushamba, bvisai mvura pamadziro nepasi nesqueegee, muvhure fan yekubvisa mhepo kwemaminitsi 30.

c-157.title: Nzira yekuchengeta mavhavha akachekwa
c-157.summary: Mavhavha anorasikirwa nemvura neshuga kuburikidza nenzvimbo yakachekwa, uye mabhakitiriya anowanda. Vhararai nzvimbo yakachekwa nerap, muchengete mufiriji, mudye mukati memazuva maviri kuti ive yakachengeteka.
c-157.principle: Kuvhuvhuta kunowirirana nenzvimbo yakaratidzwa netembiricha. Pa4 °C, kumhanya kwekuwanda kwebhakitiriya kunodzikira kusvika angangoita 1/20 yeiri pa25 °C.
c-157.example: Mavhavha akachekwa patembiricha yemuimba (30°C) anowedzera nhamba yebhakitiriya nemakumi enguva mushure memaawa 2, uye mufiriji (4°C) anochengeteka angangoita mazuva 2.
c-157.actionItem: Mavhavha asara, siyai achiri nechikamu chakakura nechikamu chechiganda, mugoisa rap padyo nenzvimbo yakachekwa mugoachengeta mufiriji.

c-158.title: Bento yezhizha yakachengeteka nemupunga une vhiniga nezvakabikwa zvakatonhodzwa
c-158.summary: Munzvimbo ine acid (pH pasi pe4.6), mabhakitiriya mazhinji anokonzera chirwere chekudya haakure. Kuisa chipunu chevhiniga mumupunga webento kana kuisa zvikafu zvatonhodzwa zvinoshanda kwenguva refu.
c-158.principle: Weak acid dissociation equilibrium $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$ inowedzera $[\mathrm{H^+}]$ uye pH ichidzikira, kukura kwebhakitiriya kunononoka.
c-158.example: Kuisa chipunu chikuru chimwe chevhiniga (15mL) mumapunu mapunu maviri emupunga (angangoita 300g) kunodzikisa pH yemupunga kuenda angangoita 5, uye kuwanda kwebhakitiriya kunononoka. Vhararai bento mushure mekutonhodza zvakakwana, muiise ne ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: Nhasi muna bento, tonhodzai mupunga zvakakwana musati mavhara, muiise ne ice pack.

c-159.title: Chikonzero nei zvishandiso zvinoita ngura mumazuva ane hunyoro
c-159.summary: Simbi inova iron oxide (ngura) kana pane mvura neoxygen, uye inokurumidza kana humidity yapfuura 60%. Oil film kana desiccant zvinononotsa ngura.
c-159.example: Pa relative humidity 60% kana kupfuura, simbi isina chinhu inoita ngura mukati memazuva mashoma, uye pasi pe40% humidity haipfuurire.
c-159.actionItem: Pukunyai zvishandiso nendege yakanyikwa mumafuta ekudzora muchiisa silica gel mubhokisi rezvishandiso.

c-160.title: Kuchenjerera pakushandisa mothball (naphthalene) mugwaro
c-160.summary: Mothball inoshanduka kubva pachakasimba ichiita gasi (sublimation) ichidzinga zvipukanana. Utsi hune ngozi kufema, saka mhepo nechinhambwe zvinodiwa.
c-160.principle: Sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$, kana tembiricha ikakwira vapor pressure inowedzera.
c-160.example: Vapor pressure ye naphthalene angangoita 11Pa pa25 °C, uye pa40 °C inowedzera angangoita nguva 4. Dzivirirai kuti isabate nguvo zvakananga.
c-160.actionItem: Nguvo dzakashandiswa mothball, dzipfapfaidze pa veranda kwemaawa 2~3 usati wadzipfeka, uye dzichengetedzwe kure nevana.

c-161.title: Kunhuhwirira kwegariki nehove kunodzikira kana ukakweshura pastainless steel
c-161.summary: Kunonzi kunhuhwirira kwesulfur compound yegariki neanyanisi kunodzikira kana ukakweshura maoko pa stainless steel. Kana ukashamba nesipo, sulfur compound yakasara inoshambidzwa.
c-161.principle: Sulfur compound $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ inonamira pa oxide film ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$) yesimbi ichiita kuti volatility idzikire.
c-161.example: Vazhinji vanoti kunhuhwirira kunodzikira kana ukakweshura maoko pa stainless faucet kwemasekonzi 30 mushure mekuchekachekesa gariki, asi humbowo hwesainzi nezvehukuru hwemhedzisiro hwakaganhurirwa. Muto werimau nevhiniga zvinogona kushandiswa pamwe chete.
c-161.actionItem: Nhasi mushure mekuchekachekesa gariki, kweshurai maoko pa stainless sink kwemasekonzi 30 mugoshamba nesipo.

c-162.title: Chikonzero nei mold yechingwa ichikura nokukurumidza mumazuva emvura
c-162.summary: Chingwa chine water activity yakakwira saka mold inokura nokukurumidza pa humidity 70% kana kupfuura. Mold hyphae inopfuura kusvika mukati mechingwa, saka kunyange kubvisa chikamu chakamera kunoramba kuri ngozi.
c-162.principle: Water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (chingwa angangoita 0.95, mold inokura pa 0.80 kana kupfuura)
c-162.example: Chingwa chiri patembiricha yemuimba ye25 °C mumazuva ane hunyoro chinomera mold mukati memazuva 3~4, uye kana chakaomeswa (-18°C) chinochengetwa kwemavhiki akati wandei.
c-162.actionItem: Nhasi cheka chingwa chamusingadi kudya kuita zvidimbu zvega muchiputira nerap muchiomese, uye mugochigocha patoaster paunodya.

c-163.title: Chikonzero nei mvura yemvura ichingova ine acid yakapfava
c-163.summary: Mvura yemvura ine acid yakapfava ye pH angangoita 5.6 nekuda kwecarbon dioxide yemumhepo inonyungudika, uye mvura ine acid inova pasi pe pH 5.6. Izvi hazvikuvadzi ganda, asi simbi nematombo zvinoora zvishoma nezvishoma.
c-163.example: Kana $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$, pH ndi $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$. Mvura yakachena iri pH 7.
c-163.actionItem: Mushure mekunaya, pukunyai mvura pamaketani ebhasikoro rakamiswa muzore mafuta tinji rimwe.

c-164.title: Mupunga wakatonhodzwa une resistant starch yakawanda saka shuga inotorwa inodzikira
c-164.summary: Kana mupunga watonhodzwa, chikamu chestarch chinoshanduka kuita resistant starch inonetsa kupukutika. Kunyange kana wapisa zvakare mushure mekuisa mufiriji, resistant starch iyi inosara zvishoma uye kukwira kweshuga yeropa kunogona kunyoroverwa zvishoma.
c-164.principle: Starch retrogradation ndiko kuti gelatinized amylose inodzoka ichiita crystal structure kana yatonhora. Makristasi aya haaparadzwi zvakanaka neamylase digestive enzyme.
c-164.example: Mupunga wakapiswa mushure memaawa 12~24 mufiriji unonzi une resistant starch yakawanda nenguva dzakawanda kupfuura mupunga wachangobikwa, asi huwandu hunowedzera chikamu chidiki chestarch yose. Musasiye mupunga patembiricha yemuimba, uuise mufiriji nokukurumidza.
c-164.actionItem: Nhasi isai mupunga wasara mufiriji mukati meawa rimwe.

c-165.title: Kukanganisa kwe fabric softener patauro mushure mekushambidza
c-165.summary: Fabric softener inovhara fibers neye cationic surfactant ichizvipfavisa, asi inodzikisa kutora mvura. Patauro, kudzikisa kushandiswa kana kushandisa vhiniga sechinotsiva zvakanaka.
c-165.principle: Cationic surfactant $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ inonamira pa negatively charged fibre $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ ichiumba hydrophobic film.
c-165.example: Tauro dzakashandiswa fabric softener dzinogona kutora mvura shoma ne20~30%. Pakushambidza matauro 10, dzikisai kushandiswa kwesoftener kuita 1 pa 3.
c-165.actionItem: Nhasi shambai matauro pasina fabric softener mugoatsurudza zvakanaka muchiomesa.

c-166.title: Kudzosera aluminum can kunoshandisa angangoita 5% chete yesimba rekugadzira itsva
c-166.summary: Aluminum inoshandisa magetsi akawanda pakugadzirwa itsva kubva pamabwe, asi kudzosera nekuinyungudisa kunochengetedza angangoita 95%. Kushambidza makani zvakanaka nokuaparadzanisa kunowedzera mhedzisiro.
c-166.principle: Bauxite electrolysis: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. Aluminum itsva 1kg inoshandisa angangoita $14\ \mathrm{kWh}$ uye aluminum yakadzoserwa angangoita $0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
c-166.example: Kudzosera aluminum can imwe (angangoita 14g) kunochengetedza angangoita 0.2kWh. Makani 100 ndi angangoita 20kWh, anenge simba rinoshandiswa neair conditioner kwemaawa angangoita 5.
c-166.actionItem: Nhasi kani yamakanwa, itsvairei zvose, mugoishambidza muchiisa mubhokisi rekuparadzanisa aluminum.

c-167.title: Chikafu chine mold hachichengeteki kunyange kubvisa chikamu chinoonekwa
c-167.summary: Mold inoparadzira hyphae seshinda pasi pechikamu chinoonekwa, uye imwe inogadzira ruvara rwehupfu. Pazvikafu zvakapfava seye chingwa, michero, jam, kana mold ichionekwa, kurasa zvose ndiko kuchengeteka.
c-167.principle: Aflatoxin $\mathrm{B_1}$ $\mathrm{C_{17}H_{12}O_6}$ ine kudzivirira kupisa uye inoparadzwa chete pamusoro pe $270\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Haisi kubviswa nekubika kana kugocha.
c-167.example: Pazvikafu zvakasimba seye cheese kana makarotsi, kune nhungamiro yekuchekera kunze 2.5cm kutenderedza chikamu chine mold, asi chikafu chine mvura yakawanda chakapfava seye chingwa, jam, kana tofu chinofanira kurasirwa chose.
c-167.actionItem: Nhasi tarisai kuti hapana mold pachingwa nejam mufiriji.

c-168.title: Kunhuhwirira kwecity gas chinhu chakaiswa nenzira yakananga
c-168.summary: City gas (methane) pakutanga haina kunhuhwirira, saka kuti kuvuza kuonekwe, thioether·mercaptan-based substance ine kunhuhwirira se'rotten egg' inowedzerwa zvishoma. Kana ukanzwa kunhuhwirira, musashandise moto kana switch yemagetsi, tanga wavhura mhepo.
c-168.principle: Methane inoputika pa 5~15% mumhepo: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Zvinhu zvinowedzerwa kuti zvinhuhwirire methane isina kunhuhwirira zvinosanganisira $\mathrm{CH_3SH}$.
c-168.example: Kana methane 0.4~1.2m³ (5~15%) yavuza mumba ye8 m³, iri mukati mewalfa yekuputika. Kana ukanzwa kunhuhwirira kwegasi, vhararai valve, vhurai mahwindo, musabata switch yemagetsi kana fan, mugoshevedza kunze.
