c-168.actionItem: Nhasi dzidzai kuti gas valve iri kupi mugoita tsika yekuvhara mushure mekushandisa.

c-169.title: Fluorescent whitening agent yeshoma yenguva chena 'inoita kuti ioneke' chena
c-169.summary: Fluorescent whitening agents dzinotora ultraviolet dzichiitumira sechiedza chebhuruu, dzichifukidza ruvara rweyero uye dzichiita kuti nguvo dzioneke dzakachena. Hazvibvisi tsvina; chiri chiratidzo chekuona, uye hazvidikanwi panguvo dzine ruvara.
c-169.principle: Fluorescence inotora ultraviolet (angangoita 350nm) ichibudisa chiedza chebhuruu (angangoita 430nm), uye energy $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ inobuda pa wavelength yakadzika zvishoma.
c-169.example: T-shirt chena yakashandisa fluorescent whitening agent inogona kuoneka yakachena angangoita 5~10% kupfuura pasi pezuva, inobudisa chiedza chebhuruu chakawanda. Nguvo dzine ruvara dzinogona kushambidzwa nedetergent yakajairika isina chiratidzo.
c-169.actionItem: Nhasi pakushambidza, tarisai chiratidzo che fluorescent whitening agent pa label ye detergent yenguvo chena nedzine ruvara.

c-170.title: Kuisa foni yakawira mumvura mumupunga hakuna mhedzisiro
c-170.summary: Mupunga une kugona kushoma kwekutora hunyoro, saka kumhanya kwekubvisa mvura mufoni kuri kusiyana zvishoma nekuomesa mumhepo. Zvakanaka kuzimisa magetsi, kusachaja, uye kuomesa panzvimbo ine mhepo.
c-170.principle: Kumhanya kwekuomesa kunowirirana nemusiyano wevapor pressure. Hygroscopicity yemupunga yakaderera zvikuru kupfuura silica gel, uye nguva iyo corrosion reaction yeshort circuit inoitika inokosha.
c-170.example: Silica gel inotora hunyoro kusvika angangoita 40% yehuremu hwayo, asi mupunga unotora zvishoma zvakanyanya. Zimisai magetsi uye muomese kwemaawa 24~48 kana kupfuura musati mavhura. Kana yawira mumvura ine munyu, bvunzai service center kutanga.
c-170.actionItem: Kana foni yanyorova, zimisai magetsi muiise panzvimbo ine mhepo panzvimbo yemupunga.

c-171.title: Kupisa ganda, tanga kutonhodza nemvura inotonhora inoyerera kwemaminitsi 20
c-171.summary: Mushure mekupisa ganda, kutonhodza nemvura inotonhora inoyerera (15~25℃) kwemaminitsi 10~20 kunobvisa kupisa kuri kupararira mukudzika kweganda uye kunodzikisa kukuvara. Musashandise echine, toothpaste, kana doenjang.
c-171.principle: Kupisa kwechinhu chinopisa kunotamira $q = mc\Delta T$ kuenda kumatishu uchiparadza protein. Mvura inoyerera inobvisa kupisa nokukurumidza.
c-171.example: Mvura ye60℃ inokonzera kupisa kwakakomba kweganda mumasekonzi 5. Mvura inotonhora kwemaminitsi 20 inodzikisa kudzika kwekupisa nekudzikamisa marwadzo, uye echine rinotonhora zvakanyanya rinodzikisa mutsipa wetsinga ichikuvadza matishu.
c-171.actionItem: Nhasi kana muchipiswa mukicheni, rangaririrai kutanga nekutonhodza nemvura inoyerera kwemaminitsi 20.

c-172.title: Chii chiri 'oxygen absorber' mukati mechikafu
c-172.summary: Kasaga kadiki kari mukurongedzwa kweseaweed kana jerky kane iron powder inoita chiitiko neoxygen ichibvisa oxygen mukati mepackage. Kana oxygen ichidzikira, kuora kwemafuta nemold zvinononoka.
c-172.example: Oxygen absorber imwe (angangoita 2g yesimbi) inotora angangoita 200mL yeoxygen, ichibvisa nenzira iri padyo oxygen ye21% mu1 L yemhepo yepackage.
c-172.actionItem: Musadye oxygen absorber iri mukasaga, siyai muchikafu chitsva chakarongedzwa pakuchengeta.

c-173.title: Kutarisa kuti mazai ari matsva, ayerereidze mumvura
c-173.summary: Ganda reeggi rine mabhura madiki, saka nekufamba kwenguva hunyoro necarbon dioxide zvinobuda uye air pocket inokura. Kana ichinyura inova itsva, kana ichiyangarara yakare.
c-173.principle: Buoyancy $F_{\mathrm{b}} = \rho_{\mathrm{water}}\,V g$, kana air pocket yakura uye average density $\rho < \rho_{\mathrm{water}}$ inoyangarara.
c-173.example: Density yeeggi yangobva kuwanikwa angangoita 1.09g/mL, uye mushure mevhiki 3~4 kana yadzikira kuita angangoita 1.02g/mL, inotanga kuyangarara mumvura isina munyu.
c-173.actionItem: Eggi rinofungirwa, usati wararipwanya, dururirai mvura mundiro muriyerereidze. Kana ichiyangarara, musadye.

c-174.title: Chikonzero nei uchi ichiomarara ichichena
c-174.summary: Kana glucose iri muuchi yapfuura muganhu wekunyungudika mumvura, inoita makristasi ichiomarara. Haisi kuora, chiri chiitiko chakajairika, uye inogona kudzoserwa nekupisa mumvura.
c-174.principle: Glucose solubility: kana saturation limit yapfuura $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(aq)} \rightarrow \mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(s)}$
c-174.example: Uchi hune glucose angangoita 31%, fructose angangoita 38%, mvura angangoita 17%, uye crystallization inokurumidza pasi pe14 °C. Kana ukaisa mumvura ye40 °C inonyunguka.
c-174.actionItem: Uchi hwakaomarara unyungudzei nokuuyerera mubhodhoro mumvura iri pasi pe40 °C, kwete mu microwave.

c-175.title: Chikonzero nei mafuta ekubikisa nemasupplements zvichiisirwa mumabhodhoro ebrown
c-175.summary: Chiedza, kunyanya ultraviolet nechiedza chebhuruu, zvinoparadza mafuta nemavitamin nekuzvikanganisa. Girazi rebrown rinovhara chiedza chine wavelength angangoita 450nm kana pasi zvakanyanya.
c-175.principle: Photo-oxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2} \xrightarrow{h\nu} \mathrm{ROO\cdot}$ (chain oxidation), photon energy $E = hc/\lambda$
c-175.example: Girazi rebrown rinovhara chiedza padyo ne400 nm kupfuura 90%, uye mafuta ari mubhodhoro rakajeka anogona kutanga kuora mukati memavhiki mashoma muzuva.
c-175.actionItem: Chengetai mafuta e sesame ne perilla mudura rine rima, kwete pawindo rine chiedza.

c-176.title: Mashandiro e instant cold pack
c-176.summary: Ammonium nitrate kana urea iri mupack kana ichinyungudika mumvura inotora kupisa uye tembiricha inodzikira. Iyi endothermic reaction inogona kushandiswa pakarepo kana ukaipwanya nokuizunza.
c-176.example: 1 mol (80g) yeammonium nitrate kana ichinyungudika mumvura inotora 25.7kJ, ichidzikisa tembiricha ye100 mL yemvura angangoita 15~20°C pasi petembiricha yemuimba.
c-176.actionItem: Pakumisa kana kurovedza muviri, tora instant cold pack, usaiisa pamusoro peganda zvakananga, uiputire netauro muishandise kwemaminitsi 15 chete.

c-177.title: Chikonzero nei lithium-ion batteries dzisina simba kupisa
c-177.summary: Tembiricha yakakwira inokurumidzisa electrolyte decomposition nekukura kwe SEI film, ichidzikisa capacity nokusingagadzirisike. Musasiye smartphone ne power bank mumotokari yekuzhizha.
c-177.principle: Degradation rate $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$: kana tembiricha ikwira angangoita 10°C, kumhanya kunova kaviri (Arrhenius rule of thumb)
c-177.example: Kana capacity inodzikira angangoita 20% mushure megore pa25 °C, pa45 °C mukati memwaka wakafanana inogona kudzikira angangoita 35~40%.
c-177.actionItem: Muzhizha, musasiye zvishandiso zvine mabhatiri mumotokari, muzvitakure mubhegi.

c-178.title: Chikonzero nei kimchi ichiva nesaasi nokukurumidza muzhizha
c-178.summary: Lactic acid bacteria dzakaiswa mu kimchi dzinowanda nokukurumidza kana tembiricha yakakwira, dzichigadzira lactic acid yakawanda. Pasi pe10 °C inoibva zvishoma nezvishoma uye kuravira kunogara kwenguva refu.
c-178.principle: Lactic acid fermentation: $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \rightarrow 2\,CH_3CH(OH)COOH}$ (pH inodzikira uye kuvava kunowedzera)
c-178.example: Pa20 °C mukati memazuva 3~4 pH inodzikira kusvika angangoita 4.2 ichiva nesaasi, asi mufiriji ye4 °C inochinja zvishoma nezvishoma pamavhiki akati wandei.
c-178.actionItem: Dururai zvamuchadya chete mumudziyo mudiki uye muchengete zvasara muchikamu chinotonhora zvakanyanya chefiriji.

c-179.title: Sunscreen ine mafuta saka kuishambidza nemvura chete hakuibvise zvakanaka
c-179.summary: Zvinhu zvinodzivirira ultraviolet nemafuta ari musunscreen hazvinyunguduki mumvura, saka mvura chete inosiya zvimwe. Oil cleanser kana cleansing balm inonyungudisa zvinhu zvemafuta, mugopedzisa nefoam cleanser kuti ibviswe zvakanaka.
c-179.principle: Like dissolves like: zvinhu zvine polarity yakafanana zvinosangana. Non-polar oil inonyungudika mu non-polar cleanser, uye mumvura surfactant (micelle) inodiwa.
c-179.example: Waterproof sunscreen yakagadzirwa kuti inosara kupfuura 80% kunyange mushure mekunyudzwa mumvura kwemaawa matatu. Kuisa cleansing oil nokuisa massage kwemasekonzi 30, wobva waiita emulsion nemvura muchishambidza zvinoshanda.
c-179.actionItem: Nhasi kana makazora sunscreen, tangai neoil cleanser mugopedzisa nefoam cleanser.

c-180.title: Mvura yebhatiri rakaparara yakashanduka kuita hupfu chena ine alkali, pukunyai muchipfeka magirovhosi
c-180.summary: Hupfu chena hunobuda kana alkaline batteries dzakare dzichivuza ndiyo potassium carbonate, potassium hydroxide inoita chiitiko necarbon dioxide yemumhepo. Inokanganisa ganda nemaziso, saka pfekai magirovhosi mupukunye nekotoni yakanyikwa mumuto werimau kana vhiniga.
c-180.principle: Makristasi machena anoumbwa ne $\mathrm{2KOH + CO_2 \to K_2CO_3 + H_2O}$, uye anoitwa neutral nevhiniga ine acid yakapfava sezvinoratidzwa $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + 2CH_3COOH \to 2CH_3COOK + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-180.example: Mvura yebhatiri ine alkali yakasimba ye pH 13~14 saka inokanganisa kana ikabata maoko asina chinhu. Pukunyai nekotoni yakanyikwa mumvhiniga mugopedzisa netauro yakaoma. Zvakachengeteka kubvisa mabhatiri pazvishandiso zvisingashandiswi.
c-180.actionItem: Nhasi bvisai mabhatiri pa remote control kana zvidhori zvisina kushandiswa kwenguva refu.

c-181.title: Chikonzero nei echine risingajeki
c-181.summary: Mhepo nezvakasanganiswa zvakanyungudika mumvura zvinosunganidzwa pakati peechine kana ichiita echine, zvichiita kuti riite chena. Kushandisa mvura yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa kunoita kuti itsvere zvishoma, asi haijeki zvachose.
c-181.principle: Gas solubility $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P$: kana mvura yaita echine solubility inenge zero uye mabhubhu anosungwa
c-181.example: Echine rakagadzirwa nemvura yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa rine mabhubhu mashoma saka rinoita rakajeka zvinoonekwa, uye kana ukaomesa kubva padivi rimwe (directional freezing) inova echine rakajeka.
c-181.actionItem: Nhasi gadzirai echine ramunoda nokudururira mvura yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa mu ice tray muchiomesa.

c-182.title: Nzira yekuchengeta hydrogen peroxide
c-182.summary: Hydrogen peroxide inoparara ichiita oxygen nemvura kana ichisangana nechiedza, kupisa, kana simbi. Chengetai mubhodhoro rebrown panzvimbo inotonhora, uye mabhodhoro akare haashande zvakanaka.
c-182.example: 3% hydrogen peroxide inogona kudzikira zvikuru mushure memwedzi 6 yekuvhurwa, uye kuparara kunokurumidza pamusoro pe30 °C.
c-182.actionItem: Nyorai zuva rekuvhura pabhodhoro rehydrogen peroxide rakatengwa kufarmasi, muriise panzvimbo inotonhora ine rima.

c-183.title: Kunwa mvura isina chinhu zvakanyanya mushure mekubuda ziya kune ngozi ye hyponatremia
c-183.summary: Kana ukanwa mvura isina chinhu yakawanda mushure mekubuda ziya kwenguva refu, sodium muropa inodzikira uye unogona kunzwa musoro unorwadza nekusvotwa. Dyai zvinwiwa kana zvekudya zvine munyu pamwe chete.
c-183.principle: Pamwe nemvura, Na$^+$ inobuda muziya. Kana ukazadza mvura isina chinhu chete, plasma sodium concentration $C_{\mathrm{Na}}=\frac{n_{\mathrm{Na}}}{V}$ denominator $V$ chete inowedzera ichidzikisa concentration, uye mvura inoenda mukati memasero nekuda kweosmosis. Chikamu chakajairika angangoita 135~145 mmol/L.
c-183.example: Mukukwira gomo kwemaawa matatu muzhizha, kubuda ziya angangoita 2L kunobvisa sodium angangoita 2g (yakaenzana nemunyu 5g). Kana ukanwa mvura isina chinhu 3L panguva imwe chete, Na$^+$ muropa inogona kudzikira pasi pe135 mmol/L.
c-183.actionItem: Nhasi pakurovedza muviri kana kufamba kwenguva refu, tora zvekudya zvine munyu (nuts, crackers) kana ion drink yakaderedzwa pamwe nemvura, uye musanwe zvinopfuura 500mL panguva imwe chete.

c-184.title: Bleach yakadonhedzwa mumvura inopisa inongorasikirwa nesimba rekuuraya utachiona
c-184.summary: Kana ukasanganisa bleach nemvura inopisa, chinhu chinoshanda chinoparara nekukurumidza uye chinongowedzera hwema hunonhuhwa hwe chlorine. Isanganise nemvura inotonhora kana inodziya zvishoma uye uishandise pakarepo.
c-184.principle: Chinhu chinoshanda HOCl chinobva ku sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) chinonzwa kupisa uye chinoparara se $2\mathrm{HOCl}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{O_2}$. Kukwira kwega kwega kwinenge 10°C kunowanzo kukurumidza kuparara ka2 kana kupfuura.
c-184.example: Bleach shoma yepamba (inenge 4-5% NaOCl) mu 500mL yemvura inoramba ichishanda kwemaawa pa 20°C, asi mumvura ye 60°C chikamu chikuru chinenge chapera mukati memaminetsi uye mhepo inonetsa inobuda zvakawanda.
c-184.actionItem: Kana uchiuraya utachiona nhasi, deredza bleach nemvura inotonhora, uishandise pakarepo, pfuudza mhepo mumba, uye usatongosanganisa nemishonga yekuchenesa ine acid.

c-185.title: Bika zvikono nemakungwa kusvika 85°C kwemunete 1 kuti uvhare Vibrio
c-185.summary: Kubika zvikono nemakungwa kusvika 85°C kana kupfuura pakati kwemunete 1 kana kupfuura kunodzikisa ngozi yeVibrio zvakanyanya. Zvikono zvisina kubikwa zvine ngozi kunyanya kune vanhu vane chirwere chekudzivirira chakaneta.
c-185.principle: Kupisa kunoshandura mapuroteni eVibrio kuti masero asaite basa. Huwandu hunodzikira se $N=N_0\,10^{-t/D}$, uye kupisa kwakawanda kunopfupisa $D$, nguva yekudzikira ka10.
c-185.example: Vibrio inowanda nekukurumidza mumvura yegungwa ye 25-35°C. Kubika kweminiti 3-5 mushure mekunge zvikamba zvavhurika uye kubata pakati pa 85°C kweminiti 1 kunowedzera kuchengeteka.
c-185.actionItem: Kana uchidya zvekugungwa nhasi, sarudza zvakabikwa zvakakwana pane zvisina kubikwa, uye geza banga nebhodhi zvakabata zvisina kubikwa pakarepo.

c-186.title: Muto weraimu kana remoni pasi pedehwe nezuva unogona kuita mavhizha
c-186.summary: Muto wemichero yecitrus unosiiwa padehwe muzuva unogona kuita kutsvuka sekupisa uye mavhizha. Kana muto wakubata, geza nesipo uye dzivisa zuva.
c-186.principle: Ma furocoumarin mugomba nemuto wecitrus anotora UVA (320-400nm) uye anosunga DNA nemapuroteni edehwe mukuita phototoxic. Simba rephoton ndi $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$, rakawanda pawavelength pfupi.
c-186.example: Kana ukamanya meraimu paphati yekunze uye usingageze maoko usati wagara muzuva maawa 1-2, mavara matsvuku nemavhizha akaita sechimiro chemuto anogona kuoneka mushure memaawa 24-72, uye mavara anogara kwemwedzi.
c-186.actionItem: Kana wabata citrus nhasi, geza maoko nesipo nemvura pakarepo, uye vhara dehwe rakabuda muzuva kusvikira wageza.

c-187.title: Kana jellyfish yakurova, geza nemvura yegungwa, kwete mvura isina munyu
c-187.summary: Kugeza nzvimbo yakarohwa nejellyfish nemvura isina munyu kunogona kuita kuti zvinhu zvinorova zvasara zvipfurwe. Geza nemvura yegungwa uye bvisa tentacles nechishandiso, kwete nemaoko.
c-187.principle: Ma nematocyst ejellyfish anopfurwa kana pane zvinomutsa zveosmotic nekemikari. Mvura isina munyu ine osmotic pressure yakaderera zvikuru kupfuura yegungwa (munyu unenge 35g/L); neku $\Pi=iMRT$ mvura inogona kupinda mumakapisuru ikamutsa kupfurwa.
c-187.example: Kana wakarohwa pabani, geza nemvura yegungwa kweasingasviki 30 sekondi, bvisa tentacles nemucheto wekadhi, uye kana kurwadza kwakanyanya, kunyika mumvura inenge 45°C kweminiti 20 anenge kunowanzo kurairwa. Rubatsiro rwekutanga runosiyana nemhando, naizvozvo fonera masevhisi enjodzi kana uri kunetseka kufema.
c-187.actionItem: Kana uchienda kugungwa nhasi, tarisa yambiro dzejellyfish uye utore bhodhoro remvura yegungwa nekadhi rebhengi rekukwenya.

c-188.title: Nei zvipfeko zvekushambira zvichirega mushure mepuru uye kuzvisarudza
c-188.summary: Zvipfeko zvekushambira zvinorega mushure mekushambira mapuru kanoverengeka nekuti chlorine inoputsa tambo dzinotatamuka. Sarudza jira rinodzivirira chlorine uye uzvigeze pakarepo mushure mekushandisa.
c-188.principle: Cheni dze spandex (polyurethane) dzinoitwa oxidation uye dzinocheneswa ne HOCl yemushonga wepuru. Cheni pfupi dzinoreva kutatamuka kushoma, uye spandex yakajairika inoparara nekukurumidza kupfuura jira rekushambira rine PBT rinodzivirira chlorine.
c-188.example: Chipfeko chakajairika che nylon/spandex chinoratidza kurega pachena mushure mekushambira ka 30-50, asi marudzi ane PBT anogara kakawanda. Chlorine yasara mupuru inowanzo 1-3mg/L.
c-188.actionItem: Mushure mekushambira nhasi, geza chipfeko mumvura inotonhora pakarepo, usachisvina, uye chiomese mumumvuri.

c-189.title: Nei aisikirimu yakaomeswazve ichiita yakaoma mukanwa
c-189.summary: Kana aisikirimu yanyunguduka ikazoomeswazve, makristaro makuru echando anoumba uye anoita kuti ive yakaoma. Mushure mekunyungudika kamwe, zviri nani kuidya pane kuiomesazve.
c-189.principle: Makristaro madiki echando ane simba repamusoro rakakura, anonyunguduka, uye mvura yawo inoenda kumakristaro makuru anokura (Ostwald ripening). Kunyungudika kunowedzera kana radius $r$ yadzikira: $\ln\frac{S_r}{S_\infty}=\frac{2\gamma V_m}{rRT}$.
c-189.example: Aisikirimu yakanaka ine makristaro echando asingasviki 50μm uye inonzwika yakapfava, asi mushure mekunyungudika nekuomeswazve anogona kukura kupfuura 100μm uye otanga kunzwika akaoma. Kuchinja kwekupisa mufiriza kunoita zvakafanana.
c-189.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta aisikirimu kumashure kwefiriza pane pamusuwo kuti udzikise kuchinja kwekupisa, uye vhara chivharo pakarepo mushure mekutora.

c-190.title: Usatongosiya dry ice mumotokari yakavharwa
c-190.summary: Dry ice hainyunguduki asi inoita gasi, rinogona kukwidziridza CO$_2$ mumotokari yakavharwa kusvika padanho rine ngozi. Itakure mahwindo akavhurika kana munzvimbo ine mhepo.
c-190.principle: CO$_2$ yakasimba inosublime: $\mathrm{CO_2(s)}\rightarrow \mathrm{CO_2(g)}$ (pa -78.5°C). 1kg inoita gasi rinenge 500L, uye CO$_2$ inopfuura 4% inoita musoro unorwadza nekuzunguzika, nemazinga akakwirira ane ngozi.
c-190.example: 2kg yedry ice inoburitsa CO$_2$ inenge 1,000L. Kana ikaparara yose mukati memotokari rinenge 3,000L, huwandu hunogona kukwira kusvika 25%, hune ngozi huru.
c-190.actionItem: Kana uchitakura dry ice nhasi, chengeta nzvimbo iine mhepo, ibate nemagirovhosi, uye usatongoiisa mugaba rakavharwa.

c-191.title: Chibage chinorasikirwa nekutapira kana chikagara nguva refu mushure mekubudiswa
c-191.summary: Kubva panguva yekukohwa chibage, shuga dzacho dzinoshanduka kuita starch uye kutapira kunoderera. Chibike pazuva rawachitenga kana kuchichengetera mufiriji kuti kutapira kugare nguva refu.
c-191.principle: Ma enzyme mumbeu anoshandura shuga se glucose kuita starch: $n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\rightarrow(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Kuita kwema enzyme kunononoka mumhepo inotonhora, saka kuchengeta mufiriji kunononokesa shanduko.
c-191.example: Chibage chitsva chinotapira chakasiiwa pakupisa kwemumba kwezuva rimwe chinogona kushandura shuga inenge 40% kuita starch, asi pa 0-4°C mufiriji maitiro acho anononoka zvikuru. Kuchengeta mapfunjiro kunodzikisa kurasikirwa kwemvura.
c-191.actionItem: Kana wakatenga chibage nhasi, chichengetere mufiriji chiine mapfunjiro pane kuchisiya kunze, uye chibike mukati mezuva rimwe kana zvichikwanisika.

c-192.title: Nei kuisa matomatisi mufiriji kuchiparadza kunaka kwawo
c-192.summary: Kutonhodza tomato yakaibva kunodzikisa hwema hwayo uye kunoita kuti ive yakapfava seupfu. Chengeta matomatisi akaibva pakupisa kwemumba uye uadye mukati memazuva mashoma.
c-192.principle: Pasi pe 12°C matomatisi anorwara nechando, zvinodzikisa kushanda kwema enzyme anoita zvinhu zvinonhuhwira (se cis-3-hexenal) uye zvinokuvadza membranes. Mwero we enzyme unoenderana nekupisa se $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-192.example: Mazuva 3 chete mufiriji ye 5°C anogona kudzikisa zvakanyanya zvinonhuhwira zvetomato. Pakupisa kwemumba, matomatisi akaibva anodyiwa zvakanaka mukati memazuva 3-5.
c-192.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta matomatisi akaibva akatarisa pasi pamudzidzi munzvimbo inotonhorera, uye kana akatonhodzwa kare, abudise maminetsi 30 usati wadya.

c-193.title: Maitiro ekununura mayonnaise yakaparadzana
c-193.summary: Usarasa mayonnaise yakaparadzana mafuta neeggi. Isanganise zvishoma nezvishoma muyolk itsva yeeggi kuti uidzorere; lecithin yeyolk itsva inodzorera emulsion.
c-193.principle: Mayonnaise i emulsion yemafuta akapararira mumvura, uye lecithin muyolk inodzikisa interfacial tension $\gamma$ yemafuta nemvura kuti matinhwi arege kubatana. Kana mafuta akaiswa nekukurumidza kana kupisa kusina kunaka, matinhwi anobatana uye zvikamu zvinoparadzana.
c-193.example: Inenge 200g yemayonnaise yakaparadzana inogona kuitwa yakapfava zvakare nekuisanganisa chipunu nechipunu mu 1 yolk itsva ne 1 teaspoon yemvura. Yolk imwe inowanzokwanisa kuita emulsion yemafuta kusvika 200mL.
c-193.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira mayonnaise nhasi, tanga nekuwedzera mafuta dzvindi nedzvindi, wozokurumidza zvishoma nezvishoma, shandisa mazai matsva, uye uchengetere mufiriji mushure mekugadzira.

c-194.title: Zvigadzirwa zvekutonhodza ne menthol hazvidzikisi kupisa kwemuviri chaizvo
c-194.summary: Zvinodhonzwa nementhol nemashiti zvinongoita kuti unzwe kutonhora; hazvidzikisi kupisa kwemuviri chaizvo. Mvura nemumvuri zvinotanga pakudzikisa kupisa.
c-194.principle: Menthol inomutsa cold receptor TRPM8 mudehwe, ichitumira zviratidzo zvechando kumasinga. Kuchinjana kwekupisa chaiko kunoda shanduko yekupisa, se $Q=mc\Delta T$, uye menthol pachayo haibvisi kupisa kwemuviri.
c-194.example: Chigadzirwa chekutonhodza chine menthol inenge 1% chinochinja kupisa kwedehwe nekanenge 0.5°C panyanya, asi kunzwa kutonhora kunogara maminetsi gumi nemaminetsi. Mukupisa kupfuura 33°C, kuvimba nekunzwa chete kune ngozi.
c-194.actionItem: Pazuva rinopisa nhasi, usavimba nezvigadzirwa zvekutonhodza chete; inwa mvura uye zorora mumumvuri kuti kupisa kwemuviri kudzikire chaizvo.

c-195.title: Kana muromo uchipisa, nwa mukaka pane mvura
c-195.summary: Kana chikafu chinopisa chichipisa muromo, mvura inobatsira zvishoma asi mukaka kana yogati zvinoshanda zviri nani. Capsaicin inonamatira kumafuta nemapuroteni.
c-195.principle: Capsaicin ($\mathrm{C_{18}H_{27}NO_3}$) mamorekuru anonyungudika mumafuta asingatongonyungudiki mumvura. Mafuta emukaka anoinyungudutsa uye casein protein inoisunga, zvichibatsira kuibvisa pamareceptors.
c-195.example: Mushure menoodles inopisa, 200mL yemvura inongosuka kwenguva pfupi, asi mukombe wemukaka (200mL, mafuta anenge 7g, protein inenge 6g) unonyaradza kupisa zvakanyanya mukati memaminetsi.
c-195.actionItem: Pachikafu chinopisa nhasi, nwa mukaka kana yogati isina chinhu pamwe chete, uye kana muromo uchipfuta, svina sipu mumuromo usati wameza.

c-196.title: Zvikamu zvakapiswa zvenyama yakagochwa pamarasha zvine benzo[a]pyrene
c-196.summary: Zvidimbu zvakasviba, zvakapiswa zvenyama yakagochwa pamarasha akavhurika zvinogona kuva ne benzo[a]pyrene, inofungidzirwa kuti inokonzera kenza. Cheka zvikamu zvakapiswa uye rega murazvo usabata nyama.
c-196.principle: Kana mafuta enyama achidonha pamarasha akapisa, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) dzinoumbwa uye dzinokwira nehutsi dzichifukidza nyama. Imwe huru ndi benzo[a]pyrene ($\mathrm{C_{20}H_{12}}$).
c-196.example: Kugocha nyama yenguruve ine mafuta zvakananga pamoto kunowedzera benzo[a]pyrene mutsi nezvakapiswa. Kupukuta grill kakawanda uye kushandisa foil kana ndiro pane grate kunogona kudzikisa PAHs zvakanyanya.
c-196.actionItem: Kana uchigocha nyama nhasi, shandisa moto wepakati kure nemurazvo unobva pamafuta anodonha, uye cheka chikamu chipi zvacho chakasviba usati wadya.

c-197.title: Shandisa graphite powder, kwete mafuta, mudanda rechikiyi
c-197.summary: Kana danda rechikiyi rakanamira, graphite powder (guruva rependi) inoshanda zviri nani kupfuura mafuta akajairika. Mafuta anoita kuti guruva rinamire uye anoita kuti danda rinamire zvakanyanya nenguva.
c-197.principle: Graphite i lubricant yakasimba iine zvikamu zvecarbon zvinotsvedza pamusoro pezvimwe. Inodzikisa friction coefficient $F=\\mu N$ mu $\\mu$ uye, sezvo yakaoma, haisunganidzi guruva.
c-197.example: Kufuridzira kamwe kana kaviri kwegraphite powder muhomwe yechikiyi kunodzikisa friction kuti chikiyi chitenderere zvakanaka. Mafuta akajairika anosanganiswa neguruva uye anogona kuita guma mukati memwedzi, achivhara danda.
c-197.actionItem: Kana chikiyi chakaoma nhasi, furidzira graphite lubricant shoma muhomwe yechikiyi, kana kuti ruka pendi mumitsetse yechikiyi uchidzipinza nekudzibudisa kakawanda.

c-198.title: Shandisa mafuta echeni, kwete WD-40, pacheni yebhasikoro
c-198.summary: WD-40 mazhinji ndiro solvent nechinhu chekuchenesa uye haigare senzvimbo yekuisa mafuta pacheni yebhasikoro. Mushure mekuchenesa, isa mafuta akagadzirirwa macheni.
c-198.principle: WD-40 i solvent inoshanduka ine firimu rakatetepa remafuta rinoparara kana kuhwohwodzwa nekukurumidza. Lubricant ine viscosity yakakwira inochengeta firimu pakati pezvinhu zvinobatana, zvichidzikisa kurasikirwa kwefriction $P_{\mathrm{loss}}=F_f\,v$.
c-198.example: Cheni yakachena, yakazorwa mafuta zvakanaka ine efficiency inenge 98-99%, asi yakaoma uye ine tsvina inogona kurasikirwa ne 3 percentage points kana kupfuura. Pa 150W yekutsika, 3% inenge 4.5W yakarasika.
c-198.actionItem: Kana cheni yako ichidzvova nhasi, ipukute nejira rakaoma, isa dhiropu rimwe remafuta echeni pa link imwe neimwe, wobva wapukuta zvakawandisa.

c-199.title: Kana aluminium ichibata stainless steel, imwe inoora kutanga
c-199.summary: Kana simbi dzakasiyana dzichibatana mumvura, iyo inoshanda zvakanyanya inoora kutanga. Kana uchisunga aluminium ne stainless steel nebhaudhi, isa washer inodzivirira magetsi pakati pazvo.
c-199.principle: Simbi mbiri dzine potentials dzakasiyana neelectrolyte dzinoumba cell diki, uye aluminium inonyungudika paanode: $\mathrm{Al}\rightarrow \mathrm{Al^{3+}}+3e^-$. Standard potentials dzinosiyana zvikuru: inenge -1.66V yeAl zvichienzaniswa nenge -0.44V kana kupfuura ye stainless (inobva paFe).
c-199.example: Pateresi yepabani, kushandisa zvisikuru zve stainless zvakananga mugonhi realuminiyamu kunogona kuita upfu hwichena hwekuora pazvinobatana mukati memwedzi kusvika gore, nekuti kusiyana kwepotential kukuru uye mvura yegungwa i electrolyte yakanaka.
c-199.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa nzvimbo dzinobatana simbi dzakasiyana, uye pane mvura inosangana, dzaparadzanise newasher inodzivirira magetsi kana pendi.

c-200.title: Usaise chikafu mubhaketi regalvanized
c-200.summary: Kuisa chikafu chine acid (vhiniga, michero yakachengetwa, kimchi) mubhaketi kana shiti rakafukidzwa nezinc kunogona kuburitsa zinc uye kukonzera kurutsa nekurwadza dumbu. Shandisa midziyo yakagadzirirwa chikafu.
c-200.principle: Chifukidzo chezinc chinonyungudika muacid: $\mathrm{Zn}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Zn^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2}$. Zvikafu zvine acid zvine pH 4 kana pazasi, saka kuita kwacho kuri nekukurumidza.
c-200.example: Panzvimbo yekudyara, lemonade kana pickles dzine pH inenge 3 dzakasiiwa mubhaketi regalvanized kwemaawa dzinogona kutora zinc ine makumi e mg/L, zvichikonzera ngozi yekurutsa nekunzwa kusvotwa. Huwandu hwekurairwa kwemunhu mukuru pazuva hunenge 8-11mg chete.
c-200.actionItem: Kana uri kukemba kana kubika kunze nhasi, shandisa chete midziyo yakanyorwa kuti yakachengeteka kuchikafu, uye chengeta mabhaketi egalvanized ekutakura mvura.

c-201.title: Tarisa mukombe weceramic wakabva kunze kwenyika kuti une lead inobuda muglaze
c-201.summary: Makapu eceramic anopenya akabva kunze anogona kuburitsa lead kubva muglaze achiisa mumvura ine acid. Tsvaga zvikwangwani zvechikafu chakachengeteka nemhedzisiro dzemiedzo, uye usasiya zvinwiwa zvine acid mukati nguva refu.
c-201.principle: Lead compounds muglaze dzinonyungudika muacid: $\mathrm{PbO}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pb^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2O}$. Kubuda kunowedzera kana pH yaderera, se vhiniga kana muto wemichero, uye nenguva refu yekubatana.
c-201.example: Mumuedzo wekunyika mu 4% acetic acid kwemaawa 24, muganho weKorea wemakapu i 0.4mg/L yelead. Zvishongo zveceramic zvisina rondedzero yemuedzo zvinogona kupfuura muganho uyu.
c-201.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa makapu eceramic akabva kunze kuti ane chikwangwani chechikafu chakachengeteka nerondedzero yemuedzo, uye usazadza makapu ezvishongo asina kuvimbiswa nezvinwiwa zvine acid se juice kana waini.

c-202.title: Mafuta anonhuhwira akasiiwa mumotokari anochinja hwema
c-202.summary: Mafuta anonhuhwira akasiiwa mumotokari inopisa anochinja hwema uye anorasikirwa nekuchena. Aachengete munzvimbo inotonhorera, yerima.
c-202.principle: Mamorekuru akareruka e top-note anoshanduka zvikuru uye anobuda nekukurumidza kana kupisa kwakwira. Vapor pressure inowedzera nenzira ye exponential nekupisa, $\ln P=-\frac{\Delta H_{\mathrm{vap}}}{RT}+C$, uye kupisa, chiedza neoxygen zvinoita oxidation yezvinhu zvinonhuhwira.
c-202.example: Motokari yakamira pakati pezhizha inogona kupfuura 60°C mukati, ichibudisa mafuta anonhuhwira kakawanda kupfuura imba ye 20°C. Mushure memavhiki mashoma, top notes dzecitrus dzinoderera uye mvura inogona kusviba.
c-202.actionItem: Nhasi, bvisa mafuta anonhuhwira mumotokari kana mubhavhu uaise mudhirowa rinotonhorera, rerima, uye vhara chivharo zvakasimba mushure mekushandisa.

c-203.title: Mafuta ekuzora nema cream akasiiwa mumotokari yezhizha anogona kuparadzana
c-203.summary: Mafuta ekuzora nema cream akasiiwa mumotokari inopisa anogona kuparadzana kuita mvura nemafuta uye achichinja, achidzikisa kushanda. Chengeta mishonga pakupisa kwakanyorwa palabel (kazhinji 30°C kana pazasi).
c-203.principle: Cream i emulsion yemvura nemafuta inosimbiswa neemulsifiers. Kupisa kunodzikisa kushanda kweemulsifier uye viscosity zvichiita kuti matinhwi abatane uye zvikamu zvaparadzane. Mwero wekuita unonzwa kupisa, $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-203.example: Motokari yakamira pakati pezhizha inogona kupfuura 60°C, saka cream inogona kuita yakaonda kana kubudisa mafuta mukati memaawa. Kana yaparadzana, chigadzirwa chinogona kusadzoka sepakutanga kunyange chikasanganiswazve.
c-203.actionItem: Kana uchibuda nhasi, tora mafuta ekuzora, sunscreen nemishonga mubhegi rako pane kuasiya mumotokari.

c-204.title: Masitovhu ealkoholi ekukemba: methanol ne ethanol hazvienzani
c-204.summary: Pamasitovhu ealkoholi ekukemba, methanol ine chepfu uye inopisa nemurazvo unenge usingaonekwi, saka denatured ethanol ndiyo yakachengeteka. Tarisa kana ichipisa, uye dzima murazvo usati wawedzera mafuta.
c-204.principle: Ethanol inopisa se $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+3\mathrm{H_2O}$ uye methanol se $2\mathrm{CH_3OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+4\mathrm{H_2O}$. Murazvo wemethanol unenge uchipinda chiedza, uye muviri unoishandura kuita formic acid, zvichiita kuti ive chepfu zvikuru.
c-204.example: Ethanol inoburitsa 27kJ/g inenge kana ichipisa zvichienzaniswa nenge 20kJ/g yemethanol, saka ethanol inopa kupisa kwakawanda pagiramu. Methanol shoma yakamezwa inogona kukonzera upofu nechepfu.
c-204.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa sitovhu yealkoholi nhasi, tarisa rudzi rwemafuta, uye wedzera mafuta chete mushure mekunge murazvo wadzimwa uye sitovhu yatonhora.

c-205.title: Usachengete petroli yemachina ekucheka uswa kana trimmer kupfuura mwedzi mitatu
c-205.summary: Petroli yakachengetwa kupfuura mwedzi mitatu yebrush cutter kana jenareta inoora, ichikonzera kuoma kutanga uye kuvharika kwe carburetor. Tenga zvaunoda chete, kana shandisa fuel stabilizer pazvasara.
c-205.principle: Zvikamu zvakareruka zvepetroli zvinobuda nemhepo uye oxidation inoumba gum inonamira inovhara mapaipi emafuta. Mafuta ane ethanol anotora mvura uye anogona kuparadzana. Oxidation inoenderera se $\mathrm{RH}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow$ peroxides nezvimwe zvinhu.
c-205.example: Mugaba rakavharwa, petroli yakajairika inowanzotanga kuva nedambudziko mushure memwedzi 3-6 uye mafuta ane ethanol mushure memwedzi 1-3. Mudziyo wakazara, unotonhorera unogara kwenguva refu nekuti mhepo shoma inobata mafuta.
c-205.actionItem: Kana usingatongoshandisi brush cutter yako kwenguva refu, dururira mafuta kana wedzera stabilizer nhasi, uye chengeta mafuta asara munzvimbo yakavharwa, inotonhorera.

c-206.title: Kana wakaisa petroli mumotokari yedhizeri, usatanga injini
c-206.summary: Kana wakaisa petroli mumotokari yedhizeri zvisiri nemaune, usaitanga uye fonera motokari yekudhonza. Fuel pump nema injector zvinogona kukuvara.
c-206.principle: Injini dzedhizeri dzinoshandisa compression ignition (mhepo yakamanikidzwa kuita kupisa kukuru inovhura mafuta pachayo), asi petroli inokurudzira kuvhura zvakaoma uye ine viscosity yakaderera, saka haizore mafuta. Compression ratio yedhizeri inenge $\varepsilon=15\sim 20$.
c-206.example: Petroli inosanganiswa inodzikisa kuzora kwepump yekumanikidza kwakakwirira uye inogona kukonzera kudzikira kwesimbi, nekugadziriswa kunodhura mamiriyoni eKRW (zviuru zveUSD). Kudururira tangi usina kutanga injini kunowanzoridzivirira kukuvara.
c-206.actionItem: Pakuisa mafuta nhasi, tarisa ruvara rwechibati chepump nerudzi rwemafuta, uye kana wakaisa mafuta asina kunaka, usatendeudza kiyi uye fonera shopu yekugadzirisa.

c-207.title: AdBlue diesel exhaust fluid inoora mukupisa kwezhizha
c-207.summary: Kana ichichengetwa ichipisa kwenguva refu, urea mudiesel exhaust fluid inoputsika, huwandu hwayo hunodzikira, uye inonhuwa ammonia. Ichengete munzvimbo inotonhorera, ine mumvuri uye usashandise mvura yekare.
c-207.principle: Mvura iyi (32.5% urea solution) inoita hydrolysis kuita ammonia, $\mathrm{(NH_2)_2CO}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{NH_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$, uye mu SCR unit inodzikisa nitrogen oxides, $4\mathrm{NH_3}+4\mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 4\mathrm{N_2}+6\mathrm{H_2O}$.
c-207.example: Kana ichichengetwa pa 25°C kana pazasi inowanzogara kwegore rinenge, asi pamusoro pe 30°C inodzikira kuita mwedzi mishoma, uye mubhutsu remotokari re 50°C hunhu hunogona kudzikira mukati memavhiki. Huwandu hunoshanduka kubva pa spec ye 32.5%.
c-207.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta exhaust fluid munzvimbo inotonhorera isina zuva rakananga, uye tarisa bhodhoro rakasiiwa kwenguva refu mubhutsu usati waishandisa.

c-208.title: Ongorora mafuta einjini nemaoxidation nekupera kwezvinowedzerwa, kwete kilometers chete
c-208.summary: Nguva yekushandura mafuta einjini inoenderana nenguva, rwendo rupfupi nemamiriro ekupisa pamwe nekilometers. Shandisa nguva yakarairwa nemugadziri sechitsanangudzo uye uipfupise mumamiriro akaoma.
c-208.principle: Mafuta einjini anoita oxidation pakupisa kwakanyanya, achiwedzera kukora uye achiumba sludge, nepo zvinowedzerwa se detergents ne dispersants zvichipera uye zvichibata acid netsvina zvishoma. Oxidation inoenderana ne $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, ichiwanzoita kaviri pakukwira kwega kwega kwe 10°C.
c-208.example: Kana mugadziri achirairira 10,000km kana gore rimwe, kushandiswa kwakaoma se rwendo rupfupi chete kana kutyaira mukupisa kunodaidza kushandurwa pa 5,000-7,500km kana mwedzi 6. Kunyange pa 5,000km pagore, shandura mushure megore.
c-208.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa sitika yeservice kana bhuku kuti uone nguva yekushandura uye uienzanise nezuva rekupedzisira rawakashandura mafuta.

c-209.title: Kuzadza matayara nenitrogen kunovhara here?
c-209.summary: Matayara akazadzwa nenitrogen anorasikirwa nekumanikidza zvishoma zvishoma, asi mhedzisiro iri diki. Chinonyanya kukosha kutarisa kumanikidza kamwe pamwedzi, kwete rudzi rwegasi.
c-209.principle: Rubber inopinza oxygen ka 3-4 nekukurumidza kupfuura nitrogen. Mhepo inenge 78% N$_2$ uye 21% O$_2$, saka kuzadza nenitrogen kunodzikisa kupinda kwe O$_2$ uye kunononokesa kudzikira kwekumanikidza. Pavolume yakagadziriswa, kumanikidza kunoenderana ne $P=\frac{nRT}{V}$, kunoenderana nemamoles nekupisa.
c-209.example: Matayara akazadzwa nemhepo anowanzorasikirwa 1-2psi (7-14kPa) pamwedzi, uye nitrogen inongodzikira zvishoma. Kudzikira kwekupisa kwemhepo kwe 10°C kunodzikisa kumanikidza ne 1psi inenge mune nitrogen nemhepo.
c-209.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kumanikidza kwematayara kana atonhora uye uigadzirise kusvika pa spec yakadhindwa palabel yepamusuwo.

c-210.title: Lunchbox yakasiiwa pakupisa kwemumba inochengeta chepfu kunyange ichipisirwa zvakare
c-210.summary: Lunchbox kana marice rolls akasiiwa muzhizha anogona kuva nechepfu isingabviswi nekupisira kana kubika kana zvatanga kuora. Kana wakahwanda, rasa.
c-210.principle: Enterotoxins dzinogadzirwa neStaphylococcus aureus ichikura pakupisa kwemumba dzinomira kupisa, uye zvizhinji zvinoramba kunyange mushure memaminetsi 30+ pa 100°C. Mabhakitiriya anofa asi chimiro chechepfu yeprotein hachikuvadzwe nyore, saka zviratidzo zvichiri kuitika.
c-210.example: Mabhakitiriya anowanda nekukurumidza pa 20-37°C uye anogona kugadzira chepfu mukati memaawa, nekurutsa nekurwadza dumbu kutanga maawa 1-6 mushure mekudya. Chikafu chakasiiwa kupfuura maawa 2 (awa 1 pamusoro pe 30°C) mushure mekubika chine ngozi.
c-210.actionItem: Nhasi, isa lunch mubhegi rekutonhodza neice pack, uye rasa chikafu chakasiiwa pakupisa kwemumba kupfuura maawa 2 mushure mekubika.

c-211.title: Usageze ndiro nedetergent muhova kana mugungwa
c-211.summary: Kugeza ndiro nedetergent muhova kana pabani kunosvibisa mvura, kunogona kuuraya hove uye kukonzera algal blooms. Geza chete munzvimbo dzakatarwa dzepakemba.
c-211.principle: Ma surfactants mudetergent anokuvadza membranes yema gill ezvisikwa zvemumvura, uye phosphates dzinowedzera zvinovaka muviri zvinokonzera algal blooms ne eutrophication. Kana algae yafa, kuora kunoshandisa oxygen uye kunodzikisa dissolved oxygen (DO).
c-211.example: Kunyange dhiropu rimwe redetergent yendiro yakajairika (inenge 0.05mL) rinogona kukanganisa zvisikwa zvemumvura mumakumi emalita emvura. Kana dissolved oxygen yehova ichidzikira pazasi pe 5mg/L, hove dzinorwa kurarama.
c-211.actionItem: Kunze nhasi, tora zvisara zvechikafu newe uye geza ndiro panzvimbo yakatarwa yegreywater yepakemba.

c-212.title: Utachiona hunotevera kufema kwako nehwema hwekutsvedza
c-212.summary: Hutachiona hunotevera carbon dioxide yaunofema nehwema hwelactic acid mukutsvedza kuti huwane pahunoruma. Kupukuta ziya nekuisa repellent kunodzikisa mukana wekurumwa.
c-212.principle: Ma receptors pamaantennae emhumhu anotevera gradients dzehuwandu, achienda kunzvimbo dzine CO$_2$ nelactic acid yakawanda ($\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$). Mhepo inofemwa inenge 4% CO$_2$, inenge ka 100 yeinenge 0.04% yemhepo yakatenderedza.
c-212.example: Munhu anofema inenge 1kg yeCO$_2$ pazuva, uye mushure mekuita fambiro ziya lactic acid rinowedzera, saka hutachiona hunokwanisa kukuwana kubva pamakumi emamita. Zvigadzirwa ne DEET 10-30% zvinowanzodzivirira kwemaawa akati wandei.
c-212.actionItem: Usati wabuda kunze nhasi, pukuta ziya, isa repellent padehwe rakashama nemacipfeko, uye bvisa mvura yakamira.

c-213.title: Hwema hwemadhaini kubva padhireni yepasi hunokwira kana trap seal yaoma
c-213.summary: Kana dhireni ichinhuhwa semadhaini, mvura yetrap seal yayo inenge yaoma. Dururira jagi remvura kuti uzadzezve seal uye uvhare hwema.
c-213.principle: Mvura inobatwa muU-bend yetrap (seal) inovhara gasi remadhaini. Kana ichibuda nemhepo, hydrogen sulfide ($\mathrm{H_2S}$) inogadzirwa nemicrobes mumadhaini inogona kukwira. Kudzika kwe seal kunowanzova 50mm.
c-213.example: Seal yedhireni yebhavhu risingashandiswi inogona kuoma mukati memavhiki 1-2, ichibvumira hwema kupinda. Kudururira 500mL yemvura inoizadza zvakare, uye muzhizha kubuda kwemvura kunokurumidza saka inowanzoomesa.
c-213.actionItem: Nhasi, dururira jagi remvura mumadhireni ebhavhu kana mubhaarikoni asingashandiswi kuti uzadze seal, uye udzokorore kamwe pamwedzi.

c-214.title: Nei mamishini echando achinhuhwa nehwema hwakasviba
c-214.summary: Hwema hwakasviba kubva kumishini yekutonhodza hunobva kumabhakitiriya nehutachiona hwehunyoro hunokura mumvura yakagumbuka neguruva mukati. Kuomesa mukati nefan mode usati wadzima kunobatsira.
c-214.principle: Mvura inoita condensation pamafin ekutonhodza se $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}\rightarrow \mathrm{H_2O(l)}$, uye microbes dzinokura muguruva nezvinhu zvine organic, dzichigadzira zvinhu zvinoshanduka (fatty acids, alcohols, nezvimwe) zvinonhuhwa zvakasviba.
c-214.example: Kudzima pakarepo mushure mekutonhodza kunosiya hunyoro hwemukati kupfuura 80%, saka mabhakitiriya anokura nyore. Kuita fan mode kweminiti 10-30 usati wadzima kunoomesa zvakawanda zvemukati uye kunodzikisa hwema zvakanyanya.
c-214.actionItem: Nhasi, rega AC iite fan mode kweminiti 15 usati wadzima, uye bvisa filter, uidzuure guruva uye uirege iome.

c-215.title: Firimu jena pachokoreti hakusi marara
c-215.summary: Firimu jena pachokoreti kazhinji hakusi marara asi fat bloom, cocoa butter yakanyunguduka ikaomazve. Kunzwika kunosvika kwakaoma zvishoma asi zvakachengeteka kudya.
c-215.principle: Cocoa butter ine mafomu akati wandei ecrystal (polymorphs). Fomu V yakagadzikana inoshanduka kuita fomu VI yakagadzikana zvikuru nekuchinja kwekupisa ichikwira pamusoro, ichioneka jena. Fomu V inonyunguduka pa 34°C.
c-215.example: Kana yakachengetwa pamusoro pe 28°C kana kupisa kuchichinja kakawanda, bloom inogona kuoneka mukati memazuva kusvika mavhiki. Kuchengeta chokoreti kwakanakisa i 15-18°C pa 50% relative humidity kana pazasi.
c-215.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta chokoreti munzvimbo inotonhorera isina zuva rakananga, uye kana uchiibvisa mufiriji, irege mupepa rayo pakupisa kwemumba kudzivirira condensation.

c-216.title: Hove dzemackerel netuna dzakasiiwa pakupisa kwemumba dzinoita histamine
c-216.summary: Hove dzine nyama tsvuku se mackerel netuna dzinogona kuita histamine kana dzakasiiwa, zvichikonzera kutsvuka kwechiso, musoro unorwadza nemamota. Kubika hakubvisi, saka chengeta hove dziri nyowani uye dzakatonhora.
c-216.principle: Bacterial histidine decarboxylase inoshandura histidine yehove kuita histamine: $\mathrm{C_6H_9N_3O_2}\rightarrow \mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$. Histamine inomira kupisa uye haiparadzwi nekubika.
c-216.example: Histamine inogona kuumbwa mukati memaawa pa 25°C asi inononoka zvikuru pa 4°C. Miganho yechikafu kazhinji 200mg/kg kana pazasi, uye kudya 100mg kana kupfuura kunogona kukonzera zviratidzo.
c-216.actionItem: Nhasi, isa hove dzine nyama tsvuku mufiriji kana mufiriza pakarepo paunodzisvitsa kumba, uye usadya hove dzakasiiwa pakupisa kwemumba kupfuura maawa 2.

c-217.title: Nei matende nemacipfeko emvura ekare achinamira
c-217.summary: Chifukidzo chinodzivirira mvura mukati metende rekare kana jasi remvura chinonamira uye chinobvaruka nekuti polyurethane inoita hydrolysis mumvura nekupisa. Kuchichengeta chakaoma zvakakwana kunononokesa izvi.
c-217.principle: Ester bonds muPU (polyurethane) coating dzinoita nemvura uye dzinoputsika, $\mathrm{R{-}COO{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow \mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{R'{-}OH}$, zvichipfupisa macheni kuti coating inamire. Mamiriro anopisa, ane humidity anokurumidza izvi.
c-217.example: Matende akafukidzwa nePU kazhinji anotanga hydrolysis mushure megore 3-5. Kana akapetwa achinyorova uye akachengetwa pamusoro pe 30°C, anogona kunamira mukati meseason imwe chete.
c-217.actionItem: Nhasi, omesa matende nemacipfeko emvura zvakakwana, wozoachengeta asina kupetwa munzvimbo inotonhorera, uye kana atoita anonamira, fungidzira kuashandura pane kuazorazve.

c-218.title: Nei makapisuru ekuwachira achisara ari zvimedu
c-218.summary: Makapisuru ekuwachira anosara ari zvimedu kana mvura yakatonhora, shoma, kana mutoro wazara. Isa kapisuru pasi pedrum kutanga, wozoisa macipfeko pamusoro.
c-218.principle: Firimu re PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) rakatenderedza kapisuru rinonyungudika mumvura, uye kumhanya kwekunyungudika kunoenderana zvikuru nekupisa, kunononoka pakupisa kudiki se $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, saka haridzvinyunguduki zvakanaka mumvura inotonhora.
c-218.example: Firimu re PVA rinonyungudika mukati memaminetsi 1-3 mumvura ye 40°C asi rinogona kutora maminetsi anopfuura 10 mumvura inotonhora ye 15°C kana pazasi. Drum yakazadzwa nemacipfeko inomanikidza kapisuru pajira kuti mvura isasvike.
c-218.actionItem: Nhasi, usabata makapisuru nemaoko anonyorova, aise mudrum kutanga uye macipfeko pamusoro, uye shandisa liquid detergent pamacycle emvura inotonhora.

c-219.title: Ma glow stick ekukemba anobwinya nekuita kwemakemikari
c-219.summary: Glow stick yekukemba inobwinya kana wairerutsa uye zvinomwa zviviri zvemukati zvichisangana nekuita kwemakemikari. Inobwinya pasina magetsi kana kupisa, ichibwinya zvakanyanya uye ichipfupika kana ichidziya, ichipera nekubwinya zvishoma uye ichiramba kana ichitonhora.
c-219.principle: Hydrogen peroxide ne oxalate ester mukati metyubhu zvinoita kuumba intermediate ine simba guru, inomutsa dye ye fluorescent kuti ibudise chiedza (chemiluminescence). Mwero wacho unonzwa kupisa, $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-219.example: Glow stick inowanzogara maawa 6-12 pa 20°C, asi pa 40°C inobwinya zvakanyanya uye inogona kudzimira mumaawa 1-2, nepo mufiriza ichiderera zvishoma ichibwinyazve kana yadziya. Haipi kupisa kwakawanda, saka ngozi yemoto idiki.
c-219.actionItem: Pakukemba usiku kana magetsi akadzima nhasi, isa glow stick imwe kana mbiri mubhegi rako, uye chengeta mvura yakadonha kure nedehwe.

c-220.title: Mavara emoto wekupemberera anobva mukubwinya kwemoto kwezvinhu zvesimbi
c-220.summary: Mavara emoto wekupemberera anobva kuzvinhu zvesimbi zvakasanganiswa mupowdhi. Strontium inopa tsvuku, copper inopa bhuruu, uye barium inopa girini.
c-220.principle: Kupisa kwemoto kunomutsa maelectron mumaatomu esimbi, uye kana adzoka kumazinga ari pasi anobudisa chiedza chine simba $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$. Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chine mazinga akasiyana, saka chimwe nechimwe chine ruvara rwacho.
c-220.example: Sr inopa tsvuku pa 650nm inenge, Ba girini pa 520nm inenge, Cu bhuruu pa 450nm inenge uye Na yero pa 589nm inenge. Bhuruu ndiyo inonyanya kuoma kugadzira nekuti copper compounds dzinoputsika nyore pamusoro pe 1,200°C inenge.
c-220.actionItem: Kana uchitarisa moto wekupemberera nhasi, edza kufungidzira simbi kubva paruvara rumwe nerumwe, uye chengeta kure nezvidimbu nehutsi.

c-221.title: Kuuraya utachiona mumvura nebhodhoro re PET rakajeka nezuva
c-221.summary: Kuzadza bhodhoro re PET rakajeka nemvura yakachena uye kuriisa muzuva kwemaawa 6 inzira yenjodzi (SODIS) yekudzikisa hutachiona. Mvura inogumbuka inofanira kusefa kutanga, uye hausi rwiyo rwakakwana rwekugadzirisa mvura yekunwa.
c-221.principle: UVA (320-400nm) nekupisa zvinokuvadza DNA nemapuroteni ehutachiona uye zvichizvisiya zvisingashandi. Mhedzisiro inoenderana ne UV dose $H=I\,t$ (simba kuwanda nenguva), uye kupisa kwemvura pamusoro pe 50°C kunoiwedzera zvikuru.
c-221.example: Pazuva rine zuva bhodhoro re PET rakajeka re 1-2L rakasiiwa maawa 6 rinodzikisa mabhakitiriya mazhinji, uye pasi pematsi emakore rinoda mazuva maviri. Mhedzisiro inodzikira kana turbidity ichipfuura 30 NTU.
c-221.actionItem: Kana ukaedza senjodzi nhasi, shandisa mvura yakajeka chete uye uise bhodhoro muzuva kwemaawa 6, asi kazhinji sarudza mvura yakabikwa kana yakagadziriswa.

c-222.title: Plastic wrap inouya muPVC nePE, uye dzinosiyana
c-222.summary: Cling wrap inouya muPVC nePE (polyethylene), uye imwe neimwe ine miganho yakasiyana yekuchengeteka kwemicrowave nekubata zvikafu zvine mafuta. Tarisa zvinhu nechiyero chekupisa pagwaro.
c-222.principle: PVC wrap ine plasticizers dzekutatamuka, dzinogona kupinda muchikafu kana ichibata chikafu chine mafuta kana kupiswa. PE wrap haidi plasticizer uye chiyero chayo chekupisa chinenge 110°C chinosiyana nechePVC (zvimwe zvigadzirwa zvakanyorwa zvinoratidza 130°C kana kupfuura).
c-222.example: Mumicrowave, chikafu chine mafuta chinogona kupfuura 100°C saka wrap inobata inogona kunyunguduka kana kuita kuti plasticizer ipinde. Chengeta 2-3cm yenzvimbo pakati pewrap nechikafu.
c-222.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa zvinhu nechiyero chekupisa usati washandisa wrap, uye mumicrowave uichengete yakasimudzwa kubva muchikafu.

c-223.title: Kana mafuta anopisa achibata chigaba che Styrofoam cheinstant-noodle
c-223.summary: Kuisa chikafu chinopisa, chine mafuta mugaba re polystyrene (Styrofoam) kunogona kuripfavisa uye kuita kuti styrene shoma ibude. Tevedza chiyero chekupisa chegaba.
c-223.principle: Polystyrene inopfava padyo ne glass transition yayo inenge 100°C uye inonyungudika nyore mumafuta, saka styrene monomer ($\mathrm{C_8H_8}$) inogona kupinda muchikafu. Kupinda kunowedzera nekupisa nenguva yekubatana.
c-223.example: Muto weinstant noodle une 90°C inenge uri pazasi pepoint yekupfava yepolystyrene uye kazhinji unogamuchirwa, asi mafuta ekubika ari pamusoro pe 100°C kana chikafu chine mafuta zvakanyanya zvinogona kunyungudutsa gaba. Shandisa midziyo inorashwa kamwe chete.
c-223.actionItem: Nhasi, shandura chikafu chinopisa, chine mafuta kubva muchigaba che Styrofoam uchiise muhodhi yegirazi kana yeceramic inomira kupisa.

c-224.title: Mabhegi eplastic anoora haaori kumba
c-224.summary: Mabhegi mazhinji anoora anoputsika chete pakupisa kukuru kwenzvimbo dzekompositi uye haaore kwazvo mumunda wepamba kana mudhasibhini. Tevedza zvikwangwani zvemuno zvekurasa.
c-224.principle: PLA (polylactic acid) inoita hydrolysis nemvura, $(\mathrm{C_3H_4O_2})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow n\,\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$ (lactic acid). Kuita kunokurumidza pamusoro peglass transition inenge 58°C, saka kunoda mamiriro ekompositi yemaindasitiri (inenge 58°C uye hunyoro).
c-224.example: Mukompositi yemaindasitiri (58°C, hunyoro), PLA inoputsika mukati memazuva 90-180 anenge, asi mumba ye 20°C inogona kutora makore kana kusaora zvachose. Haiputsiki zvakanaka mugungwa futi.
c-224.actionItem: Kana wawana bhegi rakanyorwa kuti rinoora nhasi, ripatsanure sezvakajairika uye, kana ukakwanisa, uye uuye nebhegi rekushopa rinoshandiswazve.

c-225.title: Nei mapaipi emunda achipwanyika muzuva
c-225.summary: Paipi yemunda yakasiiwa kunze inoomarara uye inoputsika mukupfuura kwemakore nekuti UV yezuva inoputsa macheni epolymer. Kana isingashandiswi, ipetere mumumvuri.
c-225.principle: Simba rephoton ye UV $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$ rinoputsa C-Cl neC-H bonds mumapolymer se PVC, richiumba radicals dzinoita neoxygen uye dzichicheka macheni. Macheni mapfupi anoita kuti zvinhu zvipwanyike.
c-225.example: Paipi ine UV stabilizer inogara makore 3-5, asi iyo yakasiiwa muzuva nguva dzose inogona kurasikirwa neplasticizer ikapwanyika mukati megore 1-2. Masikati epakati pezhizha, apo UV index iri yakakwirira, ndiko kunokuvadza zvikuru.
c-225.actionItem: Mushure mekushandisa paipi nhasi, idururire mvura uye uipetere mumumvuri kana mubhokisi rehose reel kure nezuva.

c-226.title: Nei mabhendi eraba nemagirovhosi eraba achipwanyika
c-226.summary: Mabhendi eraba nemagirovhosi anopwanyika nekukurumidza uye ochekeka nekuti ozone mumhepo inorwisa double bonds yeraba. Raba rakachengetwa rakatatamurwa rinopwanyika nekukurumidza.
c-226.principle: Ozone inowedzerwa pakati pe C=C double bonds yeraba rechisikigo (polyisoprene), $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{O_3}\rightarrow$ ozonide, uye bond inoputsika. Mapwanyiko anofamba perpendicular nekutatamuka pamusoro peraba rakatatamurwa.
c-226.example: Ozone yakatenderedza kazhinji i 0.02-0.06ppm, asi kunyange iyoyo inogona kupwanya raba rakatatamurwa mukati memavhiki kusvika mwedzi. Kuliiswa munzvimbo inotonhorera kunowedzera hupenyu hwaro zvikuru.
c-226.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta mabhendi eraba nemagirovhosi asina kutatamurwa mubhegi rakavharwa mudhirowa rinotonhorera, rerima.

c-227.title: Nei masneakers machena achiita yero
c-227.summary: Masneakers machena anoita yero kunyange achichengetwa nekuti polyurethane mu sole inoita oxidation nechiedza neoxygen uye phenolic antioxidants dzinochinja. Achengete munzvimbo inotonhorera, yerima.
c-227.principle: Zvikamu zve aromatic zvepolyurethane zvinoita oxidation pasi peUV neoxygen kuumba yellow chromophores, uye phenolic antioxidants dzinoita nenitrogen oxides kuita zvinhu zvakaita sequinone zvine yero. Photo-oxidation inowedzera ne UV dose.
c-227.example: Kana akasiiwa pawindo rine chiedza anogona kuita yero zvakajeka mukati memavhiki kusvika mwedzi, kakawanda nekukurumidza kupfuura mukabati reshangu rerima. Yero inoumbwa mulayer yakatetepa yepamusoro, iyo oxygen bleach inogona kudzikisa zvishoma.
c-227.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta masneakers machena mukabati reshangu rerima rine mhepo pane pawindo rine zuva, uye uaachengete mubhegi recotton pane eplastic.

c-228.title: Nei majini matsva achirasikirwa neruvara pakugeza kwekutanga
c-228.summary: Majini matsva anosunungura bhuruu pakugeza kwekutanga nekuti indigo dye iri pamusoro petambo chete sezvidimbu. Aageze akatendeuka, ega, mumvura inotonhora panguva yekutanga.
c-228.principle: Indigo haisi kunyungudika mumvura: inodhayiwa muchimiro chakadzikiswa chinonyungudika, wozoita oxidation mumhepo kuti zvidimbu zvisingagone kunyungudika zvinamire pamusoro petambo. Haisungwi nemakemikari netambo, saka friction nemvura zvinoibvisa.
c-228.example: Jini itsva (inenge 600g) inogona kurasa dye inenge 1-2g pakugeza kwekutanga, ichiita macipfeko machena kuti ave bhuruu kana akageswa pamwe chete. Mumvura inotonhora (30°C kana pazasi) dye shoma inobuda.
c-228.actionItem: Nhasi, geza majini matsva ega akatendeuka mumvura inotonhora panguva yekutanga, usaasanganisa nemacipfeko machena, uye uaomese mumumvuri.

c-229.title: Cement inonyorova ine alkali uye inogona kupisa dehwe
c-229.summary: Cement nekonkirita inonyorova zvine alkali zvakasimba, uye dehwe rakasiiwa richibata rinogona kupiswa nemakemikari risati rarwadza.
c-229.principle: Calcium compounds mucement dzinoita nemvura kuumba $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ (pH inenge 12.5), uye alkali inoita hydrolysis yemapuroteni nemafuta edehwe. $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$
c-229.example: Kupfugama pakonkirita inonyorova maawa 1-2 kwakakonzera kupisa kwechikamu chechipiri kusingarwadzi mumhosva dzakashumwa. pH ye 12.5 inoreva inenge ka 300,000 $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ yakawanda kupfuura mvura isina kwainoenda.
c-229.actionItem: Kana cement yabata dehwe, kutanga bvisa upfu hwakaoma, wozosuka nemvura inotsvedza kweminiti 15+; pfeka magirovhosi asingapindi mvura netirauzi refu pabasa ripi zvaro nhasi.

c-230.title: Chenjera nekupisa negasi kubva kumishonga yekuvhura madhaini
c-230.summary: Mishonga yekuvhura madhaini ine lye inopisa kana ichinyungudika, uye inoburitsa hydrogen gas kana ichibata aluminium.
c-230.principle: NaOH inoburitsa 44.5kJ/mol inenge kana ichinyungudika, uye inoita nealuminium kuumba hydrogen. $2\mathrm{Al} + 2\mathrm{NaOH} + 6\mathrm{H_2O} \to 2\mathrm{Na[Al(OH)_4]} + 3\mathrm{H_2}$
c-230.example: Kunyungudutsa 100g NaOH (2.5 mol) kunoburitsa 111kJ inenge, inokwana kupisa 1L yemvura ne 26°C inenge. Mupaipi yakamanikana inogona kupisa zvakanyanya munzvimbo imwe chete uye kumwazika.
c-230.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa mushonga wekuvhura madhaini nhasi, pfuudza mhepo, pfeka magirazi nemagirovhosi, uye usatongouisanganisa nezvimwe zvekuchenesa kana kuuisa mumidziyo yealuminium.

c-231.title: Epoxy inoomarara chete kana ukasanganisa chiyero chakarurama
c-231.summary: Epoxy inoomarara zvizere chete kana resin ne hardener zvasangana muchiyero chakanyorwa; zvikasadaro inosara ichinamira.
c-231.principle: Epoxide groups dzinoita ne amine active hydrogens muhuwandu hwakaenzana kuti dziumbe network. Huremu hwe hardener i $m_{\mathrm{hardener}} = \frac{\mathrm{AHEW}}{\mathrm{EEW}} \times m_{\mathrm{resin}}$.
c-231.example: Ne 5mL resin ne 5mL hardener (1:1), kukanganisa kwechiyero kwe 20% kana kupfuura kunowanzosiya mhedzisiro inonamira, yakapfava. Kuoma zvizere kunowanzotora maawa 24 anenge.
c-231.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa epoxy nhasi, yera kusvika pachiyero chelabel, sanganisa kweminiti 2 kana kupfuura uchikwenya pasi, uye uise layer yakatetepa.

c-232.title: Tangi rehove rinogadzikana apo ammonia inoshanduka kuita nitrate
c-232.summary: Tangi idzva rinounganidza ammonia ne nitrite kusvikira mabhakitiriya e nitrifying agadzikana, izvo zvine ngozi kuhove.
c-232.principle: Mabhakitiriya e nitrifying anoshandura ammonia ine chepfu kuita nitrite, wozoita nitrate isina chepfu zvakanyanya. $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + 1.5\,O_2 \to NO_2^- + 2H^+ + H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NO_2^- + 0.5\,O_2 \to NO_3^-}$
c-232.example: Tangi idzva rinowanzoda mavhiki 4-6 kuti riite cycle, uye zvakachengeteka zvikuru kuwedzera hove chete kana ammonia ne nitrite zvichiverenga 0ppm. Chengeta nitrate pazasi pe 40ppm nekuchinja 20-30% yemvura vhiki imwe neimwe.
c-232.actionItem: Edza ammonia, nitrite ne nitrate nekiti yekuedza nhasi, uye pakuchinja mvura suka filter media mumvura yakabviswa mutangi, kwete mumvura yepombi.

c-233.title: Usatongodururira mvura pamoto wemafuta; wuvhare nechivharo
c-233.summary: Mvura pamafuta anopisa inokanda mafuta anopisa nemhute kumativi ose.
c-233.principle: Moto unoda mafuta, oxygen nekupisa, saka chivharo chinodimbura oxygen. Mvura inonyura pasi pemafuta, ichibva yaita mhute, uye ichiwedzera inenge ka 1,700. $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(g)}$
c-233.example: Mukombe mumwe (200mL) wemvura unotsvaga mafuta ari pamusoro pe 300°C pakarepo unoita mhute inenge 340L, inogona kukanda mafuta anopisa kusvika padenga.
c-233.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta chivharo chinokodzera pani yako padyo nesitovhu, uye rangarira kuteedzana: dzima moto, wozovhara pani.

c-234.title: Nei recirculation chete parwendo rurefu ichikurara
c-234.summary: Kuramba uchishandisa recirculation mode kwenguva refu kunoita kuti carbon dioxide ienderere mberi mumotokari, izvo zvinogona kuunza kurara nekudzikira kwekutarisa.
c-234.principle: Mukabhini yakavharwa, CO2 inofemwa haigoni kubuda, saka huwandu hwayo hunowedzera nenguva. $\Delta C \approx \frac{G}{V}\,t$ ($G$: mwero wekugadzirwa, $V$: volume yekabhini)
c-234.example: Mhepo yekunze ine CO2 inenge 420ppm, asi motokari ine vanhu vazhinji pa recirculation kweminiti 30-60 yakayerwa kupfuura 2,000ppm. Kurara kunowanzoratidzwa kupfuura 1,000ppm inenge.
c-234.actionItem: Parwendo rwenhasi, chinjira ku fresh-air mode kana vhura hwindo kweminiti imwe maminetsi 20-30 ega ega.

c-235.title: Rega mvura yepombi yekutanga mangwanani ifambe kwechinguva
c-235.summary: Mvura yakagara mumapaipi husiku inogona kutora simbi ions, saka rega pombi ifambe kwechinguva usati washandisa.
c-235.principle: Copper nelead mumapaipi nemafittings zvinoita oxidation zvishoma zvishoma mumvura. $\mathrm{Pb \to Pb^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{Cu \to Cu^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Kureba kwayo kumira, huwandu hunowedzera.
c-235.example: Mushure memaawa 6+ ichimira, rega pombi ifambe masekondi 30-60 kusvikira mvura yatonhora. Pa 6L/min, miniti rimwe inenge 6L, inogona kuenda kumiti kana kuchenesa saka haipfurwi.
c-235.actionItem: Mangwana mangwanani, rega pombi ifambe masekondi 30-60 usati wazadza mukombe, uye unganidza mvura iyoyo yemiti kana kupukuta.

c-236.title: Mvura ine alkali inogadziriswa nekukurumidza mudumbu rako
c-236.summary: Acid yemudumbu inogadzirisa mvura ine alkali pakarepo, saka haikwanisi kuchinja pH yemuviri wako uye zvisingawanzo kukodzera mutengo wepamusoro.
c-236.principle: Gastric juice i 0.01-0.1 M HCl (pH 1.5-3.5), uye $\mathrm{OH^-}$ mumvura ine alkali inoita nayo pakarepo. $\mathrm{HCl + OH^- \to H_2O + Cl^-}$
c-236.example: Lita imwe yemvura ye pH 9 ine $\\mathrm{OH^-}$ mol chete ye $10^{-5}$, inokwana kugadzirisa inenge 1% ye 100mL yeacid yemudumbu ye pH 2 ($10^{-3}$ mol H+). pH yeropa inochengetwa pa 7.35-7.45 nekufema nematundu.
c-236.actionItem: Usati watenga mvura ine alkali, tarisa mashoko ehutano asina humbowo; nhasi, mvura yepombi yakajairika kana yakasefa inokwana kuita kuti urege kuziya.

c-237.title: Kuchengeta mabhatiri mufiriji kunokubatsira zvishoma
c-237.summary: Mabhatiri e alkaline emazuva ano anorasikirwa nesimba zvishoma zvakanyanya kunyange pakupisa kwemumba, saka kuaisa mufiriji kunobatsira zvishoma uye kune ngozi yecondensation.
c-237.principle: Self-discharge i yemakemikari, saka inokurumidza nekupisa maererano ne Arrhenius equation. $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ Kutonhodza kunoinononokesa, asi alkaline cells dzatova dzakanonoka zvikuru.
c-237.example: Mabhatiri e alkaline anorasikirwa ne 2-3% chete pagore pa 20°C, achipa shelf life ye 5-10 makore. Firiji inochengetedza 1% inenge pagore, uye madonhwe emvura mushure mekubvisa anogona kuora ma terminals.
c-237.actionItem: Nhasi, chengeta mabhatiri mudhirowa rinotonhorera, rakaoma achiparadzaniswa nerudzi, uye usatongosanganisa mabhatiri matsva nekare mumudziyo mumwe chete.

c-238.title: Marasha ekukemba: briquettes, marasha machena nemauraki zvinosiyana
c-238.summary: Marudzi emarasha anosiyana pakukurumidza kubatidza, huwandu hwehutsi nenguva yekupisa, saka sarudza rudzi runoenderana nebasa.
c-238.principle: Kukwira kwecarbonization, zvinhu zvinoshanduka zvishoma uye carbon yakawanda, zvichipa hutsi hushoma nekupisa kwenguva refu. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ ($\Delta H \approx -394$ kJ/mol); kana oxygen yakashoma, $2\mathrm{C + O_2 \to 2CO}$.
c-238.example: 1kg yemarasha inopa 29MJ inenge (8kWh inenge). Marasha machena akabikwa padyo ne 1,000°C anopisa kwenguva refu uye akachena asi akaoma kubatidza; marasha amauraki anobatidzwa nyore asi anotsvaira hutsi hwakawanda; briquettes dzinosiya madota akawanda nekuda kwema binders.
c-238.actionItem: Kana uchitenga marasha ekukemba nhasi, sarudza maererano nebasa, uye usatongopisa marasha mukati metende kana nzvimbo yakavharwa (chepfu yecarbon monoxide).

c-239.title: Nei kudya ma carbs mushure mekuita fambiro
c-239.summary: Mukati meawa rekutanga kana maviri mushure mefambiro, mhasuru dzinotora shuga zvakanakisa, saka ma carbohydrates panguva iyoyo anozadza glycogen nekukurumidza.
c-239.principle: Glycogen yakapera nefambiro inovakwazve neinsulin nema muscle glucose transporters. $(\mathrm{Glucose})_n + \mathrm{Glucose} \to (\mathrm{Glucose})_{n+1}$
c-239.example: Mhasuru dzinochengeta glycogen inenge 400g. Kumunhu anoita fambiro wakajairika, banana (carbs inenge 27g) negirazi remukaka mushure mefambiro yakaoma zvinokwana; kana ukazorora zuva rimwe kana kupfuura, nguva chaiyo haina basa zvikuru.
c-239.actionItem: Kana uchiita fambiro nhasi, dya carbs pamwe chete neprotein shoma mukati meawa mushure mayo, se banana, ndiro yerice, kana mukaka.

c-240.title: Ruvara rwakajeka rwemaapricot akaomeswa runobva kuma sulfites
c-240.summary: Maapricot akaomeswa orenji yakajeka anodzivirirwa kusvibiswa nema sulfites, nepo ayo ebrown kazhinji asina sulfur, uye vanhu vane asthma vanofanira kuchenjera.
c-240.principle: $\mathrm{SO_2}$ inonyungudika mumvura kuumba bisulfite, inodzivirira ma enzyme ekusvibisa neoxidation. $\mathrm{SO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HSO_3^- + H^+}$
c-240.example: Maapricot akaomeswa ane sulfur anogona kuva ne $\mathrm{SO_2}$ yemazana mashoma kusvika 2,000mg/kg inenge, uye nyika dzakawanda dzinoda label pa 10mg/kg kana kupfuura. Vanorwara neasthma vanonzwa sulfite vanogona kuva nedambudziko rekufema.
c-240.actionItem: Pakutenga michero yakaomeswa nhasi, verenga rondedzero yezvinhu kuti uone sulfites (sulphur dioxide), uye sarudza ayo ebrown asina sulfur kana uchinzwa.

c-241.title: Munyu une sodium shoma une potassium yakawanda: chenjera nechirwere chematundu
c-241.summary: Munyu une sodium shoma unochinja chikamu chesodium nepotassium, saka vanhu vane chirwere chematundu kana mishonga inokanganisa potassium vanofanira kutanga vataura nachiremba.
c-241.principle: Chikamu che $\mathrm{NaCl}$ chinochinjwa ne $\mathrm{KCl}$, kudzikisa sodium asi kuwedzera potassium. Nehuremu, Na i 39.3% yeNaCl uye K i 52.4% yeKCl.
c-241.example: 5g yemusanganiswa we 70% sodium / 30% potassium ine sodium inenge 1.4g (30% pasi pe 2.0g mu 5g yemunyu wakajairika) uye potassium inenge 0.79g. Kana kushanda kwematundu kwadzikira, potassium inogona kuunganidza ichiita ngozi yekurova kwemoyo kune ngozi.
c-241.actionItem: Usati watenga munyu une sodium shoma nhasi, tarisa chikamu che KCl palabel, uye bvunza chiremba kutanga kana uine chirwere chematundu kana uchitora mishonga ine chekuita nazvo.

c-242.title: Goridhe re 14K ne 18K haisi goridhe rakachena
c-242.summary: Nhamba yekarat inoratidza huwandu hwegoridhe: 18K i 75% goridhe ne 14K inenge 58%, nesimbi dzimwe dzichiumba chasara.
c-242.principle: Kuchena kunoratidzwa mu 24ths. $\\text{kuchena} = \\frac{K}{24}$ Kusanganisa kunoita goridhe kuti rive rakaoma uye kunochinja ruvara, nepo 24K goridhe rakachena rakapfava rinenge 99.9%.
c-242.example: Mhete ye 18K ye 10g ine goridhe rakachena re 7.5g, uye ye 14K inenge 5.8g. Hallmarks kazhinji i 750 ye 18K ne 585 ye 14K.
c-242.actionItem: Pakutenga goridhe nhasi, tarisa hallmark (750, 585, nezvimwe) nehuremu, uye uverenge pachako huwandu hwegoridhe rakachena.

c-243.title: Mbeu dzekofi dzinobudisa gasi mushure mekugochwa, wozoita oxidation
c-243.summary: Mbeu dzinoburitsa carbon dioxide pakarepo mushure mekugochwa wozoita oxidation, saka tarisira kuinwa mukati memavhiki 1-4 kubva pazuva rekugocha.
c-243.principle: $\mathrm{CO_2}$ yakagadzirwa pakugocha inobuda zvishoma zvishoma, nepo zvinonhuhwira nemafuta zvichiita neoxygen zvichiita kuti zvikure. $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$
c-243.example: 1 gramu yembeu inoburitsa mashoma emL eCO2 mushure mekugocha, uye kukuya kunowedzera nzvimbo yepamusoro kakawanda saka hwema hunodzikira mukati memaminetsi kusvika maawa. Mbeu dzakavhurwa pakupisa kwemumba dzinorasikirwa nekunaka zvakajeka mukati memavhiki 2-4.
c-243.actionItem: Pakutenga mbeu nhasi, sarudza bhegi rine zuva rekugocha, kuya usati wagadzira, uye uchengete zvakavharwa munzvimbo inotonhorera yerima (firiji ine ngozi yehunyoro).

c-244.title: Nei chifukidzo chinodzivirira mafuta pachiratidziro chefoni chichipera
c-244.summary: Chifukidzo che anti-fingerprint chefoni chakatetepa zvishoma kusvika makumi e nanometers, saka chinopera zvishoma zvishoma nekupukuta nekukweya.
c-244.principle: Firimu re fluoropolymer rinodzikisa surface energy kuti mafuta aite matinhwi pane kupararira. Contact angle inoenderana ne $\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{SV} - \gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$, uye firimu richipera, $\theta$ inodzikira.
c-244.example: Chifukidzo chakatetepa zvishoma kusvika makumi e nm, inenge chikamu chimwe pazviuru gumi zvehupamhi hwemvere (inenge 80,000nm). Jecha nezvikiyi mubhezo pamwe nekuchenesa nealcohol kakawanda zvinochipedza zvakajeka mukati memwedzi kusvika makore 2.
c-244.actionItem: Kubva nhasi, pukuta sikirini nejira rakaoma re microfiber, uye dzivisa maweti ane alcohol yakawanda kana machira akaoma.

c-245.title: Zvipfeko zvakachenjerwa nedry cleaning bvisa purasitiki uzvivhurire mhepo
c-245.summary: Zvipfeko zvichangobva kudry cleaning zvinogona kunge zvichine solvent, saka bvisa purasitiki uzvivhurire usati wazvipfeka kana kuzvichengeta.
c-245.principle: Solvent yekuchenesa perchloroethylene ine boiling point ye121℃ uye vapor pressure ye20℃ inenge 1.9kPa, saka inoputika zvishoma nezvishoma. $\mathrm{C_2Cl_4(l) \to C_2Cl_4(g)}$ Kana yakavharirwa mupurasitiki, mhute haikwanise kubuda.
c-245.example: Kana ukasiya zvipfeko zvakafukidzwa nepurasitiki mukabati, mhute inovharirwa uye hwema nekuratidzirwa zvinowedzera. Kana ukazvirembera munzvimbo ine mhepo kwemaawa mashoma kusvika zuva rimwe, zvizhinji zvinoputika. Mamwe madry cleaners anoshandisa solvent yemafuta.
c-245.actionItem: Nhasi zvipfeko zvaunotora kudry cleaner bvisa purasitiki pakarepo uzvirembere pavheranda kana panzvimbo ine mhepo kwemaawa mashoma.

c-246.title: Condensing boiler inodzorera kupisa kubva mumhute yemhepo inobuda
c-246.summary: Condensing boiler inoita mvura kubva mumhute yegasi rinobuda raiwanzorasika, uchishandisa kunyange latent heat yacho pakupisa.
c-246.principle: Gasi rinopisa rinogadzira mvura $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$ uye mhute iyi painoita mvura latent heat inenge 2.26MJ/kg inobuda. Kuti utore kupisa uku, mvura inodzoka yekupisa inofanira kunge iri pasi pe55℃.
c-246.example: Kupisa 1m³ yegasi kunogadzira anenge 1.6kg yemvura uye anenge 3.6MJ (anenge 10% yekupisa kwose) yelatent heat yakawedzerwa. Saka unochengeta anenge 10–15% yesimba pane boiler yakajairika.
c-246.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa condensing boiler, dzikisa tembiricha yekupisa (tembiricha yekudzoka pasi pe55℃) kuti mhute iite mvura zvakanaka.

c-247.title: Kenduru haisi ngoro yakanyungudika inopisa asi ngoro yakaita mhute
c-247.summary: Murazvo wekenduru haisi ngoro yakanyungudika asi mhute yengoro yakadhonzwa mudambiramira ichiita mhute inopisa.
c-247.principle: Ngoro yakanyungudika inokwira nedambiramira nekapillary action, inoita mhute nekupisa, uye mhute iyi inopindirana neokisijeni. $\mathrm{C_{25}H_{52} + 38\,O_2 \to 25\,CO_2 + 26\,H_2O}$
c-247.example: Kenduru imwe yakajairika inopisa anenge 7g yengoro paawa uye inopa anenge 80W yekupisa. Kana dambiramira rakareba zvakanyanya, hapana kupisa kwakazara uye tsvina inowedzera.
c-247.actionItem: Nhasi usati wavasa kenduru, cheka dambiramira kusvika pa5 mm kuderedza tsvina, uye usasiya kenduru yakavhenekera usipo.

c-248.title: Kubika pasta nemvura shoma kunodzikisa simba
c-248.summary: 100g yepasta inogona kubikwa nemvura inenge 1L, saka kana ukachinja tsika yekuvira 3L yemvura, kupisa kunodzikira zvikuru.
c-248.principle: Kupisa kwekuvira mvura ndi$Q = mc\Delta T$ uye starch yepasta inotanga kutora mvura kubva pa60–70℃ ichigelatinize, saka hakuna kudiwa kwemvura yakawanda.
c-248.example: Kupisa 1L yemvura ye20℃ kusvika pa100℃ kunoda anenge 334kJ (0.093kWh), uye kudzikisa kubva pa3 L kusvika pa1 L kunochengeta anenge 0.19kWh panguva imwe. Kubika uchivhara kunodzikisa zvakanyanya.
c-248.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika pasta shandisa chete anenge 1L yemvura pa100 g, vhara poto, woshanda kakawanda kuti irege kunamira.

c-249.title: Mercury yetyubhu rekuvhenekera rakaputsika, tanga wavhura mhepo
c-249.summary: Matyubhu ekuvhenekera ane mercury shoma, saka kana aputika, tanga wabudisa vanhu nemhuka, kuvhura mhepo uye wozochenesa.
c-249.principle: Mercury isimbi inoputika kunyange pakupisa kwemukamuri. $\mathrm{Hg(l) \to Hg(g)}$ Mvura yayo pa20℃ ndeye anenge 0.16Pa uye mumuvharo wakavharika mhute inounganidzwa.
c-249.example: Tyubhu diki yeCFL ine mercury inowanzova mg mashoma. Mushure mekuputika, vhura mhepo kwemaminitsi 5–10 kana kupfuura, uye panzvimbo yevacuum shandisa pepa rakakora netepi kuunganidza zvidimbu, uzvivharire uzviise mubhokisi rekuunganidza.
c-249.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa matyubhu ekuvhenekera akasara mumba nezvakapera nguva, woaisa mubhokisi rawo rekutanga, woziva nzvimbo iri padhuze yekuunganidza matyubhu ekuvhenekera akapera.

c-250.title: Mupunga mutsva shandisa mvura shoma kupfuura wekare
c-250.summary: Mupunga mutsva une unyoro hwakawanda, saka mvura yekubika inofanira kuva anenge 90% yenguva dzose kuti usanyorove.
c-250.principle: Kana mupunga uchipfuura nguva, unyoro hunodzikira uye unotora mvura yakawanda. Mvura yekubika inenge $m_{\mathrm{water}} = m_{\mathrm{rice}} \times r$ uye $r$ inenge 1.1 yemupunga mutsva, 1.2 yewekare.
c-250.example: Kana uine makapu maviri emupunga (anenge 360mL) mvura yenguva dzose inenge 400mL, asi kune mupunga mutsva edza anenge 360mL, 40mL shoma. Unyoro hwemupunga mutsva hunenge 15–16%, wekare 13–14%.
c-250.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika mupunga mutsva, shandisa chete anenge 90% yemvura yenguva dzose, uye kana wanyorova, dzikisa zvakare nguva inotevera.

c-251.title: Mukanyiwa wejeon unofanira kusanganiswa nemvura inotonhora nekukurumidza kuti ive crisp
c-251.summary: Mukanyiwa wejeon unofanira kusanganiswa nemvura inotonhora kwenguva pfupi kuti gluten shoma igadzirwe uye ibikwe ichiita crisp.
c-251.principle: Glutenin negliadin yehupfu zvikasangana nemvura zvinoita network (gluten) zvichiwedzera nesimba rekusanganisa. $\text{glutenin} + \text{gliadin} + \mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\text{kusanganisa}} \text{gluten}$ Mvura inotonhora inononoka maitiro aya.
c-251.example: Isa mvura inotonhora kapu rimwe muhupfu kapu rimwe (anenge 120g) wosanganisa anenge ka10 chete, zvakanaka kunyange kana zvimedu zvichisara. Kana ukashandura anenge 20% yehupfu kuita starch, gluten inonyungudika uye inowedzera crisp.
c-251.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchibika jeon, sanganisa nemvura inotonhora ine chando kwemasekondi 10–15 chete, usatsanga mukanyiwa kwemaminitsi anopfuura 10.

c-252.title: Bracken fern ibikwe woiisirwa mvura kuti kuvhara kwayo kudzikire
c-252.summary: Bracken fern ine ptaquiloside inokonzera cancer saka inofanira kubikwa nekunyika mumvura, asi kunyange zvakadaro zviri nani kusadya kakawanda.
c-252.principle: Ptaquiloside inoparara nekupisa nealkali. $\text{ptaquiloside} \xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{OH^-}} \text{pterosin B}$ (haina kuvhara)
c-252.example: Bika mumvura inovira kwemaminitsi 5–10, woinyika mumvura inotonhora kwezuva rimwe, uye kana ukaisa baking soda anenge 5g (0.5%) pa1 L yemvura, kuparara kunoita zvakanaka. Kunyange zvakadaro hakuna kuita 0 zvakakwana, saka usadye kakawanda.
c-252.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa bracken fern, ibike zvakakwana mumvura inovira woinyika mumvura inotonhora usati wabika.

c-253.title: Nei taro ichikonzera kuyadzwa uye kugadzirisa
c-253.summary: Ganda netaro yetaro zvine makristaro ane chimiro chesindano echalcium oxalate, saka kana ukabata nemaoko akashama anoyadzwa nekuyaruka.
c-253.principle: Makristaro echalcium oxalate (raphides) anobaya ganda achikonzera kuyadzwa, uye mukuvira kana asidhi anonyungudika zvishoma kana kudzika simba. $\mathrm{CaC_2O_4 + 2H^+ \rightleftharpoons Ca^{2+} + H_2C_2O_4}$
c-253.example: Makristaro ane hurefu hwe makumi kusvika mazana eμm (0.02–0.2mm) uye akapinza zvokunge kupinda muganda. Kana uchiyadzwa, geza nemvura inodziya ine vinegar shoma, uye kubika kunodzikisa zvakanyanya kuvava.
c-253.actionItem: Nhasi paunogadzirisa taro, pfeka magirovhosi erabha uvhare ganda pasi pemvura inoyerera.

c-254.title: Mashizha epine ndiwo anochengetedza kuti songpyeon irambe iri nyore
c-254.summary: Terpenes dziri mumashizha epine akaiswa pasi pesongpyeon dzine mushonga wekudzivirira mabhakitiriya zvishoma, asi haisi preservative, saka kuchengetedza kunoda kutarisirwa zvakasiyana.
c-254.principle: Terpenes dzemashizha epine senge alpha-pinene ($\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}}$) dzinokanganisa membrane yemabhakitiriya dzichidzikisa kuwanda. Mhedzisiro iri nyoro, inobatsira kwenguva yemaawa mashoma kusvika zuva rimwe.
c-254.example: Songpyeon inogara zuva rimwe panzvimbo inotonhorera yakajairika, mufiriji keke rinoomarara (aging), uye kana ukaigadzira mufiriza unogona kuichengeta anenge mwedzi 1. Kana ukaivimba nemashizha epine chete muzhizha pakupisa kwemukamuri, inogona kuora.
c-254.actionItem: Nhasi songpyeon yakasara, tonhodza yacho woiputira imwe neimwe mufoil wozviisa mufiriza, wozvibika nemhute usati wadya.

c-255.title: Red ginseng ibhuku rekushandurwa kwechimiro che saponin nekubikwa nemhute
c-255.summary: Red ginseng inogadzirwa nekubika ginseng mbishi nemhute wozoomesa, uye mukuita izvi shuga yeginsenoside inoparara ichigadzira zvikamu zviri mu red ginseng chete.
c-255.principle: Nekupisa nemhute, cheni yeshuga yeginsenoside inogwamba. $\text{Rb}_1 \xrightarrow{\text{mhute, H}^+} \text{Rg}_3 + 2\ \text{glucose}$
c-255.example: Red ginseng inogadzirwa nekubika ginseng mbishi pa95–100℃ kwemaawa akati wandei woiomesa, uye mukuita izvi Rg3·Rg5·Rk1 dzinoitika. Hatigoni kuvimbisa mhedzisiro, uye huwandu hweginsenoside hunosiyana nechigadzirwa.
c-255.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga red ginseng enzanisa makore (6-year root here) nehuwandu hweginsenoside hwakanyorwa (Rg1+Rb1+Rg3).

c-256.title: Ufu chena pamusoro pegrape haisi mushonga wekuuraya tupukanana
c-256.summary: Ufu chena pamusoro pegrape iwax yakazvarwa ine grape pachayo (bloom), uye rinogona kuva chiratidzo chekuti yakanyatsonaka.
c-256.principle: Bloom iwax yakaita makristaro hydrophobic senge oleanolic acid ($\mathrm{C_{30}H_{48}O_3}$) inodzivirira kuputika kwemvura uye inodzivirira mvura nemarara.
c-256.example: Layer rebloom rakatetepa zvakanyanya, riri pasi pema μm mashoma, uye rinopukutika nyore noruoko. Magrapes ane bloom yakaenzana akadzikawo kubatwa mushure mekukohwa, saka inobatsira kutonga kuvapo.
c-256.actionItem: Nhasi geza grapes pasi pemvura inoyerera kwemasekondi 30 usati wadya, uye usadzigeza kare.

c-257.title: Nei mashizha ichiita matsvuku ndokuti mashizha anogadzira ruvara rutsva
c-257.summary: Mashizha eyero iruvara rwakarongedzwa pakutanga rinoonekwa, uye mashizha matsvuku anoitika nokuti mumwaka wekudonha mashizha anogadzira anthocyanin nyowani.
c-257.principle: Kana zuva rakapfupika uye chando chikauya, chlorophyll ($\mathrm{C_{55}H_{72}O_5N_4Mg}$) inoparara ichiratidza yero yecarotenoid, uye kana shuga ichiunganidzwa, anthocyanin inogadzirwa nyowani ichiita tsvuku.
c-257.example: Mashizha matsvuku anobuda zvakajeka kana masikati akajeka shuga yakawanda ichigadzirwa uye mangwanani tembiricha ichidzikira kusvika pa5–10℃. Zvinopesana, mumwaka unodziya wane mvura, ruvara runodzikira.
c-257.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchironga rwendo rwekuona mashizha, tarisa mepu yekufanotaura kwemashizha kwevhiki 1–2 mushure mekutanga kwetembiricha yepasi ye5℃.

c-258.title: Usatore michero yeginkgo nemaoko akashama
c-258.summary: Nyama yeganda remichero yeginkgo kana ukaibata nemaoko akashama inogona kukonzera dermatitis senge poison ivy, uye hwema hunobva kubutyric acid.
c-258.principle: Ginkgolic acid (alkylphenol) yenyama yeginkgo inokonzera contact dermatitis, uye hwema husina kunaka ibutyric acid. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2CH_2COOH}$
c-258.example: Kana muto wenyama yeginkgo ukabata ganda, mushure memaawa akati wandei kusvika zuva rimwe, kunogona kuitika mavara matsvuku nekuyadzwa. Butyric acid ndeye mhando imwe chete nehwema hwebhata rakaora kana kurutsa.
c-258.actionItem: Nhasi pakufamba kwekutonhora usatore michero yeginkgo yakadonha, uye kana zvichidikanwa pfeka magirovhosi ekushandisa kamwe woisarudzira mubhegi.

c-259.title: Howa dzine chepfu hadzirasi chepfu kunyange kana wakadzibika kana kudzioma
c-259.summary: Chepfu yehowa dzine chepfu haipere kunyange ukavira, kuomesa kana kutarisa nechipunu chesirivha, saka usadye howa dzesango dzisina kutarisirwa nenyanzvi.
c-259.principle: Amatoxin (alpha-amanitin) yeAmanita phalloides ndiyo cyclic peptide inogara iri yakasimba kupisa, inovharira RNA polymerase II ichikuvadza masero eutano nepfudzi. $\text{amatoxin} + \text{RNA polymerase II} \to \text{inactive complex}$
c-259.example: Mwero unouraya ndeanenge 0.1mg/kg, uye kapu rimwe rehowa yeAmanita phalloides (anenge 50g) rinogona kuuraya kunyange munhu mukuru. Zviratidzo zvinoonekwa mushure memaawa 6–24 chete, saka zviri nyore kunonoka.
c-259.actionItem: Nhasi kana wasangana nehowa dzesango musango, usadzitora, uye kana wadya ukaita kurutsa kana kuyerera, enda kuemergency pakarepo uchitora howa dzawadya.

c-260.title: Nei usingafanire kupisa mashizha akadonha nemarara mumwaka wekudonha
c-260.summary: Kana ukapisa mashizha nemarara panze, kupisa kusina kukwana kunobudisa guruva rakawanda nezvinhu zvine chepfu, uye kupisa purasitiki/PVC kunogadzira dioxin.
c-260.principle: Kupisa panze kusina okisijeni kunogadzira PAH ne carbon monoxide. $2\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{CO}$ PVC $(\mathrm{C_2H_3Cl})_n$ painopisirwa inogona kugadzira hydrogen chloride nemhando dzedioxin.
c-260.example: PVC ine anenge 57% chlorine pahuremu, saka 1kg ine anenge 570g yechlorine. Kupisa marara epurazi panze kunogona kubudisa anenge 5–15g yeguruva pa1 kg.
c-260.actionItem: Nhasi usapise mashizha akadonha, aunganidze uashandise sefetireza kana kuaisa zvinoenderana nenzira yekuunganidza yehurumende yenzvimbo.

c-261.title: Ufu chena muhumidifier mineral yemvura yepombi
c-261.summary: Ufu chena unounganidzwa padyo nehumidifier yeultrasonic imineral senge calcium ne magnesium zvaiva zvakanyungudika mumvura yepombi.
c-261.principle: Humidifier yeultrasonic haivire mvura asi inoikanda semadonhwe madiki, uye munyu wakanyungudika mumvura unosara semakristaro akasimba kana madonhwe aoma. Kuvira kunodzikisa chikamu chehardness. $\mathrm{Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3 + CO_2 + H_2O}$
c-261.example: Kana mineral yemvura yepombi iri anenge 80mg/L uye 2.4L ikapfapfaidzwa kwemaawa 8 ousiku humwe, anenge 190mg yeparticles inogona kupararira mumhepo. Particles idzi diki zvakakwana kusvika mumapapu.
c-261.actionItem: Nhasi dururira zvakare tanki yemvura yehumidifier zuva rega rega uidzore, uye kana zvichikwanisika shandisa distilled water kana humidifier yekupisa kana evaporative.

c-262.title: Nei mabhuku ekare achiita eyero
c-262.summary: Mabhuku ekare anoita eyero uye anoputika nokuti zvinhu zveasidhi neligin zviri mupepa zvinooksidheswa nekuparadzwa.
