c-262.principle: Lignin yepepa reasidhi inooksidheswa nechiedza neokisijeni ichiita eyero, uye asidhi inogwamba cellulose ichiita kuti pepa rirege simba. $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H^+}} n\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-262.example: Mapepa ane lignin yakawanda senge nyaya (lignin anenge 25%) anoita eyero mukati memwedzi mishoma, asi mabhuku epepa risina asidhi anogara mazana emakore. Kana humidity netembiricha zvichikwira, maitiro anokurumidza.
c-262.actionItem: Nhasi isa mabhuku anokosha mushelufu inotonhorera yakaoma isina zuva rakananga, uye usaise zvidimbu zvenyaya pakati pemabhuku.

c-263.title: Pasi pematomatisi pakaoma nokuti hapana calcium
c-263.summary: Blossom end rot yematomatisi inoitika kwete nokuti ivhu rakashayiwa calcium chaiko asi nokuti calcium haisvike muchibereko.
c-263.principle: Calcium ions dzinofamba nemvura yetranspiration, uye mugumo wechibereko une transpiration shoma unowana kwakanonoka. Kana kumhanya kwekuyerera kuri kunononoka, huwandu hunopiwa hunodzikira. $J = C \times \dot{V}$ ($C$: calcium concentration, $\dot{V}$: kuyerera kwemvura)
c-263.example: Kana kudiridza kwakaenzana kwakashata, kufamba kwecalcium kunotsemuka uye zviratidzo zvinoitika; zvinokurudzirwa kupa mvura yakaenzana ne anenge 25mm (2.5cm) pavhiki nenzira yakagadzikana. Kutarisira mvura kunoshanda kupfuura kuisa calcium yakawanda muvhu.
c-263.actionItem: Nhasi pamatomatisi, panzvimbo yekudiridza kamwe chete pashure pemazuva akati wandei, dira nenzira yakaenzana ivhu risati raoma, woisa mulch.

c-264.title: Marasha emarasha uri fetireza yemahara yepotassium mumunda, asi chenjera
c-264.summary: Marasha emuti akapiswa fetireza ine alkali inopa potassium ne calcium, asi inokuvadza zvirimwa zvinoda asidhi, uye usashandise marasha ane additives kana emuti wakapendwa.
c-264.principle: $\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ yemarasha inonyungudika mumvura ichibudisa potassium ions ne hydroxide ions ichikwidza pH yevhu. $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons 2K^+ + HCO_3^- + OH^-}$
c-264.example: pH yemarasha emuti i10–13 uye ine potassium (K₂O) inenge 3–10%. Huwandu hunokurudzirwa hwakaenzana ne100 g pa1 m² pagore (zvanza zviviri) kana pasi, uye usaashandise pa blueberry kana mbatatisi.
c-264.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine marasha emuti akachena akatonhora zvakakwana, aoneke noreshi woyera pH yevhu, wozoapfapfaidza zvishoma pamunda une neutral kusvika alkaline chete.

c-265.title: Kana compost ichinhuwa, wedzera carbon
c-265.summary: Kana compost ichinhuwa ammonia kana kuora, nitrogen yakawandisa, saka sanganisa zvinhu zvecarbon senge mashizha akaoma.
c-265.principle: Kuti tupukanana dzishande zvakanaka, chiyero checarbon kunitrogen chinofanira kunge chiri anenge 30:1. $\mathrm{C/N} = \frac{m_C}{m_N} \approx 30$ Kana nitrogen yakawandisa, $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + OH^- \to NH_3 + H_2O}$ inogadzira hwema hweammonia.
c-265.example: C/N yezvisara zvechikafu inenge 15–20, mashizha akaoma 50–80, uye sawdust anenge 400. Kana ukasanganisa zvikamu 2–3 zvemashizha akaoma (zvinhu zvebrown) nechikamu 1 chezvisara zvechikafu nevolume, hwema hunodzikira zvakanyanya.
c-265.actionItem: Nhasi kana bini recompost richinhuwa, isa bhegi rimwe remashizha akaoma kana bhokisi repepa rakachekwa, usanganise zvakanaka uye uvhure mhepo.

c-266.title: Nyemba dzakaoma dzakanga dzisina kubikwa zvakakwana dzine chepfu yelectin
c-266.summary: Nyemba mbishi kana dzakabikwa zvisina kukwana pa80℃ chete dzinogona kukonzera kurutsa nekuyerera nelectin, saka dzinofanira kuvirwa zvakakwana.
c-266.principle: Lectin yenyemba (Phaseolus agglutinin) iprotein, saka inoda kupiswa zvakakwana pa100℃ kuti ishanduke. $\text{lectin inoshanda} \xrightarrow{100^\circ\mathrm{C},\ \ge 10\ \text{maminitsi}} \text{lectin yakashandurwa}$ Pa80℃ chepfu inogona kuwedzera kakawanda.
c-266.example: Kunyange kudya nyemba tsvuku mbishi 4–5 chete kunogona kukonzera kusvotwa nekurutsa mukati memaawa 1–3, uye kubika pa80℃ kunotaurwa kuwedzera chepfu anenge ka5 kupfuura nyemba mbishi. Dzemakani dzakatobikwa.
c-266.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchishandisa nyemba dzakaomeswa, dzinyike kwemaawa anopfuura 5, dururira mvura, uvire kwemaminitsi 10 kana kupfuura wozobika pamoto wakadzikira.

c-267.title: Usavhare zvakasimba chivharo chebhodhoro remaesi
c-267.summary: Maesi akaiswa mushuga anogadzira carbon dioxide nekuvirisa kweyeast, saka kana ukavhara bhodhoro zvakasimba, kumanikidza kunounganidzwa kuchikonzera kuputika.
c-267.principle: Yeast inoparadza shuga ichigadzira doro necarbon dioxide. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2\,C_2H_5OH + 2\,CO_2}$
c-267.example: Kunyange kuvirisa 10g yeglucose (anenge 0.056 mol) kunogadzira anenge 2.7L yeCO2, uye mubhodhoro re3 L kumanikidza kunogona kukwira nokukurumidza. Zvinoitika zvakanyanya kana shuga isina kunyungudika kana kupisa kwakawanda.
c-267.actionItem: Nhasi vhara bhodhoro remaesi zvisina kusimba kana kuvhara nejira, uye kana mapundu achikwira, vhura chivharo kamwe pazuva kubudisa gasi.

c-268.title: Nei mavara ecurry achiita matsvuku paunoashambidza nesipo
c-268.summary: Ruvara rweyero recurry (curcumin) runoshanduka kuita tsvuku mualkali, saka kana ukapukuta nesipo ine alkali, mavara anova matsvuku uye akasviba.
c-268.principle: Curcumin ipH indicator, yero mu acid ne neutral uye brown tsvuku pa pH inenge 8.6 kana kupfuura. $\mathrm{HCur \rightleftharpoons H^+ + Cur^-}$ (yero ⇌ tsvuku)
c-268.example: Mhinduro yesipo yakasimba ine pH 9–10 inopfuura muganho uyu wekushanduka kweruvara. Kana ukashandisa kitchen detergent isina kwayakarerekera (pH inenge 7) ruvara haruchinji, uye kana ukaomesa pazuva curcumin inoparara nechiedza ichiita yakadzikira.
c-268.actionItem: Nhasi kana mavara ecurry akaitika, geza nemvura inotonhora, utaure nekitchen detergent isina kwayakarerekera, uye usapukute nesipo woomesa pazuva.

c-269.title: Nei yolk yezai rakabikwa ichiita girini
c-269.summary: Mupendero wegirini weyolk yezai rakabikwa kwenguva refu iferrous sulfide isina njodzi, uye unogona kudzivirirwa nekudzikisa nguva yekubika.
c-269.principle: Hydrogen sulfide inobva kusulfur amino acids dzeunganda hwezai inosangana neiron yeyolk ichigadzira iron sulfide. $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + H_2S \to FeS + 2H^+}$
c-269.example: Mazai makuru anosvika pakuibva zvakakwana mushure memaminitsi 10–12 kubva pakuvira, uye kana wakabika maminitsi anopfuura 15 mupendero wegirini unowanikwa nyore. Kana ukanyika mumvura inotonhora kwemaminitsi 5 pakarepo mushure mekubika, maitiro anomira.
c-269.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika mazai, bika maminitsi 10–12 chete mushure mekuvira uye unyike mumvura inotonhora kwemaminitsi 5.

c-270.title: Kumedza bhatiri rebhatani kunokonzera kupisa mukati memaawa 2
c-270.summary: Kana ukamedza bhatiri rebhatani rakaita semari, kunogona kuitika kupisa kwakakura mumuhuro mukati memaawa 2, saka enda kuemergency pakarepo kunyange pasina zviratidzo.
c-270.principle: Kana bhatiri richibata mate emuhuro, current inoyerera, mvura inoparadzwa nemagetsi, uye kudivi renegative hydroxide ions dzinogadzira kupisa kwealkali kwakasimba. $2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2e^- \to \mathrm{H_2} + 2\mathrm{OH^-}$
c-270.example: Bhatiri rebhatani re3 V lithium rine dhayamita ye20 mm (CR2032) rinosungirira nyore muhuro hwevana, uye pH yetishu inogona kukwira kusvika pa12–13. Kukuvadzwa kunotanga mukati memaawa 2 uye haufanire kurutsisa kana kumirira.
c-270.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa kana nzvimbo yebhatiri rebhatani muremote, smart key nezvidimbu zvekutamba yakavharwa nescrew, woisa mabhatiri akawedzera kunzvimbo isingasvikwi nevana.

c-271.title: Tuna ne swordfish zvidyiwe 1–2 pavhiki nokuda kwe mercury
c-271.summary: Hove huru dzinodya dzimwe senge tuna ne swordfish dzine methylmercury yakawanda, saka zviri nani kuderedza kudya kusvika 1–2 pavhiki.
c-271.principle: Mercury inoshanduka kuita methylmercury netupukanana uye inounganidzwa muketani yechikafu. $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{tupukanana}} CH_3Hg^+}$ Muganho wevhiki unobvumirwa weEuropean Food Safety Authority ndi1.3 μg pa kg yehuremu.
c-271.example: Munhu ane huremu hwe60 kg ane muganho wevhiki we78 μg. Swordfish ine mercury 1.0ppm ine anenge 100 μg mu100 g, saka kudya kamwe chete kunogona kupfuura, uye light tuna ane anenge 0.1ppm ine anenge 10 μg mu100 g. Vakadzi vane pamuviri nevana vanofanira kutarisira zvakanyanya.
c-271.actionItem: Nhasi tuna, swordfish ne shark dya anenge 100g panguva imwe chete uye uronge kudya hove huru dzimwe chete 1–2 pavhiki ino.

c-272.title: Shrimp nemakakapi anoita matsvuku kana abikwa
c-272.summary: Kana shrimp nemakakapi akabikwa, protein inoshanduka uye ruvara rutsvuku rwakanga rwakavharirwa rwunosunungurwa, uye iyi ichiratidzo chakanaka chekuti abikwa zvakakwana.
c-272.principle: Kana zvichiri zvipenyu, astaxanthin inonamira neprotein (crustacyanin) ichiita grey-bhuruu, asi kupisa kunoshandura protein, astaxanthin tsvuku inosunungurwa. $\text{astaxanthin-protein (grey-bhuruu)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{astaxanthin (tsvuku)} + \text{protein yakashandurwa}$
c-272.example: Shrimp inoibva kana tembiricha yemukati iri 63℃ (145℉) kana kupfuura, ichiva pink isingaoneki nepakati, uye maminitsi 2–3 mumvura inovira anokwana. Kana ukaibika kupfuura, nyama inoomarara.
c-272.actionItem: Nhasi pakubika shrimp, kana muviri wava pink usingaoneki nepakati ine chimiro cheC, bvisa pakarepo kuti irege kuomarara.

c-273.title: Kana brake fluid yakwegura, kubhureka kunoita kushoma
c-273.summary: Brake fluid inotora unyoro hwemhepo ichidzikisa boiling point, uye mukubhureka kwakanyanya sepakudzika, inogona kuvira ichidzikisa simba rekubhureka.
c-273.principle: Brake fluid yeglycol inotora unyoro, saka kana yasanganiswa nemvura boiling point inodzika ichigadzira mhute, uye mhute inomanikidzwa isingaendesi simba rekubhureka. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: Dry boiling point yeDOT 4 ndeye 230℃ pashoma, asi kana yatora unyoro inodzika kusvika pa155℃, anenge 75℃ pasi. Pagore inotora anenge 2–3% yemvura, saka inokurudzirwa kuchinjwa makore 2 ega ega kana 40,000km.
c-273.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa zuva rekuchinja brake fluid kekupedzisira mumarekodhi eservice, uye kana rapfuura makore 2 ronga kuongororwa kugarage.

c-274.title: Ruvara rupink rwemhando dzehamu dzechipo hunobva kunitrite
c-274.summary: Ham inochengeta ruvara rupink kunyange ichibikwa nokuti nitrite inogadzira ruvara urwu, uye zviri nani kusadya nyama dzakagadzirwa kakawanda.
c-274.principle: Nitrite mu acid inova nitric oxide (NO) inobatana neiron yemyoglobin ichigadzira nitrosomyoglobin pink. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Muganho wekuramba kwenitrite ion munyama dzakagadzirwa muKorea ndiwe70 mg/kg kana pasi. WHO inodoma nyama dzakagadzirwa seGroup 1 carcinogen, uye kudya 50g pazuva kunowedzera njodzi yecancer yemudumbu ne18%.
c-274.actionItem: Nhasi ham yechipo wakawana chengeta mufiriji, uye udye anenge 50g panguva imwe uchiidya nemiriwo.

c-275.title: Ufu chena pamahikwa akaomeswa idzi makristaro eshuga, haisi mold
c-275.summary: Ufu chena pamusoro pegahwa rakaomeswa kazhinji haisi mold asi makristaro eshuga (glucose·fructose) akasimba pamusoro. Kana kuine mavara eblue kana dema akaita senhengo, ndiwo mold, saka dururira.
c-275.principle: Munguva yekuomesa unyoro hunodzikira uye huwandu hweshuga hunokwira, uye kana yapfuura saturated solubility, shuga inoita makristaro. Mamiriro ekuita saturated ndi$C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$ uye ndiyo mhedzisiro yekudzikira kwedhenominetor $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{shuga}}}{V_{\mathrm{mvura}}}$ yemvura kuputika.
c-275.example: Persimmon yakachena ine unyoro hwenge 80% uye shuga inenge 15%, asi akaomeswa unyoro hunodzikira kusvika pa25–30% uye shuga inowedzera kusvika pa60% kana kupfuura. Ndosaka ufu chena unoitika pamusoro.
c-275.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga gahwa rakaomeswa sarudza rine ufu hwakaenzana, rakasimba uye pamusoro paoma, uye dzivisa rine mhodzi dzebhuruu kana mavara anonamira.

c-276.title: Hwema hwemoto paunovhura heater kekutanga idzi guruva rinopiswa
c-276.summary: Kana ukavhura heater rakange rakazorora zhizha rese, hwema hwekupiswa hunowanzova guruva rakaunganidzwa paheater rinopiswa. Kana ukarimhanyisa maminitsi mashoma uchivhura mhepo, kazhinji hunopera, asi kana huchienderera zvinoda kuongororwa.
c-276.principle: Zvinhu zvemarara muguruva (fiber, ganda rakafa) kana zvapiswa zvinoparara zvichigadzira zvinhu zvinoputika nemakarbon. Zvinotanga pa $T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, uye pamusoro peheating element pakapisa kupfuura izvi.
c-276.example: Pamusoro peheating element yeelectric heater anowanzosvika 300–800°C uye guruva rinopiswa nyore. Heater ye1–2kW inonhuwa kunyange kana yakavhura maminitsi 30 chete, asi mushure mekuchenesa hunenge hwaenda.
c-276.actionItem: Nhasi usati wavhura heater, bvisa plug, bvisa guruva remuromo wekupinza nepasi nevacuum, wobva wavhura hwindo woiyedza kwemaminitsi 10. Kana hwema hwekupisa huchienderera kana utsi hukabuda, dzima pakarepo uongororwe.

c-277.title: Cabbage inofanira kuchengetwa nemunyu kuti ive nyoro uye kimchi inonaka
c-277.summary: Kana ukaisa cabbage mumunyu, nekuda kweosmosis mvura inobuda ichinyorova, uye mhando dzinopinda zvakanaka uye crispness inoramba. Kana kupisa kusina kukwana, kimchi inoita isina munyu uye yakanyorova.
c-277.principle: Membrane yeseru isemipermeable, saka kana munyu wekunze uri mukuru mvura inobuda mukati ichienda kunze. Osmotic pressure inoratidzwa se$\Pi = iCRT$, uye calcium inosunga pectin ichichengeta chimiro chetishu.
c-277.example: Kana ukaisa cabbage 1 (anenge 2.5kg) mumunyu anenge 200g (anenge 8%) kwemaawa 4–6, huremu hunodzika anenge 20–25% uye anenge 0.5–0.6kg yemvura inobuda. Munyu wecabbage yakachengetwa unofanira kunge uri anenge 2%.
c-277.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchigadzira kimchi, paunochengeta cabbage dzoreredza kamwe pakati, woidzvanya kusvika yakakotamisa isingatsemuki wozoigeza wobvisa mvura.

c-278.title: Persimmon inovava inonyorova kana tannin inonyungudika yakasimba
c-278.summary: Kuvava kwepersimmon kunobva kutannin inonyungudika mumvura, uye kana yaita insoluble hairavi. Kuomesa gahwa kana kudzikisa kuvava ndiko maitiro aya.
c-278.principle: Tannin inonyungudika inosangana neprotein yemurauro ichiita kuvava. Persimmon kana ikaibva, kuomeswa kana kuvharwa, acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) inogadzirwa inopolymerize tannin ichiishandura kuita insoluble kusingachanyungudiki mumate.
c-278.example: Persimmon inovava ine tannin inonyungudika inenge 1%, saka muromo unoomarara, asi kana yakaiswa yakavharwa pa20–25°C kwemazuva 3–5, zvizhinji zvinopera kunyungudika uye kuvava kunenge kwapera.
c-278.actionItem: Nhasi kana uine persimmon inovava, isa mumudziyo wakavharwa kana bhegi pamwe chete neapuro kana banana kwemazuva 2–3, kana peeler uiome zuva. Edza chidimbu chimwe usati wadya kuti utarise kuvava.

c-279.title: Muto wegrapefruit unochinja mhedzisiro yemishonga imwe
c-279.summary: Grapefruit inogona kudzivirira kuparara kwemishonga imwe ichikwidza kuwanda kwemushonga muropa. Kana uchidya mushonga, bvunza murapi wemishonga nezvekuwirirana negrapefruit.
c-279.principle: Furanocoumarin yegrapefruit inovharira enzyme yekuparadza mishonga CYP3A4 muura. Kana kuparadzwa kuchidzikira, mushonga unotorwa unowedzera $AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ ichikura uye njodzi yezvirwere inokwira.
c-279.example: Mamwe ma statin (mushonga wecholesterol) kana ukanwa kapu rimwe regrapefruit juice (anenge 250mL) kuratidzwa kweropa (AUC) kunogona kuwedzera nenguva dzakawanda, uye mhedzisiro inogona kugara kupfuura zuva. Mhedzisiro inosiyana zvikuru nemushonga.
c-279.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa mhinduro yemushonga waunonwa kana bvunza murapi wemishonga kana pane yambiro yegrapefruit, uye kana ichipo dzivisa grapefruit juice nemichero. Usamise mishonga wega.

c-280.title: Nei zvinwiwa zviri mundege zvichifanira kupatsanurwa kusvika pa100 mL kana pasi
c-280.summary: Pandege dzenyika dzose zvinwiwa negel zvinogona kutorwa mumidziyo isingapfuure 100mL mubhegi rinoratidzika rine zipper. Muganho wehukuru hwemudziyo imitemo yekuita kuti zvive zvakaoma kugadzira huwandu hune njodzi nemudziyo mumwe.
c-280.principle: Nekufunga kuti zvinhu zvinoputika zvemvura zvinoita njodzi kana zvawanda, hukuru hwemudziyo hunodzivirirwa. Huwandu hwose hunotorwa ndi$V_{\mathrm{zvese}}=\sum V_i$ uye mudziyo wega wega $V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ unofanira kuva 100mL kana pasi, uye kazhinji hunodzivirirwa kubhegi re1 L rimwe chete.
c-280.example: Kana ukaisa midziyo 10 ye100 mL mubhegi re1 L zipper, huwandu hwakakura ndeanenge 1L. Mudziyo we200 mL kunyange hafu yakazara kazhinji haubvumirwi nekuda kwehukuru hwemudziyo.
c-280.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchironga rwendo, tamisira shampoo, lotion nemishonga yemvura mumidziyo midiki isingapfuure 100mL uye woisa mubhegi rimwe chete rinoratidzika, womuisa pamusoro pemabhegi ako. Tarisa zvakare mitemo yeairline nenyika usati wabuda.

c-281.title: Jeotgal sarudza uchitarisa nguva yekuibva nekuravira kwe amino acid, kwete munyu
c-281.summary: Kuravira kwakanaka kwejeotgal kunobva kuamino acid dzinogadzirwa neprotein inoparara panguva yekuibva. Tarisa kuti haisi munyu chete, uye kuti ruzivo rwekugadzira nekuibva rwakajeka.
c-281.principle: Enzyme dzinoparadza protein dzomukati mehove dzinogwamba protein kuita peptides ne amino acids: $\text{protein} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{amino acid}$. Mukuita izvi glutamic acid inopa kuravira kwakanaka.
c-281.example: Salted shrimp inowanzova nemunyu anenge 20%, uye kana yaibva kwemwedzi 3–6 amino nitrogen inowedzera uye kuravira kunodzika. Kunyange nemunyu wakafanana, kana kuibva kwapfupika hwema hwehove nemunyu zvinotaridzika.
c-281.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga jeotgal, tarisa zuva rekugadzirwa, zvinhu nemunyu pachirongo, uye kana uchikwanisa kuravira, sarudza ine kunhuhwira kunotapira nekuvira kwakanaka kunosara mushure memunyu.

c-282.title: Kuongorora majoini egasi shandisa mapundu emvura yesipo panzvimbo yehwema
c-282.summary: Kana uchifungira kuyerera kwegasi pajoini, pfuta mvura yesipo uone kana mapundu achiitika. Kuongorora nemoto kana lighter kune njodzi yekuputika uye zvakarambidzwa zvachose.
c-282.principle: Gasi rinoyerera rinosundira pamusoro pefirimu resurfactant yemvura yesipo richigadzira mapundu. Kumanikidza mukati mepundu ndi$\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$ (kune soap bubble), saka kunyange kuyerera kudiki kunoita pundu rinoonekwa.
c-282.example: Kana ukapfuta mvura inosanganiswa ye100 mL yemvura ne1 mL yedetergent pajoini rehose regasi uye mapundu achikura kana achiramba achiitika, kuyerera kuripo. Gasi rekuguta rakareruka kupfuura mhepo saka rinokwira, LPG rinorema saka rinounganidzwa pasi.
c-282.actionItem: Nhasi vhara gasi valve woisa mvura yesipo pajoini rehose uone kana mapundu achiitika. Kana mapundu achikura, vhara valve, vhura mhepo wozotsvaga nyanzvi.

c-283.title: Chestnut kana ikachengetwa mukutonhora, starch inoshanduka kuita shuga uye inotapira zvikuru
c-283.summary: Kana ukachengeta chestnut mbishi mufiriji pa0–4°C kwemavhiki akati wandei, starch inoshanduka kuita shuga uye inotapira. Kana ukaiisa pakupisa kwemukamuri inoora nyore, saka kuchengeta mufiriji inzira inochengetera.
c-283.principle: Panguva yekutonhora amylase nezvimwe zvinoparadza starch kuita maltose neglucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Zvirimwa zvinounganidza shuga kudzivirira kuita chando nemhedzisiro yeosmosis.
c-283.example: Chestnut yakangobudiswa ine shuga inenge 5–8%, asi kana yakachengetwa pa0–2°C kwemavhiki 4–8, shuga inowedzera anenge ka1.5–2 uye kutapira kunowedzera zvakajeka. Pakupisa kwemukamuri, mukati memavhiki maviri mhuka nemold zvinoitika nyore.
c-283.actionItem: Nhasi putira chestnut mbishi nedanda rekicheni muganda mubhegi rezipper uise muchirongo chefiriji (anenge 1–4°C), woibika nemhute kana kuipisa mukati memavhiki 1–2.

c-284.title: Kuchengeta zvikafu mumabhodhoro kunoenderana ne pH 4.6
c-284.summary: Pakugadzira zvikafu zvemabhodhoro pamba, unofanira kuparadzanisa zvikafu zvine acid (pH 4.6 kana pasi) nezvikafu zvine acid shoma (pamusoro pe4.6). Zvikafu zvine acid shoma zvichibikwa mumvura inovira chete hazviparadzi njodzi yechepfu yebotulism.
c-284.principle: Spores dzebotulinum dzinogona kugadzira chepfu kana pH ichipfuura 4.6 uye pasina okisijeni mumamiriro akavharwa. Acid ndi$\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$ uye pH 4.6 ndi$[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Jam nemichero yakabikwa ine pH inenge 3–4 saka acid, saka kubika mumvura inovira kune chengetedzo yakadzama, asi miriwo, nyama nenyemba dzine pH 5–7 acid shoma saka dzinoda kupisa kwemanikidzo ye116–121°C. Mvura inovira haipfuure 100°C.
c-284.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchigadzira zvikafu zvemabhodhoro, tarisa acid yezvinhu (michero kana vinegar), uye zvinhu zvine acid shoma chengeta mufiriji kana friza panzvimbo yemabhodhoro epamba. Kana chivharo chakazvimba kana kuine mapundu kana hwema husiri hwakajairika, usadya uzvirasire.

c-285.title: Chocolate inogona kuva chepfu kumbwa
c-285.summary: Theobromine yechocolate inoparadzwa nembwa zvishoma nezvishoma uye inogona kukonzera chepfu. Kana cocoa yakawanda zvakawedzera njodzi, saka kana imbwa yako yadya, tarisa huwandu nemhando woudza chiremba wemhuka.
c-285.principle: Theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) ine half-life inenge maawa 17 mumbwa, yakareba kupfuura munhu (anenge maawa 6–10), saka inounganidzwa mumuviri. Njodzi yechepfu inoverengwa nehuwandu pahuremu $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{huremu}}}$.
c-285.example: Dark chocolate (cocoa 70%) ine theobromine inenge 5–8mg/g, saka imbwa ye10 kg kana ikadya anenge 50g (hafu yebhara rakajairika) inenge 250–400mg (anenge 25–40mg/kg), iri mudunhu rine njodzi yezviratidzo zvakakomba. Milk chocolate ine zvishoma.
c-285.actionItem: Nhasi chengeta chocolate nezvigadzirwa zvecocoa panzvimbo yakakwirira kana mukabati rakavharwa, kure nembwa. Kana yadya, usamirire, nyora mhando, huwandu nenguva woudza chiremba wemhuka pakarepo.

c-286.title: Chikafu chendege chinoravira chisina kuravira nokuda kwekumanikidza kwemhepo nekuoma kwendege
c-286.summary: Mukati mendege kumanikidza kwemhepo kwakadzika uye kuoma kwakanyanya saka kunhuhwirira nekuravira zvinodzikira uye chikafu chinonzwika chisina munyu. Ndosaka chikafu chendege chinoitwa nemunyu wakawanda zvakanangana.
c-286.principle: Kumanikidza kwemukati mendege kunenge kwenzvimbo ye2,000–2,400m pamusoro pegungwa (anenge 0.75–0.8atm) uye humidity yakaenzana i10–20%. Pakumanikidza kwakadzika nekuoma, kunzwa kwekunhuhwirira nekuravira kunodzika zvikuru, uye kunotaurwa kuti kutapira nemunyu zvinodzikira anenge 30%. Chiyero chekumanikidza ndi$\frac{P_{\mathrm{kabhini}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: Kunyange chikafu chakajairika pasi, pakukwirira kwekufamba kutapira nemunyu zvinogona kunzwika zvishoma ne20–30%, saka chikafu chendege chinoshandisa munyu nezvinonhuwira zvakawanda. Tomato juice inonzwika inonaka zvikuru mundege nemhaka yakafanana.
c-286.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchikwira ndege, inwa mvura kakawanda kuti muromo urege kuoma, uye kunyange kana chikafu chichinzwika chisina munyu, usawedzera munyu, sarudza chikafu chine kunhuhwirira kwakasimba kana zvinwiwa zvine kuvava.

c-287.title: Hupfu hwekubika, sarudza strong, medium kana soft nehuwandu hweprotein
c-287.summary: Kupatsanura hupfu kuita strong, medium nesoft kunobva kumusiyano weprotein. Chingwa sarudza strong flour ine protein yakawanda, keke nemabhisikiti soft flour ine protein shoma kuti texture ienderane.
c-287.principle: Protein dzegorosi gliadin negluten zvikasangana nemvura zvinoita network yegluten: $\text{gliadin}+\text{glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{gluten}$. Protein yakawanda, network inoramba uye inosimba.
c-287.example: Strong flour ine protein inenge 11–13% yechingwa chinonamira nebagel, medium inenge 9–10% yenoodles nemapancakes, soft inenge 7–9% yemakeke nemabhisikiti ane ufu. Mu100 g ye soft flour protein inenge 8g.
c-287.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga hupfu, tarisa huwandu hweprotein mumashoko ekudya kwepabhegi, uye sarudza strong, medium kana soft zvinoenderana nechikafu chaunoda kugadzira.

c-288.title: Kusanganisa mabhatiri matsva nemakare kunowedzera njodzi yekuyerera
c-288.summary: Kana ukashandisa mabhatiri matsva nemakare kana mhando dzakasiyana pamwe chete, bhatiri rakasimba zvishoma rinodzikira zvakanyanya uye rinogona kuyerera. Chinja mabhatiri ose ezvishandiso panguva imwe chete, ari emhando imwe uye enguva imwe.
c-288.principle: Museries current imwe chete inoyerera, asi kana voltage yebhatiri rakasimba zvishoma ikaenda padyo ne0 V, mamwe anochaja bhatiri iro nenzira yakapesana. Panguva iyi mhinduro senge $2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$ inogadzira hydrogen, kumanikidza kwemukati kunokwira uye kuyerera kunoitika.
c-288.example: Kana mabhatiri matsva e1.5V matatu museries (4.5V) uye rimwe rakapera padyo ne0 V, mamwe maviri anoramba achisundira anenge 3V uye bhatiri iro rinochajwa zvakapesana. Potassium hydroxide yakayerera ialkali yakasimba (pH inenge 14) inokanganisa ganda nezvishandiso.
c-288.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa mabhatiri eremote, wachi nezvidimbu zvekutamba, uye paunochinja, chinja mabhatiri ose echishandiso chimwe nenyowani dzemhando imwe chete. Usabata ufu chena unobuda noruoko.

c-289.title: Bika sagol broth kamwe chete wozvigovanisa
c-289.summary: Kana sagol yakabikwa kwenguva refu, collagen inoshanduka kuita gelatin ichigadzira muto wakasimba, uye kana wakatonhora unoita jelly. Kana ukabika kamwe chete wogovanisa mufiriza, unochengeta mari yegasi nenguva.
c-289.principle: Collagen kana yapiswa inosunungurwa ichiita gelatin, uye kana yatonhora inobva pasol ichienda kugel. Kuparadza nekupisa ndi$\text{collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{gelatin}$, uye inowanzosimba pasi pe35°C.
c-289.example: Kubika 1kg ye sagol mu6 L yemvura kwemaawa 6–8 kunobudisa anenge 4–5L yemuto. Panzvimbo yekuvhura gasi rega rega, kubika kamwe chete wogovanisa ku300 mL pamigove 15 kunodzikisa zvikuru kushandiswa kwegasi.
c-289.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchibika sagol broth, uitonhodze zvakakwana wozvigovanisa mumigove yega yega mumabhegi ezipper kana midziyo wozviisa mufiriza, uye paunodya, defrost nekudziya huwandu hunodiwa chete.

c-290.title: Ufu chena pamusoro pevhu remubhiya hausi mold asi munyu
c-290.summary: Ufu chena pavhu remubhiya kana pamupendero webhiya unogona kunge uri munyu unosara kubva mufetireza kana mvura yepombi, kwete mold. Kana ukadira mvura zvakakwana woiribvisa, unodzikira.
c-290.principle: Mvura painoputika pamusoro, munyu wakanga wakanyungudika unosara ukanyungudika. Huwandu hwemunyu ndi$C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{munyu}}}{V_{\mathrm{mvura}}}$ uye $V_{\mathrm{mvura}}$ inodzikira ichikura, kana yapfuura saturation inoita makristaro. Semuenzaniso zvikamu zvemvura inorema senge $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$ zvinosara.
c-290.example: Kana hardness yemvura yepombi iri anenge 100mg/L (sezvinoverengwa seCaCO3), kuputisa 1L yemvura kunosiya anenge 100mg yecalcium carbonate. Kunyange kupa 200mL vhiki imwe neimwe, mukati memwedzi mishoma ruvara rwakachena runooneka pamusoro pevhu.
c-290.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchiona ufu chena, bvisa 1–2cm yevhu repamusoro uvhare nevhu idzva, wozopa mvura inenge hukuru hwemubhiya zvishoma nezvishoma kuti ibude nedhiramu zvakakwana.

c-291.title: Xylitol gum ine njodzi kana imbwa ikadya
c-291.summary: Xylitol isina njodzi kuvanhu inonyanya kuita njodzi kumbwa, kunyange huwandu hushoma hunogona kukonzera shuga yeropa yakadzika nekukuvadzwa kweatiza. Chengeta gum isina shuga, makendi nebhata remapuranga akati kunze kwekusvikwa nembwa.
c-291.principle: Pancreas yembwa inoona xylitol seglucose ichibudisa insulin nokukurumidza. Nekudaro shuga yeropa inodzika zvakanyanya uye huwandu hwenjodzi hweyxylitol ($\mathrm{C_5H_{12}O_5}$) hunoverengwa ne$D=\frac{m}{m_{\mathrm{huremu}}}$.
c-291.example: Imbwa ye10 kg inogona kuva neshuga yeropa yakadzika nexylitol anenge 0.1g/kg (anenge 1g), uye pamusoro pe0.5g/kg (anenge 5g) njodzi yekukuvadzwa kweatiza yakakura. Gum imwe isina shuga inowanzova ne0.2–1g yexylitol, saka maviri kana matatu ari mudunhu rine njodzi.
c-291.actionItem: Nhasi bvisa gum nemakendi asina shuga ari mubhegi, mumhomwe nemudhirowa uaisa kure nembwa. Kana yadya, tora mashoko ezvakanyorwa woudza chiremba wemhuka pakarepo.

c-292.title: Nei mvura inodziya ine alkali inotsvedza
c-292.summary: Paunonyika mumvura inodziya ine alkali, kutsvedza kunoitika nokuti mafuta pamusoro peganda anoshanduka kuita sipo. Kana ganda rako rakasimba shoma, usagara nguva refu wobva wavhara.
c-292.principle: Alkali (pH 8.5 kana kupfuura) inoita saponification yemafuta eganda (triglycerides) ichiashandura kuita sipo neglycerol: $\text{mafuta} + 3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to 3\,\text{munyu wemafuta (sipo)}+\text{glycerol}$. Chikamu chesipo ichi chinoemulsify pamusoro ichiita kuti unzwe kutsvedza.
c-292.example: Kana ukanyika mumvura inodziya ine alkali ye pH 9–10 pa40°C kwemaminitsi 20, ganda rakafa nemafuta zvinonyungudika ichiita ganda rakatsetseka. Asi pH 10 ine $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ yakakwira ka1,000 kupfuura neutral (pH 7).
c-292.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchigeza kana kushambira mumvura inodziya, mvura ine alkali shandisa anenge maminitsi 10–20 panguva imwe, uye paunobuda pukuta mvura wobva waisa moisturizer pakarepo.

c-293.title: 'Extra virgin' yeolive oil chiratidzo chegiredhi ine acidity 0.8% kana pasi
c-293.summary: Extra virgin igiredhi remafuta anowanikwa nekudzvanya olives ane free fatty acid acidity 0.8% kana pasi uye akapfuura sensory test. Acidity yakadzika haireve nguva dzose kuravira kwakanaka, saka tarisa zvakare zuva rekukohwa nekuisa mubhodhoro.
c-293.principle: Acidity iyo chiyero che free fatty acid (sezvinoverengwa seoleic acid) mumafuta $\text{acidity (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{mafuta emahara acid}}}{m_{\mathrm{mafuta}}}\times100$. Olives dzakachena, triglycerides inoparara zvishoma saka acidity yakadzikira, uye polyphenols inononotsa oxidation.
c-293.example: Acidity 0.8% kana pasi i extra virgin, 2% kana pasi i virgin. Pabhodhoro re1 L, free fatty acid mu extra virgin inenge 8g kana pasi. Kuoma kwechiedza nekupisa, saka mabhodhoro akasviba anobatsira.
c-293.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga olive oil, tarisa 'extra virgin' pabhodhoro pamwe chete negore rekukohwa nezuva rekuisa mubhodhoro, sarudza bhodhoro rakasviba kupfuura rakajeka wozochengeta munzvimbo inotonhorera.

c-294.title: Vhara materminal ebhatiri re9V netepi kuti uchengete
c-294.summary: Bhatiri re9V rine materminal maviri padhuze padivi rimwe, saka kana akabata simbi anogona kupfupika ichipisa. Paunoachengeta mudhirowa vhara materminal netepi kana kuaisa muchikamu chimwe chimwe.
c-294.principle: Kana terminal yakabata simbi senge kiyi kana mari ichibatana pfupi, kuramba kuri kushoma kwazvo uye current hombe $I=\frac{V}{R}$ inoyerera ichigadzira Joule heat $P=I^2R$. Semuenzaniso kana $R=0.5\,\Omega$, ndi$I=18\,\mathrm{A}$.
c-294.example: Kana bhatiri re9 V rine kuramba kwemukati kwenge 1.5Ω rikaitwa short, pamusoro pepepa current $I\approx6\,\mathrm{A}$ inogona kusvika pa
c-294.actionItem: Nhasi vhara materminal emabhatiri 9V akawedzera mudhirowa netepi yakajeka kana kuaisa mumapuranga epurasitiki ekutanga. Usaachengete pamwe nemari nemakiyi.

c-295.title: Tofu rinogara nguva refu kana ukariisa mumvura uchichinja mvura zuva rega rega
c-295.summary: Tofu yakavhurwa kana ukaiisa mumvura yakachena mufiriji uchichinja mvura zuva rega rega unogona kuichengeta ichinyatsonaka mazuva 2–3 yakawedzerwa. Kana pane hwema hunovava kana kunamira, isakuedzi.
c-295.principle: Tofu isoya protein gel yakaitwa necoagulant uye ine anenge 85% yemvura, saka mabhakitiriya anobereka nyore. Kana yakanyikwa mumvura, shanduko yewater activity yepamusoro $a_w=\frac{p}{p_0}$ nekubata okisijeni zvinodzikira, uye kana mvura ichichinjwa nguva dzose mabhakitiriya akawanda nemetabolites zvinogezwa.
c-295.example: Pa4°C mufiriji, tofu yakavhurwa yakanyikwa mumvura inochinjwa zuva rega rega inogara mazuva 3–5, asi kana yakangosiiwa, pamusoro pazvo panomira kunamira mukati memazuva 1–2. Kungoramba usingarasi tofu rimwe (300g, anenge 2,000 won) kuchengeta mari yakawanda.
c-295.actionItem: Nhasi tofu yakasara isa mumudziyo wakavharwa wodira mvura yakachena (yebhodhoro kana yakabikwa ikatonhodzwa) kusvika yanyika, woichengeta mufiriji, uye kubva mangwana chinja mvura kamwe pazuva.

c-296.title: Down jackets geza nedetergent isina kwayakarerekera uye uomese zvakakwana
c-296.summary: Down (hwoko yedhadha/gwiza) jackets kana ukashandisa detergent ine alkali yakasimba, mafuta echisikigo ehwoko anobuda uye kudzoka kwayo kunodzikira. Geza nedetergent isina kwayakarerekera uye uomese zvakakwana mukati kuti udzivise hwema nemold.
c-296.principle: Mafuta (lipids) ehwoko anosaponifiers mumamiriro ealkali ichigeza: $\text{mafuta}+3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to\text{sipo}+\text{glycerol}$. Kana mafuta apera, hwoko inobatana uye ukora hwemhepo inogadzira insulation hunodzikira.
c-296.example: Mhinduro yehupfu hwekugeza hwakajairika ine pH inenge 10–11 alkali, asi detergent isina kwayakarerekera ine pH inenge 7–8. Mujaketi re800 fill power re500 g kunyange kana 100g chete yemvura yakasara, mushure mekuomesa hwema hwakanyorova nemold zvinogona kuitika.
c-296.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchigeza jaketi, shandisa detergent isina kwayakarerekera (yewool/down chete) wogeza zvakakwana, wozoliomesa zvakakwana mudryer yekupisa shoma nemabhora etennis 2–3, kana kuiomesa mumumvuri kwemazuva akati wandei kuti riome mukati.

c-297.title: Calcium ne iron supplements dzinwe munguva dzakasiyana
c-297.summary: Kana ukanwa calcium ne iron supplements pamwe chete, dzinogona kudzivirirana kutorwa. Kana uchidzinwa dzose, siya kupfuura maawa 2 pakati pazvo.
c-297.principle: Cations ye2+ senge $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ ne$\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ dzinokwikwidza transporter imwe yekutora (DMT1 nezvimwe) mumudumbu diki. Kana imwe ichikwira, kutorwa kweimwe kunodzikira, uye pamusoro pe500 mg yecalcium kutorwa kweiron kunogona kuderera zvakajeka.
c-297.example: Zvinotaurwa kuti kana ukanwa 600mg yecalcium ne18 mg yeiron pamwe, kutorwa kweiron kunodzika kusvika pa40–50%. Zvinowanzoitwa kunwa iron isina kudya pamwe nevitamin C, calcium nechikafu.
c-297.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchinwa dzose, nwa iron mangwanani usina kudya kana mangwanani, calcium nechikafu chemanheru. Kana uine mushonga wakanyorerwa, bvunza murapi wemishonga kutanga.

c-298.title: Lighter dzine mitemo yekutorwa mundege
c-298.summary: Lighter dzine mitemo inosiyana nenyika neairline, kazhinji munhu mumwe chete anotora imwe chete pamuviri uye haigoni kuiswa mubhegi rakaiswa. Torch-type (turbo) dzinorambidzwa zvakawanda. Tarisa usati wabuda.
c-298.principle: Mafuta elighter butane ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$) ari muchimiro chemvura inomanikidzwa, inopfuta zvakanyanya, uye kupisa ndi$2\,\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}+13\,\mathrm{O_2}\to8\,\mathrm{CO_2}+10\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Kana kumanikidza kwendege kwadzikira, musiyano wekumanikidza mukati nekunze $\Delta P$ unowedzera.
c-298.example: Butane inoratidza vapor pressure inenge 2atm pa20°C. Mundege (anenge 0.8atm) musiyano nekunze unokura kupfuura pasi, saka mamwe malighter anogona kuyerera mafuta kana murazvo wakura. Lighter yekushandisa kamwe yakajairika inowanzova nebutane inenge g mashoma.
c-298.actionItem: Kana uchienda rwendo nhasi, tarisa mitemo yelighter yeairline nenyika yaunoenda, uye kana usingaidi siya lighter kumba. Kana uchiitora, tora imwe chete mumhomwe kuti uigone kuratidza paunoongororwa.

c-299.title: Soy sauce yakavirisirwa neyakaparadzwa neasidhi dzine maitiro akasiyana
c-299.summary: Soy sauce yakavirisirwa inogadzirwa nekuvirisa nekuibisa soya negorosi netupukanana, uye soy sauce yakaparadzwa neasidhi inogadzirwa nekuparadza protein yesoya nehydrochloric acid nokukurumidza. Tarisa chiratidzo che'brewed soy sauce' nezvinhu zvepachirongo.
c-299.principle: Zvose zvinogwamba protein kuita amino acid asi nemakatalyst akasiyana. Kuvirisa $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\text{enzyme},\ \text{mwedzi yakawanda}}\text{amino acid}$ ne enzyme, kuparadza neasidhi $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{HCl},\ \Delta}\text{amino acid}$, kunopera mukati memaawa akati wandei kusvika mazuva.
c-299.example: Brewed soy sauce inowanzotora mwedzi 6 kusvika makore mashoma kuibva, uye acid-hydrolyzed inogona kugadzirwa mukati memazuva, saka ine mutengo wakaderera asi kunhuhwirira kusina kuzara. Soy sauce yakasanganiswa yekutenga ndeyemhando mbiri dzakasanganiswa uye chiyero chinoratidzwa pachirongo.
c-299.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga soy sauce, tarisa mazita ezvinhu kuti 'brewed soy sauce 100%' here kana 'acid hydrolyzed blend', uye sarudza zvichienderana nekushandiswa: brewed yemuto nezvakabikwa, blended yezvakakangwa nezvemuto.

c-300.title: Diesel kana kuchitonhora zvikuru, paraffin wax inoomarara uye injini haitange
c-300.summary: Paraffin wax iri mudiesel kana ichitonhora pasi pe0 inoita makristaro ichivharira fireta yemafuta uye injini isingatangi. Kana kuchitaurwa chando chakanyanya, isa diesel yechando uye zadza mafuta zvakakwana.
c-300.principle: Mapi n-paraffin ediesel (semuenzaniso $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{42}}$) kana tembiricha ikadzika pasi pe cloud point $T_{\mathrm{cp}}$ inoita makristaro. Kana $T<T_{\mathrm{cp}}$, makristaro ewax anokura, uye pamuganho wekudzika pfuti inovharwa.
c-300.example: Diesel yezhizha ine cloud point inenge 0°C, yechando yakagadziriswa kudzika kusvika pa−15 kusvika −20°C. Kana kuchisvika mangwanani e−10°C muchando, njodzi yekutadza kutanga inowedzera kana diesel yemhando yezhizha ichisara.
c-300.actionItem: Nhasi kana kuchitaurwa chando, tarisa kuti motokari yakadira diesel yechando here pagasi station, uye zadza mafuta kusvika pamusoro pehafu. Kana motokari isingatangi, usaramba uchiedza, kodza garaji kana sevhisi yeinsurance.

c-301.title: Mbeu shoma dzemupunga mumunyu dzinodzivirira kuomarara
c-301.summary: Kana munyu uchiomarara nenyoro, kuisa mbeu shoma dzemupunga kunoita kuti mupunga utore unyoro kutanga uye munyu usanamira zvishoma. Hazvizadzi, saka kuvhara zvakasimba ndiko kunokosha kutanga.
c-301.principle: Sodium chloride inoratidza hygroscopy, inotora mvura yemhepo uchinyungudika kana relative humidity iri pamusoro peanenge 75%. Critical humidity iyi ndi$\mathrm{RH}_{\mathrm{c}}\approx75\%$, uye pamusoro peizvi mbeu dzinonamira pamwe dzichiita zvimedu.
c-301.example: Kana humidity yemwaka wemvura yakapfuura 80%, mudziyo wemunyu wakavhurika unogona kuomarara mukati mezuva rimwe kana maviri. Kana ukaisa mbeu dzemupunga 10–20, dzinotora mvura shoma pamunyu we100 g ichidzikisa kunamira.
c-301.actionItem: Nhasi isa mbeu 10–20 dzemupunga mumudziyo wemunyu wovhara zvakasimba, woiisa panzvimbo inotonhorera yakaoma, kwete padyo negasi kana nzvimbo ine unyoro.

c-302.title: Usashandise enzyme detergent pawool nesilk
c-302.summary: Wool nesilk ndeye protein fibers, saka enzyme detergent ine protease inonyungudika fibers ichidziparadza. Shandisa detergent isina kwayakarerekera yewool nesilk.
c-302.principle: Protease yeenzyme detergent inoparadza peptide bonds dzeprotein: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{H_2N{-}R'}$. Keratin yewool nefibroin yesilk zvine protein imwe chete, saka dzinodzikira nemhedzisiro imwe.
c-302.example: Protease enzymes dzinoshanda zvakanyanya pa30–50°C, saka dzinoshanda patembiricha yekugeza yakajairika. Kunyange kunyika sweater yewool mudetergent ine enzyme pa30°C kwe awa 1 kunogona kusetesa fibers, kudzikisa kupenya kana kuita maburi.
c-302.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa label yekugeza yewool kana silk, uye kana pane 'enzyme (protease)' mushoko rezvinhu zvedetergent, usaishandisa, wogeza nemaoko zvakapfava nemvura inotonhora nedetergent isina kwayakarerekera yewool nesilk.

c-303.title: Zvigadzirwa zve probiotic tevera chiratidzo chekuchengeta tembiricha
c-303.summary: Zvigadzirwa zve probiotic mabhakitiriya mhenyu, saka anotyira kupisa nenyoro uye unofanira kutevera chiratidzo chekuchengeta tembiricha. Kana pachiratidzwa 'refrigerate', usazviise mumotokari kana mukutumirwa kwezhizha.
c-303.principle: Mabhakitiriya mhenyu kana tembiricha ichikwira kuzvipa kudzikira nokukurumidza kunge $N(t)=N_0\,e^{-kt}$, uye tembiricha yakakwirira $k$ inokura. Mhando dzinoita spores (semuenzaniso Bacillus), kana zvigadzirwa zvakafukidzwa kana freeze-dried zvakagadzikana kunyange pakupisa kwemukamuri.
c-303.example: Kana zvigadzirwa zvine chiratidzo che refrigerate zvakaiswa pa25–30°C, huwandu hwemhenyu hunogona kudzika zvakajeka mukati memavhiki mashoma, uye nekukurumidza mukati memotokari pamusoro pe40°C. Huwandu hunovimbiswa hunowanzotorwa pamusoro pehuwandu hunoramba hurimo kusvika pazuva rekupera, kwete patgadzirwa.
c-303.actionItem: Nhasi tarisa label yezvigadzirwa zvako zve probiotic kuti 'refrigerate' kana 'room temperature', uye kana ari refrigerate zviise mufiriji, usazviise mumotokari yezhizha kana pahwindo. Kana uine matambudziko ehutano, bvunza chiremba.

c-304.title: Kunze kwenyika tsvaga mishonga nezita rechinhu chinoshanda muchitoro chemishonga
c-304.summary: Mushonga mumwe chete une mazita ekutengesa akasiyana munyika dzakasiyana, saka kuudza zita rechinhu (chirungu) muchitoro chemishonga kwakarurama zvikuru. Semuenzaniso, acetaminophen kunze inonzi paracetamol.
c-304.principle: Mishonga ine mazita enhengo (generic, INN) akaenzana pasi rose uye mazita ekutengesa anosiyana nemugadziri. Chinhu chimwe chete $\mathrm{C_8H_9NO_2}$ chinonzi acetaminophen (US·Korea), paracetamol (Europe·Asia nezvimwe).
c-304.example: Zvigadzirwa zve500 mg acetaminophen zvinotengeswa se'Tylenol', 'Panadol', 'Paracetamol' nezvimwe zvichienderana nenyika, asi chinhu chakafanana. Mwero wepamusoro wezuva rega rega wevakuru unowanzova usingapfuuri 4g (500mg x 8).
c-304.actionItem: Nhasi kana uchigadzirira rwendo, nyora kana chengeta mufoni mazita enhengo (chirungu) emishonga yaunowanzonwa. Muchitoro chemishonga taura zviratidzo, mishonga yaunonwa nekushaya mvumo, uye tora tsamba yachiremba yemishonga yakanyorwa.

c-305.title: Musiyano weBlack, Green neOolong tea ndiwo mwero wekuoksidheswa kwemashizha
c-305.summary: Black, oolong ne green tea mashizha emuti mumwe asi mwero wekuoksidheswa (kuvirisa) unosiyana saka kuravira nemavara zvinosiyana. Green tea inodzivirira oxidation, black tea inooksidheswa zvakakwana.
c-305.principle: Polyphenol oxidase (PPO) yemashizha etea inoita kuti catechin ishande neokisijeni ichiita theaflavin: $\text{catechin}+\mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PPO}}\text{theaflavin}$. Green tea inotanga yaparadza enzyme nekupisa kudzivirira oxidation.
c-305.example: Green tea oxidation anenge 0%, oolong anenge 10–80%, black anenge 100%. Green tea inowanzobikwa nemvura ye70–80°C kwemaminitsi 1–2, black nemvura ye90–95°C kwemaminitsi 3–5.
c-305.actionItem: Nhasi paunotenga tea, tarisa ruzivo rwe'unoxidized (green)·semi-oxidized (oolong)·fully oxidized (black)' pachirongo, wozoibika nemvura yetembiricha nenguva zvakakodzera.

c-306.title: Chengeta tanki yemafuta yakazara kupfuura hafu muchando
c-306.summary: Muchando, tanki yemafuta isina chinhu inobvumira mhute yemvura iri mumhepo kuita condensation mumafuta, uye inogona kuita chando mumapombi pasi pezero. Kuchengeta tanki yakazara kupfuura hafu kunodzikisa izvi.
c-306.principle: Mhute yemvura iri munzvimbo isina chinhu inoita condensation pamadziro etanki anotonhora. Condensation inoitika kana tembiricha ichidzika pasi pe dew point $T_d$, uye mweya wakawanda uri mutanki, mhute yakawanda inogona kuita condensation. Mvura inoita chando pa $0^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ kana pasi uye inovharira kuyerera kwemafuta.
c-306.example: Tanki isina chinhu ye 50L ine anenge 50L yemweya une hunyoro, saka pa 80% relative humidity ne 10°C, mvura shoma yemagiramu inogona kuita condensation maererano nedzidziso. Tanki yakazara ine mweya mushoma saka mvura shoma, ichideredza mukana wekuti mapombi emafuta aite chando mangwanani e -10°C uye avhare kutanga.
c-306.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa mwero wemafuta emotokari yako kana wetanki yekudziisa uye wedzera kana uri pasi pehafu. Kuichengeta pamusoro pehafu itsika yemuchando iri nyore kupfuura kumirira kuzadza zvizere.

c-307.title: Kana kofi ine kuvava, pfupisa extraction panzvimbo yekuwedzera mbeu
c-307.summary: Kana kofi ine kuvava, kora kukukura kana pfupisa extraction panzvimbo yekuwedzera mbeu. Over-extraction ndiyo inokonzera kuvava, saka unogona kugadzirisa kuravira usingaparadzi mbeu.
c-307.principle: Extraction yield i $\text{yield (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{dissolved\ solids}}}{m_{\mathrm{coffee}}}\times100$, ne 18-22% kazhinji ndiyo yakanaka. Kupfuura apo, zvinhu zvinovava senge chlorogenic acid lactones ne phenylindanes zvinobudiswa zvakanyanya.
c-307.example: Ne 20g yekofi, kupfuura 22% yield kunonyungudutsa anopfuura 4.4g uye kunovava uye kuomarara. Kutarisira 20% kubva pa 20g imwe chete kunonyungudutsa anenge 4g, kuchiravira kwakanaka uye kwakaenzana. Pa anenge 1,000 KRW (anenge USD 0.70) pa 20g yembeu, kudzikisa kupambadza kunowedzera.
c-307.actionItem: Kana kofi yako ine kuvava nhasi, usawedzere mbeu. Kukuya nhanho imwe yakakora kana pfupisa nguva yekubika ne 20-30 masekonzi, uye chengeta mvura pa 90-94°C.

c-308.title: Yeast inofa mumvura inopisa kupfuura anenge 55°C
c-308.summary: Yeast yechingwa inofa mumvura inopisa zvakanyanya, saka mukanyiwa hauzovimbi. Chengeta mvura yakadziya kana ichibatwa, anenge 30-38°C.
c-308.principle: Yeast (Saccharomyces) inofa nekukurumidza pamusoro pe anenge 55°C apo mapuroteni ayo anoshandurwa. Kushanda kwayo kuri pamusoro pa anenge 28-35°C, uye fermentation $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\to2\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+2\,\mathrm{CO_2}$ inogadzira carbon dioxide inosimudza mukanyiwa.
c-308.example: Ne 7g yeyeast mu 500g yefurawa, mvura ye 35°C inobvumira mukanyiwa kuwedzera kaviri mukati meawa, asi mvura ye 60°C inouraya yeast yakawanda uye mukanyiwa haubudiri. Inochengetedzawo pakiti yeyeast (anenge 500 KRW, anenge USD 0.35).
c-308.actionItem: Kana uchibika chingwa nhasi, tarisa tembiricha yemvura nethermometer kana mukati mechiyero chako kuti yakadziya pa 30-38°C, kwete inopisa, uye sanganisa munyu neyeast zvakasiyana kuti zvirege kubatana zvakananga.

c-309.title: Kuunganidza mishonga yechikosoro kunogona kuwedzera acetaminophen kaviri
c-309.summary: Kutora mushonga wechikosoro wakasanganiswa, mushonga wekurwisa kurwadza neTylenol zvakasiyana kunogona kudzokororwa acetaminophen uye kupfuura huwandu hwepazuva. Wedzera huwandu hweacetaminophen (paracetamol) pamalabel ose.
c-309.principle: Acetaminophen inowanzoshandurwa muchiropa, asi pakudarika huwandu chetsvo chine chepfu NAPQI chinounganidzwa, chichipedza glutathione uye chichikuvadza maseru echiropa. Wedzera huwandu hwepazuva $D_{\mathrm{total}}=\sum D_i$ uye uchengete pa 4g kana pasi kuvakuru (kazhinji inorudzirwa 3g kana pasi).
c-309.example: Matablets mana eTylenol e 500mg (2g) pamwe nemasachet matatu emushonga wechikosoro wakasanganiswa une 325mg imwe neimwe (anenge 1g) anotosvika 3g pazuva. Unofanira kuverenga kuti rimwe Tylenol rirege kukupfuudza 4g.
c-309.actionItem: Kana uchitora mushonga wechikosoro nhasi, tarisa label yechigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe kuti uone acetaminophen, nyora huwandu hwepazuva, uye utsamire mukati megumi. Kana usina chokwadi, bvunza mushonga wekuchipatara.

c-310.title: Shampoo ne conditioner bars dzakasimba dzinodzivisa muganhu wemvura paunofamba
c-310.summary: Shampoo ne conditioner bars dzakasimba hadzisi mvura kana gel, saka dzinodzivisa muganhu we 100mL wekabini uye dzinorerutsa bhegi rako rekufamba. Ndege nenyika dzakawanda hadzitore sabhoza dzakasimba semvura.
c-310.principle: Dzinogadzirwa nekusimbisa surfactants (senge sodium cocoyl isethionate) pasina mvura, saka hadzina mvura chaiyo. Mutemo wemvura unotadzisa vhoriyamu ku $V\le100\,\mathrm{mL}$, saka zvakasimba hazvisanganisirwe, kunyange sarudzo yekupedzisira iri kumuchengeti.
c-310.example: Shampoo yemvura ye 250mL haigone kupinda mukabini nekuda kwehukuru hwe container, nepo bar imwe yeshampoo (anenge 50g) kazhinji inogara anenge 50-80 washes uye inorema anenge chikamu chechishanu chebhodhoro remvura. Izvi zvinokodzera rwendo rurefu.
c-310.actionItem: Kana uchifamba nhasi, pakiza shampoo ne conditioner bars dzakasimba mutini inoyerera, uye dzioneswe zvakaoma zvachose usati wapakiza panzvimbo yekuisa dzakanyorova. Mitemo inosiyana nendege nenyika, saka tarisa usati wabva.

c-311.title: Tarisa mafuta uye trans fat label pabhata nemargarine
c-311.summary: Bhata nemargarine zvinosiyana murudzi rwemafuta, saka enzanisa saturated ne trans fat panutrition label. Margarine haisi nani kana yakaipa pachayo, nokuti inosiyana nechigadzirwa.
c-311.principle: Kuwedzera hydrogen kumafuta asina saturated emiriwo kunoaomesa, uye mamwe double bonds anova trans isomers: $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{H_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ni}}\mathrm{C{-}C}$. Partial hydrogenation iyi inogona kugadzira trans fat.
c-311.example: Bhata rine anenge 80% yemafuta, akawanda saturated (anenge 50%), ane trans fat shoma yechisikigo. Mamargarine ekare akagadzirwa nepartially hydrogenated oil aive nemaresi akakwira etrans fat, asi zvigadzirwa zvazvino zvakawanda zviri pasi pe 0.5g pa serving uye kazhinji zvine saturated fat shoma.
c-311.actionItem: Kana uchitenga bhata kana margarine nhasi, enzanisa saturated ne trans fat pa serving panutrition label uye utarise kana zvinoshandiswa zvichinyora 'partially hydrogenated oil'.

c-312.title: Verenga zvinoita zvinhu zvemafuta additive usati wavimba nezvikwangwani
c-312.summary: Kune fuel additives, tarisa kuti chinhu chipi chinoita chii panzvimbo yekutarisa zvinotaurwa nezvikwangwani. Detergent-dispersants dzinochenesa deposits asi hadzivimbisi kuwedzera kukuru kwefuel economy.
c-312.principle: Detergent-dispersant surfactant molecules, dzine mativi maviri akasiyana, dzinopoteredza deposits (carbon) uye dzinodzipararira mumafuta. Fuel economy inoyerwa se $\eta=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{fuel}}$, uye mu injini yakachena kuwedzera kuri kudiki zvikuru.
c-312.example: Zvigadzirwa zvakawanda zvinoda ma mL mashoma pa litre, asi kuwedzera kwefuel economy kunenge 1-2% pafunge uye kazhinji kwakaganhurirwa. Kumotokari ye 12km/L, 2% inopa 12.24km/L, uye bhodhoro readditive re 5,000 KRW (anenge USD 3.50) rinogona kusadzoserwa mukuchengetedza mafuta.
c-312.actionItem: Kana uchironga kutenga fuel additive nhasi, tarisa tsananguro yezvinoshandiswa (detergent-dispersant, cetane improver nezvimwe) nemarudzi emafuta nemotokari, uye utarise kana zvikwangwani zvekuwedzera economy zvine mamiriro.

c-313.title: Dyisa shangu dzeganda nekirimu panzvimbo yekungodzipukuta
c-313.summary: Shangu dzeganda dzinoda kirimu kuzadza mafuta, kwete kupenya chete, kuti dzirege kuoma nekutsemuka. Dzinogara kwenguva refu, zvichichengetedza mari yeshangu itsva.
c-313.principle: Lipids dzinozadza nzvimbo dziri pakati pema collagen fibers uye dzinochengeta ganda ripfava. Kana ma lipids aya achibuda mumhepo kana kutetswa, fibers dzinokweshana uye ganda rinooma nekutsemuka. Kirimu inozadzazve nzvimbo idzi nemafuta nema wax.
c-313.example: Kana peya yeshangu dzeganda inodhura anenge 150,000 KRW (anenge USD 105), kuzvichengeta nekirimu kamwe pamwedzi kunogona kuwedzera hupenyu hwadzo kubva pamakore 2-3 kusvika 5 kana kupfuura. Pagore, izvozvo zvinenge zvichideredza mari yeshangu nehafu. Tini rimwe rekirimu yeshangu (anenge 5,000 KRW, anenge USD 3.50) rinokwana mapeya makumi.
c-313.actionItem: Nhasi, pukuta guruva rinobva pashangu dzako dzeganda nejira rakaoma, shandisa layer yakatetepa yekirimu yeshangu, uye mushure memaminitsi 5 pukuta nebrush kana jira rakapfava.

c-314.title: Miriwo yakasvibira inoita yero kana wawedzera vhiniga
c-314.summary: Kana uchiita blanching miriwo yakasvibira senge spinach kana broccoli, kuwedzera acid senge vhiniga kana muto weremoni kunoshandura girinhi yakajeka kuita olive isina kujeka. Wedzera acid pakupedzisira kana pasati padya.
c-314.principle: $\mathrm{H^+}$ kubva kuacid inotsiva $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ yepakati yechlorophyll, ichiumba pheophytin: $\text{chlorophyll}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\to\text{pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$. Pheophytin i yero-brown, saka ruvara runoita rusina kujeka.
c-314.example: Kuvira 100g yespinach mumvura ine spoon (15mL) yevhiniga kunodzikisa pH kubva pa anenge 7 kusvika pa anenge 4, uye ruvara runotanga kushanduka mukati memaminitsi 5. Mukupesana, kuita blanching kwenguva pfupi mumvura inovira ine munyu mushoma kunochengeta girinhi kwenguva refu.
c-314.actionItem: Kana uchiita blanching miriwo yakasvibira nhasi, ita blanching usina kuvhara mumvura inovira kwemaminitsi 1-2 chete, geza nemvura inotonhora, uye dururira vhiniga kana muto weremoni pasati padya.

c-315.title: Shandisa retinol usiku uye pfeka sunscreen masikati
c-315.summary: Retinol inoparara muchiedza uye inogona kuita kuti ganda rinzwe zuva zvakanyanya, saka shandisa usiku uye gara uchipfeka sunscreen masikati. Kana uine nhumbu kana chirwere cheganda, taura nemunhu ane unyanzvi kutanga.
c-315.principle: Retinol inoora pasi peUV: $\text{retinol}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{degradation products}$. Uyewo, stratum corneum inotetepa uye ganda idzva rinouya, saka huwandu hwakaenzana hweUV hunogona kukonzera kutsvuka nyore.
c-315.example: Zvakajairika kutanga nesimba rakaderera reretinol (0.1-0.3%) kaviri kana katatu pasvondo uye kushandisa sunscreen ye SPF 30 kana kupfuura masikati pa anenge 2mg/cm². SPF 30 inovhara anenge 97% yeUVB.
c-315.actionItem: Manheru ano, shandisa retinol mushure mekugeza chiso, uye mangwana mangwanani isa sunscreen ye SPF 30 kana kupfuura. Kana kurwadza kana kutsvuka kuri kwakasimba, deredza uye bvunza chiremba.

c-316.title: Chikonzero nei retort instant rice inogara patembiricha yemukamuri
c-316.summary: Instant rice inogara patembiricha yemukamuri nokuti yakavharwa wobva waiswa sterilization pakupisa nepressure zvakakwirira, ichiuraya zvipenyu zvidiki zvinenge zvose. Inogona kuchengetwa isina firiji kusvikira yavhurwa, ichiita chikafu chakanaka chekukurumidzira rwendo.
c-316.principle: Retort sterilization inoshandisa pressure pa anenge 120°C kuuraya kunyange spores dzemabhakitiriya dzinotsungirira kupisa. Nguva yesterilization inoverengwa kubva pa $F=D_T\,\log\frac{N_0}{N}$, uye chivharo chisina oksijeni chinodzivirira mabhakitiriya anoda mweya kukura.
c-316.example: Pakiti imwe yeinstant rice (210g) inoitwa sterilization pa anenge 120°C kwemaminitsi anenge 20-30 uye kazhinji inogara mwedzi 6-12 patembiricha yemukamuri. Inogona kugara isina firiji isati yavhurwa, asi mushure mekuvhurwa inofanira kudyiwa pakarepo kana kuiswa mufiriji.
c-316.actionItem: Kana uchipakira mabhegi ekufamba nhasi, isa instant rice sechikafu chekukurumidzira, uye ukande pakiti ipi neipi ine chivharo chakazvimba kana kuyerera. Pisa mumicrowave sezvakaratidzwa pacontainer.

c-317.title: Zvinotsiva shuga senge allulose ne erythritol zvega zvinosiyana mukunaka nehunhu
c-317.summary: Zvinotsiva zvakaita seallulose, erythritol ne xylitol zvinosiyana mukunaka, macalories nemhedzisiro yekugaya, saka sarudza maererano nekushandisa. Zvakawandisa zvinogona kukonzera kurwadza dumbu, saka tanga zvishoma.
c-317.principle: Sugar alcohols nema rare sugars zvinosiyana mukuumbwa kwemolecule, saka kutorwa nemacalories zvinosiyana. Erythritol ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O_4}$), semuenzaniso, inowanzotorwa uye inobudiswa mumvura yemuviri, ichipa macalories anenge zero, uye inotora kupisa pakunyunguduka ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{sol}}>0$), ichigadzira kunzwa kutonhora.
c-317.example: Shuga ine anenge 4kcal pagramu, nepo erythritol ine anenge 0-0.2kcal/g uye allulose anenge 0.4kcal/g. Neshuga ichiva 1, kunaka kwakafanana ku 0.7 kune erythritol neallulose. Huwandu hunofanira kugadziriswa kana uchitsiva shuga.
c-317.actionItem: Kana uchitenga chinotsiva shuga nhasi, tarisa rudzi (allulose, erythritol nezvimwe) nemacalories pa serving palabel, uye utange nenge 10g pazuva kuti uone kuti muviri wako unoita sei.

c-318.title: Mvura nhema mumapombi eheating isludge yesimbi yakaita oxidized
c-318.summary: Kana mvura inobuda mumapombi eheating iri nhema, inogona kunge i sludge (magnetite) yesimbi yakaita oxidized, uye sezvainounganidza, kuendesa kupisa kunoipa. Funga flush kubva kumunyori wema boiler nekutarisa corrosion inhibitor.
c-318.principle: Mumvura inopisa isina oksijeni chaiyo, simbi inoita oxidized zvishoma nezvishoma: $3\,\mathrm{Fe}+4\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}+4\,\mathrm{H_2}$. Magnetite ($\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$) inoumbwa i hupfu hutema hunounganidza uye hunowedzera thermal resistance.
c-318.example: Layer ye 1mm yesludge mumapombi nemaradiator inogona kudzikisa kuendesa kupisa ne mashoma muzana, ichiita kuti boiler ishande nguva refu uye ichikwidziridza mari yemafuta ne anenge 5-10%. Flush kazhinji inodhura mazana mashoma ezviuru zveKRW (mazana mashoma eUSD), asi kuchengetedza nehupenyu hurefu hwemidziyo zvinogona kuidzosera.
c-318.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti mapombi ako eheating akaitwa flush rinhi, uye kana yapfuura makore akawanda, kumbira munyori wema boiler kuti atarise. Usaparadza mapombi kana kubata mvura yakabudiswa iwe pachako.

c-319.title: Freezer burn inzvimbo apo hunyoro hwabuda pamusoro pakaratidzwa kumhepo
c-319.summary: Mapaki machena, akaoma panyama kana miriwo yakachengetwa kwenguva refu mufiriza ndiyo freezer burn. Hairwadzi kudya asi inoomarara uye inorasikirwa nekuravira, uye kudzvanya mweya kubuda nekuvhara kunoidzivirira.
c-319.principle: Mufiriza, chando chepamusoro chinoita sublimate chichienda kumhute chisingapfuuri mumvura, saka hunyoro hunobuda: $\mathrm{H_2O(s)}\to\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$. Pamusoro pakaomeswa pakasangana nemweya, saka mafuta anoita oxidize uye anopa kuravira kwakashata.
c-319.example: Nyama isina kuputirwa mufiriza ye -18°C inorasikirwa nehunyoro hwepamusoro hwemashoma muzana mukati mevhiki uye inooma chena. Kudzvanya mweya kubuda nevacuum kana zip bags kunochengetedza mhando kwemwedzi 3-6 kana kupfuura uye kunodzikisa chikafu chinokandwa (zviuru zvishoma zveKRW pamwedzi kana kupfuura).
c-319.actionItem: Nhasi, pakiza nyama nemiriwo yefiriza mumagoverano mamwe chete mu zip bags, dzvanya mweya wakawanda sezvaunogona, vhara uye nyora zuva. Kuzvikamu zvatova ne freezer burn, zvicheke kana kuzvishandisa musoup nemastews.

c-320.title: Nyungudutsa hupfu hwecurry nesosi mumvura inotonhora kutanga kudzivirira zvimbundu
c-320.summary: Kuwedzera hupfu hwecurry kana sosi zvakananga mumvura inopisa kunobika kunze kwayo chete uye kunoumba zvimbundu. Hunyungudutsei kutanga mumvura inotonhora kana inodziya, kana dzima moto uye usanganise zvishoma nezvishoma.
c-320.principle: Kana starch granules dzichisangana nemvura inopisa, pamusoro pazvo pane gelatinization kutanga kuita firimu regel rinonamira rinodzivirira mvura kuti irege kusvika kuhupfu huri mukati. Gelatinization inotanga pa anenge 60-70°C uye inoitika kutanga pamusoro apo $T>T_{\mathrm{gel}}$.
c-320.example: Kudurura 100g yehupfu hwecurry mumuto we 90°C kunoumba zvimbundu zvemamilimita akati wandei apo pamusoro pachiita gelatinize, asi kuhunyungudutsa kutanga mu 200mL yemvura ye 20-30°C kunoparadzira zvikamu zvakaenzana pasina zvimbundu.
c-320.actionItem: Kana uchibika curry kana sosi nhasi, nyungudutsa hupfu mumvura inotonhora kutanga uye usefa, kana dzima moto uye uwedzere zvishoma nezvishoma uchimutsa, wobva wadzorera kuvira zvinyoro.

c-321.title: AHA ne BHA exfoliants zvinoenderana ne pH nekusimba
c-321.summary: Chinokonzera mhedzisiro nekutsamwa zvose ndiyo pH yechigadzirwa nekusimba kweacid, kwete zita rechinhu chega. Kunyange acid yakapfava inogona kurwadza kana pH iri yakaderera.
c-321.principle: Ma acid anoita ionize maererano ne $\mathrm{pH} = \mathrm{p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, uye free acid isina ionized ($\mathrm{HA}$) chete ndiyo inoshanda paganda. Kana pH ichiderera zvakanyanya pasi pe $\mathrm{p}K_a$, chikamu chefree acid chinokura.
c-321.example: Chigadzirwa che 10% glycolic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ inenge 3.83) i 50% free acid pa pH 3.83 asi anenge 87% pa pH 3.0, saka chinotsamwisa zvakawanda. Salicylic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ inenge 2.97) inowanzogadzirwa padyo ne pH 3-4.
c-321.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa exfoliant nhasi, tarisa rudzi rweacid, kusimba nepH, utange nekaviri pasvondo kana kushoma, uye shandisa sunscreen zuva rinotevera.

c-322.title: Durian yakarambidzwa mumahotera mazhinji nekuda kwemunhuwi wayo
c-322.summary: Durian yakarambidzwa mumahotera nepamotokari dzevose kwete nokuti ine chepfu, asi nokuti munhuwi wayo wakasimba kunyange pakuwanda kushoma.
c-322.principle: Ma esters ($\mathrm{RCOOH + R'OH \rightleftharpoons RCOOR' + H_2O}$) nemasulfur compounds (thiols, $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$) ane odor thresholds mu ppb range, saka huwandu hushoma hunogona kuonekwa.
c-322.example: 1ppb i chikamu chimwe pabhiriyoni nevhoriyamu, chakaenzana ne anenge 0.03mL yemhute mukamuri ye 30m³. Ndosaka munhuwi uchigara mukamuri yose nemufilter yeAC.
c-322.actionItem: Usati wafamba kuSoutheast Asia, tarisa mutemo wedurian wenzvimbo yako yekugara, uye idya durian padhuka kana kunze.

c-323.title: Zvinoshandiswa mu moisturizer zvinoita mabasa akasiyana: ceramides, glycerin, mafuta
c-323.summary: Moisturizer yakanaka inosanganisa chinhu chinoramba mvura, chinozadza mukaha, uye chinovharira kuvira.
c-323.principle: Humectants (glycerin) dzinokwezva mvura, emollients (ceramides) dzinozadza mukaha pakati pema skin cells, uye occlusives (petrolatum) dzinovharira kuvira. Kufamba kwemvura kunotevera $J = -D\frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}$.
c-323.example: Glycerin inowanzoshandiswa pa 5-10%, uye petrolatum inozivikanwa kudzikisa transepidermal water loss ne 90%. Chigadzirwa chine zvitatu zvose chinogara kwenguva refu mumhepo yechando yakaoma kupfuura chinochinhu chimwe.
c-323.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa rondedzero yezvinoshandiswa kuti uone glycerin, ceramides nemafuta kana petrolatum, uye shandisa mukati memaminitsi 3 mushure mekugeza.

c-324.title: Tarisa chimney yefireplace kana sitovhu yako nekuda kwecreosote gore rimwe nerimwe
c-324.summary: Tar inobva mumhute yematanda inoita condensation pamadziro echimney, uye kuunganidza kunogona kukonzera moto wechimney, saka tarisa gore rimwe nerimwe.
c-324.principle: Tar nemhute yesoot zvinobva pakupisa kusina kukwana zvinoita condensation pamadziro echimney anotonhora sa creosote. Kupisa kusina oksijeni, $\mathrm{C_xH_y + O_2 \to C + CO + H_2O}$, kunogadzira zvakawanda zvisina kupiswa.
c-324.example: NFPA 211 muUS inorudzira kuchenesa kana deposits dzasvika anenge 3mm (1/8 inch). Matanda anyoro ane hunyoro hwepamusoro pe 20% anodzikisa tembiricha yekupisa uye anokurumidza kuunganidza.
c-324.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti matanda ako akaomeswa kusvika pa 20% hunyoro kana pasi, uye ronga kuongororwa nekuchenesa kwechimney nemunyori.

c-325.title: Bhata rinotora munhuwi kana rakachengetwa padyo nezvikafu zvine munhuwi wakasimba
c-325.summary: Bhata ine anenge 80% yemafuta, anonyungudutsa uye anotora ma molecule emunhuwi kubva muzvikafu senge kimchi kana hove.
c-325.principle: Mafuta ari nonpolar, saka anonyungudutsa nonpolar volatile molecules dzinotakura munhuwi. Partition coefficient i $K = \frac{C_{\mathrm{fat}}}{C_{\mathrm{water}}}$, uye $\log K = 3$ zvinoreva kusimba kuri ka 1,000 pamafuta.
c-325.example: Chidimbu chebhata che 200g chine anenge 160g yemafuta. Kana chasiiwa chisina kuvharwa padyo nekimchi kwemazuva mashoma, chinotora munhuwi uye chinogona kukandwa.
c-325.actionItem: Nhasi, isa bhata rako mubhandi rayo mukati mecontainer yakavharwa uye uririchengete kure nezvikafu zvine munhuwi wakasimba.

c-326.title: Chikonzero nei magirazi achiita makore mudishwasher
c-326.summary: Kunge makore kunogona kuva firimu remamineral kana etching chaiyo yepamusoro pegirazi. Kunyika mu vhiniga kunoratidza kuti ndeipi.
c-326.principle: Mvura yakapfava nedetergent ine alkaline pakupisa kwakakwira zvinonyungudutsa silicate network yegirazi uye zvinoita etch pamusoro. $\mathrm{SiO_2 + 2OH^- \to SiO_3^{2-} + H_2O}$
c-326.example: Etching i yenguva dzose, asi firimu rehard-water lime rinonyangarika mushure memaminitsi 5 mu white vinegar. Kushandisa detergent shoma ne eco cycle yakatenderedza 55°C kunodzikisa etching.
c-326.actionItem: Nhasi, nyika girazi rine makore mu white vinegar kwemaminitsi 5 kuti uone kana ri firimu, uye shandisa huwandu hwedetergent hunorudzirwa chete.

c-327.title: Tsiva mascara mwedzi mitatu kusvika mitanhatu yega yega
c-327.summary: Mascara inoenda padyo nemaziso uye inopinza mweya nekushandiswa kwega kwega, saka mabhakitiriya anounganidza; tsiva mukati memwedzi 3-6 yekuvhura.
c-327.principle: Mushure mekuvhura, preservative inopera zvishoma nezvishoma uye mabhakitiriya anokura se $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$. Kenguva yega yega wand inopinda ichibuda inosundira mweya mukati, ichikonzera kuoma nekusvibiswa.
c-327.example: Mumamiriro akakwana ane nguva yekuwedzera kaviri ye 20 minitsi, sero rimwe rinova $2^{18}$, anenge 262,000, mumaawa 6. Kana uine maziso anotsvedza kana akatsvuka, ofunga mascara yekare kutanga.
c-327.actionItem: Nhasi, nyora zuva rekuvhura patube yemascara yako, uye uitsive neitsva kana yapfuura mwedzi 3.

c-328.title: Raisi rekune dzimwe nyika rinoravira zvakasiyana nekuda kwe amylose content yaro
c-328.summary: Raisi rekune dzimwe nyika rinogona kubuda rakapfava uye rakaparadzana kana rinonamira nokuti reshiyo ye amylose kune amylopectin inosiyana.
c-328.principle: Amylose yakawanda (linear) inochengeta mbeu dzakaparadzana uye dzakasimba, nepo amylopectin yakawanda (branched) ichiita raisi rinonamira. $\text{amylose \%} = \frac{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}}{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}+m_{\mathrm{amylopectin}}}\times 100$
c-328.example: Raisi remhando yepfupi yeKorea neJapan rine anenge 17-20% amylose, long-grain indica anenge 22-28%, uye glutinous rice anenge 0%. Long-grain rice kazhinji inoda mvura ka 1.5-2 yevhoriyamu yayo.
c-328.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti pakiti yeraisi rako inoti short, medium kana long grain, uye ribike nereshiyo yemvura yakanyorwa papakiti.

c-329.title: Tarisa mouthwash kuti isina alcohol uye ine CPC
c-329.summary: Sarudza mouthwash neantibacterial ingredient yayo (CPC) uye kana ine alcohol, inogona kuomesa muromo wako.
c-329.principle: CPC (cetylpyridinium chloride) i cationic surfactant inonamira pamembranes emabhakitiriya ane negative charge uye ichiaparadza. Kukwezva kunotevera $F = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$.
c-329.example: Zvigadzirwa zveCPC kazhinji zviri 0.05-0.07%, saka kutuhwina kumwe kwe 20mL kune anenge 10-14mg. Zvimwe zvigadzirwa zvine 20% ethanol kana kupfuura, saka vanhu vanowanzoomerwa nemuromo vanogona kuda alcohol-free.
c-329.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa label yeCPC neethanol, wobva watuhwina kwemasekonzi 30 uye utuhure panzvimbo yekumedza.

c-330.title: Munhuwi wecaulk yepahwindo i acetic acid inoburitswa panguva yekuomarara
c-330.summary: Munhuwi wevhiniga wecaulk i acetic acid inoburitswa apo silicone inoomarara, uye unodzikira kana kuomarara kwapera.
c-330.principle: Acetoxy silicone inopindura nehunyoro huri mumhepo, ichiburitsa acetic acid sezvainobatana. $\mathrm{R{-}Si(OCOCH_3)_3 + 3H_2O \to R{-}Si(OH)_3 + 3CH_3COOH}$
c-330.example: Pamusoro pane ganda mukati memaminitsi anenge 10-30, uye bead ye 3mm inotora anenge maawa 24 kuomarara zvizere. Acetic acid inogona kuora simbi nemarble, saka shandisa neutral-cure silicone ipapo.
c-330.actionItem: Kana uchiisa caulk nhasi, chengeta hwindo rakavhurika kuti mweya upinde kwemaawa 24, uye sarudza neutral-cure silicone kumusimbi kana matombo.

c-331.title: Mafuta eolive anoita makore uye akasimba mufiriji haana kuora
c-331.summary: Mafuta eolive anoita makore uye akasimba mufiriji haana kuora; mafuta awo akaita crystallize, uye anojeka zvakare patembiricha yemukamuri.
c-331.principle: Kunyange fatty acids dzisina saturation dzinoita crystallize pasi pe melting point yadzo. Melting temperature inotevera $T_m = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}$, uye mafuta eolive anotanga kuita makore pasi pe anenge 5-10°C.
c-331.example: Pa 4°C mufiriji anoita makore, asi maminitsi 30-60 pa 20-25°C anoajekesa. Pa oxidation, nzvimbo yerima, yakatonhora yetembiricha yemukamuri iri nani kupfuura firiji.
c-331.actionItem: Nhasi, rega mafuta eolive ane makore agare patembiricha yemukamuri kwemaminitsi 30 panzvimbo yekuapisa mumicrowave, uye uachengete mukabati rerima kubva zvino.

c-332.title: Gadzira caramel nekunyungudutsa shuga usingamutsi
c-332.summary: Haumutsi paunogadzira caramel kudzivirira makristaro eshuga kuti arege kuumbwa zvakare nechain reaction.
c-332.principle: Crystal imwe yeshuga yakapambadzika inogona kutanga crystallization yesyrup yose. Pamusoro pe 160°C, hydrolysis ne dehydration zvinokonzera browning. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \to C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-332.example: Kuvira 200g yeshuga ne 50mL yemvura kunosvika pagolden caramel pa anenge 170-180°C mushure memaminitsi 5-10. Caramel patembiricha iyoyo inogona kukonzera kupiswa kwakakomba kana ikapopota.
c-332.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira caramel nhasi, tenderedza pani panzvimbo yekumutsa uye geza makristaro kubva pamadziro eakapoto nebrush yakanyorova.

c-333.title: Ganda rakatsvuka pasi pezvishongo zvesimbi rinogona kunge i nickel allergy
c-333.summary: Kana ganda richitsvuka uye richiita kuyera pasi pamaaring kana buckle yewachi, nickel iri musimbi inogona kunge ndiyo chikonzero. Chiremba weganda anogona kuzvisimbisa.
c-333.principle: Nickel iri musimbi inoitwa oxidized nekubuda ziya uye inonyunguduka seions. $\mathrm{Ni \to Ni^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Ma ions aya anogona kusunga mapuroteni eganda uye kukonzera contact dermatitis.
c-333.example: EU inoganhurira kuburitswa kwenickel kubva kuzvinhu zvinogara zvakabata ganda kwenguva refu ku $0.5\ \mu\mathrm{g/cm^2}$ pasvondo. Anenge munhu mumwe pavanhu gumi anonzi ane nickel sensitivity.
c-333.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa label yenickel-free pazvishongo zvinoramba zvichiita kuyera, uye ona chiremba weganda kana zviratidzo zvichienderera.

c-334.title: Kupisa kwewasabi kunongoonekwa kana yakakuyiwa uye kunokurumidza kudzikira
c-334.summary: Kupisa kwewasabi chaiyo kunogadzirwa kana maseru ayo akapwanywa nekukuya, uye kunobuda mumhute, saka kunokurumidza kudzikira.
c-334.principle: Kana maseru achiputsika, enzyme myrosinase inoparadzanisa glycoside sinigrin kuita allyl isothiocyanate inopisa. $\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}KNO_9S_2 + H_2O \to C_4H_5NS + C_6H_{12}O_6 + KHSO_4}$
c-334.example: Kupisa kwakasimba mukati memaminitsi ekukuya uye kunodzika zvakanyanya mumaminitsi 15-30. Zvigadzirwa zvakawanda zvewasabi yetube kazhinji i horseradish.
c-334.actionItem: Kana uchishandisa wasabi itsva nhasi, ikuye pakarepo usati wadya uye uchengete yakavharwa, uye utarise zvinoshandiswa pazvigadzirwa zvetube.

c-335.title: Furo rakawanda resipo yekusuka mundiro hariratidzi kuchenesa kwakanaka
c-335.summary: Furo rakawanda nekubvisa mafuta zvakanaka zvinhu zviri zviviri zvakasiyana; furo rinogona kubva ku stabilizers.
c-335.principle: Surfactants dzinoumba micelles pamusoro pe critical micelle concentration (CMC) uye dzinopoteredza mafuta. Surface tension inodzika kusvikira CMC uye inoramba yakaenzana mushure.
c-335.example: CMC ye SDS i anenge 8.2 mM, kureva anenge 2.4g pa litre. Kuwedzera sipo yakawanda kupfuura iyoyo hakuwedzeri kuchenesa zvakanyanya uye kunongoita kuti kuzvisukurudza kuome.
c-335.actionItem: Nhasi, shandisa sipo yemundiro yakaenzana nembeu yepea chete, uye ucharidze kana mafuta abuda, kwete nehuwandu hwefuro.

c-336.title: Zvipfeko zvemukati zvinogadzira kupisa zvinodziya nekutora mhute yeziya
c-336.summary: Zvipfeko zvemukati zvinogadzira kupisa zvinonzwika zvichidziya nokuti mhute yemvura inobva mumuviri wako inoburitsa kupisa kana ichinamira pafibers; mhedzisiro i diki uye pfupi.
c-336.principle: Kana mhute yemvura ichinamira pafibers, kupisa kunoburitswa semucondensation. $Q = m\,L$, uye condensation heat yemvura $L$ i anenge $2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
c-336.example: Kutora 10g yehunyoro kunoburitsa kusvika anenge 23kJ, asi kunomira fibers dzichinge dzazara. Kana uchiwana ziya zvakanyanya uye jira rakanyorova, rinodhonza kupisa uye unonzwa kutonhora.
c-336.actionItem: Nhasi, pfeka layer yakatetepa pamusoro pezvipfeko zvemukati zvinodziya, uye bvisa layer kana wotanga kubuda ziya kuti jira rirambe rakaoma.

c-337.title: Bvisa malabel nezvivharo pamabhodhoro ePET kuti ashandiswezve
c-337.summary: Mabhodhoro ePET anova zvinhu zvakanaka zvekushandiswazve chete kana ukabvisa label ukageza, kuti arege kusanganiswa nemamwe plastics.
c-337.principle: Recycling inoparadzanisa PET inonyura ne PP ne PE zvinoyangarara nedensity, $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$, wobva wanyungudutsa. PET inonyunguduka padyo ne 250°C, PP padyo ne 165°C uye PE pa anenge 110-130°C.
c-337.example: PET ine density ye anenge 1.38g/cm³ nepo PP ne PE zviri anenge 0.9g/cm³, saka zvinoparadzana mumvura. Kana chivharo che 2g chikasanganiswa nebhodhoro re 20g, zvinosvibisa zvinosvika anenge 10%.
c-337.actionItem: Nhasi, dururira uye geza bhodhoro rako rePET, bvisa label, uye uriise mubhini rekuunganidza clear-PET.

c-338.title: Meringue haizvimbi kunyange nedonhwe ramafuta
c-338.summary: Chikonzero chakajairika kwazvo chekuti meringue irege kukwira i mafuta mashoma pabhaudhi kana mumazai echena.
c-338.principle: Mapuroteni echena chezai anozaruka pamuganhu wemweya-mvura uye anoumba firimu rinobata mabubble. Mafuta anotora nzvimbo iyoyo kutanga uye anovharira kuumbwa kwefirimu. Musiyano wepressure pafirimu remububble i $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$.
c-338.example: Machena ezai matatu (anenge 100g) anenge 90% emvura uye 10% mapuroteni, nepo yolk iine anenge 30% yemafuta, saka kunyange dhonhwe rimwe rinodzikisa vhoriyamu zvakanyanya. Mabhaudhi eplastic anowanzochengeta mafuta mashoma.
c-338.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira meringue nhasi, pukuta bhaudhi regirazi kana resimbi nevhiniga kana muto weremoni uye ugovanise chena chimwe nechimwe mubhaudhi duku kutanga.

c-339.title: Ita patch test mazuva maviri usati wavhara bvudzi rinoita grey
c-339.summary: Allergy yeudzi dye inogona kuoneka kamwe kamwe, saka patch-test kuseri kwenzeve kana mukati meruoko maawa 48 usati watenda.
c-339.principle: Oxidative dyes senge para-phenylenediamine (PPD) dzinoumba reactive intermediates nehydrogen peroxide dzinosunga mapuroteni eganda uye dzinogona kukonzera allergy. $\mathrm{C_6H_4(NH_2)_2 \xrightarrow{H_2O_2} \text{reactive intermediates}}$
c-339.example: EU inoganhurira PPD pamusoro pemusoro ku 2% mushure mekusanganisa. Shandisa shoma isingapfuure sikipa uye utarise maawa 48; kana pane kutsvuka, kuyera kana kuzvimba, usatenda.
c-339.actionItem: Kana uchironga kutenda munguva pfupi, ita patch test mazuva maviri pamberi nemari shoma kuseri kwenzeve, uye usatenda kana pane mhedzisiro ipi neipi, uchitsvaga rubatsiro kana yakakomba.

c-340.title: Proof pabhodhoro rekune dzimwe nyika ndiko kaviri kweABV
c-340.summary: Pamabhodhoro eUS, proof i kaviri kwe alcohol by volume (ABV), saka 80 proof inoreva 40%.
c-340.principle: Sisitimu yeUS i $\text{proof} = 2 \times \text{ABV}$. Proof yekare yeBritain yaishandisa basis yakasiyana, apo 100 proof yaive anenge 57.15%, saka tarisa nenyika.
c-340.example: Kudurura kwe 45mL (1.5 oz) kwe whiskey ye 80 proof kune $45 \times 0.40 = 18\ \mathrm{mL}$ ethanol, anenge 14.2g, iyo i standard drink yeUS imwe. Kudurura kumwe chete pa 100 proof (50%) kune anenge 17.8g.
c-340.actionItem: Nhasi, kakamura proof yebhodhoro ripi neripi rekune dzimwe nyika ne 2 kuti uwane ABV, uye uchengete nhamba yaunonwa.

c-341.title: Water filters: activated carbon ne reverse osmosis zvinobvisa zvinhu zvakasiyana
c-341.summary: Activated carbon inobvisa organics senge chlorine nemunhuwi, nepo reverse osmosis ichibvisa dissolved ions. Sarudza zvaunoda kubvisa usati watenga.
c-341.principle: Carbon inonamira pamusoro, nepo reverse osmosis ichishandisa pressure pamusoro peosmotic pressure $\pi = iMRT$ kuti mvura chete ipfuure nemusemipermeable membrane.
c-341.example: Osmotic pressure ye 500mg/L NaCl (anenge 8.6 mmol/L) pa 25°C i anenge 0.42atm. Mayuniti eRO epamba kazhinji anoshandisa 3-4bar uye anobvisa ions dzakawanda.
c-341.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti water filter yako inofanira kutsiviwa rinhi, uye usimbise zvinotaurwa neofficial certification mark.

c-342.title: Mantles emwenje wekukambi anopenya nekuda kwe rare-earth oxides
c-342.summary: Chiedza chakajeka chemwenje wegasi hachisi murazvo asi rare-earth oxide mantle inopiswa nawo.
c-342.principle: Kana oxide mantle yapiswa kusvika pa anenge 2,000K, inoburitsa radiation zvakasimba kumawavelength anoonekwa. Peak wavelength inotevera $\lambda_{\max} T = 2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$.
c-342.example: Pa 2,000K, $\lambda_{\max}$ i anenge 1.45μm. Ma mantles eyttrium necerium anoburitsa chiedza chinoonekwa chakawanda kupfuura murazvo usina chinhu wemafuta akafanana. Ma mantles ekare aishandisa thorium oxide ine radioactivity.
c-342.actionItem: Nhasi, pisa mantle itsva kunze pakushandiswa kwayo kwekutanga, usabata madota, uye tsvaga label isina thorium.

c-343.title: Makapu epepa haashandiswizve sepepa rakajairika nekuda kwe polyethylene lining
c-343.summary: Makapu epepa ane firimu replastic rekudzivirira mvura, saka kuaisa mubhini repepa rakajairika kunoita kuti recycling ive yakaoma.
c-343.principle: Polyethylene (PE) iri mukati mekapu yepepa haizonyungudutsa mumvura uye inoyangarara pa $\rho \approx 0.92\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$, saka zvakaoma kuiparadzanisa nefiber panguva yepulping.
c-343.example: Kapu rimwe repepa rinorema anenge 10g uye PE coating i anenge 5% yeizvozvo. Pasina maitiro akasarudzika, coating iyoyo inogona kuparadza mhando yebatch yose yepepa.
c-343.actionItem: Nhasi, uya netumbler yako, uye kana ukashandisa kapu repepa, tarisa mutemo wekusarudza wenzvimbo yako uye uriunganidze zvakasiyana.

c-344.title: Kirimu inokwira yakasimba kana yakatonhora chete
c-344.summary: Kirimu inowhipwa kuita stiff peaks kana yakatonhora zvikuru chete; kirimu yakadziya haikwire kunyange ukamutsa kwenguva yakareba sei.
c-344.principle: Kana yakatonhora, mafuta ari mukati mema globules akaita crystallize, saka kuwhipa kunoita kuti ma globules abatane zvishoma kuita network inobata mabubble emweya. Mafuta akanyunguduka haagoni kuumba network iyoyo.
c-344.example: Kuwhipa 200mL yekirimu ine 35% kana kupfuura yemafuta pa 4°C kunowedzera vhoriyamu nenge kaviri mumaminitsi 3-5. Pamusoro pe 20°C haikwire, uye kuwhipa zvakanyanya kunoiparadzanisa kuita bhata ne buttermilk.
c-344.actionItem: Nhasi, tonhodza kirimu nebhaudhi kwemaminitsi 10+ usati wawhipa, uye mira pakarepo stiff peaks dzabuda.

c-345.title: Usachengete peroxide yewhitening toothpaste mumuromo kwenguva refu
c-345.summary: Peroxide iri mutoothpaste kana strips dzekuchenesa mazino inogona kutsamwisa mazino emuromo, saka ishandise nguva yakataurwa chete.
c-345.principle: Hydrogen peroxide inoita oxidize ichiputsa ma molecule emadzimbahwe ichiburitsa oksijeni. $2\mathrm{H_2O_2} \to 2\mathrm{H_2O} + \mathrm{O_2}$ Reactivity iyoyo inogona kutsamwisa mucous membranes.
c-345.example: EU inoganhurira hydrogen peroxide mutoothpaste yakajairika ku 0.1% uye inoda kutariswa nechiremba wemazino kune zvigadzirwa zvekuchenesa ze 0.1-6%. Kuichengeta kwenguva refu kupfuura zvakataurwa kunowedzera kutsamwa kwemazino nekunzwa.
c-345.actionItem: Nhasi, shandisa chigadzirwa chipi nechipi chekuchenesa nguva iri palabel chete, uye mira uye bvunza chiremba wemazino kana mazino ako achirwadza.

c-346.title: Usanwe chando chakanyungudutswa chisina kurapwa
c-346.summary: Chando chinoratidzika chakachena asi chinounganidza zvinosvibisa nemamicrobes zvemumhepo, saka chando chakanyungudutswa chinofanira kuvirwa usati wanwa.
c-346.principle: Makristaro echando anobata guruva nezvidimbu zvidiki sezvaanoumbwa uye achidzika. Kuvira kunouraya mamicrobes asi hakubvisi simbi dzinorema kana makemikari. Huwandu hwemvura hunoenderana nedensity yechando, $V_{\mathrm{water}} \approx \frac{V_{\mathrm{snow}}}{10}$.
c-346.example: Kunyungudutsa 10L yechando chitsva kunopa anenge 1L yemvura, uye mutemo wakajairika ndewekuvira kwemaminitsi 1 kana kupfuura (maminitsi 3 pamusoro pe 2,000m). Dzivisa chando chiri padyo nemigwagwa kana chakashanduka ruvara.
