c-346.actionItem: Nhasi, panguva yekukurumidzira, unganidza chete chando chitsva chakachena, tanga nemvura shoma mupoto, nyungudutsa uye uvire, uye kana zvisina, tora mvura yemabhodhoro.

c-347.title: Mukaka usina lactose i mukaka une lactose yakaparadzaniswa pakutanga
c-347.summary: Mukaka usina lactose une lactose yakagayiwa pakutanga, saka unokodzera lactose intolerance, asi mapuroteni emukaka anosara, saka haakodzeri milk allergy.
c-347.principle: Enzyme lactase inoita hydrolysis ye lactose kuita glucose ne galactose. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{lactase}} C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-347.example: Mukaka wakajairika une anenge 4.7-5g yelactose pa 100mL, saka 200mL ine anenge 9.5g. Standard yeEU yelactose-free i 0.01g pa 100g kana pasi, uye shuga dzakaburitswa dzinoita kuti uravire kuvira zvishoma.
c-347.actionItem: Nhasi, kana lactose ichikonzera kurwadza dumbu rako, sarudza chigadzirwa chisina lactose, asi dzivisa mukaka wakajairika neusina lactose kana uine milk allergy.

c-348.title: Batidza hood kana uchibika pasitovhu yegasi nokuti inoburitsa nitrogen dioxide
c-348.summary: Murazvo wegasi unogadzira nitrogen dioxide inogona kuderedza mhando yemweya mukicheni diki, saka shandisa hood paunenge uchibika.
c-348.principle: Mumurazvo unopisa, nitrojeni neoksijeni zvinobva mumweya zvinopindura ($\mathrm{N_2 + O_2 \to 2NO}$) wobva waita oxidize zvakare. $2\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{NO_2}$
c-348.example: Kuyerwa mumakicheni madiki asina mweya kwakataura nitrogen dioxide pamusoro pe WHO 1-hour guideline ye $200\ \mu\mathrm{g/m^3}$. Hood inobudisa kunze inodzikisa zvakanyanya.
c-348.actionItem: Nhasi, batidza hood usati watanga kubika uye uichengete ichishanda anenge maminitsi 10 mushure mekudzima murazvo.

c-349.title: Mafuta ekubika akasara anogona kuitwa sipo yekushambidza
c-349.summary: Panzvimbo yekudurura mafuta ekubika akasara mudhirenji, unogona kuaunganidza uye uaite kuti apindure ne lye kugadzira sipo.
c-349.principle: Saponification inoshandura triglycerides ne NaOH kuita sipo ne glycerol. $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-349.example: Mafuta esoybean anoda anenge 0.135g yeNaOH pagramu yemafuta, saka 500g yemafuta inoda anenge 68g. Lye inopisa zvakasimba, saka magogles nemagirovhosi zvinokosha, uye sipo inoomarara anenge vhiki 4.
c-349.actionItem: Nhasi, sefa mafuta akasara nefilter yekofi uaise mubhodhoro rakavharwa, uye usambodurura mudhirenji.

c-350.title: Dhonhwe rimwe remvura rinoita kuti chocolate yakanyungudutswa iomarare
c-350.summary: Mvura shoma muchocolate yakanyungudutswa inogona kuishandura kamwe kamwe kubva pakuva yakapfava kuita chimbundu chakaomarara chine ngura.
c-350.principle: Particles dzeshuga nedzecocoa dzinotora mvura uye dzinoumba mafirimu esyrup anonamira anobatanidza particles, achikwidziridza viscosity zvakanyanya. Izvi zvinonzi seizing.
c-350.example: Mvura shoma yemagiramu, anenge 1-2% ye 200g yechocolate, yakakwana kuiita seize. Kuwedzera mvura yakawanda, kusvika anenge 20% kana kupfuura, kunogona kuiita yakapfava zvakare seganache yakatetepa.
c-350.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchinyungudutsa chocolate, omesa bhaudhi nespatula uye dzivisa mhute nemvura kubva padouble boiler kuti zvirege kupinda mubhaudhi.

c-351.title: Geza zvidimbu zvekucheka pakarepo mushure mekushandisa uye uzvichengete zvakaoma zvizere
c-351.summary: Mabhakitiriya anoda hunyoro kuti awande, saka kugeza bhodhi rako rekucheka pakarepo nekuriomesa zvizere ndiko kukosha.
c-351.principle: Water activity, inoratidza kuwanikwa kwemvura, i $a_w = \frac{p}{p_0}$, uye mabhakitiriya anokonzera chirwere akawanda anokura nekukasira pa $a_w$ yeanenge 0.9 kana kupfuura.
c-351.example: Pamusoro penyama mbishi pane $a_w$ yeanenge 0.99, inokodzera kukura kwemabhakitiriya. Kumisa bhodhi kuti riome nemhepo kunodzikisa hunyoro hwepamusoro uye kunoganhurira kukura.
c-351.actionItem: Nhasi, geza bhodhi rako nemvura inopisa nedetergent pakarepo mushure mekushandisa uye uriime kuti riome zvizere, uchichengeta mabhodhi enyama mbishi nemiriwo zvakasiyana.

c-352.title: Kuvira Glühwein yemusika weKisimusi kunobudisa munhuwi wayo
c-352.summary: Mulled wine inofanira kudziiswa kusvikira ichibuda mhute chete, kwete kuvirwa, kuitira kuti munhuwi nealcohol yakawanda zvirambe.
c-352.principle: Ethanol inovira pa anenge 78°C, yakaderera kupfuura mvura, saka inotanga kuvira kana yapiswa. Vapor pressure yesanganiswa inotevera $P = x_{\mathrm{EtOH}}\,P^{\circ}_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ (mutemo waRaoult).
c-352.example: Bhodhoro re 750mL rewaini ye 12% rine anenge 90mL yeethanol. Inowanzopiwa pa 60-70°C, uye kuvira pamusoro pe 78°C kunobudisa alcohol nemunhuwi nekukasira.
c-352.actionItem: Nhasi, dziisa mulled wine pamoto wakaderera pasi pe 70°C uye bvisa zvinonhuwira usati wavira.

c-353.title: Chiratidzo cheABC pafire extinguisher chinoratidza marudzi emoto
c-353.summary: A, B ne C paextinguisher zvinoratidza moto yaunogona kurwisa, uye ABC dry-powder unit ndiyo sarudzo yakajairika yepamba.
c-353.principle: Mukunyora kweKorea neUS, A i zvinopiswa zvakajairika, B i zvinwiwa zvinopisa uye C i moto wemagetsi. Monoammonium phosphate inoparadzaniswa kana yapiswa uye inodzivirira combustion chain reaction. $\mathrm{NH_4H_2PO_4 \to NH_3 + H_3PO_4}$
c-353.example: Extinguisher yehupfu yepamba ye 3.3kg kazhinji inobuda mukati memasekonzi anenge 10-20, saka ziva kuishandisa pamberi. MuEurope makirasi anosiyana, semuenzaniso C inoreva moto wegasi, saka tarisa mitemo yenzvimbo.
c-353.actionItem: Nhasi, tarisa kuti pressure gauge yeextinguisher yako iri mugreen range uye uichengete padyo.

c-354.title: Reusable hand warmers dzinoshandisa kupisa kwe crystallization yesodium acetate
c-354.summary: Reusable hand warmers dzinoshandisa kupisa kunoburitswa kana supersaturated solution ichiita crystallize yose pamwe chete, uye kuivirisa mumvura kunoidzorera.
c-354.principle: Sodium acetate trihydrate inonyunguduka pa anenge 58°C, uye kana supercooled liquid ichiita crystallize inoburitsa heat of fusion. $Q = m\,\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$, ne $\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$ yeanenge 265J/g.
c-354.example: Pakiti ye 100g inoburitsa anenge 26kJ sezvainoita crystallize, uye pamusoro payo pakwira kusvika anenge 50°C. Kusiya pakiti imwe chete mumvura inovira anenge maminitsi 10 kunoita kuti ijeke zvakare.
c-354.actionItem: Nhasi, virisa warmer yakashandiswa mumvura kusvikira makristaro ose anyunguduka, itonhodze zvishoma nezvishoma, uye dzivisa kuibata paganda rakashama kwenguva refu.

c-355.title: Kuvharira oksijeni kunochengeta waini yakavhurwa yakanaka kwemazuva anenge mana
c-355.summary: Oksijeni ndicho chikonzero chikuru nei waini yakavhurwa ichiora, saka kuidzorera chizuva uye kuiisa mufiriji kunowanzowedzera mazuva 3-5.
c-355.principle: Oksijeni nemabhakitiriya eacetic acid zvinoshandura ethanol kuita acetic acid kuburikidza ne acetaldehyde. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH + O_2 \to CH_3COOH + H_2O}$ Rate inotevera $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, ichidzika nehafu kune 10°C yega yega yekudzika.
c-355.example: Yakadzorerwa chizuva nekuiswa mufiriji, tsvuku nechena zvose kazhinji zvinogara mazuva 3-5, asi dzasiiwa dzakavhurika patembiricha yemukamuri dzinodzikira mumazuva 1-2. Kana yasara shoma, tamisirei kubhodhoro rinodiki kuderedza mweya mukati.
c-355.actionItem: Nhasi, vhara waini yakasara nechizuva uye uiise mufiriji pakarepo, uye bvisa tsvuku maminitsi 20 usati wanwa.

c-356.title: Makristaro machena pasi pebhodhoro rewaini i tartrate deposits
c-356.summary: Mapaki machena pasi pebhodhoro kana pachizuva ndiwo tartrate crystals, kwete kuora, uye haana njodzi.
c-356.principle: Potassium hydrogen tartrate (KHT) inova yakanyungudika zvishoma patembiricha yakaderera uye inoita precipitate. $\mathrm{KHC_4H_4O_6(s) \rightleftharpoons K^+ + HC_4H_4O_6^-}$ ne $K_{sp} = [\mathrm{K^+}][\mathrm{HC_4H_4O_6^-}]$.
c-356.example: Waini kazhinji ine 1.5-4g/L ye tartaric acid, uye makristaro anoumbwa zvishoma nezvishoma mukuchengetwa kunotonhora senge firiji. Chinhu chimwe chete ndicho cream of tartar inoshandiswa mukubika.
c-356.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchiona makristaro, usakande waini; mira bhodhoro rakamira zvakananga uye dururira zvishoma nezvishoma, uchisiya sediment.

c-357.title: Usaise mafuta enhuwira kana detergent mu humidifier
c-357.summary: Mvura yakachena chete ndiyo inofanira kuiswa mutanki rehumidifier. Mafuta kana detergent zvinoshanduka kuita particles diki dzaunobva wafema.
c-357.principle: Ultrasonic humidifier inoita atomize mvura kuita matundu madiki, ichitakura zvinonyungudika mumhepo pamwe chete. Huremu hwezvisinganyangari zvinoburitswa i $m = C \times V_{\mathrm{mist}}$.
c-357.example: Pamist output yeanenge 300mL paawa, additive ye 1% inoreva anenge 3mL yemafuta kana detergent anoitwa aerosol paawa yega yega. Ma minerals emvura yepombi (tichitora 150mg/L) anovawo anenge 45mg yeguruva jena paawa.
c-357.actionItem: Nhasi, shandura mvura yehumidifier zuva rega rega, shandisa diffuser yakasarudzika kunhuhwira, uye geza tanki vhiki rega rega.

c-358.title: E10 pamapombi ekune dzimwe nyika i gasoline yakasanganiswa neethanol
c-358.summary: E10 i gasoline ine anenge 10% yeethanol; motokari dzegasoline dzakawanda dzinogona kuishandisa, asi ine simba rishoma zvishoma.
c-358.principle: Ethanol ine anenge 21MJ/L yesimba nevhoriyamu, yakaderera kupfuura gasoline inenge 32MJ/L. $E_{\mathrm{E10}} = 0.9E_{\mathrm{gas}} + 0.1E_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$, uye octane inokwira zvishoma.
c-358.example: E10 inopa anenge 30.9MJ/L, anenge 3% shoma pane gasoline, saka motokari inoita 14km/L ichaita anenge 13.6km/L. Tarisa label yechivharo chemafuta kusimbisa kuti motokari yako inokodzera E10.
c-358.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchitora motokari yekurenda, tarisa label yechivharo chemafuta (gasoline, diesel, E10-compatible) uye usasanganisa diesel negasoline.

c-359.title: Smoke detectors dzinosiyana: photoelectric versus ionization
c-359.summary: Marudzi akasiyana esmoke detector anopindura zvakanakisa kumoto akasiyana, ne photoelectric yakasimba kumoto anopfungaira zvishoma nezvishoma.
c-359.principle: Ionization alarm inoshandisa americium-241 kuita ionize mweya uye inorira kana particles dzemhute dzichideredza current, nepo photoelectric alarm ichiona chiedza chakapararira nemhute particles.
c-359.example: Ionization inopindura nekukasira kune particles diki (anenge 0.01-0.3μm) dzemoto une murazvo, uye photoelectric kune particles huru (anenge 0.3-10μm) dzemoto unopfungaira. Ionization unit ine anenge 30-40 kBq yeamericium.
c-359.actionItem: Nhasi, dzvanya bhatani retest pa detector yako, uye uritsive kana zuva rekugadzirwa kuseri rapfuura makore 10.

c-360.title: Rwendo rupfupi chete mumotokari yediesel runovharira particulate filter
c-360.summary: Kana uchityaira motokari yediesel mu rwendo rupfupi chete, exhaust haipise zvakakwana uye soot inounganidza mu diesel particulate filter (DPF).
c-360.principle: Soot iri muDPF inofanira kupiswa mu regeneration. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ inoitika pa anenge 350-450°C nekatalyst, uye active regeneration pa anenge 600°C.
c-360.example: Murwendo rupfupi exhaust inogara pasi pe 200°C uye regeneration haimbooitiki. Ndosaka zvimwe zvinodiwa rwendo rwemaminitsi 20-30 kana kupfuura pakukasira kwemugwagwa mukuru kupisa filter kusvikira yachena.
c-360.actionItem: Vhiki ino, tyaira maminitsi 20-30 kana kupfuura pakukasira kwemugwagwa mukuru kwakagadzikana, uye uitarise garaji kana chiedza chekuyambira chakabatidzwa.

c-361.title: Baking soda shoma inoita kuti nyama yakaoma ive nyoro
c-361.summary: Baking soda shoma zvikuru inokwidziridza pH yenyama yakaoma kuitira kuti ibate mvura yakawanda uye ive nyoro.
c-361.principle: Mapuroteni emhasuru anobata mvura zvakaipisisa padyo ne isoelectric point yawo (pH anenge 5-5.5). Kukwidziridza pH yenyama (anenge 5.5-5.7) nebaking soda kunowedzera negative charge saka mapuroteni anosundana uye anobata mvura yakawanda. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$
c-361.example: Sanganisa 450g yenyama yakachekwa ne anenge 2.5g (0.5%) yebaking soda kwemaminitsi 15, wobva wageza. Zvakawandisa zvinopa kuravira kwesipo nechimiro chakapfava zvakanyanya.
c-361.actionItem: Nhasi, kana nyama yekutsvaira yakaoma, ipfekedze ne 0.5% kana pasi yebaking soda kwemaminitsi 15 chete, geza zvakanaka, wobva wabika.

c-362.title: Mukaka dzimwe nguva unoputika mukofi inopisa
c-362.summary: Mukaka unoputika mukofi imapuroteni anobatana nekuda kweacid nekupisa, uye mukaka mutsva kazhinji hauna njodzi.
c-362.principle: Isoelectric point yemilk casein i anenge pH 4.6, saka sezvo pH ichiswedera padyo nayo charge inodzika uye mapuroteni anobatana. Kupisa kunokurumidza kubatana uku.
c-362.example: Mukaka uri anenge pH 6.7 uye kofi anenge 4.8-5.1. Mukaka wekare watova ne pH yakaderera uye unoputika nyore, saka kana unonhuwa kuvava, ukandei panzvimbo yekuunwa.
c-362.actionItem: Nhasi, dururira mukaka mukapu kutanga kana shandisa mukaka wakadziiswa mukofi yako, uye ukande kana uchinhuwa kuvava.

c-363.title: Kufema helium kubva mugasi rebhaluni kune njodzi
c-363.summary: Kufema helium kunoshandura izwi rako, asi kunotsiva oksijeni uye kunogona kukonzera kudzipwa mweya, saka kune njodzi.
c-363.principle: Oxygen partial pressure mugasi rekufema i $P_{\mathrm{O_2}} = F_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P$. Helium yakachena ine $F_{\mathrm{O_2}} = 0$, saka inosundira oksijeni kunze kwemapapu. Kukasira kwenzwi, $v = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma RT}{M}}$, kukuru zvakanyanya muhelium, izvo zvinokwidziridza izwi.
c-363.example: Mweya une 20.9% yeoksijeni nepo helium ye 100% ine 0%. Kukasira kwenzwi muhelium i anenge 1,007m/s, anenge ka 3 yemumweya (anenge 343m/s), uye kufema zvakananga kubva mutanki ine pressure kunogona kukuvadza mapapu.
c-363.actionItem: Nhasi, kana uchizadza mabhaluni, usafema helium, uye vhura mweya mukamuri yakavharwa.

c-364.title: Usatumire film yekukasira kwakakwirira nemu airport X-rays
c-364.summary: Airport X-rays dzinogona kuita fog pafilm, saka kufilm yekukasira kwakakwirira kuchengeteka kukumbira kuongororwa nemaoko.
c-364.principle: Kana makristaro e silver halide achitora photons dzechiedza kana dzeX-ray, anoumba latent image yemaatomu esirivha. $\mathrm{AgBr + h\nu \to Ag + Br}$ Kuratidzwa kunounganidza.
c-364.example: Film ye ISO 800 kana kupfuura inogona kuita fog mushure meku scan kwakati wandei, uye X-rays dzemabhegi akaiswa dzakasimba zvikuru. Nokuti kuratidzwa kunounganidzwa, chengeta nhamba yema scan murwendo yakaderera.
c-364.actionItem: Nhasi, isa film yako mubhegi rakajeka, kumbira kuongororwa nemaoko pasecurity, uye usaipakira mumabhegi akaiswa.

c-365.title: Ongorora kugara kwemhedzisiro nemutengo wenhuhwira kubva kuEDP kana EDT kusimba
c-365.summary: Panhuhwira, kusimba kwefragrance (%) kunoratidza zvakawanda pamusoro pekugara nemutengo kupfuura zita.
c-365.principle: Kusimba kwefragrance kwakakwirira, kuvira kunononoka uye kunogara kwenguva refu. Eau de parfum (EDP) i anenge 15-20%, eau de toilette (EDT) anenge 5-15% uye eau de cologne (EDC) anenge 2-4%.
c-365.example: Mubhodhoro re 50mL, 15% EDP ine anenge 7.5mL yemafuta enhuwira uye 8% EDT anenge 4mL, saka EDP kazhinji inodhura zvakawanda. EDT kazhinji inogara anenge maawa 3-4 uye EDP anenge maawa 5-8.
c-365.actionItem: Usati watenga nhuwira, spreyi pamukati meruoko rwako uye utarise kuti inonhuwa sei mushure memaawa 4.

c-366.title: Aerogel mumapuredzi nemagirovhosi i mweya wakawanda wakabatwa musilica
c-366.summary: Aerogel mumidziyo yemamiriro echando i silica structure ine mweya wakawanda, saka kunyange layer yakatetepa inovharira kupisa zvakanaka.
c-366.principle: Mapores e nano-size madiki kupfuura mean free path yemamolecule emweya (anenge 68nm) anovharira kuendesa kupisa. $\lambda = \frac{k_B T}{\sqrt{2}\,\pi d^2 P}$ uye kuyerera kwekupisa i $Q = \frac{kA\,\Delta T}{L}$.
c-366.example: Silica aerogel ine thermal conductivity yeanenge 0.015-0.02W/m·K, yakaderera kupfuura mweya usingafambi (anenge 0.026). Panzvimbo ye 0.02m², kukora kwe 3mm nemusiyano we 20K ne $k = 0.02$, kurasikirwa nekupisa i anenge 2.7W.

Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
20261119-math-g06-1.principle: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
20261119-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
20261119-math-g06-1.actionItem: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.

20261119-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261119-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261119-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261119-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261119-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261119-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261119-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261119-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261119-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261119-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261119-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261119-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261119-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261119-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261119-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261119-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261119-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261119-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261119-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261119-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261119-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261119-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261119-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261119-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'

20261119-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261119-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261119-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261119-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261119-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261119-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261119-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261119-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261119-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261119-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261119-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261119-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261119-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261119-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).

20261119-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261119-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261119-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261119-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261119-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261119-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261119-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261119-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261119-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261119-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261119-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261119-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261119-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261119-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.

20261119-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261119-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261119-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261119-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.

20261121-math-g01-1.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
20261121-math-g01-1.summary: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
20261121-math-g01-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
20261121-math-g01-1.example: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
20261121-math-g01-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.

20261121-math-g01-2.title: Kureba kwakayerwa nemapepa clips nemaglue sticks: ndechipi chakareba zvikuru?

Seoyun akayera kureba kwepeni yeruvara nemaglue sticks (glue yakaita tsvimbo) ndokuwana maglue sticks 3. Vose vakaaisa nemutsetse mumwe padivi pasina mapako. Chipi chakareba, peni here kana peni yeruvara?
20261121-math-g01-2.principle: Pepa clip neglue stick zvakareba zvakasiyana, saka haugoni kufananidza uchitarisa 5 ne3 chete. Kana uchiziva kuti glue stick 1 mapepa clips mangani, unogona kufananidza muchikamu chimwe chete, uye unogonawo kufananidza peni nepeni yeruvara zvakananga nekuenzanisa mugumo umwe.
20261121-math-g01-2.example: Pepa clip rimwe rakareba sa glue stick rimwe here? Funga izvozvo kutanga.
20261121-math-g01-2.actionItem: Dzidza kuti kureba kwakayerwa nezvikamu zvakasiyana hakugoni kufananidzwa nehuwandu hwoga, uye sarudza kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodiwa kuzvifananidza.

20261121-math-g02-1.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
20261121-math-g02-1.summary: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
20261121-math-g02-1.principle: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.

20261121-math-g02-2.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
20261121-math-g02-2.summary:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
20261121-math-g02-2.principle: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
20261121-math-g02-2.example: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
20261121-math-g02-2.actionItem: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.

20261121-math-g03-1.title: Nzira Dzakasiyana Dzekugovera Zvihwitsi 72 Zvakaenzana Pamaplate
20261121-math-g03-1.summary: Unoda kuisa zvihwitsi 72 pamaplate, uchizvigovera zvakaenzana pasina zvasara. Huwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega hunoshanduka zvichienderana nokuti unoshandisa maplate mangani.
20261121-math-g03-1.principle: Unogona kugovera zvihwitsi zvakaenzana pasina zvasara kana huwandu hwemaplate hunowanzwa nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe hwuri 72 chete. 4×18, 6×12, ne 9×8 ndi 72, uye hapana nhamba inowanzwa ne 5 kana 7 inoita 72.
20261121-math-g03-1.example: Kune huwandu hwemaplate hwese, kamura 72 nehuwandu uhwo uye utarise kana pane chasara.
20261121-math-g03-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekugovera dzinosangana nemamiriro (huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega) panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe zvinobatana sei.

20261121-math-g03-2.title: Kutsvaga kanganiso mukugovera zvihwitsi kwaSeoyeon
20261121-math-g03-2.summary: Seoyeon anoda kugovera zvihwitsi 85 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 4. Verenga mhinduro yaSeoyeon. Quotient ndiyo nhamba inowanikwa nemunhu wega wega, uye chasara ndiyo nhamba yasara mushure mekugovera.
20261121-math-g03-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Zvihwitsi 5 zvasara zvinogona kugoverwa zvakare, chihwitsi 1 zvakare kune vanhu 4 vese, saka kutaura 'hazvigoni kugoverwa zvakare' hakurevi chokwadi. Kutarisa kwemutsetse 4 kunongoratidza kuti number sentence inobatana; hakutauri kana chasara chakarurama.
20261121-math-g03-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, verenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kana zvinotaurwa zvakadaro chaizvo.
20261121-math-g03-2.actionItem: Shandisa mamiriro okuti chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura divisor kuwana nekugadzirisa kanganiso mumhinduro, uye uparadzanise nyaya apo kanganiso imwe chete inoitika neapo isingaitike.

20261121-math-g04-1.title: Kutarisa Tsananguro yaSeohyeon
20261121-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon akatsanangura izvi kushamwari. Pane kukanganisa mutsananguro iyi.
20261121-math-g04-1.principle: Mutsara 3 ndipo painotanga kukanganisa. Square ine mativi mana akaenzana, asi izvi hazvireve zvakapesana, "kana mativi mana akaenzana, ndeye square." Mutsara 4 unoronzera kukanganisa kumwe chete, asi nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama ndi mutsara 3.
20261121-math-g04-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa zvakare mufomu "kana ..., ipapo ...," uye nyora kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti unoenda munzira imwe chete nechirevo chiri mumutsara wapfuura here.

20261121-math-g04-2.title: Zvakanganisa kupi pakushandura kuva nhamba?
20261121-math-g04-2.summary: Minseo akanyora mhinduro yekunyora 'zviuru zvitatu makumi maviri nemashanu magumi ezviuru, zviuru zvina matanhatu' nenhamba.
20261121-math-g04-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Muzviuru zvina matanhatu, nzvimbo yezviuru ndi 4 uye nzvimbo yeimwe ndi 6, uye nzvimbo dzemazana negumi hadzina kuverengwa asi ndi 0, saka ndi 4006. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 yakanganisa nokuti inoenderera nekukosha kwakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
20261121-math-g04-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana 'mazwi akaverengwa' ne 'nhamba dzakanyorwa' zvichiwirirana.
20261121-math-g04-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandura nhamba huru yakaverengwa nemazwi kuva nhamba, uye uigadzirise uchishandisa ma 0 munzvimbo dzakange dzisina kuverengwa.

20261121-math-g05-1.title: Huwandu Hwemapoka Ekugovana Zvakaenzana: Kugadzirisa Chigadziriso
20261121-math-g05-1.summary: Unoda kugovera maswiti 48 nema chocolates 36 zvakaenzana pasina chinosara pakati pemapoka akawanda. Hayun akawana huwandu hwemapoka seizvi.
20261121-math-g05-1.principle: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Huwandu hwemapoka anogovera 48 zvakaenzana hunofanira kuva nhamba inopatsanura 48 zvakaenzana, ndiko kuti, factor ye48. Multiple inogona kuva huru kupfuura 48, uye ipapo maswiti haakwani. Mutsara 4 unotaurawo chinhu chaizosiya mamwe maboka asina kana switi imwe nemapoka 144. Mutsara 1 wakakopa dambudziko zvakanaka, uye 144 mumutsara 3 yakarurama seleast common multiple ye48 ne36.
20261121-math-g05-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye ufunge kana zvinotaurwa zvichigoneka muchokwadi mumamiriro emaswiti 48 nema chocolates 36.
20261121-math-g05-1.actionItem: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo muchigadziriso apo hukama husina kururama pakati penhamba (factor/multiple) hwakasarudzwa, uye ufunge nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mamiriro.

20261121-math-g05-2.title: Kana Avhareji Dzakafanana, Mapoka Maviri Akafanana Here?
20261121-math-g05-2.summary: Boka reSky neboka reSea rimwe nerimwe rakatumira vanhu 4 kumakwikwi ekusvetuka tambo. Marekodhi eboka reSky (huwandu hwekusvetuka) ndi 20, 22, 24, ne 54, uye marekodhi eboka reSea ndi 28, 29, 30, ne 33. Avhareji dzemapoka ese maviri dzakafanana, 30. Doha akati, "Avhareji dzakafanana, saka mapoka maviri akanaka zvakaenzana."
20261121-math-g05-2.principle: Avhareji ndi (huwandu hwezvose)÷(huwandu hwevanhu), saka kana huwandu hwevanhu hwakafanana uye avhareji dzakafanana, huwandu hwose hwakafananawo (zvese ndi 120). Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kukosha kukuru, kukosha kudiki, nekuti kwakaparadzirwa sei zvakafanana.

20261121-math-g06-1.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
20261121-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”

20261121-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.

20261121-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261121-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261121-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261121-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261121-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261121-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261121-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261121-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261121-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261121-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261121-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261121-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261121-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261121-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261121-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261121-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261121-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261121-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261121-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261121-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261121-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261121-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261121-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261121-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'
20261121-math-g08-2.actionItem: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.

20261121-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261121-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261121-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261121-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261121-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261121-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261121-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261121-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261121-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261121-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261121-math-g10-1.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
20261121-math-g10-1.summary: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
20261121-math-g10-1.principle: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
20261121-math-g10-1.example: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
20261121-math-g10-1.actionItem: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.

20261121-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261121-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261121-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261121-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
20261121-math-g10-2.actionItem: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.

20261121-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261121-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261121-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261121-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261121-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261121-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261121-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261121-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261121-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261121-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261121-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261121-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261121-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261121-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.
20261121-math-g12-1.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kuwana conditional probability, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti nei accuracy yetest yakasiyana ne 'mukana wekurwara kana mhedzisiro ipositive'.

20261121-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261121-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261121-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261121-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.
20261121-math-g12-2.actionItem: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.

20261122-math-g01-1.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
20261122-math-g01-1.summary: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
20261122-math-g01-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
20261122-math-g01-1.example: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
20261122-math-g01-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.

20261122-math-g01-2.title: Kureba kwakayerwa nemapepa clips nemaglue sticks: ndechipi chakareba zvikuru?
20261122-math-g01-2.summary: Minjun akayera kureba kwepeni nemapepa clips ndokuwana mapepa clips 5. Seoyun akayera kureba kwepeni yeruvara nemaglue sticks (glue yakaita tsvimbo) ndokuwana maglue sticks 3. Vose vakaaisa nemutsetse mumwe padivi pasina mapako. Chipi chakareba, peni here kana peni yeruvara?
20261122-math-g01-2.principle: Pepa clip neglue stick zvakareba zvakasiyana, saka haugoni kufananidza uchitarisa 5 ne3 chete. Kana uchiziva kuti glue stick 1 mapepa clips mangani, unogona kufananidza muchikamu chimwe chete, uye unogonawo kufananidza peni nepeni yeruvara zvakananga nekuenzanisa mugumo umwe.
20261122-math-g01-2.example: Pepa clip rimwe rakareba sa glue stick rimwe here? Funga izvozvo kutanga.
20261122-math-g01-2.actionItem: Dzidza kuti kureba kwakayerwa nezvikamu zvakasiyana hakugoni kufananidzwa nehuwandu hwoga, uye sarudza kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodiwa kuzvifananidza.

20261122-math-g02-1.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
20261122-math-g02-1.summary: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
20261122-math-g02-1.principle: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.
20261122-math-g02-1.example: Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
20261122-math-g02-1.actionItem: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.

20261122-math-g02-2.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
20261122-math-g02-2.summary:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
20261122-math-g02-2.principle: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
20261122-math-g02-2.example: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
20261122-math-g02-2.actionItem: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.

20261122-math-g03-1.title: Nzira Dzakasiyana Dzekugovera Zvihwitsi 72 Zvakaenzana Pamaplate
20261122-math-g03-1.summary: Unoda kuisa zvihwitsi 72 pamaplate, uchizvigovera zvakaenzana pasina zvasara. Huwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega hunoshanduka zvichienderana nokuti unoshandisa maplate mangani.
20261122-math-g03-1.principle: Unogona kugovera zvihwitsi zvakaenzana pasina zvasara kana huwandu hwemaplate hunowanzwa nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe hwuri 72 chete. 4×18, 6×12, ne 9×8 ndi 72, uye hapana nhamba inowanzwa ne 5 kana 7 inoita 72.
20261122-math-g03-1.example: Kune huwandu hwemaplate hwese, kamura 72 nehuwandu uhwo uye utarise kana pane chasara.
20261122-math-g03-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekugovera dzinosangana nemamiriro (huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega) panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe zvinobatana sei.

20261122-math-g03-2.title: Kutsvaga kanganiso mukugovera zvihwitsi kwaSeoyeon
20261122-math-g03-2.summary: Seoyeon anoda kugovera zvihwitsi 85 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 4. Verenga mhinduro yaSeoyeon. Quotient ndiyo nhamba inowanikwa nemunhu wega wega, uye chasara ndiyo nhamba yasara mushure mekugovera.
20261122-math-g03-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Zvihwitsi 5 zvasara zvinogona kugoverwa zvakare, chihwitsi 1 zvakare kune vanhu 4 vese, saka kutaura 'hazvigoni kugoverwa zvakare' hakurevi chokwadi. Kutarisa kwemutsetse 4 kunongoratidza kuti number sentence inobatana; hakutauri kana chasara chakarurama.
20261122-math-g03-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, verenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kana zvinotaurwa zvakadaro chaizvo.
20261122-math-g03-2.actionItem: Shandisa mamiriro okuti chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura divisor kuwana nekugadzirisa kanganiso mumhinduro, uye uparadzanise nyaya apo kanganiso imwe chete inoitika neapo isingaitike.

20261122-math-g04-1.title: Kutarisa Tsananguro yaSeohyeon
20261122-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon akatsanangura izvi kushamwari. Pane kukanganisa mutsananguro iyi.
20261122-math-g04-1.principle: Mutsara 3 ndipo painotanga kukanganisa. Square ine mativi mana akaenzana, asi izvi hazvireve zvakapesana, "kana mativi mana akaenzana, ndeye square." Mutsara 4 unoronzera kukanganisa kumwe chete, asi nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama ndi mutsara 3.
20261122-math-g04-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa zvakare mufomu "kana ..., ipapo ...," uye nyora kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti unoenda munzira imwe chete nechirevo chiri mumutsara wapfuura here.
20261122-math-g04-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwelogic mutsananguro inoti 'Kana mativi mana ose akafanana, ndeye square,' uye utsanangure quadrilateral iri muenzaniso unopikisa.

20261122-math-g04-2.title: Zvakanganisa kupi pakushandura kuva nhamba?
20261122-math-g04-2.summary: Minseo akanyora mhinduro yekunyora 'zviuru zvitatu makumi maviri nemashanu magumi ezviuru, zviuru zvina matanhatu' nenhamba.
20261122-math-g04-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Muzviuru zvina matanhatu, nzvimbo yezviuru ndi 4 uye nzvimbo yeimwe ndi 6, uye nzvimbo dzemazana negumi hadzina kuverengwa asi ndi 0, saka ndi 4006. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 yakanganisa nokuti inoenderera nekukosha kwakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
20261122-math-g04-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana 'mazwi akaverengwa' ne 'nhamba dzakanyorwa' zvichiwirirana.
20261122-math-g04-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandura nhamba huru yakaverengwa nemazwi kuva nhamba, uye uigadzirise uchishandisa ma 0 munzvimbo dzakange dzisina kuverengwa.

20261122-math-g05-1.title: Huwandu Hwemapoka Ekugovana Zvakaenzana: Kugadzirisa Chigadziriso
20261122-math-g05-1.summary: Unoda kugovera maswiti 48 nema chocolates 36 zvakaenzana pasina chinosara pakati pemapoka akawanda. Hayun akawana huwandu hwemapoka seizvi.
20261122-math-g05-1.principle: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Huwandu hwemapoka anogovera 48 zvakaenzana hunofanira kuva nhamba inopatsanura 48 zvakaenzana, ndiko kuti, factor ye48. Multiple inogona kuva huru kupfuura 48, uye ipapo maswiti haakwani. Mutsara 4 unotaurawo chinhu chaizosiya mamwe maboka asina kana switi imwe nemapoka 144. Mutsara 1 wakakopa dambudziko zvakanaka, uye 144 mumutsara 3 yakarurama seleast common multiple ye48 ne36.
20261122-math-g05-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye ufunge kana zvinotaurwa zvichigoneka muchokwadi mumamiriro emaswiti 48 nema chocolates 36.
20261122-math-g05-1.actionItem: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo muchigadziriso apo hukama husina kururama pakati penhamba (factor/multiple) hwakasarudzwa, uye ufunge nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mamiriro.

20261122-math-g05-2.title: Kana Avhareji Dzakafanana, Mapoka Maviri Akafanana Here?
20261122-math-g05-2.summary: Boka reSky neboka reSea rimwe nerimwe rakatumira vanhu 4 kumakwikwi ekusvetuka tambo. Marekodhi eboka reSky (huwandu hwekusvetuka) ndi 20, 22, 24, ne 54, uye marekodhi eboka reSea ndi 28, 29, 30, ne 33. Avhareji dzemapoka ese maviri dzakafanana, 30. Doha akati, "Avhareji dzakafanana, saka mapoka maviri akanaka zvakaenzana."
20261122-math-g05-2.principle: Avhareji ndi (huwandu hwezvose)÷(huwandu hwevanhu), saka kana huwandu hwevanhu hwakafanana uye avhareji dzakafanana, huwandu hwose hwakafananawo (zvese ndi 120). Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kukosha kukuru, kukosha kudiki, nekuti kwakaparadzirwa sei zvakafanana.
20261122-math-g05-2.example: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana yakarurama pamarekodhi eboka reSky neboka reSea.
20261122-math-g05-2.actionItem: Tarisa, nedata nemuenzaniso waunogadzira iwe pachako, kuti kunyange kana avhareji dzakafanana, kuti data rakaparadzirwa sei kunogona kusiyana, uye uparadzanise zvinotaurwa neavhareji nezvisingakwanisi kutaura.

20261122-math-g06-1.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
20261122-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
20261122-math-g06-1.principle: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
20261122-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
20261122-math-g06-1.actionItem: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.

20261122-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261122-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261122-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261122-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261122-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261122-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261122-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261122-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261122-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261122-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261122-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261122-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261122-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261122-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261122-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261122-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261122-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261122-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261122-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261122-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261122-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261122-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261122-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261122-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'
20261122-math-g08-2.actionItem: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.

20261122-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261122-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261122-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261122-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261122-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261122-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261122-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261122-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261122-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261122-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261122-math-g10-1.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
20261122-math-g10-1.summary: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
20261122-math-g10-1.principle: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
20261122-math-g10-1.example: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
20261122-math-g10-1.actionItem: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.

20261122-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261122-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261122-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261122-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
20261122-math-g10-2.actionItem: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.

20261122-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261122-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261122-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261122-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261122-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261122-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261122-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261122-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261122-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261122-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261122-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261122-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261122-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261122-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.
20261122-math-g12-1.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kuwana conditional probability, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti nei accuracy yetest yakasiyana ne 'mukana wekurwara kana mhedzisiro ipositive'.

20261122-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261122-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261122-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261122-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.
20261122-math-g12-2.actionItem: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.

20261123-math-g01-1.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
20261123-math-g01-1.summary: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
20261123-math-g01-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
20261123-math-g01-1.example: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
20261123-math-g01-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.

20261123-math-g01-2.title: Kureba kwakayerwa nemapepa clips nemaglue sticks: ndechipi chakareba zvikuru?
20261123-math-g01-2.summary: Minjun akayera kureba kwepeni nemapepa clips ndokuwana mapepa clips 5. Seoyun akayera kureba kwepeni yeruvara nemaglue sticks (glue yakaita tsvimbo) ndokuwana maglue sticks 3. Vose vakaaisa nemutsetse mumwe padivi pasina mapako. Chipi chakareba, peni here kana peni yeruvara?
20261123-math-g01-2.principle: Pepa clip neglue stick zvakareba zvakasiyana, saka haugoni kufananidza uchitarisa 5 ne3 chete. Kana uchiziva kuti glue stick 1 mapepa clips mangani, unogona kufananidza muchikamu chimwe chete, uye unogonawo kufananidza peni nepeni yeruvara zvakananga nekuenzanisa mugumo umwe.
20261123-math-g01-2.example: Pepa clip rimwe rakareba sa glue stick rimwe here? Funga izvozvo kutanga.
20261123-math-g01-2.actionItem: Dzidza kuti kureba kwakayerwa nezvikamu zvakasiyana hakugoni kufananidzwa nehuwandu hwoga, uye sarudza kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodiwa kuzvifananidza.

20261123-math-g02-1.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
20261123-math-g02-1.summary: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
20261123-math-g02-1.principle: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.
20261123-math-g02-1.example: Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
20261123-math-g02-1.actionItem: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.

20261123-math-g02-2.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
20261123-math-g02-2.summary:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
20261123-math-g02-2.principle: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
20261123-math-g02-2.example: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
20261123-math-g02-2.actionItem: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.

20261123-math-g03-1.title: Nzira Dzakasiyana Dzekugovera Zvihwitsi 72 Zvakaenzana Pamaplate
20261123-math-g03-1.summary: Unoda kuisa zvihwitsi 72 pamaplate, uchizvigovera zvakaenzana pasina zvasara. Huwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega hunoshanduka zvichienderana nokuti unoshandisa maplate mangani.
20261123-math-g03-1.principle: Unogona kugovera zvihwitsi zvakaenzana pasina zvasara kana huwandu hwemaplate hunowanzwa nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe hwuri 72 chete. 4×18, 6×12, ne 9×8 ndi 72, uye hapana nhamba inowanzwa ne 5 kana 7 inoita 72.
20261123-math-g03-1.example: Kune huwandu hwemaplate hwese, kamura 72 nehuwandu uhwo uye utarise kana pane chasara.
20261123-math-g03-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekugovera dzinosangana nemamiriro (huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega) panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe zvinobatana sei.

20261123-math-g03-2.title: Kutsvaga kanganiso mukugovera zvihwitsi kwaSeoyeon
20261123-math-g03-2.summary: Seoyeon anoda kugovera zvihwitsi 85 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 4. Verenga mhinduro yaSeoyeon. Quotient ndiyo nhamba inowanikwa nemunhu wega wega, uye chasara ndiyo nhamba yasara mushure mekugovera.
20261123-math-g03-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Zvihwitsi 5 zvasara zvinogona kugoverwa zvakare, chihwitsi 1 zvakare kune vanhu 4 vese, saka kutaura 'hazvigoni kugoverwa zvakare' hakurevi chokwadi. Kutarisa kwemutsetse 4 kunongoratidza kuti number sentence inobatana; hakutauri kana chasara chakarurama.
20261123-math-g03-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, verenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kana zvinotaurwa zvakadaro chaizvo.
20261123-math-g03-2.actionItem: Shandisa mamiriro okuti chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura divisor kuwana nekugadzirisa kanganiso mumhinduro, uye uparadzanise nyaya apo kanganiso imwe chete inoitika neapo isingaitike.

20261123-math-g04-1.title: Kutarisa Tsananguro yaSeohyeon
20261123-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon akatsanangura izvi kushamwari. Pane kukanganisa mutsananguro iyi.
20261123-math-g04-1.principle: Mutsara 3 ndipo painotanga kukanganisa. Square ine mativi mana akaenzana, asi izvi hazvireve zvakapesana, "kana mativi mana akaenzana, ndeye square." Mutsara 4 unoronzera kukanganisa kumwe chete, asi nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama ndi mutsara 3.
20261123-math-g04-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa zvakare mufomu "kana ..., ipapo ...," uye nyora kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti unoenda munzira imwe chete nechirevo chiri mumutsara wapfuura here.
20261123-math-g04-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwelogic mutsananguro inoti 'Kana mativi mana ose akafanana, ndeye square,' uye utsanangure quadrilateral iri muenzaniso unopikisa.

20261123-math-g04-2.title: Zvakanganisa kupi pakushandura kuva nhamba?
20261123-math-g04-2.summary: Minseo akanyora mhinduro yekunyora 'zviuru zvitatu makumi maviri nemashanu magumi ezviuru, zviuru zvina matanhatu' nenhamba.
