20261123-math-g04-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Muzviuru zvina matanhatu, nzvimbo yezviuru ndi 4 uye nzvimbo yeimwe ndi 6, uye nzvimbo dzemazana negumi hadzina kuverengwa asi ndi 0, saka ndi 4006. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 yakanganisa nokuti inoenderera nekukosha kwakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
20261123-math-g04-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana 'mazwi akaverengwa' ne 'nhamba dzakanyorwa' zvichiwirirana.
20261123-math-g04-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandura nhamba huru yakaverengwa nemazwi kuva nhamba, uye uigadzirise uchishandisa ma 0 munzvimbo dzakange dzisina kuverengwa.

20261123-math-g05-1.title: Huwandu Hwemapoka Ekugovana Zvakaenzana: Kugadzirisa Chigadziriso
20261123-math-g05-1.summary: Unoda kugovera maswiti 48 nema chocolates 36 zvakaenzana pasina chinosara pakati pemapoka akawanda. Hayun akawana huwandu hwemapoka seizvi.
20261123-math-g05-1.principle: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Huwandu hwemapoka anogovera 48 zvakaenzana hunofanira kuva nhamba inopatsanura 48 zvakaenzana, ndiko kuti, factor ye48. Multiple inogona kuva huru kupfuura 48, uye ipapo maswiti haakwani. Mutsara 4 unotaurawo chinhu chaizosiya mamwe maboka asina kana switi imwe nemapoka 144. Mutsara 1 wakakopa dambudziko zvakanaka, uye 144 mumutsara 3 yakarurama seleast common multiple ye48 ne36.
20261123-math-g05-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye ufunge kana zvinotaurwa zvichigoneka muchokwadi mumamiriro emaswiti 48 nema chocolates 36.
20261123-math-g05-1.actionItem: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo muchigadziriso apo hukama husina kururama pakati penhamba (factor/multiple) hwakasarudzwa, uye ufunge nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mamiriro.

20261123-math-g05-2.title: Kana Avhareji Dzakafanana, Mapoka Maviri Akafanana Here?
20261123-math-g05-2.summary: Boka reSky neboka reSea rimwe nerimwe rakatumira vanhu 4 kumakwikwi ekusvetuka tambo. Marekodhi eboka reSky (huwandu hwekusvetuka) ndi 20, 22, 24, ne 54, uye marekodhi eboka reSea ndi 28, 29, 30, ne 33. Avhareji dzemapoka ese maviri dzakafanana, 30. Doha akati, "Avhareji dzakafanana, saka mapoka maviri akanaka zvakaenzana."
20261123-math-g05-2.principle: Avhareji ndi (huwandu hwezvose)÷(huwandu hwevanhu), saka kana huwandu hwevanhu hwakafanana uye avhareji dzakafanana, huwandu hwose hwakafananawo (zvese ndi 120). Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kukosha kukuru, kukosha kudiki, nekuti kwakaparadzirwa sei zvakafanana.
20261123-math-g05-2.example: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana yakarurama pamarekodhi eboka reSky neboka reSea.
20261123-math-g05-2.actionItem: Tarisa, nedata nemuenzaniso waunogadzira iwe pachako, kuti kunyange kana avhareji dzakafanana, kuti data rakaparadzirwa sei kunogona kusiyana, uye uparadzanise zvinotaurwa neavhareji nezvisingakwanisi kutaura.

20261123-math-g06-1.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
20261123-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
20261123-math-g06-1.principle: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
20261123-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
20261123-math-g06-1.actionItem: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.

20261123-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261123-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261123-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261123-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261123-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261123-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261123-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261123-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261123-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261123-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261123-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261123-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261123-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261123-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261123-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261123-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261123-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261123-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261123-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261123-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261123-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261123-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261123-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261123-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'
20261123-math-g08-2.actionItem: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.

20261123-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261123-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261123-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261123-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261123-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261123-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261123-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261123-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261123-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261123-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261123-math-g10-1.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
20261123-math-g10-1.summary: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
20261123-math-g10-1.principle: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
20261123-math-g10-1.example: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
20261123-math-g10-1.actionItem: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.

20261123-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261123-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261123-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261123-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
20261123-math-g10-2.actionItem: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.

20261123-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261123-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261123-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261123-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261123-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261123-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261123-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261123-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261123-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261123-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261123-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261123-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261123-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261123-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.
20261123-math-g12-1.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kuwana conditional probability, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti nei accuracy yetest yakasiyana ne 'mukana wekurwara kana mhedzisiro ipositive'.

20261123-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261123-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261123-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261123-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.
20261123-math-g12-2.actionItem: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.

20261124-math-g01-1.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
20261124-math-g01-1.summary: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
20261124-math-g01-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
20261124-math-g01-1.example: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
20261124-math-g01-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.

20261124-math-g01-2.title: Kureba kwakayerwa nemapepa clips nemaglue sticks: ndechipi chakareba zvikuru?
20261124-math-g01-2.summary: Minjun akayera kureba kwepeni nemapepa clips ndokuwana mapepa clips 5. Seoyun akayera kureba kwepeni yeruvara nemaglue sticks (glue yakaita tsvimbo) ndokuwana maglue sticks 3. Vose vakaaisa nemutsetse mumwe padivi pasina mapako. Chipi chakareba, peni here kana peni yeruvara?
20261124-math-g01-2.principle: Pepa clip neglue stick zvakareba zvakasiyana, saka haugoni kufananidza uchitarisa 5 ne3 chete. Kana uchiziva kuti glue stick 1 mapepa clips mangani, unogona kufananidza muchikamu chimwe chete, uye unogonawo kufananidza peni nepeni yeruvara zvakananga nekuenzanisa mugumo umwe.
20261124-math-g01-2.example: Pepa clip rimwe rakareba sa glue stick rimwe here? Funga izvozvo kutanga.
20261124-math-g01-2.actionItem: Dzidza kuti kureba kwakayerwa nezvikamu zvakasiyana hakugoni kufananidzwa nehuwandu hwoga, uye sarudza kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodiwa kuzvifananidza.

20261124-math-g02-1.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
20261124-math-g02-1.summary: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
20261124-math-g02-1.principle: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.
20261124-math-g02-1.example: Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
20261124-math-g02-1.actionItem: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.

20261124-math-g02-2.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
20261124-math-g02-2.summary:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
20261124-math-g02-2.principle: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
20261124-math-g02-2.example: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
20261124-math-g02-2.actionItem: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.

20261124-math-g03-1.title: Nzira Dzakasiyana Dzekugovera Zvihwitsi 72 Zvakaenzana Pamaplate
20261124-math-g03-1.summary: Unoda kuisa zvihwitsi 72 pamaplate, uchizvigovera zvakaenzana pasina zvasara. Huwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega hunoshanduka zvichienderana nokuti unoshandisa maplate mangani.
20261124-math-g03-1.principle: Unogona kugovera zvihwitsi zvakaenzana pasina zvasara kana huwandu hwemaplate hunowanzwa nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe hwuri 72 chete. 4×18, 6×12, ne 9×8 ndi 72, uye hapana nhamba inowanzwa ne 5 kana 7 inoita 72.
20261124-math-g03-1.example: Kune huwandu hwemaplate hwese, kamura 72 nehuwandu uhwo uye utarise kana pane chasara.
20261124-math-g03-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekugovera dzinosangana nemamiriro (huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega) panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe zvinobatana sei.

20261124-math-g03-2.title: Kutsvaga kanganiso mukugovera zvihwitsi kwaSeoyeon
20261124-math-g03-2.summary: Seoyeon anoda kugovera zvihwitsi 85 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 4. Verenga mhinduro yaSeoyeon. Quotient ndiyo nhamba inowanikwa nemunhu wega wega, uye chasara ndiyo nhamba yasara mushure mekugovera.
20261124-math-g03-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Zvihwitsi 5 zvasara zvinogona kugoverwa zvakare, chihwitsi 1 zvakare kune vanhu 4 vese, saka kutaura 'hazvigoni kugoverwa zvakare' hakurevi chokwadi. Kutarisa kwemutsetse 4 kunongoratidza kuti number sentence inobatana; hakutauri kana chasara chakarurama.
20261124-math-g03-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, verenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kana zvinotaurwa zvakadaro chaizvo.
20261124-math-g03-2.actionItem: Shandisa mamiriro okuti chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura divisor kuwana nekugadzirisa kanganiso mumhinduro, uye uparadzanise nyaya apo kanganiso imwe chete inoitika neapo isingaitike.

20261124-math-g04-1.title: Kutarisa Tsananguro yaSeohyeon
20261124-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon akatsanangura izvi kushamwari. Pane kukanganisa mutsananguro iyi.
20261124-math-g04-1.principle: Mutsara 3 ndipo painotanga kukanganisa. Square ine mativi mana akaenzana, asi izvi hazvireve zvakapesana, "kana mativi mana akaenzana, ndeye square." Mutsara 4 unoronzera kukanganisa kumwe chete, asi nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama ndi mutsara 3.
20261124-math-g04-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa zvakare mufomu "kana ..., ipapo ...," uye nyora kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti unoenda munzira imwe chete nechirevo chiri mumutsara wapfuura here.
20261124-math-g04-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwelogic mutsananguro inoti 'Kana mativi mana ose akafanana, ndeye square,' uye utsanangure quadrilateral iri muenzaniso unopikisa.

20261124-math-g04-2.title: Zvakanganisa kupi pakushandura kuva nhamba?
20261124-math-g04-2.summary: Minseo akanyora mhinduro yekunyora 'zviuru zvitatu makumi maviri nemashanu magumi ezviuru, zviuru zvina matanhatu' nenhamba.
20261124-math-g04-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Muzviuru zvina matanhatu, nzvimbo yezviuru ndi 4 uye nzvimbo yeimwe ndi 6, uye nzvimbo dzemazana negumi hadzina kuverengwa asi ndi 0, saka ndi 4006. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 yakanganisa nokuti inoenderera nekukosha kwakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
20261124-math-g04-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana 'mazwi akaverengwa' ne 'nhamba dzakanyorwa' zvichiwirirana.
20261124-math-g04-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandura nhamba huru yakaverengwa nemazwi kuva nhamba, uye uigadzirise uchishandisa ma 0 munzvimbo dzakange dzisina kuverengwa.

20261124-math-g05-1.title: Huwandu Hwemapoka Ekugovana Zvakaenzana: Kugadzirisa Chigadziriso
20261124-math-g05-1.summary: Unoda kugovera maswiti 48 nema chocolates 36 zvakaenzana pasina chinosara pakati pemapoka akawanda. Hayun akawana huwandu hwemapoka seizvi.
20261124-math-g05-1.principle: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Huwandu hwemapoka anogovera 48 zvakaenzana hunofanira kuva nhamba inopatsanura 48 zvakaenzana, ndiko kuti, factor ye48. Multiple inogona kuva huru kupfuura 48, uye ipapo maswiti haakwani. Mutsara 4 unotaurawo chinhu chaizosiya mamwe maboka asina kana switi imwe nemapoka 144. Mutsara 1 wakakopa dambudziko zvakanaka, uye 144 mumutsara 3 yakarurama seleast common multiple ye48 ne36.
20261124-math-g05-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye ufunge kana zvinotaurwa zvichigoneka muchokwadi mumamiriro emaswiti 48 nema chocolates 36.
20261124-math-g05-1.actionItem: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo muchigadziriso apo hukama husina kururama pakati penhamba (factor/multiple) hwakasarudzwa, uye ufunge nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mamiriro.

20261124-math-g05-2.title: Kana Avhareji Dzakafanana, Mapoka Maviri Akafanana Here?
20261124-math-g05-2.summary: Boka reSky neboka reSea rimwe nerimwe rakatumira vanhu 4 kumakwikwi ekusvetuka tambo. Marekodhi eboka reSky (huwandu hwekusvetuka) ndi 20, 22, 24, ne 54, uye marekodhi eboka reSea ndi 28, 29, 30, ne 33. Avhareji dzemapoka ese maviri dzakafanana, 30. Doha akati, "Avhareji dzakafanana, saka mapoka maviri akanaka zvakaenzana."
20261124-math-g05-2.principle: Avhareji ndi (huwandu hwezvose)÷(huwandu hwevanhu), saka kana huwandu hwevanhu hwakafanana uye avhareji dzakafanana, huwandu hwose hwakafananawo (zvese ndi 120). Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kukosha kukuru, kukosha kudiki, nekuti kwakaparadzirwa sei zvakafanana.
20261124-math-g05-2.example: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana yakarurama pamarekodhi eboka reSky neboka reSea.
20261124-math-g05-2.actionItem: Tarisa, nedata nemuenzaniso waunogadzira iwe pachako, kuti kunyange kana avhareji dzakafanana, kuti data rakaparadzirwa sei kunogona kusiyana, uye uparadzanise zvinotaurwa neavhareji nezvisingakwanisi kutaura.

20261124-math-g06-1.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
20261124-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
20261124-math-g06-1.principle: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
20261124-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
20261124-math-g06-1.actionItem: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.

20261124-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261124-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261124-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261124-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261124-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261124-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261124-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261124-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261124-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261124-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261124-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261124-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261124-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261124-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261124-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261124-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261124-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261124-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261124-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261124-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261124-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261124-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261124-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261124-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'
20261124-math-g08-2.actionItem: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.

20261124-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261124-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261124-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261124-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261124-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261124-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261124-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261124-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261124-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261124-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261124-math-g10-1.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
20261124-math-g10-1.summary: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
20261124-math-g10-1.principle: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
20261124-math-g10-1.example: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
20261124-math-g10-1.actionItem: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.

20261124-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261124-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261124-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261124-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
20261124-math-g10-2.actionItem: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.

20261124-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261124-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261124-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261124-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261124-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261124-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261124-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261124-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261124-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261124-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261124-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261124-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261124-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261124-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.
20261124-math-g12-1.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kuwana conditional probability, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti nei accuracy yetest yakasiyana ne 'mukana wekurwara kana mhedzisiro ipositive'.

20261124-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261124-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261124-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261124-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.
20261124-math-g12-2.actionItem: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.

20261125-math-g01-1.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
20261125-math-g01-1.summary: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
20261125-math-g01-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
20261125-math-g01-1.example: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
20261125-math-g01-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.

20261125-math-g01-2.title: Kureba kwakayerwa nemapepa clips nemaglue sticks: ndechipi chakareba zvikuru?
20261125-math-g01-2.summary: Minjun akayera kureba kwepeni nemapepa clips ndokuwana mapepa clips 5. Seoyun akayera kureba kwepeni yeruvara nemaglue sticks (glue yakaita tsvimbo) ndokuwana maglue sticks 3. Vose vakaaisa nemutsetse mumwe padivi pasina mapako. Chipi chakareba, peni here kana peni yeruvara?
20261125-math-g01-2.principle: Pepa clip neglue stick zvakareba zvakasiyana, saka haugoni kufananidza uchitarisa 5 ne3 chete. Kana uchiziva kuti glue stick 1 mapepa clips mangani, unogona kufananidza muchikamu chimwe chete, uye unogonawo kufananidza peni nepeni yeruvara zvakananga nekuenzanisa mugumo umwe.
20261125-math-g01-2.example: Pepa clip rimwe rakareba sa glue stick rimwe here? Funga izvozvo kutanga.
20261125-math-g01-2.actionItem: Dzidza kuti kureba kwakayerwa nezvikamu zvakasiyana hakugoni kufananidzwa nehuwandu hwoga, uye sarudza kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodiwa kuzvifananidza.

20261125-math-g02-1.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
20261125-math-g02-1.summary: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
20261125-math-g02-1.principle: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.
20261125-math-g02-1.example: Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
20261125-math-g02-1.actionItem: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.

20261125-math-g02-2.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
20261125-math-g02-2.summary:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
20261125-math-g02-2.principle: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
20261125-math-g02-2.example: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
20261125-math-g02-2.actionItem: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.

20261125-math-g03-1.title: Nzira Dzakasiyana Dzekugovera Zvihwitsi 72 Zvakaenzana Pamaplate
20261125-math-g03-1.summary: Unoda kuisa zvihwitsi 72 pamaplate, uchizvigovera zvakaenzana pasina zvasara. Huwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega hunoshanduka zvichienderana nokuti unoshandisa maplate mangani.
20261125-math-g03-1.principle: Unogona kugovera zvihwitsi zvakaenzana pasina zvasara kana huwandu hwemaplate hunowanzwa nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe hwuri 72 chete. 4×18, 6×12, ne 9×8 ndi 72, uye hapana nhamba inowanzwa ne 5 kana 7 inoita 72.
20261125-math-g03-1.example: Kune huwandu hwemaplate hwese, kamura 72 nehuwandu uhwo uye utarise kana pane chasara.
20261125-math-g03-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nzira dzakati wandei dzekugovera dzinosangana nemamiriro (huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rega rega) panguva imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemaplate nehuwandu hwezvihwitsi paplate rimwe zvinobatana sei.

20261125-math-g03-2.title: Kutsvaga kanganiso mukugovera zvihwitsi kwaSeoyeon
20261125-math-g03-2.summary: Seoyeon anoda kugovera zvihwitsi 85 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 4. Verenga mhinduro yaSeoyeon. Quotient ndiyo nhamba inowanikwa nemunhu wega wega, uye chasara ndiyo nhamba yasara mushure mekugovera.
20261125-math-g03-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 wakanganisa. Zvihwitsi 5 zvasara zvinogona kugoverwa zvakare, chihwitsi 1 zvakare kune vanhu 4 vese, saka kutaura 'hazvigoni kugoverwa zvakare' hakurevi chokwadi. Kutarisa kwemutsetse 4 kunongoratidza kuti number sentence inobatana; hakutauri kana chasara chakarurama.
20261125-math-g03-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, verenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kana zvinotaurwa zvakadaro chaizvo.
20261125-math-g03-2.actionItem: Shandisa mamiriro okuti chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura divisor kuwana nekugadzirisa kanganiso mumhinduro, uye uparadzanise nyaya apo kanganiso imwe chete inoitika neapo isingaitike.

20261125-math-g04-1.title: Kutarisa Tsananguro yaSeohyeon
20261125-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon akatsanangura izvi kushamwari. Pane kukanganisa mutsananguro iyi.
20261125-math-g04-1.principle: Mutsara 3 ndipo painotanga kukanganisa. Square ine mativi mana akaenzana, asi izvi hazvireve zvakapesana, "kana mativi mana akaenzana, ndeye square." Mutsara 4 unoronzera kukanganisa kumwe chete, asi nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama ndi mutsara 3.
20261125-math-g04-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa zvakare mufomu "kana ..., ipapo ...," uye nyora kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti unoenda munzira imwe chete nechirevo chiri mumutsara wapfuura here.
20261125-math-g04-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kukanganisa kwelogic mutsananguro inoti 'Kana mativi mana ose akafanana, ndeye square,' uye utsanangure quadrilateral iri muenzaniso unopikisa.

20261125-math-g04-2.title: Zvakanganisa kupi pakushandura kuva nhamba?
20261125-math-g04-2.summary: Minseo akanyora mhinduro yekunyora 'zviuru zvitatu makumi maviri nemashanu magumi ezviuru, zviuru zvina matanhatu' nenhamba.
20261125-math-g04-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Muzviuru zvina matanhatu, nzvimbo yezviuru ndi 4 uye nzvimbo yeimwe ndi 6, uye nzvimbo dzemazana negumi hadzina kuverengwa asi ndi 0, saka ndi 4006. Mitsetse 4 ne 5 yakanganisa nokuti inoenderera nekukosha kwakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 3.
20261125-math-g04-2.example: Kune mutsetse wega wega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana 'mazwi akaverengwa' ne 'nhamba dzakanyorwa' zvichiwirirana.
20261125-math-g04-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandura nhamba huru yakaverengwa nemazwi kuva nhamba, uye uigadzirise uchishandisa ma 0 munzvimbo dzakange dzisina kuverengwa.

20261125-math-g05-1.title: Huwandu Hwemapoka Ekugovana Zvakaenzana: Kugadzirisa Chigadziriso
20261125-math-g05-1.summary: Unoda kugovera maswiti 48 nema chocolates 36 zvakaenzana pasina chinosara pakati pemapoka akawanda. Hayun akawana huwandu hwemapoka seizvi.
20261125-math-g05-1.principle: Mutsara 2 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Huwandu hwemapoka anogovera 48 zvakaenzana hunofanira kuva nhamba inopatsanura 48 zvakaenzana, ndiko kuti, factor ye48. Multiple inogona kuva huru kupfuura 48, uye ipapo maswiti haakwani. Mutsara 4 unotaurawo chinhu chaizosiya mamwe maboka asina kana switi imwe nemapoka 144. Mutsara 1 wakakopa dambudziko zvakanaka, uye 144 mumutsara 3 yakarurama seleast common multiple ye48 ne36.
20261125-math-g05-1.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye ufunge kana zvinotaurwa zvichigoneka muchokwadi mumamiriro emaswiti 48 nema chocolates 36.
20261125-math-g05-1.actionItem: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise nzvimbo muchigadziriso apo hukama husina kururama pakati penhamba (factor/multiple) hwakasarudzwa, uye ufunge nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mamiriro.

20261125-math-g05-2.title: Kana Avhareji Dzakafanana, Mapoka Maviri Akafanana Here?
20261125-math-g05-2.summary: Boka reSky neboka reSea rimwe nerimwe rakatumira vanhu 4 kumakwikwi ekusvetuka tambo. Marekodhi eboka reSky (huwandu hwekusvetuka) ndi 20, 22, 24, ne 54, uye marekodhi eboka reSea ndi 28, 29, 30, ne 33. Avhareji dzemapoka ese maviri dzakafanana, 30. Doha akati, "Avhareji dzakafanana, saka mapoka maviri akanaka zvakaenzana."
20261125-math-g05-2.principle: Avhareji ndi (huwandu hwezvose)÷(huwandu hwevanhu), saka kana huwandu hwevanhu hwakafanana uye avhareji dzakafanana, huwandu hwose hwakafananawo (zvese ndi 120). Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kukosha kukuru, kukosha kudiki, nekuti kwakaparadzirwa sei zvakafanana.
20261125-math-g05-2.example: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana yakarurama pamarekodhi eboka reSky neboka reSea.
20261125-math-g05-2.actionItem: Tarisa, nedata nemuenzaniso waunogadzira iwe pachako, kuti kunyange kana avhareji dzakafanana, kuti data rakaparadzirwa sei kunogona kusiyana, uye uparadzanise zvinotaurwa neavhareji nezvisingakwanisi kutaura.

20261125-math-g06-1.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
20261125-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
20261125-math-g06-1.principle: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
20261125-math-g06-1.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
20261125-math-g06-1.actionItem: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.

20261125-math-g06-2.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
20261125-math-g06-2.summary: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
20261125-math-g06-2.principle: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
20261125-math-g06-2.example: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
20261125-math-g06-2.actionItem: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.

20261125-math-g07-1.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
20261125-math-g07-1.summary:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."
20261125-math-g07-1.principle: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.
20261125-math-g07-1.example: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
20261125-math-g07-1.actionItem: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.

20261125-math-g07-2.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi
20261125-math-g07-2.summary: Takayera kukwirira kwemvura apo tichidira mvura mutangi. Axis yakatwasuka ndiyo nguva (maminitsi) uye axis yakamira ndiko kukwirira (cm). Tinonyora (nguva, kukwirira) semaviri akarongwa uye tinoriisa sepoindi pa coordinate plane. Mapoindi akati wandei anoratidzwa panguva imwe.
20261125-math-g07-2.principle: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.
20261125-math-g07-2.example: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
20261125-math-g07-2.actionItem: Mapoindi paanowedzerwa rimwe nerimwe, fungidzira muenzaniso, gadzirisa kufanotaura kwako kana mapoindi matsva aoneka, uye funga kana uchigona kuva nechokwadi chemakosha pakati pemapoindi.

20261125-math-g08-1.title: Tinoda manotsi api kutsvaga mitengo?
20261125-math-g08-1.summary: Tinoda kuziva mutengo wepencil imwe, x won, nemutengo wenotebook imwe, y won, pachitoro chezvinyorwa. Muridzi akatiratidza manotsi 5 ari echokwadi. Note A: ma pencil 2 nema notebook 3 zvinodhura 3,100 won. Note B: ma pencil 4 nema notebook 6 zvinodhura 6,200 won. Note C: Notebook inodhura 200 won kupfuura pencil. Note D: ma pencil 6 nema notebook 9 zvinodhura 9,300 won. Note E: ma pencil 5 nema notebook 5 zvinodhura 6,000 won.
20261125-math-g08-1.principle: Manotsi A, B, ne D ane reshiyo imwe chete yemapensera kumabhuku, 2:3, uye mari yawo ndiyo multiples dzakafanana (nguva 1, nguva 2, nguva 3), saka anodzokorora ruzivo rumwe chete. Nemanotsi aya chete, haugoni kugadzika mhinduro imwe chete. Kana ukaita pairi remanotsi ane mareshiyo ehuwandu akasiyana (C, E), equations mbiri dzinopa ruzivo rwakasiyana, saka makoshero anogadzikwa. (Pensera 500원, bhuku rekunyora 700원)
20261125-math-g08-1.example: Nyora patsva manotsi muchimiro che 'mapensera □ + mabhuku □ = □원' uye ufananidze manotsi maviri padivi nedivi.
20261125-math-g08-1.actionItem: Kana uchigadzira simultaneous equation, tonga kuti ma equation anopa ruzivo rwakasiyana here, uye gadzira equation isingapi ruzivo rutsva iwe pachako.

20261125-math-g08-2.title: Mukana wemusoro mumwe chete nemari mbiri
20261125-math-g08-2.summary: Kanda mari mbiri dzakarurama panguva imwe chete, kamwe chete. Kana ukatsanangura mhedzisiro nehuwandu hwemisoro chete, ndi 0, 1, kana 2. Tarisa kuti kufunga kwako pamusoro pe 'mukana wemusoro 1 chaizvo' kunoshanduka sei nehumbowo.
20261125-math-g08-2.principle: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.
20261125-math-g08-2.example: Kutanga funga kuti kutonga kupi kunogoneka 'kubva paumbowo hwaunogona kuona izvozvi chete.'
20261125-math-g08-2.actionItem: Tarisa nehumbowo kuti nyaya dzinoverengwa ne 'huwandu hwemisoro' hadziiti zvakaenzana kazhinji, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga pamusoro pemukana.

20261125-math-g09-1.title: Kana sin A=3/5, zvakafanana kunyange triangle ichikura here?
20261125-math-g09-1.summary: Muright triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, divi BC idivi riri kupesana ne ∠A, divi AC idivi riri padhuze ne ∠A (risiri hypotenuse), uye divi AB ihypotenuse. sin A inoverengwa 'sine A' uye cos A inoverengwa 'cosine A.' Mumatriangle aya, sin A=3/5 (3 pamusoro pe5).
20261125-math-g09-1.principle: Kana ukakudza mativi ose matatu nenhamba imwe chete, seye (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 inoramba yakafanana.
20261125-math-g09-1.example: Semuenzaniso wakareruka zvikuru, kana BC=3 ne AB=5, wana kureba kwedivi rakasara AC nePythagorean theorem.
20261125-math-g09-1.actionItem: Gadzira matriangle akawanda eright ane kukosha kwe sin A kwakafanana, ongorora zvirevo zvevadzidzi vaviri uchishandisa mhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti nei trigonometric ratio ichigadzikwa nehukuru hweangle.

20261125-math-g09-2.title: Tinofanira kubvunza chii kuti tigadzike quadratic function imwe chete?
20261125-math-g09-2.summary: Tinoda kuwana equation yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a haisi 0). (y inoverengwa 'y equals a x squared plus b x plus c.') Shamwari ichakuudza ruzivo nezvegirafu chidimbu nechidimbu.
20261125-math-g09-2.principle: 'Vertex nepoinzi imwe' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-2)²-1, izvo zvinopa a=1. 'Mapoinzi matatu' inogadziriswa nekuisa (0, 3) muna y=a(x-1)(x-3), izvo zvinopa a=1. Kune zvimwe zvikamu zvitatu zveruzivo, kukosha kwe a kana hurefu hwevertex hazvigadziki, saka pane equations dzakawanda.
20261125-math-g09-2.example: Rongedza kana pane quadratic functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzakasiyana dzinokodzera ruzivo rwega rwega.
20261125-math-g09-2.actionItem: Rongedza ruzivo rwakakwana kugadzika equation imwe chete yequadratic function y=ax²+bx+c neruzivo rusingakwani, uye usarudze mubvunzo wekuwedzera wekubvunza kana usingakwani.

20261125-math-g10-1.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
20261125-math-g10-1.summary: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
20261125-math-g10-1.principle: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
20261125-math-g10-1.example: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
20261125-math-g10-1.actionItem: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.

20261125-math-g10-2.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
20261125-math-g10-2.summary: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
20261125-math-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
20261125-math-g10-2.example: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
20261125-math-g10-2.actionItem: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.

20261125-math-g11-1.title: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro ye logarithmic equation ine dambudziko
20261125-math-g11-1.summary: Minho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 akapindura, ‘Ma solution ndi x=5 ne x=−1, maviri.’ Kana ukaiverenga, ndiyo ‘log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 1) kuwedzera log base 2 ye (x kubvisa 3) inoenzana ne3’.
20261125-math-g11-1.principle: Nzvimbo yekutanga painokanganisa ndi mutsara 2. Kana huwandu hwema logarithm maviri hwabatanidzwa kuita logarithm imwe, mamiriro e argument x−1>0 ne x−3>0 anonyangarika mu expression, uye mamiriro iwayo haana kunyorwa zvakaparadzana. Saka mumutsara 5 ma root ose maviri akabvumirwa, uye mutsara 6 ndiyo mhedziso iyoyo. Argument inofanira kuva positive, saka x>3 inodiwa. Kana x=−1, ipapo x−1=−2 ne x−3=−4, ma argument ndenegative, saka equation haina kutsanangurwa. Kana x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, saka inoshanda. Saka solution ndiko kukosha kumwe chete x=5.
20261125-math-g11-1.example: Nguva imwe neimwe expression ichichinja, verenga uchitarisa kuti inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nemutsara wapfuura.
20261125-math-g11-1.actionItem: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa dambudziko rinokonzerwa nekusatarisa mamiriro e argument mumhinduro ye logarithmic equation.

20261125-math-g11-2.title: Ma triangles mangani anogona kugadzirwa kubva pamativi maviri neangle imwe?
20261125-math-g11-2.summary: Mu triangle ABC, ∠A=60° uye kureba kwedivi BC i a=7. Kana kureba kwedivi CA, b, kwapiwa, unogona kusarudza kureba c kwedivi AB uye ugadzire triangle. (a, b, c i mativi ari pakatarisana ne ∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) Gaeun akati, 'Kana b i yakakura kupfuura 7, ma triangles maviri anogara achigadzirwa.'
20261125-math-g11-2.principle: Kubva ku 49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, saka c=3 kana 5. Mitengo yose mbiri i positive, saka ma triangles maviri anogona kugadzirwa.
20261125-math-g11-2.example: Isa a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines uye unyore equation ye c.
20261125-math-g11-2.actionItem: Edza kuwanza kwekuti 'kunogara kuri maviri' nemitengo chaiyo uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti hakushandi mumamiriro api.

20261125-math-g12-1.title: Inoti positive, asi munhu uyu anorwara chaizvo here?
20261125-math-g12-1.summary: Test yechirwere chakati yakabuda 'positive'. Unoda kuziva mukana wekuti munhu ane mhedzisiro yepositive anorwara chaizvo here. Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kusarudza mukana uyu.
20261125-math-g12-1.principle: Vaya vakaita positive vanoitwa 'varwere vakaita positive' ne 'vanhu vakasimba vakaita positive'. Saka unoda chikamu chevarwere, mukana wekuti murwere aite positive, nemukana wekuti munhu akasimba aite positive.
20261125-math-g12-1.example: Girai kuti vanhu vakaita positive vanogona kupatsanurwa kuita maboka maviri api.
20261125-math-g12-1.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa kuwana conditional probability, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti nei accuracy yetest yakasiyana ne 'mukana wekurwara kana mhedzisiro ipositive'.

20261125-math-g12-2.title: Kana divi tsvuku riri kuoneka, chii nechemuseri?
20261125-math-g12-2.summary: Pane makadhi matatu mubhokisi. Rimwe rine tsvuku kumativi ose maviri (kadhi tsvuku-tsvuku), rimwe rine tsvuku kudivi rimwe neblue kune rimwe (kadhi tsvuku-blue), uye rimwe rine blue kumativi ose maviri (kadhi blue-blue). Unobvisa kadhi rimwe nemukana uye uisa divi rimwe patafura, uye tsvuku iri kuoneka. Funga nezvemukana wekuti divi remuseri ritsvukawo.
20261125-math-g12-2.principle: Gadzirisa fungidziro yako yekutanga (1/2) uchishandisa data nekuongorora, uye utsvage mutsara upi wefungidziro wakaipa kuti ududze conditional probability zvakarurama.
20261125-math-g12-2.example: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora kuti ndedzipi nyaya dzauri kuverenga.

20261122-physics-g01-1.principle: Pakati pemapole akasiyana emagineti (N neS) pane simba rekudhonza (attraction), uye pakati pemapole akafanana pane simba rekudzvanyirana (repulsion).
20261122-physics-g01-1.example: Fungai zvinoitika kana mapole akasiyana emagineti asangana.
20261122-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g01-2.title: Zvinhu zvinonamira pamagineti nesimba remagineti
20261122-physics-g01-2.summary: Paperewa mukombe wepurasitiki wakajeka makaiswa clip yesimbi, uye magineti yakaiswa kunze kwemukombe. Clip inoitwei kana magineti ichikwidzwa zvishoma nezvishoma?
20261122-physics-g01-2.principle: Simba remagineti (magnetic force) rinogona kupfuura zvinhu zvitete zvakaita sepurasitiki, pepa negirazi uye kushandira pazvinhu zvesimbi.
20261122-physics-g01-2.example: Simba remagineti rinogona kupfuura purasitiki kana pepa zvitete.
20261122-physics-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g02-1.title: Kudengenyeka nekutamiswa kweruzha
20261122-physics-g02-1.summary: Ndechipi chinoitika kana tuning fork yarohwa nesando yerabha ichibatwa zvishoma pamusoro pemvura mubhesheni?
20261122-physics-g02-1.principle: Tuning fork inorira iri kudengenyeka (vibrating), saka kana yabata mvura inopfapfaidzira mvura kumativi ose uye ichiita mafungu.
20261122-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g02-2.title: Kudengenyeka nekutamiswa kweruzha
20261122-physics-g02-2.summary: Kana vanhu vaviri vachitaura nefoni yenyere yakagadzirwa nemakapu maviri epepa nenyere, ndeipi nzira inoita kuti izwi romumwe munhu rinzwike zvakajeka?
20261122-physics-g02-2.principle: Mufoni wenyere, kudengenyeka kwepasi pekapu yepepa kunotamiswa nenyere, saka nyere inofanira kutambanuka kuti kudengenyeka kuende kune rimwe divi zvakanaka.
20261122-physics-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g03-1.title: Kufamba chakananga kwechiedza nekushanduka kwemimvuri
20261122-physics-g03-1.summary: Mapepa matatu ane mukaha akaiswa achiteverana pamberi pechiedza chetochi. Mukaha inofanira kurongwa sei kuti chiedza chionekwe kune rimwe divi?
20261122-physics-g03-1.principle: Chiedza chinofamba chakananga (rectilinear propagation of light), saka chinogona kupfuura mikaha yose chete kana mikaha mitatu iri pamutsetse mumwe chete.
20261122-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g03-2.title: Kufamba chakananga kwechiedza nekushanduka kwemimvuri
20261122-physics-g03-2.summary: Tinoda kuti mumvuri wedoro rebheya pascreen ukure kupfuura zvawuri izvozvi. Nzira ipi yakakodzera?
20261122-physics-g03-2.principle: Kana kureba pakati pesosi yechiedza (tochi) nechinhu kuchiderera, kona inovharwa nechinhu inowedzera, saka mumvuri unoonekwa pascreen unokura.
20261122-physics-g03-2.example: Chinhu chikaswedera pedyo nenzvimbo inobva chiedza, nzvimbo inovharira chiedza inoita yakakura.
20261122-physics-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g04-1.title: Bharanzi yemaoko maviri nemusimboti webharanzi
20261122-physics-g04-1.summary: Chizito chinorema 20 g chakasungirirwa panzvimbo ina dzakaenzana kuruboshwe kubva pafulcrum yebharanzi. Chizito chinofanira kusungirirwa kurudyi panzvimbo mbiri kubva pafulcrum kuti pave nebharanzi chinorema marii?
20261122-physics-g04-1.principle: Maererano nomusimboti webharanzi, moment yekuruboshwe ($4\text{ nzvimbo} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) inofanira kuenzana nemoment yekurudyi ($2\text{ nzvimbo} \times ? = 80$), saka chizito che $40\text{ g}$ chinofanira kusungirirwa.
20261122-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g04-2.title: Bharanzi yemaoko maviri nemusimboti webharanzi
20261122-physics-g04-2.summary: Mukoma anorema 40 kg nomunin'ina anorema 20 kg vari kutamba seesaw. Vanofanira kugara sei kuti vave nebharanzi vachifara?
20261122-physics-g04-2.principle: Mukoma anorema ($40\text{ kg}$) anofanira kugara padyo nefulcrum nehafu yekureba kwemunin'ina anorema zvishoma ($20\text{ kg}$) kuti vave nebharanzi.
20261122-physics-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g05-1.title: Tsananguro nekuenzanisa kwe speed
20261122-physics-g05-1.summary: Ndechipi chirevo chesainzi chakarurama chekuenzanisa kumhanya (speed) kwezvinhu?
20261122-physics-g05-1.principle: Kana mukufamba kwakafanana, nguva shoma inoreva kumhanya kwakakura; kana nguva yakafanana, kureba kwekufamba kuchikura, speed inova yakakura.
20261122-physics-g05-1.example: Mumujaho wekumhanya, mukwikwidzi wekutanga ndiye anotora nguva pfupi kusvika pamutsara wekupedzisira.
20261122-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g05-2.title: Tsananguro nekuenzanisa kwe speed
20261122-physics-g05-2.summary: Kana uchironga kuedza kwakanaka kwekuenzanisa speed yebhora resimbi rinodonha mugwenga rine mativi akasiyana, ndechipi chisiri 'chimiro chinofanira kuramba chakaenzana (controlled variable)'?
20261122-physics-g05-2.principle: Nokuti tiri kuongorora speed maererano nekona yegwenga, kona yegwenga ndiyo 'manipulated variable' inofanira kushandurwa, uye zvimwe zvose zvinofanira kuramba zvakaenzana.
20261122-physics-g05-2.example: Tsvakai chimiro chatinoshandura kuti tiwane (independent variable).
20261122-physics-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g06-1.title: Kubatanidza electric circuit nemufananidzo we convex lens
20261122-physics-g06-1.summary: Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe, mabhaibhi maviri, uye switch zvakabatanidzwa nemawaya. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chemamiriro e'closed circuit' unoita kuti mabhaibhi abvire?
20261122-physics-g06-1.principle: Kuti current ifambe, pane kudiwa closed circuit inobatanidzwa pasina kutyoka kubva papole imwe yebhatiri, kuburikidza nezvikamu zvemagetsi, kusvika papole yakatarisana nayo.
20261122-physics-g06-1.example: Current inogona kufamba kana waya ichibatana pasina kutyoka.
20261122-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g06-2.title: Kubatanidza electric circuit nemufananidzo we convex lens
20261122-physics-g06-2.summary: Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chekuenzanisa circuit ine mabhaibhi maviri akaenzana akabatanidzwa mu series nemu parallel?
20261122-physics-g06-2.principle: Kana mabhaibhi akabatanidzwa mu parallel, bhaibhi rimwe nerimwe rinowana voltage yose yebhatiri, saka rinopenya zvikuru, uye kana rimwe rikatsemuka, mamwe anoramba achishanda.
20261122-physics-g06-2.example: Fungai kana mumba umwe wamira kubvirwa asi chivanze chichiri kuvira mumba.
20261122-physics-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g07-1.title: Gravity, friction nekuenzana kwe buoyant force
20261122-physics-g07-1.summary: Muzvino wemuchadenga ane mass ye 60 kg paPasi akasvika pamusoro peMwedzi. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama pamusoro pe'mass' ne'weight' paMwedzi? (Gravity yeMwedzi i 1/6 yePasi)
20261122-physics-g07-1.principle: Mass idhizaini yechinhu chinoumba chinhu, saka inoramba yakaenzana (60 kg) pamwe nepamwe, asi weight isimba regravity, saka paMwedzi inoderera kuita 1/6 yepaPasi, inenge 98 N.
20261122-physics-g07-1.example: Mass idhizaini yechinhu chimwe chete saka haichinji kunyangwe nzvimbo ichichinja.
20261122-physics-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g07-2.title: Gravity, friction nekuenzana kwe buoyant force
20261122-physics-g07-2.summary: Chidimbu chemuti chakaiswa pamusoro pe sandpaper nepamusoro pegirazi, ndokudhonzwa ne spring scale kuyera static friction yepamusoro. Ndechipi chiri pakati pezvinofanira kuramba zvakaenzana (controlled variables) chisina kururama?
20261122-physics-g07-2.principle: Nokuti kuedza uku kuri kuyera shanduko ye friction maererano nokuoma kwepamusoro pakubatana, 'kuoma kwepasi' ndiyo manipulated variable, uye haifaniri kuiswa yakaenzana.
20261122-physics-g07-2.example: Chinangwa chekuedza uku ndechekuona musiyano wefriction maererano 'nemhando (kuoma) yepamusoro pakubatana'.
20261122-physics-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g08-1.title: Mutemo waOhm ne heat capacity
20261122-physics-g08-1.summary: Waya ye nichrome ine resistance ye 10 Ω yakaiswa voltage ye 30 V. Current inofamba mu waya iyi i yakaenzana nei?
20261122-physics-g08-1.principle: Maererano nemutemo waOhm, current $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g08-2.title: Mutemo waOhm ne heat capacity
20261122-physics-g08-2.summary: Current inofamba mu waya yakananga kubva pasi kuenda kumusoro. Compass ine pole N yakaiswa kuchamhembe kwewaya iri pedyo. Ichatenderera kuenda kupi maererano nemutemo wekuruboshwe kurudyi waAmpere (right-hand rule)?
20261122-physics-g08-2.principle: Kana chigunwe chekurudyi chakatarisa kunzvimbo yecurrent (kumusoro), magnetic field yakaita denderedzwa inogadzirwa nezvigunwe zvina inoenda kumadokero kuchamhembe kwewaya, saka pole N yecompass inotenderera kumadokero.
20261122-physics-g08-2.example: Isai chigunwe chekurudyi chakamira kunzvimbo yecurrent (kumusoro) mozopeta zvimwe zvigunwe zvina.
20261122-physics-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g09-1.title: Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy
20261122-physics-g09-1.summary: Mufizikisi, mamiriro api anoita kuti huwandu 'hwebasa rasainzi' huve 0?
20261122-physics-g09-1.principle: Kana uchifamba uchitakura bhokisi nenzira yakachinjika, simba rinoshanda (simba rokumusoro rinotsigira gravity) uye nzira yokufamba (yakachinjika) zvinogadzira kona ye $90^\circ$ yakarurama, saka hapana chikamu chesimba munzira yokufamba, uye basa rakaitwa ndere $0$.
20261122-physics-g09-1.example: Basa rasainzi W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261122-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g09-2.title: Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy
20261122-physics-g09-2.summary: Vakachinja huremu nokumhanya kwegoridhe uye vakariita kuti rirovere chimedu chomuti, vakayera kureba kwakasundwa chimedu chomuti. Ndeipi mhedziso chaiyo pamusoro pekinetic energy?
20261122-physics-g09-2.principle: Kinetic energy ndi $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$ saka inoenderana nehuremu hwechinhu uye nesquare yokumhanya.
20261122-physics-g09-2.example: Fomula yekinetic energy: E_k = (1/2) m v²
20261122-physics-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g10-1.title: Kudhumhana nekuchengetedzeka, horizontal projectile negravity
20261122-physics-g10-1.summary: Pedyo nepasi, mabhora maviri esimbi A naB ari pakukwirira kumwe chete. A inosiiwa ichidonha pachena, B inokandwa zvakasimba nenzira yakachinjika. Ndeipi tsananguro chaiyo pamusoro pokufamba kwemabhora maviri? (Usatarise kuramba kwemhepo)
20261122-physics-g10-1.principle: Kufamba kwakaenzana kwakachinjika nokudonha pachena kwakatwasuka zvinozvimirira. Mabhora ose maviri anodonha nenzira yakatwasuka nechikurumidziro chimwe chete chegravity $g$, saka anosvika pasi panguva imwe chete.
20261122-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g10-2.title: Kudhumhana nekuchengetedzeka, horizontal projectile negravity
20261122-physics-g10-2.summary: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva pakukwirira kumwe chete, rimwe pasimende uye rimwe pamusoro pegaba rakapfava. Kubva pandimomwe raibata pasi kusvika raimira, ndeipi kuenzanisa chaiko kwemaquantity efizikisi?
20261122-physics-g10-2.principle: Momentum change ($\Delta p$) yemazai maviri yakaenzana, saka impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) yakaenzana. Gaba rinowedzera nguva yokurova $\Delta t$, richideredza simba pakati rokurova $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, saka izai harikuputike.
20261122-physics-g10-2.example: Sezvo akadonha kubva pakukwirira kumwe chete, kumhanya risati rarova nokushanduka kwemomentum (momentum change = impulse) kwakaenzana.
20261122-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g11-1.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity
20261122-physics-g11-1.summary: Musiyano wakakosha wefizikisi pakati peizvo 'action-reaction relationship' ne 'equilibrium of two forces' ndeupi?
20261122-physics-g11-1.principle: Action-reaction inoshanda pazvinhu zviviri zvinobatana zvakasiyana, saka masimba maviri haagoni kubatanidzwa, asi equilibrium yesimba ine nzvimbo yokushanda pachinhu chimwe, saka masimba anogona kubatanidzwa uye net force inova 0.
20261122-physics-g11-1.example: Action-reaction: simba rinosundwa naA paB nesimba rinosundwa naB paA
20261122-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g11-2.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity
20261122-physics-g11-2.summary: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina friction, chinhu A chine huremu hwe3 kg nechinhu B chine huremu hwe2 kg zvakaiswa zvichibatana, uye simba rakachinjika re20 N rinoshandiswa kutsvaira kubva kuA. Chikurumidziro chezvinhu zviviri uye simba rinosundwa naA paB ndeapi?
20261122-physics-g11-2.principle: Chikurumidziro chose ndi $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Net force inokurumidza chinhu B ndiyo simba rokubata rinosundwa naA chete, saka $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261122-physics-g11-2.example: Sisitimu yose (A+B): F = (m_A + m_B) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261122-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-1.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
20261122-physics-g12-1.summary: Pamhedziso dzeEinstein dzephotoelectric effect, chokwadi chipi chisingagoni kutsanangurwa 'nethe wave theory yechiedza' asi chinotsanangurwa zvakakwana chete 'nephoton theory (particle theory)'?
20261122-physics-g12-1.principle: Wave theory inofanotaura kuunganidzwa kwesimba nenguva, asi mu photoelectric effect photon imwe chete inopfuura threshold frequency inorovera electron nokukasira uye inoendesa simba, saka electron inobuda pasina kuvhiringidzwa nenguva.
20261122-physics-g12-1.example: Wave theory inofanira kuti chiedza chakadzikira chinofanira kusiya electron kana simba rakaunganidzwa nenguva, asi chaizvo chinosiya nokukasira.
20261122-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-2.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
20261122-physics-g12-2.summary: Charged particle ine huremu m uye charge q inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana B nokumhanya v uye inoita uniform circular motion. Radius r netenguva T yeorbit yechinhu iyi ndeipi?
20261122-physics-g12-2.principle: Centripetal force equation ndi $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Nguva ndi $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, uye zvinoshamisa kuti ine cyclotron period isingaenderani neradius yeorbit kana kumhanya.
20261122-physics-g12-2.example: Lorentz force inoshanda sa centripetal force: q v B = m v² / r
20261122-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g09-2.title: Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy

20261123-physics-g10-1.title: Kudhumhana nekuchengetedzeka, horizontal projectile negravity

20261123-physics-g10-2.title: Kudhumhana nekuchengetedzeka, horizontal projectile negravity
