20261123-physics-g10-2.principle: Momentum change ($\Delta p$) yemazai maviri yakaenzana, saka impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) yakaenzana. Gaba rinowedzera nguva yokurova $\Delta t$, richideredza simba pakati rokurova $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, saka izai harikuputike.

20261123-physics-g11-1.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity
20261123-physics-g11-1.summary: Musiyano wakakosha wefizikisi pakati peizvo 'action-reaction relationship' ne 'equilibrium of two forces' ndeupi?
20261123-physics-g11-1.principle: Action-reaction inoshanda pazvinhu zviviri zvinobatana zvakasiyana, saka masimba maviri haagoni kubatanidzwa, asi equilibrium yesimba ine nzvimbo yokushanda pachinhu chimwe, saka masimba anogona kubatanidzwa uye net force inova 0.

20261123-physics-g11-2.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity
20261123-physics-g11-2.summary: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina friction, chinhu A chine huremu hwe3 kg nechinhu B chine huremu hwe2 kg zvakaiswa zvichibatana, uye simba rakachinjika re20 N rinoshandiswa kutsvaira kubva kuA. Chikurumidziro chezvinhu zviviri uye simba rinosundwa naA paB ndeapi?
20261123-physics-g11-2.principle: Chikurumidziro chose ndi $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Net force inokurumidza chinhu B ndiyo simba rokubata rinosundwa naA chete, saka $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261123-physics-g11-2.example: Sisitimu yose (A+B): F = (m_A + m_B) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a

20261123-physics-g12-2.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
20261123-physics-g12-2.summary: Charged particle ine huremu m uye charge q inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana B nokumhanya v uye inoita uniform circular motion. Radius r netenguva T yeorbit yechinhu iyi ndeipi?
20261123-physics-g12-2.principle: Centripetal force equation ndi $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Nguva ndi $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, uye zvinoshamisa kuti ine cyclotron period isingaenderani neradius yeorbit kana kumhanya.
20261123-physics-g12-2.example: Lorentz force inoshanda sa centripetal force: q v B = m v² / r

20261124-physics-g11-1.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity

20261124-physics-g11-1.principle: Action-reaction inoshanda pazvinhu zviviri zvinobatana zvakasiyana, saka masimba maviri haagoni kubatanidzwa, asi equilibrium yesimba ine nzvimbo yokushanda pachinhu chimwe, saka masimba anogona kubatanidzwa uye net force inova 0.

20261124-physics-g11-2.title: Mitemo yaNewton yekufamba ne special relativity
20261124-physics-g11-2.summary: Pamusoro peplane yakachinjika isina friction, chinhu A chine huremu hwe3 kg nechinhu B chine huremu hwe2 kg zvakaiswa zvichibatana, uye simba rakachinjika re20 N rinoshandiswa kutsvaira kubva kuA. Chikurumidziro chezvinhu zviviri uye simba rinosundwa naA paB ndeapi?
20261124-physics-g11-2.principle: Chikurumidziro chose ndi $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Net force inokurumidza chinhu B ndiyo simba rokubata rinosundwa naA chete, saka $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.

20261124-physics-g12-2.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
20261124-physics-g12-2.summary: Charged particle ine huremu m uye charge q inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana B nokumhanya v uye inoita uniform circular motion. Radius r netenguva T yeorbit yechinhu iyi ndeipi?

20261124-physics-g12-2.example: Lorentz force inoshanda sa centripetal force: q v B = m v² / r

20261125-physics-g12-2.title: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki

20261123-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole

20261123-chemistry-g12-1.title: Kumhanya kwechiitiko, nheyo yaLe Chatelier nebhatiri rekemikari
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Ndeipi mataurirwo akarurama pamusoro peshanduko dzinoitika kana 'positive catalyst' yawedzerwa kuchemical reaction?
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst inopa nzira itsva yereaction ine activation energy yakaderera uye inowedzera ma rate constant e forward ne reverse reactions nechinhu chimwe chete. Haimbochinji reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) kana equilibrium constant ($K$).
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst haigoni kushandura musiyano wesimba (ΔH) pakati pezvinhu zvekutanga nezvigadzirwa zvekupedzisira.

20261123-chemistry-g12-2.title: Kumhanya kwechiitiko, nheyo yaLe Chatelier nebhatiri rekemikari
20261123-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Mu bvunzo ye initial rates yereaction 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), kana [O₂] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [NO] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 4 yakakura, uye kana [NO] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [O₂] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 2 yakakura. 20261124-chemistry-g01-1.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.summary: Ndezvipi pazvinotevera zvakaroverwa nemazvo ‘chinhu’ (mudziyo) une chimiro chakananga uye kushandiswa kwakananga, ne‘zvinhu’ (zvekuvaka) zvakagadzirwa nazvo?
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Mudziyo une chimiro nekushandiswa unonzi ‘chinhu’, uye zvekuvaka zvikuru zvakagadzirwa nazvo zvinonzi ‘zvinhu’.
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.example: ‘Chinhu’ ndiro zita remudziyo wakapedzwa watinoshandisa, uye ‘zvinhu’ ndiro zita rezvekuvaka.

20261124-chemistry-g01-2.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Ndeipi hunhu hwakananga hwezvinhu hwakaita sehwerabha kana bharuni, hunotambanuka kana ukadhonza nesimba uye hunodzoka kuchimiro chekutanga kana wasunungura?

20261124-chemistry-g02-1.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa chipunu chimwe cheshuga mubheka rine mvura inodziya woisanganisa nedanda regirazi? Sarudza tsananguro yakarurama.
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Kana shuga yanyungudika mumvura, mamorekuru eshuga anopararira zvakaenzana pakati pemamorekuru emvura, ichiita mvura yeshuga yakajeka isingaonekwi.

20261124-chemistry-g02-2.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti shuga inonyungudika nokukurumidza mumukombe wemvura inodziya kupfuura wemvura inotonhora?
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Kana tembiricha yemvura yakwira, kufamba kwekupisa kwemamorekuru emvura kunowedzera uye anorova zvidimbu zveshuga kazhinji nesimba, saka kunyungudika kunokurumidza.

20261124-chemistry-g03-1.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Ndeupi mamiriro ezvinhu anochinja chimiro zvakasununguka zvichienderana nechirongo chinochiisa, asi huwandu hwawo (volume) hahuchinje uye hunogara hwakafanana?
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mvura ine kubatana pakati pemamorekuru kunochinjika kupfuura chakasimba saka chimiro chinochinja nyore zvichienderana nechirongo, asi nekuti simba rekukwevera pakati pemamorekuru rinochengetedzwa, huwandu hunogara hwakafanana.

20261124-chemistry-g03-2.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi

20261124-chemistry-g03-2.example: Mamorekuru egasi akaparadzaniswa zvakanyanya, saka kune nzvimbo isina chinhu yakawanda.

20261124-chemistry-g04-1.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Rakaiswa kanini pakati pemadiki emusoro muna tafura, kani yemvura inonwiwa yakabva mufiriji yakava nematinji emvura pamusoro payo. Matinji aya akabva kupi?

20261124-chemistry-g04-2.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Kana mvura inoshanduka kuita chechine chakasimba, ndeupi mutsanangurire akarurama wekuchinja kweuremu nehuwandu?

20261125-chemistry-g01-1.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.summary: Ndezvipi pazvinotevera zvakaroverwa nemazvo ‘chinhu’ (mudziyo) une chimiro chakananga uye kushandiswa kwakananga, ne‘zvinhu’ (zvekuvaka) zvakagadzirwa nazvo?
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Mudziyo une chimiro nekushandiswa unonzi ‘chinhu’, uye zvekuvaka zvikuru zvakagadzirwa nazvo zvinonzi ‘zvinhu’.
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.example: ‘Chinhu’ ndiro zita remudziyo wakapedzwa watinoshandisa, uye ‘zvinhu’ ndiro zita rezvekuvaka.
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g01-2.title: Zvinhu nezvekuvaka: hunhu hwakasiyana
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Ndeipi hunhu hwakananga hwezvinhu hwakaita sehwerabha kana bharuni, hunotambanuka kana ukadhonza nesimba uye hunodzoka kuchimiro chekutanga kana wasunungura?
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Hunhu hwechinhu chakashanduka nesimba rekunze hwekudzoka kuchimiro chekutanga kana simba radzima hunonzi ‘kudzoka-kuchimiro’.

20261125-chemistry-g02-1.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa chipunu chimwe cheshuga mubheka rine mvura inodziya woisanganisa nedanda regirazi? Sarudza tsananguro yakarurama.
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Kana shuga yanyungudika mumvura, mamorekuru eshuga anopararira zvakaenzana pakati pemamorekuru emvura, ichiita mvura yeshuga yakajeka isingaonekwi.
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g02-2.title: Zvinhu zvinonyungudika mumvura nemusanganiswa
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Ndechipi chikonzero chekuti shuga inonyungudika nokukurumidza mumukombe wemvura inodziya kupfuura wemvura inotonhora?
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Kana tembiricha yemvura yakwira, kufamba kwekupisa kwemamorekuru emvura kunowedzera uye anorova zvidimbu zveshuga kazhinji nesimba, saka kunyungudika kunokurumidza.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.example: Kana tembiricha yakwira, mamorekuru anofamba nokukurumidza.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-1.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Ndeupi mamiriro ezvinhu anochinja chimiro zvakasununguka zvichienderana nechirongo chinochiisa, asi huwandu hwawo (volume) hahuchinje uye hunogara hwakafanana?
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mvura ine kubatana pakati pemamorekuru kunochinjika kupfuura chakasimba saka chimiro chinochinja nyore zvichienderana nechirongo, asi nekuti simba rekukwevera pakati pemamorekuru rinochengetedzwa, huwandu hunogara hwakafanana.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.example: Fungidzira kana uchidurura mvura kana mukaka mumukombe mumwe.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-2.title: Mamiriro matatu ezvinhu: chakasimba, mvura, gasi
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Pashandiswa masyringe maviri, rimwe rakazadzwa nemvura rimwe nemhepo; mukanwa wepiston wakavharwa nechigunwe uye piston yakasundwa zvakasimba. Chii chinoitika?
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gasi (mhepo) rine mamorekuru akaparadzaniswa zvakanyanya, saka kana pakaiswa kudzvinyirira rinodzvinyirirwa nyore uye huwandu hunoderera, asi mvura ine mamorekuru akatobatana saka haidzvinyirirwi zvakanyanya.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.example: Mamorekuru egasi akaparadzaniswa zvakanyanya, saka kune nzvimbo isina chinhu yakawanda.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-1.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Rakaiswa kanini pakati pemadiki emusoro muna tafura, kani yemvura inonwiwa yakabva mufiriji yakava nematinji emvura pamusoro payo. Matinji aya akabva kupi?
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ichi chiitiko che‘condensation (kuita mvura)’, apo mhute iri gasi iri mumhepo yakasangana nepamusoro pekani panotonhora ikarasikirwa nekupisa ikashanduka kuita matinji emvura.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.example: Mhute isingaonekwi iri mumhepo nguva dzose.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-2.title: Kuvhuvhuta, kuvira, condensation nekuchinja kwevolume yeechine
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Kana mvura inoshanduka kuita chechine chakasimba, ndeupi mutsanangurire akarurama wekuchinja kweuremu nehuwandu?
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Kana mvura ikaita echine, mass (uremu) inochengetedzwa, asi nekuti mamorekuru emvura anoumba makristasi ane marongedzo matanhatu ane nzvimbo isina chinhu yakawanda nekubatana kwehydrogen, huwandu hunowedzera nekuda kwe10%.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.example: Kunyangwe mvura ikaita echine, nhamba yose yemamorekuru haichinji.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution nekuvava
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.summary: 50 g yeshuga yakaiswa mu 200 g yemvura ikanyungudika zvachose. Mune iyi mvura yeshuga, ‘solvent’, ‘solute’ ne‘solution’ zvakaroverwa sei zvakanaka?
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mvura inonyungudisa inonzi ‘solvent’, shuga inonyungudika inonzi ‘solute’, uye musanganiswa wakajeka wakasanganiswa zvakaenzana unonzi ‘solution’.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mvura inonyungudisa = solvent, chinhu chinonyungudika = solute, musanganiswa wakapedzwa = solution.

20261125-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution nekuvava
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.summary: Tiri kunzvera hunhu hwesolution yemunyu-mvura iri mubheka. Ndeupi tsananguro yakarurama yehunhu hwesolution, ayo ari musanganiswa une homogeneous?
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Solution yechokwadi (musanganiswa une homogeneous) ine zvidimbu zvesolute zvakapararira zvakaenzana pakati pemamorekuru esolvent, saka hazvinyure kunyangwe zvikasiiwa kwenguva refu uye concentration yakafanana pose.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.example: Solution musanganiswa ‘une homogeneous’ une zvidimbu zvakasanganiswa zvakaenzana pamoreku.

20261125-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base nezvinhu zvitatu zvekuvaka moto
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mhinduro dzakasiyana dzakadonhedzwa pakuratidza kwekabichi tsvuku, mhinduro A yakashanduka kuita tsvuku, mhinduro B yakashanduka kuita bhuruu ichipfuurira kuita yero. Ndeipi hunhu hwakarurama hwemhinduro mbiri idzi?
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Chiratidzo chekabichi tsvuku chinoshanduka kuita ruvara rutsvuku mumhinduro ine acid, uye kuita bhuruu, girini, kana yero mumhinduro ine base.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.example: Muto wekabichi tsvuku, chiratidzo chechisikwa, une pigment yeanthocyanin.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base nezvinhu zvitatu zvekuvaka moto
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Kana hydrochloric acid yakaderera kana vhiniga yakadonhedzwa pamapundu eganda reeggi kana marble (une calcium carbonate), mabhubhu akabuda. Chii chinoitika kana gasi iri richiratswa nemvura yelime (limewater)?
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Kana calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) nea acid zvikaita chiitiko, gasi rekabhoni dhaiokisaidhi ($\text{CO}_2$) rinobuda, uye kabhoni dhaiokisaidhi inoita chiitiko nemvura yelime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) ichiumba precipitate chena yecalcium carbonate inoita kuti mvura ive mukaka-mukaka.
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.example: Kana carbonate nea acid zvikaita chiitiko, gasi rekabhoni dhaiokisaidhi (CO₂) rinobuda.

20261125-chemistry-g07-1.title: Mutemo waBoyle, Mutemo waCharles nekuchinja kwemamiriro
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Chii chiri chikonzero chakakosha chekuti ‘kudzvinyirirwa kwegasi’ kunzwike pamadziro echirongo chakavharwa chine gasi?
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Kudzvinyirirwa kwegasi kunoitika nesimba pachikamu chimwe rinoitwa nemamorekuru egasi anofamba pasina kumira nenzira isina kurongeka achirova madziro emukati echirongo.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g07-2.title: Mutemo waBoyle, Mutemo waCharles nekuchinja kwemamiriro
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Patembiricha inogara yakafanana, kudzvinyirirwa kwegasi rine volume ye60 mL pa1 atmosphere kwakawedzerwa kusvika pa3 atmosphere. Maererano neMutemo waBoyle, volume yegasi iri ndeipi?
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Maererano neMutemo waBoyle, patembiricha inogara yakafanana $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ inoshanda. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atomu, ion nechiitiko che precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Ndechipi chikonzero chakakosha chekuti atomu, inoumbwa nenucleus neelectron, ive neutral nemagetsi?
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atomu ine neutral nemagetsi nekuti huwandu hwose hwemagetsi e(+) eproton dzenucleus pakati hwakaenzana chaizvo nehuwandu hwose hwemagetsi e(-) eelectron dzinotenderera.
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.example: Nucleus ine magetsi e(+) nekuda kwe proton.

20261125-chemistry-g08-2.title: Element, atomu, ion nechiitiko che precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Chii chiri tsananguro yakarurama yekuumbwa kwe ‘ion’, apo atomu ine neutral inorasikirwa kana kuwana electron ikava nemagetsi?
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atomu inorasikirwa neelectron dziri pashell yekunze ikava positive ion (kunyanya simbi), kana kuwana electron ikava negative ion inogutsa octet rule (kunyanya zvisiri zvesimbi).
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.example: Sodium (Na) inorasikirwa nelectron imwe ikava Na⁺.

20261125-chemistry-g09-1.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Chii chikonzero chakakosha nei 'mutemo wekuchengetedzwa kwehuremu' unoitika kana shanduko yemakemikari ichiitika?
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Mu makemikari reaction, nzira yekubatana kwemaatomu inochinja uye zvinhu zvitsva zvinoumbwa, asi marudzi nenhamba yemaatomu hazviitwi kana kuparara, zvinongochengetwa sezvazvakanga zvakaita, saka huremu hwose hahuchinji.

20261125-chemistry-g09-2.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Kwakaitwa bvunzo umo hupfu hwemhangura hwakapiswa mumhepo mucrucible kuti hugadzire copper(II) oxide. Kana 4 g yemhangura yakapindura zvizere, 5 g yecopper(II) oxide yakaumbwa. Huremu hweoksijeni yakabatana ihuremu hwakadii, uye reshiyo yehuremu hwemhangura kune oksijeni ndeipi?
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Huremu hweoksijeni yakapindura ndi $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Maererano nemutemo wezvikamu zvakasimba, reshiyo yehuremu hwemhangura kune oksijeni mucopper(II) oxide inogara iri $4 : 1$.

20261125-chemistry-g10-1.title: Ionic bond, covalent bond nekuchinja kweelectron
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Chii chiri mhedziso chaiyo kwazvo yebvunzo inenzanisa kutakura magetsi kwechinhu A (sodium chloride) nechinhu B (shuga)?
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, chinhu chine ionic bond, chinonyungudika mumvura ichiparadzaniswa kuita cations neanions, saka aqueous solution yayo inotakura magetsi. Shuga, chinhu chine covalent bond, chinonyungudika semamolecule uye hachina zvinotakura charge, saka hachitakure magetsi.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.example: Chinhu chine ionic bond (NaCl) chinoita ionize kuita maion anofamba nemahara kana chanyungudutswa mumvura.

20261119-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira

Pool Rules

2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

20261119-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261119-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261119-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.

20261119-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261119-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."

20261119-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

20261119-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261119-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261119-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261119-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261119-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261119-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261119-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261119-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.
20261119-english-g10-2.actionItem: Muchinyorwa chokupokana, tsvaga mutsetse umo humbowo husingatsigiri chirevo zvakakwana, uunyore patsva semutsara une kungwarira zvikuru, uye utonge kuti humbowo hupi hwakawedzerwa hunodikanwa.

english-g11-2.principle: Kana uchiziva mamaki ekubva usati wabatana, unogona kuenzanisa kana mamaki enhengo aive makuru kare kana akakwira mushure mekubatana. Nokuti vadzidzi vanobatana nekukumbira, vadzidzi vakanaka kare muEnglish vanogona kunge vakabatana vakawanda.
english-g11-2.example: Funga kuti chokwadi chekuti vadzidzi vanobatana 'nekukumbira kana vachida' chingakanganisa sei pekutangira pamapoka maviri.
english-g11-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti uone kana musiyano wemamaki pakati penhengo dzeklabhu nevasiri nhengo uri mugumisiro weklabhu, uye unyore muEnglish mubvunzo wekuwana ruzivo irworwo.

'Ichi chirevo chinobva muchinyorwa chechikoro. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Sehumbowo, mhedzisiro yeongororo yevadzidzi 200 yakaratidzwa seizvi.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74'

20261119-english-g12-1.example: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
20261119-english-g12-1.actionItem: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yeongororo ichitiudza pamusoro pe "chikonzero", sarudza ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa pakutonga uku, uye ukurudzire muChirungu nzira yokuenzanisa yokutarisa mugumisiro wezvokudya zvemahara.

20261119-english-g12-2.example: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.

20261121-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
20261121-english-g01-1.summary:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
20261121-english-g01-1.principle: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
20261121-english-g01-1.example: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
20261121-english-g01-1.actionItem: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.

20261121-english-g01-2.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
20261121-english-g01-2.summary:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
20261121-english-g01-2.principle: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
20261121-english-g01-2.example: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
20261121-english-g01-2.actionItem: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.

20261121-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ndeipi nzvimbo? Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana
20261121-english-g02-1.summary:
Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261121-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
20261121-english-g02-1.example: Funga nzvimbo mbiri kana nhatu apo mitsetse miviri iyi ingataurwa.
20261121-english-g02-1.actionItem: Tonga kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo kubva pamitsetse miviri yakanzwikwa bedzi, uye usarudze chiratidzo chekuwedzera chinopatsanura nzvimbo.

20261121-english-g02-2.title: Mhinduro ipi inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi? Kufunga nezvemiganhu yekuremekedza
20261121-english-g02-2.summary:
Mudzidzisi anoti mangwanani, "How are you today, Mina?"

Shamwari yako Jin yakati, "MuChirungu, kutaura nokuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka. Unogona kungotaura saizvozvo kuvanhu vese."
20261121-english-g02-2.principle: b ne d dzinopindura kukwazisa uye dzinobvunza munhu mumwe, saka dzinokodzera mudzidzisi. a i isina kurongeka zvakanyanya uye c inonzwika isingaremekedzi.
20261121-english-g02-2.example: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana mhinduro inokodzera mubvunzo uye kana inokodzera mudzidzisi.
20261121-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sarudza mhinduro inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi, uye utaure chiitiko apo chirevo che 'kuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka' chisingashande.

20261121-english-g03-1.title: Tsvaga nguva yekuverenga mundandanda yaMina yeSaturday
20261121-english-g03-1.summary:
Ndandanda yaMina yeSaturday (yakanyorwa semashoko chete, pasina pikicha):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina anoda kuverenga bhuku kwe 1 awa. Anotanga pa awa uye otsiva pa awa.
20261121-english-g03-1.principle: Nguva isina basa inotanga pa10 a.m., uye 12 kusvika 14 dzizere nekudya kwemasikati nekutamba. Hapana mabasa muchirongwa kubva pa15 kusvika 16 nekubva pa16 kusvika 17, uye anopera kudya kwemanheru kusati kwasvika.
20261121-english-g03-1.example: Shandura nguva dziri mundandanda kuita nhamba dze 24-hour uye udhirowe time strip.
20261121-english-g03-1.actionItem: Funga nguva dzakasiyana dzekutanga kuverenga dzinogutsa mamiriro ose endandanda, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nguva dzisingashande.

20261121-english-g03-2.title: Ratidza 'worry' usingatauri
20261121-english-g03-2.summary: Uchanyora chiitiko umo shamwari yako Mina ine hanya panguva yebvunzo. Zvinyorwa zvinotaura manzwiro zvakananga nezvinyorwa zvinoaratidza kuburikidza nezvinoitwa zvinosvika kumuverengi nenzira dzakasiyana.
20261121-english-g03-2.principle: Kubva pamaoko anotonhora nekuongorora clock kunodzokororwa, muverengi anogona kufungidzira hanya. Kuzaira achitarisa kunze kwefafitera kunoratidza kuneta, uye kunyemwerera achinyora nekukurumidza kunoratidza kuzorora kana kuzvivimba.
20261121-english-g03-2.example: Kubva pazvinyorwa zvitatu zvega zvega, sarudza uye unyore chiito kana shanduko yemuviri yaMina.
20261121-english-g03-2.actionItem: Nyora zvinyorwa pfupi umo muverengi anogona kufungidzira manzwiro kubva pazvinoitwa nezvikomborero zvemuviri chete, pasina izwi remanzwiro.

20261121-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261121-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261121-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.
20261121-english-g04-1.example: Isa mutsetse wega wega padivi penguva yepaki '4:15-5:15' rimwe nerimwe, uye utarise kana unopera usati watanga kana unotanga pashure.
20261121-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261121-english-g04-2.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
20261121-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."
20261121-english-g04-2.principle: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
20261121-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.
20261121-english-g04-2.actionItem: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.

20261121-english-g05-1.title: Kufunga kwako kunochinja sezvaunoverenga posita
20261121-english-g05-1.summary: Jun haasi nhengo yeGreen Library. Shamwari yake Ara inhengo yeGreen Library. Vaviri vavo vari kuverenga posita iri pamberi perabhurari mutsara umwe panguva.
20261121-english-g05-1.principle: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.
20261121-english-g05-1.example: Tarisa kana mutsara mutsva wenguva ino unochinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
20261121-english-g05-1.actionItem: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.

20261121-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - zvinyorwa zvinozvitsigira here?
20261121-english-g05-2.summary:
Kirasi yaMina ine kona yekuverenga ine bhukhoso.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261121-english-g05-2.principle: Zvinyorwa zvinotaura chete nhamba yemabhuku ari pabhukhoso (12 mabhuku ezvipfuwo, nezvimwewo). Hazvitaure kuti vadzidzi vanoverenga kana kukwereta mabhuku api zvakawanda, saka hatigoni kuongorora chirevo che 'most popular'.
20261121-english-g05-2.example: Funga kuti 'popular' inorevei mumashoko aMina, uye utsvage mutsara muzvinyorwa unokuudza izvozvo.
20261121-english-g05-2.actionItem: Funga kana ruzivo rwenhamba muzvinyorwa rwunotsigira chirevo (popular), uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unogona kuongorora chirevo.

20261121-english-g06-1.title: Kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro here? Kuchinja kutonga kwako sezvo humbowo huchikura
20261121-english-g06-1.summary: Kirabhu itsva yemabhuku yakatanga kuchikoro chedu. Mudzidzisi akati, "The club is a success." Uchagamuchira humbowo chikamu chimwe panguva imwe uye ufunge kana chirevo ichi chakarurama.
20261121-english-g06-1.principle: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.
20261121-english-g06-1.example: Paradzanisa zvinosimbiswa nedata raunazvino nezvausati wazviziva.
20261121-english-g06-1.actionItem: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.

20261121-english-g06-2.title: Kugadzira matafura ekutsvaga zviitiko apo chirevo i chokwadi
20261121-english-g06-2.summary: Vadzidzi 20 mukirasi imwe vakakanda vote imwe imwe yechiitiko mushure menguva yesnack: soccer, art, kana music. Mavote anonzi s (soccer), a (art), ne m (music).
20261121-english-g06-2.principle: Mavote 8 i akawanda kupfuura art (6) ne music (6), saka i most, uye i shoma kupfuura 10, iyo i hafu ye 20, saka haisi hafu. Saka a yakarurama.
20261121-english-g06-2.example: Wedzera 8, 6, ne 6, tsvaga hafu yevadzidzi 20 i chii, uye uenzanise.
20261121-english-g06-2.actionItem: Gadzira iwe pachako matafura akati wandei evote ayo chirevo cheChirungu 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' i chokwadi.

20261121-english-g07-1.title: Ben achauya kumutambo here? Kuongorora zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro dzake
20261121-english-g07-1.summary:
Nhaurirano pakati paJisu naBen (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261121-english-g07-1.principle: Mutambo wesoccer i mangwanani uye mutambo i pa 4 p.m., saka nguva hadzipindirani. Ben akangoti angangoneta, uye pakupedzisira akati achatarisa nemai vake kutanga. Saka pane chakagadzwa (nguva) nechasara (mvumo yemai vake), uye hazvisati zvasarudzwa.
20261121-english-g07-1.example: Patsanura mashoko aBen kuita zvidimbu zvina: 'mutambo wesoccer,' 'nguva yemutambo,' 'kuneta,' ne 'mai.'
20261121-english-g07-1.actionItem: Patsanura mhinduro dzaBen munhaurirano mutsetse nemutsetse, siyanisa zvakagadzwa nezvinosara, uye utonge usingatauri 'achauya' kana 'haazouyi'.

20261121-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' inoreva here kuti zvakanaka chaizvo?
20261121-english-g07-2.summary: Sam naDad vanotaura nezvehurongwa hwePachishanu. Nhaurirano inoratidzwa muzvikamu zvitatu. Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo.
20261121-english-g07-2.principle: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.
20261121-english-g07-2.example: Tsvaga toni imwe itsva kana izwi rimwe muchidimbu ichi.
20261121-english-g07-2.actionItem: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.

20261121-english-g08-1.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
20261121-english-g08-1.summary: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
20261121-english-g08-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
20261121-english-g08-1.example: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
20261121-english-g08-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.

20261121-english-g08-2.title: Gadzirisa mutsara une nhamba isina kururama mu blog post yekuchenesa mhenderekedzo
20261121-english-g08-2.summary: Mudzidzi wekirasi imwe akanyora post iyi pa blog yechikoro. (Izvi zvinyorwa chete. Mutsara wese une nhamba.)
20261121-english-g08-2.principle: Mutsara 3 unoti vakaunganidza 30 bags muawa rekutanga, uye mutsara 4 unoti huwandu hwose hwaiva 18 bags. Huwandu hwose hahugoni kuva hushoma kupfuura zvakaunganidzwa muawa rekutanga. Post iyi oga haigoni kukuudza kuti mutsara 3 kana 4 hausina kururama, saka unogona kusarudza chero upi.
20261121-english-g08-2.example: Unganidza mitsara ine nhamba chete uye uienzanise.
20261121-english-g08-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yenhamba mu blog post isingaenderani, uye uinyore zvakare kuti ienderane neruzivo rwakasimbiswa.

20261121-english-g09-1.title: Fungidziro yakavanzika mu 'takatengesa masikati 200 shoma'
20261121-english-g09-1.summary:
Izvi zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pamberi pekafeteria yechikoro.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261121-english-g09-1.principle: Kuenda kubva pachokwadi chekuti kutengesa kwakadzikira kusvika ku 'hazvina kuenderana nekuravira kwavo', mamwe mamiriro (nhamba yevadzidzi, nhamba yemazuva echikoro, nezvimwewo) anofanira kuva akafanana. Kana pakanga pane vadzidzi vashoma kana mazuva echikoro mashoma, kutengesa kwaizodzikira kunyangwe nekuravira kwakafanana.
20261121-english-g09-1.example: Tanga wanyora nemutauro wako pachako kuti chii chingaitisa "masikati mashoma akatengeswa."
20261121-english-g09-1.actionItem: Tsvaga fungidziro isina kutaurwa inodiwa kuti chirevo chishande, uye unyore muChirungu tsananguro imwe inozungunusa fungidziro iyoyo.

20261121-english-g09-2.title: Chinja sarudzo yeresitorendi sezvo maongororo akawanda achiwedzera rimwe nerimwe
20261121-english-g09-2.summary: Mhuri iri kusarudza resitorendi yekudya kwemasikati vasati vaenda kufirimu (inotanga pa3:00 p.m.). Nguva yekudya kwemasikati iawa rimwe rinotanga pa12:30. Ruzivo rwemaongororo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva.
20261121-english-g09-2.principle: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.
20261121-english-g09-2.example: Tsvaga izwi rimwe kana nhamba imwe yawaona kekutanga muchidimbu ichi.
20261121-english-g09-2.actionItem: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.

20261121-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261121-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261121-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261121-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261121-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261121-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261121-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261121-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.
20261121-english-g10-2.actionItem: Muchinyorwa chokupokana, tsvaga mutsetse umo humbowo husingatsigiri chirevo zvakakwana, uunyore patsva semutsara une kungwarira zvikuru, uye utonge kuti humbowo hupi hwakawedzerwa hunodikanwa.

20261121-english-g11-1.title: Murairo webasa usina kujeka: chii chekubvunza kutanga?
20261121-english-g11-1.summary:
Iyi i imeyili yakagamuchirwa nemudzidzi wekuzvidzidzira Jiho kubva kumutungamiriri weboka Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Zvaanoziva Jiho: Karenda yeboka inoratidza musangano neAurora Co. paChipiri pa 10:00 nemusangano neBlue Pine Ltd. paChina pa 14:00. Foodha yekugovana ine mafaira akasiyana ekupfupisa kutengesa eJuly, August neSeptember.
20261121-english-g11-1.principle: Kana mutengi nenguva zvisina kusarudzwa, unogona kutumira faira rakaipa kumutengi akaipa. Kuchimiro, unogona kugadza default sa PDF uye ukamuzivisa, uye kuva kwake kubasa hakuna chekuita nebasa pacharo.
20261121-english-g11-1.example: Tarisa kana 'kuna ani,' 'chii,' ne 'rini' zvichibuda semuchinhu chimwe chete mu imeyili.
20261121-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kubva pamaimeyili ebasa asina kujeka, sarudza ruzivo rwunofanira kusimbiswa usati wabata, uye unyore imeyili yemibvunzo inonzwisisika zviri nyore kupindura.

20261121-english-g11-2.title: Zvinokonzerwa neklabhu yekuverenga here? Ruzivo rupi rwaizotiita kuti tiziive?
20261121-english-g11-2.summary:
Ichi chikamu chereport yeStudent council.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Mudzidzi Mina anoda kuongorora kana mhedziso iyi yakarurama. Vadzidzi vanobatana neklabhu nekukumbira kana vachida.
20261121-english-g11-2.principle: Kana uchiziva mamaki ekubva usati wabatana, unogona kuenzanisa kana mamaki enhengo aive makuru kare kana akakwira mushure mekubatana. Nokuti vadzidzi vanobatana nekukumbira, vadzidzi vakanaka kare muEnglish vanogona kunge vakabatana vakawanda.
20261121-english-g11-2.example: Funga kuti chokwadi chekuti vadzidzi vanobatana 'nekukumbira kana vachida' chingakanganisa sei pekutangira pamapoka maviri.
20261121-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti uone kana musiyano wemamaki pakati penhengo dzeklabhu nevasiri nhengo uri mugumisiro weklabhu, uye unyore muEnglish mubvunzo wekuwana ruzivo irworwo.

20261121-english-g12-1.title: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vane zvibodzwa zvakakwira: chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva?
20261121-english-g12-1.summary:
'Ichi chirevo chinobva muchinyorwa chechikoro. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Sehumbowo, mhedzisiro yeongororo yevadzidzi 200 yakaratidzwa seizvi.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74'
20261121-english-g12-1.principle: b inotarisa zvimwe zvikonzero (kurara, nguva yokudzidza), c inotarisa mhedzisiro yokupindira kwechokwadi, uye e inotarisa kururama kwokuenzanisa. a ne d hazvisi humbowo hwokuti zvokudya zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
20261121-english-g12-1.example: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
20261121-english-g12-1.actionItem: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yeongororo ichitiudza pamusoro pe "chikonzero", sarudza ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa pakutonga uku, uye ukurudzire muChirungu nzira yokuenzanisa yokutarisa mugumisiro wezvokudya zvemahara.

20261121-english-g12-2.title: Chiitiko chimwechete, misoro yenhau yakasiyana: kutonga kunochinja sezvo ruzivo rwunokura
20261121-english-g12-2.summary: Nyaya inoratidza kuti khonsoro yedhorobha yakasarudza kukwidziridza mari yekupaka padyo nechiteshi inotsunga yakaburitswa nhanho nhanho. Tarisa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja nguva dzose ruzivo ruchikura.
20261121-english-g12-2.principle: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.
20261121-english-g12-2.example: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.
20261121-english-g12-2.actionItem: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.

20261122-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
20261122-english-g01-1.summary:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
20261122-english-g01-1.principle: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
20261122-english-g01-1.example: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
20261122-english-g01-1.actionItem: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.

20261122-english-g01-2.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
20261122-english-g01-2.summary:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
20261122-english-g01-2.principle: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
20261122-english-g01-2.example: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
20261122-english-g01-2.actionItem: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.

20261122-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ndeipi nzvimbo? Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana
20261122-english-g02-1.summary:
Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261122-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
20261122-english-g02-1.example: Funga nzvimbo mbiri kana nhatu apo mitsetse miviri iyi ingataurwa.
20261122-english-g02-1.actionItem: Tonga kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo kubva pamitsetse miviri yakanzwikwa bedzi, uye usarudze chiratidzo chekuwedzera chinopatsanura nzvimbo.

20261122-english-g02-2.title: Mhinduro ipi inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi? Kufunga nezvemiganhu yekuremekedza
20261122-english-g02-2.summary:
Mudzidzisi anoti mangwanani, "How are you today, Mina?"

Shamwari yako Jin yakati, "MuChirungu, kutaura nokuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka. Unogona kungotaura saizvozvo kuvanhu vese."
20261122-english-g02-2.principle: b ne d dzinopindura kukwazisa uye dzinobvunza munhu mumwe, saka dzinokodzera mudzidzisi. a i isina kurongeka zvakanyanya uye c inonzwika isingaremekedzi.
20261122-english-g02-2.example: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana mhinduro inokodzera mubvunzo uye kana inokodzera mudzidzisi.
20261122-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sarudza mhinduro inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi, uye utaure chiitiko apo chirevo che 'kuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka' chisingashande.

20261122-english-g03-1.title: Tsvaga nguva yekuverenga mundandanda yaMina yeSaturday
20261122-english-g03-1.summary:
Ndandanda yaMina yeSaturday (yakanyorwa semashoko chete, pasina pikicha):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina anoda kuverenga bhuku kwe 1 awa. Anotanga pa awa uye otsiva pa awa.
20261122-english-g03-1.principle: Nguva isina basa inotanga pa10 a.m., uye 12 kusvika 14 dzizere nekudya kwemasikati nekutamba. Hapana mabasa muchirongwa kubva pa15 kusvika 16 nekubva pa16 kusvika 17, uye anopera kudya kwemanheru kusati kwasvika.
20261122-english-g03-1.example: Shandura nguva dziri mundandanda kuita nhamba dze 24-hour uye udhirowe time strip.
20261122-english-g03-1.actionItem: Funga nguva dzakasiyana dzekutanga kuverenga dzinogutsa mamiriro ose endandanda, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nguva dzisingashande.

20261122-english-g03-2.title: Ratidza 'worry' usingatauri
20261122-english-g03-2.summary: Uchanyora chiitiko umo shamwari yako Mina ine hanya panguva yebvunzo. Zvinyorwa zvinotaura manzwiro zvakananga nezvinyorwa zvinoaratidza kuburikidza nezvinoitwa zvinosvika kumuverengi nenzira dzakasiyana.
20261122-english-g03-2.principle: Kubva pamaoko anotonhora nekuongorora clock kunodzokororwa, muverengi anogona kufungidzira hanya. Kuzaira achitarisa kunze kwefafitera kunoratidza kuneta, uye kunyemwerera achinyora nekukurumidza kunoratidza kuzorora kana kuzvivimba.
20261122-english-g03-2.example: Kubva pazvinyorwa zvitatu zvega zvega, sarudza uye unyore chiito kana shanduko yemuviri yaMina.
20261122-english-g03-2.actionItem: Nyora zvinyorwa pfupi umo muverengi anogona kufungidzira manzwiro kubva pazvinoitwa nezvikomborero zvemuviri chete, pasina izwi remanzwiro.

20261122-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261122-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261122-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.
20261122-english-g04-1.example: Isa mutsetse wega wega padivi penguva yepaki '4:15-5:15' rimwe nerimwe, uye utarise kana unopera usati watanga kana unotanga pashure.
20261122-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261122-english-g04-2.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
20261122-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."
20261122-english-g04-2.principle: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
20261122-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.
20261122-english-g04-2.actionItem: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.

20261122-english-g05-1.title: Kufunga kwako kunochinja sezvaunoverenga posita
20261122-english-g05-1.summary: Jun haasi nhengo yeGreen Library. Shamwari yake Ara inhengo yeGreen Library. Vaviri vavo vari kuverenga posita iri pamberi perabhurari mutsara umwe panguva.
20261122-english-g05-1.principle: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.
20261122-english-g05-1.example: Tarisa kana mutsara mutsva wenguva ino unochinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
20261122-english-g05-1.actionItem: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.

20261122-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - zvinyorwa zvinozvitsigira here?
20261122-english-g05-2.summary:
Kirasi yaMina ine kona yekuverenga ine bhukhoso.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261122-english-g05-2.principle: Zvinyorwa zvinotaura chete nhamba yemabhuku ari pabhukhoso (12 mabhuku ezvipfuwo, nezvimwewo). Hazvitaure kuti vadzidzi vanoverenga kana kukwereta mabhuku api zvakawanda, saka hatigoni kuongorora chirevo che 'most popular'.
20261122-english-g05-2.example: Funga kuti 'popular' inorevei mumashoko aMina, uye utsvage mutsara muzvinyorwa unokuudza izvozvo.
20261122-english-g05-2.actionItem: Funga kana ruzivo rwenhamba muzvinyorwa rwunotsigira chirevo (popular), uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unogona kuongorora chirevo.

20261122-english-g06-1.title: Kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro here? Kuchinja kutonga kwako sezvo humbowo huchikura
20261122-english-g06-1.summary: Kirabhu itsva yemabhuku yakatanga kuchikoro chedu. Mudzidzisi akati, "The club is a success." Uchagamuchira humbowo chikamu chimwe panguva imwe uye ufunge kana chirevo ichi chakarurama.
20261122-english-g06-1.principle: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.
20261122-english-g06-1.example: Paradzanisa zvinosimbiswa nedata raunazvino nezvausati wazviziva.
20261122-english-g06-1.actionItem: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.

20261122-english-g06-2.title: Kugadzira matafura ekutsvaga zviitiko apo chirevo i chokwadi
20261122-english-g06-2.summary: Vadzidzi 20 mukirasi imwe vakakanda vote imwe imwe yechiitiko mushure menguva yesnack: soccer, art, kana music. Mavote anonzi s (soccer), a (art), ne m (music).
20261122-english-g06-2.principle: Mavote 8 i akawanda kupfuura art (6) ne music (6), saka i most, uye i shoma kupfuura 10, iyo i hafu ye 20, saka haisi hafu. Saka a yakarurama.
20261122-english-g06-2.example: Wedzera 8, 6, ne 6, tsvaga hafu yevadzidzi 20 i chii, uye uenzanise.
20261122-english-g06-2.actionItem: Gadzira iwe pachako matafura akati wandei evote ayo chirevo cheChirungu 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' i chokwadi.

20261122-english-g07-1.title: Ben achauya kumutambo here? Kuongorora zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro dzake
20261122-english-g07-1.summary:
Nhaurirano pakati paJisu naBen (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261122-english-g07-1.principle: Mutambo wesoccer i mangwanani uye mutambo i pa 4 p.m., saka nguva hadzipindirani. Ben akangoti angangoneta, uye pakupedzisira akati achatarisa nemai vake kutanga. Saka pane chakagadzwa (nguva) nechasara (mvumo yemai vake), uye hazvisati zvasarudzwa.
20261122-english-g07-1.example: Patsanura mashoko aBen kuita zvidimbu zvina: 'mutambo wesoccer,' 'nguva yemutambo,' 'kuneta,' ne 'mai.'
20261122-english-g07-1.actionItem: Patsanura mhinduro dzaBen munhaurirano mutsetse nemutsetse, siyanisa zvakagadzwa nezvinosara, uye utonge usingatauri 'achauya' kana 'haazouyi'.

20261122-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' inoreva here kuti zvakanaka chaizvo?
20261122-english-g07-2.summary: Sam naDad vanotaura nezvehurongwa hwePachishanu. Nhaurirano inoratidzwa muzvikamu zvitatu. Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo.
20261122-english-g07-2.principle: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.
20261122-english-g07-2.example: Tsvaga toni imwe itsva kana izwi rimwe muchidimbu ichi.
20261122-english-g07-2.actionItem: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.

20261122-english-g08-1.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
20261122-english-g08-1.summary: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
20261122-english-g08-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
20261122-english-g08-1.example: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
20261122-english-g08-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.

20261122-english-g08-2.title: Gadzirisa mutsara une nhamba isina kururama mu blog post yekuchenesa mhenderekedzo
20261122-english-g08-2.summary: Mudzidzi wekirasi imwe akanyora post iyi pa blog yechikoro. (Izvi zvinyorwa chete. Mutsara wese une nhamba.)
20261122-english-g08-2.principle: Mutsara 3 unoti vakaunganidza 30 bags muawa rekutanga, uye mutsara 4 unoti huwandu hwose hwaiva 18 bags. Huwandu hwose hahugoni kuva hushoma kupfuura zvakaunganidzwa muawa rekutanga. Post iyi oga haigoni kukuudza kuti mutsara 3 kana 4 hausina kururama, saka unogona kusarudza chero upi.
20261122-english-g08-2.example: Unganidza mitsara ine nhamba chete uye uienzanise.
20261122-english-g08-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yenhamba mu blog post isingaenderani, uye uinyore zvakare kuti ienderane neruzivo rwakasimbiswa.

20261122-english-g09-1.title: Fungidziro yakavanzika mu 'takatengesa masikati 200 shoma'
20261122-english-g09-1.summary:
Izvi zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pamberi pekafeteria yechikoro.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261122-english-g09-1.principle: Kuenda kubva pachokwadi chekuti kutengesa kwakadzikira kusvika ku 'hazvina kuenderana nekuravira kwavo', mamwe mamiriro (nhamba yevadzidzi, nhamba yemazuva echikoro, nezvimwewo) anofanira kuva akafanana. Kana pakanga pane vadzidzi vashoma kana mazuva echikoro mashoma, kutengesa kwaizodzikira kunyangwe nekuravira kwakafanana.
20261122-english-g09-1.example: Tanga wanyora nemutauro wako pachako kuti chii chingaitisa "masikati mashoma akatengeswa."
20261122-english-g09-1.actionItem: Tsvaga fungidziro isina kutaurwa inodiwa kuti chirevo chishande, uye unyore muChirungu tsananguro imwe inozungunusa fungidziro iyoyo.

20261122-english-g09-2.title: Chinja sarudzo yeresitorendi sezvo maongororo akawanda achiwedzera rimwe nerimwe
20261122-english-g09-2.summary: Mhuri iri kusarudza resitorendi yekudya kwemasikati vasati vaenda kufirimu (inotanga pa3:00 p.m.). Nguva yekudya kwemasikati iawa rimwe rinotanga pa12:30. Ruzivo rwemaongororo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva.
20261122-english-g09-2.principle: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.
20261122-english-g09-2.example: Tsvaga izwi rimwe kana nhamba imwe yawaona kekutanga muchidimbu ichi.
20261122-english-g09-2.actionItem: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.

20261122-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261122-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261122-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261122-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261122-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261122-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261122-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261122-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.
20261122-english-g10-2.actionItem: Muchinyorwa chokupokana, tsvaga mutsetse umo humbowo husingatsigiri chirevo zvakakwana, uunyore patsva semutsara une kungwarira zvikuru, uye utonge kuti humbowo hupi hwakawedzerwa hunodikanwa.

20261122-english-g11-1.title: Murairo webasa usina kujeka: chii chekubvunza kutanga?
20261122-english-g11-1.summary:
Iyi i imeyili yakagamuchirwa nemudzidzi wekuzvidzidzira Jiho kubva kumutungamiriri weboka Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Zvaanoziva Jiho: Karenda yeboka inoratidza musangano neAurora Co. paChipiri pa 10:00 nemusangano neBlue Pine Ltd. paChina pa 14:00. Foodha yekugovana ine mafaira akasiyana ekupfupisa kutengesa eJuly, August neSeptember.
20261122-english-g11-1.principle: Kana mutengi nenguva zvisina kusarudzwa, unogona kutumira faira rakaipa kumutengi akaipa. Kuchimiro, unogona kugadza default sa PDF uye ukamuzivisa, uye kuva kwake kubasa hakuna chekuita nebasa pacharo.
20261122-english-g11-1.example: Tarisa kana 'kuna ani,' 'chii,' ne 'rini' zvichibuda semuchinhu chimwe chete mu imeyili.
20261122-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kubva pamaimeyili ebasa asina kujeka, sarudza ruzivo rwunofanira kusimbiswa usati wabata, uye unyore imeyili yemibvunzo inonzwisisika zviri nyore kupindura.

20261122-english-g11-2.title: Zvinokonzerwa neklabhu yekuverenga here? Ruzivo rupi rwaizotiita kuti tiziive?
20261122-english-g11-2.summary:
Ichi chikamu chereport yeStudent council.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Mudzidzi Mina anoda kuongorora kana mhedziso iyi yakarurama. Vadzidzi vanobatana neklabhu nekukumbira kana vachida.
20261122-english-g11-2.principle: Kana uchiziva mamaki ekubva usati wabatana, unogona kuenzanisa kana mamaki enhengo aive makuru kare kana akakwira mushure mekubatana. Nokuti vadzidzi vanobatana nekukumbira, vadzidzi vakanaka kare muEnglish vanogona kunge vakabatana vakawanda.
20261122-english-g11-2.example: Funga kuti chokwadi chekuti vadzidzi vanobatana 'nekukumbira kana vachida' chingakanganisa sei pekutangira pamapoka maviri.
20261122-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti uone kana musiyano wemamaki pakati penhengo dzeklabhu nevasiri nhengo uri mugumisiro weklabhu, uye unyore muEnglish mubvunzo wekuwana ruzivo irworwo.

20261122-english-g12-1.title: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vane zvibodzwa zvakakwira: chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva?
20261122-english-g12-1.summary:
'Ichi chirevo chinobva muchinyorwa chechikoro. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Sehumbowo, mhedzisiro yeongororo yevadzidzi 200 yakaratidzwa seizvi.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74'
20261122-english-g12-1.principle: b inotarisa zvimwe zvikonzero (kurara, nguva yokudzidza), c inotarisa mhedzisiro yokupindira kwechokwadi, uye e inotarisa kururama kwokuenzanisa. a ne d hazvisi humbowo hwokuti zvokudya zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
20261122-english-g12-1.example: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
20261122-english-g12-1.actionItem: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yeongororo ichitiudza pamusoro pe "chikonzero", sarudza ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa pakutonga uku, uye ukurudzire muChirungu nzira yokuenzanisa yokutarisa mugumisiro wezvokudya zvemahara.

20261122-english-g12-2.title: Chiitiko chimwechete, misoro yenhau yakasiyana: kutonga kunochinja sezvo ruzivo rwunokura
20261122-english-g12-2.summary: Nyaya inoratidza kuti khonsoro yedhorobha yakasarudza kukwidziridza mari yekupaka padyo nechiteshi inotsunga yakaburitswa nhanho nhanho. Tarisa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja nguva dzose ruzivo ruchikura.
20261122-english-g12-2.principle: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.
20261122-english-g12-2.example: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.
20261122-english-g12-2.actionItem: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.

20261123-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
20261123-english-g01-1.summary:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
20261123-english-g01-1.principle: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
20261123-english-g01-1.example: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
20261123-english-g01-1.actionItem: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.

20261123-english-g01-2.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
20261123-english-g01-2.summary:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
20261123-english-g01-2.principle: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
20261123-english-g01-2.example: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
20261123-english-g01-2.actionItem: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.

20261123-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ndeipi nzvimbo? Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana
20261123-english-g02-1.summary:
Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261123-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
20261123-english-g02-1.example: Funga nzvimbo mbiri kana nhatu apo mitsetse miviri iyi ingataurwa.
20261123-english-g02-1.actionItem: Tonga kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo kubva pamitsetse miviri yakanzwikwa bedzi, uye usarudze chiratidzo chekuwedzera chinopatsanura nzvimbo.

20261123-english-g02-2.title: Mhinduro ipi inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi? Kufunga nezvemiganhu yekuremekedza
20261123-english-g02-2.summary:
Mudzidzisi anoti mangwanani, "How are you today, Mina?"

Shamwari yako Jin yakati, "MuChirungu, kutaura nokuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka. Unogona kungotaura saizvozvo kuvanhu vese."
20261123-english-g02-2.principle: b ne d dzinopindura kukwazisa uye dzinobvunza munhu mumwe, saka dzinokodzera mudzidzisi. a i isina kurongeka zvakanyanya uye c inonzwika isingaremekedzi.
20261123-english-g02-2.example: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana mhinduro inokodzera mubvunzo uye kana inokodzera mudzidzisi.
20261123-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sarudza mhinduro inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi, uye utaure chiitiko apo chirevo che 'kuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka' chisingashande.

20261123-english-g03-1.title: Tsvaga nguva yekuverenga mundandanda yaMina yeSaturday
20261123-english-g03-1.summary:
Ndandanda yaMina yeSaturday (yakanyorwa semashoko chete, pasina pikicha):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina anoda kuverenga bhuku kwe 1 awa. Anotanga pa awa uye otsiva pa awa.
20261123-english-g03-1.principle: Nguva isina basa inotanga pa10 a.m., uye 12 kusvika 14 dzizere nekudya kwemasikati nekutamba. Hapana mabasa muchirongwa kubva pa15 kusvika 16 nekubva pa16 kusvika 17, uye anopera kudya kwemanheru kusati kwasvika.
20261123-english-g03-1.example: Shandura nguva dziri mundandanda kuita nhamba dze 24-hour uye udhirowe time strip.
20261123-english-g03-1.actionItem: Funga nguva dzakasiyana dzekutanga kuverenga dzinogutsa mamiriro ose endandanda, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nguva dzisingashande.

20261123-english-g03-2.title: Ratidza 'worry' usingatauri
20261123-english-g03-2.summary: Uchanyora chiitiko umo shamwari yako Mina ine hanya panguva yebvunzo. Zvinyorwa zvinotaura manzwiro zvakananga nezvinyorwa zvinoaratidza kuburikidza nezvinoitwa zvinosvika kumuverengi nenzira dzakasiyana.
20261123-english-g03-2.principle: Kubva pamaoko anotonhora nekuongorora clock kunodzokororwa, muverengi anogona kufungidzira hanya. Kuzaira achitarisa kunze kwefafitera kunoratidza kuneta, uye kunyemwerera achinyora nekukurumidza kunoratidza kuzorora kana kuzvivimba.
20261123-english-g03-2.example: Kubva pazvinyorwa zvitatu zvega zvega, sarudza uye unyore chiito kana shanduko yemuviri yaMina.
20261123-english-g03-2.actionItem: Nyora zvinyorwa pfupi umo muverengi anogona kufungidzira manzwiro kubva pazvinoitwa nezvikomborero zvemuviri chete, pasina izwi remanzwiro.

20261123-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261123-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261123-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.
20261123-english-g04-1.example: Isa mutsetse wega wega padivi penguva yepaki '4:15-5:15' rimwe nerimwe, uye utarise kana unopera usati watanga kana unotanga pashure.
20261123-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261123-english-g04-2.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
20261123-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."
20261123-english-g04-2.principle: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
20261123-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.
20261123-english-g04-2.actionItem: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.

20261123-english-g05-1.title: Kufunga kwako kunochinja sezvaunoverenga posita
20261123-english-g05-1.summary: Jun haasi nhengo yeGreen Library. Shamwari yake Ara inhengo yeGreen Library. Vaviri vavo vari kuverenga posita iri pamberi perabhurari mutsara umwe panguva.
20261123-english-g05-1.principle: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.
20261123-english-g05-1.example: Tarisa kana mutsara mutsva wenguva ino unochinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
20261123-english-g05-1.actionItem: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.

20261123-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - zvinyorwa zvinozvitsigira here?
20261123-english-g05-2.summary:
Kirasi yaMina ine kona yekuverenga ine bhukhoso.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
