20261123-english-g05-2.principle: Zvinyorwa zvinotaura chete nhamba yemabhuku ari pabhukhoso (12 mabhuku ezvipfuwo, nezvimwewo). Hazvitaure kuti vadzidzi vanoverenga kana kukwereta mabhuku api zvakawanda, saka hatigoni kuongorora chirevo che 'most popular'.
20261123-english-g05-2.example: Funga kuti 'popular' inorevei mumashoko aMina, uye utsvage mutsara muzvinyorwa unokuudza izvozvo.
20261123-english-g05-2.actionItem: Funga kana ruzivo rwenhamba muzvinyorwa rwunotsigira chirevo (popular), uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unogona kuongorora chirevo.

20261123-english-g06-1.title: Kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro here? Kuchinja kutonga kwako sezvo humbowo huchikura
20261123-english-g06-1.summary: Kirabhu itsva yemabhuku yakatanga kuchikoro chedu. Mudzidzisi akati, "The club is a success." Uchagamuchira humbowo chikamu chimwe panguva imwe uye ufunge kana chirevo ichi chakarurama.
20261123-english-g06-1.principle: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.
20261123-english-g06-1.example: Paradzanisa zvinosimbiswa nedata raunazvino nezvausati wazviziva.
20261123-english-g06-1.actionItem: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.

20261123-english-g06-2.title: Kugadzira matafura ekutsvaga zviitiko apo chirevo i chokwadi
20261123-english-g06-2.summary: Vadzidzi 20 mukirasi imwe vakakanda vote imwe imwe yechiitiko mushure menguva yesnack: soccer, art, kana music. Mavote anonzi s (soccer), a (art), ne m (music).
20261123-english-g06-2.principle: Mavote 8 i akawanda kupfuura art (6) ne music (6), saka i most, uye i shoma kupfuura 10, iyo i hafu ye 20, saka haisi hafu. Saka a yakarurama.
20261123-english-g06-2.example: Wedzera 8, 6, ne 6, tsvaga hafu yevadzidzi 20 i chii, uye uenzanise.
20261123-english-g06-2.actionItem: Gadzira iwe pachako matafura akati wandei evote ayo chirevo cheChirungu 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' i chokwadi.

20261123-english-g07-1.title: Ben achauya kumutambo here? Kuongorora zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro dzake
20261123-english-g07-1.summary:
Nhaurirano pakati paJisu naBen (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261123-english-g07-1.principle: Mutambo wesoccer i mangwanani uye mutambo i pa 4 p.m., saka nguva hadzipindirani. Ben akangoti angangoneta, uye pakupedzisira akati achatarisa nemai vake kutanga. Saka pane chakagadzwa (nguva) nechasara (mvumo yemai vake), uye hazvisati zvasarudzwa.
20261123-english-g07-1.example: Patsanura mashoko aBen kuita zvidimbu zvina: 'mutambo wesoccer,' 'nguva yemutambo,' 'kuneta,' ne 'mai.'
20261123-english-g07-1.actionItem: Patsanura mhinduro dzaBen munhaurirano mutsetse nemutsetse, siyanisa zvakagadzwa nezvinosara, uye utonge usingatauri 'achauya' kana 'haazouyi'.

20261123-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' inoreva here kuti zvakanaka chaizvo?
20261123-english-g07-2.summary: Sam naDad vanotaura nezvehurongwa hwePachishanu. Nhaurirano inoratidzwa muzvikamu zvitatu. Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo.
20261123-english-g07-2.principle: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.
20261123-english-g07-2.example: Tsvaga toni imwe itsva kana izwi rimwe muchidimbu ichi.
20261123-english-g07-2.actionItem: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.

20261123-english-g08-1.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
20261123-english-g08-1.summary: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
20261123-english-g08-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
20261123-english-g08-1.example: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
20261123-english-g08-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.

20261123-english-g08-2.title: Gadzirisa mutsara une nhamba isina kururama mu blog post yekuchenesa mhenderekedzo
20261123-english-g08-2.summary: Mudzidzi wekirasi imwe akanyora post iyi pa blog yechikoro. (Izvi zvinyorwa chete. Mutsara wese une nhamba.)
20261123-english-g08-2.principle: Mutsara 3 unoti vakaunganidza 30 bags muawa rekutanga, uye mutsara 4 unoti huwandu hwose hwaiva 18 bags. Huwandu hwose hahugoni kuva hushoma kupfuura zvakaunganidzwa muawa rekutanga. Post iyi oga haigoni kukuudza kuti mutsara 3 kana 4 hausina kururama, saka unogona kusarudza chero upi.
20261123-english-g08-2.example: Unganidza mitsara ine nhamba chete uye uienzanise.
20261123-english-g08-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yenhamba mu blog post isingaenderani, uye uinyore zvakare kuti ienderane neruzivo rwakasimbiswa.

20261123-english-g09-1.title: Fungidziro yakavanzika mu 'takatengesa masikati 200 shoma'
20261123-english-g09-1.summary:
Izvi zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pamberi pekafeteria yechikoro.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261123-english-g09-1.principle: Kuenda kubva pachokwadi chekuti kutengesa kwakadzikira kusvika ku 'hazvina kuenderana nekuravira kwavo', mamwe mamiriro (nhamba yevadzidzi, nhamba yemazuva echikoro, nezvimwewo) anofanira kuva akafanana. Kana pakanga pane vadzidzi vashoma kana mazuva echikoro mashoma, kutengesa kwaizodzikira kunyangwe nekuravira kwakafanana.
20261123-english-g09-1.example: Tanga wanyora nemutauro wako pachako kuti chii chingaitisa "masikati mashoma akatengeswa."
20261123-english-g09-1.actionItem: Tsvaga fungidziro isina kutaurwa inodiwa kuti chirevo chishande, uye unyore muChirungu tsananguro imwe inozungunusa fungidziro iyoyo.

20261123-english-g09-2.title: Chinja sarudzo yeresitorendi sezvo maongororo akawanda achiwedzera rimwe nerimwe
20261123-english-g09-2.summary: Mhuri iri kusarudza resitorendi yekudya kwemasikati vasati vaenda kufirimu (inotanga pa3:00 p.m.). Nguva yekudya kwemasikati iawa rimwe rinotanga pa12:30. Ruzivo rwemaongororo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva.
20261123-english-g09-2.principle: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.
20261123-english-g09-2.example: Tsvaga izwi rimwe kana nhamba imwe yawaona kekutanga muchidimbu ichi.
20261123-english-g09-2.actionItem: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.

20261123-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261123-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261123-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261123-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261123-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261123-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261123-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261123-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.
20261123-english-g10-2.actionItem: Muchinyorwa chokupokana, tsvaga mutsetse umo humbowo husingatsigiri chirevo zvakakwana, uunyore patsva semutsara une kungwarira zvikuru, uye utonge kuti humbowo hupi hwakawedzerwa hunodikanwa.

20261123-english-g11-1.title: Murairo webasa usina kujeka: chii chekubvunza kutanga?
20261123-english-g11-1.summary:
Iyi i imeyili yakagamuchirwa nemudzidzi wekuzvidzidzira Jiho kubva kumutungamiriri weboka Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Zvaanoziva Jiho: Karenda yeboka inoratidza musangano neAurora Co. paChipiri pa 10:00 nemusangano neBlue Pine Ltd. paChina pa 14:00. Foodha yekugovana ine mafaira akasiyana ekupfupisa kutengesa eJuly, August neSeptember.
20261123-english-g11-1.principle: Kana mutengi nenguva zvisina kusarudzwa, unogona kutumira faira rakaipa kumutengi akaipa. Kuchimiro, unogona kugadza default sa PDF uye ukamuzivisa, uye kuva kwake kubasa hakuna chekuita nebasa pacharo.
20261123-english-g11-1.example: Tarisa kana 'kuna ani,' 'chii,' ne 'rini' zvichibuda semuchinhu chimwe chete mu imeyili.
20261123-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kubva pamaimeyili ebasa asina kujeka, sarudza ruzivo rwunofanira kusimbiswa usati wabata, uye unyore imeyili yemibvunzo inonzwisisika zviri nyore kupindura.

20261123-english-g11-2.title: Zvinokonzerwa neklabhu yekuverenga here? Ruzivo rupi rwaizotiita kuti tiziive?
20261123-english-g11-2.summary:
Ichi chikamu chereport yeStudent council.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Mudzidzi Mina anoda kuongorora kana mhedziso iyi yakarurama. Vadzidzi vanobatana neklabhu nekukumbira kana vachida.
20261123-english-g11-2.principle: Kana uchiziva mamaki ekubva usati wabatana, unogona kuenzanisa kana mamaki enhengo aive makuru kare kana akakwira mushure mekubatana. Nokuti vadzidzi vanobatana nekukumbira, vadzidzi vakanaka kare muEnglish vanogona kunge vakabatana vakawanda.
20261123-english-g11-2.example: Funga kuti chokwadi chekuti vadzidzi vanobatana 'nekukumbira kana vachida' chingakanganisa sei pekutangira pamapoka maviri.
20261123-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti uone kana musiyano wemamaki pakati penhengo dzeklabhu nevasiri nhengo uri mugumisiro weklabhu, uye unyore muEnglish mubvunzo wekuwana ruzivo irworwo.

20261123-english-g12-1.title: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vane zvibodzwa zvakakwira: chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva?
20261123-english-g12-1.summary:
'Ichi chirevo chinobva muchinyorwa chechikoro. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Sehumbowo, mhedzisiro yeongororo yevadzidzi 200 yakaratidzwa seizvi.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74'
20261123-english-g12-1.principle: b inotarisa zvimwe zvikonzero (kurara, nguva yokudzidza), c inotarisa mhedzisiro yokupindira kwechokwadi, uye e inotarisa kururama kwokuenzanisa. a ne d hazvisi humbowo hwokuti zvokudya zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
20261123-english-g12-1.example: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
20261123-english-g12-1.actionItem: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yeongororo ichitiudza pamusoro pe "chikonzero", sarudza ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa pakutonga uku, uye ukurudzire muChirungu nzira yokuenzanisa yokutarisa mugumisiro wezvokudya zvemahara.

20261123-english-g12-2.title: Chiitiko chimwechete, misoro yenhau yakasiyana: kutonga kunochinja sezvo ruzivo rwunokura
20261123-english-g12-2.summary: Nyaya inoratidza kuti khonsoro yedhorobha yakasarudza kukwidziridza mari yekupaka padyo nechiteshi inotsunga yakaburitswa nhanho nhanho. Tarisa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja nguva dzose ruzivo ruchikura.
20261123-english-g12-2.principle: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.
20261123-english-g12-2.example: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.
20261123-english-g12-2.actionItem: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.

20261124-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
20261124-english-g01-1.summary:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
20261124-english-g01-1.principle: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
20261124-english-g01-1.example: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
20261124-english-g01-1.actionItem: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.

20261124-english-g01-2.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
20261124-english-g01-2.summary:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
20261124-english-g01-2.principle: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
20261124-english-g01-2.example: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
20261124-english-g01-2.actionItem: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.

20261124-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ndeipi nzvimbo? Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana
20261124-english-g02-1.summary:
Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261124-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
20261124-english-g02-1.example: Funga nzvimbo mbiri kana nhatu apo mitsetse miviri iyi ingataurwa.
20261124-english-g02-1.actionItem: Tonga kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo kubva pamitsetse miviri yakanzwikwa bedzi, uye usarudze chiratidzo chekuwedzera chinopatsanura nzvimbo.

20261124-english-g02-2.title: Mhinduro ipi inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi? Kufunga nezvemiganhu yekuremekedza
20261124-english-g02-2.summary:
Mudzidzisi anoti mangwanani, "How are you today, Mina?"

Shamwari yako Jin yakati, "MuChirungu, kutaura nokuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka. Unogona kungotaura saizvozvo kuvanhu vese."
20261124-english-g02-2.principle: b ne d dzinopindura kukwazisa uye dzinobvunza munhu mumwe, saka dzinokodzera mudzidzisi. a i isina kurongeka zvakanyanya uye c inonzwika isingaremekedzi.
20261124-english-g02-2.example: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana mhinduro inokodzera mubvunzo uye kana inokodzera mudzidzisi.
20261124-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sarudza mhinduro inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi, uye utaure chiitiko apo chirevo che 'kuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka' chisingashande.

20261124-english-g03-1.title: Tsvaga nguva yekuverenga mundandanda yaMina yeSaturday
20261124-english-g03-1.summary:
Ndandanda yaMina yeSaturday (yakanyorwa semashoko chete, pasina pikicha):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina anoda kuverenga bhuku kwe 1 awa. Anotanga pa awa uye otsiva pa awa.
20261124-english-g03-1.principle: Nguva isina basa inotanga pa10 a.m., uye 12 kusvika 14 dzizere nekudya kwemasikati nekutamba. Hapana mabasa muchirongwa kubva pa15 kusvika 16 nekubva pa16 kusvika 17, uye anopera kudya kwemanheru kusati kwasvika.
20261124-english-g03-1.example: Shandura nguva dziri mundandanda kuita nhamba dze 24-hour uye udhirowe time strip.
20261124-english-g03-1.actionItem: Funga nguva dzakasiyana dzekutanga kuverenga dzinogutsa mamiriro ose endandanda, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nguva dzisingashande.

20261124-english-g03-2.title: Ratidza 'worry' usingatauri
20261124-english-g03-2.summary: Uchanyora chiitiko umo shamwari yako Mina ine hanya panguva yebvunzo. Zvinyorwa zvinotaura manzwiro zvakananga nezvinyorwa zvinoaratidza kuburikidza nezvinoitwa zvinosvika kumuverengi nenzira dzakasiyana.
20261124-english-g03-2.principle: Kubva pamaoko anotonhora nekuongorora clock kunodzokororwa, muverengi anogona kufungidzira hanya. Kuzaira achitarisa kunze kwefafitera kunoratidza kuneta, uye kunyemwerera achinyora nekukurumidza kunoratidza kuzorora kana kuzvivimba.
20261124-english-g03-2.example: Kubva pazvinyorwa zvitatu zvega zvega, sarudza uye unyore chiito kana shanduko yemuviri yaMina.
20261124-english-g03-2.actionItem: Nyora zvinyorwa pfupi umo muverengi anogona kufungidzira manzwiro kubva pazvinoitwa nezvikomborero zvemuviri chete, pasina izwi remanzwiro.

20261124-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261124-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261124-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.
20261124-english-g04-1.example: Isa mutsetse wega wega padivi penguva yepaki '4:15-5:15' rimwe nerimwe, uye utarise kana unopera usati watanga kana unotanga pashure.
20261124-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261124-english-g04-2.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
20261124-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."
20261124-english-g04-2.principle: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
20261124-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.
20261124-english-g04-2.actionItem: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.

20261124-english-g05-1.title: Kufunga kwako kunochinja sezvaunoverenga posita
20261124-english-g05-1.summary: Jun haasi nhengo yeGreen Library. Shamwari yake Ara inhengo yeGreen Library. Vaviri vavo vari kuverenga posita iri pamberi perabhurari mutsara umwe panguva.
20261124-english-g05-1.principle: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.
20261124-english-g05-1.example: Tarisa kana mutsara mutsva wenguva ino unochinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
20261124-english-g05-1.actionItem: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.

20261124-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - zvinyorwa zvinozvitsigira here?
20261124-english-g05-2.summary:
Kirasi yaMina ine kona yekuverenga ine bhukhoso.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261124-english-g05-2.principle: Zvinyorwa zvinotaura chete nhamba yemabhuku ari pabhukhoso (12 mabhuku ezvipfuwo, nezvimwewo). Hazvitaure kuti vadzidzi vanoverenga kana kukwereta mabhuku api zvakawanda, saka hatigoni kuongorora chirevo che 'most popular'.
20261124-english-g05-2.example: Funga kuti 'popular' inorevei mumashoko aMina, uye utsvage mutsara muzvinyorwa unokuudza izvozvo.
20261124-english-g05-2.actionItem: Funga kana ruzivo rwenhamba muzvinyorwa rwunotsigira chirevo (popular), uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unogona kuongorora chirevo.

20261124-english-g06-1.title: Kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro here? Kuchinja kutonga kwako sezvo humbowo huchikura
20261124-english-g06-1.summary: Kirabhu itsva yemabhuku yakatanga kuchikoro chedu. Mudzidzisi akati, "The club is a success." Uchagamuchira humbowo chikamu chimwe panguva imwe uye ufunge kana chirevo ichi chakarurama.
20261124-english-g06-1.principle: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.
20261124-english-g06-1.example: Paradzanisa zvinosimbiswa nedata raunazvino nezvausati wazviziva.
20261124-english-g06-1.actionItem: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.

20261124-english-g06-2.title: Kugadzira matafura ekutsvaga zviitiko apo chirevo i chokwadi
20261124-english-g06-2.summary: Vadzidzi 20 mukirasi imwe vakakanda vote imwe imwe yechiitiko mushure menguva yesnack: soccer, art, kana music. Mavote anonzi s (soccer), a (art), ne m (music).
20261124-english-g06-2.principle: Mavote 8 i akawanda kupfuura art (6) ne music (6), saka i most, uye i shoma kupfuura 10, iyo i hafu ye 20, saka haisi hafu. Saka a yakarurama.
20261124-english-g06-2.example: Wedzera 8, 6, ne 6, tsvaga hafu yevadzidzi 20 i chii, uye uenzanise.
20261124-english-g06-2.actionItem: Gadzira iwe pachako matafura akati wandei evote ayo chirevo cheChirungu 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' i chokwadi.

20261124-english-g07-1.title: Ben achauya kumutambo here? Kuongorora zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro dzake
20261124-english-g07-1.summary:
Nhaurirano pakati paJisu naBen (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261124-english-g07-1.principle: Mutambo wesoccer i mangwanani uye mutambo i pa 4 p.m., saka nguva hadzipindirani. Ben akangoti angangoneta, uye pakupedzisira akati achatarisa nemai vake kutanga. Saka pane chakagadzwa (nguva) nechasara (mvumo yemai vake), uye hazvisati zvasarudzwa.
20261124-english-g07-1.example: Patsanura mashoko aBen kuita zvidimbu zvina: 'mutambo wesoccer,' 'nguva yemutambo,' 'kuneta,' ne 'mai.'
20261124-english-g07-1.actionItem: Patsanura mhinduro dzaBen munhaurirano mutsetse nemutsetse, siyanisa zvakagadzwa nezvinosara, uye utonge usingatauri 'achauya' kana 'haazouyi'.

20261124-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' inoreva here kuti zvakanaka chaizvo?
20261124-english-g07-2.summary: Sam naDad vanotaura nezvehurongwa hwePachishanu. Nhaurirano inoratidzwa muzvikamu zvitatu. Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo.
20261124-english-g07-2.principle: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.
20261124-english-g07-2.example: Tsvaga toni imwe itsva kana izwi rimwe muchidimbu ichi.
20261124-english-g07-2.actionItem: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.

20261124-english-g08-1.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
20261124-english-g08-1.summary: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
20261124-english-g08-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
20261124-english-g08-1.example: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
20261124-english-g08-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.

20261124-english-g08-2.title: Gadzirisa mutsara une nhamba isina kururama mu blog post yekuchenesa mhenderekedzo
20261124-english-g08-2.summary: Mudzidzi wekirasi imwe akanyora post iyi pa blog yechikoro. (Izvi zvinyorwa chete. Mutsara wese une nhamba.)
20261124-english-g08-2.principle: Mutsara 3 unoti vakaunganidza 30 bags muawa rekutanga, uye mutsara 4 unoti huwandu hwose hwaiva 18 bags. Huwandu hwose hahugoni kuva hushoma kupfuura zvakaunganidzwa muawa rekutanga. Post iyi oga haigoni kukuudza kuti mutsara 3 kana 4 hausina kururama, saka unogona kusarudza chero upi.
20261124-english-g08-2.example: Unganidza mitsara ine nhamba chete uye uienzanise.
20261124-english-g08-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yenhamba mu blog post isingaenderani, uye uinyore zvakare kuti ienderane neruzivo rwakasimbiswa.

20261124-english-g09-1.title: Fungidziro yakavanzika mu 'takatengesa masikati 200 shoma'
20261124-english-g09-1.summary:
Izvi zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pamberi pekafeteria yechikoro.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261124-english-g09-1.principle: Kuenda kubva pachokwadi chekuti kutengesa kwakadzikira kusvika ku 'hazvina kuenderana nekuravira kwavo', mamwe mamiriro (nhamba yevadzidzi, nhamba yemazuva echikoro, nezvimwewo) anofanira kuva akafanana. Kana pakanga pane vadzidzi vashoma kana mazuva echikoro mashoma, kutengesa kwaizodzikira kunyangwe nekuravira kwakafanana.
20261124-english-g09-1.example: Tanga wanyora nemutauro wako pachako kuti chii chingaitisa "masikati mashoma akatengeswa."
20261124-english-g09-1.actionItem: Tsvaga fungidziro isina kutaurwa inodiwa kuti chirevo chishande, uye unyore muChirungu tsananguro imwe inozungunusa fungidziro iyoyo.

20261124-english-g09-2.title: Chinja sarudzo yeresitorendi sezvo maongororo akawanda achiwedzera rimwe nerimwe
20261124-english-g09-2.summary: Mhuri iri kusarudza resitorendi yekudya kwemasikati vasati vaenda kufirimu (inotanga pa3:00 p.m.). Nguva yekudya kwemasikati iawa rimwe rinotanga pa12:30. Ruzivo rwemaongororo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva.
20261124-english-g09-2.principle: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.
20261124-english-g09-2.example: Tsvaga izwi rimwe kana nhamba imwe yawaona kekutanga muchidimbu ichi.
20261124-english-g09-2.actionItem: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.

20261124-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261124-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261124-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261124-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261124-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261124-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261124-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261124-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.
20261124-english-g10-2.actionItem: Muchinyorwa chokupokana, tsvaga mutsetse umo humbowo husingatsigiri chirevo zvakakwana, uunyore patsva semutsara une kungwarira zvikuru, uye utonge kuti humbowo hupi hwakawedzerwa hunodikanwa.

20261124-english-g11-1.title: Murairo webasa usina kujeka: chii chekubvunza kutanga?
20261124-english-g11-1.summary:
Iyi i imeyili yakagamuchirwa nemudzidzi wekuzvidzidzira Jiho kubva kumutungamiriri weboka Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Zvaanoziva Jiho: Karenda yeboka inoratidza musangano neAurora Co. paChipiri pa 10:00 nemusangano neBlue Pine Ltd. paChina pa 14:00. Foodha yekugovana ine mafaira akasiyana ekupfupisa kutengesa eJuly, August neSeptember.
20261124-english-g11-1.principle: Kana mutengi nenguva zvisina kusarudzwa, unogona kutumira faira rakaipa kumutengi akaipa. Kuchimiro, unogona kugadza default sa PDF uye ukamuzivisa, uye kuva kwake kubasa hakuna chekuita nebasa pacharo.
20261124-english-g11-1.example: Tarisa kana 'kuna ani,' 'chii,' ne 'rini' zvichibuda semuchinhu chimwe chete mu imeyili.
20261124-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kubva pamaimeyili ebasa asina kujeka, sarudza ruzivo rwunofanira kusimbiswa usati wabata, uye unyore imeyili yemibvunzo inonzwisisika zviri nyore kupindura.

20261124-english-g11-2.title: Zvinokonzerwa neklabhu yekuverenga here? Ruzivo rupi rwaizotiita kuti tiziive?
20261124-english-g11-2.summary:
Ichi chikamu chereport yeStudent council.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Mudzidzi Mina anoda kuongorora kana mhedziso iyi yakarurama. Vadzidzi vanobatana neklabhu nekukumbira kana vachida.
20261124-english-g11-2.principle: Kana uchiziva mamaki ekubva usati wabatana, unogona kuenzanisa kana mamaki enhengo aive makuru kare kana akakwira mushure mekubatana. Nokuti vadzidzi vanobatana nekukumbira, vadzidzi vakanaka kare muEnglish vanogona kunge vakabatana vakawanda.
20261124-english-g11-2.example: Funga kuti chokwadi chekuti vadzidzi vanobatana 'nekukumbira kana vachida' chingakanganisa sei pekutangira pamapoka maviri.
20261124-english-g11-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuti uone kana musiyano wemamaki pakati penhengo dzeklabhu nevasiri nhengo uri mugumisiro weklabhu, uye unyore muEnglish mubvunzo wekuwana ruzivo irworwo.

20261124-english-g12-1.title: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vane zvibodzwa zvakakwira: chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva?
20261124-english-g12-1.summary:
'Ichi chirevo chinobva muchinyorwa chechikoro. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Sehumbowo, mhedzisiro yeongororo yevadzidzi 200 yakaratidzwa seizvi.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74'
20261124-english-g12-1.principle: b inotarisa zvimwe zvikonzero (kurara, nguva yokudzidza), c inotarisa mhedzisiro yokupindira kwechokwadi, uye e inotarisa kururama kwokuenzanisa. a ne d hazvisi humbowo hwokuti zvokudya zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
20261124-english-g12-1.example: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
20261124-english-g12-1.actionItem: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yeongororo ichitiudza pamusoro pe "chikonzero", sarudza ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa pakutonga uku, uye ukurudzire muChirungu nzira yokuenzanisa yokutarisa mugumisiro wezvokudya zvemahara.

20261124-english-g12-2.title: Chiitiko chimwechete, misoro yenhau yakasiyana: kutonga kunochinja sezvo ruzivo rwunokura
20261124-english-g12-2.summary: Nyaya inoratidza kuti khonsoro yedhorobha yakasarudza kukwidziridza mari yekupaka padyo nechiteshi inotsunga yakaburitswa nhanho nhanho. Tarisa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja nguva dzose ruzivo ruchikura.
20261124-english-g12-2.principle: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.
20261124-english-g12-2.example: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.
20261124-english-g12-2.actionItem: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.

20261125-english-g01-1.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
20261125-english-g01-1.summary:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
20261125-english-g01-1.principle: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
20261125-english-g01-1.example: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
20261125-english-g01-1.actionItem: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.

20261125-english-g01-2.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
20261125-english-g01-2.summary:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
20261125-english-g01-2.principle: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
20261125-english-g01-2.example: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
20261125-english-g01-2.actionItem: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.

20261125-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ndeipi nzvimbo? Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana
20261125-english-g02-1.summary:
Wakanzwa zvakataurwa nemurume nemushandi wematikiti. Havana kutaura kuti nzvimbo ndeipi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261125-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket ne show i mashoko anoshandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda, sa cinema kana concert hall. Zvakaoma kusarudza imwe kubva pamitsetse miviri bedzi.
20261125-english-g02-1.example: Funga nzvimbo mbiri kana nhatu apo mitsetse miviri iyi ingataurwa.
20261125-english-g02-1.actionItem: Tonga kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo kubva pamitsetse miviri yakanzwikwa bedzi, uye usarudze chiratidzo chekuwedzera chinopatsanura nzvimbo.

20261125-english-g02-2.title: Mhinduro ipi inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi? Kufunga nezvemiganhu yekuremekedza
20261125-english-g02-2.summary:
Mudzidzisi anoti mangwanani, "How are you today, Mina?"

Shamwari yako Jin yakati, "MuChirungu, kutaura nokuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka. Unogona kungotaura saizvozvo kuvanhu vese."
20261125-english-g02-2.principle: b ne d dzinopindura kukwazisa uye dzinobvunza munhu mumwe, saka dzinokodzera mudzidzisi. a i isina kurongeka zvakanyanya uye c inonzwika isingaremekedzi.
20261125-english-g02-2.example: Tarisa zvakasiyana kana mhinduro inokodzera mubvunzo uye kana inokodzera mudzidzisi.
20261125-english-g02-2.actionItem: Sarudza mhinduro inokodzera kukwazisa kwemudzidzisi, uye utaure chiitiko apo chirevo che 'kuremekedza kunogara kuri kwakanaka' chisingashande.

20261125-english-g03-1.title: Tsvaga nguva yekuverenga mundandanda yaMina yeSaturday
20261125-english-g03-1.summary:
Ndandanda yaMina yeSaturday (yakanyorwa semashoko chete, pasina pikicha):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina anoda kuverenga bhuku kwe 1 awa. Anotanga pa awa uye otsiva pa awa.
20261125-english-g03-1.principle: Nguva isina basa inotanga pa10 a.m., uye 12 kusvika 14 dzizere nekudya kwemasikati nekutamba. Hapana mabasa muchirongwa kubva pa15 kusvika 16 nekubva pa16 kusvika 17, uye anopera kudya kwemanheru kusati kwasvika.
20261125-english-g03-1.example: Shandura nguva dziri mundandanda kuita nhamba dze 24-hour uye udhirowe time strip.
20261125-english-g03-1.actionItem: Funga nguva dzakasiyana dzekutanga kuverenga dzinogutsa mamiriro ose endandanda, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nguva dzisingashande.

20261125-english-g03-2.title: Ratidza 'worry' usingatauri
20261125-english-g03-2.summary: Uchanyora chiitiko umo shamwari yako Mina ine hanya panguva yebvunzo. Zvinyorwa zvinotaura manzwiro zvakananga nezvinyorwa zvinoaratidza kuburikidza nezvinoitwa zvinosvika kumuverengi nenzira dzakasiyana.
20261125-english-g03-2.principle: Kubva pamaoko anotonhora nekuongorora clock kunodzokororwa, muverengi anogona kufungidzira hanya. Kuzaira achitarisa kunze kwefafitera kunoratidza kuneta, uye kunyemwerera achinyora nekukurumidza kunoratidza kuzorora kana kuzvivimba.
20261125-english-g03-2.example: Kubva pazvinyorwa zvitatu zvega zvega, sarudza uye unyore chiito kana shanduko yemuviri yaMina.
20261125-english-g03-2.actionItem: Nyora zvinyorwa pfupi umo muverengi anogona kufungidzira manzwiro kubva pazvinoitwa nezvikomborero zvemuviri chete, pasina izwi remanzwiro.

20261125-english-g04-1.title: Notsi yaAmai nenguva yokutamba yaJisu
20261125-english-g04-1.summary:
'Notsi yakasiiwa naAmai patafura (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Shure kweizvozvo shamwari yake Jisu akatumira meseji. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261125-english-g04-1.principle: Piano class i 4:00-4:30, saka 4:15-4:30 inopindirana, uye kubvisa marara pa 5:00 kuri mukati me 4:15-5:15. Kusvika kumba pa 3:30 nedinner pa 6:30 zviri kunze kwenguva yepaki.
20261125-english-g04-1.example: Isa mutsetse wega wega padivi penguva yepaki '4:15-5:15' rimwe nerimwe, uye utarise kana unopera usati watanga kana unotanga pashure.
20261125-english-g04-1.actionItem: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvakati wandei zviri panotsi yaAmai nenguva yakakurudzirwa neshamwari, tsvaga pasingaenderani, uye uti kwete muChirungu uchikurudzira nguva yakasiyana.

20261125-english-g04-2.title: Sarudza nguva dzokufamba nembwa nedzoruzivo rwepamba
20261125-english-g04-2.summary:
"Notsi yakasiiwa naBaba (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Pazasi, nyora nguva imwe neimwe se 'maminitsi mangani mushure me 4:00 p.m.'. Semuenzaniso, kana ukatanga pa 4:30, nyora 30, uye kana ukatanga pa 5:15, nyora 75."
20261125-english-g04-2.principle: Homework i 5:00-6:00 uye kufamba i 5:30-6:00, saka mabasa maviri anopindirana kubva pa 5:30 kusvika pa 6:00. Kufamba kunotanga shure kwe 5:00 uye mabasa ose maviri anopera pamberi pe 6:30, saka mamwe mamiriro anochengetwa.
20261125-english-g04-2.example: Wedzera nguva inotorwa (mumaminitsi) kunguva yokutanga yebasa rega rega kuti utsvage nguva inopera.
20261125-english-g04-2.actionItem: Gadzira zvisanganiswa zvakasiyana zvakati wandei zvenguva yokufamba nenguva yoruzivo rwepamba zvinogutsa mamiriro ose ari panotsi yaBaba.

20261125-english-g05-1.title: Kufunga kwako kunochinja sezvaunoverenga posita
20261125-english-g05-1.summary: Jun haasi nhengo yeGreen Library. Shamwari yake Ara inhengo yeGreen Library. Vaviri vavo vari kuverenga posita iri pamberi perabhurari mutsara umwe panguva.
20261125-english-g05-1.principle: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.
20261125-english-g05-1.example: Tarisa kana mutsara mutsva wenguva ino unochinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
20261125-english-g05-1.actionItem: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rweposita rwuchibuda nhanho nenhanho, uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unoongorora ruzivo rusiri paposita.

20261125-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - zvinyorwa zvinozvitsigira here?
20261125-english-g05-2.summary:
Kirasi yaMina ine kona yekuverenga ine bhukhoso.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261125-english-g05-2.principle: Zvinyorwa zvinotaura chete nhamba yemabhuku ari pabhukhoso (12 mabhuku ezvipfuwo, nezvimwewo). Hazvitaure kuti vadzidzi vanoverenga kana kukwereta mabhuku api zvakawanda, saka hatigoni kuongorora chirevo che 'most popular'.
20261125-english-g05-2.example: Funga kuti 'popular' inorevei mumashoko aMina, uye utsvage mutsara muzvinyorwa unokuudza izvozvo.
20261125-english-g05-2.actionItem: Funga kana ruzivo rwenhamba muzvinyorwa rwunotsigira chirevo (popular), uye ugadzire mubvunzo weEnglish unogona kuongorora chirevo.

20261125-english-g06-1.title: Kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro here? Kuchinja kutonga kwako sezvo humbowo huchikura
20261125-english-g06-1.summary: Kirabhu itsva yemabhuku yakatanga kuchikoro chedu. Mudzidzisi akati, "The club is a success." Uchagamuchira humbowo chikamu chimwe panguva imwe uye ufunge kana chirevo ichi chakarurama.
20261125-english-g06-1.principle: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.
20261125-english-g06-1.example: Paradzanisa zvinosimbiswa nedata raunazvino nezvausati wazviziva.
20261125-english-g06-1.actionItem: Sezvo data ichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe, chinja kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo che 'kirabhu yemabhuku ibudiriro', uye upedze muChirungu uchishandisa zvikamu zviviri zvehumbowo.

20261125-english-g06-2.title: Kugadzira matafura ekutsvaga zviitiko apo chirevo i chokwadi
20261125-english-g06-2.summary: Vadzidzi 20 mukirasi imwe vakakanda vote imwe imwe yechiitiko mushure menguva yesnack: soccer, art, kana music. Mavote anonzi s (soccer), a (art), ne m (music).
20261125-english-g06-2.principle: Mavote 8 i akawanda kupfuura art (6) ne music (6), saka i most, uye i shoma kupfuura 10, iyo i hafu ye 20, saka haisi hafu. Saka a yakarurama.
20261125-english-g06-2.example: Wedzera 8, 6, ne 6, tsvaga hafu yevadzidzi 20 i chii, uye uenzanise.
20261125-english-g06-2.actionItem: Gadzira iwe pachako matafura akati wandei evote ayo chirevo cheChirungu 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' i chokwadi.

20261125-english-g07-1.title: Ben achauya kumutambo here? Kuongorora zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro dzake
20261125-english-g07-1.summary:
Nhaurirano pakati paJisu naBen (yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261125-english-g07-1.principle: Mutambo wesoccer i mangwanani uye mutambo i pa 4 p.m., saka nguva hadzipindirani. Ben akangoti angangoneta, uye pakupedzisira akati achatarisa nemai vake kutanga. Saka pane chakagadzwa (nguva) nechasara (mvumo yemai vake), uye hazvisati zvasarudzwa.
20261125-english-g07-1.example: Patsanura mashoko aBen kuita zvidimbu zvina: 'mutambo wesoccer,' 'nguva yemutambo,' 'kuneta,' ne 'mai.'
20261125-english-g07-1.actionItem: Patsanura mhinduro dzaBen munhaurirano mutsetse nemutsetse, siyanisa zvakagadzwa nezvinosara, uye utonge usingatauri 'achauya' kana 'haazouyi'.

20261125-english-g07-2.title: 'That's fine.' inoreva here kuti zvakanaka chaizvo?
20261125-english-g07-2.summary: Sam naDad vanotaura nezvehurongwa hwePachishanu. Nhaurirano inoratidzwa muzvikamu zvitatu. Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mifananidzo.
20261125-english-g07-2.principle: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.
20261125-english-g07-2.example: Tsvaga toni imwe itsva kana izwi rimwe muchidimbu ichi.
20261125-english-g07-2.actionItem: Kuverenga nhaurirano shoma panguva imwe, gadzira kutonga nezvemanzwiro emukati emutauri, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwapfuura kana chiratidzo chitsva chamuka.

20261125-english-g08-1.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
20261125-english-g08-1.summary: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
20261125-english-g08-1.principle: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
20261125-english-g08-1.example: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
20261125-english-g08-1.actionItem: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.

20261125-english-g08-2.title: Gadzirisa mutsara une nhamba isina kururama mu blog post yekuchenesa mhenderekedzo
20261125-english-g08-2.summary: Mudzidzi wekirasi imwe akanyora post iyi pa blog yechikoro. (Izvi zvinyorwa chete. Mutsara wese une nhamba.)
20261125-english-g08-2.principle: Mutsara 3 unoti vakaunganidza 30 bags muawa rekutanga, uye mutsara 4 unoti huwandu hwose hwaiva 18 bags. Huwandu hwose hahugoni kuva hushoma kupfuura zvakaunganidzwa muawa rekutanga. Post iyi oga haigoni kukuudza kuti mutsara 3 kana 4 hausina kururama, saka unogona kusarudza chero upi.
20261125-english-g08-2.example: Unganidza mitsara ine nhamba chete uye uienzanise.
20261125-english-g08-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yenhamba mu blog post isingaenderani, uye uinyore zvakare kuti ienderane neruzivo rwakasimbiswa.

20261125-english-g09-1.title: Fungidziro yakavanzika mu 'takatengesa masikati 200 shoma'
20261125-english-g09-1.summary:
Izvi zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pamberi pekafeteria yechikoro.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261125-english-g09-1.principle: Kuenda kubva pachokwadi chekuti kutengesa kwakadzikira kusvika ku 'hazvina kuenderana nekuravira kwavo', mamwe mamiriro (nhamba yevadzidzi, nhamba yemazuva echikoro, nezvimwewo) anofanira kuva akafanana. Kana pakanga pane vadzidzi vashoma kana mazuva echikoro mashoma, kutengesa kwaizodzikira kunyangwe nekuravira kwakafanana.
20261125-english-g09-1.example: Tanga wanyora nemutauro wako pachako kuti chii chingaitisa "masikati mashoma akatengeswa."
20261125-english-g09-1.actionItem: Tsvaga fungidziro isina kutaurwa inodiwa kuti chirevo chishande, uye unyore muChirungu tsananguro imwe inozungunusa fungidziro iyoyo.

20261125-english-g09-2.title: Chinja sarudzo yeresitorendi sezvo maongororo akawanda achiwedzera rimwe nerimwe
20261125-english-g09-2.summary: Mhuri iri kusarudza resitorendi yekudya kwemasikati vasati vaenda kufirimu (inotanga pa3:00 p.m.). Nguva yekudya kwemasikati iawa rimwe rinotanga pa12:30. Ruzivo rwemaongororo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva.
20261125-english-g09-2.principle: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.
20261125-english-g09-2.example: Tsvaga izwi rimwe kana nhamba imwe yawaona kekutanga muchidimbu ichi.
20261125-english-g09-2.actionItem: Verenga maongororo eresitorendi nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako, uye unyore muEnglish mamiriro echiyero chaunogona kuvimba nacho.

20261125-english-g10-1.title: Tinonyora sei zviziviso zviviri zvinopokana mu school newsletter?
20261125-english-g10-1.summary:
Uri muchikwata chinyora cheschool English newsletter. Zviziviso zviviri zvefestival zvakasiyana.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Hauna kusimbisa kuti chipi chakarurama.
20261125-english-g10-1.principle: Kana zvisati zvasimbiswa, zvakaenzana kutaura zvinotaurwa nesosi imwe neimwe yaviri, uye kuudza vaverengi kuti zvichiri kutariswa. Kusarudza divi rimwe uchirishumira, kana kuudza vanhu kuti vasauya pasina ruzivo, kunonyengera vaverengi.
20261125-english-g10-1.example: Enzanisa ruzivo rwunopiwa nechiziviso chimwe nechimwe kuvaverengi nezvichahwanikwa.
20261125-english-g10-1.actionItem: Nyorera vaverengi (vadzidzi) chinyorwa chinotaura zviziviso zviviri zvakasiyana nenzira yakaenzana, uchitaura zvisati zvasimbiswa uye zvinofanira kuitwa nevaverengi.

20261125-english-g10-2.title: Mhosva imwe chete inogona kururamisa kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose' here?
20261125-english-g10-2.summary:
"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261125-english-g10-2.principle: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. 20261119-korean-l1-1.title: Ndeipi chiratidzo chinotungamirira kupaki yemotokari?
20261119-korean-l1-1.summary:
"Muenzi anokwira kuchikoro ndokuda kusiya motokari kwehawa imwe. Masaini matatu ari kuonekwa (pasina mifananidzo, saka akatsanangurwa nemashoko).

Sign A: mavara machena '주차 금지' pabhodhi dzvuku. Denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse wakatsemuka rinoyambuka mufananidzo mudiki wemotokari. Rakasungirirwa kuuzivi hwechikoro.
Sign B: bhodhi dzvuku bhuruu, mavara machena '방문자 주차장' nemubvi unotarisa kurudyi. Umire padivi pemugwagwa.
Sign C: bhodhi girini, mavara machena '주차장 출구' nemubvi unotarisa kumashure kumugwagwa. Rakarembera pamusoro penzira dzakamanikana apo motokari dzinobuda.

Mazwi: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit."
20261119-korean-l1-1.principle: Saini B ndeyevaenzi, inotumidza paki yemotokari uye inopa nzira. Saini A ine izwi rekutanga rimwe chete asi ine chiratidzo chekurambidza. Saini C inotumidzawo paki yemotokari, asi 출구 zvinoreva kubuda, saka inoratidza pakubuda motokari.
20261119-korean-l1-1.example: Rondedzera zvinotaurwa nesaini imwe neimwe nemashoko, nezvinowedzerwa nechiratidzo chayo kana mubvi.
20261119-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Verenga masaini matatu pfupi emugwagwa, batanidza mazwi nemubvi nechiratidzo chakatsanangurwa, uye utonge kuti ndeipi inotungamirira kunoita kuti muenzi aise motokari; dzivirira kutonga kwako pamberi pekuverenga kwakapera hafu kweshamwari.

20261119-korean-l6-2.title: Dhirafiti ipi ichabvumirwa nemukuru?
20261119-korean-l6-2.summary:
Uri mudzidzi wegore rekutanga hyunivhesiti. 민준 선배 mukuru wekirabhu, anopfuura iwe nemakore matatu; wakataura naye kaviri chete. Akanyora zvinyorwa zvakanaka muchidzidzo chesvondo rapfuura. Bvunzo yako ndeyemangwana masikati uye unoda kuona zvinyorwa nhasi. Wakanyora madhirafiti mana:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261119-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B inobvunza kuti zvinogoneka here (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inopa chikonzero, uye chikonzero chinoratidza kumanikidzwa kwenguva. Draft C ine rukudzo zvakanyanya asi haitaure kuti inodiwa mangwana, saka mukuru angapindura svondo rinouya. Draft A haina kuswedera rukudzo kumukuru ari kure, uye Draft D inomumanikidza.
20261119-korean-l6-2.example: Enzanisa kuti dhirafiti imwe neimwe inonzwika sekunge yakanyorerwa ani.
20261119-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Tonga zvikumbiro zvina zvedhirafiti nemataurirwo azvo uye utsanangure kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinoita kuti chikumbiro chibvumirwe nyore, uye dhirafiti dzipi dzinoita sedzine rukudzo dzichiri kusabudirira.

20261121-korean-l1-1.title: Ndeipi chiratidzo chinotungamirira kupaki yemotokari?
20261121-korean-l1-1.summary:
"Muenzi anokwira kuchikoro ndokuda kusiya motokari kwehawa imwe. Masaini matatu ari kuonekwa (pasina mifananidzo, saka akatsanangurwa nemashoko).

Sign A: mavara machena '주차 금지' pabhodhi dzvuku. Denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse wakatsemuka rinoyambuka mufananidzo mudiki wemotokari. Rakasungirirwa kuuzivi hwechikoro.
Sign B: bhodhi dzvuku bhuruu, mavara machena '방문자 주차장' nemubvi unotarisa kurudyi. Umire padivi pemugwagwa.
Sign C: bhodhi girini, mavara machena '주차장 출구' nemubvi unotarisa kumashure kumugwagwa. Rakarembera pamusoro penzira dzakamanikana apo motokari dzinobuda.

Mazwi: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit."
20261121-korean-l1-1.principle: Saini B ndeyevaenzi, inotumidza paki yemotokari uye inopa nzira. Saini A ine izwi rekutanga rimwe chete asi ine chiratidzo chekurambidza. Saini C inotumidzawo paki yemotokari, asi 출구 zvinoreva kubuda, saka inoratidza pakubuda motokari.
20261121-korean-l1-1.example: Rondedzera zvinotaurwa nesaini imwe neimwe nemashoko, nezvinowedzerwa nechiratidzo chayo kana mubvi.
20261121-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Verenga masaini matatu pfupi emugwagwa, batanidza mazwi nemubvi nechiratidzo chakatsanangurwa, uye utonge kuti ndeipi inotungamirira kunoita kuti muenzi aise motokari; dzivirira kutonga kwako pamberi pekuverenga kwakapera hafu kweshamwari.

20261121-korean-l1-2.title: Unogona kupinda muraibhurari rinhi?
20261121-korean-l1-2.summary:
Chiratidzo pamusuo weraibhurari (mutsetse mumwe pamutsara mumwe):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Mazwi: 오전 = mangwanani (a.m.); 오후 = masikati/manheru (p.m.); 낮 = masikati; 쉬어요 = (inozorora); ~ inoverengwa 'to' (kubva ... kusvika ...). Unoda kushanyira musi weChitatu.
20261121-korean-l1-2.principle: Mitsetse 2 ne3 inoshanda pazuva rimwe nerimwe rakajairika. Mutsetse 1 izita uye mutsetse 4 unotaura nezve Sunday chete.
20261121-korean-l1-2.example: Bvunza mutsetse mumwe nomumwe: unoshanda musi weChitatu here?
20261121-korean-l1-2.actionItem: Verenga chiratidzo chine mitsetse yakawanda, sarudza mitsetse ipi inokosha pazuva rakapiwa, wobva watsvaga nguva dzakawanda dzekusvika dzinokodzera dzose.

20261121-korean-l2-1.title: Ndiani anoenda, ndiani anoramba?
20261121-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 mudzidzi uye anotaura nerukudzo kuvakuru. Katatu 지우 anoti goodbye. Tarisa kuti ndiani anofamba uye ndiani anoramba pavari.

Scene 1: 지우 anopedza kutaura mukamuri ya선생님 uye anobuda. 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
Scene 2: 지우 ne 선생님 vanobuda muchikoro pamwe chete. Pagedhi vanofamba nzira dzakasiyana.
Scene 3: 지우 anodya kudya kwemanheru kumba ka할머니. Wobva aenda kumba. 할머니 anoramba kumba.
20261121-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 inotaurwa nemunhu ari kuenda kumunhu ari kuramba. 지우 anobuda uye 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
20261121-korean-l2-1.example: Bvunza: ndiani ari kufamba achienda, uye ndiani ari kuramba mukamuri?
20261121-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Sarudza kuti kutambira kupi kunokodzera kubva kune ari kuenda neari kuramba, cherekedza mamiriro apo vose vanoenda, uye unyore kutambira kune rukudzo nekutenda.

20261121-korean-l2-2.title: Kutenda shamwari, kutenda mudzidzisi
20261121-korean-l2-2.summary: 서준 akapa mudzidzi bhuku uye mudzidzi akanyora kudzoka: '책 줘서 고마워!' Zvino mudzidzisi wa서준 anopa 서준 bhuku, uye 서준 anoda kutumira meseji inenge yakafanana kumudzidzisi.
20261121-korean-l2-2.principle: Zvose chiito chinotaura zvakaitwa nemudzidzisi (줘서 inova 주셔서) neizwi rekutenda (고마워 inova 고맙습니다 kana 감사합니다) zvinoratidza hukama, uye zvinoreva zvinofanira kuramba zviri 'ndatenda nekundipa bhuku'.
20261121-korean-l2-2.example: Tarisa zvinhu zviviri musarudzo imwe neimwe: chiito chezvakaitwa nemudzidzisi neizwi rekutenda.
20261121-korean-l2-2.actionItem: Sarudza kutenda kunokodzera mudzidzisi, wobva wanyora patsva meseji nemazwi ako.

20261121-korean-l3-1.title: Ndiani akapa mari yekudya?
20261121-korean-l3-1.summary:
Vadzidzi vaviri vepaklasi, 지우 ne 하나, vari kuchat nekutaura kunoremekedza kwe -요. MuKorea kazhinji musoro wemutsara (anoita chiitiko) unosiiwa. (댁 = izwi rekuremekedza rekumba kwemumwe munhu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261121-korean-l3-1.principle: Tsamba haitauri musoro wemutsara, asi chimiro chechiito chinoratidza kuti anopa i munhu anofanira kuremekedzwa, uye munhu bedzi akadai munyaya i 할머니, uko 하나 akashanyira. 'Pamwe' yakarurama: tsamba haitauri zvakananga.
20261121-korean-l3-1.example: Tarisa kupera kwe 주셨어요 uye uienzanise ne 먹었어요 mumutsara wapfuura.
20261121-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Fungidzira kuti musoro wemutsara wakasiiwa unoreva ani, ratidza humbowo mutsamba, uye utaure kuti fungidziro inochinja sei kana chiratidzo chimwe chabviswa.

20261121-korean-l3-2.title: Mutsara mumwe usina kujairika mukuzvisimudzira
20261121-korean-l3-2.summary: Mudzidzi mutsva, 이민수, anozvisimudzira kuklasi. Mitsara shanu inoratidzwa. Mutsara mumwe unonzwika usina kujairika kumuteereri weKorea.
20261121-korean-l3-2.principle: Mutsara 2 usina kujairika. 님 i zita rinowedzerwa kumazita evamwe kuratidza kuremekedza. Kuiisa pazita rako pachako kunonzwika sekuzvirumbidza. Mimwe mitsara yakanaka pakuzvisimudzira kuklasi.
20261121-korean-l3-2.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe nenzwi sekunge uri kutaura kuklasi yako. Upi waizoita kuti vanoteerera vanyemwe?
20261121-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsara uri mukuzvisimudzira unonzwika usina kujairika, taura kuti sei, uye uunyore patsva kuti unzwike zvakajairika.

20261121-korean-l4-1.title: Bhuka imba
20261121-korean-l4-1.summary:
Boka renyu rinoda kushandisa imba yeshure kwechikoro. Verenga chiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka renyu 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261121-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 inosanganisira 3시 ~ 4시, apo imba iri kuchenesa. Chirongwa chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kutariswa kune nguva yacho yese, kwete kutanga bedzi.
20261121-korean-l4-1.example: Nyora awa rekutanga neawa rekupera rechirongwa.
20261121-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Batanidza mitemo yeimba kubva muchiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka wako uye utsvage zvirongwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana zvekubhuka zvinogutsa mamiriro ese.

20261121-korean-l4-2.title: Zvanonoka kuenda kupuri here?
20261121-korean-l4-2.summary:

20261121-korean-l5-1.title: Chiziviso chekushanya kwechikoro chine dambudziko renguva
20261121-korean-l5-1.summary: Kirasi yenyu yakagamuchira chiziviso ichi kubva kumudzidzisi nemeseji.
20261121-korean-l5-1.principle: Mitsara 3 ne 4 inopokana: kirasi inosvika pakiki pa 11:30, asi chikafu chemanheru 'mushure mekusvika' chiri pa 11:00. Mitsara 1, 2 ne 5 inoenderana.
20261121-korean-l5-1.example: Isa nguva dzemitsara nenhevedzano uye uienzanise.
20261121-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kupokana muchiziviso chekushanya, sarudza zvingasvikwa, uye unyore mubvunzo unoremekedza unogadzirisa.

20261121-korean-l5-2.title: Mubvunzo upi wandinofanira kubvunza?
20261121-korean-l5-2.summary:
Mudzidzi mukirasi yako Hana anotumira meseji iyi neChitatu. PaSatidha unoshanda kusvika 1:00 p.m., uye unogona kushandisa 10,000 won pachiitiko chete.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261121-korean-l5-2.principle: Miganhu yako miviri inguva yekupera kwebasa (1:00) nebhajeti (10,000 won). Nguva yekutanga inopindura muganhu wekutanga uye huwandu hwemaawa (wakawedzerwa ne 5,000 won) hunopindura wechipiri.
20261121-korean-l5-2.example: Nyora miganhu yako miviri kutanga, wobva wabvunza kuti dimikira ripi rinoshaikwa raizokubvumira kuedza muganhu mumwe nemumwe.
20261121-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rupi rwunoshaikwa rwaunoda usati wabvuma kukoka, wobva wazvikumbira zvakanyatsoita muchiKorea chine rukudzo.

20261121-korean-l6-1.title: Ndinokumbira kupi?
20261121-korean-l6-1.summary: Ndi4:20 p.m. Uri pakaunta ye주민센터 (nzvimbo yeushumiri hwedunhu) yedunhu rako. Unoda kukumbira pasipoti. Hauna chokwadi kuti une mufananidzo wepasipoti mubhegi rako here.
20261121-korean-l6-1.principle: Vandudza kuverenga kwako mhinduro dzemukuru wehofisi sezvo kutaurirana kuchiwanda, wobva wabvunza mubvunzo unotevera une musoro.
20261121-korean-l6-1.example: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
20261121-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Vandudza kuverenga kwako mhinduro dzemukuru wehofisi sezvo kutaurirana kuchiwanda, wobva wabvunza mubvunzo unotevera une musoro.

20261121-korean-l6-2.title: Dhirafiti ipi ichabvumirwa nemukuru?
20261121-korean-l6-2.summary:
Uri mudzidzi wegore rekutanga hyunivhesiti. 민준 선배 mukuru wekirabhu, anopfuura iwe nemakore matatu; wakataura naye kaviri chete. Akanyora zvinyorwa zvakanaka muchidzidzo chesvondo rapfuura. Bvunzo yako ndeyemangwana masikati uye unoda kuona zvinyorwa nhasi. Wakanyora madhirafiti mana:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261121-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B inobvunza kuti zvinogoneka here (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inopa chikonzero, uye chikonzero chinoratidza kumanikidzwa kwenguva. Draft C ine rukudzo zvakanyanya asi haitaure kuti inodiwa mangwana, saka mukuru angapindura svondo rinouya. Draft A haina kuswedera rukudzo kumukuru ari kure, uye Draft D inomumanikidza.
20261121-korean-l6-2.example: Enzanisa kuti dhirafiti imwe neimwe inonzwika sekunge yakanyorerwa ani.
20261121-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Tonga zvikumbiro zvina zvedhirafiti nemataurirwo azvo uye utsanangure kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinoita kuti chikumbiro chibvumirwe nyore, uye dhirafiti dzipi dzinoita sedzine rukudzo dzichiri kusabudirira.

20261122-korean-l1-1.title: Ndeipi chiratidzo chinotungamirira kupaki yemotokari?
20261122-korean-l1-1.summary:
"Muenzi anokwira kuchikoro ndokuda kusiya motokari kwehawa imwe. Masaini matatu ari kuonekwa (pasina mifananidzo, saka akatsanangurwa nemashoko).

Sign A: mavara machena '주차 금지' pabhodhi dzvuku. Denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse wakatsemuka rinoyambuka mufananidzo mudiki wemotokari. Rakasungirirwa kuuzivi hwechikoro.
Sign B: bhodhi dzvuku bhuruu, mavara machena '방문자 주차장' nemubvi unotarisa kurudyi. Umire padivi pemugwagwa.
Sign C: bhodhi girini, mavara machena '주차장 출구' nemubvi unotarisa kumashure kumugwagwa. Rakarembera pamusoro penzira dzakamanikana apo motokari dzinobuda.

Mazwi: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit."
20261122-korean-l1-1.principle: Saini B ndeyevaenzi, inotumidza paki yemotokari uye inopa nzira. Saini A ine izwi rekutanga rimwe chete asi ine chiratidzo chekurambidza. Saini C inotumidzawo paki yemotokari, asi 출구 zvinoreva kubuda, saka inoratidza pakubuda motokari.
20261122-korean-l1-1.example: Rondedzera zvinotaurwa nesaini imwe neimwe nemashoko, nezvinowedzerwa nechiratidzo chayo kana mubvi.
20261122-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Verenga masaini matatu pfupi emugwagwa, batanidza mazwi nemubvi nechiratidzo chakatsanangurwa, uye utonge kuti ndeipi inotungamirira kunoita kuti muenzi aise motokari; dzivirira kutonga kwako pamberi pekuverenga kwakapera hafu kweshamwari.

20261122-korean-l1-2.title: Unogona kupinda muraibhurari rinhi?
20261122-korean-l1-2.summary:
Chiratidzo pamusuo weraibhurari (mutsetse mumwe pamutsara mumwe):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Mazwi: 오전 = mangwanani (a.m.); 오후 = masikati/manheru (p.m.); 낮 = masikati; 쉬어요 = (inozorora); ~ inoverengwa 'to' (kubva ... kusvika ...). Unoda kushanyira musi weChitatu.
20261122-korean-l1-2.principle: Mitsetse 2 ne3 inoshanda pazuva rimwe nerimwe rakajairika. Mutsetse 1 izita uye mutsetse 4 unotaura nezve Sunday chete.
20261122-korean-l1-2.example: Bvunza mutsetse mumwe nomumwe: unoshanda musi weChitatu here?
20261122-korean-l1-2.actionItem: Verenga chiratidzo chine mitsetse yakawanda, sarudza mitsetse ipi inokosha pazuva rakapiwa, wobva watsvaga nguva dzakawanda dzekusvika dzinokodzera dzose.

20261122-korean-l2-1.title: Ndiani anoenda, ndiani anoramba?
20261122-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 mudzidzi uye anotaura nerukudzo kuvakuru. Katatu 지우 anoti goodbye. Tarisa kuti ndiani anofamba uye ndiani anoramba pavari.

Scene 1: 지우 anopedza kutaura mukamuri ya선생님 uye anobuda. 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
Scene 2: 지우 ne 선생님 vanobuda muchikoro pamwe chete. Pagedhi vanofamba nzira dzakasiyana.
Scene 3: 지우 anodya kudya kwemanheru kumba ka할머니. Wobva aenda kumba. 할머니 anoramba kumba.
20261122-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 inotaurwa nemunhu ari kuenda kumunhu ari kuramba. 지우 anobuda uye 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
20261122-korean-l2-1.example: Bvunza: ndiani ari kufamba achienda, uye ndiani ari kuramba mukamuri?
20261122-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Sarudza kuti kutambira kupi kunokodzera kubva kune ari kuenda neari kuramba, cherekedza mamiriro apo vose vanoenda, uye unyore kutambira kune rukudzo nekutenda.

20261122-korean-l2-2.title: Kutenda shamwari, kutenda mudzidzisi
20261122-korean-l2-2.summary: 서준 akapa mudzidzi bhuku uye mudzidzi akanyora kudzoka: '책 줘서 고마워!' Zvino mudzidzisi wa서준 anopa 서준 bhuku, uye 서준 anoda kutumira meseji inenge yakafanana kumudzidzisi.
20261122-korean-l2-2.principle: Zvose chiito chinotaura zvakaitwa nemudzidzisi (줘서 inova 주셔서) neizwi rekutenda (고마워 inova 고맙습니다 kana 감사합니다) zvinoratidza hukama, uye zvinoreva zvinofanira kuramba zviri 'ndatenda nekundipa bhuku'.
20261122-korean-l2-2.example: Tarisa zvinhu zviviri musarudzo imwe neimwe: chiito chezvakaitwa nemudzidzisi neizwi rekutenda.
20261122-korean-l2-2.actionItem: Sarudza kutenda kunokodzera mudzidzisi, wobva wanyora patsva meseji nemazwi ako.

20261122-korean-l3-1.title: Ndiani akapa mari yekudya?
20261122-korean-l3-1.summary:
Vadzidzi vaviri vepaklasi, 지우 ne 하나, vari kuchat nekutaura kunoremekedza kwe -요. MuKorea kazhinji musoro wemutsara (anoita chiitiko) unosiiwa. (댁 = izwi rekuremekedza rekumba kwemumwe munhu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261122-korean-l3-1.principle: Tsamba haitauri musoro wemutsara, asi chimiro chechiito chinoratidza kuti anopa i munhu anofanira kuremekedzwa, uye munhu bedzi akadai munyaya i 할머니, uko 하나 akashanyira. 'Pamwe' yakarurama: tsamba haitauri zvakananga.
20261122-korean-l3-1.example: Tarisa kupera kwe 주셨어요 uye uienzanise ne 먹었어요 mumutsara wapfuura.
20261122-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Fungidzira kuti musoro wemutsara wakasiiwa unoreva ani, ratidza humbowo mutsamba, uye utaure kuti fungidziro inochinja sei kana chiratidzo chimwe chabviswa.

20261122-korean-l3-2.title: Mutsara mumwe usina kujairika mukuzvisimudzira
20261122-korean-l3-2.summary: Mudzidzi mutsva, 이민수, anozvisimudzira kuklasi. Mitsara shanu inoratidzwa. Mutsara mumwe unonzwika usina kujairika kumuteereri weKorea.
20261122-korean-l3-2.principle: Mutsara 2 usina kujairika. 님 i zita rinowedzerwa kumazita evamwe kuratidza kuremekedza. Kuiisa pazita rako pachako kunonzwika sekuzvirumbidza. Mimwe mitsara yakanaka pakuzvisimudzira kuklasi.
20261122-korean-l3-2.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe nenzwi sekunge uri kutaura kuklasi yako. Upi waizoita kuti vanoteerera vanyemwe?
20261122-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsara uri mukuzvisimudzira unonzwika usina kujairika, taura kuti sei, uye uunyore patsva kuti unzwike zvakajairika.

20261122-korean-l4-1.title: Bhuka imba
20261122-korean-l4-1.summary:
Boka renyu rinoda kushandisa imba yeshure kwechikoro. Verenga chiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka renyu 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261122-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 inosanganisira 3시 ~ 4시, apo imba iri kuchenesa. Chirongwa chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kutariswa kune nguva yacho yese, kwete kutanga bedzi.
20261122-korean-l4-1.example: Nyora awa rekutanga neawa rekupera rechirongwa.
20261122-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Batanidza mitemo yeimba kubva muchiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka wako uye utsvage zvirongwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana zvekubhuka zvinogutsa mamiriro ese.

20261123-korean-l2-2.title: Kutenda shamwari, kutenda mudzidzisi

20261123-korean-l3-1.title: Ndiani akapa mari yekudya?
20261123-korean-l3-1.summary:
Vadzidzi vaviri vepaklasi, 지우 ne 하나, vari kuchat nekutaura kunoremekedza kwe -요. MuKorea kazhinji musoro wemutsara (anoita chiitiko) unosiiwa. (댁 = izwi rekuremekedza rekumba kwemumwe munhu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!

20261123-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Fungidzira kuti musoro wemutsara wakasiiwa unoreva ani, ratidza humbowo mutsamba, uye utaure kuti fungidziro inochinja sei kana chiratidzo chimwe chabviswa.

20261123-korean-l3-2.title: Mutsara mumwe usina kujairika mukuzvisimudzira

20261123-korean-l3-2.principle: Mutsara 2 usina kujairika. 님 i zita rinowedzerwa kumazita evamwe kuratidza kuremekedza. Kuiisa pazita rako pachako kunonzwika sekuzvirumbidza. Mimwe mitsara yakanaka pakuzvisimudzira kuklasi.
20261123-korean-l3-2.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe nenzwi sekunge uri kutaura kuklasi yako. Upi waizoita kuti vanoteerera vanyemwe?
20261123-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsara uri mukuzvisimudzira unonzwika usina kujairika, taura kuti sei, uye uunyore patsva kuti unzwike zvakajairika.

20261123-korean-l4-1.title: Bhuka imba

Boka renyu rinoda kushandisa imba yeshure kwechikoro. Verenga chiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka renyu 서준.

- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261123-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 inosanganisira 3시 ~ 4시, apo imba iri kuchenesa. Chirongwa chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kutariswa kune nguva yacho yese, kwete kutanga bedzi.
20261123-korean-l4-1.example: Nyora awa rekutanga neawa rekupera rechirongwa.
20261123-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Batanidza mitemo yeimba kubva muchiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka wako uye utsvage zvirongwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana zvekubhuka zvinogutsa mamiriro ese.

20261123-korean-l4-2.title: Zvanonoka kuenda kupuri here?
20261123-korean-l4-2.summary:
Ziviso iri pamusuwo wepuri yekushambira, uye shamwari yako 민지 inokutumira meseji.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

20261123-korean-l6-1.summary: Ndi4:20 p.m. Uri pakaunta ye주민센터 (nzvimbo yeushumiri hwedunhu) yedunhu rako. Unoda kukumbira pasipoti. Hauna chokwadi kuti une mufananidzo wepasipoti mubhegi rako here.
20261123-korean-l6-1.principle: Vandudza kuverenga kwako mhinduro dzemukuru wehofisi sezvo kutaurirana kuchiwanda, wobva wabvunza mubvunzo unotevera une musoro.

Uri mudzidzi wegore rekutanga hyunivhesiti. 민준 선배 mukuru wekirabhu, anopfuura iwe nemakore matatu; wakataura naye kaviri chete. Akanyora zvinyorwa zvakanaka muchidzidzo chesvondo rapfuura. Bvunzo yako ndeyemangwana masikati uye unoda kuona zvinyorwa nhasi. Wakanyora madhirafiti mana:

20261123-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Tonga zvikumbiro zvina zvedhirafiti nemataurirwo azvo uye utsanangure kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinoita kuti chikumbiro chibvumirwe nyore, uye dhirafiti dzipi dzinoita sedzine rukudzo dzichiri kusabudirira.
