[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261124-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 inosanganisira 3시 ~ 4시, apo imba iri kuchenesa. Chirongwa chimwe nechimwe chinofanira kutariswa kune nguva yacho yese, kwete kutanga bedzi.
20261124-korean-l4-1.example: Nyora awa rekutanga neawa rekupera rechirongwa.
20261124-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Batanidza mitemo yeimba kubva muchiziviso nemeseji yemumwe webhoka wako uye utsvage zvirongwa zvakawanda zvakasiyana zvekubhuka zvinogutsa mamiriro ese.

20261124-korean-l4-2.title: Zvanonoka kuenda kupuri here?
20261124-korean-l4-2.summary:
Ziviso iri pamusuwo wepuri yekushambira, uye shamwari yako 민지 inokutumira meseji.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

민지: 목요일 수영 수업, 4시 40분까지 가면 돼요?
20261124-korean-l4-2.principle: Pa 목요일 pane kirasi pa 4:30. Musuwo unovharwa kana yatanga, uye ziviso inokumbira vanhu kuuya maminetsi 10 kare (4:20). 4:40 iri shure kwenguva dzose mbiri.
20261124-korean-l4-2.example: Tsvaga 목요일 muziviso uye uverenge nguva yekutanga kirasi.
20261124-korean-l4-2.actionItem: Batanidza ziviso nemeseji yeshamwari kutonga kuti nguva yakarongwa yekusvika inoshanda here, taura mitsara inosarudza, uye unyore mhinduro inopa nguva chaiyo yekupedzisira.

20261124-korean-l5-1.title: Chiziviso chekushanya kwechikoro chine dambudziko renguva
20261124-korean-l5-1.summary: Kirasi yenyu yakagamuchira chiziviso ichi kubva kumudzidzisi nemeseji.
20261124-korean-l5-1.principle: Mitsara 3 ne 4 inopokana: kirasi inosvika pakiki pa 11:30, asi chikafu chemanheru 'mushure mekusvika' chiri pa 11:00. Mitsara 1, 2 ne 5 inoenderana.
20261124-korean-l5-1.example: Isa nguva dzemitsara nenhevedzano uye uienzanise.
20261124-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Tsvaga kupokana muchiziviso chekushanya, sarudza zvingasvikwa, uye unyore mubvunzo unoremekedza unogadzirisa.

20261124-korean-l5-2.title: Mubvunzo upi wandinofanira kubvunza?
20261124-korean-l5-2.summary:
Mudzidzi mukirasi yako Hana anotumira meseji iyi neChitatu. PaSatidha unoshanda kusvika 1:00 p.m., uye unogona kushandisa 10,000 won pachiitiko chete.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261124-korean-l5-2.principle: Miganhu yako miviri inguva yekupera kwebasa (1:00) nebhajeti (10,000 won). Nguva yekutanga inopindura muganhu wekutanga uye huwandu hwemaawa (wakawedzerwa ne 5,000 won) hunopindura wechipiri.
20261124-korean-l5-2.example: Nyora miganhu yako miviri kutanga, wobva wabvunza kuti dimikira ripi rinoshaikwa raizokubvumira kuedza muganhu mumwe nemumwe.
20261124-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Sarudza ruzivo rupi rwunoshaikwa rwaunoda usati wabvuma kukoka, wobva wazvikumbira zvakanyatsoita muchiKorea chine rukudzo.

20261124-korean-l6-1.title: Ndinokumbira kupi?
20261124-korean-l6-1.summary: Ndi4:20 p.m. Uri pakaunta ye주민센터 (nzvimbo yeushumiri hwedunhu) yedunhu rako. Unoda kukumbira pasipoti. Hauna chokwadi kuti une mufananidzo wepasipoti mubhegi rako here.
20261124-korean-l6-1.principle: Vandudza kuverenga kwako mhinduro dzemukuru wehofisi sezvo kutaurirana kuchiwanda, wobva wabvunza mubvunzo unotevera une musoro.
20261124-korean-l6-1.example: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
20261124-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Vandudza kuverenga kwako mhinduro dzemukuru wehofisi sezvo kutaurirana kuchiwanda, wobva wabvunza mubvunzo unotevera une musoro.

20261124-korean-l6-2.title: Dhirafiti ipi ichabvumirwa nemukuru?
20261124-korean-l6-2.summary:
Uri mudzidzi wegore rekutanga hyunivhesiti. 민준 선배 mukuru wekirabhu, anopfuura iwe nemakore matatu; wakataura naye kaviri chete. Akanyora zvinyorwa zvakanaka muchidzidzo chesvondo rapfuura. Bvunzo yako ndeyemangwana masikati uye unoda kuona zvinyorwa nhasi. Wakanyora madhirafiti mana:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261124-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B inobvunza kuti zvinogoneka here (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inopa chikonzero, uye chikonzero chinoratidza kumanikidzwa kwenguva. Draft C ine rukudzo zvakanyanya asi haitaure kuti inodiwa mangwana, saka mukuru angapindura svondo rinouya. Draft A haina kuswedera rukudzo kumukuru ari kure, uye Draft D inomumanikidza.
20261124-korean-l6-2.example: Enzanisa kuti dhirafiti imwe neimwe inonzwika sekunge yakanyorerwa ani.
20261124-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Tonga zvikumbiro zvina zvedhirafiti nemataurirwo azvo uye utsanangure kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinoita kuti chikumbiro chibvumirwe nyore, uye dhirafiti dzipi dzinoita sedzine rukudzo dzichiri kusabudirira.

20261125-korean-l1-1.title: Ndeipi chiratidzo chinotungamirira kupaki yemotokari?
20261125-korean-l1-1.summary:
"Muenzi anokwira kuchikoro ndokuda kusiya motokari kwehawa imwe. Masaini matatu ari kuonekwa (pasina mifananidzo, saka akatsanangurwa nemashoko).

Sign A: mavara machena '주차 금지' pabhodhi dzvuku. Denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse wakatsemuka rinoyambuka mufananidzo mudiki wemotokari. Rakasungirirwa kuuzivi hwechikoro.
Sign B: bhodhi dzvuku bhuruu, mavara machena '방문자 주차장' nemubvi unotarisa kurudyi. Umire padivi pemugwagwa.
Sign C: bhodhi girini, mavara machena '주차장 출구' nemubvi unotarisa kumashure kumugwagwa. Rakarembera pamusoro penzira dzakamanikana apo motokari dzinobuda.

Mazwi: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit."
20261125-korean-l1-1.principle: Saini B ndeyevaenzi, inotumidza paki yemotokari uye inopa nzira. Saini A ine izwi rekutanga rimwe chete asi ine chiratidzo chekurambidza. Saini C inotumidzawo paki yemotokari, asi 출구 zvinoreva kubuda, saka inoratidza pakubuda motokari.
20261125-korean-l1-1.example: Rondedzera zvinotaurwa nesaini imwe neimwe nemashoko, nezvinowedzerwa nechiratidzo chayo kana mubvi.
20261125-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Verenga masaini matatu pfupi emugwagwa, batanidza mazwi nemubvi nechiratidzo chakatsanangurwa, uye utonge kuti ndeipi inotungamirira kunoita kuti muenzi aise motokari; dzivirira kutonga kwako pamberi pekuverenga kwakapera hafu kweshamwari.

20261125-korean-l1-2.title: Unogona kupinda muraibhurari rinhi?
20261125-korean-l1-2.summary:
Chiratidzo pamusuo weraibhurari (mutsetse mumwe pamutsara mumwe):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Mazwi: 오전 = mangwanani (a.m.); 오후 = masikati/manheru (p.m.); 낮 = masikati; 쉬어요 = (inozorora); ~ inoverengwa 'to' (kubva ... kusvika ...). Unoda kushanyira musi weChitatu.
20261125-korean-l1-2.principle: Mitsetse 2 ne3 inoshanda pazuva rimwe nerimwe rakajairika. Mutsetse 1 izita uye mutsetse 4 unotaura nezve Sunday chete.
20261125-korean-l1-2.example: Bvunza mutsetse mumwe nomumwe: unoshanda musi weChitatu here?
20261125-korean-l1-2.actionItem: Verenga chiratidzo chine mitsetse yakawanda, sarudza mitsetse ipi inokosha pazuva rakapiwa, wobva watsvaga nguva dzakawanda dzekusvika dzinokodzera dzose.

20261125-korean-l2-1.title: Ndiani anoenda, ndiani anoramba?
20261125-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 mudzidzi uye anotaura nerukudzo kuvakuru. Katatu 지우 anoti goodbye. Tarisa kuti ndiani anofamba uye ndiani anoramba pavari.

Scene 1: 지우 anopedza kutaura mukamuri ya선생님 uye anobuda. 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
Scene 2: 지우 ne 선생님 vanobuda muchikoro pamwe chete. Pagedhi vanofamba nzira dzakasiyana.
Scene 3: 지우 anodya kudya kwemanheru kumba ka할머니. Wobva aenda kumba. 할머니 anoramba kumba.
20261125-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 inotaurwa nemunhu ari kuenda kumunhu ari kuramba. 지우 anobuda uye 선생님 anoramba padesiki.
20261125-korean-l2-1.example: Bvunza: ndiani ari kufamba achienda, uye ndiani ari kuramba mukamuri?
20261125-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Sarudza kuti kutambira kupi kunokodzera kubva kune ari kuenda neari kuramba, cherekedza mamiriro apo vose vanoenda, uye unyore kutambira kune rukudzo nekutenda.

20261125-korean-l2-2.title: Kutenda shamwari, kutenda mudzidzisi
20261125-korean-l2-2.summary: 서준 akapa mudzidzi bhuku uye mudzidzi akanyora kudzoka: '책 줘서 고마워!' Zvino mudzidzisi wa서준 anopa 서준 bhuku, uye 서준 anoda kutumira meseji inenge yakafanana kumudzidzisi.
20261125-korean-l2-2.principle: Zvose chiito chinotaura zvakaitwa nemudzidzisi (줘서 inova 주셔서) neizwi rekutenda (고마워 inova 고맙습니다 kana 감사합니다) zvinoratidza hukama, uye zvinoreva zvinofanira kuramba zviri 'ndatenda nekundipa bhuku'.
20261125-korean-l2-2.example: Tarisa zvinhu zviviri musarudzo imwe neimwe: chiito chezvakaitwa nemudzidzisi neizwi rekutenda.
20261125-korean-l2-2.actionItem: Sarudza kutenda kunokodzera mudzidzisi, wobva wanyora patsva meseji nemazwi ako.

20261125-korean-l3-1.title: Ndiani akapa mari yekudya?
20261125-korean-l3-1.summary:
Vadzidzi vaviri vepaklasi, 지우 ne 하나, vari kuchat nekutaura kunoremekedza kwe -요. MuKorea kazhinji musoro wemutsara (anoita chiitiko) unosiiwa. (댁 = izwi rekuremekedza rekumba kwemumwe munhu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261125-korean-l3-1.principle: Tsamba haitauri musoro wemutsara, asi chimiro chechiito chinoratidza kuti anopa i munhu anofanira kuremekedzwa, uye munhu bedzi akadai munyaya i 할머니, uko 하나 akashanyira. 'Pamwe' yakarurama: tsamba haitauri zvakananga.
20261125-korean-l3-1.example: Tarisa kupera kwe 주셨어요 uye uienzanise ne 먹었어요 mumutsara wapfuura.
20261125-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Fungidzira kuti musoro wemutsara wakasiiwa unoreva ani, ratidza humbowo mutsamba, uye utaure kuti fungidziro inochinja sei kana chiratidzo chimwe chabviswa.

20261125-korean-l3-2.title: Mutsara mumwe usina kujairika mukuzvisimudzira
20261125-korean-l3-2.summary: Mudzidzi mutsva, 이민수, anozvisimudzira kuklasi. Mitsara shanu inoratidzwa. Mutsara mumwe unonzwika usina kujairika kumuteereri weKorea.
20261125-korean-l3-2.principle: Mutsara 2 usina kujairika. 님 i zita rinowedzerwa kumazita evamwe kuratidza kuremekedza. Kuiisa pazita rako pachako kunonzwika sekuzvirumbidza. Mimwe mitsara yakanaka pakuzvisimudzira kuklasi.
20261125-korean-l3-2.example: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe nenzwi sekunge uri kutaura kuklasi yako. Upi waizoita kuti vanoteerera vanyemwe?
20261125-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Tsvaga mutsara uri mukuzvisimudzira unonzwika usina kujairika, taura kuti sei, uye uunyore patsva kuti unzwike zvakajairika.

20261118-life-all.title: Leave the Microwave Center Empty
20261118-life-all.summary: Arranging food in a ring on the plate makes a microwave heat more evenly.
20261118-life-all.principle: Microwaves at 2.45GHz form standing waves with wavelength λ = c/f ≈ 12.2cm, creating hot and cold spots.
20261118-life-all.example: The plate center often gets less energy and stays cold. A ring layout plus one stir midway can cut temperature differences by 20°C or more.
20261118-life-all.actionItem: Today arrange food in a ring with the middle empty and stir halfway through.

20261119-life-all-2.title: Bubble Wrap Window Insulation
20261119-life-all-2.summary: Sticking bubble wrap to a window traps still air that cuts heat loss sharply.
20261119-life-all-2.principle: Still air conducts only about 0.026W/m · K, 1/40 of glass (1.0). In Q = UAΔT the coefficient U falls.
20261119-life-all-2.example: A 2m² single pane with a 20°C indoor-outdoor gap and U ≈ 5.8 loses 232W. Bubble wrap lowering U to about 3.5 gives 140W, saving roughly 90W.
20261119-life-all-2.actionItem: Today spray water on a window and press bubble wrap, flat side to the glass.

20261123-life-all-1.principle: Microwaves at 2.45GHz form standing waves with wavelength λ = c/f ≈ 12.2cm, creating hot and cold spots.
20261123-life-all-1.example: The plate center often gets less energy and stays cold. A ring layout plus one stir midway can cut temperature differences by 20°C or more.
20261123-life-all-1.actionItem: Today arrange food in a ring with the middle empty and stir halfway through.

20261123-life-all-2.title: Bubble Wrap Window Insulation
20261123-life-all-2.summary: Sticking bubble wrap to a window traps still air that cuts heat loss sharply.
20261123-life-all-2.principle: Still air conducts only about 0.026W/m · K, 1/40 of glass (1.0). In Q = UAΔT the coefficient U falls.
20261123-life-all-2.example: A 2m² single pane with a 20°C indoor-outdoor gap and U ≈ 5.8 loses 232W. Bubble wrap lowering U to about 3.5 gives 140W, saving roughly 90W.
20261123-life-all-2.actionItem: Today spray water on a window and press bubble wrap, flat side to the glass.
